dos:03e2fe504d44ba25.description: A first-person shooter in which space pilot Mash Hardrock is hired by the Jupiter Moon Mining Corporation for a rescue operation, driving a moon buggy armed with a mining laser.
dos:03e2fe504d44ba25.title: Robot Redemption

dos:03e8ecd0f7b0c524.description: A SimCity-family simulation: save or develop the rainforest across 40 different isles, hiring people with differing environmental concerns. Includes custom isles.
dos:03e8ecd0f7b0c524.title: SimIsle: Missions in the Rainforest

dos:03effd5d0c8143ae.description: Burst colored bubbles by linking three of the same color, aiming your shots at the right angle. The game ends when bubbles crowd past the bottom line.
dos:03effd5d0c8143ae.title: Bust-A-Move Again

dos:03ff0a746de38072.description: A Highlander game originally released only on the Atari Jaguar; this is the unreleased PC version, which leaked online.
dos:03ff0a746de38072.title: Highlander: Last of the Macleods

dos:04030aa5c5450f94.description: A Boulder Dash-style game. As Joe Kowalski, make your way to the exit of six increasingly difficult caverns, each to be finished within five minutes, while avoiding enemies such as grabbers.
dos:04030aa5c5450f94.title: Blow Up!

dos:040a46b8b01d48c8.description: A platform action game in which Tal single-handedly clears aliens from a post-nuclear Earth. He must find a sacred suit of armor that shields him from radiation, heals him and lets him float.
dos:040a46b8b01d48c8.title: Rad Warrior

dos:040dc62ac01f7537.description: Papyrus's second racing game, four years after Indianapolis 500. Official license with all eight real tracks, sponsors and logos, multiple TV-style replays and a comprehensive garage and setup.
dos:040dc62ac01f7537.title: IndyCar Racing

dos:0421d8ce8a852311.description: A two-player shareware strategy game fought with charged tokens. A 16x10 grid is filled with red and blue counters, split between opposite halves of the screen.
dos:0421d8ce8a852311.title: Battle Charge

dos:042833b1f33cc253.description: An action game in which a Chinese prince fights dark opponents with his sword and spells such as magical arrows and fireballs, finding new magical weapons to defeat dragons and bosses.
dos:042833b1f33cc253.title: Prince of Evil

dos:042c0bd0f3f118b3.description: A platform game in which the shaman sorcerer Mabin sealed four classic movie monsters (Dracula, Frankenstein's monster, the Mummy and the Wolf Man) into a vessel, and the heroes Duchi and Bbukku deal with the consequences.
dos:042c0bd0f3f118b3.title: Duchi & Bbukku

dos:042d686e3c212131.description: Shao Kahn has won and Earthrealm is overrun. Using the Outworld Tournament as a diversion, he revives his Queen Sindel on Earth, and the fighters left must stop his extermination squads in one-on-one combat.
dos:042d686e3c212131.title: Mortal Kombat 3

dos:042e2a314893ad31.description: A text adventure from Australia, full of irreverent humor in the style of Infocom and Douglas Adams, with built-in pop-up hints.
dos:042e2a314893ad31.title: The Multi-Dimensional Thief

dos:04327f9f3861b0b3.description: An action game with light puzzle-solving. Travel through eight time periods, from Prehistoric and Roman Empire to Feudal Japan, Wild West and the Future, each with its own enemies and weapons.
dos:04327f9f3861b0b3.title: Time Commando

dos:0434b56f16510e29.description: A cyberpunk RPG based on When Gravity Fails. As private investigator Marid Audran, solve a murder in the Budayeen district, gather clues, buy cybernetic upgrades and survive turn-based fights.
dos:0434b56f16510e29.title: Circuit's Edge

dos:044717f2e071c71f.description: Based on Buichi Terasawa's space pirate Cobra. After a message from Dominique, held prisoner by Salamandar, Cobra and his cybernetic partner Lady enter isometric arenas to rescue her.
dos:044717f2e071c71f.title: Cobra (1987)

dos:045e8bbc3d5cb1dc.description: A German action game like Crillion, sequel to Bubble Blobb. It is like Breakout, but you control the ball directly: it bounces up and down on its own, and you steer it left and right.
dos:045e8bbc3d5cb1dc.title: Bubble Blobb II

dos:0472d68a36d1fc3f.description: A medieval city adventure in which you play an honest thief who must stop a plot to assassinate the Duke. Arcade sequences such as fighting guards and climbing walls combine with talking to characters and collecting items.
dos:0472d68a36d1fc3f.title: Shadows of Cairn

dos:04764827b99da6db.description: Based on the French TV game show. Take on the challenges of the island fortress with daring, strength and speed, facing the Fortress Council overseen by Father Fouras. Multiplayer.
tags: Action; Interactive Movie; Strategy; Game Show
dos:04764827b99da6db.title: Fort Boyard: The Challenge

dos:04782cfa428ff2eb.description: A side-scrolling action game across six levels. Play Elliot Ness going after mob boss Al Capone, picking up weapons such as a shotgun and tommy gun, and watch out for Capone's henchmen.
dos:04782cfa428ff2eb.title: The Untouchables

dos:047e513b2af72bcd.description: Part of the NBA Jam series. Choose from over 40 real college teams for head-to-head, tournament and season play, with arcade-style two-on-two basketball and wild dunks.
dos:047e513b2af72bcd.title: College Slam

dos:04975f18140d832b.description: An early fishing simulator in which you enter a bass competition with pro Rich Tauber as your partner. More than 20 lure types and colors, techniques from casting to flipping and jigging, and a working fish finder.
dos:04975f18140d832b.title: Rich Tauber's Bass Champ

dos:0497eee22e48defe.description: A Korean rail-shooter by Daekyo Computer that nearly filled a CD-ROM with prerendered animation, made openly to imitate and improve on Rebel Assault.
dos:0497eee22e48defe.title: Time on Target

dos:049bb29848826682.description: A text adventure with a random geography and consistently logical puzzles, like Zork or Colossal Cave, giving a complete treasure hunt that can be replayed endlessly.
dos:049bb29848826682.title: Chimaera

dos:04aa7dc034ace3d8.description: A top-down role-playing game with 256-color graphics and a mouse interface. As the Guildmaster, you explore a huge world after an invitation to visit. A complete game.
dos:04aa7dc034ace3d8.title: Ultizurk 3: The Guildmaster's Quest

dos:04afa7f0a240e7b5.description: A shareware single-variant solitaire game played entirely with the mouse: click the pack to deal, then move cards around the clock.
dos:04afa7f0a240e7b5.title: Clock Solitaire

dos:04bb945c2842cf2a.description: A first-person shooting gallery set in what could be 1930s Chicago. Shoot the gangsters who pop up in backyards and streets before they shoot you.
dos:04bb945c2842cf2a.title: Dugsy

dos:04be1b27d1f9922e.description: An SSI-style top-down role-playing game. Create a party of eight characters and travel a scrolling land of towns, mazes and dungeons in search of the Emperor's stolen crown, with tactical combat.
dos:04be1b27d1f9922e.title: Wizard's Crown

dos:04c2819f850f0d41.description: In the year 691 of the celestial calendar the dimensional control computer Laxis goes rogue and flees to another era. In the power suit Arouza, with a dimensional controller, you hunt it down.
dos:04c2819f850f0d41.title: Feedback

dos:04d0773b4cc06a8e.description: Two-on-two beach volleyball with serves, thumps and spikes. 15 levels and 20 challengers on beaches such as Rio, Hawaii and Sydney, working toward being crowned King of the Beach.
dos:04d0773b4cc06a8e.title: Kings of the Beach

dos:04d1b6427d9092d0.description: Pilot a starglider along a road through space, avoiding obstacles and holes without running out of fuel or oxygen. The full version has 30 roads in 10 areas.
dos:04d1b6427d9092d0.title: SkyRoads

dos:04e2252b3cedd351.description: A text adventure in which you must save your domed city from the Outsiders, under a time limit for the whole game and a shorter one for finding a way to protect the city.
dos:04e2252b3cedd351.title: Mutant Invasion

dos:04e3e083e8bf4e97.description: A Sesame Street educational game for one in which children practice counting, adding and subtracting in five activities, such as How Many Zips? and Beam That Number.
dos:04e3e083e8bf4e97.title: Astro-Grover

dos:04e7a2658afd00c2.description: A real-time strategy game focused on managing units rather than building bases, licensed from AD&D in the Forgotten Realms. Five storylines of increasing difficulty with three missions each.
dos:04e7a2658afd00c2.title: Blood & Magic

dos:04f06cacbf43cf16.description: A beat-'em-up with detailed graphics. As a cyborg handyman, you fight your way through the robots of a megacorporation to reach the core and deactivate the evil AI that controls them.
dos:04f06cacbf43cf16.title: Rise of the Robots

dos:04fcfb702759c3d8.description: A parser-driven adventure in the style of King's Quest, set in Pompeii in 79 A.D. As Avaricius, a wealthy Roman, escape the city before the volcano erupts.
dos:04fcfb702759c3d8.title: Denarius Avaricius Sextus

dos:05084961d33ca903.description: A puzzle game about making loops: place random pieces, from lines and corners to S bends and other shapes, on a grid and link them into a closed loop to move on.
dos:05084961d33ca903.title: Loopz

dos:050f5c9b8dc63a2b.description: A clone of Taito's Space Invaders modeled closely on the original arcade game. Move left and right at the bottom of the screen shooting rows of aliens, with those at the top worth more.
dos:050f5c9b8dc63a2b.title: Invaders 1978

dos:051d9a80bee80e50.description: Lars the Wanderer's medieval homeland is invaded by tiny yellow smilies in futuristic machines. With Mimi, the mad scientist's daughter, from the future, he sets out to stop them.
dos:051d9a80bee80e50.title: Lars The Wanderer

dos:052c8462b9d86944.description: A no-frills version of Pong plus a Breakout variant, duplicating the originals almost exactly, without flashy graphics or sound effects.
dos:052c8462b9d86944.title: PLBM Pong-Out

dos:05345bf3f701e58c.description: Sequel to Dark Designs I: Grelminar's Staff. Adventurers journey to Mount Delkeina, through its tunnels, to defeat an evil warlord and close the dimensional gate he uses to raise an army of monsters.
dos:05345bf3f701e58c.title: Dark Designs II: Closing the Gate

dos:053cad72998f299f.description: An arcade puzzle platformer in which you control a ghost, with a different task on each level.
dos:053cad72998f299f.title: Averno

dos:054894245336e921.description: A two-player dogfight on split screen or over a null-modem link, against the computer or a person. Takeoffs and landings are automatic, so you can focus on shooting, and crashes get flyby replays.
dos:054894245336e921.title: SkyChase

dos:054fbafccaf00371.description: Control a US attack submarine in a hybrid of turn-based and real-time play: each turn has a timer, so you need to act fast on the large amount of information shown on screen.
dos:054fbafccaf00371.title: Submarine

dos:05558ec9b0a87c16.description: A side-scrolling action-platform shooter featuring giant mechs, sharp animation and vibrant colors.
dos:05558ec9b0a87c16.title: SAF: Secret Armored Force

dos:05736dd117708a97.description: A futuristic overhead tank shooter set in the year 3871. As the lone survivor of a frontier outpost attacked by alien larvae, pilot a security drone around each sector and repair the communication links to alert the Federation.
dos:05736dd117708a97.title: Xenopods

dos:05748735852cbd42.description: A strategic and managerial wargame by GDG: command conquistadors in exploration, colonization and battle on land and sea on a fictive planet called Paradise.
dos:05748735852cbd42.title: Spoils of War

dos:057feddfc428ec30.description: An overhead pool game designed to be easy to control, with UK and US 8-ball and 9-ball games, customizable rules, computer opponents of varying skill, two-player play and a Survivor mode.
dos:057feddfc428ec30.title: Arcade Pool

dos:0583cb4e29f78c10.description: A basic protected-mode Tetris from 1998, with no options or difficulty selection. Later levels bring new backgrounds, music and pre-filled blocks.
dos:0583cb4e29f78c10.title: Tetris Gold Professional

dos:0586392077da0981.description: A Gold Box AD&D role-playing game. A magical well brings adventurers to a frozen town under siege; create up to six characters, explore in first person and fight turn-based battles.
dos:0586392077da0981.title: Secret of The Silver Blades

dos:05873fa7b56f64eb.description: A shareware strategy game for one or two players on a grid of lines. Players take turns naming coordinates, with the objective of creating triangles.
dos:05873fa7b56f64eb.title: Fencing

dos:059eb5863ec03dcd.description: An isometric shoot-'em-up from the arcades. Destroy the Zaxxon defence system in three stages, starting with the aircraft, guns and missiles of Asteroid City.
dos:059eb5863ec03dcd.title: Zaxxon

dos:05b12d840232bcce.description: An educational U.S. geography simulation with 19 scenarios. Drive an 18-wheel truck around the country picking up and delivering commodities, using commands such as turning on the motor and examining the map.
dos:05b12d840232bcce.title: Crosscountry USA

dos:05cb0f66eaafaf93.description: A third-person 3D racing game for one or two players with rudimentary physics and dynamic lighting. Eight cars (three models in different colors) and 15 tracks.
dos:05cb0f66eaafaf93.title: Rally Sport

dos:05cc07a7f13a69cf.description: Duke fights an alien invasion across a futuristic Los Angeles in a first-person shooter built around exploration, secrets and interactive scenery, with an unusual arsenal.
dos:05cc07a7f13a69cf.title: Duke Nukem 3D

dos:05de8159f08008a6.description: A side-scrolling Defender-style shooter. Pilot a small armed craft against invading aliens who abduct humans, and clear each stage by destroying all the Hunters that capture them.
dos:05de8159f08008a6.title: Glook

dos:05e131c1502de325.description: A battleship game: find and sink all the enemy ships before your opponent sinks yours.
dos:05e131c1502de325.title: Ocean Battle

dos:05e870d88339e605.description: A mostly text-based strategy game with arcade elements, based on Anne McCaffrey's stories of the dragons of Pern.
dos:05e870d88339e605.title: Dragonriders of Pern

dos:05ec401dbb71e2dc.description: An educational adventure for ages 6 to 8. The Master of Mischief has frozen Treasure Mountain with a weather machine, and you restore it by finding treasures and returning them to the castle at the top, solving math problems.
dos:05ec401dbb71e2dc.title: Super Solvers Treasure MathStorm!

dos:0600e8854755c9b5.description: A preschool educational game starring ALF, companion to Alf's Thinking Skills. Several mini-games teach the English alphabet and basic words.
dos:0600e8854755c9b5.title: ALF's World of Words

dos:0602e7227bf216d9.description: A Boulder Dash-style game. Explorer Logan Maxwell, after studying a thousand-year-old puzzle in the south of Africa, goes mining for jewels.
dos:0602e7227bf216d9.title: Lomax Boulders

dos:0618351a69a089df.description: A computer version of Scrabble: draw seven tiles and form words for points, against a friend or the computer at one of nine levels.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Education; Strategy
dos:0618351a69a089df.title: Scrabble: Deluxe Edition

dos:061ae83afc65318e.description: Sequel to Al Pond. Al lands on Nonytoonyfatso Island and has to find Chief Nakimuga and free him from Arabian terrorists.
dos:061ae83afc65318e.title: Al Pond 2: Island Quest

dos:062278003ebabbad.description: A text adventure in which you must steal an experimental laser weapon from a secret Soviet research complex in Antarctica, with a strict time limit and randomly appearing guards.
dos:062278003ebabbad.title: Terror in the Ice Caverns

dos:062d4dec4deec764.description: A basic shooter with twin-stick style controls: one set of keys moves you, another sets which direction you fire.
dos:062d4dec4deec764.title: Fighter (1998)

dos:062f17b217caaf3a.description: A Korean horizontal shoot-'em-up with text-heavy menus, responsive controls and vivid backgrounds.
dos:062f17b217caaf3a.title: SungSegi

dos:062f3e3002790611.description: Young Daniel is asked for help by the Foodys, small aliens from planet Foody, whose diet board has been destroyed and scattered. A platform game about healthy food.
dos:062f3e3002790611.title: The Secret of Foody

dos:0630026cbb17ab97.description: A top-down racer in which every car goes at the same speed, with 18 tracks. Win each race to see the next track, and earn 800 pounds to spend in a shop on car upgrades such as nitro.
dos:0630026cbb17ab97.title: Carnage

dos:064cb80053f73381.description: An action RPG starring Samtong, a round yellow ex-mascot who becomes a hero when an evil overlord kidnaps the princess of a fantasy country.
dos:064cb80053f73381.title: Super Samtong

dos:064edcee0088e353.description: The TV game show as a game: someone draws on the board and you work out what it represents, often a common expression shown literally, such as a light bulb over a head for "bright idea."
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Game Show; Puzzle
dos:064edcee0088e353.title: Win, Lose or Draw

dos:06508afad9c43e91.description: A homemade Dragon Ball fighting game with sprites that appear to be taken from another game.
dos:06508afad9c43e91.title: Dragon Ball

dos:065fa4b63afbefe8.description: A platform action game starring a dragon on roller blades.
dos:065fa4b63afbefe8.title: Skate Dragon

dos:0665e94feaabf4af.description: A maze strategy game from ADM Computers in which a dragon is placed in a maze.
dos:0665e94feaabf4af.title: Doni's Mazes

dos:0668e3dc426ac914.description: A side-scrolling shooter in which you play Rodge Rock, collecting power-ups and shooting everything in sight.
dos:0668e3dc426ac914.title: Rodge Rock in Retroactive

dos:0669cc0b09f1401e.description: An educational geography quiz about Europe, teaching facts about the continent's countries, such as which borders which.
dos:0669cc0b09f1401e.title: GeoTutor 1: Europe

dos:06719edea5aedc6e.description: Connect Four in EGA graphics: drop dots into slots to get four in a row horizontally, vertically or diagonally.
dos:06719edea5aedc6e.title: EGA Connect Four

dos:06740458c5c73a59.description: A top-down racing game with combat elements.
dos:06740458c5c73a59.title: Hot Speed

dos:06788a2b7dccc31e.description: A Tetris clone billed as the first in SVGA, with identical gameplay and backgrounds and music.
dos:06788a2b7dccc31e.title: Tetris Pro

dos:067f9d1d826c63e4.description: The 1992 free Christmas demo of Lemmings, promoting Lemmings and Oh No! More Lemmings. Four new levels with Christmas songs and Lemmings in Santa outfits in snowscapes.
dos:067f9d1d826c63e4.title: Xmas Lemmings (1992)

dos:06978ac7701d1b51.description: A tennis game in Mindscape's 4D Sports series, with simple untextured 3D polygon graphics and advanced replay features.
dos:06978ac7701d1b51.title: 4D Sports Tennis

dos:0699cbfb5bfea482.description: American tourist George Stobbart barely escapes a cafe bombing in Paris and investigates the killer's clues, uncovering a mystery tied to the Knights Templar. The first Broken Sword game.
dos:0699cbfb5bfea482.title: Circle of Blood

dos:069ca274d07c5c77.description: Lemmings sequel with a bigger plot. The Lemmings have split into 12 tribes with their own landscapes, including Egyptian, Circus and Highland, and Lemming Island is in danger.
dos:069ca274d07c5c77.title: Lemmings 2: The Tribes

dos:069e427f8f356e00.description: A text-only adventure aboard Columbus, a generation ship and humanity's first attempt to reach the stars. You were born aboard, and resources are scarce.
dos:069e427f8f356e00.title: Starship Columbus

dos:06b21ab2e21338d4.description: A puzzle game in which you defend your Fuzzball from the enemy in square worlds while collecting all the keys or cards to enter the next level. 15 levels in five worlds.
dos:06b21ab2e21338d4.title: Freakin' Funky Fuzzballs

dos:06b229e0525f08bb.description: Pilot a rocket ship across an asteroid field. It moves right at a fixed speed and is pulled down by gravity, and the Shift key gives upward thrust.
dos:06b229e0525f08bb.title: Asteroid Pilot

dos:06c1b796fc815b3a.description: An arcade game in which you help a hedgehog cross several obstacle courses. Four levels, three lives.
dos:06c1b796fc815b3a.title: Hedgehog

dos:06d8ef0f69d0da5c.description: A computer version of the board game Clue. Mr. Boddy has been murdered; find the killer, weapon and place by deduction from the cards the computer deals out.
dos:06d8ef0f69d0da5c.title: Clue: Master Detective

dos:06e4cd1608ce121a.description: A PC version of Atari's Gravitar, with minimal Asteroids-style graphics. Fly a small ship among planets around a sun, fighting gravity as you go.
dos:06e4cd1608ce121a.title: Gravitar

dos:06f97cccd5eec508.description: A Formula One simulation made with the support of Scuderia Ferrari, set in 1986. Your job starts at the Maranello factory, where you perfect the car and test aerodynamics in the wind tunnel, before racing.
dos:06f97cccd5eec508.title: Ferrari Formula One

dos:06fbc625be04837a.description: Act as a judge deciding sentences in a series of criminal cases: weigh the circumstances, request evidence, and compare your decision with the game's judge. Requesting more information reduces your points.
dos:06fbc625be04837a.title: Crime and Punishment

dos:0700c0b00b9348da.description: Third in a series of horizontal shooters about a monkey, with power-ups, experience points, responsive controls and vibrant art.
dos:0700c0b00b9348da.title: Sibal Monkey Adventure 3

dos:070f391cc5921c35.description: A Spanish show jumping game with a side view and simple arcade controls.
dos:070f391cc5921c35.title: A La Carrera

dos:072f1e60e849907f.description: A top-down arcade racer against miniature opponents with twenty levels, played against the computer or up to three friends on one keyboard, with obstacles from oil slicks to tornadoes.
dos:072f1e60e849907f.title: Race!

dos:0730f8c1804b0e37.description: A Tron light-cycle clone: make your opponents crash into your tail. Up to four players, any of them computer-controlled, with many options you can save.
dos:0730f8c1804b0e37.title: Cycle Warz

dos:073d974b54c897af.description: Take control of an ant colony and build it up to conquer the other colonies in the yard, fighting foes such as spiders and humans. Includes a Quick Game option and a tutorial.
dos:073d974b54c897af.title: SimAnt

dos:073dd66d54482bcd.description: A text adventure in an unknown, strange world, where the Usurper seizes the rights of others and spreads tyranny over the innocent.
dos:073dd66d54482bcd.title: The Usurper: The Mines Of Qyntárr

dos:073fb0f8b60ee2d0.description: Your small plane has crashed in the Sierra Nevada. A topographic map shows a ranger outpost, your only hope, but you don't know where on the map you are.
dos:073fb0f8b60ee2d0.title: Wilderness: A Survival Adventure

dos:07415b616413341a.description: Sequel to Lethal Tender. As super spy Nick Hunter, take back into custody the international terrorist Bruno Riggs, who has escaped jail with the help of a new terrorist cell.
dos:07415b616413341a.title: Terminal Terror

dos:0756d0f6899ce296.description: A flight simulator in which you fly the F/A-18, F-16 and F-14 in a hypothetical Soviet invasion of the US west coast, with patrols, bombing runs, cruise missile interception and carrier landings. San Francisco is modeled in detail.
dos:0756d0f6899ce296.title: JetFighter: The Adventure

dos:075d4aa325206794.description: A baseball game in the Micro Sports Pro League Baseball series, with updated rosters from the 1993 season.
dos:075d4aa325206794.title: Pro League Baseball (1994)

dos:076291f1f9f906f6.description: A hex-based, turn-based wargame based on the board game 5th Fleet, for two players, with each day divided into six rounds.
dos:076291f1f9f906f6.title: 5th Fleet

dos:076e1925c85cdc0c.description: A shareware remake of Atari's Asteroids with a Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode, available in the registered version. One or two players.
dos:076e1925c85cdc0c.title: CHAMP Asterocks

dos:07818ce2b042966b.description: Play a giant space slug guarding your territory, devouring the ships of pilots who land there, growing larger as you eat, careful not to eat yourself. Radiation surrounds the territory.
dos:07818ce2b042966b.title: Giant Space Slug

dos:0781b27e4e468f81.description: A shooting game made of eight similar mini-games. Move a gun along the bottom of the screen and shoot turkeys as they descend.
dos:0781b27e4e468f81.title: Tommy's Turkeys

dos:07868a49301e1f56.description: A strategy game of the Battle of the Bulge, December 1944. As the German commander, you must cross the Ardennes forest and reach the far side of the Meuse River.
dos:07868a49301e1f56.title: The Battle of the Bulge: Tigers in the Snow

dos:078e830225c4e035.description: First in the Bumpy series, starring a bouncing head. Choose whether it bumps left or right and how high it bounces, crossing platforms to pick up every item on screen, in the style of Mappy.
dos:078e830225c4e035.title: Bumpy

dos:079b1a56fb42e084.description: A mouse-driven adventure in which amateur inventor Elandra helps amateur rocket builder Mickey Farley, who needs fuel and materials to launch his rocket into space.
dos:079b1a56fb42e084.title: Blast Off

dos:07aad1c3abf7d253.description: As anti-terror agent Max Remington, gather evidence through house searches and wiretaps, decode messages for further clues, and take down the operations of known bad guys for the CIA.
dos:07aad1c3abf7d253.title: Sid Meier's Covert Action

dos:07adc5eade8c3aef.description: An arcade rally racer. Pick a rally car such as a Toyota Celica or Lancia Delta and drive one of four types of track full of obstacles, aiming to win with minimal damage.
dos:07adc5eade8c3aef.title: Deadly Racer

dos:07b756c2508b6582.description: A platformer in which the sorceress Zoldrane has kidnapped and cursed Nicky's grandfather. Find a way past her to take an elixir from her chest and cure him.
dos:07b756c2508b6582.title: Nicky Boom

dos:07b7e27fd87c99be.description: A fan game based on the SNES F-Zero: futuristic hovercar racing with 800x600 graphics, 3D-rendered cars and four tracks laid out like the originals.
dos:07b7e27fd87c99be.title: F-Zero

dos:07bbe06f1f30b19a.description: A Donkey Kong clone and sequel to Aldo's Adventure. Take Aldo to the treasure chest, avoiding falling barrels; remaining time is added to your score.
dos:07bbe06f1f30b19a.title: Aldo Again

dos:07c706c64b741203.description: A one-man top-down CRPG experiment that rebels against genre conventions, exposing arbitrary design and story clichés.
dos:07c706c64b741203.title: Untima IX: Descension

dos:07e2a51accc95795.description: Rise from slavery in Herculaneum to positions of influence in ancient Rome. Adventure sections can be solved in different ways, and military stages put you in command of an army.
dos:07e2a51accc95795.title: Rome: Pathway to Power

dos:07e37c29d4a9798f.description: An arcade racing game in which you race police cars through San Francisco (Cisco), past the Golden Gate Bridge, Chinatown and the Twin Peaks.
dos:07e37c29d4a9798f.title: Cisco Heat: All American Police Car Race

dos:07e70fcb9279bb68.description: A futuristic Risk-style strategy game with production, professions and changing resource values. Start from a small fort and build an empire with ground, air and water forces.
dos:07e70fcb9279bb68.title: Battles of Destiny

dos:07ef24b1579d18e9.description: A 2D shooter in which you pilot a space fighter, shooting through waves of aliens to destroy the enemy's Magnet Power Station before an atomic turbine missile arrives. Warps and special objects help you escape.
dos:07ef24b1579d18e9.title: Juno First

dos:07f40a7571ffe3d9.description: A platformer in which a boy trapped in a comic book escapes through boards of forest animals and deadly traps such as spikes. Collect 33 diamonds to advance, and coins for bonuses.
dos:07f40a7571ffe3d9.title: Mr. Tomato

dos:07f43a4367a649ff.description: A simulation of a Soviet 45-mm M-42 anti-tank gun crew in World War II. Repel Tiger and Panther tanks and suppress firing points, firing at chosen targets and changing the gun's position.
dos:07f43a4367a649ff.title: Tanks' Destroyer

dos:07f9417cba23a954.description: A soccer game featuring top European club teams of 1992 from England, Germany, Scotland, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, France and Sweden, such as Bayern München, Manchester United, Ajax and Real Madrid.
dos:07f9417cba23a954.title: Euro Soccer

dos:07faa5c75e6179c1.description: A Galaxian-style fixed-screen shooter from Epic. Fly your fighter and shoot everything that moves, collecting power-ups such as fruit. Shareware, with three episodes.
dos:07faa5c75e6179c1.title: Kiloblaster

dos:0803d9488b5a9f4d.description: A shareware puzzle game with elements of Pipe Dream. On a grid, place web pieces (bends, straights and crossroads) ahead of a moving spider.
dos:0803d9488b5a9f4d.title: Spider Run

dos:080438b2ef20b795.description: The classic Battleship against the computer, with two limits: no diagonal ships and no adjacent ships (though the computer may place them so).
dos:080438b2ef20b795.title: Battleship (1986)

dos:0812d2093bbb1c3a.description: Rise of the Triad: Dark War. A madman with the power to kill millions has been found, and the HUNT task force is sent to learn his plans. After the infiltration of his island stronghold goes wrong, the only way out is in. First-person shooter with cooperative play.
dos:0812d2093bbb1c3a.title: Rise of the Triad: Dark War

dos:0812f79bef044617.description: A 2D side-scrolling shooter in the style of mid-90s classics, with power-ups, a variety of weapons, shields, accompanying drones and level bosses. Set on a hostile planet in the future, with two-player cooperative play.
dos:0812f79bef044617.title: SideLine

dos:0832266330e1c213.description: In the desert town of Vertic, werewolves, vampires, mummies and zombies feast on the population. Two citizens team up with two professional monster hunters to cleanse the town of evil.
dos:0832266330e1c213.title: Lords of Doom

dos:0866d7e91b4b6051.description: A Taiwanese falling-block puzzle game from Jack Bean Studio, a developer known for its RPGs.
dos:0866d7e91b4b6051.title: Mojing Da Maoxian

dos:08735ae046beb32c.description: A horror interactive fiction game set in a decaying Lovecraftian fishing village. A young couple inherits an ancestral mansion after a death ends the Verlac line, and you play the wife.
dos:08735ae046beb32c.title: Anchorhead

dos:0878507aa4eff707.description: An early computer adaptation of the board game Agravation.
dos:0878507aa4eff707.title: Agravation

dos:087b8245976f7cfd.description: A timed side-scrolling platformer. As Egor Woodenhead, collect the body parts and screws to build Frankenstein's Monster across four locations: village, cemetery, dungeon and castle.
dos:087b8245976f7cfd.title: Frankenstein

dos:087e10bcdc0f7139.description: An educational game from Vision Software. While Yogi naps, Boo Boo wanders off to another national park, and you play Yogi finding him with park maps and Mr. Ranger's help.
dos:087e10bcdc0f7139.title: Yogi Bear visits the National Parks

dos:08814aa079729244.description: A historical wargame of the European and North African theaters of World War II. Up to two players command the Axis or the Allies, with the focus on military aspects and not diplomacy.
dos:08814aa079729244.title: Operation Europe: Path to Victory 1939-45

dos:0884ebecc706a124.description: A flight shooter set in the late 21st century, in which insect-like aliens have invaded Earth. Fly the experimental XF5700 Mantis fighter against the invaders.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Flight Simulator; Vehicle Simulation
dos:0884ebecc706a124.title: XF5700 Mantis Experimental Fighter

dos:089db54f35aa6582.description: A Bullfrog strategy game of owning a theme park. Place rides, paths and queues on your land, leave room for bigger rides as they become available, and add lakes and trees to attract guests.
dos:089db54f35aa6582.title: Theme Park

dos:089f8b476583e54f.description: A side-view action game. As Ryu, a master of martial arts and sword fighting, take on the warlord Achilles with a sword for offense and a shield for defense to bring peace back to the world.
dos:089f8b476583e54f.title: Trojan

dos:08a3e79c0658c0fb.description: A computerized Battleship against the computer, with ten difficulty levels and fleets of eight ships rather than five.
dos:08a3e79c0658c0fb.title: Sea Hunt

dos:08a96c9b70bb5d30.description: An action game in which you play Count Dracula, able to turn into a bat and a werewolf. Find holy medallions to bring chaos to Earth while avoiding Van Helsing's vampire hunters.
dos:08a96c9b70bb5d30.title: NightHunter

dos:08bdfff31feb24e9.description: A humorous and violent sports game. Win by scoring at least 7 of 14 goals or by killing enough of the opposing team, with tackles, pummelings and a moat with a shark-like creature. Two-player cooperative play.
dos:08bdfff31feb24e9.title: M.U.D.S: Mean Ugly Dirty Sport

dos:08c150fbee72d97d.description: A Spanish platformer starring Eco-Kid, who sets out to save a herd of elephants.
dos:08c150fbee72d97d.title: Eco-Kid: La Senda de los Elefantes

dos:08c2a6c6b72d4c0c.description: Third in SSI's Great Naval Battles series, a large naval simulation of the entire Pacific War, with all the major American and Japanese ships and aircraft and a Random Battle Generator.
dos:08c2a6c6b72d4c0c.title: Great Naval Battles Vol. III: Fury in the Pacific, 1941-44

dos:08c4cfd871296ab6.description: Play a worm that must reach the bell at the top of the screen without being hit by blocks sliding down, in a Donkey Kong style.
dos:08c4cfd871296ab6.title: Willy the Worm

dos:08cc69daf703aa6b.description: A first-person arcade racer with difficulty and manual/automatic control options. Only two cars and two tracks are open at first, and the police will chase you.
dos:08cc69daf703aa6b.title: OverHeat

dos:08ce08b41d5824ab.description: A MUD-like text game in the 2004 IF Competition. Survive against stronger opponents in an enclosed castle complex through a TADS interface. The emphasis is on survival, not storytelling.
dos:08ce08b41d5824ab.title: Magocracy

dos:08d289962e8300ae.description: A licensed soccer simulation with the 16 teams of the 1996/97 Champions League plus 32 others for fictional league modes, with real players.
dos:08d289962e8300ae.title: UEFA Champions League 1996-97

dos:08d3c7eee1c23df5.description: An Infocom murder mystery. You have twelve hours to solve the case as a sleuth, and one false move lets the killer strike again.
dos:08d3c7eee1c23df5.title: Deadline (1984)

dos:08ea2824db1d1f23.description: A re-release of the 1987 arcade classic Bubble Bobble together with Rainbow Islands. One or two players blow bubbles to trap enemies, then pop them for fruit; enemies that escape become faster.
dos:08ea2824db1d1f23.title: Bubble Bobble also featuring Rainbow Islands

dos:0900c2220bb1c078.description: A type-in BASIC game from Compute! magazine. Your ship is trapped in a series of caverns, in rooms full of unfriendly aliens.
dos:0900c2220bb1c078.title: Space Caverns

dos:0902f127e394d514.description: A side-scrolling shooter in an Apache-like helicopter, flying missions from an aircraft carrier in a war between the North Atlantic Defence Alliance and the country of Dosnovia, with specific targets to take out.
dos:0902f127e394d514.title: Airstrike

dos:09093733aa791601.description: A dice game for one, two or four players. Roll six dice in turn, score for combinations based on matching numbers, and nominate a scoring die with the chance to re-roll.
dos:09093733aa791601.title: Frazzle!

dos:090a44d1ffacdf03.description: The first computer Family Feud, based on the TV game show. Two families of five compete, or one plays a computer family, over three rounds like the show.
dos:090a44d1ffacdf03.title: Family Feud

dos:0922132c933d1403.description: A MechWarrior-like first-person simulation. Command heavily armed HERCs against Cybrids, intelligent cyborg creatures built by humanity that rebelled against it.
dos:0922132c933d1403.title: Metaltech: Earthsiege

dos:092442922ab5d2a9.description: A shareware collection of character-graphics games with a common theme, all based on randomly generated mazes and controlled entirely by keyboard.
dos:092442922ab5d2a9.title: Tommy's Cat and Mouse

dos:092b19475f0072c2.description: A turn-based strategic simulation: choose a squad of four from eight elite soldiers of a Sabre Team and take them through five increasingly tough hostage-rescue and building-storming missions.
dos:092b19475f0072c2.title: Sabre Team

dos:093a7614ceb82c1b.description: Play a rookie boxer fighting your way to the top. Win bouts to earn money to pay for training and your manager, and work toward the title of Champion.
dos:093a7614ceb82c1b.title: ABC Wide World of Sports Boxing

dos:0941f10dea2d423a.description: A surreal puzzle-strategy game by Geoff Crammond on a 3D landscape of hills and valleys. You begin at the lowest point and must reach the vantage of The Sentinel, a statue-like being with an energy-draining stare, using a limited supply of energy.
dos:0941f10dea2d423a.title: The Sentry

dos:094a5590ba45d389.description: Second in Leisuresoft's Leisureland series of adventure games for children aged 5 to 8 who are learning to read, based on The Wind in the Willows.
dos:094a5590ba45d389.title: Wind in the Willows

dos:097b50be62f8a4d0.description: A strategy game with two conquests: the Mongol conquest, uniting the small tribes of the country, and the more complex world conquest.
dos:097b50be62f8a4d0.title: Genghis Khan II: Clan of the Gray Wolf

dos:0987cccf4fcbd125.description: Sent by the galactic government to rescue hostages from alien invaders, fly an aircraft supported by a personal carrier base used to repair and re-arm your craft, collecting hostages from a factory and stealing them from aliens.
dos:0987cccf4fcbd125.title: QAD: Quintessential Art of Destruction

dos:0989685399571fc0.description: An action RPG in which three brothers wander the magical land of Holm. Real-time play in an extremely large world, about 17,000 screens of terrain, billed at the time as the largest ever created.
dos:0989685399571fc0.title: The Faery Tale Adventure: Book I

dos:09974144faa9438a.description: A platformer in which you collect all the crystals needed to fight Mhur, who locked you up four years ago.
dos:09974144faa9438a.title: Panic!

dos:099b538db3bd21c5.description: A simple but fascinating arcade shooter from 1989 for one or two players, released only in 2017.
dos:099b538db3bd21c5.title: Captain Fizz

dos:09a2c7b9329534ff.description: Live the life of an old lady who loves to play Bingo. Daily life requires pills, food and sleep, but your one goal is to play bingo.
dos:09a2c7b9329534ff.title: !Bingo Granny!

dos:09ab5de65da4c2ae.description: Play a fresh recruit at the Confederation Academy testing skills in the simulator. There is no storyline or campaign; play simple dogfight missions or build your own.
dos:09ab5de65da4c2ae.title: Wing Commander Academy

dos:09c7af456c359d3f.description: A puzzle game like a jigsaw: move and rotate abstract shapes on a grid, without overlaps, until they form a complete filled square.
dos:09c7af456c359d3f.title: Fiddle

dos:09ca8606c22a149b.description: A Donkey Kong Country-style platformer in which you play a red gorilla who wants to become a man, through levels representing stages of evolution.
dos:09ca8606c22a149b.title: Barbarian (1996)

dos:09ceb0825320fa26.description: Thai chess, or Makruk, which looks like regular chess but has different, slower rules.
dos:09ceb0825320fa26.title: Thai Chess

dos:09d7bbe3f8153614.description: This archive holds The New Print Shop, Broderbund's 1989 makeover of The Print Shop, and its Companion, which adds graphics editors and envelope printing.
dos:09d7bbe3f8153614.title: The New Print Shop Companion / The New Print Shop

dos:09d7bbe3f8153614.1.description: A companion to The Print Shop with extra functions such as graphics editors and envelope printing.
dos:09d7bbe3f8153614.1.title: The New Print Shop Companion

dos:09d7bbe3f8153614.2.description: Broderbund's 1989 makeover of The Print Shop, with a MacOS-like interface and higher resolution graphics, later supplanted by Print Shop Deluxe.
dos:09d7bbe3f8153614.2.title: The New Print Shop

dos:09dc745c5c93da01.description: Sierra's sequel to NASCAR Racing, with a new engine improving graphics, physics, sound and multiplayer. Adds the official cars, tracks and drivers of 1996, an arcade mode, mouse interface and a radio spotter.
dos:09dc745c5c93da01.title: NASCAR Racing 2

dos:09e40fe1472ae685.description: An isometric real-time role-playing game set as Ragnarok draws near, when Loke, the God of Mischief, turns Midgard into a battlefield against his brother Odin and the dead rise from Hela's realm.
dos:09e40fe1472ae685.title: Dusk of the Gods

dos:09e5a922d9d3afc9.description: A shufflepuck game: slide a puck across a table past a computer opponent at the other end. The table is drawn as a vector grid in perspective, and the mouse controls your bat.
dos:09e5a922d9d3afc9.title: Air Puck

dos:09edce0b5f3d898a.description: Baccarat set in a Monte Carlo casino, for up to four players, with saving. Bet to win as much money as you can.
dos:09edce0b5f3d898a.title: Monte Carlo Baccarat

dos:09f303f6da367d5d.description: Sequel to Destruction Derby with the same no-holds-barred crashing and scoring, plus new tracks, technical improvements and a pit stop feature that allows car repairs.
dos:09f303f6da367d5d.title: Destruction Derby 2

dos:09f343527c175d9b.description: Sequel to Team Yankee: a mix of realistic tank simulation and strategy wargame, with the same split-screen interface and a more detailed graphics engine.
dos:09f343527c175d9b.title: Pacific Islands

dos:09ffd2fff1aca008.description: In a tavern in Moraff's World, you join a game of Stones, trading precious and semiprecious stones around the table to build the most valuable hand.
dos:09ffd2fff1aca008.title: Moraff's Stones

dos:0a032902f3d84d44.description: An educational math game with Mutanoid aliens. In the year 2020, a trashed Earth launches rockets of junk into the next galaxy, where the shapeless Mutanoids squeeze into coffee pots, trash cans and old appliances.
dos:0a032902f3d84d44.title: The Mutanoid Math Challenge

dos:0a1420a75b81dc67.description: Strategy game in which you control one of six rival parties competing for control of a random generated world. Build a base and troops, and mine four kinds of ore to keep the cash flowing.
dos:0a1420a75b81dc67.title: Total Control

dos:0a22334a7a64e985.description: A version of the arcade game Qix: draw rectangles in the playfield while avoiding enemies on the margins and in the open area, and fill a percentage of the area to advance.
dos:0a22334a7a64e985.title: Xonix

dos:0a239e388ab532fe.description: A beat-'em-up highly reminiscent of River City Ransom, in Korean.
dos:0a239e388ab532fe.title: Blood Boiled High School

dos:0a29ffdcad6c3e68.description: A cute Pac-Man clone with five worlds in high-resolution EGA graphics, created by two Swedish authors.
dos:0a29ffdcad6c3e68.title: CD-Man Version 2.0

dos:0a2ae49b1b5e65db.description: As a space fighter pilot, take your CHZ-250 fighter to defend Earth against an alien invasion that SETI has reported entering the Solar System.
dos:0a2ae49b1b5e65db.title: UFO Invasion

dos:0a2bfd88e57ab19e.description: A forerunner of Minesweeper. As a US Marine private, get an important message across a minefield.
dos:0a2bfd88e57ab19e.title: Relentless Logic

dos:0a4102a3c287d55e.description: An official add-on level for Duke Nukem 3D, set between it and the Plutonium Pak. Aliens interrupt Duke's vacation and he fights through a hotel, clubs and other locations.
dos:0a4102a3c287d55e.title: Duke Nukem's Penthouse Paradise

dos:0a5e3701dbc3eb68.description: In Neutropolis, a totalitarian regime forbids showing emotions such as joy. Teenager Kent Knutson is arrested by the police Norms and imprisoned for whistling.
dos:0a5e3701dbc3eb68.title: Normality

dos:0a60e094940a3e06.description: A budget World War I flight sim from COSMI. Fly as a British or German pilot on missions such as patrols, escorts and balloon busting.
dos:0a60e094940a3e06.title: War Eagles / Fokker

dos:0a675b89ab43dab2.description: An entry in the Striker soccer series with more fluid gameplay, in-match commentary, team customization and FMV clips.
dos:0a675b89ab43dab2.title: Striker '95

dos:0a6f983d88b12321.description: A cute shoot-'em-up in which a lone starship pilot meets the Dreaded Space Bats of Doom on a routine assignment. Straightforward, with multiplayer.
dos:0a6f983d88b12321.title: Invasion of the Mutant Space Bats of Doom

dos:0a7214b86333f1f4.description: A board game against the computer or a friend, made for Allegro Speedhack 2001. Two players take turns placing colored tiles on an 8x8 board, like Othello at first glance, but with different rules.
dos:0a7214b86333f1f4.title: Alex the Allegator 2

dos:0a7463e3243f0395.description: A fantasy adventure using the same interface as Deja Vu. Enter the ancient keep of Shadowgate to find the Staff of Ages and stop the Warlock Lord from summoning the demon Behemoth.
dos:0a7463e3243f0395.title: Shadowgate

dos:0a86c77fdeac7ca6.description: A Mahjong tile-matching game in which tiles match by line of sight and proximity, with an animated intro. Clearing the board reveals pictures of women.
dos:0a86c77fdeac7ca6.title: SaChun 3

dos:0a8980b4e5e93454.description: An Epyx Olympic sports game with winter events such as ski jump, hot dog, biathlon, bobsled and free skating.
dos:0a8980b4e5e93454.title: Winter Games

dos:0a937f3555ba19c0.description: A platformer in which a malevolent sorcerer named Sakiski threatens Laurasia a hundred years after a dragon was sealed away by the prince of Bamas and the princess of Pars using magical Hartinum equipment.
dos:0a937f3555ba19c0.title: Lychnis

dos:0a9c0ea3b9499a4e.description: Dynamix's World War II Pacific flight sim with many aircraft and ships, including ground attack missions and land-based aircraft as well as anti-shipping strikes and carrier flying.
dos:0a9c0ea3b9499a4e.title: Aces of the Pacific

dos:0aa340df1c45de02.description: An adaptation of Berzerk. Move through scrolling maze-like rooms shooting rampaging aliens and robots with a handgun. Both you and your enemies fire in eight directions, and metal walls deflect shots.
dos:0aa340df1c45de02.title: Rage Against the Machine

dos:0aa9d9f8c928cd96.description: A German fantasy dungeon crawler with tile-based movement and real-time combat. You are thrown into the dungeons of Castle Ragor and must escape past the traps of its master Megrim.
dos:0aa9d9f8c928cd96.title: Escape from Ragor II: Megrim's Rache

dos:0ab2cc2589b85ac0.description: A puzzle game with a touch of strategy in which you guide a population of a creature through the wilds of biological evolution.
dos:0ab2cc2589b85ac0.title: Darwin's Island

dos:0ab6bd05910b8764.description: On a field of light green cells, blue and pink balls appear from the dark green border and roll randomly. You cannot control them directly, but you can click cells to direct their movement.
dos:0ab6bd05910b8764.title: Black Hole

dos:0ac6e41f99969418.description: A Mickey Mouse game for young children, helping them identify shapes and match colors. Mickey is a magician performing a magic show, with Minnie as his assistant, giving spoken encouragement.
dos:0ac6e41f99969418.title: Mickey's Colors & Shapes

dos:0acdc09def26f1c5.description: As the warrior Armorik, win eternal fame from Thor by single-handedly conquering the eight territories of the North.
dos:0acdc09def26f1c5.title: Armorik the Viking: The Eight Conquests

dos:0ade3dd8a97b2c08.description: A turn-based Monopoly-like game for two to six players. Build a business empire across 52 countries and be the richest player while others go bankrupt or resign.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Construction and Management Simulation; Strategy
dos:0ade3dd8a97b2c08.title: Oligopoly

dos:0adf8a8f6cad3606.description: An educational game testing your knowledge of US geography with a map of the states. Practice state names and capitals before playing.
dos:0adf8a8f6cad3606.title: See the U.S.A.

dos:0ae0dddc3a520b89.description: A text-based casino with a slot machine, Wheel of Fortune, roulette wheel, keno parlor, craps table and baccarat table, for one or several players.
dos:0ae0dddc3a520b89.title: High Roller Casino

dos:0ae5fa40d2e45634.description: A Breakout clone in which you bounce a ball to destroy squares marked with Roman numerals in order, across 20 levels with many special blocks.
dos:0ae5fa40d2e45634.title: BipBop II

dos:0aeb017c59e16f58.description: A fixed-screen shooter in which you fire at an enemy orb slowly crossing the screen left and right, and dodge its slightly homing shots.
dos:0aeb017c59e16f58.title: Federation Defender

dos:0aef0b3a80f7cfbc.description: A two-player Infogrames puzzle game with brightly colored diamonds, framed as a battle of colors for territory, licensed in the wake of Tetris from a Russian designer.
dos:0aef0b3a80f7cfbc.title: 7 Colors

dos:0aef3ec02b0503f9.description: A computer version of the ancient African counting game Wari, designed to teach you how to play well. You haven't beaten the game until you have beaten The Elephant.
dos:0aef3ec02b0503f9.title: Wari: The Ancient Game of Africa

dos:0af7657aa0b21f54.description: A puzzle game in which you arrange mirrors to beam light onto a target, with new obstacles and power-ups as you go.
dos:0af7657aa0b21f54.title: Laser Light

dos:0af778828c04bc39.description: A racing game across America in a turbocharged Ferrari F40 that tops 300 MPH, as you race to stop a ring of rogue police officers running a stolen car racket. The route has many forks.
dos:0af778828c04bc39.title: F40 Pursuit Simulator

dos:0af81091035450a5.description: The arcade classic: a yellow dot-muncher clears a maze of dots and fruit while four ghosts chase it. One or two players.
dos:0af81091035450a5.title: Pac-Man

dos:0af8e3ad5fe4c4e7.description: A Space Invaders clone with insects instead of aliens. Waves of bugs attack and your lone sideways-moving tank must shoot them down.
dos:0af8e3ad5fe4c4e7.title: Invaders

dos:0afc2b7fd996eeb6.description: In 2124, alien life is found living in the atmosphere of Jupiter, and some of the creatures prove hostile. An action simulation set in the gas giant.
dos:0afc2b7fd996eeb6.title: Eye of the Storm

dos:0b021bbdf7433544.description: A simple two-player falling-block game reminiscent of Dr. Mario and Puyo Puyo, with no apparent option to play against the computer.
dos:0b021bbdf7433544.title: Toki Suni Hexa

dos:0b02789f60aef607.description: An educational adventure in which Jenny is stranded on the prairie in 1842 after being separated from her wagon train. Gather food and find a warm shelter before winter.
dos:0b02789f60aef607.title: Jenny of the Prairie

dos:0b087999378d0d41.description: Up to four human players each manage a horse racing stable: choose which races to enter and which jockeys to hire based on form and conditions, then watch the races from a side view.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Racing & Driving; Sports
dos:0b087999378d0d41.title: Omni-Play Horse Racing

dos:0b090e29b4aaf4f1.description: A typing tutor in which teacher Mavis Beacon takes you through touch typing lessons explained on a chalkboard, showing the keyboard and the fingers to use.
dos:0b090e29b4aaf4f1.title: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing!

dos:0b0a2f601825f65e.description: A side-scrolling shoot-'em-up. Guide a space ship through two levels inside an alien structure that endangers Earth, destroying or avoiding enemies and obstacles. The project is codenamed XERIX.
dos:0b0a2f601825f65e.title: Xerix

dos:0b0e2c9b3d6fc4da.description: An unofficial Prince of Persia made in 1994 by Kirill A. Terebilov with PRINCEDIT. It starts like the original but has devious level design and tougher enemies later on.
dos:0b0e2c9b3d6fc4da.title: 4D Prince of Persia

dos:0b215353d0ed9cee.description: Sequel to Kingdoms of England: a turn-based medieval strategy game for up to six human or computer players, each a Lord commanding up to twenty armies in a bid to become King of England.
dos:0b215353d0ed9cee.title: Vikings: Fields of Conquest - Kingdoms of England II

dos:0b260818753ca985.description: Los Angeles is overrun by the mutant army of evil Nolan. Choose one of six cars with different strength and handling and drive the streets shooting mutants from all directions with an unlimited machine gun.
dos:0b260818753ca985.title: L.A. Blaster

dos:0b34bcf5ed6fdefc.description: A pool game using the engine from Jimmy White's Whirlwind Snooker, with 3D graphics, realistic physics and many shot combinations of direction, speed and spin. UK and US 8-ball and 9-ball.
dos:0b34bcf5ed6fdefc.title: Archer Maclean's Pool

dos:0b50388a3117e502.description: A scrolling shoot-'em-up in which an ancient alien device called The System, built to hold ultimate knowledge, has turned into a weapon if accessed the wrong way.
dos:0b50388a3117e502.title: Zanac

dos:0b5708c2fa97b97b.description: A one-player strategy game on an 8x8 grid: capture an enemy battle vessel without destroying it by destroying all the spaces around it.
dos:0b5708c2fa97b97b.title: Capture the Enemy Space Ship

dos:0b5783baedab7015.description: A real-time strategy game recreating the Battle of Balaclava in 1854, in which 25,000 Russian troops try to take the area from outnumbered British, French and Turkish forces.
dos:0b5783baedab7015.title: The Charge of the Light Brigade

dos:0b593cd27110fc99.description: A text-based simulation in which you win votes to get elected.
dos:0b593cd27110fc99.title: Election Day

dos:0b67809c9615c0a4.description: An interactive educational journey through space: read about WWII rockets, eclipses and space colonies, and watch Voyager flybys, Apollo launches, JFK's moon challenge and computer simulations.
dos:0b67809c9615c0a4.title: Space Adventure (1992)

dos:0b6a9312e70e5d74.description: A tactical, hex-based war simulation with five WWII scenarios, such as the Normandy invasion, with Axis or Allies, plus Attack, Defend and Encounter modes.
dos:0b6a9312e70e5d74.title: Panthers in the Shadows

dos:0b6ee57871ed291c.description: Ten-pin bowling against a friend or a computer player at skill levels 1 to 4, following the rules over 10 rounds.
dos:0b6ee57871ed291c.title: Strike

dos:0b7cfdafc8f4ee71.description: An expanded version of Sand Storm for registered shareware players, adding to the original Scuds, Jets and Tomahawk scenarios.
dos:0b7cfdafc8f4ee71.title: Sand Storm: The Championship Version

dos:0b852d49e4efd7af.description: A parallax-scrolling fantasy shooter. As the dragon-rider Yarin, take revenge for the destruction of your village, across six levels with huge bosses and special weapons like dragonfire.
dos:0b852d49e4efd7af.title: Dactylus

dos:0b856b80315fd2aa.description: A text-menu BBS role-playing game: choose a class and build strength through monster battles, equipment upgrades and random events before facing the Red Dragon. Players can also challenge each other.
dos:0b856b80315fd2aa.title: Legend of the Red Dragon

dos:0b860fb59ec6f686.description: A free turn-based strategy game very similar to Blue Byte's Battle Isle series, with multiple modes mostly for human opponents, plus an AI and a campaign mode.
dos:0b860fb59ec6f686.title: Advanced Strategic Command

dos:0b8d6ac9ada924ea.description: In 1880s London, British gentleman Piers Featherstonehaugh and his servant Mossop find a talking cat on their doorstep who tells them of a plot involving genetic mutations gone haywire. Stop it.
dos:0b8d6ac9ada924ea.title: Gene Machine

dos:0b9b9ee7b4c1d231.description: A Breakout-style game with different brick layouts in each level, some indestructible bricks that trap or deflect the ball.
dos:0b9b9ee7b4c1d231.title: Popcorn

dos:0b9c7c9f7f58e770.description: A historical trading simulation in Renaissance Venice. As a wealthy merchant you wield economic, political, religious and military power, managing trade routes, warehouses and commodities.
dos:0b9c7c9f7f58e770.title: Merchant Prince

dos:0b9ec85347a4a007.description: A Boulder Dash variant about pretzels: dig through the pretzel mines for food while avoiding falling boulders, monsters and explosions.
dos:0b9ec85347a4a007.title: PretzelDash

dos:0ba6f4cc8d20c2ac.description: A platform puzzle game. Professor Avish, invited to give a lecture, wakes up in his pajamas in a mysterious castle with many rooms.
dos:0ba6f4cc8d20c2ac.title: Avish!

dos:0ba9795c6d5691ca.description: An educational falling-block game of basic math: arrange falling numbers so that the top block of a column of three is the sum of the two beneath. Mistakes shrink the container.
dos:0ba9795c6d5691ca.title: Valgetal

dos:0bb2ccd0815c217b.description: An educational strategy game on a schematic map of England about the Norman Conquest in the 11th century, when William the Conqueror defeated Harold II at Hastings.

dos:0edfab6bec43e1f8.description: Fly the Royal Navy Merlin helicopter in the Navy's training simulation, viewed in 3D from several camera angles. Start near a frigate and land on its stern, at three difficulty levels.
dos:0edfab6bec43e1f8.title: Merlin Challenge

dos:0ee47f5d76c17c30.description: A platformer starring Tiny, a cute round creature who must defeat the wicked one who captured the King and turned the Tinies into mindless monsters. Tiny can become a swimmer, rock eater, fireball spitter or rope swinger.
dos:0ee47f5d76c17c30.title: Fury of the Furries

dos:0ee4e16104f60c24.description: A little-known American football game by Micro League and published by IBM, a follow-up of sorts to NFL Pro League Football.
dos:0ee4e16104f60c24.title: All-American College Football (1995)

dos:0ee6699e66c9267e.description: A two-player shareware game like Scorched Earth and Worms. Each player drops five tanks onto a generated 2D landscape and scores by destroying the opponent's tanks and, optionally, the buildings.
dos:0ee6699e66c9267e.title: War-8}!

dos:0ee8e3d76a4b06d4.description: Fantasy strategy and role-playing in the magical land of Enroth, with castles of six creature types each, from griffins and golems to unicorns, hydras and four kinds of dragon.
dos:0ee8e3d76a4b06d4.title: Heroes of Might and Magic II (Deluxe Edition)

dos:0eedca5758fc8f81.description: An educational capture-the-flag action game for two players, who work as a team against Max and his robots to reach Max's zone, capture the flag and bring it back.
dos:0eedca5758fc8f81.title: Bannercatch

dos:0ef51fd5fed33fca.description: A shareware Wheel of Fortune game for one to three players, following the format of the TV show as it was in autumn 1987. Later the basis for VGAWHEEL.
dos:0ef51fd5fed33fca.title: EGAWHEEL

dos:0efc7f00210a5d80.description: A shareware turn-based puzzle game for one to four people with elements of Wheel of Fortune: solve puzzles by picking letters, playable by keyboard or mouse.
dos:0efc7f00210a5d80.title: A Clue's Solution (1993)

dos:0f03809b083d56b5.description: An adaptation of the pipe-laying game: keep an ant running through tunnels as long as possible by rotating tunnel pieces.
dos:0f03809b083d56b5.title: Ant Run

dos:0f152c45758da417.description: A Lode Runner clone. Move Roboman to pop balloons on the level to find a key that opens the exit door, with bonus points for popping them all, hidden surprises and springboards.
dos:0f152c45758da417.title: Roboman

dos:0f185dc439bb2af1.description: A puzzle on a 3x3 board of two-sided tiles, starting in a random state. Flip a tile by entering its number, but only if it is white; flipping the central one also flips its four neighbors.
dos:0f185dc439bb2af1.title: Flipper (1983)

dos:0f2070134187ecad.description: Third in the Super Cars series of top-down arcade racers from Magnetic Fields, essentially a remake of Super Cars II with added elements, 256-color VGA graphics and an optional management portion.
dos:0f2070134187ecad.title: Supercars International

dos:0f2309cfc0d234ed.description: A multiplayer game for up to four players. Each flies a space ship by keyboard through many mazes, collecting gems and new weapons and trying to annihilate the others.
dos:0f2309cfc0d234ed.title: MegaMaze

dos:0f235175e8a94ffb.description: A 2D toon-style beat-'em-up about Jokes, a group of fighters freeing their planet from an evil entity. Ten playable characters, including Miopninja, a ninja with glasses.
dos:0f235175e8a94ffb.title: Fight'N'Jokes

dos:0f293704e1ee84f1.description: A full-motion video adventure. A DEA team raids an apartment in Los Angeles and finds that it was used to build a nuclear bomb, now in the hands of a German terrorist.
dos:0f293704e1ee84f1.title: Flash Traffic: City of Angels

dos:0f298679f117b04e.description: Sent to harvest ore in space, with a finite fuel supply, a robot arm to collect materials and twin missiles against hordes of aliens.
dos:0f298679f117b04e.title: Space Pirate

dos:0f312381770bab6c.description: A tribute to Arcade Volleyball by the author of Pizza Worm. Two players with huge heads face each other across a volleyball net and bounce the ball around.
dos:0f312381770bab6c.title: Zorlim's Arcade Volleyball

dos:0f33b639f50d4216.description: Part of the Reader Rabbit series for older children. Reader Rabbit volunteers at the Daily Skywriter News Company of World-ville, matching words and sentences across seven word types in four activities.
dos:0f33b639f50d4216.title: Reader Rabbit 3

dos:0f3e94b4e2081207.description: The first of a loose trilogy of treasure-hunt text adventures, with Crobe and Quest for the Sangraal. The elven kingdom of Fyleet has fallen, and orcs and hobgoblins have looted its fortress.
dos:0f3e94b4e2081207.title: Fyleet

dos:0f4100fc16d1c2ed.description: A conversion of the Atari arcade game based on the second Indiana Jones film. As Indy, play cycles of levels, such as a mine level where you whip through to free captive children.
dos:0f4100fc16d1c2ed.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

dos:0f55498f103cee2e.description: A compilation of Earthworm Jim and Earthworm Jim 2.
dos:0f55498f103cee2e.title: Earthworm Jim 2

dos:0f71e3ea833d84d4.description: Command the Los Angeles-class 688i nuclear attack submarine on missions around the world, with the full arsenal of missiles, torpedoes, sonar and radar against mines, ships and subs.
dos:0f71e3ea833d84d4.title: Fast Attack: High Tech Submarine Warfare

dos:0f725ff0e641a829.description: Fifth in the Might and Magic series: control a party of 6 heroes to save the Darkside of Xeen, completing the quest begun in Clouds of Xeen.
dos:0f725ff0e641a829.title: Might and Magic V: Darkside of Xeen

dos:0f84e3770cca2e6c.description: A text adventure: banished to the caverns of Demon's Forge for killing four palace guards, the king's greatest gladiator must find the exit, which no prisoner ever has.
dos:0f84e3770cca2e6c.title: Demon's Forge

dos:0f8e4150cc985f07.description: An Italian game influenced by the Mani pulite scandal. In one type of level you shoot political leaders carrying small flags while avoiding others.
dos:0f8e4150cc985f07.title: Il grande gioco di Tangentopoli

dos:0f939098d507b9af.description: Lead a team from the Conference, the fifth division of English football, to the Premier League and European glory, signing and selling players and using the phone to reach staff such as coaches.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:0f939098d507b9af.title: Premier Manager 3

dos:0fa7dcb34033237d.description: An adventure adapted from Stephen King's novella The Mist. A thick, sinister mist traps you in a supermarket, and you must escape the panic and the bug-ridden town.
dos:0fa7dcb34033237d.title: Stephen King: The Mist

dos:0fb5d51b7a60f1af.description: A humorous point-and-click adventure in which garishly dressed Richard Longhurst, with no memories, wakes in an abandoned zoo and is tossed forward and backward in time.
dos:0fb5d51b7a60f1af.title: Richard Longhurst and the Box that Ate Time

dos:0fb5e9c5c36fe3f6.description: A World War II simulation in the European Theater, billed as an educational game and exceedingly rare.
dos:0fb5e9c5c36fe3f6.title: Supreme Command

dos:0fb974372c6f9aad.description: A side-scrolling shooter that uses ASCII characters to make 16-color graphics. The galaxy is in trouble and you save it.
dos:0fb974372c6f9aad.title: Attack on Altair

dos:0fc4b26b9637037a.description: A remake of Digger: collect diamonds, stay clear of falling diamonds and rocks, and avoid ghosts. 32 levels with level codes, and three minutes per level.
dos:0fc4b26b9637037a.title: Digger (1992)

dos:0fca23eac9ca81cc.description: A first-person shooter in which humanity fights aliens. Your ship boards the alien mothership, where you fly or walk through MadSpace and the laws of physics don't always apply. 25 levels, with Stereo3D cutscenes.
dos:0fca23eac9ca81cc.title: MadSpace: To Hell and Beyond

dos:0fe5cf1c6ea6d3bd.description: A weird 3D puzzle-action game in which you are a little guy in a chamber you rotate by pushing around its corners, so objects fall and new parts of the level open up. Two-player competitive mode.
dos:0fe5cf1c6ea6d3bd.title: Blast Chamber

dos:0fe7e83feb56b06d.description: Push rocks around to form ladders to reach the butterflies, then take the exit once you have them all. 15 puzzles with helpful items such as a rope and pick axe.
dos:0fe7e83feb56b06d.title: Rock Man

dos:0fef6d83f112ca69.description: The first campaign disk for Castles. The Picts are rebelling in the north of Albion, and you must build more castles to defend it.
dos:0fef6d83f112ca69.title: Castles: The Northern Campaign

dos:0ff2e591f025aa21.description: A political simulation of world government. You are elected US President and handle crises, avoid wars in conflict zones, send aid and keep a good approval rating.
dos:0ff2e591f025aa21.title: Shadow President

dos:1006975732eaf434.description: A Donkey Kong clone in two parts on the same layout: climb to the top to rescue your girlfriend while a gorilla throws barrels down the ramps.
dos:1006975732eaf434.title: David's Kong

dos:1006fde165dd3e35.description: A simplistic backgammon in EGA graphics that lets you play against the computer.
dos:1006fde165dd3e35.title: EGA Backgammon

dos:10092a6deb5aa3a5.description: A platform puzzle game in which you control a stick figure drawn by a little girl in her notebook, which her brother has filled with scribbles and monsters.
dos:10092a6deb5aa3a5.title: StixWorld

dos:100ee052f97d9602.description: Mega Phoenix brings the arcade game Phoenix into the 90s, later made into a coin-op by Gaelco. A single-screen shoot-'em-up with several waves and a shield that lasts briefly.
dos:100ee052f97d9602.title: Mega Phoenix

dos:101167810ca99cf5.description: Buy equipment, head beneath the town and mine to get rich and marry the woman of your dreams.
dos:101167810ca99cf5.title: MinerVGA

dos:10222b501918cba2.description: A mix of action and puzzle: collect items by jumping among platforms, which change shape and function in later levels as obstacles are added.
dos:10222b501918cba2.title: Bumpy's Arcade Fantasy

dos:10227249117d705c.description: An add-on for Heretic and Hexen with 12 new Heretic episodes and over 250 additional levels, new textures, sounds, weapons and monsters, plus an interface to load levels and create multiplayer games.
dos:10227249117d705c.title: H!Zone

dos:1022bc75f9e9b7c1.description: A wargame with three scenarios of the German campaign against Leningrad, starting with the approach from August to December 1941 and the battle of Tikhvin.
dos:1022bc75f9e9b7c1.title: Leningrad

dos:102721349e7e6bcd.description: Move left and right shooting birds in the sky and avoiding the blocks they drop.
dos:102721349e7e6bcd.title: Fenix

dos:10450984cb06675e.description: The Wheel of Fortune game show on the computer: take turns spinning the wheel and guessing letters to solve word puzzles.
dos:10450984cb06675e.title: Wheel of Fortune: Second Edition

dos:1077f899f7c549e3.description: A hand-drawn point-and-click adventure. As 1930s US private detective Jack Orlando, you have 48 hours to solve a murder, talking to many people across more than 200 scenes.
dos:1077f899f7c549e3.title: Jack Orlando

dos:108b16b93dd81e77.description: An action fighting game set in feudal Japan, against many enemies in many settings.
dos:108b16b93dd81e77.title: Bushido: The Way of the Warrior

dos:108f9546fd4f3bf7.description: Aliens have planted a huge bomb deep in the Earth and challenge the best pilot to reach it in a high-speed ship before the timer runs out, with minimal shields against the tunnel walls.
dos:108f9546fd4f3bf7.title: Tunnels of Armageddon

dos:108fd57097325527.description: A maze action game from IBM that runs on a monochrome display. Select the maze, marker speed, sound options and scoring type, timed or point value.
dos:108fd57097325527.title: One Hundred and One Monochrome Mazes

dos:10939410dd206af4.description: A collection of three arcade-style games by Russian programmer Dima Pavlovsky: Rebel Planets, Ivan and Metal Hearts. In Rebel Planets you shoot upward from a small ship at the bottom of the screen to destroy enemies.
dos:10939410dd206af4.title: Troika

dos:109fc9bed78ccd9b.description: Don Diego Vega is secretly Zorro, a masked swordsman protecting the innocent in Spanish colonial California. Don Cortez hopes to gain more power by finding an ancient treasure, and Zorro sets out to stop him.
dos:109fc9bed78ccd9b.title: Zorro

dos:10a1af9a7c8237a0.description: A platformer on the Jill of the Jungle engine. As Onesimus, a slave of Philemon, escape to Rome to find the apostle Paul, who will teach you how to become a Christian and find true freedom.
dos:10a1af9a7c8237a0.title: Onesimus: A Quest for Freedom

dos:10ae43bf0defbc6d.description: A basic soccer game that skips the managerial side of PC Futbol. Play friendly matches or try to win the European Championship, the World Championship or the Americas tournament.
dos:10ae43bf0defbc6d.title: PC Gol

dos:10b27218cc477522.description: A soccer management simulation set in a fictional European league of eight top clubs, including PSV Eindhoven, Rangers, Liverpool, Arsenal, Real Madrid, Marseille, AC Milan and Bayern Munich.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer; Strategy
dos:10b27218cc477522.title: European Superleague

dos:10d371e3ab8c6a0c.description: A Russian 2.5D sprite first-person shooter from 1998, made in the wake of Duke Nukem 3D.
dos:10d371e3ab8c6a0c.title: Liquidator

dos:10d6ae82c07fba78.description: A shareware remake of Pac-Man with a Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode, closely emulating the arcade original.
dos:10d6ae82c07fba78.title: CHAMP Pac-em

dos:10d8fcd885cda035.description: A turn-based strategy game that starts in 275 BC with a young Roman legionnaire. Begin with one province, Rome, and one legion, and conquer every province on the map by force or diplomacy, on land and sea.
dos:10d8fcd885cda035.title: Centurion: Defender of Rome

dos:10d913b63b55cb47.description: A chess game with a strong opponent, 168 openings, and 2D, 3D and War Room boards. It suggests moves, rates the player, replays 151 classic matches and includes a Mentor tutor.
dos:10d913b63b55cb47.title: The Chessmaster 3000

dos:10ec6eb6616192a6.description: After Jeremy Hartwood's suicide in his Louisiana mansion Derceto, play private investigator Edward Carnby or Jeremy's niece Emily, investigating the death in a house reputed to be haunted.
dos:10ec6eb6616192a6.title: Alone in the Dark

dos:10ed2ebe81f4babf.description: A Rubik's Cube-style puzzle viewed from the top with all sides displayed, where you choose from 4 to 25 sides. Many starting arrangements are grouped by difficulty.
dos:10ed2ebe81f4babf.title: Cubulus

dos:10f08328b7a9a5c2.description: A children's game based on the novel. Phineas Fogg and his monkey sidekick Sidney bet that they can travel around the world in 80 days, choosing the next destination from a world map.
dos:10f08328b7a9a5c2.title: Around the World in 80 Days

dos:10fed285c63b2464.description: An asteroids shooter: blast the asteroids in a hostile field while guarding against alien ships, with each wave bringing faster rocks and more aggressive aliens.
dos:10fed285c63b2464.title: Roxx!!!

dos:11095afdce6c8762.description: A Mario Kart clone in which you race around quasi-3D tracks as a character from the Skunny games. Many tracks around the world, and a battle mode against the computer or a friend.
dos:11095afdce6c8762.title: Skunny Kart

dos:111545688c422835.description: A classic-style plane shooter: move up a vertically scrolling environment and shoot anything that moves.
dos:111545688c422835.title: Island Hopper

dos:1117850eb6379d6e.description: Third in the Ikari Warriors series, a top-down vertically scrolling shooter. The presidential candidate's daughter has been kidnapped, and you must get past enemy lines to rescue her.
dos:1117850eb6379d6e.title: Ikari III: The Rescue

dos:11178c411af45776.description: A side-scrolling platformer about a girl named Peach. The Nightmares have taken over DreamLand and captured her true love, so she must collect four keys across dream worlds to enter the castle and defeat them.
dos:11178c411af45776.title: Peach's Dream

dos:1122b98d5d4a45ae.description: A 3D real-time World War II flight combat game based on missions flown by the 357th Fighter Group, the Yoxford Boys, in P-51 Mustangs over France and Germany from England.
dos:1122b98d5d4a45ae.title: The Heroes of the 357th

dos:113816eff29a4b71.description: A WWII naval simulator. Aboard a Fletcher-class destroyer, defend groups of friendly ships from enemy submarines, locating them on a zoomable map.
dos:113816eff29a4b71.title: Search and Destroy

dos:113fc6303b0ac823.description: An update of the classic Empire wargame with more terrain, more sighting and movement rules, and land units that can take damage in a skirmish instead of simply being destroyed.
dos:113fc6303b0ac823.title: Empire II: The Art of War

dos:1151a7f57488266e.description: A shareware darts game for one or two players based on the pub game 301. You must finish on a double, and a bust resets your turn's score.
dos:1151a7f57488266e.title: Bardarts

dos:117bb4f43d847c2b.description: A shareware cribbage against the computer, with five-card (to 61 points) and six-card (to 121 points) versions.
dos:117bb4f43d847c2b.title: Tommy's Cribbage

dos:117eb5ff84a428ba.description: A shareware patience game with four solitaire games: Betsy Ross, Corner Card, Pyramid and Sir Tommy. Keyboard controlled, with optional sound and a demo mode.
dos:117eb5ff84a428ba.title: Tommy's Patience II

dos:118456b2265b09d2.description: Half a year after Bedlam, the biomechs are back as the Biomex and control important facilities. An isometric shooter in which you pilot Major Kern's combat robot to destroy them.
dos:118456b2265b09d2.title: Bedlam 2: Absolute Bedlam

dos:118d609faf51817f.description: A text adventure: trapped in thick fog on the moors while looking for the house of Dr. Potter, a reporter wonders what strange goings-on he will find.
dos:118d609faf51817f.title: Mysterious Adventure No. 2: The Time Machine

dos:119479fc9cb7a5bb.description: A first-person shooter in which you pilot a Planet Runner, a huge robot. As a mercenary for corporations, clear planets of rival companies and alien menaces. Single and multiplayer.
dos:119479fc9cb7a5bb.title: Shattered Steel

dos:1196eeb4d99f938f.description: Dork the Dinosaur is knocked out by a branch during a thunderstorm and dreams he is a character in an eight-level platform game.
dos:1196eeb4d99f938f.title: Dork's Dreams

dos:11a29f3eaac9cba1.description: A character-graphics platform game in which you keep the plumbing free of pests by jumping to bang the platform beneath them, stunning them so you can collect them for points.
dos:11a29f3eaac9cba1.title: Ario Bros

dos:11a34d6b8992d43a.description: Olympic Games in the stone age, with events like clubbing, dino racing, firemaking, mate tossing, saber racing and the dino vault. Up to four players choose from six cavemen with different skills and drawbacks.
dos:11a34d6b8992d43a.title: Caveman Ugh-lympics

dos:11a9dd41d6ae11f5.description: The Sun League fights the oppressive Gar computer. You control a Viper V droid sent into a defense base to reactivate the planet's defenses by finding floppy disks all over the station.
dos:11a9dd41d6ae11f5.title: Day of the Viper

dos:11b829b996af9ff8.description: A realistic flight simulation. As a UN fighter pilot, fly the F-117A, Eurofighter 2000 or F-22 in various scenarios.
dos:11b829b996af9ff8.title: TFX

dos:11be7a4c094f529d.description: A scrolling shooter in four missions. Kill baddies for the money they carry and spend it in shop rooms to upgrade your craft. One or two players.
dos:11be7a4c094f529d.title: Blood Money

dos:11beefc288f02b07.description: Second chapter of the Rob Blanc series. Rob is nearly Defender of the Universe, but the High Ones send him on a holiday on Earth first, where he gets stuck in a lift with an enigmatic teenager.
dos:11beefc288f02b07.title: Rob Blanc II: Planet of the Pasteurised Pestilence

dos:11c5eb91ebf49787.description: Complete 69 levels riding a pedal-powered helicopter to pick up cavemen who announce where they want to go and carry them to their destinations. Levels are platforms with cave entrances.
dos:11c5eb91ebf49787.title: Ugh!

dos:11c684a3fd4ce78d.description: A Mahjong (Shanghai) variant with 40 levels of tiles with symbols like butterflies and masks. Pair them within the time limit; a tile can only be moved if nothing is on top of it.
dos:11c684a3fd4ce78d.title: Sarakon

dos:11cb85dfa99c42b6.description: Between Jetfighter 3 and 4, an arcade-action turn with a Wing Commander-like interactive movie feel. A conflict between NATO and Russia erupts over Norwegian oil fields.
dos:11cb85dfa99c42b6.title: JetFighter: Full Burn

dos:11edc0f2cc47462c.description: A Donkey Kong-like game in which you are the batboy and climb the structure by ladders to retrieve the home run ball, avoiding moving items.
dos:11edc0f2cc47462c.title: Climber 5

dos:11f1800adff71386.description: A 3D shooter. As Kurt, save the world from aliens who sent 8 giant fortresses to destroy Earth. Run and jump through 6 missions of strange worlds and kill the Stream Riders with your machine gun arm.
dos:11f1800adff71386.title: MDK

dos:120368e06cd49883.description: The board game Monopoly: buy streets and railroad stations, build houses and hotels, and charge rent to other players.
dos:120368e06cd49883.title: Monopoly 1985

dos:120f0f167cbcf2ff.description: A computerized version of the card game Mille Bornes. Race another driver over 1000 miles, dealing with accidents, blown tires and other hazards, where strategy matters more than arcade skill.
dos:120f0f167cbcf2ff.title: 1,000 Miler

dos:121bc4d717aea342.description: Bub and Bob wander into a cave of monsters and are turned into dinosaurs, and must reach the end of the cave to change back. A single-screen platformer: clear each level's enemies to move on.
dos:121bc4d717aea342.title: Bubble Bobble
