dos:1221c4aaaaad6668.description: A Qix-style area-claiming puzzle: cut lines across the field to fence off territory, reach the required coverage, and dodge enemies that get nastier as time passes. Food bonuses add time.
dos:1221c4aaaaad6668.title: Silk

dos:1228bb4189dc9c1d.description: IBM's version of Othello/Reversi: two players take turns placing chips, enclosing lines of the opponent's pieces between two of their own to flip them.
dos:1228bb4189dc9c1d.title: Verso

dos:122a3eba44bd0db6.description: An adventure set in Mike Callahan's bar on Long Island, a place to share problems with the friendly bartender, whose clientele includes mythological beings.
dos:122a3eba44bd0db6.title: Callahan's Crosstime Saloon

dos:12322530de2bd8ec.description: Play an exhibition basketball game as the Harlem Globetrotters or their rivals, the Generals, with quarters from one to twelve minutes. The Globetrotters can pull off special moves such as behind-the-back passes.
dos:12322530de2bd8ec.title: Harlem Globetrotters

dos:12353b37c2f7a4f3.description: A math puzzle game: guide an algebraic spirit through a forest to find number cubes and cast a magic spell by solving the roots of a polynomial.
dos:12353b37c2f7a4f3.title: Magenta's Maze

dos:123b5b1d82b6b72e.description: Sequel to DID's space sim Epic, continuing the Raxxon-Terran conflict. You are a Terran pilot ambushed by the Raxxons and surgically transformed into one of their own.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Flight Simulator; Vehicle Simulation
dos:123b5b1d82b6b72e.title: Inferno

dos:125db54f10548063.description: A shareware game in which a space miner skims a spaceship over a planet's surface, avoiding some obstacles and collecting others, to mine the precious ore Orindum.
dos:125db54f10548063.title: Dodgem

dos:12639fb0137f1831.description: A demonstration text adventure whose type-in source code is in COMPUTE!'s Guide to Adventure Games. Venture into a defunct factory tower to retrieve magnetic media holding a copy of Crowther & Woods' original adventure.
dos:12639fb0137f1831.title: COMPUTE!'s Guide to Adventure Games (included game)

dos:126447d10b40ad03.description: A comic sci-fi adventure in which Rex crash-lands on a strange planet while chasing a valuable vase. Explore an odd society, make use of its transformation technology and solve inventory puzzles to get the prize and a way home.
dos:126447d10b40ad03.title: Rex Nebular and the Cosmic Gender Bender

dos:126c38f6ddf00f92.description: A German puzzle game that takes the idea of Oil's Well and expands it with fairly complex gameplay.
dos:126c38f6ddf00f92.title: Oilmania

dos:127f2314a27c401e.description: Arguably the first text adventure construction program for the IBM PC, released in 1985. Use DOS menus and pop-up windows to create your world and all its objects and characters.
dos:127f2314a27c401e.title: Computer Novel Construction Set

dos:12806560f155bcf4.description: A single-player Backgammon game against the computer.
dos:12806560f155bcf4.title: Backgammon (1987)

dos:12813df7807f85a8.description: Billy and Jimmy Lee set out to avenge Marian, killed by the Black Warriors gang in retaliation for their earlier defeat. A beat-'em-up for one or two players.
dos:12813df7807f85a8.title: Double Dragon II: The Revenge

dos:128bbad958820c3f.description: An unofficial Quake campaign of 21 levels. As in the original, the first stage has no enemies and offers four paths, each a difficulty level, from Easy to Nightmare.
dos:128bbad958820c3f.title: Quake Level Master V

dos:128eecc7ef59c0ab.description: A shareware word-guessing game: try letter combinations and the computer reports how many jots you have, a jot being the right letter in the right place. Words are three, five or seven letters.
dos:128eecc7ef59c0ab.title: Jotto

dos:12983dd10676107f.description: Zak McKracken, a tabloid writer, teams up with scientist Annie Larris and two Yale students, Melissa and Leslie, to stop the alien Caponians, who have infiltrated the phone company.
dos:12983dd10676107f.title: Zak McKracken and the Alien Mindbenders

dos:129d54dc415c5c9e.description: Sequel to Spirit of Excalibur, set after King Arthur's death. The demonic Shadowmaster has been summoned, and a terrible new force threatens Britain.
dos:129d54dc415c5c9e.title: Vengeance of Excalibur

dos:12a2928d587ac0d7.description: A sideways Breakout. Rescue Princess Gwen from a castle by bouncing five magic coins into bricks with a magical sword given by the good sorcerer Bruce.
dos:12a2928d587ac0d7.title: Dragons: A Challenge in Chivalry

dos:12a3fdad15a89e0a.description: A puzzle game in which two characters must reach set spots in logical levels, helping each other past obstacles with switches, stone blocks, doors and lifts. Originally released for the ZX Spectrum.
dos:12a3fdad15a89e0a.title: Quadrax

dos:12a9d2eab85493d0.description: Control a snake at the bottom of the screen and reach a goal at the top within a time limit. The snake keeps moving in one direction until it meets an obstacle, when it may change direction.
dos:12a9d2eab85493d0.title: Ariva

dos:12bd10f12eb1fc24.description: A side-view Spanish action game in which a hero in a spacesuit runs, jumps, floats in the air for a while and fires laser charges at his enemies.
dos:12bd10f12eb1fc24.title: El Amo del Mundo

dos:12c942a5febd9bad.description: An adventure for young children. Fatty Bear helps the other toys prepare a surprise party for Kayla, finding cake ingredients, missing letters for the sign and balloons, with bowling and piano mini-games.
dos:12c942a5febd9bad.title: Fatty Bear's Birthday Surprise

dos:12d2409aab84132d.description: A top-down soccer game with exhibition, league and cup modes, many national teams and formation options that you can edit manually.
dos:12d2409aab84132d.title: DDM Soccer '96

dos:12da3798d9c92479.description: An exploration puzzle game: each level strands you somewhere on a scrolling overhead map, and you must find the golden keys needed for that level and reach the exit.
dos:12da3798d9c92479.title: Expo

dos:12df5234a550cb5e.description: A video poker game that can be used for playing against the computer or for calculating statistical outcomes.
dos:12df5234a550cb5e.title: Strategic Video Poker

dos:12ead4d23130f980.description: A six-month snowmobile trek through the snowy woods of northeastern Canada. Ten contestants race through 25 cities, surviving in the wilderness and hunting animals.
dos:12ead4d23130f980.title: Skidoo

dos:12f303d68cc9354a.description: A side-scrolling action platformer. As Fox, a member of the CEO special corps, go to the Soviet city of Chernovska to find out what became of an agent who reported on a military project called RAM.
dos:12f303d68cc9354a.title: R.A.M.

dos:12f4ae69962cb578.description: Laserdisc-style conversion of Don Bluth's cartoon. Cadet Dexter tries to free his love Kimberly from the evil Borf, transforming into Space Ace in critical moments.
dos:12f4ae69962cb578.title: Space Ace II: Borf's Revenge

dos:12f51f2c38d92d99.description: A simple arcade game: survive a barrage of meteor showers by dodging them with your character anywhere on the screen.
dos:12f51f2c38d92d99.title: Tommy's Meteors

dos:12f6e8e8833de091.description: A racing game based on rally driver René Metge and his Porsche 944 Turbo, viewed from above and behind the car, on four French racetracks including Paul Ricard, Magny-Cours and Dijon-Prenois.
dos:12f6e8e8833de091.title: Turbo Cup

dos:12fa46aa081b61fc.description: A scrolling shooter in which you play an overlynx, a peaceful ancient race of Earth and Atlantis, fighting humans created by aliens on the planet Danedola to exterminate your kind.
dos:12fa46aa081b61fc.title: Interpose

dos:12fc9c8ce20f3a1a.description: A snake variant in which hitting your own tail doesn't end the game; you bite that part off and lose length.
dos:12fc9c8ce20f3a1a.title: Endless Snake

dos:12fddb0dd2cc096e.description: An ASCII rogue-like with randomized maps. Explore 20+ dungeon levels to capture the magical Sudbury Sapphire from a group of Imperial Dragons, past vine traps, labyrinth traps and wall torches.
dos:12fddb0dd2cc096e.title: MAG

dos:12ff7c8669741a2f.description: The second collection of games for preschoolers and younger students, with drawing and music mini-games.
dos:12ff7c8669741a2f.title: Thinkin' Things Collection 2

dos:1306ca54ebb21583.description: A fighting game with characters from the Ravenloft setting of AD&D. Besides winning each battle, you quest for artifacts that decide whether the ranks of Chaos or the Lords of Law triumph.
dos:1306ca54ebb21583.title: Iron & Blood: Warriors of Ravenloft

dos:1308ac244030b3f2.description: A text adventure in which you are on the skeleton crew testing a submarine in emergency conditions. The rest of the crew has disappeared, and you run around the sub fixing everything that doesn't work.
dos:1308ac244030b3f2.title: Nuclear Sub Adventure

dos:13110d0b3464700c.description: Sequel to Shadowlands. Command a team of four explorers through a deserted space station, solving puzzles, fighting baddies and exploring, in a real-time RPG.
dos:13110d0b3464700c.title: Shadoworlds

dos:1316d5b24e15d1e1.description: An Arkanoid-style game with a ball, a paddle and blocks at the top of the screen.
dos:1316d5b24e15d1e1.title: Enigma

dos:1323457af5b9b0a3.description: A timed text adventure: a broken-down car leaves you stranded near an unfriendly farm. Explore the grounds, find useful objects and work around the residents' routines before help arrives.
dos:1323457af5b9b0a3.title: The Farmer's Daughter

dos:1342620c84b18f6b.description: An add-on for Descent with over 100 new fan-made levels judged best by Computer Gaming World in a contest, plus a new level from the creators.
dos:1342620c84b18f6b.title: Descent: Levels of the World

dos:13698bf0f6b85499.description: A Battleship-style game with many enhancements: fighter jets, radar jamming and infrared scopes, each tied to a specific ship, adding strategy to the familiar game.
dos:13698bf0f6b85499.title: Armada (1992)

dos:136a6ef650d83ac9.description: A puzzle game in which you choose a picture that is cut into blocks on screen and slide the blocks up, down, left and right to rebuild it.
dos:136a6ef650d83ac9.title: Jigsaw!

dos:136f5c18eb845169.description: A side-scrolling space shooter from Korea with 6 stages, each ending in a boss. Shoot everything that moves with CTRL and use the extra weapon with ALT.
dos:136f5c18eb845169.title: Fox Ranger

dos:1374328ca5405e31.description: A simple educational game for children: guess words of up to six letters while a green airplane flies and each letter choice uses fuel.
dos:1374328ca5405e31.title: Letter Drop

dos:138950c034f91a66.description: A horizontal-scrolling platformer in which you play secret agent Top, striking enemies with your head. Items collected during a level can be exchanged for energy and time at the end.
dos:138950c034f91a66.title: Hammer-Head

dos:13928f1feacea3b5.description: The arcade classic: ride a flying ostrich (a stork for Player 2) with a lance against evil knights on vultures, flapping to strike from above. One or two players.
dos:13928f1feacea3b5.title: Joust

dos:1392900a8b736fda.description: A shareware Lode Runner-style arcade puzzle game of ladders and platforms: collect all the gems on a level to move on.
dos:1392900a8b736fda.title: Moraff's Escapade

dos:13953ed90edac0b6.description: A fantasy adventure and role-playing game that opens on a dark midnight beside a hut with a vegetable garden, as a howl begins out of the quiet.
dos:13953ed90edac0b6.title: Dismal Passages

dos:1398831e5a21c0d3.description: MicroProse's second edition football simulation, emphasizing management and coaching over arcade action. Fully editable statistics for every NFL team and player of the 1994 season.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Football; Strategy
dos:1398831e5a21c0d3.title: Ultimate NFL Coaches Club Football

dos:139e53fecf826d42.description: A shareware arcade shooter, a cross between Galaxian and Space Invaders: move your ship left and right with the cursor keys and shoot for a high score.
dos:139e53fecf826d42.title: Bandits!

dos:139fb1dcddcf2066.description: A joke program by Doug Oldfield, programmer on Space Quest III and IV, parodying tourist guidebooks with humorous descriptions of locations near Sierra's headquarters.
dos:139fb1dcddcf2066.title: Fun Seeker's Guide to Eastern Madera County

dos:13a1f37c0b43b6eb.description: A Dinamic scrolling hack 'n' slash game in two parts: find three magic scrolls in the first, then go on to defeat your foes and rescue the other wizards in the second, which requires a password.
dos:13a1f37c0b43b6eb.title: Satan

dos:13a492072a242203.description: An Olympics-style sports game with five events: hurdles, triple jump, skeet shooting, diving and fencing. Play events individually or as a tournament, choosing your nationality.
dos:13a492072a242203.title: Summer Challenge

dos:13a7624018bed066.description: A division-level strategic wargame covering the entire Russian Front from Berlin to Stalingrad, with over 150 German and over 200 Soviet divisions.
dos:13a7624018bed066.title: Second Front: Germany Turns East

dos:13b58c44f292d91f.description: A collection of mini-games from Spain, a DOS remake of Sega's arcade game Puzzle & Action: Tant-R.
dos:13b58c44f292d91f.title: Puzz & Brain

dos:13bce0fb052866a7.description: The wizard Anthrax has summoned a Demon to usurp the kingdom, and a random stranger nearby realizes that only he can beat back the horde of monsters it sends.
dos:13bce0fb052866a7.title: Wrath of the Demon

dos:13bfdfe846e14962.description: Eight world-renowned weapon fighters are invited to a mysterious tournament. A one-on-one fighter that lets you sidestep a full 360 degrees around your opponent.
dos:13bfdfe846e14962.title: Battle Arena Toshinden

dos:13ea711c418cfe65.description: A live-actor arcade shooter from American Laser Games set in the 1920s gangster era. Find out who shot singer Johnny Rock, or who hired the shooters, and put them behind bars.
tags: Action; Interactive Movie; Shooter / Rail shooter
dos:13ea711c418cfe65.title: Who Shot Johnny Rock?

dos:13ee880b79e04f05.description: Fight creatures of myth and folklore with swords and wands in search of a golden ring with magical powers, collecting mushrooms along the way to restore your health.
dos:13ee880b79e04f05.title: ICON: Quest for the Ring

dos:13fc5fdaa945f30c.description: A text adventure in which you are a government agent held in a secret base in the United States, where you learn of a Soviet plan to fire nuclear missiles from inside the country and blame it on an inside job. You must stop it.
dos:13fc5fdaa945f30c.title: Escape from Soviet Science and Detention Base

dos:14064c506c11ffb1.description: Make a fortune by acquiring companies in each of 12 industries to build monopolies, raising funds through bank loans, venture capital or junk bonds.
dos:14064c506c11ffb1.title: Corporate Raider: The Pirate of Wall St.

dos:14077c9a35c05b94.description: Edmark's first game for very young children, entirely point-and-click with spoken instructions. Millie perches on a desk on the main page in front of a row of activities.
dos:14077c9a35c05b94.title: Millie's Math House

dos:140c9c1892bc6de5.description: Downhill racing from an isometric, Marble Madness-style view. Reach the bottom within the time limit, stay on the track and avoid hazards such as water, logs and parked cars. Faster finishes earn more prize money.
dos:140c9c1892bc6de5.title: Motorbike Madness

dos:1411d1ab7771d4b7.description: A role-playing adventure on the land of Faland, full of demons, monsters, wild animals and renegades, with farmlands, forests, mountains and deserts to explore.
dos:1411d1ab7771d4b7.title: FallThru

dos:1413944a4960b70c.description: A game based on programming in Pascal, inspired by C-ROBOTS: design and program a robot to win real-time battles against robots written by others.
dos:1413944a4960b70c.title: P-Robots

dos:141c107563fce6cf.description: Robots rule Earth and the last humans are kept in a zoo with American artifacts. A wave of killings is under way, and you have 12 hours to find out who is responsible and why.
dos:141c107563fce6cf.title: Free D.C!

dos:141d503a4f991a0e.description: A flight sim set in a near future after the Soviet collapse, where Alaska declares independence and oil is scarce. You fly as a mercenary pilot in the Strike Commander squadron.
dos:141d503a4f991a0e.title: Strike Commander

dos:1429278ae4816d82.description: A murder mystery on a ship in which you piece together clues and evidence to find the culprit, relying on logical deduction and precise timing.
dos:1429278ae4816d82.title: Murder on the Atlantic

dos:1429b7a7c21beaa0.description: The official game of the Major Indoor Soccer League. Create an expansion team and build it into a championship franchise: trade and create players, modify rosters and train for the season. Coach, GM, play, or all three.
dos:1429b7a7c21beaa0.title: Major Indoor Soccer League

dos:143df1940244a706.description: A grand strategic game of World War II in the west, 1944-1945. The Western and Italian fronts are covered in detail, and the Eastern front reflects the effect of a two-front war.
dos:143df1940244a706.title: Western Front: The Liberation of Europe 1944-1945

dos:14480d2be18b94ae.description: A simple arcade platformer starring a bunny with a passion for sweets. Climb ladders, jump traps and hop platforms to grab every food item; each level brings a new kind of treat.
dos:14480d2be18b94ae.title: Bong Bong

dos:144d7d5df4ae4ab5.description: An Asteroids-style game where instead of asteroids there is one large BattleStar on the field that you must destroy while avoiding its fire.
dos:144d7d5df4ae4ab5.title: BattleStar 2

dos:1453ef70c6a2a73e.description: A pinball game with four SVGA tables, multiplayer modes and a realistic physics model. Tables don't scroll; you see the whole table at 800x600. A leaked prototype that was never released.
dos:1453ef70c6a2a73e.title: Electronic Pinball

dos:145ce6c9508dcf88.description: A shareware program that makes predictions about the future in two modes. In the first, pick from a list of questions, such as political elections, science, health and education.
dos:145ce6c9508dcf88.title: Crystal Ball

dos:1466dabf49ea4696.description: An IQ-test-style brain trainer with questions in five categories: odd one out, shapes, building blocks, dominoes and number sequences. You have fifteen minutes, or you can practice one category.
dos:1466dabf49ea4696.title: Advanced Thinking Skills

dos:146830a6511f8dac.description: Play Joshua, leader of the Israelites after Moses, leading them to Canaan past puzzles and obstacles such as falling rocks and hostile soldiers, using his horn and special weapons. One or two players.
dos:146830a6511f8dac.title: Joshua & the Battle of Jericho

dos:1475ba89a514842b.description: A Spanish-language fantasy RPG: find a way out of Castle Ragor using spells, healing potions, poisons, weapons and keys.
dos:1475ba89a514842b.title: Escape From Ragor

dos:148bc61d6d36077b.description: An educational Sesame Street game published by Hi Tech Expressions in 1987, in which you pick a character, such as Bert, and go around town.
dos:148bc61d6d36077b.title: Sesame Street: Pals Around Town

dos:149134abd9df493a.description: King Reginald Hornbluff of Regal City contains crime and vigilante conflict by building a huge gladiatorial arena with cash prizes. You fight in The Pit.
dos:149134abd9df493a.title: The Pit

dos:14921b4bcdd925a6.description: A word game of rearranging letters with several modes. In the standard game, find as many words as you can by mixing the letters of a word; in the anagrams-only game, use all of the letters.
dos:14921b4bcdd925a6.title: Scramble (1990)(Softdisk)

dos:149dae74f9239deb.description: A fan version of Super Star Trek written in QBasic, all commands entered in capitals.
dos:149dae74f9239deb.title: Super Star Trek (1995)

dos:14b86a9b4181e507.description: A land management game in the vein of Hamurabi. As Earl of a medieval English manor, each turn is a year of your reign, and you manage serfs, peasants and nobles.
dos:14b86a9b4181e507.title: Manor

dos:14bb369be1a4216d.description: A strategy game of the American Revolution. By 1775, the Crown has taxed the New World colonies without representation, and the colonies boycott British rule.
dos:14bb369be1a4216d.title: Liberty or Death

dos:14bed306f309c471.description: A poker game of five-card draw against the computer's two photographed players, Suzi and Melissa. Each hand you win moves the show along, and extra data disks bring in new opponents.
dos:14bed306f309c471.title: Str♥p Poker II

dos:14cc07e68f101faf.description: A space shoot-'em-up with eight alien types, each with its own attack pattern. Clear a zone to advance, ten zones make a fleet, and the game gets harder after each fleet.
dos:14cc07e68f101faf.title: Fleet Sweep

dos:14dad6d71da277c1.description: Bethesda's fourth Terminator game, a first-person corridor crawler. SkyNet is overrun by the Resistance and again sends a robot into the past, to 1984.
dos:14dad6d71da277c1.title: The Terminator: Rampage

dos:14ee21bb242fb47e.description: Korea's first first-person shooter, from Ablex, with Doom-like aesthetics and demonic enemies, more futuristic weapons, and voxel-based terrain.
dos:14ee21bb242fb47e.title: Hades

dos:14ee73c6e90939df.description: A World War II naval strategy and simulation game about the desperate battles of the Solomon Islands, in and around Guadalcanal.
dos:14ee73c6e90939df.title: Task Force 1942

dos:14ef530fed55c776.description: An add-on episode for Duke Nukem 3D: aliens have captured the President in Washington D.C., and Duke goes there to clear the city of them and free him.
dos:14ef530fed55c776.title: Duke it out in D.C.

dos:14fea277df40d3d7.description: A shareware golf game for up to ten players, each with a differently colored ball, sequel to Caddiehack CGA Tour, with EGA/VGA graphics and ARCH, a course architect program for designing your own courses.
dos:14fea277df40d3d7.title: Caddiehack

dos:150e9c7332ac9761.description: A top-down soccer game with exhibition, league and cup modes, many national teams and formations you can adjust manually.
dos:150e9c7332ac9761.title: DDM Soccer '97

dos:151301367de22978.description: Rescue captured soldiers from P.O.W. camps in a small, fast jeep where heavy forces would fail. A top-down military shooter. One or two players cooperatively.
dos:151301367de22978.title: Jackal

dos:1517b4bf693014e9.description: A licensed Lotus racing game with two modes: racing against 19 computer rivals with silly names, or against the clock. 13 types of races, from motorways to night-time.
dos:1517b4bf693014e9.title: Lotus: The Ultimate Challenge

dos:1518d61b6139cb8b.description: A strategic political and war simulator starting in 1028 AD and lasting up to 100 turns (500 years). Up to 10 players, with the computer controlling up to 6.
dos:1518d61b6139cb8b.title: Medieval Lords: Soldier Kings of Europe

dos:151997df1e7bf846.description: Abmis the Lion, King of the Beasts, must recover all of his kingdom's stolen potatoes. Navigate side-view platform mazes, avoiding animal hazards, in pursuit of the foxy thief.
dos:151997df1e7bf846.title: Abmis the Lion

dos:152881f2cda51201.description: Shogi, Japan's most popular strategy game, related to chess and descended from the same ancient games, in EGA graphics.
dos:152881f2cda51201.title: EGA Shogi

dos:153fe428f3695ae7.description: A top-down vertical shooter in which you fly through complex formations of enemies with guns, lasers, energy blasts, missiles and satellite drones.
dos:153fe428f3695ae7.title: Mirage Thunder

dos:1540a5f39e7c1341.description: A text and graphic anthropomorphic action scenario serialized in fan magazines, set on an island on the Pacific Rim in the mid-2030s.
dos:1540a5f39e7c1341.title: Toho Academy Adventure

dos:1541b7750ee9f094.description: A Korean platformer in which you play an Indian warrior through six levels, seeking crystals wanted by an evil sorcerer.
dos:1541b7750ee9f094.title: Apachacha

dos:15442ce11dec6611.description: An educational object-sorting game modeled on the Atari Adventure, with a quacking dragon-duck, for a younger audience. Gertrude is a benevolent goose.
dos:15442ce11dec6611.title: Gertrude's Secrets

dos:154925a792208685.description: An arcade yacht simulator: reach a destination in a limited time without hitting rocks or obstacles, adjusting speed, sail position and wind direction.
dos:154925a792208685.title: Regatta

dos:154c812b618264d0.description: A program for making your own animated cartoons from actor templates and static backgrounds, simple enough for a child of 5, with characters from a duck to a pig.
dos:154c812b618264d0.title: Cartooners

dos:155031cfd51c1ac8.description: Several action parts based on the film, each resembling a different genre game, such as a side-view beat-'em-up in the first level, with cutscenes from the movie between levels.
dos:155031cfd51c1ac8.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

dos:155c78ba5a4a74ad.description: A graphic and text adventure that follows the legendary Level 9 adventures but meets modern expectations, as a contemporary homage.
dos:155c78ba5a4a74ad.title: Curse of Rabenstein, The

dos:1571850d4f0b1b83.description: A space trading game with a text adventure interface. You begin with your first spaceship and 200 space-credits, and the aim is to turn it into 30,000 and the rank of Master Trader.
dos:1571850d4f0b1b83.title: Wraith Blaster

dos:157329b9c7b768ef.description: The original idea behind SkyRoads. Fly a hovercraft over platforms, avoiding gaps and falling off, with some platforms giving power-ups or killing you.
dos:157329b9c7b768ef.title: Kosmonaut

dos:15868e2c653dd96f.description: Blinky the purple dinosaur returns as the evil Shnookwad unleashes monsters on Funky Forest. With a Box of Everlasting Doughnuts and his cat Doughnut, explore sixteen colorful levels.
dos:15868e2c653dd96f.title: Blinky 2

dos:158ce704383119c3.description: A flight simulator of the Soviet SU-25 attack jet with a wide range of bombs and munitions. Three sets of missions, from 1991 to 1993, from attacking tanks to bridges.
dos:158ce704383119c3.title: Stormovik: SU-25 Soviet Attack Fighter

dos:159522ca4f093338.description: Cinemaware's American football game styled as a TV broadcast, with a TV-style introduction before each match and cutscenes following dramatic moments. Primarily action-based.
dos:159522ca4f093338.title: TV Sports: Football

dos:1597de570abba308.description: Shortly after the war, several countries want control of Berlin, and the Americans have smuggled in an atomic bomb. As an American spy, guard the bomb and keep it from Stalin. An early third-person point-and-click adventure.
dos:1597de570abba308.title: Berlin 1948

dos:159cdbdab8b88e1a.description: A maze game in text-mode graphics: steer your vehicle from the bottom right to the exit at the top left without hitting walls. Three mazes (the third random) and 10 skill levels.
dos:159cdbdab8b88e1a.title: Datnoids

dos:15acf605cba20ee8.description: Third in the Oxyd series and the first sold commercially. A real-time puzzle game where you roll a ball through landscapes, hitting oxyd stones that reveal colored symbols and matching them.
dos:15acf605cba20ee8.title: Oxyd Magnum!

dos:15ade1ab513b9201.description: A compilation of over 1000 WADs for Doom and Doom II, with new graphics, sound and music.
dos:15ade1ab513b9201.title: D!Zone 3

dos:15af8d2aed5d4a48.description: An online multiplayer flight simulator with 17 World War II fighters and bombers from five nations, including the P-51D Mustang, Spitfire Mk IX, FW-190 and B-17G Flying Fortress, for dogfights and bombing missions.
dos:15af8d2aed5d4a48.title: Air Warrior

dos:15b41742382b491b.description: Johnny Bazookatone, a guitar hero with a purple pompadour, is imprisoned in 2050 in Sin Sin Prison by El Diablo, the Lord of the Underworld, who is jealous of his talent. A side-scrolling platformer.
dos:15b41742382b491b.title: Johnny Bazookatone

dos:15c65b01394bb5eb.description: A clone of Cabal (Nam 1975), in which you are a lone soldier shooting at enemies such as boats and fighters.
dos:15c65b01394bb5eb.title: Kuwait Assault

dos:15cba65459356292.description: A Legend Entertainment text adventure based on Frederik Pohl's novel. As a prospector, you explore strange worlds in search of artifacts and installations of the vanished alien Heechee.
dos:15cba65459356292.title: Frederik Pohl's Gateway

dos:15cd8c428d695be5.description: A light-cycle game in the style of Tron, written in Turbo C for Hercules monochrome graphics. Each of two contestants can be human or computer controlled, and there is a demo mode.
dos:15cd8c428d695be5.title: H-Tron

dos:15d3c3473096175d.description: A pinball-style game with five balls, flippers controlled by the keypad, and bonus points for knocking out parts of the FLIPOUT title.
dos:15d3c3473096175d.title: Tommy's Flipout

dos:15db16b25f307e65.description: The solo version of the sequel to Shadow of Yserbius, the Sierra Network's graphical multi-user dungeon game. Brave warriors and wizards enter dangerous dungeons to uncover the evils plaguing the land.
dos:15db16b25f307e65.title: Fates of Twinion

dos:15e1cbbe147f98d7.description: An arcade match-pairs memory game with a Pac-Man-like hero. Open all the pairs of pictures before time runs out, avoiding the unpaired skeleton card. Only a nine-level demo was released.
dos:15e1cbbe147f98d7.title: Pairs

dos:15e38652e1a3ced1.description: A freeware version of the board game Sorry! for one to four players. Draw cards to move your tokens, and be first to get all your pieces to the center of the board.
dos:15e38652e1a3ced1.title: Sorry! (1988)

dos:15fbdbe52956f06d.description: A collection of board games played with Mario, who talks to you as you play Checkers, Go Fish, Dominoes, Backgammon and Yacht.
dos:15fbdbe52956f06d.title: Mario's Game Gallery

dos:1601bb850c59736b.description: Sequel to Artworx's Slap-Shot! Hockey. Play the computer at three skill levels or a second player head-to-head, with precision passing, body checks, penalty shots and a shootout mode.
dos:1601bb850c59736b.title: International Hockey

dos:160f21347e2401f0.description: A game that looks like a Pac-Man clone but lets you jump, shoot and drop bombs, and is more complicated than it seems.
dos:160f21347e2401f0.title: The Fantastic Zapman 1

dos:16118dbaf99ac08d.description: Play the Doctor from Doctor Who, trying to stop the Daleks from invading Earth with help from companions. It starts with flying a hover platform through the sewers of London, blasting monsters with a laser.
dos:16118dbaf99ac08d.title: Dalek Attack

dos:16140c7fdf55901a.description: Fantasy football where monsters pummel each other and dodge landmines to score touchdowns.
dos:16140c7fdf55901a.title: Grave Yardage

dos:161b8daa8f1d4202.description: A pseudo-3D maze game that uses text for graphics, written in QBasic.
dos:161b8daa8f1d4202.title: Baron Von Evil's Mansion

dos:161e6c80096728a8.description: A text adventure in which, as the last surviving crew member of a space freighter, you must escape in a frail shuttle without being eaten by a mutant monster.
dos:161e6c80096728a8.title: Mysterious Adventure No. 5: Escape from Pulsar 7

dos:162189d2ed2b1efd.description: A tank-in-a-maze game in the vein of Tank Battalion, with an isometric view and World War II setting. Patrol your territory as enemy forces pour in. Its Chinese title translates to Battle of the Bulge.
dos:162189d2ed2b1efd.title: Battle Europe

dos:16251a7775410f5f.description: An interactive full-motion video shooter based on the HBO movie. A UN plane over the jungles of Vietnam is shot down and the terrorist Vinh Moc kidnaps the survivors.
dos:16251a7775410f5f.title: Soldier Boyz

dos:164c1b5625154769.description: A text adventure in which you play an Australian on a skiing vacation in Germany who wakes up in the cabin to find his family gone.
dos:164c1b5625154769.title: Vacation Gone Awry

dos:16507f1a70558111.description: Mickey and Pluto board a spaceship and are sent on a quest by XL30 of the planet Oron to find nine pieces of its stolen memory crystal, hidden on the planets of the solar system.
dos:16507f1a70558111.title: Mickey's Space Adventure

dos:1671ec1bf55aaaff.description: Sequel to Romance of the Three Kingdoms with the same concept and improvements to features that were frustrating in the first game, such as generals dying easily of disease.
dos:1671ec1bf55aaaff.title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms II

dos:167201bc18e992bd.description: An inventor races his new radio control and camera system to the patent office by folding it into a paper airplane. Over seven levels, ride wind currents and brave dangers.
dos:167201bc18e992bd.title: Paper Airplane

dos:16779ae2317a0477.description: The Player's Choice Edition of Burnout Championship Drag Racing, an add-on with an extra in-car view, more tracks and cars, and additional engine components.
dos:16779ae2317a0477.title: Burnout Championship Drag Racing (Player's Choice)

dos:167e961e5f451229.description: Dan Bunten's board game of world domination: explore and dominate a world inhabited by natives before three other players do. Play against computer players or friends by modem.
dos:167e961e5f451229.title: Global Conquest

dos:1685316786217ea7.description: A racing game made by the Chinese company Multi-System for its Super MS-200E controller.
dos:1685316786217ea7.title: Race Car

dos:1690d4ac04be5d4f.description: The second Helious game: maneuver a balloon through levels, where every maneuver releases air from the balloon and too much will end it.
dos:1690d4ac04be5d4f.title: Helious II

dos:169e73fdb38ee825.description: A medically themed action shooter: control a tiny hypodermic syringe within a microscopic grid of cells to cure a patient of a quickly mutating viral infection.
dos:169e73fdb38ee825.title: Virus Rage

dos:16b0d5a30747edd1.description: A shareware maze game: hunt for treasure in computer-generated labyrinths over five levels with 9999 possible mazes each, tracking time and steps.
dos:16b0d5a30747edd1.title: Labyrinth (1986)

dos:16b80216e93ee01e.description: Geoff Crammond's second racing simulation, recreating all the circuits and drivers of the 1994 Formula 1 World Championship, viewed from the cockpit, with texture mapping.
dos:16b80216e93ee01e.title: Grand Prix II

dos:16b80ef874849927.description: Drew Blanc, the animator behind the Fluffy Fluffy Bun Bun Show, is sickened by its cute rabbits and gets pulled into a cartoon world with his creation Flux Wildly, a sarcastic purple character.
dos:16b80ef874849927.title: Toonstruck

dos:16ce903c7e283a23.description: An early Doom clone built with the 3D Game Creation engine. You land on a planet and shoot everything in sight to reach your goal.
dos:16ce903c7e283a23.title: Castaway: The Ordeal Begins

dos:16d175b65e230174.description: A Rampage-style arcade game where you play an ogre or a dragon searching an island for an egg that gives super powers, smashing buildings to find the right one.
dos:16d175b65e230174.title: AAARGH!

dos:16d22ee7db4cb49c.description: An unfinished, unreleased FMV platformer by Loricel for the REEL Magic MPEG playback card, which doubled as a Sound Blaster compatible card.
dos:16d22ee7db4cb49c.title: Entity (REEL Magic)

dos:16dfd45626ccd270.description: A railroad management simulation from Artdink, an earlier installment of its Take the A-Train series that was published internationally before A-Train.
dos:16dfd45626ccd270.title: Railroad Empire

dos:16e0bba2c747a3ce.description: Last of four Treasure games in the Super Solvers series. The Master of Mischief goes to Crystal City in deep space, turns asteroids into Disasteroids and shatters its crystals, and the Super Solvers must restore them.
dos:16e0bba2c747a3ce.title: Super Solvers Treasure Galaxy!

dos:16faed711801990f.description: An action-adventure inspired by cult B-movies of the 50s and 60s, especially Them. Play geologist Dr. Greg Bradley, new in town, who investigates strange events.
dos:16faed711801990f.title: It Came From The Desert

dos:17017b3859adead8.description: A falling-block educational game: use falling x-components and numbers to solve first-grade equations.
dos:17017b3859adead8.title: Valgebra

dos:172c1fd9a3fff14e.description: A fantasy RPG set in Osbeorht, held by the demon wizard Eoghan and a brotherhood of necromancers. A brave adventurer must find a number of artifacts to defeat evil.
dos:172c1fd9a3fff14e.title: The Amulet

dos:17345c976c06dcad.description: You are the Avatar, returning to Britannia after 200 years to find ritual murders and the Fellowship gathering followers, while the Guardian mocks you. Your old companions join your quest. Includes Forge of Virtue.
dos:17345c976c06dcad.title: Ultima VII: The Black Gate + Forge of Virtue

dos:17471b6c2f6afb50.description: Third in the tank combat series after Team Yankee and Pacific Islands, imagining Iraq invading Kuwait a second time. The series is known for showing all four of your tanks at once.
dos:17471b6c2f6afb50.title: War in the Gulf

dos:17479b61052ee175.description: A simplified combat game using basic units with defined attributes, with scenarios from simple to complex and thousands of possible games each. The computer can play either or both commanders.
dos:17479b61052ee175.title: The Perfect General

dos:174a0ac6b840477f.description: Your king and fellow warriors have been slain and you are wounded. You vow to find and destroy Lugor the Evil Presence, who caused it. A text adventure.
dos:174a0ac6b840477f.title: Avenger of Rubicon

dos:1754c66c35c678fb.description: Players leave trails as they move across an empty black field, and crashing into any trail is death. Outmaneuver and outlive the enemies. Starting level, difficulty and speed are adjustable.
dos:1754c66c35c678fb.title: Boxzum

dos:1756c84bbff20ec0.description: A PC conversion of the classic mainframe game that started computer role-playing games, using D&D rules in a dungeon crawl.
dos:1756c84bbff20ec0.title: DND

dos:175772fb852f9448.description: A shareware Blackjack game from Hyperware's Gamblers and Money Grubbers series. Play with up to four other players and up to six decks.
dos:175772fb852f9448.title: Gamblers and Money Grubbers

dos:1757f807948f334b.description: An action game in which you control the Metal Mutant, sent to the planet Kronox to find and destroy the insane computer AROD 7. Levels are divided into separate screens.
dos:1757f807948f334b.title: Metal Mutant

dos:175e54598afac68f.description: A text adventure about a man who has just moved to a new apartment and falls victim to bureaucratic procedures that always go wrong: he can't get his mail, reach his bank account or live normally.
dos:175e54598afac68f.title: Bureaucracy

dos:177eeb81f73a5500.description: A text adventure sequel in which you wake in a cell-like room in an asylum, with a box containing a credit card on the bed, and try to escape using the objects you find.
dos:177eeb81f73a5500.title: Asylum (1985)

dos:17a06f0b69c18d2c.description: The classic dungeon crawl in ASCII characters: explore the Dungeon of Doom one turn at a time with a host of weapons and items, against 25 types of monsters.
dos:17a06f0b69c18d2c.title: Rogue

dos:17a17e8db073ed66.description: First in Keith Laverty's RoboMaze trilogy. Defeat enemies as you move across maze-like screens, with many destructible environments concealing bonus items.
dos:17a17e8db073ed66.title: RoboMaze: The Basement

dos:17b09d4efec20a8f.description: A side-scrolling platform shooter. As CIA special agent Charles Cat, destroy a neo-Nazi secret base in the Andes across three stages: jungle, base and laboratory.
dos:17b09d4efec20a8f.title: Spy Master

dos:17b0be82c3c36655.description: True sequel to Dungeon Master, mixing real-time battles with puzzle solving and travel, now with auto-mapping. The first part of the game is spent above ground.
dos:17b0be82c3c36655.title: Dungeon Master II: The Legend of Skullkeep

dos:17baaa8edad7c007.description: An educational title for younger kids featuring the Berenstain Bears.
dos:17baaa8edad7c007.title: The Berenstain Bears: Treehouse Classroom

dos:17be9ee45c7279ca.description: A text adventure. As a recent Police Academy graduate starting as a patrolman, aided by the friendly alien Battune, talk to people, gather clues, solve crimes and make arrests in a crime-ridden district.
dos:17be9ee45c7279ca.title: Battune: Crimefighter

dos:17c5009b910096c8.description: Play an ASCII frog that hops left and right and extends its tongue to catch fat insects, showing how tough life in the wild gets.
dos:17c5009b910096c8.title: Bugfeast

dos:17d4583fe0a668b9.description: A jigsaw program for young learners: a picture is broken into between 8 and 60 square pieces to put back together, building shape recognition and visual skills.
dos:17d4583fe0a668b9.title: The Berenstain Bears: Jr Jigsaw!

dos:17d6a7c650741e47.description: A single-player crossword game with thirty-nine ready-made crosswords and an editor for creating and sharing your own, with hint options in solution mode.
dos:17d6a7c650741e47.title: Tommy's Crosswords

dos:17ec70bd3efeb989.description: A shareware turn-based fantasy tactics game. Command a race such as orcs, elves, goblins or the undead in single battles or a campaign, each race with unique units and bonuses.
dos:17ec70bd3efeb989.title: Fallen Heroes

dos:17ec9998d58443a3.description: Twin brothers Na Daero and Na Gaeseong, caught by police for minor crimes, plan a bigger theft after their release, but a mysterious Mr. X foils them and leaves with their trophies.
dos:17ec9998d58443a3.title: Twins (1995)

dos:17f51e8a32bb8b7e.description: A real-time strategy game built on unit types, formation and strength, set in ancient times before gunpowder with fast Barbarians, heavily armored units and more.
dos:17f51e8a32bb8b7e.title: The Ancient Art of War

dos:17fbce294bf5fe59.description: Fourth in the Game of Robot series. The hero, now noted for enduring adventures, is sent on an official mission to investigate mysterious radio interference from an old radar station.
dos:17fbce294bf5fe59.title: Robot IV: Operation ExtraTax

dos:17fd3219fc619d7e.description: A text-mode adventure game in the style of Rogue, famous for its level editor with scripting that lets you build unlimited new scenarios, stories, characters, traps and machines.
dos:17fd3219fc619d7e.title: ZZT

dos:17feabdd54aba30d.description: A freeware blackjack game for up to seven players with every seat under player control and a dealer as the only computer opponent, using Harrah's Marina, Atlantic City rules.
dos:17feabdd54aba30d.title: Professional Blackjack

dos:180464c0710cb634.description: Search for a treasure hidden underground before you run out of energy, in the fewest tries possible.
dos:180464c0710cb634.title: Gold Hunt 1.1

dos:180b916a270ffb1c.description: A very early adaptation of Trivial Pursuit: answer questions and try to win one wedge from each category.
dos:180b916a270ffb1c.title: Trivial Pursuit (1987)

dos:1813f2d47038ef7e.description: As Gideon Braver Vandenburg, heir to a planet, you are implicated in the destruction of your family's home and exiled. With the help of an old friend, pilot a 'Mech to win back your throne.
dos:1813f2d47038ef7e.title: MechWarrior

dos:182698654bd00acb.description: Roger Rabbit is framed for the murder of Marvin Acme. Find Acme's will, which leaves Toon Town to the Toons, and save Jessica from Judge Doom and his weasels in 1940s Hollywood.
dos:182698654bd00acb.title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit

dos:1829d40cc206a8f5.description: An ice hockey game with the NHLPA license and real NHL players but fictional teams, with a built-in editor to modify teams and players.
dos:1829d40cc206a8f5.title: Solid Ice

dos:182a8274f1141d61.description: A crosshair shooter. LA Lieutenant Mike Harrington, used to a drug war, finds the Predator has arrived and must stop it.
dos:182a8274f1141d61.title: Predator 2

dos:1835c06262493412.description: As Don Jonz, a marshal of the United Forces of Orion, you win a free trip to Eternam, the galaxy's most luxurious planet-sized fun park.
dos:1835c06262493412.title: Eternam

dos:1836257563722e72.description: An educational game in which aliens from the planet Glixer II travel through time kidnapping great scientists and erasing their discoveries, and Einstein needs your help to restore them.
dos:1836257563722e72.title: Rescue the Scientists

dos:183a33461b8b58f1.description: A single-player shareware shooter. Doctor Vladimir Von Technoface, who has discovered time travel, is bidding for world domination by visiting Nazi Germany in 1945, and Adam must stop him.
dos:183a33461b8b58f1.title: Adam the New Age Warrior in Time After Time

dos:184292ee27ec9f85.description: A comedy text adventure by Chuck Benton, published by On-Line Systems. Explore the nightlife and solve object puzzles in the game that later inspired Leisure Suit Larry.
dos:184292ee27ec9f85.title: Softp♥rn Adventure

dos:185b523c5750335b.description: A Snake variant where you can also shoot at things.
dos:185b523c5750335b.title: Firing Snake

dos:185d1096f452d605.description: A learning pack for ages 3 to 7 on the African Serengeti: five simple puzzle games for shape and pattern recognition, an Explore Story where you lead the lion cub Maya back to her mother, and Hide and Seek.
dos:185d1096f452d605.title: Zurk's Learning Safari

dos:1863a89b7a7fba2c.description: Mason Powers, a former CIA agent, wakes in a Turkish asylum with erased memories, then recovers and escapes, convinced he is innocent of the murder of his supervisor.
dos:1863a89b7a7fba2c.title: Countdown

dos:1865e52566b87e99.description: A Korean horizontally-scrolling shooter similar to IAS. Fly a fighter above planet surfaces and through hostile bases to avert an alien threat to humanity.
dos:1865e52566b87e99.title: Into the Sun: Projected Distruction

dos:18691234cafd697f.description: One or two player windsurfing at three skill levels. Show four judges your skills, from speed to trick-surfing, at 15 locations.
dos:18691234cafd697f.title: Windsurf Willy

dos:18714fd3660aac9f.description: The original commercially licensed version of Alexey Pajitnov's Tetris: fit falling shapes together so completed lines disappear, and the game ends when pieces stack to the top.
dos:18714fd3660aac9f.title: Tetris (1987)

dos:187367e15def5d20.description: An educational program for building creatures from heads, bodies, arms and legs, with thousands of combinations, then learning programming fundamentals by making them dance.
dos:187367e15def5d20.title: Creature Creator

dos:18889544804cac90.description: As Ransom Stark, hacker, scrounger or mercenary depending on your answers, you are caught in an affair with the evil megacorporation TransTechnicals, a fight for Cyberspace and vampires in Manhattan.
dos:18889544804cac90.title: BloodNet: A Cyberpunk Gothic

dos:18955908df06cbeb.description: Manage a cricket team from one of seven countries on tours of three lengths: one-day, three-day or a full test match.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Cricket
dos:18955908df06cbeb.title: World Cricket

dos:18a3c81c16995987.description: In 2012, terrorists led by Victor Baloch seize the twin U.N. towers and capture the world leaders at a summit. As a member of the government's Elite Force, you go in to stop them.
dos:18a3c81c16995987.title: Operation Body Count

dos:18a895c5c4a1a5b6.description: A CD-ROM edition of Jazz Jackrabbit with the original six episodes plus three new ones, exploring planets such as Exoticus, Industrius and Deserto, with new music and graphics.
dos:18a895c5c4a1a5b6.title: Jazz Jackrabbit CD-ROM

dos:18a942acdd5bf191.description: A text adventure in which your one-man spaceship crash-lands on a barren planet and you search 103 locations for remnants of civilization.
dos:18a942acdd5bf191.title: Forbidden Quest

dos:18adf5afb41183c5.description: In 2087, a physicist who invented a time machine gathers Guardians to travel back and stop the assassination of President Kennedy.
dos:18adf5afb41183c5.title: Guardians of Infinity: To Save Kennedy

dos:18b194d236310f35.description: A Russian falling-block puzzle in which the blocks are snakes of different kinds and lengths, crawling on landing and eliminating snakes of the same kind already landed. Later expanded into WildSnake.
dos:18b194d236310f35.title: Zmeelov

dos:18c1aa315fa30668.description: The Guardian banishes the Avatar to the world of Pagan, a land under his control. Stranded without companions, find a way back to Britannia while confronting four Titans.
dos:18c1aa315fa30668.title: Ultima VIII: Pagan

dos:18c36a7f736592eb.description: An updated Moraff's Memory for one or two players, based on the card game Concentration: match all pairs in as few turns as possible, or take turns against a second player.
dos:18c36a7f736592eb.title: Moraff's Monster Memory

dos:18cdf07836ed9500.description: A collection of three table games including Foosball, with keyboard and mouse controls and automatic pole switching in beginner mode.
dos:18cdf07836ed9500.title: 3-D TableSports

dos:18dbce26e690cfa8.description: An arcade-style action game in a large maze with generators that spawn the enemy Snipes. Shoot all the generators and Snipes, with one set of keys to move and one to fire.
dos:18dbce26e690cfa8.title: Snipes

dos:18ddb8a3e29e32e8.description: A quiz game for 1, 2 or 3 players with four blocks of questions in six categories: art and literature, science, music, film and television, sport, and history and geography.
dos:18ddb8a3e29e32e8.title: Arcade Trivia Quiz

dos:18e405a1bb4bf568.description: A fighting game. Inventor William Spade, who made a time portal generator, loses body parts defending it from the Takar and rebuilds himself.
dos:18e405a1bb4bf568.title: Time Slaughter

dos:18e612857b888b02.description: You are sent to investigate radiation sickness aboard the space station Icarus, where the captain is murdered, an assassin threatens a visiting Senator and the station plunges toward the sun.
dos:18e612857b888b02.title: Sentient

dos:18e7343d284f9818.description: A Taiwanese action game based on the manga Ranma 1/2, starring Ranma, a teenager cursed to change form when splashed with water. Two modes, essentially two games in one.
dos:18e7343d284f9818.title: Qi Xiao Quan

dos:18ecfc987dff378f.description: Rumor has it the wealthy and eccentric Mr. Stone left his estate to whoever finds and opens his safe. Explore his manor and manipulate objects with two-word commands.
dos:18ecfc987dff378f.title: Stoneville Manor

dos:18f3cb09bead0de0.description: A text adventure in which you wake in a cell on the day of your sentencing for a terrible crime you did not commit, and the circumstantial evidence is against you.
dos:18f3cb09bead0de0.title: The Escape From Prison Island

dos:18f99b784e04f1eb.description: Sudoku for DOS with three levels of difficulty.
dos:18f99b784e04f1eb.title: Sudoku The Mind Game

dos:1904cd13205bfb8f.description: An English version of El chico de los recados, a graphical adventure and prequel to Rudolphine Rur, showing images with text descriptions. You play Galdrin.
dos:1904cd13205bfb8f.title: The Errand Boy

dos:190616f7f571ca79.description: A shareware Space Invaders clone: alien ships march back and forth toward your ship, and you must destroy them before they reach the bottom of the screen. High score table.
dos:190616f7f571ca79.title: SDI2040

dos:192556d9845dd64b.description: A platformer in which sword-armed Bert the Barbarian fights enemies with swords or throwing knives. The graphics are made out of clay.
dos:192556d9845dd64b.title: Bert the Barbarian

dos:19265de262e4017a.description: Two school friends, Wacek and Andzia, are told by an old Professor that a flying saucer has crashed and must find the little alien and help him. A kid-friendly adventure.
dos:19265de262e4017a.title: Sfinx

dos:192a7f73d04665cf.description: A graphic adventure of managing money and travelling town to town across Australia as an investigator solving mysteries, starting with almost no money.
dos:192a7f73d04665cf.title: Gumboots Australia

dos:193792798803febb.description: A shareware strategy game for one or two on an 8x8 grid: take turns placing counters, with each square holding as many as it has neighbors, and claim cells in chain reactions.
dos:193792798803febb.title: Chain Reaction (1990)

dos:193d6d26923aeedd.description: A head-to-head chase game on a flat playfield: one player runs while the other gives chase, points go to whoever makes the catch, and the roles swap every so often.
dos:193d6d26923aeedd.title: B♥tt Slam!!!

dos:1942f893f95b524a.description: On an automated space station where the robots have gone crazy, Joe must climb and jump across platforms to collect all his keys and escape.
dos:1942f893f95b524a.title: Janitor Joe

dos:1947f73a10126405.description: Zack, a new repairman at GadgetCo, navigates over 60 rooms of a falling-apart factory, avoiding deadly traps to find his missing tools and fix the interconnected machinery. A puzzle adventure.
dos:1947f73a10126405.title: Contraption Zack

dos:194c0091946deaba.description: The German release of ElectroMan: a platformer with puzzle elements in which you guide Jacek, the Electroman, around levels using teleporters and other devices.
dos:194c0091946deaba.title: Electro Body

dos:194f1ca0598f638a.description: A compilation of three simplified sports games: Baseball with six teams for up to two players, and Rockets, which lets two play Tennis or one play Squash.
dos:194f1ca0598f638a.title: Pro-League Baseball

dos:19732aa46032d8d9.description: A simple futuristic scrolling shooter written for the 100KB PC game compo at Inscene 2000: blast through endless alien attacks and take down as many hostiles as you can.
dos:19732aa46032d8d9.title: Out 'M' Up

dos:1977406ed668c49b.description: A Shakespearean adventure that begins with a sight-seeing visit to the playwright's hometown, where people, animals and objects begin to act strangely and the surroundings turn unfamiliar.
dos:1977406ed668c49b.title: Avon

dos:197a3c27644b87cd.description: Find and rescue your friend the red mouse in a maze of 36 tunnel rooms, grabbing cheese for strength and TNT to blast through walls. No two games are the same.
dos:197a3c27644b87cd.title: Mice Maze

dos:198409893884445d.description: A Kellogg's-sponsored platformer made to advertise the cereal, but a good game in its own right.
dos:198409893884445d.title: Tony & Friends in Kellogg's Land

dos:1991178462aa80e0.description: A shareware Boulder Dash-style game. Control a probe that tunnels through the earth collecting all the diamonds, avoiding falling rocks and mining droids that hunt you down.
dos:1991178462aa80e0.title: Terra Probe

dos:1991ca5719985a70.description: A point-and-click adventure in which a five-year-old boy enters a mysterious house in search of the mythical shadow ape. You have three commands: do, take and use.
dos:1991ca5719985a70.title: Shadow Ape

dos:199c3cfda183f30b.description: You are shipwrecked in the Pacific and drift in fog to a deserted island full of treasures that are worthless if you can't return to civilization. A text adventure.
dos:199c3cfda183f30b.title: Castaway

dos:19a67999e61f74fb.description: A treasure hunt set in the Australian outback, mostly in an abandoned gold mine.
dos:19a67999e61f74fb.title: Dinkum

dos:19a83a67a7930363.description: The first part of Scott Adams's only multi-part adventure, among the hardest in the series. Completing it gives a password for part two.
dos:19a83a67a7930363.title: Savage Island Part 1

dos:19b27f5e042a481a.description: A freeware clone of Taito's Space Invaders: control a cannon at the bottom of the screen and destroy waves of advancing aliens, with three lives.
dos:19b27f5e042a481a.title: Space Invaders

dos:19b92b20ea4a5706.description: A standalone version of the Micro Bucks slot machine from The Las Vegas EGA Casino. Insert up to five credits to play up to five lines.
dos:19b92b20ea4a5706.title: Micro Bucks II

dos:19d7aaa7729848ca.description: Fourth in the Police Quest series, with a new setting and new protagonist, LAPD homicide detective John Carey, who finds his best friend and ex-partner Bob Hickman murdered.
dos:19d7aaa7729848ca.title: Police Quest 4: Open Season

dos:19e51ee9f7d902ac.description: Includes all four games of the Dragon's Domain series, which was inspired by the old Atari game Adventure.
dos:19e51ee9f7d902ac.title: Dragon's Domain: Anniversary Edition

dos:19ee3dc762e50a61.description: A keyboard-controlled adventure and exploration game. As captain of a space ship, rescue a Drosi ship trapped in a decaying orbit, in a story with more to it.
dos:19ee3dc762e50a61.title: Stellar Explorer: The Drosi Encounter

dos:19ef2c14cd9186f5.description: A 3D falling-block puzzle that supports up to four players.
dos:19ef2c14cd9186f5.title: Block Out

dos:19f03d6ceebe14f0.description: Evil overlord Bytor and his wizards have stolen the Ankh. As Wally the space flier, survive harsh planets and recover it before they unleash its power.
dos:19f03d6ceebe14f0.title: Orion Odyssey: The Search for the Magic Ankh

dos:1a009ec33ef253ec.description: An arcade game in which you help Barbie become a fashion model. Each level scrolls left to right, and you avoid moving obstacles by moving up and down and controlling speed.
dos:1a009ec33ef253ec.title: Barbie Super Model

dos:1a00b3f933b3600d.description: A shareware tile-matching memory game with 16, 24, 36 or 64 tiles. Select a tile to rotate and reveal a picture, then find its match. Registering adds more animations and tiles.
dos:1a00b3f933b3600d.title: The Animated SVGA Memory Game

dos:1a14d8a53c486eb0.description: A versus fighting game set in China's Three Kingdoms era. Choose from five characters for one-on-one fights or a story mode loosely based on real history.
dos:1a14d8a53c486eb0.title: Sango Fighter

dos:1a1716028c7e9ec8.description: A text adventure on Lovecraft themes in the 1920s with an unusual character generation routine, in which you guide a character's career through WWI and professions to earn skill points.
dos:1a1716028c7e9ec8.title: The Hound of Shadow

dos:1a2685eb943675b4.description: A Krisalis football manager and action game with the Professional Footballers Association license, an upgrade of Manchester United: The Double that uses the Tacti-Grid tactics system.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:1a2685eb943675b4.title: Player of the Year

dos:1a27d19925e9cd7f.description: A program that lets you design and distribute your own adventure games, an adventure engine for describing locations, rooms, objects, words and events, with sound and music.
dos:1a27d19925e9cd7f.title: Gamescape

dos:1a2bc5495ec1a0ba.description: Madman Bruno Vasto has stolen the experimental SF-2 stealth fighter and threatens to blow up Washington D.C. As secret agent David Wolf, infiltrate his organization and retrieve it, in a game that merges cinematic cutscenes with action.
dos:1a2bc5495ec1a0ba.title: David Wolf: Secret Agent

dos:1a2bee17fb31bef6.description: A Tetris-like game written in Pascal by an employee of a research institute in Tula in 1991, differing from Tetris in how the screen is cleared.
dos:1a2bee17fb31bef6.title: TETCOLOR

dos:1a31e0ea158b7d3b.description: A platformer in which Leo the Lion searches the islands of the Archipelago Lion for a stolen crown, through jungle, swamps, a magic castle dungeon and a pyramid, solving many puzzles.
dos:1a31e0ea158b7d3b.title: Leo the Lion

dos:1a33cc2f94ec4577.description: A shareware Space Invaders clone: move your gun along the bottom of the screen blasting a formation of aliens that drop bombs as they descend, with four shield structures between.
dos:1a33cc2f94ec4577.title: Space Intruders

dos:1a39347b564fc2d0.description: Pilot one of many futuristic racers across courses around the world, picking up weapons during races to keep opponents in check and upgrading your racer after each track.
dos:1a39347b564fc2d0.title: Slipstream 5000

dos:1a3ce3930c04a577.description: Sequel to The Basket Manager. Coach a professional basketball team with a $34,000,000 budget, managing its economics and playing the games in Tournament or Single Match mode.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Basketball
dos:1a3ce3930c04a577.title: Basket Playoff

dos:1a3f3933cbf6b49c.description: A German dragon-themed vertical shoot-'em-up with decent graphics and the common gameplay elements of the genre.
dos:1a3f3933cbf6b49c.title: The Dragon's Power

dos:1a41b25487432d69.description: A freeware Christmas edition of Jetpack with new levels from the original developers. Play Santa Claus, exploring levels full of treasures and peril to collect all the gifts.
dos:1a41b25487432d69.title: Jetpack Christmas Special!

dos:1a46e433a087e5d3.description: Sequel to Last Half of Darkness. You wake alone in a strange room near a dungeon, the girl you saved is missing, and she is about to be sacrificed to an ancient volcanic force.
dos:1a46e433a087e5d3.title: Last Half of Darkness II

dos:1a4d82194a4db0c1.description: A sports game in which you play a cat running a series of obstacle courses, each harder than the last, from the city park to the underground sewer and a bowling pub.
dos:1a4d82194a4db0c1.title: Bad Cat

dos:1a4ea2bedd843d0c.description: Team 17's one-on-one fighting game in the vein of Street Fighter II. In one-player mode choose from four characters, including brothers Dan and Nik and the Buddhist monk Lo-Ray.
dos:1a4ea2bedd843d0c.title: Body Blows

dos:1a6919e77ffc59dd.description: One of the earliest party-based RPGs: an open-ended hack-and-slash through a multilevel dungeon with a party of 1 to 6 characters from classes such as Fighters, Priests and Thieves.
dos:1a6919e77ffc59dd.title: Oubliette

dos:1a6db05987eb4160.description: A graphical adventure for the IBM PC, ported from the TRS-80 CoCo II, where it won a contest in 1985. Difficult and addictive, in CGA or better.
dos:1a6db05987eb4160.title: Evil Crypt

dos:1a72843b904988f7.description: A Maxis simulation about the 1994 debate over the US health care system. Choose which proposals to adopt and even what assumptions go into the underlying models.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Education; Strategy
dos:1a72843b904988f7.title: SimHealth

dos:1a860dae2d9f5e95.description: A sci-fi text adventure in which you wake six months before schedule from cryogenic sleep to the computer alarm and must find out why small gelatinous creatures have breached the ship.
dos:1a860dae2d9f5e95.title: Solus

dos:1a920c0fa23904c2.description: The pack-in game for Loriciel's West Phaser light gun, a Western-themed shooter with mechanics like Operation Wolf.
dos:1a920c0fa23904c2.title: West Phaser

dos:1a93c6f597736d2e.description: A turn-based hybrid of Command & Conquer and X-Com. Command modern-day troops in battle after battle against hordes of fantasy creatures such as orcs and skeletons to save the world.
dos:1a93c6f597736d2e.title: Spellcross

dos:1a9d8053f3618ec2.description: An adventure tie-in to the film. The producer finds that the film has been stolen by Bela Lugosi's double, and you must track him down and get it back around the movie lot and town.
dos:1a9d8053f3618ec2.title: Plan 9 From Outer Space

dos:1ab91c9dadc2b233.description: A top-down scrolling shooter in which you drive a heavily armed car along winding roads, destroying a world-threatening criminal organization and the vehicles it sends against you.
dos:1ab91c9dadc2b233.title: Highway Fighter

dos:1abb4d41eecd8d69.description: A free Spanish platformer. A young man appears in a corner of one of five levels and must reach the opposite lower corner while collecting diamonds.

dos:1abd158bebb974aa.description: A computer version of Conway's Game of Life, the cellular automaton simulation in which patterns evolve over generations.
dos:1abd158bebb974aa.title: Conway's Game of Life

dos:1abe372dab9c586d.description: A German advergame published by the Sparkasse bank using characters from the KNAX comics, with arcade play for one or two.
dos:1abe372dab9c586d.title: KNAX

dos:1abea4ccd21c778e.description: As the picnic baskets are laid out, giant ants swarm from the anthills. Exterminate them with a bulldozer to flatten anthills, a bucket of water and more before they become too many.
dos:1abea4ccd21c778e.title: Ant Attack!

dos:1accc19a38488138.description: A circus-themed educational game with four games on counting, number matching and problem solving, each with four difficulty levels. Right answers earn tickets.
dos:1accc19a38488138.title: Math Rabbit Deluxe

dos:1acf5396b89deb79.description: A Zelda-like game in which you play a soldier of God fighting forces of darkness in a modern city to find the armor of God, each guarded by demon bosses. An angel may help if you answer Bible questions.
dos:1acf5396b89deb79.title: Spiritual Warfare

dos:1ad5c24d490d8008.description: An Adventure-style game: as a knight, recover the chalice by finding keys to open gates and getting through mazes and dungeons while avoiding dragons, skeletons and fire elementals.
dos:1ad5c24d490d8008.title: Dragon's Mandate

dos:1ad71b7723bb6d16.description: A Rubik's cube program that both challenges you to solve the puzzle and trains you in how to solve it.
dos:1ad71b7723bb6d16.title: Digital Cube

dos:1aefe8ad28095c12.description: A side-scrolling shoot-'em-up set in 2019 in a post-apocalyptic world where you fight evil machines. Very similar to the jeep stage of Army Moves.
dos:1aefe8ad28095c12.title: Buggy Ranger

dos:1afd6c73fa316a6f.description: A medieval fantasy RPG. As a WarWizard, skilled in combat and magic, recover the Ancient Armor used to defeat the previous Dark WarWizard, who has risen again to rule the land.
dos:1afd6c73fa316a6f.title: WarWizard

dos:1b03a18356b81b6d.description: An educational game for spelling and typing: words float down from a castle and you type them correctly before they reach the bottom and destroy the drawbridge.
dos:1b03a18356b81b6d.title: Spell Castle

dos:1b040debec9a5bdf.description: An educational English game from Scetlander. Two weeks after Henrietta and Henry marry, Henry has a heated discussion with Morgana the Morbid in Castle Spellalot.
dos:1b040debec9a5bdf.title: Henrietta's Book of Spells

dos:1b0d0db32dbe487d.description: An advergame for the German newspaper Die Welt. As a paperboy on a bicycle, throw newspapers into the postboxes of subscribers along a residential street.
dos:1b0d0db32dbe487d.title: Die Welt

dos:1b1d6545cf9516c6.description: Sequel to Pinball Dreams with four new tables: Partyland, Speed Devils, Billion Dollar Gameshow and Stones 'n' Bones. Realistic physics, multiplayer and a high score table.
dos:1b1d6545cf9516c6.title: Pinball Fantasies

dos:1b1ef306f7f84c3a.description: An unofficial Star Trek text adventure in which new ensign Marty Stu tries to earn a permanent posting aboard the Enterprise, with exploration, conversations and object puzzles.
dos:1b1ef306f7f84c3a.title: Xtrek

dos:1b35fd0ebe116d53.description: A side-scrolling ninja action game. The protagonist, trained twenty years by the best Tokugawa warriors, is now a Budo master and sets out to find and destroy his foes.
dos:1b35fd0ebe116d53.title: Budō: The Art of Ninja Combat!

dos:1b36ef5d6aaed035.description: Guide your man through falling mines to collect hearts, using wipers to counteract mines and dynamite to blast through. You need only 3 of 4 hearts, and use the keys around '5' to move.
dos:1b36ef5d6aaed035.title: Fall-Zone

dos:1b3735ebbb7372bb.description: A vertically scrolling ASCII skiing game: ski down the track without hitting trees, scoring 10 points for each tree passed and 100 for bonus items, with trees getting denser.
dos:1b3735ebbb7372bb.title: Skiing (1984)

dos:1b43437519bf90c6.description: Sequel to Wolf, set in the same simulation environment, but you are a lion chosen from 20 animals with varying attributes in existing prides or ones you assemble.
dos:1b43437519bf90c6.title: Lion

dos:1b46127ae1d9660e.description: A Quake total conversion with 19 new levels full of new enemies and new weapons such as uzis, a foe-to-friend converter and an inflator gun.
dos:1b46127ae1d9660e.title: Shrak for Quake

dos:1b479663e0245cb8.description: Based on L. Frank Baum's novel: as Dorothy Gale, carried by a cyclone to Oz with Toto, a Scarecrow, a Tin Woodman and a Lion, find your way to the Emerald City.
dos:1b479663e0245cb8.title: The Wizard of Oz

dos:1b5ca549a57ca594.description: A Gauntlet-like game from 1989 with EGA graphics and a level editor for making your own levels.
dos:1b5ca549a57ca594.title: The Black Orb

dos:1b60204588660923.description: A real-time strategy game in the vein of Warcraft or Command & Conquer: colonize newly discovered planets, control their resources and defend your colony.
dos:1b60204588660923.title: M.A.X.: Mechanized Assault & Exploration

dos:1b66483e436ae5d6.description: An early tactical combat game of humans and aliens fighting with laser guns, melee weapons and special powers. Alien races include Viking warriors, Denebian slime devils and space mutants.
dos:1b66483e436ae5d6.title: Galactic Gladiators

dos:1b714f5b49bbf809.description: A strategic-level WWII game in which you lead the Allied or Axis High Command in Europe, making political, economic and military decisions to achieve your war aims.
dos:1b714f5b49bbf809.title: High Command: Europe 1939-'45

dos:1b74d69bf4b0ee62.description: A basic turn-based strategy game: two armies face off on a battlefield and try to destroy the enemy headquarters, planning moves on an overhead map with statistics for each vehicle.
dos:1b74d69bf4b0ee62.title: Operation Com●Bat

dos:1b81acebcbfb5cf6.description: A blessed island enjoys eternal springtime thanks to the Shard of Spring, until an evil sorceress steals it. The world has fallen to hunger and despair, and you must get it back.
dos:1b81acebcbfb5cf6.title: Shard of Spring

dos:1b868cae6b748e1d.description: One of the first business sims. One to eight players compete for profit, setting production levels and prices in a simulation of basic finance and economics.
dos:1b868cae6b748e1d.title: Cartels & Cutthroat$

dos:1b90ee9791bfd488.description: A side-scrolling shoot-'em-up in which you fly a P-47 Thunderbolt against hordes of Nazis. The 16-bit versions have a simultaneous two-player mode and loop with increasing difficulty.
dos:1b90ee9791bfd488.title: P47 Thunderbolt

dos:1b90fb6e9ec1f74f.description: Stranded on an alien planet after your spaceship explodes, find pieces of it to rebuild it, jumping across platforms and shooting droids and aliens in a side-scroller.
dos:1b90fb6e9ec1f74f.title: Trantor the Last Stormtrooper

dos:1b9508a9830aef78.description: A murder mystery with scrolling graphics and animation that is different every time, depending on the detective you pick, how you question people, look for clues and make accusations.
dos:1b9508a9830aef78.title: Murder On The Zinderneuf

dos:1b95e2c0ac0694de.description: A first-person action adventure aboard DS9. As an alien envoy, you become involved in a murder plot that leads to war with an evil alien race.
dos:1b95e2c0ac0694de.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine - Harbinger

dos:1bd4f5033cfeb8de.description: A Level 9 text adventure from 1988, sequel to Gnome Ranger, with a novella included explaining the background to the story.
dos:1bd4f5033cfeb8de.title: Gnome Ranger II: Ingrid's Back

dos:1bd86741f982a19f.description: Guide a floppy disk from the bottom of the screen to the top by crossing a series of floors, climbing to the next floor when you reach the end of one.
dos:1bd86741f982a19f.title: Disk Crash

dos:1bd89f1c30b163b0.description: A shareware Breakout variant: move a paddle along the bottom of the screen to keep a ball, or several balls, from touching the bottom, hitting bricks at the top.
dos:1bd89f1c30b163b0.title: G-stones III

dos:1bdce2a21d530291.description: A soccer game with practically every international team of 1994 and modes including exhibitions for one or two players and the World Cup, seen from behind and above the player.
dos:1bdce2a21d530291.title: Planet Soccer

dos:1be0d41781fe51b7.description: A Donkey Kong-based game in two parts. In the first, climb five buildings, defeating one of Kong's minions on each while avoiding barrels and fireballs and activating levers.
dos:1be0d41781fe51b7.title: Kong's Revenge

dos:1be80678cdc7cee9.description: A trilogy of text adventures made with the Computer Novel Construction Set. As the punk Allen, a local ruffian, get drunk, save the world from a chicken and escape from prison.
dos:1be80678cdc7cee9.title: The Punk Allen Trilogy

dos:1becab19a1ed5a13.description: A football simulation featuring Tom Landry's likeness and advice. As a new coach of the team of your choice, you are mentored by Landry, and can customize your team and manage acquisitions.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Football
dos:1becab19a1ed5a13.title: Tom Landry Strategy Football

dos:1bf2e7b8b0d163ef.description: A classic Snake written in Borland Turbo Pascal 6.0 for DOS in 320x200 with 256 colors: eat food, grow your tail, and avoid walls and yourself.
dos:1bf2e7b8b0d163ef.title: Snake

dos:1bf631b63c77607a.description: A simple platformer in which a tiny red creature runs and jumps through levels, escaping enemies and obstacles without being able to fight back.
dos:1bf631b63c77607a.title: Zipman III

dos:1bfa643f714062bf.description: A Conan platformer made by Swedish student Eric Isaksson, inspired by Conan: Hall of Volta, created at 18 for the school's Compis computer in 1990 and later converted for the IBM PC.
dos:1bfa643f714062bf.title: Conan

dos:1bfdba7cad62c7d1.description: An educational game for young viewers starring Joe the bunny, who travels with a backpack and wants to learn in a magical town, which he must first enter by solving a puzzle.
dos:1bfdba7cad62c7d1.title: The Travels of Joe Rabbit in the Big City

dos:1c0193854db53b2d.description: A vertical shooter in which you pilot a slow, large aircraft that must fight its way back to its home base.
dos:1c0193854db53b2d.title: Bomber

dos:1c1cd4ec441cc9ce.description: The first Tennis Elbow: a World Tour of 90 events against 250 players, with singles, doubles and even two-against-one matches on grass, clay, flexi and cement courts, and slow-motion replays.
dos:1c1cd4ec441cc9ce.title: Tennis Elbow

dos:1c277584209e5f1f.description: A re-release of USS John Young with new missions and somewhat improved graphics.
dos:1c277584209e5f1f.title: USS John Young 2

dos:1c3a4860bfc2c27d.description: A shoot-'em-up in which, as Peter Jones, the Cosmic Sheriff, you take out rebels on Jupiter's moon Io and shut down the pumps that guard the galaxy's last cobalt deposit.
dos:1c3a4860bfc2c27d.title: Cosmic Sheriff

dos:1c3b0c8903a4d27c.description: A shareware coloring game for young children: build pictures from pre-drawn templates and figures, with each animal's name displayed and spoken, in four sizes.
dos:1c3b0c8903a4d27c.title: Bert's Whales and Dolphins

dos:1c3cb0a68d07749b.description: A Taiwanese arcade game with simple but entertaining gameplay and no text beyond the English menu, aimed at a young audience.
dos:1c3cb0a68d07749b.title: Bumping Warrior

dos:1c42313c9e0a34ee.description: A realistic karate fighting game. Choose a fighter by strength, stamina and resistance, pick from 55 moves and train at a gym between fights.
dos:1c42313c9e0a34ee.title: Best of the Best Championship Karate

dos:1c6f62961b86905e.description: An isometric action game like Head Over Heels. In 1927, treasure hunter Howard Kelp dons a diving suit to search for the gold on the wreck of the Esmerelda, sunk in 1829.
dos:1c6f62961b86905e.title: Treasure Trap

dos:1c7157e849f34f78.description: An educational shape-matching game: Ernie the Magician makes two shapes appear and you decide if they match. If they do, Ernie nods and the shapes float together; if not, he shakes his head.
dos:1c7157e849f34f78.title: Ernie's Magic Shapes

dos:1c72751f18729203.description: A children's game of making faces by combining parts: many noses, mouths, ears and eyes and some haircuts. Version 2 doubles the pieces and adds coloring.
dos:1c72751f18729203.title: Funny Face

dos:1c72c818bf8cf4fc.description: A trading simulation. As a 19th-century merchant, buy a ship, find a crew, load goods and sail between ports around the world to earn money for more ships.

dos:1c75a9e6f9171ba4.description: A puzzle game like Deflektor with indirect control of a light beam. In each of 50 levels, rotate mirrors to guide the beam from start to end, destroying enemies along the way.
dos:1c75a9e6f9171ba4.title: Mindbender

dos:1c764b7faf010b05.description: A text adventure: after a hard P.E. session and a shower, your clothes are missing from the locker room. Find them and get dressed without letting Mr. Mean catch you.
dos:1c764b7faf010b05.title: Gymnasium Adventure

dos:1c7ac47938f8c8e8.description: A top-down puzzle game. As a guardian, contain the Triffids, balls of pure energy, by building walls with blocks of five colors on the upper plane.
dos:1c7ac47938f8c8e8.title: Guardians

dos:1c82b971d1f59e94.description: A dating simulation: build the personality and traits of a romantic partner, then go through dating scenarios with multiple-choice questions that affect how well the date goes.
dos:1c82b971d1f59e94.title: Girlfriend Construction Set

dos:1c89907c93069b32.description: A classic puzzle game in which the Fool wanders the land solving puzzles to break enchantments and undo evil. Includes word searches, cryptograms, jigsaws, anagrams and a Tarot-based card game.
dos:1c89907c93069b32.title: The Fool's Errand

dos:1c9b356663a96820.description: Sequel to Super Ski II with six events in the French Alps: Super Giant, Downhill, Slalom, Snowboard Giant Slalom, Snowboard Slalom and Ski Jump. Practice, Medal Competition and Time/Points Competition modes.
dos:1c9b356663a96820.title: SuperSki III

dos:1c9e157c5730b49a.description: You play an assassin who has lost his memory and must get it back. Third-person play with a fixed camera that follows you around the map.
dos:1c9e157c5730b49a.title: Perfect Assassin

dos:1ca829d9a078d208.description: A hockey management simulator: create your own team as manager, handle salaries, and hire or fire coaches.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Hockey
dos:1ca829d9a078d208.title: Hockey League Simulator II

dos:1cb86fc7e8d28686.description: A gallery shooter spin-off of Mystic Midway: Rest in Pieces. Each level is a period of your life shown as a rollercoaster ride on which objects from that period, such as baby toys and braces, assault you.
dos:1cb86fc7e8d28686.title: Mystic Midway: Phantom Express

dos:1cc629a0bacc0483.description: An off-road racing game with no AI opponents, only obstacles, in a race against the clock. Compete against your own high scores.
dos:1cc629a0bacc0483.title: 4x4 Team

dos:1cc653d386e38e4d.description: An early realistic Harrier flight simulation by Rod Hyde with 3 skill levels and two practice modes, one for flight basics and one for combat.
dos:1cc653d386e38e4d.title: Strike Force Harrier
