dos:1cd14b69d980feae.description: A soccer penalty simulator with large sprites and CGA graphics, for one player against the computer or for two players.
dos:1cd14b69d980feae.title: Mundial de Italia

dos:1cd8a7ef996ec50f.description: A home computer conversion of the mainframe adventure, a fantasy treasure hunt in a claustrophobic dungeon like Zork, with over 400 rooms and 200 objects.
dos:1cd8a7ef996ec50f.title: Acheton

dos:1cdadf8b22594170.description: Ten arcade mini-games based on Don Bluth's film. Charlie the dog, a good guy but a scoundrel, is killed by an evil crime lord and goes to heaven, but yearns to return to Earth to set things right.
dos:1cdadf8b22594170.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven

dos:1ce0830c9ce86ddb.description: Based on the American TV game show. Choose all 11 correct answers out of 16 on the board without picking one of the five wipeouts, with a Hot Spot prize hidden behind one.
dos:1ce0830c9ce86ddb.title: Wipeout (1989)

dos:1ce183cd1e4f1362.description: As a mystical shaman, go through an Egyptian pyramid to get the magical Eye of Horus, turning into a bird with the up arrow to search the levels, avoiding traps.
dos:1ce183cd1e4f1362.title: Eye of Horus (1989)

dos:1cf1ab1323598ba2.description: A naval surface combat tactical simulation covering 1922-1945, with detailed smoke, starshells, searchlights, radar, shore batteries, weather and more, and ship classes from PT boats to battleships.
dos:1cf1ab1323598ba2.title: Action Stations!

dos:1cf71c2a33dbbcec.description: A puzzle game with 101 levels in which you guide Brainies of four colors onto a spot matching their color. Move a cross-hair and press fire over a Brainy to control it. Running out of time costs a life.
dos:1cf71c2a33dbbcec.title: The Brainies

dos:1d077be293282a02.description: A Star Trek strategy clone, perhaps the oldest. Command the Enterprise to destroy all the Klingons in a galaxy of 64 quadrants, with invisible Romulans too.
dos:1d077be293282a02.title: NewTrek

dos:1d11a7630799caf8.description: A DOS version of Laser Chess, which plays like chess except some pieces are deflectors and a laser cannon. Place your deflectors strategically to aim your laser.
dos:1d11a7630799caf8.title: Laser Chess (1994)

dos:1d16d3934a6c01da.description: In 14th century France, as the Dauphin Charles, recapture Rheims from the English with Joan's help, in a hybrid of arcade combat and strategy.
dos:1d16d3934a6c01da.title: Joan of Arc: Siege & the Sword

dos:1d18545b6a2ae550.description: A vertical shooter with a smooth engine, two ship types with different weapons, homing and regular missile upgrades, bombs and shields. Two players cooperatively.
dos:1d18545b6a2ae550.title: Baryon

dos:1d18672431c92eb2.description: A puzzle in which you move blocks with a cross-hair so that blocks of the same design touch and clear, until all are cleared.
dos:1d18672431c92eb2.title: Puzznic

dos:1d1e7e89bb9f3a45.description: At a carnival you stop at Troggle Shoot, where owner Dr. Quandary invites you to shoot at targets to win one of three dolls.
dos:1d1e7e89bb9f3a45.title: The Secret Island of Dr. Quandary

dos:1d29af46be382753.description: A large Colossal Cave-style adventure in which you set out to free the land of Hezarin from the evil tyrant Anjith.
dos:1d29af46be382753.title: Hezarin

dos:1d33cdce1214e5f9.description: Dizzy must rescue four of his Yolkfolk friends from Cuckoo Land, Ice Land, Cloud Land and Zak's Castle in a single-screen action game resembling Pengo.
dos:1d33cdce1214e5f9.title: Kwik Snax

dos:1d36753687adfdbd.description: Third in Donald Daley's Socrates series of chess programs, more a training program for good and experienced players.
dos:1d36753687adfdbd.title: Socrates 3.0

dos:1d3c7abadf32c53d.description: Destroy your enemy's ultimate weapon by flying a high-tech hovercraft through perilous tunnels full of enemy vehicles, choppers and sentry guns.
dos:1d3c7abadf32c53d.title: Tunnel B1

dos:1d3ef5d6af58ebe9.description: A flight simulator based on the film. As Maverick, fly an F-14 Tomcat with your RIO Merlin through missions from the Top Gun school in San Diego to conflict zones in Cuba, Korea and Libya.
dos:1d3ef5d6af58ebe9.title: Top Gun: Fire at Will!

dos:1d41b6de93472de8.description: A shareware remake of Namco's 1980 Galaga with a Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode.
dos:1d41b6de93472de8.title: CHAMP Galagon

dos:1d5fa9adb35eaf5c.description: Chris Crawford's macroeconomics simulation after Balance of Power: balance a country's military and social spending to survive among competing fictitious nations.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Education; Strategy
dos:1d5fa9adb35eaf5c.title: The Global Dilemma: Guns or Butter

dos:1d6ffd83b8152956.description: An Arkanoid-inspired brick-breaker: deflect an always-moving ball with a paddle, catch power-ups from some bricks, and lose when you run out of balls.
dos:1d6ffd83b8152956.title: BOLTX

dos:1d71250492534b6a.description: As a cadet fresh out of Starfleet Academy, command your first U.G.A.S. starship in a Federation war with the Krellans and Zaldrons.
dos:1d71250492534b6a.title: Star Fleet I: The War Begins!

dos:1d7383420a40b20a.description: Command giant HERCs in head-to-head combat over network or modem, or against the computer. Its two-player mode was ahead of its time.
dos:1d7383420a40b20a.title: Metaltech: Battledrome

dos:1d7cbb298d17f135.description: Sequel to Pinball Dreams with four new tables: Neptune (undersea), Safari, Revenge of the Robot Warriors (sci-fi) and Stall Turn (aviation).
dos:1d7cbb298d17f135.title: Pinball Dreams II

dos:1d7ff5cc575bdb3c.description: A scenery add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator covering England, Scotland and Wales, with many small airfields.
dos:1d7ff5cc575bdb3c.title: Perfect Flight Deluxe: Great Britain

dos:1d83ad4a5b2d9226.description: A shareware educational game of word problems for grades 2 to 7, for one or two players. The land of Greecia has lived in darkness under the god Apathy, and Zeus plans his downfall by teaching.
dos:1d83ad4a5b2d9226.title: Math Assault I Word Problems

dos:1d88a8aeae78cf02.description: A text adventure on a mostly predetermined course in which each object you pick up kills exactly one creature, and the goal is to kill them all.
dos:1d88a8aeae78cf02.title: Electrabot

dos:1d91db79d7e8902d.description: Sam & Max, Freelance Police, a canine shamus and a hyperkinetic rabbity thing, hit the road across quirky America on the trail of a runaway carnival bigfoot in a deranged animated adventure.
dos:1d91db79d7e8902d.title: Sam & Max Hit the Road

dos:1d92e5b2e90656b4.description: A turn-based militaristic strategy game with board game-like play: move forces from region to region and fight enemy units, with the goal of occupying all regions. Two scenarios.
dos:1d92e5b2e90656b4.title: Call to Arms

dos:1d9a3e758ee10d03.description: A side-scrolling arcade game in which you fly an attack aircraft with eight lives against enemy aircraft and naval forces from a neighboring country coming in from the right.
dos:1d9a3e758ee10d03.title: Navjet

dos:1d9c96b1701c3c73.description: Infocom's sci-fi text adventure. In the year 2186 you are destined to rendezvous with a gargantuan starship from the edge of the galaxy and must gain entry to its mysteries.
dos:1d9c96b1701c3c73.title: Starcross

dos:1daba8e241e5362d.description: A top-down cartoon racer for 1 to 4 players, similar to Micro Machines 2, with practice, Knockout Races, tournaments, Beat the Clock and Team Knockout. Choose from 12 characters.
dos:1daba8e241e5362d.title: Motor Mash

dos:1db11e1253f422d5.description: A freeware side-scrolling shooter inspired by the arcade P-47 Thunderbolt: fly the P-47 against waves of planes and ground installations.
dos:1db11e1253f422d5.title: P-47 Freedom Fighter

dos:1db38e1ccfb24952.description: Based on the film, the game starts just after the T-Rex pushes the visitors' van into its pit. As Dr. Alan Grant, find Tim and Lex, take them to the Visitor's Center and get everyone off the island.
dos:1db38e1ccfb24952.title: Jurassic Park

dos:1dbdf256f2b1b8cc.description: A simulation of modern naval combat in real time, tracking surface ships, subs, missiles and aircraft, with an adjustable clock ratio and pause.
dos:1dbdf256f2b1b8cc.title: Harpoon II: Admiral's Edition

dos:1dbe41cb96a2a734.description: A LucasArts-style adventure on the island of Santa Lanchia, where a fisherman's boat is destroyed by lightning and he and the wreckage drift ashore.
dos:1dbe41cb96a2a734.title: Monsoon

dos:1dc3415a28f817e3.description: A space simulation in which you are a Galactic Command officer commanding and controlling every aspect of a giant Battlecruiser.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Strategy; Vehicle Simulation
dos:1dc3415a28f817e3.title: Battlecruiser 3000AD

dos:1dc90d9401819c7d.description: An Infocom mystery in which, as a young American detective, you answer a letter from old friend Tamara Lynd and travel to Tresyllian Castle in England.
dos:1dc90d9401819c7d.title: Moonmist

dos:1dd7a16f1a20c19b.description: A Risk clone using the same rules: place armies on the map and conquer the majority of the lands, attacking adjacent territories in turns.
dos:1dd7a16f1a20c19b.title: Conquest

dos:1de556b1820026f4.description: A first-person role-playing game like Dungeon Hack or Eye of the Beholder, with simple, intuitive gameplay and no long story. Attack monsters by timing presses of the Spacebar.
dos:1de556b1820026f4.title: Dungeon of Death (1994)

dos:1e0641be3c9dbb0f.description: Tecmo's World Cup '90 reworked for the 1992 European Championships, with the tournament structure of two groups of four and the semi-finals and final. Pick any European nation.
dos:1e0641be3c9dbb0f.title: European Championship 1992

dos:1e0c795c9efa0f48.description: A light simulator of big robots in the distant future, on Earth at the end of the 21st century, where you join the resistance against the global corporations enslaving the world.
dos:1e0c795c9efa0f48.title: Iron Assault

dos:1e1d536a2681a135.description: Krisalis's third licensed game for Manchester United, after the club's first league title since 1967, mixing management with football action.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:1e1d536a2681a135.title: Manchester United Premier League Champions

dos:1e26afebc2183396.description: A shareware real-time strategy game similar to Command & Conquer, with base building, resource gathering and combat with ground, naval and air units, in which all vehicles consume fuel.
dos:1e26afebc2183396.title: ARSENAL Taste the Power

dos:1e2ef27d00190b05.description: An advertising platformer interspersed with mini-games, promoting the products of Nashua, which made printer cartridges and floppy disks. Real prizes were offered for record results.
dos:1e2ef27d00190b05.title: NashuaMan

dos:1e477adc52b8ef16.description: A shareware collection of 7 little mouse-controlled shooting games that test your quick reactions, with points and a high score list.
dos:1e477adc52b8ef16.title: Shooting Gallery (1990)

dos:1e489b2ab7545ccc.description: In his second adventure James Pond must retrieve the toys Dr Maybe has stolen, using a stretch device to reach high areas or slide across ceilings, across worlds themed on toy types.
dos:1e489b2ab7545ccc.title: James Pond 2: Codename: RoboCod

dos:1e5d2be022e9e51b.description: A text-menu BBS game in which players compete to raise enough money to buy a restaurant, expanding a nightlife business into new districts while rival players interfere.
dos:1e5d2be022e9e51b.title: P♥mpWars

dos:1e5e142032302548.description: An educational game for all ages in which you become animals in four groups: Forest Animals, Ocean Animals, Jungle Animals and Young Lion, on a grid with randomly placed obstacles.
dos:1e5e142032302548.title: Animal Quest

dos:1e7909fd1d21cad4.description: Fly a scout ship to rescue survivors from a space station caught in a meteor shower. The ship moves forward continuously and loops from top to bottom of the screen.
dos:1e7909fd1d21cad4.title: Meteors

dos:1e85507afc03cfaf.description: Version 4 of Flight Simulator, released 15 months after version 3, adding an airplane designer, a sailplane, random weather and dynamic scenery like air traffic.
dos:1e85507afc03cfaf.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (v4.0)

dos:1e87c3982e9b20e1.description: A set of four simple games: Frog, a Frogger clone; Pac-Em, a text-mode Pac-Man clone; Red Alert, a text-mode naval shooter; and Tank!, a two-player text-mode tank battle.
dos:1e87c3982e9b20e1.title: Arcade Bonanza

dos:1e9d76c22cadbbeb.description: A text adventure from the Classic Adventure Series. Search for Queen Anne's crown, lost in the eighteenth century and last seen in the Arabian desert, on a screen split into several boxes.
dos:1e9d76c22cadbbeb.title: The Lost Crown of Queen Anne

dos:1ea41b6167289641.description: A Korean cartoony platformer starring Shakii the wolf, ruler of the kingdom of Shake, which was plunged into chaos by the almost invincible Lion Warrior Midnight Sword.
dos:1ea41b6167289641.title: Shakii the Wolf

dos:1eab1bfdc0633ee4.description: A Tetris clone in which you play eight games at once and blocks float upward, with some new shapes. When a playing field fills, keep going with the others.
dos:1eab1bfdc0633ee4.title: Floatris

dos:1eaccbd567c56a95.description: A suite of tools to compile simple Choose-Your-Own-Adventure style games, including Gnomic, a demonstration game distributed only with it.
dos:1eaccbd567c56a95.title: Adventure Book

dos:1ebfa544921777eb.description: A tile-based RPG in the vein of the early Ultima games. On the planet Lysandia, eliminate the chaotic presence threatening it, with character creation, weapons, spells and skills such as swimming.
dos:1ebfa544921777eb.title: Excelsior Phase One: Lysandia

dos:1ec24bfb0d1276f4.description: A freeware keyboard-controlled Pac-Man variant: negotiate a maze chased by ghosts, eating fruit and pills, with power pills making ghosts vulnerable.
dos:1ec24bfb0d1276f4.title: Pac PC

dos:1ec3093304bc299d.description: A very early implementation of Eliza, the program that mimics a human's responses to what you type.
dos:1ec3093304bc299d.title: Eliza (1981)

dos:1ecda9c9504b7174.description: You play Heimdall, a demigod of Norse mythology charged with guarding the entrance to Asgard from all evil, including Ragnarok, which is on its way.
dos:1ecda9c9504b7174.title: Heimdall

dos:1ed4c981203cd627.description: A basketball game with real NBA teams and an offensive, action-oriented style. Play an exhibition or try to win the NBA title in playoff mode, substituting tired players.
dos:1ed4c981203cd627.title: Lakers versus Celtics and the NBA Playoffs

dos:1ed722f66bad7881.description: A side-scrolling platformer in which you control a super monkey, collecting weapons and power-ups such as spitting green balls and bags of money, avoiding hostile animals and monsters.
dos:1ed722f66bad7881.title: Super Kof

dos:1efeca409491899f.description: A BASIC story game by three high school students, a hypertext-like tree story with many choices leading to immediate death and characters borrowed from Spaceballs.
dos:1efeca409491899f.title: Quest of Yog

dos:1f09b9e0a0ae6066.description: After Dal'X, Bomb'X and Castle'X, a classic 2D platformer with the usual enemies, secret zones and end-level bosses. You are Nestor Burnos, whose fiancee Maëva has disappeared.
dos:1f09b9e0a0ae6066.title: Arcad'X

dos:1f1c1d26b90e37f9.description: A single-player RPG set in the world of Magic Candle using a modified engine, aimed at novices: clear the monsters from the cellars, dungeons and dark corners of Maramon.
dos:1f1c1d26b90e37f9.title: The Keys to Maramon

dos:1f1eb3a14bf086a3.description: A turn-based tactical squad combat game that introduced team-oriented missions, RPG-style squad leader development and a scenario builder, with ten missions in the retail version.
dos:1f1eb3a14bf086a3.title: Breach

dos:1f20557abf1c0428.description: A puzzle adventure about Bureau 13, an ultra-secret organization investigating the paranormal, which sends two agents after a member who has drawn unwanted attention. Many characters to choose from.
dos:1f20557abf1c0428.title: Bureau 13

dos:1f325ff0ace33795.description: Barbie has a big day tomorrow and dreams about her planned activities. Traverse five levels of thirteen stages through the mall, the beach and the soda shop to make it through the night.
dos:1f325ff0ace33795.title: Barbie

dos:1f366c34161291f4.description: A 16-color shareware clone of the classic mainframe Star Trek game. Each sector of the universe is an 8x8 grid containing planets, starbases and enemies.
dos:1f366c34161291f4.title: EGA Trek

dos:1f3892c1ec48a766.description: An early computer translation of a classic board and paper hockey simulation.
dos:1f3892c1ec48a766.title: APBA Pro Hockey

dos:1f511ec6c4951664.description: A Pac-Man variant: control Wilf, dumped by circumstances into a maze inhabited by sinister creatures, and complete it while avoiding the monsters.
dos:1f511ec6c4951664.title: Wibbling Wilf

dos:1f55eaddb65ab058.description: A 3D snooker simulation, the snooker version of Virtual Pool and the most realistic available at the time.
dos:1f55eaddb65ab058.title: Virtual Snooker

dos:1f5fa9ff1c737358.description: An educational adventure: as a treasure hunter exploring a castle, find the exit while earning points by picking locks and finding treasures, solving math riddles with the four basic operations.
dos:1f5fa9ff1c737358.title: Adventures in Math

dos:1f62c7f635e44709.description: An adaptation of Lewis Carroll's story: Alice escapes her math homework into a wonderland of bizarre characters including the Cheshire Cat and the Jabberwock.
dos:1f62c7f635e44709.title: The Adventures of Alice who Went Through the Looking-Glass and Came Back Though Not Much Changed

dos:1f6d1c4525d2db15.description: After a failed scheme, Plucky Duck and Buster Bunny have one pouch of magic beans left, which grows a huge beanstalk. Control Plucky through eight areas in a platform adventure.
dos:1f6d1c4525d2db15.title: Tiny Toon Adventures: The Great Beanstalk

dos:1f77c9e894270a0b.description: A timed puzzle game: fill out levels with bricks to build as tall a tower as possible, with limited time per level and each level becoming the base for the next.
dos:1f77c9e894270a0b.title: Towers

dos:1f7bab04b67ed35b.description: A shareware miniature golf game controlled with keyboard and mouse. A shot is made by choosing the tee position, setting the direction, then the power.
dos:1f7bab04b67ed35b.title: Power Putt

dos:1f7e42f0777c7a02.description: A soccer game released for the 1994 World Cup with an overhead view like Sensible Soccer. Club and national teams, with players that vary in speed and skills such as heading and overhead kicks.
dos:1f7e42f0777c7a02.title: International Soccer

dos:1fb5bdadd0d46951.description: A golf game with two 18-hole courses and Leader Board-style hitting mechanics. Account for wind and pick from 14 clubs, in a 3D third-person view with an overhead map.
dos:1fb5bdadd0d46951.title: California Pro Golf

dos:1fba440cfe37ca80.description: In 1984 two undercover cops lose a criminal who flees the bar by motorcycle, and the chase begins. A police adventure.
dos:1fba440cfe37ca80.title: Blue Force

dos:1fcb65a88a311c14.description: Create a party of adventurers from several races and explore the world, earning fame, glory and gold by completing quests, with turn-based combat and a well-designed inventory.
dos:1fcb65a88a311c14.title: Knights of Legend

dos:1fd8a32214c8acf3.description: A wacky mix of track and field and retro arcade games played as an alien. Choose from 8 alien characters with different strengths, such as the many-legged caterpillar-like Mr. Mune.
dos:1fd8a32214c8acf3.title: Alien Olympics

dos:1fd9ea7eb90ed1ea.description: A one or two-player platform game with fruit, worms, penguins and fireball-throwing monsters, installable in English and Swedish. The Evil One has captured Bublina, and you are armed with a magic rod.
dos:1fd9ea7eb90ed1ea.title: Bubble Pop

dos:1fe61df840279b98.description: Play a dozen well-known courses, including Augusta and Pebble Beach, with a split screen showing an overhead view of the hole and a 3-D view. Includes a driving range to practice.
dos:1fe61df840279b98.title: World Tour Golf

dos:1fe7bb92b4c8977a.description: An early mouse-controlled character simulation from Erosoft: select a scene and use mouse movements to control its animation. Interaction is limited compared with a conventional adventure game.
dos:1fe7bb92b4c8977a.title: SimuS♥x

dos:1fe84a216a5a2fa5.description: A third-person point-and-click adventure. As sports journalist Richard Kendall in summer 1997, you follow an expedition of four explorers into the Atlantic searching for traces of Atlantis.
dos:1fe84a216a5a2fa5.title: Ark of Time

dos:2005974e6242478f.description: Liberate "The Boss" and bring him back safely. Dropped from a chopper with your panther and a .357 Magnum, travel through parts of the city to find him.
dos:2005974e6242478f.title: Wild Streets

dos:200fa00a21e29704.description: A CD-ROM from model maker Revell showcasing six fast European cars. Look under the hood at their parts or watch promotional videos with commentary and statistics, plus a racing game.
dos:200fa00a21e29704.title: European Racers

dos:2015f168251830e1.description: A Gomoku (Five in a Row) variant on an extended go board of 28x18 squares: you, as blue, take turns placing pieces against the computer, as red.
dos:2015f168251830e1.title: Amoba

dos:2019bb45361af888.description: An interactive behind-the-scenes CD-ROM about the Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition. Browse production material explaining changes made for the revised films.
dos:2019bb45361af888.title: Star Wars: Making Magic

dos:20304b4e3419a625.description: In 2050, enemies known as alterants control the city by distributing mind-controlling drugs. In a 3D view from a hovercraft, destroy all the alterants and stop their drug runs.
dos:20304b4e3419a625.title: Hoverforce

dos:203a8454c8578ef8.description: Manage a virtual farm: buy and sell livestock, plant and maintain crops, in a changing weather system with realistic seasons.
dos:203a8454c8578ef8.title: Sim Farm

dos:203b77ef7d242280.description: An unofficial single-player Star Trek adventure built with Domark's Virtual Reality Studio. A timed game on an Enterprise whose self-destruct sequence has started, played like a maze exploration through similar corridors.
dos:203b77ef7d242280.title: 3D Trek

dos:205d17777a904b77.description: Years ago the Zybonians installed a control center in the middle of the Earth so they could pull the planet from its orbit to their home system. Sequel to Deep.
dos:205d17777a904b77.title: Deep II: The Center of the Earth

dos:205d895c45c87182.description: A simple two-player game on one computer in which each player flies a red or green helicopter and tries to destroy the enemy helicopter.
dos:205d895c45c87182.title: Chopper Duel

dos:20649712cec5bb5f.description: An aerial racing simulation: complete a lap around the course as quickly as possible, steering with a detailed set of flight controls. Scenery and your opponent are 3D shaded polygons, and the cockpit view can be turned and zoomed.
tags: Flight Simulator; Racing & Driving; Vehicle Simulation
dos:20649712cec5bb5f.title: Pylon Racer

dos:20922b3295b9970a.description: A graphical adventure in Larry Niven's Known Space universe, centered on the Ringworld, an immense artificial band orbiting a distant star.
dos:20922b3295b9970a.title: Ringworld: Revenge of the Patriarch

dos:2093fcd1d5da2ec5.description: Martin Bourdages's first game, a fast, small VGA Tetris-based game. This is the registered version, with two players enabled and an additional game.
dos:2093fcd1d5da2ec5.title: TETRIX

dos:2097de1fa6196af4.description: An enhanced Pac-Man clone in which you gobble up gumdrops and other foodstuffs while avoiding getting eaten yourself.
dos:2097de1fa6196af4.title: Snack Attack II

dos:20a027ff0feab05d.description: Recreates three key battles of the American War of Independence, including Bunker Hill. British and American sides can be human or computer controlled at 3 skill levels, with adjustable reinforcements and ammunition.
dos:20a027ff0feab05d.title: Sons of Liberty

dos:20a6b807f90fcd6a.description: A remake of the 1981 RPG Ultima. Travel to another world and save the land of Sosaria from the evil wizard Mondain, with top-down overworld tiles and first-person pseudo-3D dungeons.
dos:20a6b807f90fcd6a.title: Ultima I: The First Age of Darkness

dos:20c10a43500f5690.description: A text adventure of exploring a mine: visit all the rooms and return the treasures to the entrance in as few moves as possible. Choosing a different mine number at the start gives you a different mine.
dos:20c10a43500f5690.title: Mines

dos:20c43307044bc37c.description: A computerized Battleship for two human players or one against the computer, published by Acorn Software Products.
dos:20c43307044bc37c.title: Sink the Fleet

dos:20c487934879e608.description: A hack-and-slash platformer set in the Crimean War. As a British cavalryman on horseback with a sword, kill Russian soldiers before their muskets, mortars and handguns kill you.
dos:20c487934879e608.title: The Trooper

dos:20e0545bb0ba0514.description: A shooting-gallery game in the style of Operation Wolf. As the detective Mike Gunner, you are hired to end the criminals of Robbland city, the most dangerous city on Earth.
dos:20e0545bb0ba0514.title: Mike Gunner

dos:20ebf2fe8cc54e32.description: A shooting gallery demo program bundled with IBM's first BASIC compiler: move a ground-based gun left and right and line up shots at targets crossing the screen.
dos:20ebf2fe8cc54e32.title: Target (1982)

dos:20f13e1e70a50906.description: A very basic Breakout with just a paddle, a ball and bricks, without power-ups or enemies. A short game of 9 stages that is without end.
dos:20f13e1e70a50906.title: Rompe Muros

dos:20f296ef04141ad7.description: The classic puzzle game, basis of countless clones: in a warehouse, push crates one at a time onto marked spots to complete each level.
dos:20f296ef04141ad7.title: Soko-Ban

dos:20f64d1ce40a138d.description: On the planet Twinsun, four races lived in peace until Dr. Funfrock used cloning and teleporting to create an army of soldiers and monsters. Play Twinsen in an action adventure.
dos:20f64d1ce40a138d.title: Relentless: Twinsen's Adventure

dos:2104d23ab03f2795.description: A word game and sliding tile puzzle from Softdisk disk subscriptions: rearrange letters within a constrained area to spell out words. Each appearance contained different puzzles.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Puzzle / Sliding block & tile
dos:2104d23ab03f2795.title: Anna's Gram

dos:2105e43914fa9c99.description: An F/A-18 flight simulator focused on air shows, replicating the tight maneuvers and precision flying of the US Navy's Blue Angels through formation flying.
dos:2105e43914fa9c99.title: Blue Angels: Formation Flight Simulation

dos:2111428f4f8da28e.description: A tactical WWII simulation of the whole Eastern front from 1939 to 1945, with over 700 weapon types and hundreds of unit types and formations.
dos:2111428f4f8da28e.title: Tigers on the Prowl 2

dos:211664c42916831c.description: A text adventure. As millionaire Steven Scott, you find your racehorse's trainer and rider has been stealing from you and face deceit and danger finding out why.
dos:211664c42916831c.title: High $take$

dos:2117f45145f3187d.description: A golf simulator that uses photographs taken from many angles to simulate the Harbour Town Golf Links, played from a first-person perspective.
dos:2117f45145f3187d.title: Picture Perfect Golf

dos:211eaa9ea8e8fefe.description: An educational Disney game for pre-schoolers learning the alphabet. Choose Mickey's home or the fair, where Mickey can perform 26 actions.
dos:211eaa9ea8e8fefe.title: Mickey's ABC's: A Day at the Fair

dos:21303423e17a6bfa.description: As Hen House Harry, collect 12 eggs from each single-screen level of platforms, ladders and lifts, avoiding ducklings, in a game similar to Donkey Kong.
dos:21303423e17a6bfa.title: Chuckie Egg

dos:2133e4d7110288c3.description: An updated version of the educational game Math Blaster!, no longer written in BASIC.
dos:2133e4d7110288c3.title: Math Blaster Plus!

dos:214728bd86b24f35.description: Mankind's last defender is pitted against waves of alien ships bent on destroying Earth with powerful explosives. Hunt down each ship within a strict, shrinking time limit.
dos:214728bd86b24f35.title: Devastator

dos:21583866e5070216.description: A simple shooter in which you fly a ship forward and shoot enemies, while asteroids line the sides of the screen and limit your movement.
dos:21583866e5070216.title: Galactic Battle (2000)

dos:21639c09c430c2df.description: A free racing simulator from a German programmer. Single races only: choose one of four tracks, one of four rivals (three cars and the clock) and one of three cars.
dos:21639c09c430c2df.title: Topspeed 300

dos:21642fd997105922.description: An arcade action game in the style of Moon Patrol. Drive a four-wheel-drive truck across a desert, accelerating, firing missiles and jumping, with 8 levels.
dos:21642fd997105922.title: Offroad

dos:216d941618b8f1c8.description: A Tic Tac Toe-style game in which the goal is to get 5 in a row on a massive board.
dos:216d941618b8f1c8.title: K&K

dos:2174d1c7eff943b5.description: Third and final game in Ezra Sidran's Universal Military Simulator series, with real-time unit movement on accurately recreated topographical maps of historical battlefields.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Education; Simulation; Strategy
dos:2174d1c7eff943b5.title: The War College: Universal Military Simulator 3

dos:2189acac2a591d06.description: An ASCII graphic adventure with 11 new levels and custom level support. As the fearless adventurer Eduin, find your village in the Dark Woods while evil creatures try to stop you.
dos:2189acac2a591d06.title: Dark Woods 2

dos:218d89b160138672.description: A Korean sci-fi side-scrolling shooter in which you control a giant mecha sent into a hostile area of deep space to fight mechanized aliens, moving in eight directions.
dos:218d89b160138672.title: Combatrobo Zakato

dos:2199d1077aedceee.description: It is 1908 and you are president of an upstart car company: design cutting-edge automobiles, manage finances and run marketing campaigns, with many classic car designs you can modify.
dos:2199d1077aedceee.title: Detroit

dos:219a09fe23408bce.description: A shooting gallery game with digitized actors. Escaped prisoners, helped by outsiders and armed, pop up from cover on different screens, and as a Sheriff's deputy you must take them out.
dos:219a09fe23408bce.title: Blood Bath at Red Falls

dos:21b68e045406bd22.description: An action game with puzzle elements: control the space probe Sky Cat on a mission to find and rescue hostages in an alien base, shooting enemies with a laser like Thexder and solving puzzles to overcome obstacles.
dos:21b68e045406bd22.title: Sky Cat

dos:21cb22c3a6c77b04.description: A toolkit to design and play turn-based strategic battles in any era, from ancient times to the future, with complete control over units' firepower, movement and strength. One or two players.
dos:21cb22c3a6c77b04.title: Wargame Construction Set

dos:21d21ac3d6d4efe8.description: Bar scene games on your PC: compete in a tournament or practice up to 5 events, including Liar's Dice, Wet 'n' Wild, Last Call and Air Hockey.
dos:21d21ac3d6d4efe8.title: Bar Games

dos:21d9817259ca9009.description: A computerized spirit board: use a mouse as the planchette to spell out messages from any spirits nearby, letter by letter.
dos:21d9817259ca9009.title: DaSi

dos:21e3dfafae4c5d7e.description: A Space Invaders-like arcade shooter: defend your ship at the bottom of the screen from waves of attackers. Each cleared round brings a harder one, with a time limit.
dos:21e3dfafae4c5d7e.title: Czorian Siege

dos:21f0ecea4fa7b728.description: A shareware vertical scrolling helicopter game in character graphics: fly over enemy territory destroying SAM tanks, dodging homing missiles by constantly changing course and speed.
dos:21f0ecea4fa7b728.title: Tommy's Airshark

dos:21f4b5b05bb0b82e.description: The first baseball game of Dynamix's Front Page Sports brand, balancing team management and statistical accuracy based on the 1994 Major League season, with a career mode where players age and improve.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:21f4b5b05bb0b82e.title: Front Page Sports: Baseball '94

dos:21f9d6b14d8b2777.description: A word game in which you fill in the missing letters of an incomplete word that slowly moves down the screen, for one or more players.
dos:21f9d6b14d8b2777.title: Webster: The Word Game

dos:21fd3ebba82be6aa.description: A shareware horizontal scrolling shoot-'em-up: destroy defense bases set up by an alien race through the levels and rescue captive humans.
dos:21fd3ebba82be6aa.title: World Quest

dos:220a2d987686e5f2.description: A basic action game in which you control a bouncing ball. In each one-screen level, backgrounds progressing from the big bang to the future, bounce between platforms collecting points and the exit key.
dos:220a2d987686e5f2.title: Pop-Up

dos:220ed12bbdb5d304.description: A small shareware strategy and action game for two players, with 30 rounds on random terrain. Each gets a team of small humanoid Clonks, and the goal of each round is to kill the enemy's captain.
dos:220ed12bbdb5d304.title: Clonk

dos:221b558fb1176766.description: In the far future, gladiator-style blood sports have been revived. To solve a mystery, the hero must become a player in the cruel battles where only the most ruthless survive. A first-person shooter.
dos:221b558fb1176766.title: XS

dos:221dcbbe5c1ffacc.description: A solitaire laid out like mahjong with cards face down, 25 left in a draw deck. Collect the maximum number of cards totaling 13 and clear the layout.
dos:221dcbbe5c1ffacc.title: Egyptian Solitaire

dos:2227e3c7454c0d3a.description: A text adventure: Inter-Planetary Human Simulations has built IP-39, the ultimate human-match android, and it has gone missing. Find out whether it was stolen or escaped, and where it is.
dos:2227e3c7454c0d3a.title: Doppleganger

dos:22325b9a932a885b.description: An educational typing game. MasterType is a wizard defending the command ship at the center of the screen from missiles launched from each corner, as you type the words that destroy them.
dos:22325b9a932a885b.title: MasterType

dos:22363a1276996624.description: A Korean colorful platformer. Choose either of two little kobolds, Cobi with a club or Comi with a hammer, who both control the same and can perform special combo moves.
dos:22363a1276996624.title: Dokkaebi-ga Ganda

dos:2239275917e22f6b.description: A cross between Breakout and Space Invaders: control a robot that walks along the top of a brick wall and jumps, as a line of bugs rises from the bottom and a bomb flies across.
dos:2239275917e22f6b.title: Jump

dos:2249b443fa6ff9a9.description: Interactive fiction based on Roger Zelazny's novels. As Prince Corwin, compete against your eight scheming brothers and sisters for the throne of Amber, center of the one true world.
dos:2249b443fa6ff9a9.title: Nine Princes in Amber

dos:22691d6070d058f2.description: Pumpkins have stolen Earth's candles to their home planet. As an axe-wielding maniac, destroy them and collect the candles in a simple 2D action game of mazes. Its fame comes from a newsgroup joke.
dos:22691d6070d058f2.title: Smashing Pumpkins into Small Piles of Putrid Debris

dos:2270bb7ec76e75c6.description: A top-down Gauntlet-style game: move through the maze collecting keys and using potions to heal and defend yourself.
dos:2270bb7ec76e75c6.title: Firefall

dos:22716f94a191af24.description: A toolkit to design and play turn-based strategic battles set between 1846 and 1905, with full control over units, one or two players, and pre-made scenarios and campaigns.
dos:22716f94a191af24.title: Wargame Construction Set III: Age of Rifles 1846-1905

dos:22723c2cc4568c13.description: A variant of the Atari 2600 Adventure: return the golden chalice to the yellow castle, past locked gates, a bat and several dragons.
dos:22723c2cc4568c13.title: Indenture

dos:22730068adee48bf.description: A WWII strategy game of the Eastern Front from 1941 to 1945 at corps level. Play either the Russians or the Germans, with full control including production of war material.
dos:22730068adee48bf.title: Gary Grigsby's War in Russia

dos:22754a671b59cadd.description: An RPG in which the kingdom of Celystra's new king Lythare loses his newborn child, and blames the Champion Knight-Paladin. First volume of the Aethra Chronicles.
dos:22754a671b59cadd.title: The Aethra Chronicles: Volume One - Celystra's Bane

dos:22758807a1f3dfb3.description: A Pipe Dream-style game: lay track for marathon runners through a forest using pieces at the bottom of the screen, and place the finish line before the runners reach it.
dos:22758807a1f3dfb3.title: Runoff

dos:2279d192b708713d.description: Ants are after your sugar cubes. Armed with a fly swatter, squash each ant before it drags a cube off the screen, keeping a target minimum of cubes on each level.
dos:2279d192b708713d.title: Splat!

dos:228e79b59cea5a69.description: A freeware keyboard-controlled Pong for one or two players, with five difficulty levels, a high score table and a soundtrack.
dos:228e79b59cea5a69.title: Pong

dos:229b11ba8de70816.description: A graphical roguelike RPG with an easy interface and a detailed near-real-time combat system. You are the hero who wants to explore the Valley to slay monsters and find treasure.
dos:229b11ba8de70816.title: The Valley

dos:229b6ca2f7964f56.description: A model railroad simulation: sketch and design your own track plan, add terrain, buildings and rivers, then place customizable trains and change switches.
dos:229b6ca2f7964f56.title: Design Your Own Train

dos:229f5e1af220e363.description: Guide Dave through ten levels to reclaim his trophies from a deserted pirate's hideout. A run-and-jump platformer meant to be harder than usual, originally for the Apple II.
dos:229f5e1af220e363.title: Dangerous Dave in the Deserted Pirate's Hideout

dos:22a85e805a68595d.description: Another adventure for the snowball hero, who must stay solid despite fireballs and lava pools. Essentially the first game with new graphics and levels.
dos:22a85e805a68595d.title: Joe Snow 2

dos:22a89724869932b5.description: Manhattan, 2019, after a nuclear war. Jonathan "Jungle" Rogers must reach the airdrop platform XV-238 in the base of the schizophrenic assassin professor McJerin and escape to outer colonies.
dos:22a89724869932b5.title: After The War

dos:22c585562452cbf5.description: A small text adventure by Swedish programmer Magnus Olsson, in version 4.3, with teleporting, dragons and locked doors.
dos:22c585562452cbf5.title: The Dungeons of Dunjin

dos:22c9b59472afefde.description: The sequel to Bomb Jack, adding side scrolling and moving closer to a platformer. As the bomb-hungry caped superhero, collect bombs for points and avoid monsters.
dos:22c9b59472afefde.title: Mighty Bombjack

dos:22d0b8979f7b5d42.description: Follow-up to Puyo Puyo, a falling block game: combine four or more same-colored Puyos to make them disappear, and chain combos to send Nuisance Puyos to the opponent.
dos:22d0b8979f7b5d42.title: Puyo Puyo 2

dos:22d27c664a7e13ec.description: A puzzle in which you empty the field of molecules by sending each into its own gate, though each moves in four directions from obstacle to obstacle.
dos:22d27c664a7e13ec.title: Soul Magician

dos:22e02b71fc93077c.description: An updated Pong and Quadrapong in which two or four players bounce a ball around a square court, each moving a paddle along one edge. The goal is to score the fewest misses.
dos:22e02b71fc93077c.title: Rotating Pong

dos:22e525790b7232cf.description: A minimalist one-room interactive fiction game: the room is the middle of a town square in a nondescript New England town, containing only a single object, a phone booth.
dos:22e525790b7232cf.title: Pick up the Phone Booth and Die

dos:22e552f67bdd1b4a.description: A Boulder Dash clone starring a funny green monster. Collect all the diamonds in each level while avoiding falling cobblestones, traps and creatures underground.
dos:22e552f67bdd1b4a.title: Felix

dos:22e895f6eecf67ae.description: An Angband variant in ASCII graphics that adds new races, modified classes, an Adventurer's Guild for quests and over 120 new monsters.
dos:22e895f6eecf67ae.title: EyAngband

dos:22e9bfeb2746ad22.description: A Simon Says-style game where up to 2 players compete to memorize a color sequence.
dos:22e9bfeb2746ad22.title: Flasher II

dos:22ece43afe33328f.description: A shareware puzzle game described as a cross between Othello and Life. Anti Chaos: make squares of different colors all the same color on a grid where each square is linked to its neighbors.
dos:22ece43afe33328f.title: AntiC

dos:22ee14072c929917.description: A compilation of 15 games and activities for kids 3 to 8 from the Putt-Putt and Fatty Bear Funpacks plus new ones, mostly played against Putt-Putt or Fatty Bear.
tags: Action; Board Game / Party Game; Education; Puzzle; Strategy
dos:22ee14072c929917.title: Putt-Putt and Fatty Bear's Activity Pack

dos:2311157e737e1949.description: Version 2.0 of a wildland fire simulation. On a top-down map of 180,000 acres of forested coastland in the Northwest, set up the situation and fight the fire.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Strategy; Education
dos:2311157e737e1949.title: Firestorm 2000: The Wildland Fire Simulation

dos:231818b7597f848e.description: Based on the Belgian comic Les Tuniques Bleues, replay the American Civil War as the North or South. Move troops on a map of the US, and battles between armies in the same state play out as action sequences.
dos:231818b7597f848e.title: North & South

dos:2331df2ad55bec10.description: An adventure and arcade game set 100,000 years ago. As a young hunter of the Light-Foot tribe, explore your territory, keep friendly contacts with other tribes and trade objects.
dos:2331df2ad55bec10.title: Sapiens

dos:233b08a209c4460c.description: A text adventure in which you are Amsel of Fandora, a scientist and visionary who has lived as a hermit and can no longer afford the peace of solitude, with your friend Hawkwind at your side.
dos:233b08a209c4460c.title: Dragonworld

dos:233bcc30ada0391c.description: A keyboard-controlled game in which you fly a 3D landscape firing rockets at enemy craft, with single-player, player-versus-player and two-player cooperative modes.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Shooter; Vehicle Simulation
dos:233bcc30ada0391c.title: Ace

dos:233d20230441370a.description: Three side-scrolling platform games with Bible themes. In Noah's Ark, find a male and female of each species and bring them to the ark before the flood. Another is Save Baby Moses.
dos:233d20230441370a.title: Bible Adventures

dos:2342ad7c44066cca.description: An interactive comic book from ICE Inc, one of the earliest of its kind before CD-ROMs, in which you follow the story of a return to planet Earth.
dos:2342ad7c44066cca.title: Pangea: Return to Planet Earth

dos:236c5eadb333fcc0.description: A shooting game made for the Spanish Gunstick light gun, similar to Crossbow. William Tell walks on automatically to rescue his beloved while you act as bodyguard, shooting threats.
dos:236c5eadb333fcc0.title: Guillermo Tell

dos:236d9289143fdeb9.description: A Falcon 3.0 expansion pack that lets you fly the Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-29, the agile Soviet fighter, and fight for the other side, with the graphics and realism of Falcon 3.0.
dos:236d9289143fdeb9.title: MiG-29: Deadly Adversary of Falcon 3.0

dos:2380f2864b6d4640.description: Buck Rogers awakens in the 25th century, an ancient military hero, and joins the New Earth Organization to fight for Earth. A Gold Box role-playing game.
dos:2380f2864b6d4640.title: Buck Rogers: Countdown to Doomsday

dos:23887da41e1ac37a.description: A rare Spanish side-view space shoot-'em-up whose pictures and names of characters have nothing to do with the gameplay.
dos:23887da41e1ac37a.title: Adentrator

dos:238a5a4542128efd.description: A puzzle follow-up to King's Valley: collect all treasures by drilling and cutting through pyramids haunted by mummies, with a limited supply of equipment you must use in the right order.
dos:238a5a4542128efd.title: King's Valley 2

dos:238f4f91b8646ea5.description: A one-on-one fighting game modeled closely on Street Fighter, for one or two players.
dos:238f4f91b8646ea5.title: Street Count 2 Plus

dos:23974317553dbe4d.description: An advergame for the German TV magazine WISO. A Breakout variant in which bricks with a question mark trigger a multiple-choice question about the economy.
dos:23974317553dbe4d.title: WISO Breakout

dos:2397bfe37f47a51b.description: Dinamic Multimedia's first international competition game, in which you are the Spanish national coach for Euro '96, choosing from the Primera Division players and designing the team's formation.
dos:2397bfe37f47a51b.title: PC Seleccion Espanola de Futbol Eurocopa '96

dos:239ef9d44b7659ed.description: A text adventure in which a nightmare comes true: find your way out of a wax works factory where all the exhibits come to life.
dos:239ef9d44b7659ed.title: Mysterious Adventure No. 11: Waxworks

dos:23a5ed58f17eb8f1.description: Tie-in of the board game. Up to four players land on a planet with their motherships and try to gather as much ore as possible within 24 rounds, while tanks and destroyers fight over it.
dos:23a5ed58f17eb8f1.title: Full Metal Planet

dos:23baa95e1eb294b3.description: A fishing game for one to two players, effectively a two-player version of Richard Olsen's Bass Class, supporting up to fifty lakes, including those made for BassTour.
dos:23baa95e1eb294b3.title: BassDuel

dos:23bfc71d7cc624c3.description: A tennis simulation with all the rules from tie-breaks to break points, viewed from behind a player with a split-screen option. Singles and doubles over 1, 3 or 5 sets on grass, quick, hard or clay courts.
dos:23bfc71d7cc624c3.title: Tennis Cup 2

dos:23c2b8ad94b65f6c.description: A Tetris clone for up to two players with 7 block shapes: fill a line of the pit to make it disappear.
dos:23c2b8ad94b65f6c.title: Tetrolis

dos:23cb77afec8c3f2d.description: The REEL Magic edition of Return to Zork, a full-motion video adventure starting behind the white house, where a video message from a wizard begins your quest.
dos:23cb77afec8c3f2d.title: Return to Zork (REEL Magic)

dos:23d46ad27ec82c91.description: As a highly respected warrior, conquer as many regions as possible in three stages: fight through hordes of fighters to reach the castle, climb its sections, then battle its inhabitant.
dos:23d46ad27ec82c91.title: Onslaught

dos:23e52e47f1f2ce8c.description: Command a squadron of rebel pilots to outfly and outsmart the invasion force of the Terran Overlord Government.
dos:23e52e47f1f2ce8c.title: Renegade: Battle for Jacob's Star

dos:23ed491e21122c2d.description: A shareware dungeon crawl. Two hundred years ago you served Lord Trentarus, whose mages built a sarcophagus of pure wizidrium to ensure his reign continued.
dos:23ed491e21122c2d.title: Skull Quest I: The Cyan Sarcophagus

dos:23f7897d095b0586.description: An action game of cat-themed mini-games tied together: as a little black cat, work your way from an alley to a lady cat in an apartment complex, scoring as many points as you can.
dos:23f7897d095b0586.title: Alley Cat

dos:23fce87b143db63e.description: A Pac-Man clone written in compiled BASIC, with the maze rotated 90 degrees: munch the dots, collect prize items for bonus points and dodge four ghosts.
dos:23fce87b143db63e.title: Packman

dos:24036d0500656570.description: Hugo the troll goes on an adventure to rescue his wife Hugoline and three children from the evil witch Scylla. Includes mini-games such as Hugo on a snowboard.
dos:24036d0500656570.title: Hugo 4

dos:242a30536956550a.description: Be a TV network executive who picks the shows and cancels low-rated ones in favor of popular tripe and identical sitcoms, in a highly unusual simulation from First Row Software.
dos:242a30536956550a.title: Prime Time

dos:242c63d5a79ec229.description: An interactive fiction adventure written with the AGS toolkit in which you play Bertrand, a resident of a small mountain village who ducks into a mansion during a storm.
dos:242c63d5a79ec229.title: Witchfinder

dos:242c6e1e582a16ec.description: Second in the DRED trilogy: as a DRED agent, defend the DRED headquarters under attack. The puzzles are tougher than in the first.
dos:242c6e1e582a16ec.title: D.R.E.D. Attack!

dos:24316dab5ca56353.description: A puzzle game in which you guide a robot through many levels with hazards such as lasers and enemies, blowing up bombs and pushing crates, with smooth scrolling playfields.
dos:24316dab5ca56353.title: Robbo

dos:2460d02ac3ed5685.description: A fixed-screen shoot-'em-up: move left and right at the bottom of the screen and shoot the aliens at the top, Drones, Emissaries, Hornets and Commanders, with higher ones worth more.
dos:2460d02ac3ed5685.title: Galaxian

dos:24705ff935adcba1.description: An epic fantasy RPG in the land of Trazere, where armies of mutants are marauding. Heroes scour cities, dungeons and wilderness for clues to the source of the evil, moving on a strategic map.
dos:24705ff935adcba1.title: The Four Crystals of Trazere

dos:2470dbeaacc29101.description: On a trip to Disney World, Cosmo is stranded on a planet with his parents vanished. Run and jump through lands such as alien tropics, haunted forest, ice cave and future world to find them.
dos:2470dbeaacc29101.title: Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure

dos:24840aae2a4f6721.description: An inventive Tetris take: the field is a large circular fortress with a small ring of balls at the center, and new colored balls arrive from outside to complete circles.
dos:24840aae2a4f6721.title: XFortress

dos:2488b16920b65d75.description: A first-person shooter distributed by Coca-Cola through McDonald's. On your first day at school, a mad scientist has turned your schoolmates into zombies, and you cure them.
dos:2488b16920b65d75.title: Mr. Pibb

dos:24a652171b3d63a0.description: A graphical multiplayer space strategy war game of galactic empires. Colonize and develop planets that determine what kind of starships you can build.
dos:24a652171b3d63a0.title: VGA Planets

dos:24c116c7dbdfef2c.description: The alien hero of Galactix returns at the request of the King of Galaxia, whose three magical orbs have been stolen by bandits, to retrieve them.
dos:24c116c7dbdfef2c.title: Galactix II: The Search for the Lost Orbs

dos:24e1a3060bd91dee.description: A free first-person shooter by Pie in the Sky made as a demo of their Game Creation System, with 3D graphics and sound effects.
dos:24e1a3060bd91dee.title: Industrial Killers

dos:24e35e75a2728246.description: A strategy game on an 8x8 board against the computer, Max. You control the blue pieces around the center and it commands the red ones in the corners, each side moving once per turn.
dos:24e35e75a2728246.title: Tactile

dos:24e3c6474b5cc96b.description: A 3D real-time submarine simulation: command a US submarine in the Pacific during World War II, navigating to track and intercept Japanese warships.
dos:24e3c6474b5cc96b.title: GATO

dos:25059b1758e8ed53.description: A fishing simulator: travel to a river, buy equipment at the docks and take tips from Bill Saiff, whose house walls hold the angler's trophies and greatest misses.
dos:25059b1758e8ed53.title: Gone Fishin'

dos:2507bc553c7c2d5d.description: One of the first games made in Russia after the Soviet collapse: a beat-'em-up of Russian peasants in hand-to-hand combat to defeat Evil Forces and protect ancient scrolls describing the Sobor combat system.
dos:2507bc553c7c2d5d.title: Sabor

dos:2508b7cc47e57b5f.description: A shareware platform game for one or two players: guide the small red Aro through sixty levels (eighteen in the shareware release) at four difficulty levels.
dos:2508b7cc47e57b5f.title: Aro II

dos:25191d3644684161.description: A puzzle game in which you rebuild a structure, such as a big A, from eight differently shaped blocks (some like Tetris pieces) that you rotate and place in limited numbers.
dos:25191d3644684161.title: Lettrix

dos:2528919d2f5fbd7f.description: An educational geography game for ages 7 and up, in the style of Carmen Sandiego. Help professional photographer Nigel take pictures around the world.
dos:2528919d2f5fbd7f.title: Nigel's World: Adventures in Geography

dos:253285b22cdb8729.description: Play Charlie Chaplin starring in films in the style of black-and-white classics. After filming each scene, you get to edit it.
dos:253285b22cdb8729.title: Charlie Chaplin

dos:253584831f133f25.description: Travel to Tokyo to rescue Eva from a scientist who plans to turn her into a machine, in a mouse-driven adventure with several smaller challenges.
dos:253584831f133f25.title: Geisha

dos:2544a782b4edee0d.description: An educational English game helping children identify letters and sound combinations, numbers and number sequences, and everyday vocabulary.
dos:2544a782b4edee0d.title: KidSpeak English - Mike Teaches English

dos:254510256665960a.description: After its creator is killed, you are left holding a sample of a mysterious invention. Deliver it, investigate the intrigue around it and avoid being blamed for the murder.
dos:254510256665960a.title: Fascination (1991)

dos:254afef1b5cb04e2.description: A program for children from pre-school through third grade that teaches telling time in a variety of ways, converting digital to analog and back, at selectable difficulty levels.
dos:254afef1b5cb04e2.title: Animated Clock v3.0

dos:254d052437ee13c6.description: A wargame of the Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815 between Napoleon's French forces and Wellington's English and allied forces and Blücher's Prussians.
dos:254d052437ee13c6.title: Waterloo

dos:255f8857bb05df21.description: A drag racing simulation: fine-tune your car with a dizzying array of customization options, then send it down short, linear tracks at high speed.
dos:255f8857bb05df21.title: Burnout: Championship Drag Racing

dos:2566ffde47c2b6c2.description: An early squad-level tactical combat game like X-Com and Laser Squad: isometric turn-based combat in the far future, where surviving squad leaders gain experience.
dos:2566ffde47c2b6c2.title: Breach 2

dos:2576295d953cb4b4.description: A total conversion of Duke Nukem 3D developed for WizardWorks as a paid add-on; after a year of production the project was finished and released free on the Internet.
dos:2576295d953cb4b4.title: Duke It's Zero Hour

dos:258324849de72c12.description: A shareware sci-fi shooter. Scientists have genetically modified insects that now live in an underground tunnel network, whose leader Phylox rules from a fortress with a breeding chamber.
dos:258324849de72c12.title: Phylox

dos:259e82c59cc9a4be.description: Race as Spanish rally driver Carlos Sainz in a Toyota Celica in the World Championship at circuits such as Monte Carlo, Sweden, UK, Argentina and Spain, on clay, asphalt and snow, tuning the car for each.
dos:259e82c59cc9a4be.title: Carlos Sainz

dos:25ad50d3b4bbbddb.description: An arcade racer of high-speed dune buggies. 5 tracks of 5 stages each, from cities to deserts to tracks over water, and 12 drivers to pick from.
dos:25ad50d3b4bbbddb.title: Power Drift

dos:25b4a1e5e5a8f772.description: A fairly detailed chess tutorial, apparently originally part of Grand Master Chess: Tutor & Challenge, with the challenge portion missing.
dos:25b4a1e5e5a8f772.title: 1st Chess Tutor

dos:25b66662d3bc8676.description: A puzzle arcade game probably inspired by Tetris and Columns. Blocks slowly appear at the top of columns, and you use a cursor at the bottom to pull blocks down from a column, since the game ends if a column reaches the bottom.
dos:25b66662d3bc8676.title: Drop-Drop

dos:25dc8050f36313bc.description: A word game for one or more players. The word-giver sees the real definition and paraphrases it, others make up their own, and everyone votes for the definition they think is correct.
dos:25dc8050f36313bc.title: Fictionary (1989)

dos:25df384a01d6fad6.description: A text adventure made with the Computer Novel Construction Set: the dog has done a poop in the middle of the Town Square, and your task is to clean it up.
dos:25df384a01d6fad6.title: Scoop Da Poop

dos:25e6a58ee3701022.description: A puzzle game: collect all the treasures by drilling and cutting through pyramids haunted by mummies, with a limited supply of tools that you must use in the right order or get stuck.
dos:25e6a58ee3701022.title: King's Valley

dos:25f7462b15a6189c.description: Krisalis's fourth licensed Manchester United game, named for the club's 1993-94 Premier League and FA Cup double. Overhead view like Kick Off with loose control and a range of moves.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:25f7462b15a6189c.title: Manchester United: The Double

dos:25f9ae6f92d39aad.description: A very simple shareware arcade game against a friend or the AI. Each player has 7 of the 14 cannons along the bottom, and shots ricochet off the walls.
dos:25f9ae6f92d39aad.title: Ricochet

dos:25f9f80215698328.description: A manager simulator for a team in the top three German leagues, with the real players and teams of the time. Handle economics and sport, trade players and more.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:25f9f80215698328.title: Bundesliga Manager

dos:2603e3c52acb10eb.description: In 2880, alien races pillage the planet Soran, forcing its inhabitants to flee to Earth and live in a floating Sky-City. A first-person shooter.
dos:2603e3c52acb10eb.title: ThunderGun: The Cybwar Mission

dos:26079d54e16f7844.description: Mirinae Software's final game, a casual arena fighter for two players.
dos:26079d54e16f7844.title: Super Kid

dos:262889186922639d.description: A Boulder Dash clone in which a smiling red ball collects all the coins and goes to the exit, avoiding falling rocks and other dangers.
dos:262889186922639d.title: Rolling Jack

dos:262a07eba2dc09b7.description: An old-fashioned jump'n'run. Jasper's cat Orlando is nabbed by a witch who wants him for a potion, so make your way through a world of magic and monsters to her castle.
dos:262a07eba2dc09b7.title: Jasper's Journeys

dos:262a780661fa6909.description: A Formula 1 racing game in arcade or simulation mode, with manual or automatic transmission, training, single races or a full season, and a two-player option on separate computers.
dos:262a780661fa6909.title: Vroom

dos:2634d794354d16a9.description: Jumpman is a bomb disposal expert who saves the Jupiter headquarters after the Alienators booby-trap its 30 levels. Find your way around each screen using platforms, ladders and a jet booster, collecting every bomb.
dos:2634d794354d16a9.title: Jumpman

dos:263a46b87ef24d06.description: A Tetris clone with slower falling blocks. Cleared blocks add to a rising bar chart at the right of the main area, and blocks can be rotated, moved and dropped.
dos:263a46b87ef24d06.title: Smooth Tetris

dos:263c2ffbcee5c0c5.description: An arcade game from Maddox Games, later known for IL-2 Sturmovik. Two mice have fun: one runs along a table on which five saucers sit, trying to keep the dishes dropped by his brother from falling.
dos:263c2ffbcee5c0c5.title: Plates

dos:2655a8890e0bcb92.description: A strategy game of the Vietnam War. As both President and commander-in-chief, keep South Vietnam from falling to the Vietcong while managing military resources and public opinion.
dos:2655a8890e0bcb92.title: 'Nam 1965-1975

dos:265b06459da3d480.description: A first-person shooter built with the same 3D creation software as Castaway. As a ninja working for Santa, rescue his reindeer from Abominable Snowpeople.
dos:265b06459da3d480.title: Deer Napped

dos:26626e19f366cca6.description: A Core Wars game: you get a tank, a programming language and a board with obstacles like rocks, trees and rivers, and write a program that wins in the most trials.
dos:26626e19f366cca6.title: Digital Warriors

dos:26649f3c6b516c67.description: A hand-drawn point-and-click adventure set in Russia after Perestroika. A mystery spanning a continent is split into three parts, each with a different character.
dos:26649f3c6b516c67.title: The Big Red Adventure

dos:2668e9e77349e067.description: An early 3D soccer game with four leagues (England, France, Germany, Italy) and basic management options such as trading players, finances and stadium expansion, with camera options and seasonal weather.
dos:2668e9e77349e067.title: ONSIDE Complete Soccer

dos:2676860d8f3eab4c.description: A photographic adventure starring Jo Guest: a routine milk delivery turns into an unexpected visit. Use the mouse to explore the house and choose how the encounter develops.
dos:2676860d8f3eab4c.title: Jo Guest in the Milk Round

dos:267757f5bd8d3969.description: A Thai kick boxing game endorsed by André Panza, with over 35 moves. Build your fighter in the training gym and customize attacks before taking on opponents in the ring.
dos:267757f5bd8d3969.title: Panza Kick Boxing

dos:2678b2ef5c3de20f.description: A basketball simulator with many difficulty levels, redefinable keys, play against the computer or a friend, selectable match length and a demo mode.
dos:2678b2ef5c3de20f.title: Golden Basket

dos:268a3edf05cd3a87.description: An educational game for up to four players testing knowledge of the fifty US states, with quizzes such as State Comparison, where you compare area and population of two random states.
dos:268a3edf05cd3a87.title: These United States

dos:268bde2e605d7b16.description: Interactive fiction that is a single conversation with a single character. You play an art critic speaking to Galatea, an animate sculpture with artificial intelligence, with dozens of possible outcomes.
dos:268bde2e605d7b16.title: Galatea

dos:2692aeee1ce0e35a.description: Use your helicopter gunship to land and save civilians while destroying enemy hostiles, with quick maneuvers and a chain-gun.
dos:2692aeee1ce0e35a.title: Airlift Rescue

dos:2694be5361d5bfe8.description: A Taiwanese fighting game matching fighters from different martial arts backgrounds, with simple fighting using two kinds of attacks.
dos:2694be5361d5bfe8.title: Battle of the Martial Arts

dos:26950da930a509ad.description: A Finnish English-language two-dimensional shooter, originally shareware and made free in 2000. In a post-apocalyptic world after the Third World War, soldiers fight to amuse a morally feral population.
dos:26950da930a509ad.title: BMF

dos:269c3f5184b70126.description: An arcade racing game with simple controls and no realistic physics, with power-ups and cars that can jump. Pick one of eight characters with different traits before racing.
dos:269c3f5184b70126.title: World Rally Fever: Born on the Road

dos:269f521e4f0f429b.description: A role-playing adventure set in the future as imagined by Victorian science fiction writers, based on GDW's tabletop RPG. Explore Earth's far corners and travel between planets on ships of Martian liftwood.
dos:269f521e4f0f429b.title: Space 1889

dos:26a0f31d55a6ec9b.description: An isometric tactical war game like Cannon Fodder, but more advanced. Command squads through missions on terrains from grasslands and desert to the Moon, with pistols and machine guns.
dos:26a0f31d55a6ec9b.title: Theatre of Death

dos:26a40ee4a36621ab.description: A text adventure in the land of Kerovnia: inducted into the Guild of Thieves as a beginner, steal your way to the top, helped and hindered by the Guildmaster.
dos:26a40ee4a36621ab.title: The Guild of Thieves

dos:26a43d25c5fb1378.description: A fast arcade shooter for two players, against the computer or a human via split screen, flying ships in caves and destroying opponents with weapons and bonus add-ons.
dos:26a43d25c5fb1378.title: Wham!

dos:26af9dcc2a0b67b0.description: A real-time strategy game very similar to Warcraft II, set in Semirechye, a medieval fantasy world loosely based on Slavic folk tales, where you lead a tribe.
dos:26af9dcc2a0b67b0.title: Horde: The Northern Wind

dos:26b260e4fb5123f2.description: A pseudo-3D flying game in which you control a lightly-engined plane over planets and in space. In 2354 humanity has colonized space and collides with the Kartanian Empire.
dos:26b260e4fb5123f2.title: True Blood: The Karthanian Ultimatum

dos:26b5b84b158ae60a.description: A role-playing game set after a devastating atomic war, with the Earth a radioactive wasteland, where the courageous live on the surface and many people live in huge underground Vaults.
dos:26b5b84b158ae60a.title: Fallout (1997)

dos:26bbdc9c23985c13.description: Follow-up to Halloween Harry in a side-scrolling platform shooter: aliens are invading Earth and turning humans into zombies to enslave them.
dos:26bbdc9c23985c13.title: Alien Carnage

dos:26cb8fb08bfc8172.description: A plotless side-scrolling futuristic shooter: a space fighter flies left to right destroying hostile objects, while dodging harmless ones such as asteroids and bubbles.
dos:26cb8fb08bfc8172.title: Bios

dos:26ce89786448592d.description: Puts nearly every team and player from 1871 to 1981 against each other, using the engine of Tony La Russa 3 with aged courts and players, in exhibition or series play.
dos:26ce89786448592d.title: Old Time Baseball

dos:26e1036512d85814.description: A top-down driving game in which you are a cab driver picking up customers and dropping them off, avoiding crashes and refueling in time.
dos:26e1036512d85814.title: Popo Car

dos:26e6137499e10fa0.description: Another Crosscountry geography game, now of Canada. Drive an 18-wheel truck around the country picking up and delivering commodities with typed commands like TURN ON MOTOR.
dos:26e6137499e10fa0.title: Crosscountry Canada

dos:26eba2e042b7132a.description: A Finnish freeware game about demolishing buildings: run a demolition company and bring down buildings with as little explosives and collateral damage as possible.
dos:26eba2e042b7132a.title: Operation Cleaner

dos:26f7632a5b10071d.description: In 1938 Indiana Jones and his father race to keep Hitler from capturing the Holy Grail, dealing with Nazi guards, the Luftwaffe and enemy spies. A SCUMM point-and-click adventure.
dos:26f7632a5b10071d.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade: The Graphic Adventure

dos:26fa837d8502e488.description: Private investigator Tex Murphy is hired to investigate the murder of a university professor, one of eight scientists on Project Overlord, which sought to control people remotely, and finds other related deaths.
dos:26fa837d8502e488.title: Mean Streets

dos:26fc802599649b36.description: An evil wizard at the top of a sinister tower has imprisoned the souls of four great gods in four talismans and hidden them. A role-playing game.
dos:26fc802599649b36.title: Hexx: Heresy of the Wizard

dos:270f6962e2c9958d.description: A 2D top-down space shooter: enter a solar system where pirates have overrun the freighter lanes, clear them and protect the freighters, with a radar in the corner of the screen.
dos:270f6962e2c9958d.title: SPIN

dos:2710b31e12256477.description: A real-time 3D simulation of flight from lunar orbit to moon landing. Master gravity and inertia in a Lunar Landing Vehicle over hazardous terrain, with keyboard or joystick.
dos:2710b31e12256477.title: Lunar Explorer: A Space Flight Simulator

dos:271bd416667cc7e0.description: A single-screen shoot-'em-up: protect humans from predatory buzzards that hatch from eggs laid by pairs in their nests each round.
dos:271bd416667cc7e0.title: Buzzard Bait

dos:2726a70b052b0a17.description: A shareware program that generates mazes from parameters like size, colors and path width, which can be printed and used as puzzles.
dos:2726a70b052b0a17.title: Tommy's Show And Tell Maze Generator

dos:2730b099270e8b5d.description: A platform action game with light adventure elements. Cornelius the Elf must rescue his sweetheart Elisa from the evil Necrilous the Not-Very-Nice.
dos:2730b099270e8b5d.title: Elf

dos:2738257d4d940ca4.description: A Civil War strategy simulation in which you play the Confederacy, allocating funds for food, salaries and weapons and choosing offensive or defensive strategies to win as many battles as you can.
dos:2738257d4d940ca4.title: Civil War (1983)

dos:2738d9bbe5c39558.description: Play Jerry, chased by Tom, and use various tricks to pay him back. Choose from two difficulty levels and set the time to play.
dos:2738d9bbe5c39558.title: Tom & Jerry: Yankee Doodle's CAT-astrophe

dos:276153aaf5afca96.description: A platform game with 60 levels, essentially a remake of the SNES game Super Troll Islands, featuring the TV character Mr. Blobby.
dos:276153aaf5afca96.title: Mr. Blobby

dos:276da53a5bbdadff.description: A Space Invaders-style shooter in which destroyed alien ships drop gold and silver coins, which you collect to buy power-ups.
dos:276da53a5bbdadff.title: Cash Invaders

dos:27701be3dac35bbb.description: A beat-'em-up in which you play former punk rocker and martial artist Duke Dunnegan, wrestler Gorgeous George or a pushed-too-far teacher, cleaning the mean streets of thugs.
dos:27701be3dac35bbb.title: Bad Street Brawler

dos:277b8cfcb78a1f7e.description: An add-on program of 9 slot machines, including 3-wheel, 5-wheel and progressives, for Capstone casino games such as Trump Castle and Casinos of the World.
dos:277b8cfcb78a1f7e.title: Lots -o- $lot$

dos:2785d7b5cdf64412.description: A small tabletop-style soccer game from Sweden: each team has three players and the ball can only leave the field through the goal.
dos:2785d7b5cdf64412.title: Final Soccer Challenge

dos:2789e6e32995d350.description: Aquatania has become a land of misfortune thanks to plotting witches. Find five charms and a magic bracelet to put things right, surviving events like being hit by a car and falling a great distance.
dos:2789e6e32995d350.title: Jinxter

dos:2792db5cc009cb74.description: The first of the PC Basket series of budget games, combining a database of Spanish basketball teams with a basketball simulator. It includes 8 teams.
dos:2792db5cc009cb74.title: PC Basket

dos:279e9770c9fe25a8.description: Loosely inspired by Dutch Schultz's buried millions, go down into the Lost Dutchman's Gold Mine to blast out a lost treasure in a random maze, infested with rats and spiders.
dos:279e9770c9fe25a8.title: Shultz's Treasure

dos:27aa10592e8fb5d7.description: After humans' victory over the neurocomputer MESIA in the 23rd century, the corporation Conex rebuilds cities and makes new robots, and slowly it becomes clear the company is not what it seems.
dos:27aa10592e8fb5d7.title: Genocide 2: Master of the Dark Communion

dos:27cd6063542a64f7.description: A realistic 3D baseball game in full-screen SVGA with fully animated players, various camera angles and enhanced physics, with real and fantasy ballparks and four skill levels.
dos:27cd6063542a64f7.title: Earl Weaver Baseball II

dos:27da0aa260d20914.description: Fly as an American or Japanese pilot in one of 4 operations in the Pacific during WWII. Twelve aircraft and about 20 ship types, with a manual full of historical information.
dos:27da0aa260d20914.title: Battlehawks 1942

dos:27f0b77b8460853c.description: A single-player keyboard-controlled Asteroids-style shooter in which enemy ships travel in vertical or horizontal lines. Destroy them all and find the exit.
dos:27f0b77b8460853c.title: Rocket Fighter

dos:27f2bb2acd4878f1.description: Build molecules out of the atoms provided, watching for double, triple and four-way atoms that stop you from completing your task.
dos:27f2bb2acd4878f1.title: Atomino

dos:27f6d06bd33d9c9d.description: A game for children where you are the bus driver for the town's children, with some logic and memory elements.
dos:27f6d06bd33d9c9d.title: Fisher-Price: School Bus Driver

dos:27fa46312e266bf5.description: A text adventure in which you play a GI stationed at Osan Air Base, trying to piece together what happened the night before after a night out at the clubs of Songtan.
dos:27fa46312e266bf5.title: SONGTAN: The Next Morning

dos:2800e03d12d4767d.description: The registered version of Brix, adding 112 levels and a level editor, a near exact clone of Taito's Puzznic: move pieces so identical ones touch and disappear.
dos:2800e03d12d4767d.title: Brix 2 Deluxe

dos:28028d8f639ada70.description: Third chapter in a series of text adventures after Two Days to the Race and The Queen's Footsteps. It is April 19, 1907 and you, Emilia Vittorini, are hosted at a villa in Varenna on Lake Como.
dos:28028d8f639ada70.title: Silk Dust

dos:28059beadc2674b5.description: It's 1989 and a meteor shower is bringing a deadly, virulent disease to Earth. Contain the infection and keep mankind from catastrophe.
dos:28059beadc2674b5.title: Epidemic!

dos:280a43fdcf03686f.description: A shareware side-scrolling platformer closely resembling Super Mario Bros., set in a fantasy land under terror, based on an unofficial DOS Super Mario Bros. by the same author.
dos:280a43fdcf03686f.title: Super Angelo

dos:2815e63b69bca1e4.description: Mika Huy is assigned by her boss at the Reality-on-the-Norm newspaper to take three photographs, including the alley bum Sinny Binds, Davy Jones's grave and zombie Mayor Michael Gower.
dos:2815e63b69bca1e4.title: I Spy II

dos:281a9ab3f098ce60.description: The sequel to the ZZT series, with 5 very large game boards with different puzzles and storylines.
dos:281a9ab3f098ce60.title: Super ZZT

dos:282dd02576a017ea.description: A puzzle game: on each time-limited level, push color boxes of the same color together to unite them, then push the resulting box into the exit tile.
dos:282dd02576a017ea.title: Color Buster

dos:282df99dc51a2614.description: A computerized Klondike Solitaire: arrange cards in 7 tableau stacks, build piles of alternating color and descending value, and move aces to the four foundation cells.
dos:282df99dc51a2614.title: Solitaire

dos:2839f3a6689c696a.description: A computer coloring book in the Electric Crayon series with 29 pictures of Super Mario Bros. characters in different occupations, colored from a 16-color palette with a mix button for 256 colors.
dos:2839f3a6689c696a.title: Electric Crayon 3.1: Super Mario Bros. & Friends: When I Grow Up

dos:2843317eb68e3a6e.description: In medieval Korea, peasant boy Dusu must save his love from an arrogant noble's son who wants to marry her. A 2D side-scrolling platform game with a stick, sickles and magic spells.
dos:2843317eb68e3a6e.title: Jisaeneun Dal

dos:28480dbcd8b90bfe.description: A puzzle game in which you, a white ball, must escape from red balls, evil robots, on a field of colored cells with a flashing exit.
dos:28480dbcd8b90bfe.title: Robots from Hell

dos:28629bd7d972c7eb.description: An arcade-style soccer game with an Indoor and an Outdoor part. Play single matches, league or tournament, with weather effects, replays, customizable game length and funny moves.
dos:28629bd7d972c7eb.title: Keith Van Eron's Pro Soccer

dos:286bf50e56d27fb4.description: A maze-like arena where laser tanks fight. Destroy all the opponents that spawn to finish each level, shooting through thin walls.
dos:286bf50e56d27fb4.title: Robot Tank

dos:286dc21b439b0822.description: A Bomberman clone made in 1997 by Kurt W. Dekker (PLBM Games). Destroy the other player or enemies and the blocks in the way, collecting helpful items.
dos:286dc21b439b0822.title: Nitro!

dos:28758ee829338ba1.description: A mouse-only Klondike Solitaire. Click cards to move them onto each other in alternate suits to clear the tableau. Cheating is allowed, but the program will yell at you.
dos:28758ee829338ba1.title: Klondike Solitaire

dos:287de469313495cc.description: An adventure with optional graphics and a verb-noun interface. Princess Sabrina has vanished and King John the Good asks travellers to find her, so you begin in the dark forests of Transylvania.
dos:287de469313495cc.title: Transylvania

dos:287f7f7c50146a3d.description: Pirate Fry needs a pirating license and must pass three tests: kill someone, steal something valuable and redeem himself. He is sent to Volcano Island to fulfill his triple objective.
dos:287f7f7c50146a3d.title: Pirate Fry and Volcano Island

dos:288329889b5b8cf8.description: An interactive board game in which Asterix and friends travel the Roman Empire on a challenge from Caesar, learning about countries' history and culture. Play as Asterix, Obelix, Impedimenta and others.
dos:288329889b5b8cf8.title: Astérix: Caesar's Challenge

dos:28a6514083e25150.description: Two games in one for children: a platformer for 1 or 2 players and a pair-matching game, starring Sooty and Sweep.
dos:28a6514083e25150.title: Sooty & Sweep

dos:28a9bfb0a891bfa1.description: A nonlinear police investigation in 2D graphics, sequel to Mortville Manor. A cyclone puts detective Jerome Lange's ship in at Maupiti Island, where more trouble starts.
dos:28a9bfb0a891bfa1.title: Maupiti Island

dos:28c0b287da48f4fa.description: A strategy game in the distant solar system Dominium, settled from Earth, where wars ended with a Galactic Charter and military forces were reduced.
dos:28c0b287da48f4fa.title: Dominium

dos:28c13b7d174a5984.description: A rugby league game with set tackles instead of rucks and mauls, viewed from an isometric perspective.
dos:28c13b7d174a5984.title: International Rugby League

dos:28c181aaba33a645.description: The second Redcat game, in which Princess Dana has been kidnapped and Redcat must fight through seven levels, killing a lot of mice, to rescue her.
dos:28c181aaba33a645.title: RedCat 2: De Ontvoering van Prinses Dana

dos:28eb2986b223f419.description: Sequel to Dangerous Dave: a side-scrolling action game in which you run through a huge mansion of many levels, battling monsters and collecting items, with extra lives at score milestones.
dos:28eb2986b223f419.title: Dangerous Dave in the Haunted Mansion

dos:28ebdf13555b68b7.description: Eight-year-old genius Billy Blaze, Commander Keen, flies to Mars in a rocket built from household objects, until the alien Vorticons steal vital parts and hide them in the Martian cities.
dos:28ebdf13555b68b7.title: Commander Keen 1: Marooned on Mars

dos:28eed1bb0c557274.description: A Psygnosis puzzle game like Lemmings but with a smaller number of caterpillar-like creepers to guide to their goal, in a Christmas edition.
dos:28eed1bb0c557274.title: Creepers Christmas

dos:28f293af97d0f9eb.description: As Grand Vizier Iznogoud, whose only aim is to depose the Caliph of Baghdad and take his place, face many challenges and enemies in a colorful platform environment.
dos:28f293af97d0f9eb.title: Saban's Iznogoud

dos:28fe256c05577bed.description: People are vanishing in the city of Waterdeep, so descend into Undermountain, a Forgotten Realms labyrinth built on the Descent engine, to find eight pieces of an amulet.
dos:28fe256c05577bed.title: Descent to Undermountain
