dos:28ff1bcbc66ec6bc.description: Drive a bike up a ramp and jump over a series of yellow school buses. Keep your speed matched to the number of buses to land on the down-ramp without crashing; you have three lives.
dos:28ff1bcbc66ec6bc.title: Stunt Jumper

dos:2908ff48dd866522.description: A re-release of the 1996 World War I air combat sim Flying Corps with the Fokker D-VII, a new campaign, a mission editor, Direct3D and 3DFX support and multiplayer.
dos:2908ff48dd866522.title: Flying Corps: Gold

dos:291301920a472743.description: A fighting game with a variety of characters from China's Three Kingdoms era, 220 to 280 AD.
dos:291301920a472743.title: Stormy World: The Three Kingdoms

dos:2913f8402ff195b5.description: The classic sliding puzzle: 15 numbered tiles in a 4x4 square with one missing, which you arrange in order by sliding tiles into the empty spot while the game counts your moves.
dos:2913f8402ff195b5.title: Fifteen Puzzle

dos:291e5f566af04e5c.description: In 2197 the Voyager 2 probe reappears in Earth orbit with a passenger with dark intentions, and retired starfighter pilot James Egg is the key to stopping the attack. A plot-driven public domain game.
dos:291e5f566af04e5c.title: StarFight III: Within the Darkness

dos:291f03d9e72899f8.description: A bridge game with a built-in tutorial mode in which Omar Sharif guides novices through the rules, with sample hands showing the best bids and plays, while experienced players can start right away.
dos:291f03d9e72899f8.title: Omar Sharif on Bridge

dos:291fde4af80fbed9.description: The original space strategy game: name your civilization and those of up to three AI opponents and set out to dominate the galaxy by mining, building and conquest.
dos:291fde4af80fbed9.title: Reach for the Stars: The Conquest of the Galaxy

dos:2928c811b19f6fbc.description: You are due to take your girlfriend to the Live Aid concert, but thieves have dismantled your motorcycle. Find and reassemble all the parts by 7:30 pm or she will go with the loathsome John.
dos:2928c811b19f6fbc.title: Sidewalk

dos:2929ebde762e0ad9.description: A puzzle in which the screen is divided into two fields of cells: the right side shows an image that you must lay out from tiles in the left.
dos:2929ebde762e0ad9.title: Astatin

dos:292c09e4bf74877d.description: A Gals Panic spinoff in the Qix style: claim sections of the playfield to reveal photographic images.
dos:292c09e4bf74877d.title: Gal Pani II

dos:2932ae28f0a83845.description: An unofficial VGA remake of the arcade Mario Bros.: flip the turtles that come out of the two pipes by hitting them from beneath, not jumping on them. Two players cooperatively.
dos:2932ae28f0a83845.title: Mario Brothers VGA

dos:29462b3cad7dc7d3.description: An early learning collection of 6 games for ages 3-8: Draw, Scribble, Names, Sequence, Letters and Match, building reading and counting skills and keyboard familiarity.
dos:29462b3cad7dc7d3.title: KinderComp

dos:294a94cb5c0ae188.description: A German Formula 1 team management simulation by Ascaron, with the 1995 teams and drivers licensed. Run an existing team like Ferrari or Williams or build your own.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Racing & Driving
dos:294a94cb5c0ae188.title: Team F1

dos:2953143102f43bf5.description: A series of Sokoban-style puzzles in which you push crates onto their target squares, with a photographic gallery gradually unlocked as stages are completed.
dos:2953143102f43bf5.title: Soko-S♥x

dos:295445241c17c3eb.description: Based on the Tom Clancy movie. As CIA officer Jack Ryan, find out whether the Red October, Russia's top-secret nuclear missile submarine heading west, is trying to defect, and prevent a deadly war.
dos:295445241c17c3eb.title: The Hunt for Red October (1990)

dos:2954cb6daa0ec97b.description: A baseball game of strategy and statistics. Manage pinch hitters, infield positions, relief pitchers and base runners, with 28 major league teams and the ability to enter data for new ones.
dos:2954cb6daa0ec97b.title: Computer Baseball

dos:2954d2e07c247203.description: Your colony is under attack by a marauding cross-shaped alien vessel that wants the colony's food stores. Defend them with a single ship.
dos:2954d2e07c247203.title: Star Ship Attack

dos:29808ab150989e27.description: A naval simulation in which you command the Ocean Ranger, a frigate-sized foilborne missile ship, tracking and destroying targets on the surface, beneath the sea and in the air in four locations.
dos:29808ab150989e27.title: Ocean Ranger

dos:2996858058866c50.description: A top-down arcade game in which you play a pursued spy driving a vehicle, such as a boat or car, armed with a revolver, in locations like a river or city street.
dos:2996858058866c50.title: .386 Spys

dos:299a0b63a15e5556.description: A one-on-one fighting game whose five fighters are objects: Ace High the playing card, Slammer the door, Ringo the phone, Jumpy the spring and Tock the clock, each with a special attack.
dos:299a0b63a15e5556.title: Battling Butlers

dos:299c4814cdb9dd24.description: A Towers of Hanoi variant: help a stack of monkeys retrieve two apples from a tree, moving one at a time and never placing a larger monkey on a smaller one.
dos:299c4814cdb9dd24.title: Monkey Business

dos:29a285da0c0002e6.description: A coin-op conversion: you are a hero raised from the dead by Zeus to rescue his daughter Athena, fighting undead and demons through Ancient Greek scenery to the god Neff. The title refers to your shapeshifting.
dos:29a285da0c0002e6.title: Altered Beast

dos:29a33ed9f6f4cab8.description: A pinball game with four different tables.
dos:29a33ed9f6f4cab8.title: Pinball 4000

dos:29acab8dbb21d3f5.description: A chess game that adds an animated battle between pieces for each capture, in a futuristic science-fiction setting, with pieces animated from clay models.
dos:29acab8dbb21d3f5.title: Battle Chess 4000

dos:29af44566c709bd3.description: Fly the RAF Harrier GR7 or US Marine Corps AV-8B, with vertical take-off, hovering and reversing, in three imagined flash-point areas of future conflict.
dos:29af44566c709bd3.title: Harrier Jump Jet

dos:29c50547ca7509fd.description: A 3D space combat simulator with many missions and smooth polygon-fill graphics.
dos:29c50547ca7509fd.title: Star Crusader

dos:29c6512ecd95ce31.description: Fly a Sopwith biplane, shooting down enemy planes and destroying enemy buildings, alone or against the computer. The only officially released version adds a novice mode, damaged but flyable planes and screen damage.
dos:29c6512ecd95ce31.title: Sopwith: The Author's Edition

dos:29d09c62997822d8.description: You are attacked by arrows from four directions: aim your sword at the attacking arrows and shoot them before they hit you.
dos:29d09c62997822d8.title: Fiery Darts

dos:29d21e7f4387d3ac.description: A puzzle strategy game set in ancient Egypt, in which you are a high priest saving unfortunate people from evil forces in a pyramid.
dos:29d21e7f4387d3ac.title: Hieroglyph

dos:29d50a73a6c72b98.description: A puzzle game of creating wacky machines. Each level has a machine designed for a task but with parts missing, and you place the parts so it works, using cats, mice and other machine parts.
dos:29d50a73a6c72b98.title: The Incredible Machine 2

dos:29d56b8a95d214a6.description: A game of obscure words for one or more players: type FICT at the DOS prompt, enter the number of players and names, then guess definitions.
dos:29d56b8a95d214a6.title: Fictionary (1992)

dos:29d6cffbfaec6b48.description: A simple economy game about building factories and maintaining product quality. You lose if you run out of money or your product quality falls to 0.
dos:29d6cffbfaec6b48.title: Economitopia

dos:29d8a7d7542f60b1.description: A turn-based wargame with eight airborne operations at the tactical level, from the scattered landings at Crete to the bridges of Arnhem. The only game in a proposed series.
dos:29d8a7d7542f60b1.title: The Pure Wargame

dos:29e172da2098d7b7.description: A baseball management application full of stats: manage your own team through the season, make trades and add players through the yearly draft, aiming for the World Championship.
dos:29e172da2098d7b7.title: Out of the Park

dos:29ebfde2e49c6fa8.description: A 16-line BASIC program from PC Magazine: move a paddle along the bottom to deflect a ball off the walls, and the game ends when you lose all ten balls.
dos:29ebfde2e49c6fa8.title: PChallenge

dos:29fa9bea9c850977.description: A Snake variation in which the python devours rabbits hopping around the field, and a mongoose hunts you from time to time. You can hide in a hole.
dos:29fa9bea9c850977.title: Python

dos:2a1da63a797b5edd.description: A tennis game, precursor to Tie Break Tennis, with imitation of real players, eye-catching graphics and digitized voices.
dos:2a1da63a797b5edd.title: Virtual Tennis

dos:2a1f4a1f2468b18b.description: An improved edition of Clonk that remembers each player's data and statistics over time, and lets you play randomly generated rounds instead of predefined ones.
dos:2a1f4a1f2468b18b.title: Clonk A.P.E.

dos:2a22240ba2120a2a.description: A freeware side-scrolling platformer in which the Hunchback races through levels to rescue his beloved Esmeralda, dodging fireballs, flaming pits and angry birds.
dos:2a22240ba2120a2a.title: Hunchback 96

dos:2a277d20d49b3257.description: Infogrames's Lovecraft-inspired adventure in the Alone in the Dark line. As Lt. Ryan aboard the submarine H.M.S. Victoria, you go on a rescue mission to the Antarctic and pick up two mysterious crates.
dos:2a277d20d49b3257.title: Prisoner of Ice

dos:2a29ef09707d3426.description: A shareware space strategy game: destroy your enemies' starbases by mining stars, building warships and scouting, with three weapon types of differing damage, accuracy and range.
dos:2a29ef09707d3426.title: Stellar Conquest 3: Hostile Takeover

dos:2a2a60eca82c3cb8.description: A Korean arcade space shooter based on an anime of the same name, a simplistic Wing Commander with menus half in English and half in Korean.
dos:2a2a60eca82c3cb8.title: Armageddon: Hondon Sog-Euro

dos:2a2b76dc2bd0ad47.description: Design and manage your own customized hockey league, or create current or classic leagues from the past.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Hockey
dos:2a2b76dc2bd0ad47.title: Hockey League Simulator

dos:2a33504a96cb555b.description: A BASIC text adventure from the early 1980s in which you search for Dr. Livingston across Africa, with a minimalist plot and sparse descriptions.
dos:2a33504a96cb555b.title: African Adventure Or In Search of Dr. Livingston

dos:2a374d1f45c194b0.description: A beat-'em-up in which you fight as Red Beard or One Eye through pirate-themed levels such as ships and forts, battling ninjas and skeletons to get your money back from an evil wizard. A friend can play the other pirate.
dos:2a374d1f45c194b0.title: Skull & Crossbones

dos:2a3fe14ceb0d735a.description: A simulation of the Indianapolis 500 using 3D polygon graphics for the 33 cars. Choose and customize your car.
dos:2a3fe14ceb0d735a.title: Indianapolis 500: The Simulation

dos:2a3fff4feb76fb4f.description: A one or two-player Breakout clone set in the 25th century, when mankind faces savage wars over dwindling resources to feed 40 billion people.
dos:2a3fff4feb76fb4f.title: Powball

dos:2a445a6969df9814.description: A hybrid real-time and turn-based wargame set in WWII France. Create a character and play one of 12 scenarios from either side, with promotions or demotions changing the units you command.
dos:2a445a6969df9814.title: Iron Cross

dos:2a558c4ce4d1cc39.description: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up in which a stick figure fights creatures that look like MS Paint drawings.
dos:2a558c4ce4d1cc39.title: Endless Horror

dos:2a5cb0409de60a47.description: In the near future the world is divided among 5 power nations. Use tactics, spying and diplomacy to conquer the world, with the smaller powers falling under your control.
dos:2a5cb0409de60a47.title: Global Domination

dos:2a62ee50f7032d7c.description: A very realistic space shuttle simulator that comes with a thick manual and a large sheet of the cockpit instruments, which you must learn to fly the missions.
dos:2a62ee50f7032d7c.title: Shuttle: The Space Flight Simulator

dos:2a78b2094c2480fd.description: An educational game for children 4-8 to improve reading skills, with several activities for letter recognition, including Fantastic Flying Letters, in which Bouncy Bee introduces each letter with a picture word.
dos:2a78b2094c2480fd.title: Bouncy Bee Learns Letters

dos:2a7aef4ae92342a8.description: A horse racing simulation with a realistic wagering system and live odds, a 1000-horse stable and a horse editor, a simplified racing form and photos at the finish. Includes a casino mode.
dos:2a7aef4ae92342a8.title: Cyber Pony

dos:2a8f8d97da81209c.description: A football manager in which you take a team from the lowest division of English football, choosing from the weak ones at first, and work up to the first division and the Cup.
dos:2a8f8d97da81209c.title: Club Football: The Manager

dos:2a91f56c5c2ee04d.description: An action game in which you play Erik the viking, sent by the gods to collect three objects that will make him king: the parchment of wisdom, the Caesar laurels and the trophy of war.
dos:2a91f56c5c2ee04d.title: Drakkar

dos:2aa19c19badc6450.description: Often called the progenitor of 90s first-person shooters, a surreal wireframe 3D Pac-Man clone: move through a maze collecting points and items that let you kill the ghosts.
dos:2aa19c19badc6450.title: 3-Demon

dos:2ab48b82b0a9545b.description: A fantasy-horror pinball game from China, like Dragon's Fury. An evil wizard has defeated and trapped two good ones. Controlled with the two Shift keys and Enter to launch, with a bonus stage inside the dragon.
dos:2ab48b82b0a9545b.title: Tsumera

dos:2abe56558e51d32d.description: Writer Adrienne Delaney moves into an old mansion with her photographer husband Donald, and starts having horrifying nightmares while the house changes her husband for the worse.
dos:2abe56558e51d32d.title: Phantasmagoria

dos:2ac322ed8d4a17fa.description: Based on the Three Kingdoms era of 3rd-century China and Luo Guanzhong's novel: take command of one of the warlords rivaling for control after the Yellow Turban Rebellion, among hundreds of historical characters.
dos:2ac322ed8d4a17fa.title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms

dos:2ac9d9797965bb1c.description: A remake of the second Miner Willy adventure. After a wild party at his mansion, Willy must restore order to a house in complete disorder.
dos:2ac9d9797965bb1c.title: Jet Set Willy II: The Final Frontier

dos:2ada2acff17d8da4.description: Third in SSI's Steel Panthers series of hex-based tank warfare, with larger battlefields, bigger unit command structures and improved leaders and command interface, covering 1939-1999.
dos:2ada2acff17d8da4.title: Steel Panthers III: Brigade Command - 1939-1999

dos:2addf52431b73f2f.description: Sequel to The Bard's Tale. After Mangar the Dark is defeated, the evil Archmage Lagoth Zanta splits the Destiny Wand into seven pieces and scatters them over the land.
dos:2addf52431b73f2f.title: The Bard's Tale II: The Destiny Knight

dos:2ae701dbadbf4c27.description: A full-motion video fighting game set in ancient China. You protect half of a magical mask whose wearer gains untold power, while the villain Wang Tu holds the other half and wants yours.
dos:2ae701dbadbf4c27.title: Supreme Warrior

dos:2ae78e4f71dc331e.description: A shareware drag racing game, controlled by mouse or keyboard, in which the objective is the fastest possible time in a drag race.
dos:2ae78e4f71dc331e.title: Dragcity U.S.A.

dos:2afa8e8425f3a9e6.description: Third in the HardBall baseball series, with 256-color VGA graphics and Al Michaels providing running commentary.
dos:2afa8e8425f3a9e6.title: HardBall III

dos:2afb2aff2bb12a90.description: An interactive fiction piece made of a single move, answering the criticism of puzzle games that make you guess the designer's mind.
dos:2afb2aff2bb12a90.title: Aisle

dos:2afe4909f447615e.description: A shooter with strategic elements: pay off debts to the corporation Peace by finding three precious crystals on the planet Cursed Earth, outfitting your team with the funds available.
dos:2afe4909f447615e.title: Przekleta Ziemia

dos:2b09700290aa583b.description: A 1986 Sesame Street game starring Rubber Duckie, who must make his way to Ernie's bathtub through a series of connections, teaching basic logic, directions and sequencing.
dos:2b09700290aa583b.title: Ernie's Big Splash

dos:2b20218b9bcfa0d5.description: A two-player version of EcoMaster, an ecology simulation in which you predict how animals will survive in different environments or biomes.
dos:2b20218b9bcfa0d5.title: EGA EcoMaster

dos:2b216fc3cb950761.description: A Spacewar!-style duel against a human or the computer: two triangular spacecraft fight to the death in an arena, using rotation and thrust.
dos:2b216fc3cb950761.title: Rocket Rangers

dos:2b254f63a8dbf204.description: A text adventure in the World of Wimsey: the village of Lostwithiel is cursed by Nirvana the Ice Maiden, who bewitches one young man every month. Find the crystal bell that can break the curse.
dos:2b254f63a8dbf204.title: Nirvana

dos:2b3009ad7f3059ac.description: A puzzle in which you navigate a glove through rooms blocked by chess pieces on a checkered floor, like Sokoban but with opposition, opening a path to the exit while avoiding being blocked.
dos:2b3009ad7f3059ac.title: Chess Housers (1990)

dos:2b36321dd92a944a.description: A NovaLogic simulation of the F-22 that emphasizes action and graphics over realism, with campaigns, a quick mission mode and multiplayer.
dos:2b36321dd92a944a.title: F-22 Lightning II

dos:2b3c98c9000d5bb0.description: An educational game to teach graphing skills to children 4-10, in which the creature Bumble guides you through six games.
dos:2b3c98c9000d5bb0.title: Bumble Games

dos:2b4312d9f4e7b60a.description: A model railroad simulation: sketch your own track plan, add terrain, buildings and rivers, then place customizable trains and change switches.
dos:2b4312d9f4e7b60a.title: Design Your Own Railroad

dos:2b57697280affe6d.description: A political simulation in which you are the US President, in your first term, meeting the challenges of politics and economy and aiming to be re-elected.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation / Political; Strategy
dos:2b57697280affe6d.title: President's Choice

dos:2b611a3841ece097.description: A winter-themed edition of the Around the World platform game, with snow replacing the original scenery.
dos:2b611a3841ece097.title: Around the World: Christmas

dos:2b75cb9b8d87ee69.description: An open source roguelike originally by Linley Henzell, now maintained by the Crawl DevTeam. Choose a race and class for your character and set it loose in a dungeon.
dos:2b75cb9b8d87ee69.title: Linley Henzell's Dungeon Crawl

dos:2b8937eac8aa6cf1.description: A geography game in which you travel by train to US cities in search of the FuzzBomb, which turns ordinary people into FuzzBodies. Plant crystals and build up 100 to touch the bomb.
dos:2b8937eac8aa6cf1.title: Agent USA

dos:2b9b2064b43369a1.description: Space Invaders in ASCII characters, written in Pascal, with a few added features.
dos:2b9b2064b43369a1.title: ASCII Invaders

dos:2b9ec0ec6d16e48e.description: A desktop planetary program from Broderbund, more of an application than an edutainment game, for exploring space.
dos:2b9ec0ec6d16e48e.title: Discover Space

dos:2bacb8fe62875f19.description: A cricket game using Ian Botham's name and one-day cricket rules of 1991, with two teams of eleven players.
dos:2bacb8fe62875f19.title: Ian Botham's Cricket

dos:2baf33ef06b42184.description: A one-on-one fighting game in which ten contestants compete in a tournament for the title of Universe Hero, at the end of the 21st century as the galaxy settles after interstellar wars.
dos:2baf33ef06b42184.title: Violent Vengeance: The Universe Hero

dos:2bb1090e2132c3f5.description: The second promotional game distributed with Israeli Tzabar Salads: a Memory (Concentration) variant in which you uncover pairs of cards with identical pictures, alone or against another player.
dos:2bb1090e2132c3f5.title: Koach Tzabar 2

dos:2bb6a52b63cd80e5.description: Lucasfilm's graphic adventure in which teenager Dave Miller ventures into a mansion to rescue his girlfriend from an evil mad scientist.
dos:2bb6a52b63cd80e5.title: Maniac Mansion

dos:2bc0a3fe3bf562dd.description: A platform game starring Asterix and Obelix, playable by one player choosing either or by two simultaneously, collecting artifacts across Europe in 50 BC, with bonus levels like a rugby match.
dos:2bc0a3fe3bf562dd.title: Asterix & Obelix

dos:2bc2eb9708e1ec41.description: A Breakout clone for monochrome displays: dismantle a wall of bricks with a ball deflected by your paddle, starting with five balls.
dos:2bc2eb9708e1ec41.title: Smashout

dos:2bc423de8c0734de.description: An odd, surreal puzzle of screens activated by numeric keys, each representing a control panel from an alien space ship, with bleeps and flashing lights.
dos:2bc423de8c0734de.title: Tommy's Space Panels

dos:2bc431244b5fb70e.description: All TV satellite dishes have been stolen by crazed Schnozes, and astronauts sent to the Moon have been captured. Secret agent Skunny Hardnut is sent to rescue them and retrieve the dishes.
dos:2bc431244b5fb70e.title: Skunny: Lost in Space

dos:2bdc5f14b31c2216.description: A game for 1-4 players where you crack mystery words from 12 categories, played much like Wheel of Fortune.
dos:2bdc5f14b31c2216.title: Mind Dance Vol. II

dos:2be95e0abae10e00.description: College student Hiroaki Hanya investigates the unusual good fortune shaping his relationships. Advance the illustrated story with commands for looking, talking, thinking and moving between locations.
dos:2be95e0abae10e00.title: Runaway City

dos:2befeff25ffb9b9f.description: First of SSI's four Great Naval Battles simulators, with both expansion packs. Command the British or German navy in WWII's North Atlantic in a full campaign, mini campaigns or individual battles.
dos:2befeff25ffb9b9f.title: Great Naval Battles I: North Atlantic 1939-43

dos:2bf68c431490ceca.description: A soccer game built around the 1990 World Cup in Italy. Pick a team and try to win the championship, controlling the player with the ball or nearest to it in a third-person side-scrolling view.
dos:2bf68c431490ceca.title: Italy '90 Soccer

dos:2bfaf040f69cb135.description: An ASCII video poker game with 5 casinos that differ in the number of winning combinations and payout multipliers, and many settings to make the game harder or easier.
dos:2bfaf040f69cb135.title: Masque Video Poker

dos:2bfeedb41f62469e.description: An educational tool for children ages 4 to 14 with multi-level modules for Math, Music, English, Alphabet, Art and Time, and an exam generator.
dos:2bfeedb41f62469e.title: School-Mom

dos:2c0ae5ba3d5a3b0a.description: Steer a worm, avoiding hitting yourself or any red square. Collect green squares for bonus lives and survive as long as possible.
dos:2c0ae5ba3d5a3b0a.title: Action Worm

dos:2c104ea6902b7e08.description: A slightly isometric top-down tennis game for two players, computer or human, on grass, dirt or clay at three difficulty settings. Create a character and save its stats.
dos:2c104ea6902b7e08.title: Center Court Tennis

dos:2c2458c769132359.description: A top-down space shooter that scrolls at different speeds in any direction, as you wish, over the surface of a ruined, devastated planet.
dos:2c2458c769132359.title: Battlestorm

dos:2c2c93726b92543f.description: A building is on fire and babies are jumping from it. As a two-man fire fighter team, use a stretcher to bounce them safely into the ambulance, with only three keys.
dos:2c2c93726b92543f.title: Bouncing Babies

dos:2c34647eef27e790.description: A puzzle platformer in which a jovial stick figure prospects for diamonds across 22 ANSI-styled levels, each a puzzle of its own. Shares its idea with a Game Boy title of the same name.
dos:2c34647eef27e790.title: Pitman

dos:2c36fc94ca3f97d7.description: A conversion of Quake. The mutant Apocalypse has created an army of evil X-Men clones, and you are a cyborg created by Magneto who can morph your arms into a variety of weapons.
dos:2c36fc94ca3f97d7.title: X-Men: The Ravages of Apocalypse

dos:2c38649feb83802b.description: An educational title in which you explore the inner body of a frog, either dissecting it to remove organs or reconstructing it.
dos:2c38649feb83802b.title: Operation: Frog

dos:2c38abed1f789181.description: A BBS version of Hangman where users solve puzzles and create new ones for the next user to log in.
dos:2c38abed1f789181.title: Tele-Hang

dos:2c3fa2c7f698538b.description: A near-carbon copy of Frogger with updated graphics and sound.
dos:2c3fa2c7f698538b.title: Toad

dos:2c42128fd133ef49.description: An arcade puzzle game in which you catch all the bugs riding a 5x5 grid on each level, with more bugs than traps as the levels progress.
dos:2c42128fd133ef49.title: Catcher

dos:2c4d8c5803487819.description: Your favorite uncle has died and left you a painting of a beautiful woman, Parrish's Earthly Delight, and a note. A text adventure.
dos:2c4d8c5803487819.title: Earthly Delights

dos:2c531e7170bc30f7.description: Follow-up to X-COM: Enemy Unknown. In 2040, forty years after the aliens were defeated, they return, this time from the depths of the oceans, in a resource management and tactical combat game.
dos:2c531e7170bc30f7.title: X-COM: Terror from the Deep

dos:2c61a1d035621603.description: An Asteroids clone seen from behind your ship, in which you are surrounded by dangerous space rocks.
dos:2c61a1d035621603.title: 3D Baller

dos:2c66bebfd52e6699.description: A trilogy of first-person shooters by Thom Campana of Campana Productions, made with the 3D Game Creation System and based on a childhood dream of making computer games.
dos:2c66bebfd52e6699.title: Colosso Adventure Series

dos:2c6c99c79ead97b9.description: As Keef the Thief, a promising young thief on the outskirts of the merchant city of Mercon, avoid the penalty for thievery, the removal of body parts, while training to steal from the city treasury.
dos:2c6c99c79ead97b9.title: Keef the Thief: A Boy and His Lockpick

dos:2c6fea8154331d57.description: A counting game with the Berenstain Bears.
dos:2c6fea8154331d57.title: The Berenstain Bears: Learn to Count

dos:2c74e25d1412b54a.description: A collection of three treasure-hunting text adventures, including Perils of Darkest Africa, in which you look for jewels from King Solomon's mines.
dos:2c74e25d1412b54a.title: Tales of Treasure

dos:2c7a29e91e1ea132.description: A near exact clone of Taito's Puzznic: move pieces horizontally so that identical ones touch and disappear, before time runs out.
dos:2c7a29e91e1ea132.title: Brix (1993)

dos:2c8dbaf48f1bd3c0.description: A detailed sailing yacht simulator of the America's Cup race between Australia II and Liberty. Against the computer you control only Australia II; against a human, both ships are available.
dos:2c8dbaf48f1bd3c0.title: America's Cup Yacht Racing Simulator

dos:2c919941e7b0f8d7.description: A beat-'em-up set in 2002, when incurable diseases and rising crime have pushed society to the verge of collapse and cybernetic organisms have been produced to function like humans.
dos:2c919941e7b0f8d7.title: Zyclunt

dos:2c9559d638b17f7b.description: A text-based adventure for DOS based on the James Bond film A View to a Kill, developed by Angelsoft and published by Mindscape.
dos:2c9559d638b17f7b.title: James Bond 007: A View to a Kill

dos:2c9ba1d07a6cc09b.description: An adaptation of the Russian version of the card game Fan Tan for three players, one human and two computer, with a 36-card deck, starting with the Nine of Diamonds.
dos:2c9ba1d07a6cc09b.title: Nine

dos:2c9c4b1218ed92ce.description: The first game titled PC Fútbol, later called PC Fútbol 2.0, a football game with management and match play, following Simulador Profesional de Fútbol.
dos:2c9c4b1218ed92ce.title: PC Futbol

dos:2c9cb80dbb0a718e.description: A fully animated horse racing simulation for one to six players: choose from a stable of over 200 horses, bet on one to win, place or show, and cheer it on.
dos:2c9cb80dbb0a718e.title: Race the Nags

dos:2ca412c772961607.description: A side-scrolling platformer in which a heroine, told by an elder that she is the chosen one, tries to save a planet from an evil creature freed from its petrified state.
dos:2ca412c772961607.title: Entity

dos:2caa71de0da22890.description: A TV trivia game for 1-6 players or teams: guess a TV actor's name from a clue of initial letters plus the name of a show, such as FATHER GHOUL - THE MUNSTERS.
dos:2caa71de0da22890.title: Tommy's Telewords

dos:2cad4f29eed9e880.description: Sequel to Star Fleet I. You are accepted as an Altern in the Krellan Empire and build a military career as a Krellan commander on missions against the United Galactic Alliance.
dos:2cad4f29eed9e880.title: Star Fleet II: Krellan Commander

dos:2cb0fc262598bc08.description: A multimedia interactive adventure in anatomy: explore the body to learn where the coccyx is, why certain muscles are important and when twins are formed.
dos:2cb0fc262598bc08.title: Bodyworks 3.0

dos:2cbf4c9f18b2cde9.description: Run, fly and dodge obstacles while returning fire on wave after wave of attacking aliens with a really big gun. A third-person arcade shooter with end-of-level bosses.
dos:2cbf4c9f18b2cde9.title: Space Harrier

dos:2ce506d8fd29cb83.description: A virtual shooting gallery of dinosaurs: each stage sets how many of a type to shoot, points to collect and a time limit, with enemies sometimes descending on parachutes.
dos:2ce506d8fd29cb83.title: Time Hunters

dos:2ceaddf8d75908df.description: A simple shooter in which a city faces never-ending alien saucers, and with a single gun you must lead each target based on its altitude and velocity.
dos:2ceaddf8d75908df.title: UFO (1982)

dos:2ceb214ffd638b5f.description: A strategy game set after Earth's biosphere collapsed, leaving only androids built for the last war, which collect resources and build and send robots to fight.
dos:2ceb214ffd638b5f.title: Final Frontier

dos:2cede3e03bb4e16d.description: A tennis simulation with a top-down scrolling view: you don't control the player's motion, but choose the shot once he gets near the ball, including topspin, lobs and stop volleys.
dos:2cede3e03bb4e16d.title: Tie Break

dos:2cfa87dacba77079.description: A murder mystery: personalize your character and enter a party where everyone is a suspect. You have about two hours to solve the case and make an arrest.
dos:2cfa87dacba77079.title: Murder!

dos:2cfd3866800b7c4c.description: A shareware blackjack for one to four players with a tutor mode in which you pick one of four preset strategies and watch the game play automatically, or customize your own.
dos:2cfd3866800b7c4c.title: Ultimate Blackjack

dos:2cfe2d52df704d4b.description: A very basic chess game: play against the AI, another person, or have the computer play itself.
dos:2cfe2d52df704d4b.title: Ed Chess

dos:2d01064a0aa19940.description: A magical typing tutor for kids: learn letters with words, play musical notes with the keyboard and learn proper finger placement.
dos:2d01064a0aa19940.title: Davidson's Kid Keys

dos:2d0272344b41b2c2.description: A real-time puzzle game in which you steer a friendly spotted ball with the cursor keys through a labyrinth, gaining speed as it goes and losing energy when it collides.
dos:2d0272344b41b2c2.title: Rock 'n Roll

dos:2d132efc9b61b5da.description: A top-down puzzle game: on each level, use gears of 3 sizes to link all the pegs on a grid, starting from red cogs on the screen.
dos:2d132efc9b61b5da.title: Gear Works

dos:2d30c91e63b57c10.description: A text-parser adventure with moving on-screen actors. As Les Manley, a tech specialist, win the Search for Elvis contest and the heart of the girl of your dreams.
dos:2d30c91e63b57c10.title: Les Manley In: Search For The King

dos:2d3761cdd56ac8d9.description: Play an ancient Roman gladiator in an almost fighting game, in an amphitheater against people and lions.
dos:2d3761cdd56ac8d9.title: Gladiator (1992)

dos:2d54b2865896e5ba.description: A generation after the Staff of Gnilda and the armor of the Knight of Diamonds were reclaimed, earthquakes and tidal waves ravage Llylgamyn, and the Sages believe the Orb of scrying is its salvation.
dos:2d54b2865896e5ba.title: Wizardry III: Legacy of Llylgamyn

dos:2d5e6ccdc66e93f3.description: An early blackjack conversion, based on a Compucolor II version: the computer deals from a standard deck and the hand closest to 21 wins; exceed 21 and you bust.
dos:2d5e6ccdc66e93f3.title: Blackjack (1983)

dos:2d680f5543229992.description: An updated Hunt the Wumpus: explore a 20-room cave with bottomless pits and bats and shoot the wumpus with an arrow. Several new cave options.
dos:2d680f5543229992.title: Wumpus II

dos:2d68cb92a4877833.description: A mix of turn-based county and economic management and real-time combat. The king has died and five nobles, including you, vie for control of the realm.
dos:2d68cb92a4877833.title: Lords of the Realm II

dos:2d6b1f9e9a0fa08c.description: Six card games, Crazy Eights, Old Maid, Hearts, Gin Rummy, Cribbage and Klondike Solitaire, against up to three of 18 computer opponents, including characters from other Sierra games.
dos:2d6b1f9e9a0fa08c.title: Hoyle Official Book of Games: Volume 1

dos:2d728f630b56d576.description: The Lutonian Embassy has been taken over by the Red Legion terrorists and the ambassador's daughter kidnapped. Lead a group of three special agents chosen from nine soldiers to save her within a time limit.
dos:2d728f630b56d576.title: Mayday Squad

dos:2d7358713526a8ef.description: A horror adventure from Horrosoft. After a strange letter from your father, the village pastor, you return home to find him missing and everyone hostile, as evil forces have taken over the villagers.
dos:2d7358713526a8ef.title: ...A Personal Nightmare

dos:2d8622b33281dabb.description: The first part of the Doppy & Pru text adventure trilogy.
dos:2d8622b33281dabb.title: Doppyworld

dos:2d92c51bcdf8360b.description: A multiplayer Snake-like game similar to Cervii: control a continuously growing snake and stay alive as long as possible while the other players do the same.
dos:2d92c51bcdf8360b.title: Achtung, die Kurve!

dos:2d9958117debf92c.description: An early spaceship simulator like EGA Trek but simpler: fly a long voyage, fight Imperial ships, repair and refill at starports, and trade commodities for profit.
dos:2d9958117debf92c.title: Starlord (Keith Cox, 1987)

dos:2da6adfd55374f6f.description: Sequel to Fantasy with eight short interactive scenarios, in which you fill in details that personalize how each story unfolds.
dos:2da6adfd55374f6f.title: Fantasy II

dos:2dafc7c11b0e50b0.description: An unofficial Formula 1 racing game across a 16-circuit season, with practice, single race and full season modes, and options for tires, transmission, laps and difficulty.
dos:2dafc7c11b0e50b0.title: F-1

dos:2db1677a8f4c35fe.description: As an international undercover agent, you have 12 hours to recover stolen blueprints for an invincible missile at the Alpenhof Ski Resort and thwart the plans of VODAC.
dos:2db1677a8f4c35fe.title: The Alpine Encounter

dos:2db8dc6fe7cce3c2.description: The free-form space trading and combat simulation often considered the progenitor of the genre. As Commander Jameson, start at Lave Station with 100 credits and a Cobra Mark III trading ship.
dos:2db8dc6fe7cce3c2.title: Elite

dos:2dba922f60448c2b.description: A simple shooter in the tradition of American Laser Games's Mad Dog McCree, with video backgrounds. As one of the last bounty hunters, shoot foes with a mouse or light gun and protect the innocent.
tags: Action; Interactive Movie; Shooter / Rail shooter
dos:2dba922f60448c2b.title: The Last Bounty Hunter

dos:2dbdaced27091bb7.description: An atmospheric puzzle adventure aboard a giant cylindrical spaceship that has entered the solar system. You replace an astronaut who died on the way to investigate it.
dos:2dbdaced27091bb7.title: Rama

dos:2dcdc0a9c4840c0a.description: Fly an F14-LBC Rapier on missions over Colombia, from destroying drug labs, refineries and convoys to carrier missions against enemy ships and oil supplies.
dos:2dcdc0a9c4840c0a.title: Snow Strike

dos:2dd94f5de16d93d9.description: A freeware IPX network-only tank game: shoot the other tanks without being killed, hiding behind random objects and picking up weapons beyond your wimpy laser.
dos:2dd94f5de16d93d9.title: NetMaze

dos:2de0df6b1796aafb.description: An international ice hockey game: control a leading national team in practice, exhibition or tournament modes, training your team and swapping players.
dos:2de0df6b1796aafb.title: World Hockey '95

dos:2de346558afaea14.description: A text adventure in which you search for the legendary lost Dutchman's gold, starting in a miner's shack with a map and heading through deserts, mountains and ghost towns.
dos:2de346558afaea14.title: Lost Dutchman's Gold

dos:2dedb6bc1fdb1e72.description: A shareware homage to Galaxian: move your ship side to side with the cursor keys and fire with the Space bar for a high score.
dos:2dedb6bc1fdb1e72.title: Galaxi

dos:2df3e775fdff2d14.description: An educational history game about the Spanish exploration of America. As a conquistador exploring southeastern North America, pick regions on a map and collect gold and knowledge.
dos:2df3e775fdff2d14.title: Discovering America

dos:2df7ae15738f750e.description: A Breakout clone from Bulgaria with power-ups and variable speeds.
dos:2df7ae15738f750e.title: Kirpich

dos:2dfecfeea36019f3.description: As Prof. George Jumpalot, explore a large cave of red platforms to find a sacred statue left by the Ginkians, an ancient tribe of headhunters.
dos:2dfecfeea36019f3.title: Caverns of Gink

dos:2e05d77b31d4da67.description: A puzzle of two overlapping rectangles of colored squares in the form of a cross, with four points of contact, to be rearranged.
dos:2e05d77b31d4da67.title: Cross of Insanity

dos:2e0a988925312380.description: A scientific outpost on a far off planet has been attacked, and a team of marines is sent to investigate and destroy the invaders. A shooter for one or two players.
dos:2e0a988925312380.title: Alien Breed: Tower Assault

dos:2e0cd2132ce890e7.description: A combat simulation with Greek triremes in the Peloponnesian War between Athens and Sparta, in which the boats ram and sink each other. Based on the Avalon Hill board game Trireme.
dos:2e0cd2132ce890e7.title: RAM!

dos:2e1ba74409ebad08.description: Lucasfilm's second air combat simulation recreating the Battle of Britain in summer 1940. Fly for the German Luftwaffe or the British RAF in the Spitfire or Hurricane.
dos:2e1ba74409ebad08.title: Their Finest Hour: The Battle of Britain

dos:2e1c13fc8875b983.description: In 2112, as captain of a colonization starship in the Neublinn Galaxy, you are on a mission to colonize nine solar systems when a powerful alien race called the Mancer enters the galaxy.
dos:2e1c13fc8875b983.title: Space Conquest: A Galactic Odyssey

dos:2e328ea2b7667ed4.description: A program for making vector graphics animations with mouse and keyboard: you create frames and the software generates the in-between ones in real time, with a Macintosh-style interface.
dos:2e328ea2b7667ed4.title: Fantavision

dos:2e3cae881508b818.description: A two-player cue sports simulator with five game modes: pool, 8 ball, 9 ball, Bumper Pool and Snooker, with an editor for Bumper Pool.
dos:2e3cae881508b818.title: Rack 'Em

dos:2e41e0e08ebc3b28.description: You are a cop clearing your town of criminals in two parts: a driving-action stage in a red Ferrari, destroying hostile cars, and a side-scrolling action stage with somersaults over gaps and elevators.
dos:2e41e0e08ebc3b28.title: Techno Cop

dos:2e43c6179d2b4295.description: An obscure Russian Doom clone with an engine as complex as Wolfenstein 3D's, with maze-like labyrinths and enemies such as bats, mutants and wizards.
dos:2e43c6179d2b4295.title: Dungeons of Kremlin

dos:2e6721e9b8481b71.description: Six ruthless dictators have created the planet Draconia, full of gruesome life-forms, and you go in your spaceship to destroy them all. A side-scrolling R-Type-influenced shoot-'em-up in six levels.
dos:2e6721e9b8481b71.title: Menace

dos:2e6e4efe0c84a5d5.description: The last of the Dragonlance RPG series on the Gold Box engine. Evil, having failed twice, tries again to conquer Krynn, this time with the Dark Queen herself commanding its forces.
dos:2e6e4efe0c84a5d5.title: The Dark Queen of Krynn

dos:2e87557b9aac9409.description: A remake of the 8-bit game Pongo: push three diamonds together on each plan, with monsters hatching from ordinary stones and hostile creatures that can be crushed.
dos:2e87557b9aac9409.title: R-activ

dos:2e9f1c3f22d0c863.description: An unusual epic interactive fiction in a surreal Lewis Carroll-like setting with an emphasis on word puzzles. You wake in a river bed and must find six objects scattered across ages and landscapes.
dos:2e9f1c3f22d0c863.title: T-Zero

dos:2eb687d362d752ba.description: Mine for gems while avoiding the malfunctioning mine robots.
dos:2eb687d362d752ba.title: Mine Shaft

dos:2eba2c43edc805a1.description: A revised poker edition supporting up to three opponents at once, with new SVGA photographs. Play five-card draw and add opponents with compatible data disks.
dos:2eba2c43edc805a1.title: Str♥p Poker Professional rev. B

dos:2ebc90dbde0a0af1.description: Second in the BAT series, set in the city of ROMA 2 on the planet Shedishan. The United Galaxies Organization asks the Bureau of Astral Troubleshooters to investigate the murder of an agent, Sylvia Hatford.
dos:2ebc90dbde0a0af1.title: B.A.T. 2: The Koshan Conspiracy

dos:2ebf2453c2168cbd.description: Sequel to Gun.Smoke. As Marshall James, sent by Texas to restore order to the corrupt town of Devil Stone, play a side-scrolling run-and-gun in the style of Sunset Riders, then a saloon section.
dos:2ebf2453c2168cbd.title: Desperado 2

dos:2eccff541762ce8c.description: An Arkanoid clone set inside a mechanical system, where the racket is a nut. Bounce the ball to break bricks, though some are indestructible.
dos:2eccff541762ce8c.title: The Brick

dos:2eceedf6bad0f393.description: An educational game in which you play the Pilgrims on the Mayflower: make the voyage across the Atlantic, find a safe harbor, pick a place for the colony and manage its development until it is self-sufficient.
dos:2eceedf6bad0f393.title: Pilgrim Quest

dos:2ed121b3cf8d5393.description: A re-release of Wheel of Fortune with an extra one thousand new puzzles.
dos:2ed121b3cf8d5393.title: Wheel of Fortune: Golden Edition

dos:2edfb657cf45fda7.description: Your wife has been viciously stabbed and you are bent on revenge, but must follow professional police procedure and direct forensic and crime lab investigations in the gritty world of crime.
dos:2edfb657cf45fda7.title: Police Quest 3: The Kindred

dos:2ee3d95b52177efe.description: An officially licensed Lord of the Rings text adventure based on The Two Towers. Play Frodo or Sam, following the book's plot closely, with illustrated locations.
dos:2ee3d95b52177efe.title: The Shadows of Mordor

dos:2ee8a879bcd02dc0.description: By the designer of X-COM: UFO Defense, a tactical game in which you control a group of marine-like soldiers and the occasional cyborg through missions.
dos:2ee8a879bcd02dc0.title: Laser Squad

dos:2ef3f1861c1e7ab7.description: King Graham has been crowned and needs a queen. The magic mirror shows a girl locked in a quartz tower in the faraway land of Kolyma, and he must rescue her. The PCjr edition of King's Quest II.
dos:2ef3f1861c1e7ab7.title: King's Quest II: Romancing the Throne (PCjr)

dos:2f01cfae1cf944fe.description: A PC remake of the 1984 arcade game in which you kill snakes with a whip using the F5 and F6 keys, with a single level and no scorpions.
dos:2f01cfae1cf944fe.title: Snake Pit

dos:2f097ede5377e4d7.description: A game based on the film about the furlings, forest creatures who go into the forest one day.
dos:2f097ede5377e4d7.title: Once Upon a Forest

dos:2f1485635aaefd7a.description: A children's bowling game made for Fisher-Price as a promotion, in which you help the Little People win an exciting competition.
dos:2f1485635aaefd7a.title: Fisher-Price: Little People Bowling Alley

dos:2f28169b03c6e12d.description: The first of MicroProse's Command Series tactical wargames, designed by Sid Meier and Ed Bever, descended from NATO Commander, about the Allied campaign in Europe.
dos:2f28169b03c6e12d.title: Crusade in Europe

dos:2f41bd344b708b62.description: The USA edition of A320 Airbus, a realistic flight simulation covering the US between the West and Northeast coasts with about 240 airports and improved flight physics.
dos:2f41bd344b708b62.title: A320 Airbus: Edition USA

dos:2f41eb17d8713d21.description: Ten numbered-grid challenges with SVGA presentation and spoken commentary: alternate horizontal and vertical moves to collect points, with three difficulty settings, a timer and a hidden-fields mode.
dos:2f41eb17d8713d21.title: Penthouse: Hot Numbers Deluxe

dos:2f4f8fe3b0b57278.description: An adaptation of the 1970s mainframe Star Trek game: as captain of the Enterprise, destroy the Klingon battle force, usually around 17 battle cruisers, within a time limit.
dos:2f4f8fe3b0b57278.title: Super Star Trek (1982)

dos:2f56b88fc303d237.description: A text adventure about finding, entering and winning a Classic Car Show against obstructive family members, odd creatures, criminals such as Big Bubba and the law.
dos:2f56b88fc303d237.title: Fast Lane

dos:2f7152bfa6de7de9.description: A text adventure in which a fun outing in Rylvania turns into a nightmare and you play the star, choosing whether to damn yourself and save others.
dos:2f7152bfa6de7de9.title: The Horror of Rylvania

dos:2f71aabbd060dedd.description: A vertically scrolling racer in no more than 256 bytes of machine code: the car zooms along at constant speed and you steer left and right to avoid the roadsides and other cars.
dos:2f71aabbd060dedd.title: Formula-1 TURBO

dos:2f76e7af40a9db1f.description: An educational alphabet game in which Perry the penguin climbs ladders to pick up letters and drops them onto the right trucks, to build a city.
dos:2f76e7af40a9db1f.title: Alpha Build

dos:2f8075c8e326d6ee.description: You are a shipowner: choose your hometown, buy a used ship, charter freight to its destination, then buy new ships with the profit and keep them repaired.
dos:2f8075c8e326d6ee.title: Ports of Call

dos:2f820d87ff1633f9.description: A dodgeball sports game that parodies Sango Fighter, with teams of three super-deformed players with special powers.
dos:2f820d87ff1633f9.title: Panda Dodgeball (Baoxiao Duobiqiu)

dos:2f844fad0abdbc9a.description: At night you visit the House of Fortunes and Rosemary West offers five predictions: Astrology, Crystal Ball, Numerology, I Ching and Tarot, each room with animations.
dos:2f844fad0abdbc9a.title: Rosemary West's House of Fortunes

dos:2f86a703795d7a1b.description: A whimsical text adventure in which you are an asylum inmate with second thoughts about staying, in a nuthouse full of eccentric characters. Owes much to the TRS-80 classic Bedlam.
dos:2f86a703795d7a1b.title: Gerbil Riot of '67

dos:2f94c5af80bddf7a.description: Aliens have taken over the three moons of your home planet and you must blow them up. Each moon has four levels in different perspectives, beginning with a first-person 3D space flight sim.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Shooter; Vehicle Simulation
dos:2f94c5af80bddf7a.title: Xenocide

dos:2f9ce3593a8d00ef.description: A sci-fi virtual reality adventure. As Newton, son of the missing CYCORP Managing Director Zel Winters, crack your father's VR Interface and find an SOS message.
dos:2f9ce3593a8d00ef.title: NET:Zone

dos:2f9e96ecad61d205.description: A side-scrolling platformer in which a skater tries to save the world's supply of Milo, skating, jumping and grinding through levels collecting tins, with bosses.
dos:2f9e96ecad61d205.title: Milo the Fuel Run

dos:2fa95499b7e2b2a9.description: An alien space vessel has crashed near the Pecos River with a score of hostile survivors. You are deployed near an abandoned settlement across the river to inspect the crash site.
dos:2fa95499b7e2b2a9.title: Alien River

dos:2fb3f45a1490c1a9.description: A computer knowledge quiz in which you build a dream computer.
dos:2fb3f45a1490c1a9.title: Computer-Ease

dos:2fb7bb7f79bd24f4.description: A simple implementation of John Conway's Game of Life: create a pattern manually or randomly and watch it evolve.
dos:2fb7bb7f79bd24f4.title: Life in the Fast Lane

dos:2fc73900b5988ea5.description: Follow-up based on the classic Korean tale of Hong Gildong, a boy persecuted by his family who becomes a noble-hearted bandit. An interactive cartoon movie like Dragon's Lair.
dos:2fc73900b5988ea5.title: Hong Gildong-jeon 2

dos:2fc74955a0adaee9.description: A flight simulator and action game in which you fly an F-14 in single battles or a career, with 256-color graphics.
dos:2fc74955a0adaee9.title: F-14 Tomcat

dos:2fc83855de68e19a.description: A keyboard-controlled Pac-Man style game, released as a freeware beta with thirty-two boards and a board editor.
dos:2fc83855de68e19a.title: Mr. Muncher

dos:2fd42f27239fd6a9.description: A shooter with three characters: Kamchak the lizard or the humans Dan and Eleena, each with a different path. The planet Ioxia supplies the vital element Mazrium, and its dormant alien forces have awoken.
dos:2fd42f27239fd6a9.title: Eradicator

dos:2fd98c5f80c2a47a.description: A flight simulator with three planes, over 100 airports and maps of major US cities, formation flying and a NAV system.
dos:2fd98c5f80c2a47a.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (v3.0)

dos:2ff0bdf4a8c75a5b.description: An evil scientist has turned you into a ball. Roll your way through mazes of monsters, keys, doors, trampolines and wall-dissolving acid to survive.
dos:2ff0bdf4a8c75a5b.title: Rollin

dos:2ff38fb95947ec7e.description: Includes two games written in the EGL arcade-game language: a collection of over 20 different games, and The Rise and Fall of the Human Race, an arcade/graphic adventure of 25 levels.
dos:2ff38fb95947ec7e.title: EGL-Rise

dos:3004c1b078b9045e.description: A falling-block puzzle for one or two players. Line up three or more bricks of the same color in a row, vertically, horizontally or diagonally, to set off explosions and score bonus points.
dos:3004c1b078b9045e.title: Chain Reaction (1996)

dos:300cf02418878b0f.description: A side-scrolling action platformer in which a special agent hunts through a city of mutants for the five pieces of the stolen Golden Eagle, shooting enemies and solving simple puzzles on each level.
dos:300cf02418878b0f.title: Golden Eagle

dos:301787b77d73be81.description: An interactive showcase of exotic cars, letting the viewer look over the interior and exterior of each model along with its price and specifications.
dos:301787b77d73be81.title: Exotic Car Showroom

dos:302871e65e6fe40f.description: A 360-degree scrolling shoot 'em up with gravity and thrust-and-turn flight in the vein of Thrust. Play deathmatch combat or a checkpoint race against other players.
dos:302871e65e6fe40f.title: Roketz

dos:3030230d5aee3c9b.description: An illustrated interactive fiction adaptation of Arthur Conan Doyle's The Lost World, played by typing commands to explore and solve the story.
dos:3030230d5aee3c9b.title: The Lost World

dos:3036f6b34a1338ea.description: Dizzy sets out to lift the spell the wizard Zaks has cast on the Yolkfolk and rescue his kidnapped girlfriend Daisy, collecting and using items through platforming and puzzle-solving.
dos:3036f6b34a1338ea.title: The Fantastic Adventures of Dizzy

dos:3055a6daa73f8577.description: A platform game starring Moe, Larry and Curly, who must collect $5000 to save an orphanage from an evil banker while dodging flying pies.
dos:3055a6daa73f8577.title: The Three Stooges

dos:3058a6501128b345.description: A turn-based naval simulator recreating the fleets, specifications and tactics of the major battles of the First World War. You begin as an Admiral on the bridge of a great flagship.
dos:3058a6501128b345.title: Dreadnoughts

dos:305d11f31d73b688.description: Play a computer hacker, destroying data on other people's machines and bank computers, upgrading your software and hardware, and battling rival hackers.
dos:305d11f31d73b688.title: Computer Underground

dos:305f49d4ecfb9983.description: A single-player simulation of starship combat between vessels from the Star Trek universe, inspired by the board game Star Fleet Battles. You and the computer enter orders such as firing phasers or changing course, then watch the turn play out.
dos:305f49d4ecfb9983.title: Trek73

dos:30679d8e313f85c6.description: A version of the Jeopardy! quiz show with questions written for kids.
dos:30679d8e313f85c6.title: Jeopardy! New Junior Edition

dos:307ce2bfd0aa4289.description: An action game based on the movie Arachnophobia. Clear spider-infested farms, houses and public buildings using the pesticide Toxi-Max.
dos:307ce2bfd0aa4289.title: Arachnophobia

dos:3081c11896a9e829.description: Based on the Robotech animated series, you play a freedom fighter infiltrating Reflex Point, the Invid base on Earth, to defeat the Invid Prince inside.
dos:3081c11896a9e829.title: Reflex Point

dos:309126bfb80c5dae.description: An adventure set in the Old West in which you capture criminals and put them in jail for cash. Your score depends on how much money you make.
dos:309126bfb80c5dae.title: Western

dos:30923973659ba94f.description: A poker game presented as an illustrated encounter, following a meeting with a roller skater from a park to a nightclub as a series of poker hands.
dos:30923973659ba94f.title: Teenage Queen

dos:309311701d4cf56c.description: An amateur PC port of Street Fighter II, made by a single person who studied recorded gameplay of the Super Famicom version. Choose a fighter and battle one-on-one.
dos:309311701d4cf56c.title: Street Fighter II: The World Warrior

dos:3094ab397887d447.description: A racing game seen from above and slightly behind the car. Pick from vehicles ranging from a police car and VW Beetle to a school bus and truck, each with its own strengths and weaknesses.
dos:3094ab397887d447.title: Ignition

dos:309e3a02957da151.description: A flight simulator set at the Strategic Air Command Bombing and Navigation Competition, held at Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota, testing a pilot's quick decision-making.
dos:309e3a02957da151.title: Strike Aces

dos:30a64f4e1c8e2cd1.description: A science fiction adventure written by Roger Zelazny and Jane Lindskold, set in a future where universes can be created as Pocket Universes.
dos:30a64f4e1c8e2cd1.title: Chronomaster

dos:30a9e863b931432b.description: A first-person flight combat game, often compared to Descent, in which you pilot the TV-202 fighter, which can fly freely in any direction with constant thrust, across a series of missions.
dos:30a9e863b931432b.title: Terminal Velocity

dos:30ab3b40a0915560.description: An updated Sensible World of Soccer with current teams and fewer bugs. A top-down football game with quick matches or a 20-year career as player-manager.
dos:30ab3b40a0915560.title: Sensible World of Soccer '96/'97

dos:30bd0499ad77492e.description: The sequel to Loaded, with an improved graphics engine. Play a cast of deformed, strange characters such as Sister Magpie and Butch through violent, mission-based shooting.
dos:30bd0499ad77492e.title: Re-Loaded

dos:30bfc9718abee089.description: An unofficial Deep Space Nine story played through a small set of text commands, where interactions with the show's characters drive the scenario.
dos:30bfc9718abee089.title: XTREK: Deep Space Nine

dos:30c09a4fee0de292.description: An unofficial commercial add-on for DOOM II that replaces all 32 levels with new music, textures and graphics, and a plot in which an alien race from the planet Hell conquers Earth.
dos:30c09a4fee0de292.title: Hell to Pay

dos:30c1b506d8ead358.description: The third GeoTutor geography quiz, covering Central America and the Caribbean islands. It teaches the location of each country and adds a short paragraph about it.
dos:30c1b506d8ead358.title: GeoTutor 3: Central America

dos:30c80e5d88743099.description: Catch falling colored tiles and arrange them in rows, columns or diagonals of a single color. Each level sets a different pattern goal while the tiles fall faster and in more colors.
dos:30c80e5d88743099.title: Klax

dos:30cc4309ce50f63d.description: A single-player word puzzle a bit like the puzzle round of Wheel of Fortune. A clue phrase leads you to uncover the hidden phrase, name or thing.
dos:30cc4309ce50f63d.title: Acrostix

dos:30dbe809263ee21f.description: The sequel to Cyberia. Zak, the Zak/Cyberion hybrid, crash-lands on Earth after the destruction of Devlin's orbital headquarters and is drawn into a new action-adventure.
dos:30dbe809263ee21f.title: Cyberia 2: Resurrection

dos:30dee5d2a5c63bdd.description: A 256-color graphical update of The Manhole with new CD audio music. The gameplay and layout are unchanged, with both English and Japanese text.
dos:30dee5d2a5c63bdd.title: The Manhole: New and Enhanced

dos:30f19190472efb34.description: An arcade game based on a superstition among South Korean schoolchildren in the 1980s and 1990s: to improve your grades, steal items belonging to your classmates.
dos:30f19190472efb34.title: Jinx

dos:31011a5369cf4435.description: A single-player Gin Rummy card game against the computer. Each player is dealt ten cards and tries to form sets of the same rank or runs in the same suit.
dos:31011a5369cf4435.title: Tommy's Gin Rummy

dos:3117f84e7855ae3e.description: A strategy war game with 130 territories to conquer. Each year you manage your economy to feed troops, buy weapons such as tanks, planes and nuclear bombs, or build farms and factories, then attack enemy territories.
dos:3117f84e7855ae3e.title: Super Domination

dos:31213b4d6a52129e.description: A side-scrolling action game based on Clive Barker's film Nightbreed, in which Boone fights his way through Midian against the Sons of the Free.
dos:31213b4d6a52129e.title: Clive Barker's Nightbreed: The Action Game

dos:31271792d14e766e.description: A simple amusement-park shooting gallery with six events, such as shooting moving ducks or balloons. When you run out of time or bullets you receive a prize.
dos:31271792d14e766e.title: Crazy Shot

dos:3131a455bd017882.description: A text adventure written with the authors' own system, similar to TADS.
dos:3131a455bd017882.title: Skyland's Star

dos:3136c3805ab3264c.description: A two-player game in which each player flies a rocket around a battlefield, trying to shoot the other. The loser is whoever's health runs out first.
dos:3136c3805ab3264c.title: Rocket Duel

dos:3137d3ec70da38c8.description: A multiplayer hack-and-slash role-playing door game for bulletin board systems. Explore the dungeons of Durunghins alone or in teams, fight monsters or one another, and try to reach the deepest level.
dos:3137d3ec70da38c8.title: Usurper

dos:3138187888382812.description: A mahjong game in which you play one-on-one matches against seven characters, mostly in any order with the last held until later. Winning earns illustrations.
dos:3138187888382812.title: Mahjong Houtei Raoyui

dos:31390908da3101ae.description: One of the oldest interactive fiction titles, first written in 1979 for an IBM 370 mainframe under the name Brand X. A fantasy text adventure.
dos:31390908da3101ae.title: Philosopher's Quest

dos:31476b35985af527.description: A top-down science fiction shooter inspired by Alien in atmosphere and by Gauntlet in gameplay, set on the space station ISRC-4, which has been overrun by aliens. Two space marines fight through it.
dos:31476b35985af527.title: Alien Breed

dos:3155cbefe08c79fe.description: An arcade conversion of the shooter in which you take part in Operation Wolf, a rescue mission for prisoners, and fight soldiers, ninjas, patrol boats and helicopters across a series of missions.
dos:3155cbefe08c79fe.title: Operation Wolf

dos:31710e950e01012e.description: A Compute! magazine type-in BASIC game starring Nerm the Worm, trapped in Bemer Castle. It is a Snake variation in which you steer a crawler in constant motion, eating magic mushrooms.
dos:31710e950e01012e.title: Nerm of Bemer

dos:3173e8e480cb7663.description: A puzzle game similar to Boulder Dash and Heartlight. Collect all the hearts and floppies before time runs out, dealing with elements like electricity, amber, bombs and grass.
dos:3173e8e480cb7663.title: Self Control

dos:31750f30923839cd.description: A graphical adventure in which a valuable treasure has been stolen from the museum on the island of Calixto, and you must recover it and find out why it vanished. Objects are shown visually.
dos:31750f30923839cd.title: Calixto Island

dos:3176a1ca9cf08396.description: A set of educational puzzle games for one or more players, in which you work out sentences created by the computer, with eight difficulty levels in each mode.
dos:3176a1ca9cf08396.title: Jabbertalky

dos:318146e17a3a9980.description: A detailed wargame of the Arab-Israeli conflicts from 1973 to the present of 1991. Fight the 1973 war at the operational level as Israel, or take the harder Arab side.
dos:318146e17a3a9980.title: Conflict: Middle East

dos:3185fb15b11b2ee3.description: A four-player strategy game in which you lead England, France, Spain or Portugal in exploring and conquering the New World. It is historically accurate, so Spain has the advantage.
dos:3185fb15b11b2ee3.title: Gold of the Americas: The Conquest of the New World

dos:318890f0d2761b95.description: A commercially published pinball game on the Epic Pinball engine, with four tables: Fantasy, Blood, Snooker Champ and Odyssey.
dos:318890f0d2761b95.title: Silverball

dos:31a6ca844aa1d25d.description: Guide a purple-haired lady vampire through fifty rooms, collecting every vial of blood to open the portcullis to the next chamber while avoiding obstacles.
dos:31a6ca844aa1d25d.title: Vampiric Tower

dos:31b348bc21ae393a.description: A word-based educational game identical to Letter Drop but with a different dictionary of words.
dos:31b348bc21ae393a.title: Letter Drop 2

dos:31b9bfcbe49020ba.description: An Asteroids-style shooter with a wide range of weapons and enemies across 100 levels, with improved graphics and music from demoscene musicians.
dos:31b9bfcbe49020ba.title: Piranha

dos:31c647f9a4ca5803.description: A Euchre card game with drop-down menu options for AI difficulty and alternate rule sets.
dos:31c647f9a4ca5803.title: Euchre (1996)

dos:31c96b3ff4f08192.description: A short work of interactive fiction in which you wander through a series of vignettes from a person's life, like a maze of memories. The author called it a sketch made to test an authoring system.
dos:31c96b3ff4f08192.title: A Fable

dos:31cf309a35094a22.description: A 1995 PC port of a well-known Soviet arcade platformer, written in 1990 for the Vektor-06Ts computer.
dos:31cf309a35094a22.title: Adskok

dos:31d0604b8cc4a723.description: A strategy simulation with detailed graphics, where almost every significant event is accompanied by a small animation.
dos:31d0604b8cc4a723.title: Dark Universe

dos:31d857bec4379de6.description: A version of Minesweeper written by Jan Leschinsky to demonstrate the GRAFIN-II graphical interface. Clear the field as quickly as possible, marking mines with flags.
dos:31d857bec4379de6.title: Minesweeper

dos:31dcbe748900842b.description: An Ataxx variant played with angry little balls, for one or two players.
dos:31dcbe748900842b.title: SeoGyun

dos:31e28622bc109d8c.description: A very early four-in-one package of computerized board games: Checkers for Beginners, Elusion, Battleship and Reversi.
tags: Board Game / Battleship; Board Game / Checkers & Draughts; Board Game / Reverse or Othello; Strategy
dos:31e28622bc109d8c.title: Strategy Games

dos:31e2fdeeddb670de.description: A first-person shooter in which mild-mannered attorney Jack 'Calculator' Hayes is caught in a militia takeover of a company building that hides a C.I.A. base beneath it.
dos:31e2fdeeddb670de.title: Troubled Tower

dos:31e9f83d4ed0730a.description: A Tetris-like falling-block puzzle built around colored balls, with more complex mechanics than the usual colorful-ball puzzles.
dos:31e9f83d4ed0730a.title: Color Balls

dos:31fc540bc1b75a09.description: An interactive movie in which you play a Starfleet Cadet whose father died fighting the Borg at Wolf 359. Q, played by John de Lancie, sends you back in time to that battle.
dos:31fc540bc1b75a09.title: Star Trek: Borg

dos:32118d034353b04f.description: A side-scrolling action platformer starring the comic-book heroine Lorna, who crosses hostile alien environments fighting mutants with close-range attacks or an assault rifle.
dos:32118d034353b04f.title: Lorna

dos:3215c866b7190597.description: A Bubble Bobble clone in which two dragons clear platform screens by trapping enemies in bubbles and collecting bonus items.
dos:3215c866b7190597.title: Brave Bubble Dragon

dos:32309c6e88ca6049.description: A backgammon game in CGA graphics, played against the computer.
dos:32309c6e88ca6049.title: Backgammon (1984)

dos:3237101bcd32948f.description: A party board game for two to eight players. Roll dice, follow the prompt on each space, and gain or lose money while working toward a chosen winning total.
dos:3237101bcd32948f.title: S♥XXcapades

dos:323b52bed2da9543.description: A Scrabble-like word game for one or more players: choose letters from your tray and place them on the board to make valid words, using the mouse or arrow keys.
dos:323b52bed2da9543.title: Scramble (1990)(Gruber)

dos:3249ec2060b6fd98.description: A mix of Berzerk and Adventure. Explore over 120 rooms to find the evil enemy.
dos:3249ec2060b6fd98.title: Shamus

dos:32510777d8f7f375.description: A shooter in which you pilot a Pegasus ground-skimmer across a moon infested with evil beings. It is a dream, and has much in common with Tau Ceti.
dos:32510777d8f7f375.title: Phantasm

dos:32514d37e93f4cd0.description: An arcade game inspired by Lode Runner. Dig holes to trap enemies, collect power-ups, and choose between two characters with the same abilities.
dos:32514d37e93f4cd0.title: Super Panic Monsters

dos:3254a11ab78649f7.description: An interactive fiction game in which Tark, a D&D cleric, is summoned to the Astral Plane to confront a demon who imprisons artists' souls.
dos:3254a11ab78649f7.title: Tark Simmons, Priestess of the First Church, in her battle against the Demon of Dark Desire

dos:325b4e32ee2662c1.description: An interactive fiction game in which you are the assistant curator of Boston's Evelyn Museum and travel into the South American jungle to find new artifacts and revive the museum's attendance.
dos:325b4e32ee2662c1.title: The Great Archeological Race

dos:3266430ad801005d.description: A standalone modification of Wolfenstein 3D in which B. J. Blazkowicz infiltrates castle Blutigbeil, where secret chemical weapons are being produced.
dos:3266430ad801005d.title: Project: Weltuntergang

dos:326f9a1ecb9fbe06.description: A side-view beat 'em up in which you play a cop fighting hordes of zombies in fully 2D graphics.
dos:326f9a1ecb9fbe06.title: The Last Man Alive

dos:3278a194dd8e3fa8.description: A freeware word game against the computer. Make as many words as you can from adjacent letters on a 5x5 grid of random letters.
dos:3278a194dd8e3fa8.title: Bog

dos:3294c65bbe8a398d.description: A comedic fantasy adventure and role-playing game in which an Overlord has imposed unjust laws on the kingdom of Braminar, even outlawing hamburgers, and you build skills, artifacts and followers to oppose him.
dos:3294c65bbe8a398d.title: Braminar

dos:329b23fe9d7eb6e0.description: A platformer in which a race of rational bees defends its civilization against an invasion of alien mosquitoes, dragonflies and ants.
dos:329b23fe9d7eb6e0.title: Beez

dos:32c95c2ecbb51945.description: A tennis simulation with 2D players on a 3D simulated court, where the camera zooms and pans to follow the action. It has training, season and exhibition modes.
dos:32c95c2ecbb51945.title: Advantage Tennis

dos:32ccb8f263d320aa.description: A shareware sports quiz for one to four players, from the Trivia Shell series. It is customizable, with three difficulty levels including a beginner mode where all answers are true or false.
dos:32ccb8f263d320aa.title: Sports Trivia

dos:32d3c0f8bda67050.description: An old-school scrolling shoot 'em up. Dodge enemy fire and collect special symbols, with green ones tuning your four weapon types.
dos:32d3c0f8bda67050.title: Future Dimension

dos:32d58001fd9188f6.description: A platformer about Billy the Kid. In 1875 William Bonney is a 15-year-old in jail and does not stay there long. You play through key moments of his life, and a few invented ones.
dos:32d58001fd9188f6.title: Billy The Kid Returns

dos:32ee964e6969c485.description: A business simulation in which you are the CEO making decisions to stay ahead of competitors and raise shareholder value, with comic-style graphics.
dos:32ee964e6969c485.title: Big Business

dos:3304aca6a64579f6.description: In the year 2227, you are Tom Driscoll, a space pilot for the DDT Corporation, sent to the newly discovered desert world Albion where the factory ship Toronto is harvesting minerals. An action role-playing game.
dos:3304aca6a64579f6.title: Albion

dos:3315066c2fca1123.description: An adventure set in the small southeast Asian kingdom of Opalia in the 1950s, where USSR and US agents have destabilized the country and local rebels plan to act.
dos:3315066c2fca1123.title: Secret Mission (1996)

dos:33274f9bb838839e.description: Based on the 1989 Batman movie, the game has five parts, each resembling a different game type, starting with a platform stage in the chemical plant where you hunt Jack Napier.
dos:33274f9bb838839e.title: Batman: The Movie

dos:333726639d5cc4bd.description: A Yahtzee-style dice poker game for one or more players.
dos:333726639d5cc4bd.title: Yatzee

dos:333a15e6bcaf4133.description: A first-person shooter in which you play Werner Mueller, a sysop at GIC Headquarters in Futura City, woken at night by explosions and caught in a deadly fight.
dos:333a15e6bcaf4133.title: Angst: Rahz's Revenge

dos:333bdf187c845c93.description: A keyboard-controlled shareware pinball game for one player. It is not a real-table simulation: everything is shown on one screen, with a VGA table in the lower left.
dos:333bdf187c845c93.title: Moraff's Pinball

dos:333beff762882d89.description: A role-playing strategy game in which you control up to seven students who enter a high school to take on the evil teachers and stop the demonic Principal's plan for world domination.
dos:333beff762882d89.title: Ten Nights of Killing and Mayhem at F.J.B. II

dos:333d425a61fbf304.description: A version of ELIZA, the 1966 chatterbot by Joseph Weizenbaum of MIT that mimics a Rogerian psychotherapist by prompting you to elaborate on what you type.
dos:333d425a61fbf304.title: Eliza (1988)

dos:3359eaaa46a4d5a5.description: Four children's card games in one program: Memory Match for solitaire, and Old Maid, Go Fish and Slapjack against the computer.
dos:3359eaaa46a4d5a5.title: Kid's Kards

dos:335b8ae1d41dedd8.description: An English-language text adventure inspired by Wagner's opera. You are a modern person who has fallen asleep at the opera, and the game takes place in their dreams.
dos:335b8ae1d41dedd8.title: Der Ring des Nibelungen

dos:33633d34836ce46a.description: A shareware electronic version of dominoes, created by Barry Sargent.
dos:33633d34836ce46a.title: Dem Bonz

dos:3363661a2c0715dc.description: An arcade flight game in which you fly the ATF (Advanced Tactical Fighter) on missions around the world, destroying enemy submarines, radars, aircraft and bases, seen from behind your plane.
dos:3363661a2c0715dc.title: Airstrike USA

dos:3363b3369d734eee.description: A shoot 'em up set in New York in 1930. Gangsters pop up in a row of buildings and you must shoot each one before the on-screen timer runs out.
dos:3363b3369d734eee.title: Prohibition

dos:336d5f291eddc9e7.description: A traffic control simulation in which you manage the flow of vehicles through a busy city block during the 7:00 to 9:00 AM rush hour, as traffic grows and streets jam.
dos:336d5f291eddc9e7.title: Rush Hour

dos:3373b587ba1044ff.description: The last game of the Doom text adventure trilogy, in which you are again the space explorer who survived Doomawangara, the most dangerous planet in the universe.
dos:3373b587ba1044ff.title: Last Days of Doom

dos:337b77c6f79869b1.description: A shooter set in Victorian England, where Baron Fortesque used a time traveler's knowledge to build an immense artificial intelligence, the Chaos Engine. For one or two players.
dos:337b77c6f79869b1.title: The Chaos Engine

dos:3386dd8c4d89459c.description: The fourth Wizardry game, in which you play not a party but Werdna, the evil Archmage from the end of the first game, fighting through the dungeon.
dos:3386dd8c4d89459c.title: Wizardry IV: The Return of Werdna

dos:338b4b627841315c.description: A Prince of Persia-style platformer in which you fight a voodoo curse and its henchmen while avoiding deadly traps.
dos:338b4b627841315c.title: Death by Dark Shadows

dos:338dd9fe5d43bb4f.description: A first-person shooter in which you are a mage out to destroy the evil Nemesis, throwing fireballs at foes or at certain walls, and finding bolts and nukes.
dos:338dd9fe5d43bb4f.title: Curse of the Catacombs

dos:339ae3add20f6ec2.description: A maze puzzle from William Soleau and Soleau Software, a successor to Blind Maze, MadMaze and Mission Maze that replaces ASCII graphics with images.
dos:339ae3add20f6ec2.title: Mindcube

dos:33b341a69767204d.description: A text adventure in which you are Gringleguts the Orc, sworn to take revenge on all humankind. Every person and creature goes about its own daily life, so characters move from place to place while you play.
dos:33b341a69767204d.title: Knight Orc

dos:33b568a7de1275ef.description: An adventure game set entirely in and around a haunted mansion, with graveyards, crypts and swamps. It is considered a forerunner of horror adventure games, with gloomy atmosphere and spooky music.
dos:33b568a7de1275ef.title: Last Half of Darkness

dos:33bc442f7bc5f264.description: A puzzle game of logic and deduction: work out which spy on your team is really a mole leaking secrets to your enemies, without being fooled by their disguise.
dos:33bc442f7bc5f264.title: MasterSpy

dos:33c057016f5eb224.description: A boxing game that aims to recreate the sport in detail instead of acting as a pure arcade game, with multiple camera angles and viewpoints.
dos:33c057016f5eb224.title: 4-D Boxing

dos:33c8eaff83b54609.description: A first-person 3D shooter set in feudal Korea, known as Legend of the Seven Paladins, and the first commercially released game using the Build engine.
dos:33c8eaff83b54609.title: Rock 'n Shaolin: Legend of the Seven Paladins 3D

dos:33d382beda0f9eaf.description: A DOS conversion by John Nelson of Eamon, the game creation system and text-adventure role-playing series created by Donald Brown for the Apple II in 1980.
dos:33d382beda0f9eaf.title: Eamon (2000)

dos:33d649f05591ef12.description: A computer version of the card-matching game Go-Stop.
dos:33d649f05591ef12.title: Image Go-Stop

dos:33f10693f3486992.description: An archery game inspired by the archery event in the arcade game Track and Field, written by an author who found that event hard to master.
dos:33f10693f3486992.title: Archery

dos:34128822743e648c.description: An arcade shooter in which you pilot a Sioux AH-23 attack helicopter and a T1 assault tank against alien forces secretly operating on Earth.
dos:34128822743e648c.title: Extreme Assault

dos:3425dcb86d482c5d.description: The arcade racing game in which you drive a Ferrari with a female passenger across varied terrain on short tracks, seen from just above and behind the car, with sharp bends and hazards.
dos:3425dcb86d482c5d.title: Out Run

dos:34289bb261c44c01.description: A role-playing adventure created with the Bard's Tale Construction Set. Starting in the city of Lorraine, assemble a team of adventurers to complete the king's quest, with the same mechanics as the original Bard's Tale.
dos:34289bb261c44c01.title: The Bard's Lore II: The Dark Tower

dos:342d7e764204f703.description: The sequel to Accolade's baseball game HardBall, with better graphics and animation and authentic major league ballparks.
dos:342d7e764204f703.title: HardBall II

dos:342ebc094c20a702.description: A Spanish action-arcade game in which you guide an armored knight with a sword through several screens, fighting creatures before meeting the dragon.
dos:342ebc094c20a702.title: La Cueva del Dragon

dos:34303de1d6d67af8.description: A version of Monopoly designed specifically for the city of San Diego.
dos:34303de1d6d67af8.title: Sandiegopoly

dos:34399b7d924e15dc.description: Command a submarine in hostile waters and sink as many enemy ships as you can. With a limited supply of torpedoes, time each launch against ships zig-zagging across the periscope view.
dos:34399b7d924e15dc.title: Torpedo Alley

dos:345a23238c209b8b.description: Play a NASA Administrator who must design and build a space station over 15 years, planning shuttle launches, recruiting personnel and managing the budget.
dos:345a23238c209b8b.title: Project: Space Station

dos:34601d20d2034416.description: Test drive ten of the best cars on ten tracks, from Monterey Raceway to a mall parking lot, in the format of Car & Driver magazine. Race solo or against computer-controlled cars, or by modem, with replays.
dos:34601d20d2034416.title: Car and Driver

dos:34623742c65f723a.description: A text-mode DOS platformer made for a DOS game creation competition at high-voltage.cz.
dos:34623742c65f723a.title: House Breaker

dos:34656f1d2e96924c.description: A breakout game from the makers of Fuzzy's World, designed to close the book on Arkanoid-style programs, with enemy fighters and menacers that launch colored balls to hinder you.
dos:34656f1d2e96924c.title: Electranoid

dos:3467ed4d7d2e18fa.description: A puzzle game that its authors call a four-sided colored domino.
dos:3467ed4d7d2e18fa.title: Crux

dos:3472c01f5f8b233a.description: A word puzzle in which dots randomly appear on screen to form the letters of a hidden message. A clue is shown first and points are awarded by how few dots you need to guess it.
dos:3472c01f5f8b233a.title: Find a Message Word Puzzles

dos:347667480bf44296.description: A kingdom-building game in the mythical land of Genesia, seen in isometric view. Watch your people work, play and suffer in real time while you build infrastructure, grow food, mine minerals and produce building materials.
dos:347667480bf44296.title: Ultimate Domain
