dos:347db59e2b8ffb41.description: An Olympic sports game with eight events, any selection of which can be played at a time, including rowing, cycling and the triple jump.
dos:347db59e2b8ffb41.title: Summer Games II

dos:348129a7bbe40450.description: An arcade game about road marking: you drive a truck through city streets painting the road lines.
dos:348129a7bbe40450.title: Mad Painter!

dos:348265c21f01512d.description: A puzzle game in a simple design. A figure made of blue, yellow and red squares sits on the playing field, and you must make it match a target figure shown in the top right corner.
dos:348265c21f01512d.title: Amado

dos:348400e5d5b0cd6f.description: A breakout-style game in which you move a platform to keep a bouncing ball in play and destroy the blocks in front of you, trying to reach the treasure shown at the top of the screen before time runs out.
dos:348400e5d5b0cd6f.title: Bank Buster

dos:34855e40de48bf30.description: A pinball simulator that was the first to simulate a real machine, with support for high resolutions up to 1024x768. It has a single table, adjustable voltage levels and a magnet ball option.
dos:34855e40de48bf30.title: Eight Ball Deluxe

dos:3486d35936e95d02.description: A simulation of the ten-event Olympic Decathlon, in effect ten arcade games back to back. You use the keyboard to control speed in a race or the timing of a javelin throw, and there is a training mode.
dos:3486d35936e95d02.title: Microsoft Decathlon

dos:3487d0f4955a95dd.description: A platformer in which Santa loses all his presents from his sleigh, scattered across the country, and must cross scrolling levels to collect them.
dos:3487d0f4955a95dd.title: Santa's Xmas Caper

dos:34937729b234854c.description: A Spanish action game starring Mortadelo and Filemon. Dr. Bacterio's experiment to grow hens to horse size has failed, and a gang of uncontrolled giant hens is roaming the streets.
dos:34937729b234854c.title: Mortadelo y Filemón II: Safari Callejero

dos:34a83b8fd081c935.description: A chess program written by Richard Lang, who has written programs that won the World Computer Chess Championship ten times, and a continuation of the Mephisto series.
dos:34a83b8fd081c935.title: ChessGenius

dos:34afa376279f543e.description: An educational game for ages 5 to 7 with four games that build math skills, including Clowns' Counting Games, a number counting game with three levels of difficulty.
dos:34afa376279f543e.title: Math Rabbit

dos:34b10cbbefcabf47.description: A simple fighting game on an urban rooftop. The fighters Ken and Roc, nearly identical, fight three rounds across a seemingly endless series of levels.
dos:34b10cbbefcabf47.title: Fatal Challenge

dos:34b9c9b8515b1154.description: A platformer in which Moktar, an Arab man lost in the big city, must be brought back home. It is essentially Titus the Fox with a different main character.
dos:34b9c9b8515b1154.title: Lagaf': Les Aventures de Moktar - Vol 1: La Zoubida

dos:34bab04c3e2a3c87.description: A second short unofficial text adventure set in the Deep Space Nine universe, guided by a limited command vocabulary and encounters with its characters.
dos:34bab04c3e2a3c87.title: XTREK Deep Space Nine: The Second Coming

dos:34c5559f65efc047.description: A Spanish fighting game, in the style of Mortal Kombat, whose odd cast includes a hot dog, a robot, a woman and other characters.
dos:34c5559f65efc047.title: Salchicha Mortal

dos:34cbcefeea07eaa9.description: A hockey game that lets you control Wayne Gretzky and other stars such as Mario Lemieux, Eric Lindros and Mark Messier, 600 players in all, with the 26 NHL teams of the time and international teams.
dos:34cbcefeea07eaa9.title: Wayne Gretzky and the NHLPA All-Stars

dos:34ccb493d4c0dd4f.description: A Swedish take on Snake. Use the arrow keys to steer a green snake that is always moving through a scrolling labyrinth, with limited strength that decreases as it moves.
dos:34ccb493d4c0dd4f.title: Snaker

dos:34d332b181e10dda.description: A first-person adventure about exploration and puzzle solving. In 2134, fifty years into a brutal civil war between the Alliance and the anti-technology UN, the desperate Alliance sends you on a mission.
dos:34d332b181e10dda.title: Mission Critical

dos:34d4cc2eb6c395cf.description: An adventure based on the French comic character Iznogoud. As the Grand Vizier, whose only thought is to depose the Caliph of Baghdad and become Caliph instead of the Caliph, you wander around and scheme.
dos:34d4cc2eb6c395cf.title: Iznogoud

dos:34e27faf2189af11.description: A board and adventure game based on Bram Stoker's Dracula. Dracula has come to London seeking fresh blood, and has already turned Lucy Westerna into a vampiress.
dos:34e27faf2189af11.title: Dracula in London

dos:34ead909aa99219f.description: A Korean platformer based on a popular Korean animated series, with animated cut scenes from the show.
dos:34ead909aa99219f.title: Dooly the Little Dinosaur

dos:34ed21760a2f5018.description: A Star Trek style game of protecting the Federation by ridding it of Klingons. The galaxy is 8x8 quadrants of 8x8 sectors, each empty or holding a star, a starbase or a Klingon warship.
dos:34ed21760a2f5018.title: Quadrant

dos:34f0a7032d447275.description: A vertical scrolling shooter in which you, the Supreme Magician, travel from the Marsh of Eternal Stench to the Garden of Eden, surviving a deluge of monsters. For one or two players.
dos:34f0a7032d447275.title: Mystical

dos:34f514ea25ed9b54.description: A clone of Dr. Mario. On a Tetris-like board with three kinds of viruses, drop red, blue, yellow and green pills to clear the viruses by matching four or more of one color.
dos:34f514ea25ed9b54.title: Dr. Rudy

dos:34f55e8b8d136759.description: A strategy wargame of Second World War campaigns with six scenarios, beginning with Breakthrough 1940, the German invasion of France.
dos:34f55e8b8d136759.title: Storm in the West

dos:34fa3245c49aec95.description: A baseball game licensed from Pete Rose in which you can play every position on the field, with different batting and pitching styles, digitized voice, one or two players and season play.
dos:34fa3245c49aec95.title: Pete Rose Pennant Fever

dos:35061a28a9814bcc.description: A falling-block puzzle game in the style of Puyo Puyo, with a full story mode. Wander an overhead map of a village and challenge its characters to matches.
dos:35061a28a9814bcc.title: Princess Bubble

dos:35087d5686848263.description: A text-mode dungeon romp for fans of Kroz and ZZT. As a wizard in the caverns, gather gold, gems and orbs while facing seven types of enemies.
dos:35087d5686848263.title: Majik

dos:350dbd2e996d73a7.description: Two games on one disk, built to show off an early 3D system: Voyageur IV, an asteroid shooter, and 3D Ping Pong, a table-tennis game, launched from a common menu.
dos:350dbd2e996d73a7.title: 3DWorld

dos:350dd0d9ea24ace8.description: A side-view platformer starring a bearded, big-eyed caveman abducted by aliens. To get home he crosses several worlds, each with its own style, enemies and levels, with no weapons.
dos:350dd0d9ea24ace8.title: Perfect Worlds

dos:352b624ebe6fa2b3.description: The Jeopardy! quiz show with over 1000 answers on sports, from Olympic events like gymnastics and swimming to football, golf and baseball, with one-on-one play against the computer.
dos:352b624ebe6fa2b3.title: Jeopardy! New Sports Edition

dos:353956f7be2284ee.description: The first of Moraff's dungeon crawls. Choose to be a fighter or a wizard and explore four-color dungeons, climbing back up ropes to shops and inns, with a map that fills in as you go.
dos:353956f7be2284ee.title: Moraff's Revenge

dos:3542fa81eb18bdc5.description: A Spanish action game. After bringing peace to Cocovillage, Mad Mix faces a new threat at Cococastle, the haunted castle of his cousin Ope's town.
dos:3542fa81eb18bdc5.title: Mad Mix 2: En el castillo de los fantasmas

dos:3549e9d1abe4d3f0.description: A space game in which you navigate obstacles using indirect thrust.
dos:3549e9d1abe4d3f0.title: EV4DE

dos:354ec4db8c71c450.description: A shareware falling-block puzzle played with the keyboard. Colored tiles slide down a ramp to a grey catcher, which you then position over the play area and drop them into.
dos:354ec4db8c71c450.title: Rampcube

dos:3550bb2f958bbe1f.description: An odd soccer game whose teams are made up of characters such as construction workers, cowboys, grannies, insects and scientists.
dos:3550bb2f958bbe1f.title: Furcol

dos:35608fbbafdce895.description: The episodic first-person shooter and follow-up to the top-down Castle Wolfenstein. Play B.J. Blazkowicz, an Allied spy, across six episodes, the first distributed as shareware.
dos:35608fbbafdce895.title: Wolfenstein 3D

dos:35736cc5bdf35189.description: An arcade adventure with four distinct stages that repeat with greater difficulty once you survive them all. Fail, and the lovely Penelope, captured by cannibals, is lost along with you.
dos:35736cc5bdf35189.title: Jungle Hunt

dos:3574f822aa26a7a6.description: The first game in the Strike series. A year after the Gulf War, a self-styled general takes over an Arab Emirate and threatens world war, and you fly a helicopter gunship to stop him.
dos:3574f822aa26a7a6.title: Desert Strike: Return to the Gulf

dos:3576e959928ba756.description: A platform shooter starring Van Slug, a futuristic detective who rids the city and countryside of monsters, through fairly large levels full of ground and flying enemies.
dos:3576e959928ba756.title: VanSlug: X Mission

dos:357b5837d328b8a7.description: A platformer based on the Disney movie in which you control Mowgli, raised by animals in the jungle, and try to reach the human village. He can jump, run and climb.
dos:357b5837d328b8a7.title: Disney's The Jungle Book

dos:3584369ec6ec82c8.description: A five-level platformer in which the Blues Brothers flee the law. Play bulky Jake or nippy Elwood, cross a prison, a river and the city, and collect your missing records. For one or two players.
dos:3584369ec6ec82c8.title: The Blues Brothers

dos:3595bddb960114e3.description: A shareware first-person shooter with the engine and play mechanics of Wolfenstein 3D, plus an optional high-resolution mode. The registered version has three episodes.
dos:3595bddb960114e3.title: Depth Dwellers

dos:35b34fff78815612.description: A text adventure set in 2285, when Earth is dying from a plague and a now-extinct plant could cure it. Time travel is the only hope, taking you to places like the Old West and the American Revolution.
dos:35b34fff78815612.title: Time Traveler

dos:35b49e9ce3396bff.description: A sequel to Mike Singleton's Lords of Midnight III, based on Wagner's Der Ring des Nibelungen. Play Siegmund, son of Volsung, on a quest to find nine magical objects.
dos:35b49e9ce3396bff.title: Ring Cycle

dos:35b86c1eddf713f0.description: A superhero text adventure featuring the Gamma Force: a humanoid made of flame, an elf princess with a bow and a musclebound waterbeast.
dos:35b86c1eddf713f0.title: Gamma Force in Pit of a Thousand Screams

dos:35b887cc273d2ca8.description: Guide a ball through 50 levels of walls and barriers. You control a bat that serves the ball and then follows it through the level, deflecting it before it falls behind you and costs one of your four lives.
dos:35b887cc273d2ca8.title: The Light Corridor

dos:35bfcae4d438b43b.description: A compilation of the voxel-based RAH-66 helicopter simulations: Comanche: Maximum Overkill, the Global Challenge and Over the Edge add-ons, plus ten bonus missions.
dos:35bfcae4d438b43b.title: Comanche CD

dos:35f2db36db5d82c3.description: A computer adaptation of Games Workshop's board game, a violent fictional sport. Teams such as the Champions of Death and the Elfheim Eagles play single matches or a full league, and you give the orders.
dos:35f2db36db5d82c3.title: Blood Bowl

dos:35f7b0d35f277a73.description: A single-player shareware version of the Chinese tile-matching game, played with the mouse. It was first released around 1989, and version 3.1 came in September 1991.
dos:35f7b0d35f277a73.title: Solitile

dos:35fb5179e0c5bddf.description: A construction-site game for kids in which you try out an excavator, bulldozer, steamroller or wrecking ball with just three buttons to press.
dos:35fb5179e0c5bddf.title: Kids on Site

dos:360d8773417b2bb7.description: A very simple scrolling arcade shooter from Taiwan, likely ported from a console, which is difficult from the start. A joystick is recommended.
dos:360d8773417b2bb7.title: MH28

dos:361314c70a748217.description: A single-player Pac-Man clone. Pako, a friendly yellow blob, must eat the eggs of space pests and pass 100 levels to be cloned and released into the world.
dos:361314c70a748217.title: Pako

dos:361d9a92ee454de1.description: A text adventure from the book Creating Adventure Games On Your Computer, one of four sample adventures typed in and compiled in BASIC to teach interactive fiction design.
dos:361d9a92ee454de1.title: Aftermath of the Asimovian Disaster

dos:362ee12ac7ceb536.description: A Minesweeper-style logic game in which you clear the cargo bays of Altair-217 station of irradium explosive devices planted by a criminal group, with the colonists' lives depending on you.
dos:362ee12ac7ceb536.title: Cargo Bay Deluxe

dos:3637716906f4c1f4.description: A side-scroller like Paperboy, on a skateboard. Navigate streets and sidewalks collecting flags before time runs out, dodging pedestrians, cars and obstacles through 10 levels.
dos:3637716906f4c1f4.title: Awesome Earl in SkateRock

dos:364f5ce4c5c3e202.description: A Lode Runner clone with 25 levels of ladders, ropes, enemies and diamonds. As a commando sent into an underground warehouse, you pick up all the stolen diamonds.
dos:364f5ce4c5c3e202.title: Diamond Dash

dos:36500e15da629c06.description: A space flight simulation in which a computer has taken control of an intergalactic empire and locked it in limbo. You must reach it through hostile territory and destroy it.
dos:36500e15da629c06.title: Xiphos

dos:3658f812b6242b04.description: The sequel to Deja Vu. You wake in Las Vegas with a headache as Ace Harding, and must find $112,000 belonging to a murdered Chicago racketeer for the mobster Tony Malone.
dos:3658f812b6242b04.title: Deja Vu II: Lost in Las Vegas

dos:365e1c28cdfd29f8.description: A Wolfenstein-style 3D shooter made with the Pie 3D Game Creation System, in which you rescue Santa's frozen elf from the evil polar bear king. It uses heavy weapons but is not gory.
dos:365e1c28cdfd29f8.title: Terror in Christmas Town

dos:366403f291d3553b.description: A compilation of the whole Wing Commander II saga on one CD: Vengeance of the Kilrathi and its Special Operations expansions.
dos:366403f291d3553b.title: Wing Commander II: Deluxe Edition

dos:366cf92c0750d15f.description: Lead a covered wagon party of pioneers west from Independence to Oregon's Willamette Valley. Stock up on provisions, then decide when to rest and how much to eat as you travel.
dos:366cf92c0750d15f.title: The Oregon Trail Deluxe

dos:36983d77f804c911.description: A shooter similar to Galaxian War: no plot, black space, and waves of resilient enemy ships that die only after several precise hits.
dos:36983d77f804c911.title: Battle Insects

dos:36a6dcc31443876e.description: Avalon Hill's strategic board game Diplomacy in its first commercial computer adaptation. Choose a country and attempt world domination.
dos:36a6dcc31443876e.title: Computer Diplomacy

dos:36a6dd001a9e5f57.description: A text adventure in which you explore the Miser's House. It has little text and simple puzzles, and no goal beyond exploring, with points awarded for treasures.
dos:36a6dd001a9e5f57.title: The Miser's House

dos:36a7f6b405490070.description: An educational game for toddlers set in a children's treehouse, teaching numbers, shapes, letters and animals through activities with items found around the treehouse.
dos:36a7f6b405490070.title: The Treehouse

dos:36b1d0e2912da4da.description: A Spanish clone of Pang. As part of Ball Breaker Corp. you destroy balls that have invaded Earth, which split into smaller balls each time they are hit until they disappear.
dos:36b1d0e2912da4da.title: Ball Breakers Corp.

dos:36b820885b25889c.description: The successor to Championship Manager, with the same text interface and new features such as reserve squads, transfers of international players and injury time.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:36b820885b25889c.title: Championship Manager 93/94

dos:36bdf41c51a2793d.description: A role-playing game in which a prophecy says dragons will rule the world. The emperor sends four heroes, warriors and magicians, to an island to confront their lords.
dos:36bdf41c51a2793d.title: Drakkhen

dos:36ca28cca41e9390.description: A shooter in which you are a spaceship pilot defending Mars against ten hordes of space snakes, each stronger than the last. You have five ships.
dos:36ca28cca41e9390.title: Space Snake

dos:36cefcb2137ddbd3.description: A flight simulation of US Naval aviators over Vietnam, with MiGs, AAA and SAMs, and carrier landings. Configure each plane's loadout, plan your mission package and fly.
dos:36cefcb2137ddbd3.title: Flight of the Intruder

dos:36d558d98a2b22cf.description: An action platformer with gameplay like Flashback. A fanatic group called Apocalypse attacks a nuclear convoy to start a global nuclear conflict, and the president sends his best agent to stop them.
dos:36d558d98a2b22cf.title: B.I.G.

dos:36ddf09319b08816.description: A cross between Arkanoid and Tetris.
tags: Action; Paddle & Pong; Puzzle / Falling block puzzle
dos:36ddf09319b08816.title: Biprolex +

dos:36ec714faf02b243.description: The second Star Saga game, combining science fiction role-playing with a strategy board game. Up to six players take pre-created characters, in a merging of computerized and non-computerized RPG.
dos:36ec714faf02b243.title: Star Saga Two: The Clathren Menace

dos:36ed17c64f7420fb.description: A racing game based on the classic Italian road race. Drive a rickety 1920s car across Italy in stages, staying within the time limits at each checkpoint to remain in the race.
dos:36ed17c64f7420fb.title: 1000 Miglia

dos:36ed8d247658e9fc.description: A real-time mecha strategy game set in futuristic Japan. Command a group of armed soldiers through missions, from infiltrating a drug lord's mansion to assassinating a coup leader, pausing to give orders.
dos:36ed8d247658e9fc.title: CRW: Metal Jacket

dos:36ef120bb3d04ed4.description: A chess program with several AI levels for beginners and advanced players, up to an ELO rating of 2150, and an optional advice feature that tries to teach you chess.
dos:36ef120bb3d04ed4.title: Chess Simulator

dos:36ef29da7a1388e2.description: A text adventure in which Richard sets out to find his father, the archaeologist Edward Lynton, who has mysteriously disappeared, while the evil god Darsuggotha tries to ascend into our world.
dos:36ef29da7a1388e2.title: Demon's Tomb: The Awakening

dos:3708a9621d27057c.description: A platformer based on the 1960s TV series The Munsters. The family has been transported to a mysterious castle, and you play its members in turn, collecting items in each room to rescue the rest.
dos:3708a9621d27057c.title: The Munsters

dos:372dc3b767214f28.description: An action game based on the film Platoon, in which you control a squad of five US soldiers in Vietnam in turn, switching between them as each can take only three hits.
dos:372dc3b767214f28.title: Platoon

dos:372e1b4634b1f53d.description: A creative kids' title from EA Kids in which you make your own music videos using songs and characters from the time, including ones from other EA Kids titles.
dos:372e1b4634b1f53d.title: Video Jam!

dos:374253abbffe9856.description: A standard side-view platformer: run, jump and collect bonuses through a series of short, sometimes difficult levels, moving between them through locked doors.
dos:374253abbffe9856.title: Crazy Sue

dos:3746845bea659a6c.description: A cyberpunk adventure set in the near future, when hell has been found to exist. The Hand of God governs the ways to hell, demons can reach our dimension, and criminals are sent to hell instead of jail.
dos:3746845bea659a6c.title: Hell: A Cyberpunk Thriller

dos:3748fc026895c6c9.description: A football management game featuring English teams. Start with any Division 3 side and try to climb to the Premiership, handling training, scouting and other duties.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:3748fc026895c6c9.title: Match Day Manager

dos:374cf232239c1137.description: A Bust-A-Move variant without the cute mascots. Aim and launch a colored sphere up a narrow tunnel, ricocheting it into place, with an automatic launch after ten seconds.
dos:374cf232239c1137.title: Bubble Crack

dos:3770b8378f79a39b.description: A squash game licensed from Jonah Barrington, with one- and two-player modes. Barrington calls the score and claimed the program could improve a player's real squash.
dos:3770b8378f79a39b.title: Jonah Barrington's Squash

dos:377cad0e9c728979.description: The sequel to Elite. You have a ship and limited funds and nowhere to go but out into space: trade, fight, hunt criminals or work for the various governments, with few limits.
dos:377cad0e9c728979.title: Frontier: Elite II

dos:378b7da30ad4465c.description: An educational adventure like Law and Order for kids, with over 50 mysteries to solve, from missing items and dug-up skeletons to sea monster sightings.
dos:378b7da30ad4465c.title: Eagle Eye Mysteries

dos:378b9efe9ac443fa.description: A tactical starship combat game. Command the United Alliance of Planets, Klargon Empire, Reman Star Empire, Imperial Pirates or Freemen planets, fighting ships, starbases and outposts with phasers and torpedoes.
dos:378b9efe9ac443fa.title: The Warp Factor

dos:378e7bae3eb243eb.description: An educational action game. The lazy Gruzzles have stolen all the letters from every book, and Benny the Bookworm sets out to get the words back.
dos:378e7bae3eb243eb.title: Word Rescue

dos:378e7d4824078d88.description: A combination of first-person helicopter simulation and isometric espionage action. As ace pilot and neurosurgeon Johnny McGibbitts, fly behind enemy lines on a mission against the Mad Leader.
dos:378e7d4824078d88.title: Infiltrator

dos:378ef203a2d96f1f.description: Perhaps the earliest official Scrabble for the PC, for up to four players with computer opponents at 8 skill levels and an amendable 20,000-word dictionary.
dos:378ef203a2d96f1f.title: The Computer Edition of Scrabble Brand Crossword Game

dos:3792915df1c3fbb2.description: A shareware, single-player two-dimensional platformer. Diana, sitting in class, finds herself in the lost temple of the Aztecs.
dos:3792915df1c3fbb2.title: The Adventures Of Dianalee: In The Lost temple Of The Aztecs

dos:379a79e568fc62c3.description: A Russian remake of Sokoban with EGA graphics. It is intentionally austere, with no menu, screensaver or plot.
dos:379a79e568fc62c3.title: Labyrinth (1992)

dos:37a69f23ed9bba2b.description: A chess game based on Terminator 2, with sounds and characters from the movie as pieces. Captures are animated like Battle Chess but fought off the board in futuristic wastelands, with several difficulties and play styles.
dos:37a69f23ed9bba2b.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day - Chess Wars

dos:37b1fc4169abca8b.description: Build a series of castles to gain dominion over the land. Your decisions affect your standing with the Church, nobles and peasants, while you keep a strong military and workforce and watch your treasury.
dos:37b1fc4169abca8b.title: Castles

dos:37b29bee97d5a7b2.description: A four-way scrolling shooter inspired by Sopwith. Fly an early 20th century fighter plane with the objective of blowing things up, using moves such as climbing, diving, flipping and 360-degree loops.
dos:37b29bee97d5a7b2.title: Artman's Goplanes!

dos:37b670977f0ccac9.description: A text adventure in which you must save your people from living without the Ruby of Rashmik, the magic object that makes crops grow and the birds fly.
dos:37b670977f0ccac9.title: The Wizard's Castle (1994)

dos:37b987a9bd7dd226.description: A three-in-a-row logic puzzle in which you transfer rings onto pins to line up three of the same color vertically or horizontally.
dos:37b987a9bd7dd226.title: Color Towers

dos:37be25ee8a63f160.description: Pilot the Gunship Gladiator helicopter to stop a coup. Twelve levels in three styles, starting with flying low over a city to shoot tanks.
dos:37be25ee8a63f160.title: ThunderBlade

dos:37c1179f71e0194d.description: Five-card draw poker against up to three photographed opponents at once, with VGA graphics and an introductory voice sequence. More opponents were available on data disks.
dos:37c1179f71e0194d.title: Str♥p Poker III

dos:37cae7b97dd28abf.description: An American football game with single games against the computer or a friend and full seasons with playoffs and Super Bowls. A Construction Set lets you create your own team down to its playbook.
dos:37cae7b97dd28abf.title: Unnecessary Roughness '95

dos:37e59fb0ebf16276.description: Santa has lost his sled and his delivery notes. Walk around town, pick up the presents and work out by trial and error which house each belongs to, while a rogue Easter Bunny gets in the way.
dos:37e59fb0ebf16276.title: Nicolausi

dos:37f8001d72ab8f1a.description: An arcade game in which you are a bartender serving beer to demanding customers in four lanes of increasing length. If a customer reaches the end of the lane without a beer, you lose.
dos:37f8001d72ab8f1a.title: Tapper

dos:37fe2331da99e08a.description: The first Leisure Suit Larry adventure, in which Larry Laffer goes on a disastrous search for romance. Explore illustrated locations, type commands and solve inventory puzzles for comedy and points.
dos:37fe2331da99e08a.title: Leisure Suit Larry in the Land of the Lounge Lizards

dos:38025a6ef55c6d57.description: A junior edition of Wheel of Fortune with word puzzles aimed at a younger audience.
dos:38025a6ef55c6d57.title: Wheel of Fortune: Junior Edition

dos:380bb00ce0bcdfbd.description: A direct computer conversion of Steve Jackson's board game, in which a giant supertank fights superinfantry and howitzers. It plays like the board game.
dos:380bb00ce0bcdfbd.title: Ogre

dos:381bde0b24ecf54e.description: A role-playing game based on novels by Lord Steven and heavily inspired by the early Ultima games. An evil wizard threatens the kingdom of Syree, and none of its heroes has returned.
dos:381bde0b24ecf54e.title: The Kingdom of Syree

dos:381ee1e90236b2d3.description: A shareware underwater arcade game in which you play a marine biologist diving for rare sea creatures. Lead the diver to the creatures and bring them back to your cage for points.
dos:381ee1e90236b2d3.title: Alive Sharks

dos:382acaa7f60c8891.description: An isometric 3D platformer, with controls rotated to match the viewpoint. Each level is played against a time limit.
dos:382acaa7f60c8891.title: Whizz

dos:38301ea1b71ebb39.description: A 2D naval simulation with action elements, set in 1995 as tensions boil in the Persian Gulf between Iranian, Iraqi and US forces. You are captain of the destroyer U.S.S. John Young.
dos:38301ea1b71ebb39.title: Battle Stations

dos:383277aae666a2c1.description: You wake in prison with no memory and find a briefcase computer that controls four droids. Use them to find out who you are and escape, in a role-playing game.
dos:383277aae666a2c1.title: Captive

dos:38384430fc77bcc0.description: A stock market game for up to four players, who invest in oil companies, car companies and airlines and use performance graphs and economic trends to make their fortune. You can take out a loan.
dos:38384430fc77bcc0.title: Stock Market: The Game

dos:383f5cedcb2c4526.description: A platformer in which thugs from the evil Thindicate corporation kidnap Roy Fat's wife and he must trade for her with the Duplicator. There are seven stages.
dos:383f5cedcb2c4526.title: Fatman: The Caped Consumer

dos:384783ff93463ae8.description: An ASCII space strategy game in which you are the supreme leader of a galactic empire, with the common 4X elements of planet management, exploration and conquest.
dos:384783ff93463ae8.title: Anacreon: Reconstruction 4021

dos:38509aa69d2e8078.description: A reading game for 3 to 7 year olds, with talking characters and digitized music and sound to help build reading skills.
dos:38509aa69d2e8078.title: Electric Reading Land

dos:385b0e1d7f2b636e.description: Dan Bunten's M.U.L.E. revamped with VGA graphics and set underwater. Four players compete for economic dominance in a round-based colony.
dos:385b0e1d7f2b636e.title: Subtrade: Return to Irata

dos:386776f13171f209.description: The second GeoTutor geography quiz, on South America. It teaches where each country is and adds a paragraph or two about each.
dos:386776f13171f209.title: GeoTutor 2: South America

dos:386f4a1eb1bad421.description: A side-scrolling platformer in which Mylo Steamwitz, a space trader, enters the mines of the Altairian system to collect crystals and start a twibble farm. Finish all 16 levels, collecting every crystal.
dos:386f4a1eb1bad421.title: Crystal Caves

dos:387cb39e44c3c489.description: An adventure in which you single-handedly save the world from alien intruders, among strange characters, aliens and heroes in detailed settings.
dos:387cb39e44c3c489.title: Alien Incident

dos:387e6ccff949e77b.description: A scrolling shooter in which you, found guilty though innocent, choose to become a front-line warrior for the empire instead of a colonist. Pilot one of two ships and shoot everything on screen.
dos:387e6ccff949e77b.title: Wingstar

dos:388b4fc2f9f07324.description: An action-sports game with a threefold mission: sail three legs around the Bermuda Triangle as fast as you can, rescue lost swimmers and rafters, and avoid sharks, mist and whirlpools.
dos:388b4fc2f9f07324.title: Sailing... an adventure in the Bermuda Triangle

dos:389e5a0124f99db3.description: The first Tetris sequel, designed by Alexey Pajitnov with Andrei Sgenov. Falling pieces are rotated and positioned to form complete rows, here looking down into a well.
dos:389e5a0124f99db3.title: Welltris

dos:38a0ac87805d2534.description: A parody of Zork, full of goofy situations and commentary on the inadequacy of adventure games of the late 1970s and early 1980s, played as a nonlinear treasure hunt.
dos:38a0ac87805d2534.title: Pork 1: The Great Underground Sewer System

dos:38a5581a34b4178f.description: The fifth Ultima, built on the Ultima IV engine, with an overhead view of Britannia and its towns, and 3D dungeons. It adds much more world interactivity and deeper characters.
dos:38a5581a34b4178f.title: Ultima V: Warriors of Destiny

dos:38ab0c59bba156b2.description: A rugby simulation for one or two players without an official license.
dos:38ab0c59bba156b2.title: World Class Rugby 95

dos:38bec611e8ea979f.description: A first-person RPG in which you are abducted from Earth by aliens and dumped in a strange, familiar city in an alternate dimension. Explore it and find the clues that lead you onward.
dos:38bec611e8ea979f.title: Alternate Reality: The City

dos:38c204015abb24e2.description: An Apogee platformer starring Baron Baldric, later reused in the isometric game Mystic Towers. The registered version was sold only in Australia.
dos:38c204015abb24e2.title: Baron Baldric: A Grave Adventure

dos:38c656d6aee900a3.description: A turn-based strategy game of the South Pacific campaigns of the Second World War. Command either the Japanese or US forces, with hundreds of specific units.
dos:38c656d6aee900a3.title: World War II: Battles of the South Pacific

dos:38ca5609b55a779b.description: A mecha combat game heavily inspired by the Amiga's MechForce, itself a computer adaptation of the BattleTech board game.
dos:38ca5609b55a779b.title: Titans of Steel

dos:38ccf28c1b1e8807.description: A beat 'em up set in a post-apocalyptic New York, starring the twin brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee, trained in the Sou-Setsu-Ken fighting style. Play alone or with a friend.
dos:38ccf28c1b1e8807.title: Double Dragon

dos:38d3356eadbac6e5.description: A side-scrolling fighter like Double Dragon. As the fallen angel, you search for the leader of a drug distribution network, beginning in the London underground, with two tasks to complete on each level.
dos:38d3356eadbac6e5.title: Fallen Angel

dos:38d846af5e7b13c1.description: A Street Fighter II clone with stick-figure fighters, for one or two players.
dos:38d846af5e7b13c1.title: Stick Fighter II

dos:38dcf859aba9861e.description: A bomber game in which you fly zig-zagging across the sky, losing altitude with each turnaround, and drop bombs on the cities below.
dos:38dcf859aba9861e.title: Air Attack!

dos:38e2dd0b5b5af015.description: An old-school overhead RPG much like the first Ultima games, controlled with simple keyboard commands, on a quest involving the Sword of Rhin.
dos:38e2dd0b5b5af015.title: Hera: Sword of Rhin

dos:38e4fea938296719.description: Play Willy and shoot spitwads at bouncing balls. Each large ball you hit splits into two smaller ones, and each split drops a power-up.
dos:38e4fea938296719.title: Spit Wad Willy

dos:38f0bdf4b56f38df.description: The building is on fire and the babies are trapped. You are the rescuer holding the safety net, and must catch each baby that jumps.
dos:38f0bdf4b56f38df.title: Tommy's Gorilla Ball Babies

dos:38fe5d9b47da0bac.description: An educational game for children aged two to six, in which Barney Bear visits the farm.
dos:38fe5d9b47da0bac.title: Barney Bear Goes to the Farm

dos:390b0238ec8bbe8c.description: A platformer in which you play Aldo, who looks a lot like Mario in Donkey Kong, climbing to the upper levels to reach a treasure chest while avoiding falling barrels.
dos:390b0238ec8bbe8c.title: Aldo's Adventure

dos:390c141ea48216c7.description: A chess opponent with detailed graphics and a large book of opening moves.
dos:390c141ea48216c7.title: Sargon V: World Class Chess

dos:391efacece3d91ad.description: A shareware ski jumping simulation with full 3D graphics and realistic physics. It has 32 hills, from the small K50 in England to the huge K250 in Slovenia, and up to 16 players.
dos:391efacece3d91ad.title: Deluxe Ski Jump

dos:39227b23d9ab88d3.description: A simulation of commanding a Type VII U-Boat, an exact recreation of submarine warfare circa 1941, with internal and external views in full 3D.
dos:39227b23d9ab88d3.title: Das Boot: German U-Boat Simulation

dos:3928930499e954eb.description: Unlike the first two games, which were role-playing and resource management, Universe 3 poses true logic-based puzzles, with characters moving much as in Omnitrend's tactical game Breach.
dos:3928930499e954eb.title: Universe 3

dos:392cee57d388acb7.description: An Asteroids-style game in which you fly a spaceship and shoot all the asteroids and aliens you meet. Large asteroids split into smaller ones, and a map shows where they are.
dos:392cee57d388acb7.title: Zappa Roidz

dos:392f7d257bca349f.description: A platform shooter in which you play a soldier in red armor, reminiscent of Crusader, with no clear plot.
dos:392f7d257bca349f.title: Deep Red

dos:393612e5aeed2e84.description: A clone of the arcade game Pengo. Control Pango, a penguin, in a maze of ice blocks that can be moved or destroyed, and clear it of the bees chasing you.
dos:393612e5aeed2e84.title: Pango

dos:393a725de99926d5.description: A puzzle game in which Bloxinies, a little character with a smiling face, enters an odd gate into a puzzle world and can escape only by collecting all the diamonds that open the door.
dos:393a725de99926d5.title: Bloxinies

dos:3954a0f1a8c9c6a2.description: A lesser-known Coktel Vision adventure that introduced the interface used in many of the company's later games, and one of its first to use FMV cut scenes.
dos:3954a0f1a8c9c6a2.title: Bargon Attack

dos:395b9dbc14736847.description: An Infocom text adventure in which you are teleported into the body of the main character in the world of Sorcerer, following the story from there.
dos:395b9dbc14736847.title: Sorcerer

dos:395bf03421965170.description: A simulation of the air war over Iraq a few years after the Gulf War, in which you fly an F-16 in a series of one-off missions, with a detailed cockpit and systems.
dos:395bf03421965170.title: Back to Baghdad

dos:3989a463d42e8679.description: A puzzle game inspired by Pipe Dream. Balls of three colors constantly appear at the left of the play field, and you route them into matching storage cups at the right.
dos:3989a463d42e8679.title: Rimtrix

dos:3991d07ca8542f70.description: A World War II flight simulation and strategy game in which you fly a dive bomber armed with torpedoes and a machine gun and try to sink the battleship Bismarck.
dos:3991d07ca8542f70.title: Dive Bomber

dos:399f4a25abece61a.description: In the year 2127, after the great interstellar war, the galaxy is full of unclaimed planets. As a starship captain, you explore and take advantage of them.
dos:399f4a25abece61a.title: Command Adventures: Starship

dos:39a68aa5e3d177dd.description: A text adventure in which you are stranded in deep space without fuel and find an abandoned space station where strange things have been happening, then try to reach the planet below.
dos:39a68aa5e3d177dd.title: Deep Space Drifter

dos:39b31f1f77eb2635.description: A puzzle game in which each level gives you atoms to arrange into a specific molecule shape in a top-down view. A small picture of the target is shown at the lower left.
dos:39b31f1f77eb2635.title: Atomix

dos:39b5eb28e57a090a.description: Destroy the enemy cities by entering the angles at which to fire your missiles. UFOs fly over and try to destroy a city or your base. The game ends when you have fired all twelve missiles.
dos:39b5eb28e57a090a.title: Night Bomber

dos:39cb2a051dc90a25.description: An educational game for ages 2 to 5 starring Donald Duck. His alphabet letters have escaped and are hiding around the house, and you help him find all 26 and put them back.
dos:39cb2a051dc90a25.title: Donald's Alphabet Chase

dos:39d06fc09e54acae.description: Based on the AD&D Spelljammer rules, you pilot a ship that travels into space and to distant planets for exploration and piracy.
dos:39d06fc09e54acae.title: Spelljammer: Pirates of Realmspace

dos:39db2b9718194f0d.description: Develop the careers of aspiring heavyweight boxers as their manager, choosing options through an icon-based manager's office, including training the boxers.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Boxing
dos:39db2b9718194f0d.title: World Championship Boxing Manager

dos:39db776b79b06bcf.description: Two basketball games in one package, with 3 skill levels. One recreates the real game, with a full league for one or two players that can be saved, and the other is faster paced.
dos:39db776b79b06bcf.title: Omni-Play Basketball

dos:39f9c7513d313efa.description: A tool for running NBA fantasy basketball leagues: name the league and commissioner, set the number of teams, import new stats and draft players.
dos:39f9c7513d313efa.title: FastBreak Fantasy Basketball

dos:3a048aa64fbf4f31.description: A text-based simulation of darts for up to 20 players. Each player picks fast overarm, controlled overarm or underarm throws, which affects accuracy.
dos:3a048aa64fbf4f31.title: Bullseye

dos:3a0afcf2d9eb8852.description: A sports edition of Jeopardy! with 700 categories and 3,500 questions on sports like baseball, football and hockey.
dos:3a0afcf2d9eb8852.title: Jeopardy! Sports Edition

dos:3a16b223d8400e19.description: A collection of six arcade mini-games. Miss Piggy has been pignapped by the sinister Dr. Grump, and Kermit, Gonzo, Fozzie and other Muppets come to the rescue.
dos:3a16b223d8400e19.title: Jim Henson's Muppet Adventure No. 1: 'Chaos at the Carnival'

dos:3a23692416b99337.description: An early Gettysburg simulation with simple top-down map graphics and keyboard controls.
dos:3a23692416b99337.title: Decision at Gettysburg

dos:3a40240af6a038af.description: An educational text adventure that turns the South American geography lesson into a trek, built around the region's rivers, mountains and countries.
dos:3a40240af6a038af.title: South American Trek

dos:3a55547f9025ba82.description: A racing game where you also score points for wrecking opponents, with more points for hits like making them spin a full 360.
dos:3a55547f9025ba82.title: Destruction Derby

dos:3a72a5314f09dd5b.description: A maze game: move your character from start to finish before your points, which act as time, run out. Finishing earns extra time for the next level.
dos:3a72a5314f09dd5b.title: Dedale

dos:3a84fbd915e7e83a.description: An action-adventure set in Calia, the independent California created after a meteor crash splits it from the continent. You play Rick Cage.
dos:3a84fbd915e7e83a.title: NeoHunter

dos:3a8abd2c59844762.description: A text-based space trading game much like Elite, with strategy and action, where you play against other people and build citadels and ports, made popular through bulletin boards.
dos:3a8abd2c59844762.title: Trade Wars 2002

dos:3ab1ad3be08d4b63.description: A shareware game based on Balloon Fight with two sub-games, including Midnight Journeys, a right-to-left scroller in which you float on two balloons across a night sky.
dos:3ab1ad3be08d4b63.title: Balloonz

dos:3abfec646ce05e6d.description: The arcade game in which you drive an armed moon buggy, shooting aliens and avoiding their bullets, craters, rocks and landmines.
dos:3abfec646ce05e6d.title: Moon Patrol

dos:3ac6d1cc9296de9e.description: A platformer in which you are a ninja out to redeem the land of Naipusan and defeat the evil Shogun of Death through levels such as a village, a cemetery and a castle.
dos:3ac6d1cc9296de9e.title: Shadow Knights

dos:3ad248ddb1817582.description: A text adventure in which an American archaeologist searches the Yucatan rain forest for the Lost City of Kukulcan, a fabled city many think exists only in legend.
dos:3ad248ddb1817582.title: Quest of Kukulcan

dos:3ad2ced40a012896.description: A 360-degree space shoot 'em up with no levels or final goal: survive as long as you can by shooting enemies and avoiding collisions.
dos:3ad2ced40a012896.title: Obliterator (1996)

dos:3addd15ae5b50257.description: A port of the classic cave text adventure made to show off the Master's Edition of the Adventure Game Toolkit authoring system.
dos:3addd15ae5b50257.title: Adventure in Humongous Cave

dos:3adead12a95ea198.description: A two-player death match set in a prison with several levels to choose from. As time passes the bored guards throw down lead pipes, fire extinguishers and eventually a shotgun.
dos:3adead12a95ea198.title: Cell Block A

dos:3af15a7af986af6c.description: A combat racing game set in a hopeless dark future, where you enter the gruelling Thrash Race Tournament and need to be ruthless and deadly to win.
dos:3af15a7af986af6c.title: Maximum Roadkill

dos:3afa6f5305829bb1.description: An arcade game in which you aim to become the biggest fish in the sea. Eat all the fish smaller than you on each screen to move on, growing as you eat.
dos:3afa6f5305829bb1.title: Freddy Fish

dos:3afdc6a4dc7fe4c8.description: A Korean beat 'em up featuring mechs, in which many of the robot fights, especially at the start, are fought with physical contact.
dos:3afdc6a4dc7fe4c8.title: Mechanic War

dos:3b11ef5ab41f4b41.description: A turn-based strategy game in which you command an all-female military group in giant mechanized battlesuits through nine missions, from destroying convoys to stalling an enemy advance.
dos:3b11ef5ab41f4b41.title: Power Dolls

dos:3b176d6116f133c2.description: An action shooter in which you fly across vast regions of the planet to wipe out deadly diseases around the globe.
dos:3b176d6116f133c2.title: Ebola: Civilian Assault

dos:3b19dc77d47a0b05.description: A remake of the first Leisure Suit Larry game with a new interface: instead of typing commands, you perform actions with the mouse.
dos:3b19dc77d47a0b05.title: Leisure Suit Larry: In the Land of the Lounge Lizards (SCI Remake)

dos:3b1c3808be8df1d8.description: A clone of Hextris, itself a Tetris clone. Hexagonal blocks fall onto the screen and you create lines in all directions, with the next three blocks previewed.
dos:3b1c3808be8df1d8.title: Maxtris

dos:3b2224c641b1ba11.description: An ASCII text game in which you control a ship and must destroy alien fighters, arriving in threes, before one gets past you. The speed increases over time.
dos:3b2224c641b1ba11.title: Alien Attack

dos:3b28b8670143e32a.description: A first-person 3D space shooter released by Novell to show off NetWare's IPX networking. Steer your ship, shoot enemy ships and collect satellites, alone or in multiplayer.
dos:3b28b8670143e32a.title: NetWars

dos:3b3b4f75f97dd799.description: A game show trivia game from IBM with categories such as The Bible, Famous Epitaphs, High Technology, Hollywood Horrors and Diet and Fitness.
dos:3b3b4f75f97dd799.title: Trivia 101: The Introductory Course

dos:3b3be019d429164e.description: The sequel to Doom. The last space marine returns to Earth after saving Mars, only to find that the demons have already invaded.
dos:3b3be019d429164e.title: DOOM II: Hell on Earth

dos:3b469144fc52a2bf.description: A text game in which your students aren't writing their assignments, so you write them for them, using the W key for regular writing.
dos:3b469144fc52a2bf.title: Fatuma

dos:3b4af924d3773753.description: A minigame collection that began as an interactive TV game show in the style of Denmark's Hugo, where contestants at home controlled the hero by phone.
dos:3b4af924d3773753.title: Coba on the Run 2

dos:3b56f5da3432da35.description: The second Battle Isle game from Blue Byte. After a long space flight you arrive on the planet Chromos and must save its civilization from the Titan-net Empire.
dos:3b56f5da3432da35.title: Battle Isle 2200

dos:3b5751d073527abd.description: A puzzle game in which you reconstruct pictures by collecting scattered tiles and placing them in the right order, while dealing with tile-stealing chess pieces and dissolving tiles.
dos:3b5751d073527abd.title: Never Mind

dos:3b6ae0d4668fb6e2.description: A game much like The Oregon Trail in which you make choices through text menus to try to reach the top of Mount Everest. The random length of the climb makes equipping yourself hard.
dos:3b6ae0d4668fb6e2.title: Everest Explorer

dos:3b72970a23ee87da.description: The fourth Papyrus racing game and sequel to IndyCar Racing. It has fifteen tracks and 640x480 SVGA graphics, with improvements introduced in NASCAR Racing.
dos:3b72970a23ee87da.title: IndyCar Racing II

dos:3b759e56322330a6.description: An educational puzzle game about logic circuits. Move a square through rooms containing AND, OR and NOT gates, flip-flops, delays and clocks and wire them together.
dos:3b759e56322330a6.title: Rocky's Boots

dos:3b773d64b4e536c9.description: A space strategy game in which you design your own colony, transports and cruisers, allocate resources and do research and development.
dos:3b773d64b4e536c9.title: Berserker Raids

dos:3b869fb3ecd2dfc7.description: A rare Spanish puzzle arcade game in which you play a brave painter who must paint a large surface while being hunted.
dos:3b869fb3ecd2dfc7.title: Brocha Gorda

dos:3b8fe2304283ffde.description: An interactive adventure through the human body. Zoom down the spinal column, watch blood cells flow through veins, and climb down the brain, with an interactive encyclopedia.
dos:3b8fe2304283ffde.title: 3-D Body Adventure

dos:3b959675e21e121f.description: A helicopter flight simulator by Digital Integration recreating the AH-64 Apache, with realistically simulated controls.
dos:3b959675e21e121f.title: Tomahawk

dos:3b97ce5d507c42cf.description: A shareware word puzzle based on US vanity license plates. For example, PPNRTYM stands for Peace In Our Time.
dos:3b97ce5d507c42cf.title: Tommy's Plates

dos:3ba2159cffbc4594.description: A baseball simulation in which you replay individual games or whole seasons, past or present, with a built-in Stat Compiler keeping a permanent record of your team's statistics.
dos:3ba2159cffbc4594.title: Pure-Stat Baseball

dos:3ba7069f4c181b11.description: An arcade-style women's boxing game for one or two players with stylized, doll-like fighters.
dos:3ba7069f4c181b11.title: Total Knockout: Championship Female Boxing

dos:3ba97d48a89edb0d.description: A platformer based on the Disney series. Control Chip, helped by Dale who is computer controlled, breaking through obstacles set by Professor Nimnul.
dos:3ba97d48a89edb0d.title: Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers: The Adventures in Nimnul's Castle

dos:3bab340bcdb926bf.description: An early flight simulator in which you fly a Harrier jet with V/STOL, VIFF, heat-seeking missiles and friend-or-foe radar over Grenada in 1984, avoiding SAMs.
dos:3bab340bcdb926bf.title: Harrier Combat Simulator

dos:3bad924e13f37259.description: The second game in the Great Naval Battles series, set in the South Pacific around the 1942-43 struggle for Guadalcanal.
dos:3bad924e13f37259.title: Great Naval Battles Vol. II: Guadalcanal 1942-43

dos:3bb245ff59db1e2a.description: A text adventure comedy in which you are Kuulest's slave, sent to recover the Orb of Studosity from the evil Unnkulians.
dos:3bb245ff59db1e2a.title: Unnkulian Underworld : The Unknown Unventure

dos:3bbb59fd62370c67.description: A tactical simulation of small-unit actions in World War II, a sequel to Panzer Strike with similar rules, covering the Pacific, Asian and other theaters.
dos:3bbb59fd62370c67.title: Typhoon of Steel

dos:3bbb6834a681c249.description: A tile-based platforming puzzle game made in QBasic, with 5 levels and source code included.
dos:3bbb6834a681c249.title: NumJump

dos:3bccfe7d41bd24ee.description: A boxing game in which you play a boxer's career. Create your boxer by trading off attributes, and fight from a first-person view.
dos:3bccfe7d41bd24ee.title: TKO

dos:3bd3b695cc914723.description: A touch-typing tutorial with games for practice, including sentence typing tests and a Tic-Tac-Toe game.
dos:3bd3b695cc914723.title: Proto Type

dos:3bd3c31816c74a66.description: You are a reporter for a big city newspaper investigating the stabbing of a rival reporter. Follow suspects, listen in on conversations and search their homes while they're away.
dos:3bd3c31816c74a66.title: The Scoop

dos:3bedb3d17f554846.description: A text adventure based on the film in which James Bond foils Goldfinger's plan to seize the world's gold supply.
dos:3bedb3d17f554846.title: James Bond 007: Goldfinger

dos:3bf47436ae74bbf7.description: A sequel to Soviet Block, a falling-block puzzle, this time with two-player head-to-head play.
dos:3bf47436ae74bbf7.title: Soviet Block II

dos:3c0b47791b0810cd.description: A racing game in which you pilot small aircraft through a multi-textured half-pipe in the Powerdrome racing series, entered by Typhoon Racing.
dos:3c0b47791b0810cd.title: Powerdrome

dos:3c0ccbe739924dcb.description: A single-player strategy game spun off from Star Control 2, with an extensive original story, exploration, battles, planet landings and dialog with other characters.
dos:3c0ccbe739924dcb.title: Fibs and Brags in Outer Space!

dos:3c0f1e3195125f20.description: A Sierra-style adventure created with Quest Maker.
dos:3c0f1e3195125f20.title: Hot Rod Harry

dos:3c2f2ecfe4fefe4b.description: A limited edition with MechWarrior 2: 31st Century Combat and Ghost Bear's Legacy. You are a genetically engineered Clan MechWarrior as the Clans invade the Inner Sphere.
dos:3c2f2ecfe4fefe4b.title: MechWarrior 2: Limited Edition

dos:3c372930135a7baa.description: The seventh Scott Adams adventure, set in an amusement park. Your first puzzle is getting past the turnstiles, then you solve the mystery of the place.
dos:3c372930135a7baa.title: Mystery Fun House

dos:3c3f2dd3a4f18b59.description: A strategy board game like Archon: move different types of dinosaurs on a chess-like board, with combat decided by action scenes.
tags: Action; Board Game / Party Game; Strategy
dos:3c3f2dd3a4f18b59.title: Dino Wars

dos:3c4fa8a7701c936a.description: A soccer management simulation in which you take over Leeds United, English champions of 1991/92, in the fourth division and try to climb back to the top.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:3c4fa8a7701c936a.title: Leeds United Champions

dos:3c5110a0bc37bfb0.description: A short AGI adventure sequel in which Richard travels to New York hoping to meet a television star. Explore the city and type commands to solve puzzles.
dos:3c5110a0bc37bfb0.title: F♥ck Quest 2: Romancing the B♥ne

dos:3c5222ab53c5c1a6.description: A fantasy text adventure with graphics. After Lord Drakul's defeat, Prince Erik and Princess Sabrina are shipwrecked by a giant wave and are brought back ashore.
dos:3c5222ab53c5c1a6.title: Transylvania III: Vanquish the Night

dos:3c5ff8e4863d9390.description: A pinball simulator with a single medieval-themed table shown on one screen, with score and bonus indicators and hot-seat multiplayer.
dos:3c5ff8e4863d9390.title: Solid State Pinball: Tristan

dos:3c67401566df2b79.description: One of the oldest PC games, written in 1980 and converted to the IBM PC in 1981, probably the first chess game for MS-DOS.
dos:3c67401566df2b79.title: Chess (1981)

dos:3c71973f01302c77.description: A sea-faring simulation and strategy game in which you play a member of the Franco family, once influential in Portugal, rebuilding its fortunes after a disastrous voyage to find the kingdom of Prester John.
dos:3c71973f01302c77.title: Uncharted Waters

dos:3c73d845ecd0dfad.description: An alphabet learning game with two modes, Beginner's Alphabet and Alphabet Master, playable with a friend on one PC or against the computer.
dos:3c73d845ecd0dfad.title: Discover the Alphabet

dos:3c778516aee662da.description: An early squad-based combat strategy game in a medieval fantasy world. Choose Human, Orc, Dwarf or Elf, each with strengths and weaknesses, and clear out areas of opponents.
dos:3c778516aee662da.title: Battle Master

dos:3c7c6e48f5683cd0.description: A two-player fighting game with 8 humorous characters, including Bill Clinton, in best-of-three shooting rounds.
dos:3c7c6e48f5683cd0.title: Outlaw 1997

dos:3c8bde8a49b7b75b.description: A prototype side-view ski jumping game in the Ski King series. Press enter to start skiing, and use the up and down arrows to perform tricks.
dos:3c8bde8a49b7b75b.title: Ski King 3

dos:3c94c6bd502b5df5.description: A shareware side-scrolling action game in which Fred investigates to discover an access code, collecting gems and food and killing enemies along the way.
dos:3c94c6bd502b5df5.title: FBI Fred

dos:3caea6e98b851ddf.description: An educational game for children aged two to six with four games, from an entry level that shows a picture and plays a song for each key press, to more advanced variations.
dos:3caea6e98b851ddf.title: ABC Fun Keys

dos:3cb866a8e7fd4533.description: A beat 'em up in which Spider-Man and Captain America team up against Dr. Doom, who plans to blow up New York City with a stolen atomic bomb.
dos:3cb866a8e7fd4533.title: The Amazing Spider-Man and Captain America in Dr. Doom's Revenge!

dos:3cb8a4c40020ee86.description: A dice game played with six dice, in which you roll certain dice and combinations to accumulate a predetermined winning score.
dos:3cb8a4c40020ee86.title: Farkle

dos:3cc53c562122cac3.description: A text adventure in which a starship has run out of energy near a planet, and as Captain you use what remains to teleport six crew members to the surface.
dos:3cc53c562122cac3.title: Landing Party

dos:3ccbbe93b5e4f914.description: The sequel to Thexder. The Fire Hawk robot has a laser, a shield and the ability to transform into a jet, plus special weapons.
dos:3ccbbe93b5e4f914.title: Fire Hawk: Thexder - The Second Contact

dos:3cce8f80202236d3.description: A two-player puzzle game in which you build a solid bridge from one side of a dot-filled board to the other while blocking your opponent from doing the same.
dos:3cce8f80202236d3.title: Double Cross

dos:3cdda79109d5f9fc.description: A collection of three Breakout variants, Brick Wall, Falling Walls and The Blast Adventure, in Moraffware's colorful style.
dos:3cdda79109d5f9fc.title: Moraff's Blast I

dos:3ce1b2ece61d4bcb.description: A simple space shooter on one-screen levels. Shoot everything that moves, such as snake formations of smiley faces or descending alien ships, to reach the next level, and collect power-ups.
dos:3ce1b2ece61d4bcb.title: Turn n' Burn

dos:3ce34b34e39d8921.description: A shareware quiz game for up to four players, from the Trivia Shell series where the question packs can be swapped for other subjects, with three levels of difficulty.
dos:3ce34b34e39d8921.title: General Trivia

dos:3ceac49be8d0dc5c.description: In the far future you are an engineer sent to update an outdated defense base with automation code, when the base is suddenly invaded by unknown forces.
dos:3ceac49be8d0dc5c.title: Defcon 5

dos:3cede3e3af769186.description: A futuristic 3D racing game in the style of Hi-Octane, through futuristic cities and tunnels. It features damage and special upgrades.
dos:3cede3e3af769186.title: Track Attack

dos:3cf554e5ebeaf5c1.description: A point-and-click edutainment adventure from Sierra, the makers of EcoQuest and Dr. Brain, in which Pepper travels through time.
dos:3cf554e5ebeaf5c1.title: Pepper's Adventures in Time

dos:3cff6a67703a9dc3.description: The twelfth and final adventure in the main Scott Adams series. The king is ill, and you must retrieve a magic elixir from a faraway land before it is too late.
dos:3cff6a67703a9dc3.title: Golden Voyage

dos:3d059b484a699f91.description: The first of Automated Simulations' Dunjonquest role-playing games and one of the earliest computer RPGs, a graphical dungeon crawl resembling a roguelike.
dos:3d059b484a699f91.title: Dunjonquest: Temple of Apshai

dos:3d0b66ec9a4adbcf.description: A free fighting game by two friends. Under a gloomy sky two strange little men, one green (you) and one grey, fight, each with a health bar that falls on impact.
dos:3d0b66ec9a4adbcf.title: Marble Fighter

dos:3d0fffc1710c7f28.description: A shooter based on the film. Patrolman Alex Murphy is killed in Detroit and rebuilt by Omni Consumer Products as the cyborg law enforcement officer RoboCop.
dos:3d0fffc1710c7f28.title: RoboCop (1989)

dos:3d141120cd7785de.description: A kart racing game with karts reaching 130 MPH. Choose from three classes of engines, 4 types of chassis and 4 types of tires.
dos:3d141120cd7785de.title: Virtual Karts

dos:3d185febd16f39d0.description: An Israeli motorcycle racing game with little text. The menu offers a new game, a non-interactive demonstration and other items.
dos:3d185febd16f39d0.title: Moto Grand Prix

dos:3d1d09b9fb374aaf.description: A commercial add-on for Doom II with all-new sprites and maps on the Doom engine. Run through levels, kill monsters and search for keycards, with some new features.
dos:3d1d09b9fb374aaf.title: HacX

dos:3d232fd968a357b6.description: A Spanish arcade shooter in which you destroy alien flying saucers, moving endlessly forward and scoring for each kill.
dos:3d232fd968a357b6.title: Ovni

dos:3d2bd8d471a9d999.description: Pilot the Cobra Mark IV General Contact Vehicle, a highly maneuverable stellar craft with beam lasers front and rear and missile launchers, in a space combat game.
dos:3d2bd8d471a9d999.title: LineWars

dos:3d3420e1489536f6.description: A solitaire card game with a twist: you have a money budget, and making moves costs money.
dos:3d3420e1489536f6.title: Las Vegas Solitaire

dos:3d3a6bf1b4c7cca2.description: An action puzzle game in text-only ANSI graphics. You play ANSI Dude, who lands his spacecraft on a strange planet and enters a 2D world.
dos:3d3a6bf1b4c7cca2.title: The Amazing Adventures of ANSI Dude

dos:3d3c771538939404.description: Pirates of the mad Emperor Louis the 30th have captured your best friend Jean. Blast through seven islands in a heavily armed hovercraft, destroying armed and armored enemies, to rescue him.
dos:3d3c771538939404.title: Islands of Danger!

dos:3d3f750c48911f7c.description: A typical arcade-style side-scrolling space shooter. You fly a ship from left to right, starting with low firepower that grows with power-ups.
dos:3d3f750c48911f7c.title: Dark Moon

dos:3d424e902c1f5868.description: An interactive fiction game based on Frederick Forsyth's Cold War spy novel. As John Preston, you head the C1(A) agency of the intelligence service.
dos:3d424e902c1f5868.title: The Fourth Protocol

dos:3d512efc6dc83d3c.description: After his family is gunned down by gangsters, Frank Castle becomes The Punisher, cleaning up New York one criminal at a time. Raise $500,000 to pay off an enemy, in a game mixing shooting and driving.
dos:3d512efc6dc83d3c.title: The Punisher

dos:3d53b7caa72af0d7.description: Pilot your orb with paddles in a search for Vern Grenington and his entire vehicle service station, which vanished near a known black hole.
dos:3d53b7caa72af0d7.title: Beyond the Black Hole

dos:3d572bc8982196a9.description: A pure logic puzzle: flip all the red tiles back to gray in as few moves as possible, moving diagonally, up or down from any starting tile.
dos:3d572bc8982196a9.title: Raku Master

dos:3d58b9def5a81311.description: A Snake-style game. You start with a small train that is constantly moving and steer it with the arrow keys, keeping the ever-growing train alive to score points.
dos:3d58b9def5a81311.title: Tommy's Gorilla Ball Train

dos:3d5ec73c80487eb8.description: The second Kroz game, very similar to Kingdom of Kroz but with different level design and puzzles.
dos:3d5ec73c80487eb8.title: Dungeons of Kroz

dos:3d6c55f210d7c4ac.description: A first-person 2D flight simulation in which you fly a British RAF Mosquito to stop enemy trains, intercept V-1 buzz bombs, sink U-boats and shoot down bombers.
dos:3d6c55f210d7c4ac.title: Ace of Aces

dos:3d6ece92120a37dd.description: A Jeopardy! quiz show edition for younger players.
dos:3d6ece92120a37dd.title: Jeopardy! Junior Edition

dos:3d8d4d9f5766cd5e.description: A Sierra adventure based on the Disney film about Taran, an assistant pig-keeper whose pig Hen Wen has magical powers that the Horned King wants.
dos:3d8d4d9f5766cd5e.title: The Black Cauldron

dos:3d96da97dab2cc26.description: A single-player shareware peg solitaire with two classic board layouts, including the traditional cross-shaped board with thirty-three holes.
dos:3d96da97dab2cc26.title: Peg Solitaire

dos:3d96ddb01012dc36.description: A 3D environment created with Virtual Reality Studio by Incentive Software.
dos:3d96ddb01012dc36.title: BDream (VR Dream #1)

dos:3d97c8ba2ca266ac.description: The first of Geoff Crammond's Grand Prix series, known as World Circuit in the US, with all 16 circuits of 1991 in quick race, single race or full championship modes.
dos:3d97c8ba2ca266ac.title: World Circuit

dos:3d9add91cb9677d9.description: A short interactive story whose few details the player customizes before reading it.
dos:3d9add91cb9677d9.title: Fantasy

dos:3da604f222b82c4e.description: A soccer simulation branded with the Spanish striker Emilio Butragueno. There is no league or tournament, only a single match between the white and blue teams.
dos:3da604f222b82c4e.title: Emilio Butragueno Futbol

dos:3da70fb68cdf5c2e.description: An adventure in which your uncle Smoke Bailey lost an item holding the secrets of the universe, The Most Amazing Thing, somewhere in the Mire, and you go after it.
dos:3da70fb68cdf5c2e.title: In Search of the Most Amazing Thing

dos:3daf18939805930c.description: An adventure in which you explore a wire-frame 3D maze that holds the abandoned headquarters of the FIRX Underground Empire, a factory of magical and technical items.
dos:3daf18939805930c.title: Fue

dos:3dc652db37e28b06.description: An arcade-puzzle game set in 2099 in a lab-fortress orbiting Phobos, left behind by a mysterious long-dead civilization.
dos:3dc652db37e28b06.title: Phobos '99

dos:3dce53ac44ff9975.description: An action game in three phases, the third more arcade-like than the first two. The protagonist Atahualpa Yupanqui aspires to obtain the Sacred Sword.
dos:3dce53ac44ff9975.title: La Espada Sagrada

dos:3dd575a852c759c0.description: A single-player trick-taking card game for three, in which you take the north seat and the computer plays the other two.
dos:3dd575a852c759c0.title: Tommy's Six-Bid Solo

dos:3dd5842f16fdf267.description: A typical vertical-scrolling shoot 'em up with EGA graphics, one of Apogee's attempts at a commercial-level shareware game.
dos:3dd5842f16fdf267.title: Major Stryker

dos:3de4ae1fe5c711e6.description: The fifth Microsoft Flight Simulator, adding SVGA graphics, textures in certain areas, sound card support and two new flight areas, Paris and Munich. It was the last DOS-only release.
dos:3de4ae1fe5c711e6.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (v5.1)

dos:3de90a29076b8832.description: A medieval beat 'em up similar to Golden Axe, in which a lone warrior travels the land killing beasts on his way to an evil lord.
dos:3de90a29076b8832.title: Targhan

dos:3debde7cfcf0ade7.description: A top-down giant robot shooter. Pilot an egg-shaped robot and shoot everything in sight, first as a walker and then inside the main complex.
dos:3debde7cfcf0ade7.title: Final Orbit

dos:3df4f9ce2f0f4f00.description: A math game for ages 10 to adult, going beyond Math Blaster Plus to word problems and pre-algebra, with puzzle activities such as math versions of Hangman and the Towers of Hanoi.
dos:3df4f9ce2f0f4f00.title: Math Blaster Mystery

dos:3e016602d2be9c55.description: A classic role-playing game in which the Black Knights have taken over the island of Gelnor. Defeat them and their master Nikademus. It was one of the first RPGs with a bank for storing money.
dos:3e016602d2be9c55.title: Phantasie

dos:3e048acf5f407a03.description: A lighthearted text adventure in which you are a Harvard student living in Dudley House, solving puzzles and navigating with an unclear goal.
dos:3e048acf5f407a03.title: A Dudley Dilemma

dos:3e0742846e77cfda.description: A cricket game focused on the Ashes, the fabled tours between England and Australia, for one or two players.
dos:3e0742846e77cfda.title: Battle for the Ashes 97

dos:3e1f1428663cb8cb.description: A role-playing game following Books I and II. The seal on the wizard Paltivar has been broken, and the kingdoms of Thaine face his return to the lands of Yendor.
dos:3e1f1428663cb8cb.title: Yendorian Tales: The Tyrants of Thaine

dos:3e22616d319152c2.description: A two-player domino game. Each player has five square tiles with numbers on each side and places them on a seven-by-nine grid, next to tiles with matching numbers.
dos:3e22616d319152c2.title: FourSide

dos:3e39c48213033526.description: An educational adventure set in Europe, similar to Carmen Sandiego, in which you track the jewel thief and smuggler Dr. Xavier Tortion, known as Dr. X.
dos:3e39c48213033526.title: The Spy's Adventures in Europe

dos:3e3fe8ba139b55b1.description: An action-strategy game in which Space Dude, a dorky teenager on a surfboard, defends the Golden City from KingDorf and his Hoppers, choosing missions along the way.
dos:3e3fe8ba139b55b1.title: Space Dude

dos:3e40a173031a39c6.description: A text-only interactive fiction game in which you must destroy the evil plot Dr. Beauvias is preparing.
dos:3e40a173031a39c6.title: Voodoo Island

dos:3e418db2eb507b50.description: An action game based on the film in which the Enterprise, with a skeleton crew and a barely functioning ship, heads into the Neutral Zone to deal with the situation on Nimbus III.
dos:3e418db2eb507b50.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier

dos:3e42dea78d2fdac0.description: A Korean-made versus fighting game with one-player and two-player modes and no story, offering eight selectable fighters.
dos:3e42dea78d2fdac0.title: The Great Fighter

dos:3e448735888f4f5b.description: A wrestling and versus-fighting hybrid with over-the-top moves, the successor to WWF WrestleMania: The Arcade Game.
dos:3e448735888f4f5b.title: WWF in Your House

dos:3e4e01585c06ebf8.description: A World War II submarine simulation in which you command a US submarine against the Japanese in the Pacific after the attack on Pearl Harbor.
dos:3e4e01585c06ebf8.title: Silent Service II

dos:3e5118bdb438029f.description: A space flight shooter in which Earth is a wasteland and giant transport ships carrying 10 million people each are launched to find a new world, with you piloting ahead of one of them.
dos:3e5118bdb438029f.title: Lightspeed

dos:3e5d1de2ecd3efc8.description: A World War II scenario created with Domark's original Flight Sim Toolkit.
dos:3e5d1de2ecd3efc8.title: Flight Sim Toolkit: World War II

dos:3e7317e9dc579240.description: A rare instant puzzle game. Each level is a set of consecutive screens, and a password is given after passing them so you can resume later.
dos:3e7317e9dc579240.title: 4-Get-It

dos:3e77d3614ad2161c.description: A scrolling space shooter with 4 similar levels, each split into two parts, the second harder because it ends in a boss. Destroy everything and try to survive.
dos:3e77d3614ad2161c.title: Arya Vaiv

dos:3e78cda5a1a463e7.description: A artillery game in which you shoot the tank at the other end of the hill by choosing the angle and force of your shot. Play against the computer or with a friend.
dos:3e78cda5a1a463e7.title: Tank Wars (1986)

dos:3e810ad60af427bd.description: A simple platformer written in Turbo Pascal. Collect all the treasures to complete each of 12 levels, with 2 types of enemies.
dos:3e810ad60af427bd.title: Diplo

dos:3e86ec12fdcef209.description: You are private investigator Tom Scool, hired to sneak into a famous actress's chalet posing as the thriller writer Eric Wells and steal her precious gem Vesnu.
dos:3e86ec12fdcef209.title: In the Dead of Night

dos:3e89b4de3d4a8709.description: A platformer in which a retired superhero must recover diamonds stolen by the insane genius Austen van Flyswatter, navigating fiendish arrangements of platforms and traps.
dos:3e89b4de3d4a8709.title: Captain Dynamo

dos:3e92e028e3fa62d7.description: A freeware sumo game in which each wrestler has his own stats and personality, with taunts and cries as you play, adding a layer of strategy.
dos:3e92e028e3fa62d7.title: Sumo Wrestling

dos:3ea00eb84e5cf882.description: A platoon-level tactical simulation of armored warfare between NATO and the Soviet Union in the 1990s, for up to 2 players, with 4 historical scenarios.
dos:3ea00eb84e5cf882.title: Mech Brigade

dos:3ea8b4434158a7d0.description: A 3D shooter in which you drive a little red tank and blast enemies, in the style of Battlezone, choosing among three tanks with different speed, armor and firepower.
dos:3ea8b4434158a7d0.title: Spectre

dos:3ea9b328639b25bc.description: As a new reporter for Headline Harry, editor of the US Daily Star, you must prove yourself by getting the story fast and right against Marvin Muckraker and his reporters.
tags: Adventure; Board Game / Party Game; Education
dos:3ea9b328639b25bc.title: Headline Harry and The Great Paper Race

dos:3ebb6d11252ba8df.description: The CD-ROM release of Strike Commander, including Strike Commander and Tactical Operations, with an extra opening cinematic and digitized speech.
dos:3ebb6d11252ba8df.title: Strike Commander (CD-ROM Edition)

dos:3eda5afe8433ccb4.description: A business simulation of the airline industry that avoids bogging you down in details. Starting in 1946, build up a successful airline from small beginnings.
dos:3eda5afe8433ccb4.title: Air Bucks

dos:3ee02fa33e64b8c5.description: An ASCII RPG, surprisingly deep, that plays like a roguelike but is not random. It has people to talk to, shops to buy items from, and a large world.
dos:3ee02fa33e64b8c5.title: Wizard's Lair

dos:3ee7307b4ed20773.description: A horror text adventure in which you, a horror novel author, stay for a month in an old manor with a history of its own.
dos:3ee7307b4ed20773.title: Hampton Manor

dos:3eeae6ed1941e4ef.description: A turn-based RPG built with an RPG creation engine, set in the Evil Dead movie world, in which you explore the familiar cabin as Ash.
dos:3eeae6ed1941e4ef.title: Evil Dead Timeline

dos:3ef0ac8669e1dd24.description: An amateur Australian arcade go-kart game with 3 speed classes, plus a practical course called Driving Instructions for learning the controls.
dos:3ef0ac8669e1dd24.title: Billabong Racers

dos:3ef270cb1bfd4610.description: A fan-made game with a plot related to Castlevania, based on Castlevania II: Simon's Quest and able to run under DOS.
dos:3ef270cb1bfd4610.title: Dracula's Shadow

dos:3ef3a25ff5edd244.description: The second and last game of the Worlds of Ultima series, in which the hero travels to Mars at the turn of the century, chatting with characters of 19th century history.
dos:3ef3a25ff5edd244.title: Ultima Worlds of Adventure 2: Martian Dreams

dos:3ef438cb8de6fa19.description: A puzzle game against the clock in which you contain gushing oil by creating a series of passages to control its flow.
dos:3ef438cb8de6fa19.title: Oil Cap

dos:3f12d03e2801a21f.description: A tactical simulation of the Battle of the Alamo, February 23 to March 6, 1836. You command the Texian defenders, a handful of riflemen and cannons, and try to fend off the attackers.
dos:3f12d03e2801a21f.title: Defend The Alamo

dos:3f34ca1934e82f33.description: A platform shooter in which an evil woman, Gremla, rules the five planet confederations beyond Alpha Centauri with an army of Terminators, and you fight to stop her.
dos:3f34ca1934e82f33.title: Game Over

dos:3f38464bc202a1c7.description: A digital conversion of a carnival game released by the School of Telecommunications Engineering of Barcelona as a stress-relief tool. Control a student armed with eggs and tomatoes.
dos:3f38464bc202a1c7.title: Pim-Pam-Pum

dos:3f3fbfa856dd1775.description: An educational game in which children practice addition, subtraction, multiplication or division, with grade levels from 1st to 6th. The games are timed.
dos:3f3fbfa856dd1775.title: Yogi Bear's Math Adventures

dos:3f478cfe74d564b9.description: A text adventure from the book Creating Adventure Games On Your Computer, one of four sample adventures typed in and compiled in BASIC to teach interactive fiction design.
dos:3f478cfe74d564b9.title: Werewolves and Wanderers

dos:3f4ac43c6865331e.description: The sequel to Nobunaga's Ambition, set in feudal Japan of the 16th century, where daimyo contend for dominance and the winner becomes Shogun.
dos:3f4ac43c6865331e.title: Nobunaga's Ambition II

dos:3f4f664719417df2.description: A text adventure in the South American jungles, in the footsteps of archaeologist Dr. Paul Jamison, a friend who disappeared while seeking the secrets of the Incas.
dos:3f4f664719417df2.title: Inca (1985)

dos:3f523e61db9dfdbb.description: A one-on-one basketball game in front of a single basket, as Julius Erving or Larry Bird, playing to a score or a time limit.
dos:3f523e61db9dfdbb.title: One-on-One

dos:3f70a114bea97e02.description: A freeware pool game for one or two players, controlled with the mouse, with an undo feature and performance stats for each player.
dos:3f70a114bea97e02.title: Another Pool

dos:3f769c3822e95179.description: The 1997 edition of EA's NHL series, with a refined virtual stadium system and new camera angles, including the top-down view missing from NHL 96.
dos:3f769c3822e95179.title: NHL 97

dos:3f873e24f26c670c.description: A side-scrolling beat 'em up in which you play a ninja fighting everyone in his path, armed with a dagger and a shuriken you can throw.
dos:3f873e24f26c670c.title: Ninja

dos:3f8ce57b1d80753b.description: A rare mahjong-style tile-matching game, despite the chess-sounding name.
dos:3f8ce57b1d80753b.title: Equalizer's CheckMate

dos:3f987330e6ae6b39.description: A single-player shareware contract bridge game in which you always play the South hand. It uses US practices with the Goren Point-Count method for hand evaluation.
dos:3f987330e6ae6b39.title: Contract Bridge

dos:3f9ca8d41c5d835a.description: A version of the code-breaking classic Mastermind. Guess the color code by placing pegs on the board, getting a white mark for each correct color and a red mark for each correct position.
dos:3f9ca8d41c5d835a.title: Mastermind (1993)

dos:3fa4b3b3a107082d.description: A go-kart racing game in which you play one of eight wacky animals, including a tiger, elephant, raccoon, panda and shark, each with its own animations, using a variety of special items.
dos:3fa4b3b3a107082d.title: Wacky Wheels

dos:3fa8157dd1ba7ee4.description: A diving game: earn points by collecting rare fish and opening treasure chests along the ocean floor, finding keys in each underwater cavern.
dos:3fa8157dd1ba7ee4.title: ScubaVenture

dos:3fab066d780c65ee.description: A conversion of the TSR board war game of Middle East conflicts, including the Gulf War and hypothetical conflicts involving nations like Iran, Israel and Saudi Arabia.
dos:3fab066d780c65ee.title: A Line in the Sand

dos:3fb25d53ade5a491.description: An arcade conversion in which a soldier in a goofy hat attacks an enemy base in a side-scrolling platform action game.
dos:3fb25d53ade5a491.title: Rush'n Attack

dos:3fb508778ae84ca1.description: A checkers-like game for two players. Get a ball onto the opponent's base while stopping them from doing the same, playing red or green balls.
dos:3fb508778ae84ca1.title: Funball

dos:3fc18381e90f2c97.description: An arcade game in which you play Rollo and paint the entire section while evading the Brush Brothers to progress.
dos:3fc18381e90f2c97.title: Rollo and the Brush Brothers

dos:3fccbdc55af2da48.description: The second King's Quest. King Graham, newly crowned, needs a queen and turns to the magic mirror, which shows him a maiden to rescue.
dos:3fccbdc55af2da48.title: King's Quest II: Romancing the Throne

dos:3fcd7139699401be.description: A 3D shooter in which you stop an alien invasion that began with a near doubling of UFO sightings over the city, which the media dismissed as hoaxes.
dos:3fcd7139699401be.title: Alien Cabal

dos:3fcdf940ee28c9ff.description: An enhanced Pac-Man-style game in which you clear mazes full of dots while evading pursuing ghosts, with power pellets that let you hunt them for a limited time.
dos:3fcdf940ee28c9ff.title: Greedy

dos:3fce56ae361d0560.description: A scrolling shooter in which you are sent on a space mining expedition, harvesting ores with a ship that has a finite supply of fuel and a robot arm to collect them.
dos:3fce56ae361d0560.title: Space Miner (1983)

dos:3fd722df5c3cbf3a.description: A puzzle game loosely licensed from the 7Up soft drink, for up to 4 human or computer players, each taking spots of a particular color from opposite corners.
dos:3fd722df5c3cbf3a.title: Spot

dos:3fe4747730229103.description: The first of Scott Adams' text adventures. Using simple two-word commands, explore an enchanted world, solve puzzles and recover 13 lost treasures.
dos:3fe4747730229103.title: Adventureland

dos:3ff89873f4151fed.description: A single-player multimedia educational title with a science quiz, which is not an encyclopedia and not as straightforward as it sounds.
