dos:3ff89873f4151fed.title: Isaac Asimov: Science Adventure

dos:400c46d673def0b1.description: A 9KB remake of Asteroids: your ship is confined to a wrap-around sector of space and must survive incoming rocks by breaking them into smaller bits, steering by rotating and thrusting.
dos:400c46d673def0b1.title: Blastocyst

dos:400d6eb334058e9b.description: A space shooter with Asteroids-like controls, in which you shoot at the center, where an enemy craft protected by several force shields fires back.
dos:400d6eb334058e9b.title: XOLO

dos:400dd1b5f865c9f2.description: An ASCII text air traffic control simulation, very similar to Air Traffic Controller. Guide planes to land safely before they run out of fuel or crash.
dos:400dd1b5f865c9f2.title: Air Trax

dos:40228e221905e036.description: A pirate adventure on the Caribbean island of Melee, where Guybrush Threepwood wants to be a pirate and must pass three challenges set by the Pirate Leaders, starting with insult sword fighting.
dos:40228e221905e036.title: The Secret of Monkey Island

dos:402ea4fb83b4a261.description: The sequel to PC Futbol, updated for the 1994/95 Spanish Primera Division season, with database and line-ups.
dos:402ea4fb83b4a261.title: PC Futbol 3.0

dos:4035618ae42959a1.description: A Scott Adams text adventure created for the TI that was the only one not to require the separate TI Adventure cartridge.
dos:4035618ae42959a1.title: Return to Pirate's Island

dos:4036599ad4b7f5d7.description: A puzzle game in which you play a pyromaniac who hides gas cans around a building the night before, then the next day goes to the top floor with a ball of cotton to light it.
dos:4036599ad4b7f5d7.title: Pyro II

dos:403fede7ba7b8578.description: A text-based soccer management simulator licensed for the 1994 World Cup in the USA, focused on national teams. You decide the team composition and general strategy.
dos:403fede7ba7b8578.title: World Cup All Time Greats

dos:40604a4265ee3005.description: A text adventure set in downtown Rhondale Circle. Find the secret item and deposit it in the secret container.
dos:40604a4265ee3005.title: Hick Town

dos:40608f1d794606d9.description: A soccer game based on the 1994 World Cup in the USA, with information on stadiums, schedules, teams and real players, and single matches or a full championship.
dos:40608f1d794606d9.title: USA Soccer '94

dos:406d19ad084d897f.description: A medical simulation with over 400 cases at Legacy Memorial Hospital. Examine patients, choose tests and treatments, and handle follow-up care with reference material available throughout.
dos:406d19ad084d897f.title: Emergency Room

dos:406f084551379e04.description: A clone of the old Star Trek text strategy game. As commander of the GUARDIAN, find the ships of the Alien empire with the scanner and fire torpedoes while raising shields.
dos:406f084551379e04.title: Space Guardian

dos:4075016216a00b54.description: A Crystal Quest variant: pilot a little spaceship with inertia and collect gems, using the mouse, until the exit opens.
dos:4075016216a00b54.title: XQuest

dos:40826f4f8cfafa57.description: A top-down shooter with the same basic gameplay as Loaded or The Chaos Engine. Choose your character and weapons, then destroy the enemy and retrieve the lost items.
dos:40826f4f8cfafa57.title: Cyberdogs

dos:4089efec24629da6.description: A graphic adventure set in futuristic Australia, where corporate-owned cities are separated by a wasteland called The Gap. Robert Foster is captured by soldiers from Union City after his tribe is killed.
dos:4089efec24629da6.title: Beneath a Steel Sky

dos:408ef524d7ba5498.description: Jean-Pierre's biggest adventure yet, with more dungeons, more items, a new map feature, and an option to skip random battle encounters.
dos:408ef524d7ba5498.title: Chronicles of Galia: The Shadow of Evil

dos:408ef9eb177126f7.description: A Wild West game featuring William H. Bonney, Billy the Kid, and his adversary Sheriff Pat Garrett, both hired by the rancher John Tunstall to protect Lincoln County from outlaws.
dos:408ef9eb177126f7.title: Billy the Kid

dos:4093c87775eb334d.description: A five-card draw poker game at Buck Mann's casino. Cut the deck, place a bet and replace cards once.
dos:4093c87775eb334d.title: The Original Buck Mann's Poker for One

dos:4093e84b255333aa.description: A comedy science fiction graphic adventure that, unlike its predecessor, is played entirely with point-and-click mouse controls and needs a Sound Blaster-compatible card.
dos:4093e84b255333aa.title: Captain Spleen 2

dos:409d26973bef6567.description: Help Roger Rabbit get out of each room he is stuck in so he can capture Baby Herman before Mommy returns home, by making him pull, push, kick, slide and jump on objects.
dos:409d26973bef6567.title: Hare Raising Havoc

dos:40aa81ef27204e11.description: An international-team football game released ahead of the 1998 World Cup, with modes including practice situations such as corners, dribbling and free kicks.
dos:40aa81ef27204e11.title: Kick Off 98

dos:40b4c52eaf366012.description: A role-playing game in which the heroes of N.E.O., the New Earth Organization, are sent to diplomatic talks on Venus after defeating the forces of R.A.M.
dos:40b4c52eaf366012.title: Buck Rogers: Matrix Cubed

dos:40bb15a6603dccee.description: A violent side-scrolling platform shooter starring a bunny named Toxic, who turns super aggressive when his coffee break is interrupted by the earth being covered in decaffeinated goo.
dos:40bb15a6603dccee.title: Toxic Bunny

dos:40bb68be544a151c.description: A strategy game in which you compete with three other players to become a rich landowner by carefully choosing which plots of land to buy.
dos:40bb68be544a151c.title: Speculator

dos:40bf1d32d4be473e.description: Guide a little girl around the screen collecting flowers while staying out of reach of a pursuing police officer.
dos:40bf1d32d4be473e.title: FlowerPower

dos:40bfbbf0fc0c2088.description: A puzzle game similar to Plotting. In each level, make all the colored blocks disappear from the screen by throwing blocks of the same color, in phases of five levels each.
dos:40bfbbf0fc0c2088.title: Throwland

dos:40c0d97eeb6b4425.description: A multi-player solitaire game in which you compete against 3 manga-style CPU players to play as many of your cards as possible while blocking the others.
dos:40c0d97eeb6b4425.title: Poker Relay

dos:40c92af6fc725378.description: Similar to Thexder, Wibarm adds puzzles, exploration and third-person 3D to a mix of arcade action and anime-style role-playing, with stats that grow with experience.
dos:40c92af6fc725378.title: Wibarm

dos:40fa30c9251700d2.description: A top-down action puzzle game quite like Paganitzu. As the gravedigger Samuel, collect jewels in the Loodam Crypts while avoiding monsters and traps.
dos:40fa30c9251700d2.title: Gravedigger

dos:40fdd8c8111a2389.description: A micro game testing speed, memory, concentration and dexterity: match as many elemental symbols with their index numbers as you can before the timer expires.
dos:40fdd8c8111a2389.title: L5RC

dos:40ffb13bf3235fef.description: A text adventure in which you are the rightful heir to the throne of Hamil, stolen as a child and unaware of your birthright, in a kingdom of magic known to you only through myths.
dos:40ffb13bf3235fef.title: Kingdom of Hamil

dos:4101d4d68054e26e.description: An encyclopedia and database of information about the earth, with an educational game that tests your knowledge.
dos:4101d4d68054e26e.title: Earthquest

dos:410b448f70cb6746.description: The second Scott Adams text adventure. You move between an ordinary London flat and two islands filled with dangerous creatures and people, in search of treasure.
dos:410b448f70cb6746.title: Pirate Adventure

dos:410c0ced4e2ca890.description: A basketball game with 64 licensed NCAA teams and exhibition, tournament and season modes, playable in arcade mode or coach mode where you call the plays.
dos:410c0ced4e2ca890.title: NCAA Championship Basketball

dos:410f69038661e10a.description: A game based on the movie Jaws, in which a giant shark terrorizes the beaches of the United States and Mexico.
dos:410f69038661e10a.title: Jaws

dos:411fad2e56f08d98.description: An educational puzzle game in which Billy Bat brags that he's the fastest animal in the world, and Robby the Rabbit challenges him to a race around the world.
dos:411fad2e56f08d98.title: Thinking Games 2

dos:412575b275eae25c.description: The final Jill of the Jungle game, with improved animations, new graphics, music, levels and many new enemies, and a map-based world not present in the first two games.
dos:412575b275eae25c.title: Jill of the Jungle: Jill Saves the Prince

dos:4141aabc69ae3252.description: An action game based on the Spielberg movie. Just after midnight, Gremlins and Mogwai run around Billy's living room and you control Billy from a third-person view.
dos:4141aabc69ae3252.title: Gremlins

dos:414dfa704b351e8a.description: A simple adaptation of the casino game Keno. Pick up to fifteen numbers out of eighty, then the computer draws twenty random numbers and you win if yours match.
dos:414dfa704b351e8a.title: Keno

dos:4158768346186b58.description: A shareware eco-strategy game for one player. On a map of an idyllic rural area, planners are building pavements everywhere, and you must build walls and clear pathways to prevent them.
dos:4158768346186b58.title: Green

dos:416085eca9f097b0.description: A very simple space shooter: shoot aliens before they reach your ship, using plasma guns and smart bombs. You score more for shooting them as soon as they appear.
dos:416085eca9f097b0.title: Kamikazi Alien

dos:416b597ff7746604.description: A role-playing game set in nineteenth-century London where Detective Mark Flint helps Jewel escape a secret society pursuing her unusual necklace, with turn-based battles in which ammunition and reloading matter.
dos:416b597ff7746604.title: GunBlaze

dos:416c7fa2a5de9ca7.description: A simple Easter egg hunt aimed at 7 to 12 year olds, mostly unlocking doors with color-coded keys and looking inside containers, with a religious side.
dos:416c7fa2a5de9ca7.title: Heather's Easter Egg Hunt

dos:4173860328dc4d28.description: The second Fire and Forget game, described as Crazy Cars (also by Titus) with weapons in a futuristic setting. In each of five levels you blast your way to the front of the pack.
dos:4173860328dc4d28.title: Fire & Forget II

dos:4176f029122bf96e.description: A 3D shooter like DOOM or Wolfenstein 3D in which no weapon hurts enemies, so it is non-violent. Your mission is to find the person responsible for sending you your cheese of the month samples.
dos:4176f029122bf96e.title: Bobenstein 3D

dos:41786bc96b02dc12.description: Find and kill the enemy cars. Your car is red and the enemy blue, and you are damaged by their bullets and crashes. It plays like an early prototype of Grand Theft Auto.
dos:41786bc96b02dc12.title: Road Kill

dos:417872c554f7d0c8.description: Space pilot Duke Skytripper is stranded on a backwater planet after an encounter with space rubble and too much beer, and sets out across the landscape in this strategy game.
dos:417872c554f7d0c8.title: Muck Men from MARS!

dos:417c4804bdb94776.description: A game-making system for creating your own Sierra-like adventure games, with EGA graphics and walk-behinds, though it can only make adventure games.
dos:417c4804bdb94776.title: Game Builder

dos:41816beb71a55a98.description: A direct sequel to Spear Resurrection, further extending the Spear of Destiny story. World War II is long over and the Spear is believed lost forever.
dos:41816beb71a55a98.title: Spear End of Destiny

dos:41952269f29802cd.description: A racing game with three championships open from the start, the Adventure Cup, Fun Cup and Danger Cup, and a choice of six fictionally named cars such as Big Boss and Yellow Cab.
dos:41952269f29802cd.title: 2 Fast 4 You

dos:41a90b2578060d0b.description: A Sierra adventure set in the ninth century, when Camelot has fallen under a curse of famine and drought because of the love triangle between King Arthur, Gwenhyver and Launcelot.
dos:41a90b2578060d0b.title: Conquests of Camelot: The Search for the Grail

dos:41aa4c8f63b7c593.description: A mystery adventure set in mid-17th century England on the property of Gallant Hall. You play the cavalier knight Sir Guy Gallant.
dos:41aa4c8f63b7c593.title: Sir Guy Gallant & The Deadly Warning

dos:41b994adea05e7b9.description: A PC port of an Amiga game, a hybrid of Bomberman and Soko-Ban. Up to four players can play, in two game modes.
dos:41b994adea05e7b9.title: Super Gem'Z

dos:41d3593b84e2e6e0.description: An enhancement for JetFighter II that adds 125 new missions and the ability to fly Lockheed's F-22 Lightning Advanced Tactical Fighter.
dos:41d3593b84e2e6e0.title: JetFighter II: Advanced Tactical Fighter

dos:41d9c451203eac23.description: An early character simulation in which you type sentences to converse with Terri, combining generated replies with live-action presentation.
dos:41d9c451203eac23.title: Girlfriend Terri

dos:41e186715c1bd7c4.description: A first-person shooter in which you are a magician called by the townspeople to defeat his ancient archrival Nemesis again.
dos:41e186715c1bd7c4.title: The Catacomb Abyss

dos:41e763a30bcf7f51.description: A first-person role-playing game in an abstract wireframe 3D style, using the VirtualDungeon engine, a reskin of Bob's Dragon Hunt in which the dragons are giant ants.
dos:41e763a30bcf7f51.title: Antkill

dos:41e89720d62fd8bc.description: Maneuver a balloon through levels without popping it. Air is released as you move, and losing too much also loses the game, while dangers are added as levels progress.
dos:41e89720d62fd8bc.title: Helious

dos:41ed979b1887927e.description: The first NBA Live on the PC, with all players of the 1994-95 season and the East and West All-Star teams. Manage over 300 players with the new General Manager feature.
dos:41ed979b1887927e.title: NBA Live 95

dos:4201444580eb5561.description: The official licensed game of the Atlanta Olympic Games, a 3D multi-event sports game with 15 events, including 100 meters, 400 meters, 100M crawl, javelin, hammer, discus and jumps.
dos:4201444580eb5561.title: Olympic Games: Atlanta 1996

dos:4210be70fd710705.description: An educational game in which jewel thief and smuggler Dr. Xavier Tortion (Dr. X) is on the loose in North America and you must find the jewels he stole.
dos:4210be70fd710705.title: The Spy's Adventures in North America

dos:421882d9ae8709c4.description: An indie platformer, the third of the Blinky series, with no connection to earlier games of that name.
dos:421882d9ae8709c4.title: Blinky 3

dos:4223e90d7070d042.description: A shoot 'em up inspired by Operation Wolf. As a lone soldier, shoot your way through waves of soldiers, tanks and helicopters with bullets and grenades, aiming with a crosshair.
dos:4223e90d7070d042.title: Veteran

dos:42274534d39280a2.description: An extraordinary, strange game: after selecting the player's shoe size, a baffling story sets up the rescue of a daughter.
dos:42274534d39280a2.title: Quest ][

dos:423194da8cb15397.description: A top-down soccer game recreating the 1994 World Cup, with the 24 qualifying teams plus other nations like England, France and Denmark.
dos:423194da8cb15397.title: World Cup USA 94

dos:4237575b0f03f5ac.description: The debut game of Mips Soft, a scrolling shooter whose enemies include monstrous fish-like creatures, space warships and robots.
dos:4237575b0f03f5ac.title: Fly 2020

dos:4237ced592258108.description: A budget game based on the 1980s TV show. Control Alf as he runs around the neighborhood collecting pizzas and avoiding cats and the man of the household.
dos:4237ced592258108.title: ALF: The First Adventure

dos:423f91e77fa6e14c.description: A role-playing game in which a party of heroes is ambushed and captured near Tilverton and cursed with five azure bonds, magical markings that can take control of them.
dos:423f91e77fa6e14c.title: Curse of the Azure Bonds

dos:42497376fd58f1b4.description: The last voyage of the starship USS Enterprise in a Star Trek adventure, beginning with your graduation from Starfleet.
dos:42497376fd58f1b4.title: Star Trek: The Last Generation

dos:4262f4dfa12d5b7c.description: A simple platformer in which an anthropomorphic wolf is tasked by a museum director to collect four objects from around the world.
dos:4262f4dfa12d5b7c.title: Around the World

dos:4265a5476b668206.description: A soccer game for the 1990 World Cup in Italy, with all participating national teams, though player names are fictional because it was unlicensed. You can create custom teams.
dos:4265a5476b668206.title: World Cup 90

dos:4267a1f44dc8d190.description: A Pong-based game for one or two players, on one machine or over a modem via XBAND PC. Balls launch from the center and players use paddles to keep them in play.
dos:4267a1f44dc8d190.title: Mortal Pong

dos:426e7630a664553f.description: Epyx's winter Olympics game with 8 events including figure skating, cross-country skiing, speed skating, ski jumping, slalom, downhill and luge, for up to 8 players.
dos:426e7630a664553f.title: The Games: Winter Edition

dos:42776c805eb48a7d.description: A variant of Bundesliga Manager Professional with the same gameplay but the English football league. Act as manager of a 3rd division team.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:42776c805eb48a7d.title: The Manager

dos:4280f7eb9abb6775.description: A role-playing game in which you are a Time Lord protecting the temporal balance of the universe, traveling to the Galaxy's End to stop Dr. Samuel Kurtz from reaching the dawn of time.
dos:4280f7eb9abb6775.title: Alien Fires: 2199 AD

dos:4281431c14e9c595.description: The sequel to Coktel Vision's surreal space combat adventure based on a fantasy take on Incan mythology. You begin as Atahualpa, El Dorado's spunky kid, who takes the family starship for a spin.
dos:4281431c14e9c595.title: Inca II: Nations of Immortality

dos:429028802627a4c4.description: A real-time strategy game set after a nuclear war that divided humanity into survivors and mutants, who fight a war over oil.
dos:429028802627a4c4.title: KKND: Krush Kill 'N Destroy

dos:4299f91879aad825.description: A falling-block puzzle game like Tetris but with hexagons, awarding a point per piece placed and extra points for each line cleared.
dos:4299f91879aad825.title: Hextris

dos:42a05e66855d1ff3.description: A BASIC-programmed Lunar Lander-type game. Land the Lunar Excursion Module on the white goal pad using the cursor keys to fire the left, right and vertical thrusters.
dos:42a05e66855d1ff3.title: Out on a LEM

dos:42adfd69b3fcd5bb.description: A 2D space shooter based on the 1987 TV series, set in the year 2147 when Earth is a wasteland.
dos:42adfd69b3fcd5bb.title: Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future

dos:42af76de857eb979.description: A business and strategy simulation in which captain Articus must raise 50,000 gold pieces to ransom his daughter, kidnapped by the pirate Bloodthroat, by transporting goods and battling.
dos:42af76de857eb979.title: Pirates of the Barbary Coast

dos:42b337204b807a03.description: A simple desktop publishing program for novices and children, with a step-by-step interface similar to The Print Shop and a variety of clip art.
dos:42b337204b807a03.title: The Newsroom

dos:42b5c78f9da8457d.description: A strategy game in which you choose one of four leaders, Scarlet, Oberon, Caesar or Madcap, and play 10 levels, the first 9 being groups of 3 territories.
dos:42b5c78f9da8457d.title: Mega lo Mania

dos:42c2ce2cb52386c6.description: A King's Quest-style adventure set in Jerusalem in 600 B.C., following Nephi's adventures as told in the Book of Mormon.
dos:42c2ce2cb52386c6.title: Nephi's Quest

dos:42c7b2632eca03f5.description: The third and last Spellcasting text adventure by Steve Meretzky at Legend Entertainment, set at a spring break.
dos:42c7b2632eca03f5.title: Spellcasting 301: Spring Break

dos:42cf0a988541bfe4.description: A shooter in which you act as a guardian angel saving the life of a small long-necked dinosaur cub.
dos:42cf0a988541bfe4.title: Dinos

dos:42d073a96c670031.description: The second Questron game. Start as a lowly peasant with a few gold coins and build up by exploring the countryside and fighting hordes of monsters.
dos:42d073a96c670031.title: Questron II

dos:42d264174350ece0.description: A football management game with over 50 teams from 15 European countries, each with its own league system.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:42d264174350ece0.title: Football Masters 99

dos:42d7da61444a0900.description: The action game of Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis. It starts in Monte Carlo, where Indy has recruited his former student Sophie and located ancient discs.
dos:42d7da61444a0900.title: Indiana Jones and The Fate of Atlantis: The Action Game

dos:42e23a158f6ff5ff.description: A game in which a whole solar system was bombed and the splinters of five planets drift through space, inhabited by rival clans who each want to claim a whole splinter. Play one clan.
dos:42e23a158f6ff5ff.title: Splitterwelten

dos:42e3870dc2af11d9.description: A futuristic hovercar racing and combat game in a 3D environment. A freelance Raider ventures into the dangerous Free Zone to scavenge rare and expensive items.
dos:42e3870dc2af11d9.title: Zone Raiders

dos:42e90357ebe19e3f.description: The last title in Sierra's Turbo Learning series. Kids learn simple algebra through 3 mini games and take tests to advance to the next level.
dos:42e90357ebe19e3f.title: Mega Math

dos:42f6910b61390219.description: A resurrection of the classic platform game with one- and two-player options, detailed graphics, a level editor, and music and sound effects.
dos:42f6910b61390219.title: Lode Runner: The Legend Returns

dos:43008ca57de918cb.description: A Harrier Jump Jet simulation written by a pilot who flies them for a living, Vaughan Dow, as an accurate recreation of his day job.
dos:43008ca57de918cb.title: Harrier Mission

dos:43078e1c535a762a.description: A simple shareware, two-player, keyboard-controlled version of Pong with no changes to the original gameplay and no sound.
dos:43078e1c535a762a.title: Spong

dos:430d5e83b6dcfe56.description: A custom launcher for the top 100 DOOM WADs and total conversions per DOOM World, plus bonus WADs released with commercial games.
dos:430d5e83b6dcfe56.title: DOOM: eXoWAD

dos:4311fc365549791c.description: A single-player shareware space shooter. A spaceship has crash-landed in Tommy's back garden, and he helps the aliens fix it.
dos:4311fc365549791c.title: Tommy's Saucer

dos:431aff7529a68b87.description: A pre-school game for practicing classification of objects. In a playful setting of shops, Big Bird and Little Bird deliver mail to one of four locations.
dos:431aff7529a68b87.title: Big Bird's Special Delivery

dos:431ce4ff6b9e4ef5.description: A crossword puzzle game in which you guess words from text clues and spell them into cells arranged in rows and columns.
dos:431ce4ff6b9e4ef5.title: The Daily Telegraph Computer Crossword Challenge

dos:431f8a63504a1bdf.description: An arcade conversion of Joust in which you play a buzzard slamming into other birds from above to survive.
dos:431f8a63504a1bdf.title: Conquest (1983)

dos:432d452ec13b870c.description: A shooting gallery with a B-movie horror theme, with a demonic host called Dr. Dearth, zombies and other spooky glowing things.
dos:432d452ec13b870c.title: Mystic Midway: Rest in Pieces

dos:432fcfe8c0df5d8b.description: The sequel to Flashback. Play Conrad, imprisoned by the Morphs, who gains the trust and help of the mysterious Ancients.
dos:432fcfe8c0df5d8b.title: Fade to Black

dos:434431e9dbc0216f.description: A role-playing game in which the land of Akalabeth was peaceful until the evil Mondain created dungeons filled with foul creatures. The warrior British drove him off, but the monsters remain.
dos:434431e9dbc0216f.title: Akalabeth: World of Doom

dos:434b1c171f3c803f.description: A shareware educational title that teaches mental arithmetic to first, second and third graders. The pupil chooses between multiplication or division questions.
dos:434b1c171f3c803f.title: Animated Multiplication and Division

dos:43572c6be16b59f0.description: A single-player trick-taking card game, normally for three players, in which you take the north seat and the computer plays the other two. It is also known as Terziglio, an Italian game.
dos:43572c6be16b59f0.title: Tommy's Calabresella

dos:435b1fd88cdfe6c8.description: A strategy and management game in which, after the last Alien War, resources are exhausted and most people live in Mega-Primus, a self-sufficient city.
dos:435b1fd88cdfe6c8.title: X-COM: Apocalypse

dos:4360ddb99a7f64dc.description: A small Finnish program in which the player fires projectiles at an ANSI-art portrait of an unnamed public figure, watching each hit wear the face away until little of it is left.
dos:4360ddb99a7f64dc.title: Tikkasentappopeli

dos:436100ed4f29f5d0.description: A single-player shooter in which you control a gun moving left and right across the bottom of the screen, which can also move up and down a little.
dos:436100ed4f29f5d0.title: Tommy's Gorilla Ball Gauntlet

dos:436c9662351456ad.description: An action, adventure and RPG hybrid with square-based movement similar to Dungeon Master, set in the future, with a split screen for up to four players.
dos:436c9662351456ad.title: Hired Guns

dos:436fdb5b6b74b487.description: A 3D version of Taiwan sixteen-tile mahjong, based on how the Taiwanese game works.
dos:436fdb5b6b74b487.title: Authentic Taiwan Sixteen Mahjong

dos:43771c993fdb6b72.description: A jigsaw puzzle simulation with many puzzles based on children's artwork or new designs. Fit the pieces onto the board in the shortest time, with a high score for finishing.
dos:43771c993fdb6b72.title: Jigsaw Puzzle

dos:4386c66b25f8652c.description: An educational game to improve reading comprehension in five areas: main idea, recalling facts, sequence of events, drawing inferences and vocabulary, with a bowling theme.
dos:4386c66b25f8652c.title: Read 'N Roll

dos:43899681a6bef3dc.description: An edutainment text adventure in the style of other Topologika releases, with mathematical and logic puzzles that drive the story.
dos:43899681a6bef3dc.title: Giant Killer

dos:439c3ed06cce7169.description: A 2D helicopter simulation with arcade gameplay and missions including combat, POW rescue, Gulf of Terror, Arctic rescue, Oil Blaze and Bermuda Triangle.
dos:439c3ed06cce7169.title: Super Huey II

dos:439ce6e2cb5fe296.description: The sequel to Galactic Empire, an early first-person space adventure hybrid from Coktel Vision with a fast 3D engine, as you pilot a spacecraft around planets and stars.
dos:439ce6e2cb5fe296.title: A.G.E.

dos:43b70040ba99a26e.description: An advertising game for Domino's Pizza. Play a delivery boy who must get a pizza to the top floor of Doom Industries in 30 minutes while the Noid tries to stop him.
dos:43b70040ba99a26e.title: Avoid the Noid

dos:43c144c70c9be427.description: A flight simulator based on the Veritech/Valkyrie fighter from the Robotech/Macross anime, in which you fly the fighter without transforming it.
dos:43c144c70c9be427.title: Veritech: Variable Flight Simulator

dos:43c5168fc9722d73.description: A platformer starring a rabbit with ninja skills, mostly moving to the right but sometimes descending to sewers or the metro to fight thugs and ninjas.
dos:43c5168fc9722d73.title: Ninja Rabbits

dos:43d46130d56d1a9f.description: A puzzle game in which you control a junkyard crane with an electromagnet and limited magnetic energy to pick up and rearrange a jumbled pile of railway cars into a sensible sequence.
dos:43d46130d56d1a9f.title: Magnetic Crane

dos:43da1afbe1bc63c7.description: The third Aldo platformer, with ten boards of jumping and running. Reach the treasure chest on each stage while avoiding falling hazards.
dos:43da1afbe1bc63c7.title: Aldo's Assault (Aldo 3)

dos:43e2d75114c26ea9.description: A roguelike in which you play an adventurer who travels to a remote mountain range to save the world of Ancardia from the forces of Chaos, or join them.
dos:43e2d75114c26ea9.title: Ancient Domains of Mystery

dos:43e8d9e1c01d1937.description: A Tetris-based puzzle game with its own gameplay, in which figures fall onto the screen and you make combinations of blocks of the same type.
dos:43e8d9e1c01d1937.title: Jagtris

dos:43f3d54bbdad59a4.description: A platformer in which Dug Kewl returns home to find that his wife has been taken by the Supreme Spurkasaur. With his drill and gun he travels through four worlds to rescue her.
dos:43f3d54bbdad59a4.title: Dig It!

dos:43fc5c13d793d641.description: An educational adventure in which Putt-Putt gears up to join the annual Cartown Pet Parade, meeting local characters along the way.
dos:43fc5c13d793d641.title: Putt-Putt Joins the Parade

dos:4406c37348ae3877.description: A third-person point-and-click adventure in which you are Boris Verne, thrown into another dimension by your uncle's Virtual Dimension Inducer, on a quest to find the fabled lost star.
dos:4406c37348ae3877.title: Universe (1994)

dos:4411f34fe84eda9d.description: A multiplayer snake variant that plays like Tron light cycles. Team up two humans against the computer, with power-ups that lengthen your worm.
dos:4411f34fe84eda9d.title: Flatworm II

dos:442f485438078d34.description: A Frogger-style arcade game about a small frog's difficult trip from the bottom of the screen to the top.
dos:442f485438078d34.title: Leaper

dos:443541f9513b75dd.description: A football management simulation with an arcade component in which you manage Manchester United through a season to see how many trophies you can win.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:443541f9513b75dd.title: Manchester United

dos:4439bc90333ece61.description: A timed action strategy game like Soko-Ban. The evil Wizard Chang Li Xung has imprisoned you in the Maze of Keys, and you escape each of 50 levels by pushing directional blocks.
dos:4439bc90333ece61.title: Wizard's Doom

dos:443c537be416f6f0.description: An adventure set in the advanced city of Atlantis. Control young Seth as he tries to save Queen Rhea from a threat.
dos:443c537be416f6f0.title: Atlantis: The Lost Tales

dos:44419573b267f74e.description: A punk-rock text adventure in which you play Tim, a young punk rocker living in a squat in an imaginary city where punk rock is dying.
dos:44419573b267f74e.title: Broken String: The Punk Adventure

dos:444b28c255830521.description: A Chinese fighting game with bright graphics and eight fighters.
dos:444b28c255830521.title: Fighting Dragon

dos:44509e154032b4ba.description: A shareware card game, Pirada I: The Fearless, the first of a trilogy whose second and third parts were available only to registered players.
dos:44509e154032b4ba.title: Pirada Trilogy

dos:4452c44b6f7c7427.description: A tank warfare game in which you command a platoon of four M1 tanks, and issue orders to tanks, AA units, aircraft, artillery and infantry in a campaign against Warsaw Pact forces in Europe.
dos:4452c44b6f7c7427.title: M1 Tank Platoon

dos:44611d3cacf99fab.description: A two-player tank game. Move in 8 directions and fire bullets that rebound, which can also kill you. Some levels have destructible tiles.
dos:44611d3cacf99fab.title: Tank For Two

dos:446545684969a1d2.description: A spelling game in which you control a dolphin helping a submarine reach the ocean floor before it runs out of air, by picking up letter sponges and matching them to the sub's sign.
dos:446545684969a1d2.title: Sea Speller

dos:4470e42b7f2d9b0f.description: Drive the Raven, the most advanced Terran fighting vehicle, against Gir Draxon and his Arcturan army, fighting from star system to star system.
dos:4470e42b7f2d9b0f.title: Stellar 7

dos:44735b3d4017654c.description: A strategy game in which the D.R.A.G.O.N. Force, a mercenary team that takes the most dangerous jobs, undertakes twelve missions against drug barons and terrorists, from eliminating targets to rescuing hostages.
dos:44735b3d4017654c.title: D.R.A.G.O.N. Force

dos:4478c5bd20dfb728.description: A fantasy RPG in which you wander a top-down world, find and fight monsters, and try to save the kingdom.
dos:4478c5bd20dfb728.title: The First City of Alliance

dos:4482418bac838ee4.description: A translation of the old leapfrog brain-teaser. Five red pegs sit on the left and five green on the right with a single space between, and you must swap their positions.
dos:4482418bac838ee4.title: Switch (1982)

dos:44905a770b6c8358.description: A children's game in which you play against Fatty Bear at Reversi, Lines & Boxes, and the card game Go Fish.

dos:5f4fc9a63b8069b1.description: A compilation with the campaigns of Star Wars: TIE Fighter, the three campaigns of the add-on Defender of the Empire and more.
dos:5f4fc9a63b8069b1.title: Star Wars: TIE Fighter (Collector's CD-ROM)

dos:5f5a33fa6e0ed809.description: An adaptation of the oriental board game Kalah, part of the Mancala family, played by one player against an AI opponent.
dos:5f5a33fa6e0ed809.title: Kalah

dos:5f73dfa7caa1b5cb.description: A multiple-choice trivia game with questions adults of drinking age might exchange, which tries to simulate inebriation in text mode.
dos:5f73dfa7caa1b5cb.title: Beer Trivia

dos:5f7552b43d691282.description: A point-and-click graphic adventure in which James Bond travels to South America on a mission.
dos:5f7552b43d691282.title: 007 James Bond: The Stealth Affair

dos:5f8a3b8896ff81a1.description: A political simulation in which a secret organization based on the 13th floor of a London office building works to keep the current British government in power.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation / Political; Strategy
dos:5f8a3b8896ff81a1.title: Floor 13

dos:5f987539e9ba5440.description: A first-person shooter using a 3D game creation engine, the third in the Despair series, in which you must destroy the wind machine before the Earth is blown away.
dos:5f987539e9ba5440.title: Despair 3

dos:5f98ca7c8b283890.description: An educational program with several mini-games teaching children about change, including Name That Coin, Pick the Coins and Silly Seals.
dos:5f98ca7c8b283890.title: Flippy's Circus Coins

dos:5fb59ff7111d11e5.description: A platform game in which Dan searches for his missing girlfriend in a strange video-game world, collecting gold and avoiding water and deep pits, with no conventional enemies.
dos:5fb59ff7111d11e5.title: Dan Dolme

dos:5fb6b974d35bd711.description: An overhead-view RPG based on Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Forgotten Realms, the first of the Savage Frontier series, in which you stop marauding invaders.
dos:5fb6b974d35bd711.title: Gateway to the Savage Frontier

dos:5fb7e9640f034286.description: A text adventure in which you wander a shadowy, ever-changing landscape that seems made of fog, trying to remember who you are.
dos:5fb7e9640f034286.title: The Misadventure of the Holy Grail

dos:5fbd188ddbe8228f.description: A car racing game across different tracks in 9 countries, in which you turn into the meanest Road Hog.
dos:5fbd188ddbe8228f.title: Road Hog!

dos:5fd822e83d2d38e3.description: A Snake-type game in which you guide a wiggling brown worm through a rectangular playfield, eating apples to grow and score.
dos:5fd822e83d2d38e3.title: C-Mato

dos:5fdb1f9134b32d46.description: A role-playing and space exploration game in which a great empire of Humans, Velox, Thrynn and Elowan once ruled the stars with the energy source Endurium.
dos:5fdb1f9134b32d46.title: Starflight

dos:5fe39c170d7675e8.description: Roger Wilco, janitor of the starship Arcada, is dozing in a closet when an alarm sounds: the Arcada is under attack by the Sariens.
dos:5fe39c170d7675e8.title: Space Quest I: The Sarien Encounter

dos:5fe60d65feadc73c.description: A strategy-adventure hybrid based on Frank Herbert's novel Dune, in which you play Paul Atreides, son of Duke Leto.
dos:5fe60d65feadc73c.title: Dune

dos:5fefd53de9228e6b.description: A Mancala game, an antique game going back thousands of years, played on a field divided into six pits on each side, initially filled with chips.
dos:5fefd53de9228e6b.title: Kalakh

dos:5ff59bf994d3e55b.description: A vastly improved version of Spectrum Holobyte's Falcon, with high-resolution EGA graphics, better mission planning and a head-to-head mode.
dos:5ff59bf994d3e55b.title: Falcon A.T.

dos:5ff7291712442f35.description: A crazy mini golf game played with the mouse, which sets direction and strength of your putts across 9 tricky holes protected by bouncing hamburgers and windmills.
dos:5ff7291712442f35.title: Will Harvey's Zany Golf

dos:5ffcea09babc6fe0.description: A text adventure set in the fantasy land of Thurania, where Alex, an 8-year-old grandchild of a magician, learns about the talisman, a floating magic stone, when their city is attacked.
dos:5ffcea09babc6fe0.title: Talisman: Challenging the Sands of Time

dos:6008c469b16de548.description: A four-level arcade adventure based on the third Indiana Jones film. Indy climbs, explores and solves puzzles with his whip, hunting the Cross of Coronado, a shield and a diary on the way to the Holy Grail.
dos:6008c469b16de548.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade: The Action Game

dos:60095a1378b566df.description: A flight simulation built around the F-14 Tomcat and F/A-18 Hornet, launched from a carrier during Operation Desert Storm. Configure your aircraft, choose a pilot and fly the missions you are given.
dos:60095a1378b566df.title: Combat Air Patrol

dos:600a1b024a95bc0e.description: A horse racing game based on the British flat racing season, covering the English Classics along with group races, handicaps, maidens and sellers.
dos:600a1b024a95bc0e.title: Good to Firm

dos:6011500a38573a9c.description: A ballistic artillery game in which two gorillas on a city skyline take turns hurling exploding bananas at each other, setting angle and velocity to land the hit.
dos:6011500a38573a9c.title: QBasic Gorillas

dos:603228a3a7e67775.description: A first-person shooter set in the Terminator universe, originally an expansion for Terminator: Future Shock. It runs on an updated Xngine with sharper 640x480 play and was released as a standalone game.
dos:603228a3a7e67775.title: SkyNET

dos:603c36a507e1c313.description: A real-time strategy game set in the year 699. Slav prince Mirko, whose settlement has been burned, leads his warriors to conquer the surrounding territories and take revenge on his treacherous neighbors.
dos:603c36a507e1c313.title: Polanie

dos:6041950953cb4652.description: A 3D shooter in the style of Zarch. You fly a spaceship in any direction through closed environments, shooting enemies while a mini-map in the corner shows where they are.
dos:6041950953cb4652.title: Phase2

dos:6041ef4ef7b7b0ab.description: A first-person shooter made with Pie in the Sky Software's 3D Game Creation System. You infiltrate the military compound of an unnamed Middle Eastern dictatorship that is secretly manufacturing chemical weapons.
dos:6041ef4ef7b7b0ab.title: Chemical Warfare

dos:604e85ea4caf2632.description: Interactive fiction with graphics. Your aim is to escape the land of Kerovnia, where strange events are routine and the banished Roobikyoub dwarves, makers of fine whisky, have upset the king's subjects.
dos:604e85ea4caf2632.title: The Pawn

dos:60541ea09e8b6414.description: A side-scrolling beat 'em up in which Freddy Hardest fights through the streets of a decayed future New York, taking on thugs armed with baseball bats and knives. The difficulty is set high.
dos:60541ea09e8b6414.title: Freddy Hardest in South Manhattan

dos:6058b69b4bf91365.description: A Tic Tac Toe variant played on a 3x3x3 cube. Score by lining up three of your marks in a row, win more games than your opponent to take the match.
dos:6058b69b4bf91365.title: Cubic Tic Tac Toe

dos:605ad1c88a7f5687.description: A fantasy strategy game in which you play a wizard competing against up to four computer wizards on two planes of existence. Win by destroying your rivals or by casting the Spell of Mastery.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Role-Playing; Strategy / 4X
dos:605ad1c88a7f5687.title: Master of Magic

dos:605cc41d60bf9bd5.description: A creativity program for making animations and pictures with Bugs Bunny and the cast of his cartoon world. Set your frame, place backgrounds and characters, and build your own cartoon.
dos:605cc41d60bf9bd5.title: The Bugs Bunny Cartoon Workshop

dos:605cf64673c4702d.description: A Bible-based adventure following the apostle Paul's first missionary journey from Acts 13 and 14. It spans ten cities and over 160 locations.
dos:605cf64673c4702d.title: Paul's First Journey

dos:605dfda8ac46c80b.description: A soccer management game, an updated Championship Manager 93/94 in which you take charge of an Italian club from Serie A or B, with rules adjusted to Italian football.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:605dfda8ac46c80b.title: Championship Manager Italia

dos:606631de5f64886b.description: A snake game in which a beer-themed worm from Finland slithers around the screen. Arcade play in the classic snake mold.
dos:606631de5f64886b.title: Beerworm

dos:60708d04aab8c479.description: A stealth fighter flight simulator and sequel to F-19 Stealth Fighter. Fly air-to-air and ground missions over the Persian Gulf, Cuba and Vietnam in both cold war and full-scale war scenarios.
dos:60708d04aab8c479.title: F-117A Nighthawk Stealth Fighter 2.0

dos:607261b51e03b0d9.description: A basketball management game, the sequel to PC Basket. Lead one of the 16 teams of the 1993/94 Spanish league, choosing your five and team tactics and controlling the players.
dos:607261b51e03b0d9.title: PC Basket 2.0

dos:6076caccb4e918c5.description: A cyberpunk interactive movie viewed in first-person slideshow style, similar to Myst. As Sam Frost, fresh out of prison, you are hired by Metacorp to find out why guests of its Alexandria resort are being killed.
dos:6076caccb4e918c5.title: MTV's Club Dead

dos:607c17258c85c641.description: A platformer and successor to Charlie the Duck. Guide Charlie through 18 levels across different worlds, find secret exits to hidden levels, and face a boss after every six levels.
dos:607c17258c85c641.title: Charlie II

dos:60820c527f7e4cfb.description: A naval hydrofoil missile boat game mixing simulation and action. Missions include destroying every enemy vessel in an area, surveillance of ships you must identify without sinking them, and escort duty.
dos:60820c527f7e4cfb.title: PHM Pegasus

dos:6085abd8dce882bc.description: An auto-scrolling game in which you move your submarine up and down to dodge obstacles.
dos:6085abd8dce882bc.title: Escape Sub!

dos:608a9a53d9093337.description: A business simulation in which you head a petrochemical conglomerate for 1 to 10 years, buying domestic and foreign oil and releasing it to refineries to build your fortune. Each turn is half a financial year.
dos:608a9a53d9093337.title: Oil Barons (1992)

dos:608b52816abb15f7.description: A vertically scrolling action game ported from the arcades. One or two players fight through jungles, rivers and ruins, picking up machine guns, grenades and rocket launchers along the way.
dos:608b52816abb15f7.title: Ikari Warriors

dos:60974be03860df93.description: An adventure in which a witch has put a princess and her castle under a spell. After 100 years the castle is full of deadly creatures, and you must clear them out and rescue Sleeping Beauty.
dos:60974be03860df93.title: Battune Meets Sleeping Beauty

dos:60a031368ca0fc55.description: Fly an F-14 Tomcat mission after mission, shooting planes out of the sky with a vulcan cannon and a limited supply of missiles in this port of the arcade shooter.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Shooter; Vehicle Simulation
dos:60a031368ca0fc55.title: After Burner

dos:60b2501289ad7e33.description: A shooter built on a spell that turns the strong Bully into a fish and the fearless Monica into a hawk on alternate full moons, keeping them apart. Only an extraordinary event can break it.
dos:60b2501289ad7e33.title: Sol Negro

dos:60b8178dd516d0e2.description: A wrestling game with arcade elements, licensed from the World Wrestling Federation. Pick Hulk Hogan, the Ultimate Warrior or the British Bulldog and fight in practice matches and championship bouts.
tags: Action; Fighting / Versus Fighting; Sports / Wrestling
dos:60b8178dd516d0e2.title: WWF Wrestlemania

dos:60bfd74f9677e739.description: Assemble a team of 5 X-Men from 15 and battle evil mutants in a top-down RPG. Fights can be resolved as side-scrolling action or turn-based RPG combat.
dos:60bfd74f9677e739.title: X-Men II: The Fall of the Mutants

dos:60c0ea7022c323bb.description: A turn-based railroad empire-building game based on Avalon Hill's board game, keeping its hexagonal map and track tokens. Invest, build routes and out-trade your rivals.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Construction and Management Simulation; Strategy
dos:60c0ea7022c323bb.title: 1830: Railroads and Robber Barons

dos:60c3bea1e3f9c206.description: A turn-based, hex-based wargame on the Battlefront engine about Allied and Axis forces in North Africa in World War II. Eight scenarios from Syria in 1941 onward can be played from either side.
dos:60c3bea1e3f9c206.title: Rommel: Battles for North Africa

dos:60cda01e752a02d0.description: A top-down exploration shoot 'em up in which you collect four crystals from a hostile alien craft and carry them to your scout ship to destroy it. Keys open the way, and roaming androids must be cleared from each room.
dos:60cda01e752a02d0.title: Space Adventure (1988)

dos:60ce42180e41d20c.description: A falling-block puzzle game in which three-ball jelly beans drop from the top of the screen. Position them to make rows of three or more of the same color.
dos:60ce42180e41d20c.title: Jelly Bean Factory

dos:60cfc6893680c6ef.description: A Cinemaware action-strategy game in which you sail the high seas as Sinbad, helping the Princess defeat the Black Prince and his minions from hell. You fight pirates and genies along the way.
dos:60cfc6893680c6ef.title: Sinbad and the Throne of the Falcon

dos:60e558a82757e3c1.description: A combination of Syndicate and its American Revolt expansion. In a future ruled by corporate syndicates, you direct a squad of agents to take control away from competing companies.
dos:60e558a82757e3c1.title: Syndicate Plus

dos:60e9925032659195.description: A platformer in which you play a robotic insect in a robotic jungle whose cousins are chewing through the citadel and threatening the reactor core. Capture the renegade insects and use them later to perform tasks.
dos:60e9925032659195.title: Spiderbot

dos:60f89119e5919780.description: A full-screen 3D role-playing game with puzzle and combat elements. You are Drake, an adventurer out to stop the evil Khull-Khumm and restore Stonekeep to its former glory.
dos:60f89119e5919780.title: Stonekeep

dos:60f9fcd7acd19cd6.description: A crossword program with an archive of 365 Los Angeles Times puzzles. Load a puzzle, move around the grid to pick Across and Down clues and type in answers while a clock times you.
dos:60f9fcd7acd19cd6.title: CrossWorld: The LA Times Edition

dos:61008c02b4599d1e.description: A platformer in which treasure hunter Panama Joe searches a maze of Aztec catacombs for ancient treasure, avoiding bouncing and rolling skulls, spiders, chains and fire.
dos:61008c02b4599d1e.title: Montezuma's Revenge (1984)

dos:61053eff0351131d.description: A mountain climbing action simulation. Reach the peak by one of several trails of varying difficulty, with alternating joystick movements in the manner of the Epyx games, while managing the gear in your backpack.
dos:61053eff0351131d.title: Final Assault

dos:6106eef5412aedb8.description: A card game of preference in which you join a private card club and choose two opponents, who range from fools to card-sharpers.
dos:6106eef5412aedb8.title: Pref Club

dos:6107ae2ec1740f6b.description: A faithful take on the Pac-Man arcade classic in CGA graphics. Move through a maze collecting dots, avoid the ghosts and use power pills to turn the tables on them.
dos:6107ae2ec1740f6b.title: PC-Man

dos:61080d4834343781.description: A shareware space flight and combat simulator played from the bridge of a starship. Accept missions from Space Force HQ and complete as many as you can; the game ends when you die or fail three missions.
dos:61080d4834343781.title: SIMSpace

dos:61126a8faa451b13.description: A fan-made graphical adventure built on Sierra's AGI interpreter in the style of Police Quest 1 and King's Quest III. You play Hank, a geeky, lanky teenager.
dos:61126a8faa451b13.title: Hank's Quest: Victim of Society

dos:61135738ec5a68d7.description: A track-and-field sports game in which you enter athletes for a chosen country and train them before competing in a varied set of events.
dos:61135738ec5a68d7.title: The Carl Lewis Challenge

dos:61197bd0484e33b0.description: The Prince, turned into a beggar by a lookalike who has taken his place, fights to restore himself and his bride in this cinematic platform sequel to Prince of Persia.
dos:61197bd0484e33b0.title: Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow & The Flame

dos:6119fc5640e769ed.description: A top-down kart racing game with 8 circuits against 2 opponents, one of which can be human, in the style of Super Sprint. Races can be wet, dry or on ice, so pick your tires to suit.
dos:6119fc5640e769ed.title: Karting Grand Prix

dos:611d167432ce6b71.description: Two dino-mites, Spike and Bloop, race to gather eggs before one-eyed cavemen called Trogs can eat them. One or two players.
dos:611d167432ce6b71.title: Trog!

dos:611e58338a6de8ff.description: A shareware dungeon game and sequel to The Dungeons of Grimlor, mixing action with puzzles as you explore the dungeons beneath the town.
dos:611e58338a6de8ff.title: The Dungeons of Grimlor II

dos:6122f5c4b5f23b73.description: A bridge card game played against the computer or other players by hot seat or local network. Includes the full rules, a tutorial, and commentary and tips from champion Omar Sharif.
dos:6122f5c4b5f23b73.title: Bridge Champion with Omar Sharif

dos:61244d6919909842.description: Max Montezuma, a soldier descended from a legendary Aztec emperor, crashes on an uncharted island and explores ancient ruins, linking the mystery of the past to the present. Combines first-person shooting, platforming and puzzles.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Platform; Puzzle
dos:61244d6919909842.title: Montezuma's Return

dos:61279b92c6146679.description: A scholar of 14th-century France is sent by the king and the pope to investigate the Abbey of Montglane. After a fire destroyed old manuscripts, you must recover ten treasures that went unaccounted for.
dos:61279b92c6146679.title: The Abbey

dos:6139dee5067f865f.description: An unofficial commercial add-on for DOOM II that replaces all 32 original levels with a new set and a new plot, in which the demons are an alien race from the planet Hell. Gameplay is unchanged.
dos:6139dee5067f865f.title: Perdition's Gate

dos:6139fdc720e8d0d9.description: A four-player RISK-style conquest game in which you cannot see your opponents' armies and they cannot see yours, making every battle unpredictable.
dos:6139fdc720e8d0d9.title: Blind Wars

dos:613d9acdaf2bd6eb.description: A minesweeper-style puzzle game. Reveal cells showing how many mines lie adjacent and mark the mines; clicking a mine reveals them all and ends the game.
dos:613d9acdaf2bd6eb.title: Flagger

dos:613e9f6f96779313.description: Karnov, the fire-breathing Russian, seeks the Lost Treasure of Babylon. He runs, swims, jumps, climbs and flies through nine levels.
dos:613e9f6f96779313.title: Karnov

dos:6141bfafb5b048c9.description: A space strategy game set in the 27th century. After the interstellar warp drive is developed, two research ships are sent to find colony planets, but only Explorer-2 returns to Earth.
dos:6141bfafb5b048c9.title: Reunion

dos:614a019507aa6fcb.description: Race off-road trucks around compact dirt circuits full of jumps and tight turns. Earn prize money, upgrade your truck and compete against other drivers.
dos:614a019507aa6fcb.title: Ivan 'Ironman' Stewart's Super Off Road

dos:615e9a6f8907822c.description: A meandering text adventure in choose-your-own-adventure style, in which you guide a 16-year-old Vietnam-era draft dodger-in-training through the confusing times, with no clear long-term goals.
dos:615e9a6f8907822c.title: Hippy's Quest I: PEACE MAN

dos:615f04fbe314f7aa.description: Your pet dog Rover has been dog-napped by evil robots. Explore 30 levels of puzzles and destroy deadly robots to rescue him.
dos:615f04fbe314f7aa.title: Rescue Rover

dos:616ab1ab95c1f20b.description: A BBS door game in which, as a caller dialing in remotely, you see how much you can bug the SysOp, the system operator, before he wakes up.
dos:616ab1ab95c1f20b.title: Don't Wake the SysOp

dos:616cac974b5026fa.description: An educational program full of scientific facts about the planets, asteroids and satellites of the Solar System. You can calculate things like a planet's position on a given date, and there is a small quiz and a puzzle.
dos:616cac974b5026fa.title: Orbits: Voyage Through the Solar System

dos:6178f586696d44fb.description: A strategy game set in the Dragon Isles, a once-peaceful archipelago devastated by a vast invading fleet. You lead the scattered survivors in rebuilding and fighting back.
dos:6178f586696d44fb.title: Dragon Isles

dos:617a752596f766aa.description: A tile puzzle in three variations of 120 timed stages each. Rebuild set arrangements or clear pieces by changing their colors and values; passwords let you resume every fifth level.
dos:617a752596f766aa.title: Logo

dos:6182a9feda402af2.description: A Space Invaders-style shooter. Control a laser cannon at the bottom of the screen and destroy wave after wave of brightly colored demons that bounce around and attack with bombs and lasers.
dos:6182a9feda402af2.title: Demon Attack

dos:618d00a436341d2d.description: A compilation of the V for Victory wargame series, including Utah Beach, Velikiye Luki, Market-Garden and Gold-Juno-Sword. You command forces as a military strategist in World War II.
dos:618d00a436341d2d.title: V for Victory: Commemorative Collection

dos:6190a6ee37727615.description: An interactive fiction engine for playing or writing your own interactive stories.
dos:6190a6ee37727615.title: Figment: The Imagination Processor

dos:61918f32ff3f6df4.description: A platformer in the vein of Donkey Kong Country and Chinese bootleg games, starring a basketball-playing monkey who crosses pre-rendered levels fighting dog-like creatures.
dos:61918f32ff3f6df4.title: King Kong 10

dos:619b40ba3d461e0e.description: A 2D golf game from the makers of Sensible Soccer. It is an action take on the sport rather than an accurate simulation, built on the idea of no fuss, just fun.
dos:619b40ba3d461e0e.title: Sensible Golf

dos:61a6c927b78821ca.description: The FMV version of The Lord of the Rings for the REEL Magic MPEG card, a role-playing game set in Middle-earth where the dark lord Sauron forged the One Ring to control the races.
dos:61a6c927b78821ca.title: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings (REEL Magic)

dos:61a7979285a79107.description: An Arthurian adventure in search of the Grail. A mouse-driven interface lets you investigate locations and complete smaller quests along the way.
dos:61a7979285a79107.title: Grailquest

dos:61bdcad95c6bd518.description: A strategy game in which you play a DOD operative using the Ballistic Missile Defense System, with ground, land-launched and space-based components, to destroy incoming ballistic missiles and protect the United States.
dos:61bdcad95c6bd518.title: Defcon 5 (1987)

dos:61c801882b4be169.description: Set in 1963, you start with a little money to buy your first hot rod, tune it for performance and race rivals at the diner for money and pink slips.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Racing & Driving
dos:61c801882b4be169.title: Street Rod

dos:61d12aea4015625e.description: A four-player ecology simulation in which players bid with ecopoints for animals, then see how each fares in different biomes and whether its value rises or falls.
dos:61d12aea4015625e.title: EcoMaster

dos:61d8e9683718d8fc.description: A curling simulator played with a swing meter, similar to golf games, in which you deliver stones toward the target as in real curling.
dos:61d8e9683718d8fc.title: Pro Curl

dos:61dc191ae46e0977.description: The Bungeling Empire has stolen a cache of gold and you must infiltrate its treasury and take it back, crossing 150 screens of platforms, ladders and ropes while avoiding robotic guards.
dos:61dc191ae46e0977.title: Lode Runner

dos:61f13eee52f60aca.description: A shoot 'em up with scrolling in all directions. The zoomed-in view makes it hard to shoot enemies before they appear.
dos:61f13eee52f60aca.title: Blue Falcon 2.0

dos:620a5c5eb8cb95e1.description: An open-world 8-bit-style action game inspired by Grand Theft Auto, combining driving, fighting and shooting. It began as a homebrew NES demake of Grand Theft Auto III and is set in the eighties.
dos:620a5c5eb8cb95e1.title: Retro City Rampage 486

dos:620ecdffaa1a5c18.description: Microsoft's version of the classic snake game. Steer your snake to eat the numbers that appear on screen; it grows longer with each one and dies if it hits a wall or its own tail.
dos:620ecdffaa1a5c18.title: QBasic Nibbles

dos:621bc20af4984d18.description: You are John Parker, a Rastafarian soldier defending your ganja field against landing American soldiers. Standing on your Volkswagen bus, fire at the soldiers and also destroy bombers, helicopters and UFOs.
dos:621bc20af4984d18.title: Ganja Farmer

dos:621c5a412089a70b.description: A 1995 remake of the 1992 Dismal Passages. The story and location names are changed, and the gameplay is now an action-oriented adventure rather than a turn-based RPG.
dos:621c5a412089a70b.title: Dismal Passages: Part I - The Wicked Curse

dos:621e530108d3eb90.description: You are Rockford, digging through monster-infested caves for diamonds. Collect enough in each level to open the portal to the next, and watch for falling boulders, which can squash enemies.
dos:621e530108d3eb90.title: Boulder Dash

dos:62207ada4985d176.description: The D-Day invasion recreated with Impressions' Micro Miniatures wargaming system. Direct units as overall commander, or play out individual battles yourself.
dos:62207ada4985d176.title: D-Day: The Beginning of the End

dos:6221ba283b59ace4.description: The Gold release bundles the flight simulator U.S. Navy Fighters with its Marine Fighters add-on. Fly US naval aircraft over Ukraine in a war against Russia, in a campaign, single missions or missions you create.
dos:6221ba283b59ace4.title: U.S. Navy Fighters Gold

dos:6223af71dde3f64d.description: A rally game with 28 tracks taken from the real RAC Rally, driven in six real rally cars. The weather changes from rain to sun to snow, and surfaces vary from tarmac to mud.
dos:6223af71dde3f64d.title: Network Q RAC Rally Championship

dos:622e46e99b217389.description: Control a four-colored disc with your mouse. Colored balls zoom around the playfield, and four wall-mounted hands of matching colors grab for them.
dos:622e46e99b217389.title: Velcro Mind

dos:623412f07cc8bfa4.description: A shareware puzzle game in which you steer an energy field ship with the / and \ keys. Each key press leaves behind a mirror that deflects your craft if it strikes it.
dos:623412f07cc8bfa4.title: Tommy's Energy Fence

dos:623442282c5bf145.description: Hopy-ONE, a bio-droid created in a lab researching the deadly Fast Line Virus, must collect samples of the virus to help produce a vaccine, in this platformer.
dos:623442282c5bf145.title: Hopy-ONE

dos:623ecca46d648071.description: A shareware interactive fiction from 1987. A flat tire on a holiday drive leaves you lost, and the driveway you remember leads you to Castle Ralf.
dos:623ecca46d648071.title: Castle Ralf

dos:624654d766778d75.description: An adventure RPG from the early 90s that was popular among shareware boards, in which you quest for the Eternal Grimoire.
dos:624654d766778d75.title: Enchantasy: Quest for the Eternal Grimoire

dos:6269a5b2463c82d5.description: A stock market simulation, Release 2, which adds margin and short sales. You start with a net worth of $10,000 on a market where three companies each from several industries have changing share prices.
dos:6269a5b2463c82d5.title: Millionaire: The Stock Market Simulation (Release 2)

dos:62753de834e346d6.description: A simple action RPG in which a young warrior (a barbarian, knight or valkyrie) helps a weakened kingdom and recovers Artifacts that once made it strong. You move in real time through forests and other terrain.
dos:62753de834e346d6.title: Times of Lore

dos:62837a7b33c0d9dc.description: An educational game for pre-schoolers with Disney characters, teaching counting from 1 to 9. Mickey plans a surprise party for a randomly chosen Disney character.
dos:62837a7b33c0d9dc.title: Mickey's 123's: The Big Surprise Party

dos:6288094332d5e9e0.description: As an MI7 agent you must unmask a mole. The plans for the new Sonic Macrothrodule are believed leaked, and you have one hour to solve the puzzle.
dos:6288094332d5e9e0.title: Spy Snatcher

dos:628a6cde7b0effe8.description: A head-to-head air combat flight sim set in modern times with a strong arcade feel. You fly a generic hypothetical modern fighter on sorties; a follow-up to ACE.
dos:628a6cde7b0effe8.title: ACE 2

dos:628e44793502de02.description: A kart racing game similar to Super Mario Kart. Up to four players race in split-screen, or you can face seven computer opponents in three leagues, using eight different vehicles.
dos:628e44793502de02.title: Street Racer

dos:6295be0f1a090f35.description: A flight combat game set in a fantasy world with one big continent, so there has never been naval warfare and all fighting is in the air. With the king dead and no heir, four factions go to war.
dos:6295be0f1a090f35.title: Air Power: Battle in the Skies

dos:629d20cfeefa95ca.description: A 3D tank simulation. Control up to 16 tanks, command the company, platoon or individual tank parts, play head to head, and fight 15 missions across three theatres of war, with a thermal-imaging night mode.
dos:629d20cfeefa95ca.title: Tank: The M1A1 Abrams Battle Tank Simulation

dos:62a3dfc662223de2.description: A comical, unrealistic top-down football game with a small square pitch and huge players. Master overhead kicks, trapping the ball and quick one-twos.
dos:62a3dfc662223de2.title: Empire Soccer 94

dos:62b3a57c4bc7f478.description: An improved version of 4D Tennis with better player animation and digitized photos of tennis stadiums around the world where the matches are played.
dos:62b3a57c4bc7f478.title: Compaq Grand Slam Cup

dos:62be2891f121a8eb.description: A platformer starring a caveman who clubs ghosts and other creatures on his way to the end of each level, picking up throwable weapons along the way.
dos:62be2891f121a8eb.title: Eracha

dos:62c89d2f60273b6b.description: A Spanish isometric puzzle game in which you guide a disembodied glove through a checkerboard labyrinth, pushing chess pieces out of the way, each moving by its own chess pattern, to reach the exit.
dos:62c89d2f60273b6b.title: Chess Housers (1993)

dos:62db1ab7c7f57ef4.description: A Zork-like text adventure with crude graphics. Stay alive and find the treasures while your strength drains every turn, so finding ways to restore it is essential.
dos:62db1ab7c7f57ef4.title: Hellfire: Journey to Hell

dos:62e760cd5a120664.description: Epyx's basketball played the way kids play it, on four courts: the schoolyard, the alleyway, the parking lot and the backyard, each with its own hazards.
dos:62e760cd5a120664.title: Street Sports Basketball

dos:62f50cee792660f7.description: The first of SSI's gold box AD&D games. Create a party, help the city of Phlan defeat the evils that threaten it, then search for the legendary Pool of Radiance in first-person dungeons and overhead turn-based combat.
dos:62f50cee792660f7.title: Pool of Radiance

dos:62f590c83b7dbc3a.description: As a new employee of TetraCorp, you colonize asteroids and turn them into successful mining colonies, then sell your ore to the Federal Ore Trading Commission while spreading into the unknown.
dos:62f590c83b7dbc3a.title: Fragile Allegiance

dos:62f7218942a5dcac.description: A freeware puzzle game whose board is three overlapping circles made of squares, named for the triskelion, a motif of three symbols around a common center.
dos:62f7218942a5dcac.title: Triskelion

dos:62f73f432698b047.description: A series of mini-games based on the 1950s TV series. Ralph Kramden wants to hold the Raccoon Lodge's annual meeting at Miami Beach, and the Kramdens and Nortons must work to raise the money.
dos:62f73f432698b047.title: The Honeymooners

dos:632e57b2af320d46.description: The shareware first episode of a trilogy, unrelated to the Jules Verne novel, mixing platform action with puzzles.
dos:632e57b2af320d46.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth!

dos:633f9df569df27c7.description: A rugby game with the official Super League license. Pick one of its teams and play a match, passing, running or kicking for points under unchanged rugby rules.
dos:633f9df569df27c7.title: Super League Pro Rugby

dos:634448fab02fe90e.description: All the fairy godmothers are captured except you. Free them by collecting every token on a screen, grabbing the key and reaching the exit, using a magic wand to transform objects against the monsters.
dos:634448fab02fe90e.title: F.Godmom

dos:634787c69932dc49.description: A children's matching game in which you use the mouse to match words to pictures; clearing the board triggers an animation.
dos:634787c69932dc49.title: Animated Words v4.0

dos:6347a57649236d55.description: A horror adventure, whose title means Howls, in which you play Kane, a small-time thief, or his girlfriend Lorry, searching for a stash of gold after your car breaks down and you must repair it to leave.
dos:6347a57649236d55.title: Hurlements

dos:634dd8fc40d1085a.description: On the coast of darkest Africa, you gather the right supplies for a dangerous safari from the village's many items, explore Africa, and then return to civilization.
dos:634dd8fc40d1085a.title: Battune Goes on Safari

dos:634f9c00a84f1714.description: A text-based Othello game from Finland, played against a simple computer opponent.
dos:634f9c00a84f1714.title: Othello (1990)

dos:6351f8aefe74dab4.description: A freeware clone of Ultimate's Atic Atac with improved graphics, sounds and new level design. Pick one of three characters trapped in a haunted castle, each with its own weapons and routes through the maze.
dos:6351f8aefe74dab4.title: The Burps

dos:63624da393a35e36.description: A Risk-style war game against the computer, another person or over the internet, with humans, dragons, wizards and other creatures. Pick a map or have one generated at random.
dos:63624da393a35e36.title: Conquered Kingdoms

dos:6365e3730f01fc33.description: A graphical adventure with a real-time element in which you wake in a padded cell, one of thousands of rooms in a labyrinthine asylum, at 9:30 PM and must find a way out.
dos:6365e3730f01fc33.title: Asylum (1991)

dos:636709bd5eb6a64c.description: Guide your frog to safety in three different locations, starting underwater and reaching the surface, then hopping across logs, birds and even a whale to the life preserver behind a tugboat.
dos:636709bd5eb6a64c.title: Frogger II: ThreeeDeep!

dos:636e67f48651bb00.description: A Pac-Man clone in which a smiling face collects all the dots on a one-screen level while escaping ghosts shaped like playing-card symbols. Green power dots let you eat them for a while.
dos:636e67f48651bb00.title: Poke-Man

dos:6371730aca4f940b.description: An action game based on the British comic magazine Viz, with its crude humor. Play Johnny Fartpants, Buster Gonad or Biffa Bacon and run through scrolling environments.
dos:6371730aca4f940b.title: Viz: The Game

dos:6375c0d014695f20.description: A CD of 1500 levels for Duke Nukem 3D, including one hundred multiplayer levels and a level loader to keep track of where you are.
dos:6375c0d014695f20.title: Duke Assault

dos:6377126594e77dc7.description: A helicopter simulation in which you fly the experimental UH-1XA in several modes: a flight school that guides you through takeoff, flight and landing, and a reality mode with missions to fly.
dos:6377126594e77dc7.title: Super Huey UH-IX

dos:63839660a47d043b.description: The shareware prequel to Heroes: The Sanguine Seven. Control a superhero team to defeat the henchmen of the villainous Wild Hare, who is rampaging the city; three of the seven heroes are available.
dos:63839660a47d043b.title: Heroes 1/4: The Tantalizing Trio

dos:63860e403d5903e2.description: A French Qix clone in which you claim 70 percent of the screen to advance while avoiding or trapping the enemies, which come in three types: Rollers, Kicks and Suiveurs.
dos:63860e403d5903e2.title: Kicks

dos:6397d6a0640ce898.description: An adventure set in the summer of 1937. Industrialist Bronson Bernard invites guests to the maiden launch of his flying boat Condor, and the party hides something darker.
dos:6397d6a0640ce898.title: The Case of the Cautious Condor

dos:639f2d2c1f6f761e.description: Take the role of Christopher Columbus and later Spanish conquistadors, exploring the New World or a randomly generated map. Establish forts and missions and bring gold back to Spain to earn promotions from the Queen.
dos:639f2d2c1f6f761e.title: The Seven Cities of Gold

dos:63a657d14ce30de0.description: A shoot 'em up of Spanish origin with an unusual craft, a World War I flying bookcase in place of a space fighter.
dos:63a657d14ce30de0.title: Battle Fire

dos:63ba0cbedaa95f90.description: A fast stunt racing game: choose from eight cars and race on over sixteen tracks with loops and corkscrews. Drivers are organized in teams of two cars each.
dos:63ba0cbedaa95f90.title: Whiplash

dos:63c2b980f8eedd60.description: A top-down stock car race from coast to coast across the southern US, from Florida to California via freeways, bridges, side routes and country roads, and you can even cut through houses and water.
dos:63c2b980f8eedd60.title: Stocker

dos:63ca664f11dbc6f9.description: Compete with up to three other traders on the interplanetary market, raising and lowering prices for goods. Produce goods like perfume by planting flower fields and buy raw materials such as water.
dos:63ca664f11dbc6f9.title: Traders: The Intergalactic Trading Game

dos:63de31946b640c51.description: A color-based Tetris variant. The screen is split into two squares, and on the left you control a platform to catch the blocks falling from above.
dos:63de31946b640c51.title: Cuber

dos:63e941fd31a37fd6.description: It's 1926, and Edward Carnby, nicknamed the Supernatural Private Eye, investigates the disappearance of a film crew at Slaughter Gulch, a ghost town in the Mojave Desert.
dos:63e941fd31a37fd6.title: Alone in the Dark 3

dos:63f13d0801d92162.description: Build a racing career with Mario Andretti. Start with $20,000, buy a Sprint Car, win a season to earn money and progress through six racing series.
dos:63f13d0801d92162.title: Mario Andretti's Racing Challenge

dos:640625f82bb03215.description: A turn-based ASCII spacecraft simulator set in a Star Trek-like universe. As a young Star Fleet lieutenant you command a light scout, and as you rise in rank, you face the Kazzim empire.
dos:640625f82bb03215.title: Star Ship Command

dos:6411c8ad05f6044b.description: A point-and-click adventure developed by Flair Software and released for PC DOS in Europe in 1996.
dos:6411c8ad05f6044b.title: Time Paradox

dos:641a42ef050d5848.description: A story painting adventure in which you play Peter Pan. You stole Captain Hook's treasure map, and he took the children from your village, so you trade the map to rescue your friends.
dos:641a42ef050d5848.title: Peter Pan: A Story Painting Adventure

dos:641d87dead30cacf.description: An RPG in the land of Darkmoore, ruled by the evil Lexnor. Choose from five classes and travel Darkmoore conquering dungeons to build your fame; the screen is split into two parts.
dos:641d87dead30cacf.title: The Red Crystal: The Seven Secrets of Life

dos:641f13f06e3887ba.description: A sailing simulation with eight courses. Race against computer opponents, steering the boat and setting sail trim and centerboard position, with wireframe 3D boats and a switchable overhead map.
dos:641f13f06e3887ba.title: The American Challenge: A Sailing Simulation

dos:64244a8ec57db2dc.description: A rogue-like RPG with randomly generated dungeons, in which you descend to fight monsters and find treasure. The DOS version has tile-based graphics.
dos:64244a8ec57db2dc.title: Silmar

dos:643159e594d40e4c.description: A pipe-style puzzle game by William Soleau with modest CGA graphics.
dos:643159e594d40e4c.title: Main Break

dos:6436ebdf3ffdbd7f.description: A Korean platform shooter similar to early Duke Nukem. A boy miraculously turned into a super-cop traverses hostile areas to defeat monsters and evil mechanical creatures in colorful scenery.
dos:6436ebdf3ffdbd7f.title: Super Cop

dos:643b21851733dfca.description: A well-written interactive fiction set in the Twilight universe by Paragon Software. Your girlfriend is kidnapped, and you must deal with the kidnappers, rescue her and save the world.
dos:643b21851733dfca.title: Twilight's Ransom

dos:643dbcfcd055d215.description: An arcade go-kart racing game with 16 tracks, the predecessor of Manic Karts. Just drive and steer, picking up power-ups and upgrades such as Turbo, Oil and Grip.
dos:643dbcfcd055d215.title: SuperKarts

dos:643e2e09671e2149.description: A Psygnosis arcade game in which you control an arrow that sets a direction and fire balls from it, aiming at the right angles to score a goal against your opponent.
dos:643e2e09671e2149.title: Ballistix

dos:6445f67ae84cfa11.description: The classic text adventure. Starting near a white house in a forest, you enter the Great Underground Empire to collect the Nineteen Treasures of Zork.
dos:6445f67ae84cfa11.title: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire

dos:644e82d2714c5394.description: A turn-based strategy game about two warring kingdoms with no computer opponent, so you need a friend or play yourself. After setting up your area, players take turns moving tanks, rotating turrets and firing.
dos:644e82d2714c5394.title: Tank Regime

dos:645c25c6bc7a4a1d.description: AGD Interactive's remake of the second King's Quest chapter. King Graham travels to the land of Kolyma to find his bride and must find three mystical stones to open the way to her.
dos:645c25c6bc7a4a1d.title: King's Quest II: Romancing the Stones (2002 Remake)

dos:6478bb8e168c7cda.description: A text-only financial game like Lemonade Stand, but with drug sales, robberies and shootouts with the police. You start with $500 in one of eight US cities.
dos:6478bb8e168c7cda.title: Druglord

dos:64a9697a4777eae0.description: A stick figure fighting game with 256 fighters, one for each color, for two players.
dos:64a9697a4777eae0.title: Fight!

dos:64adbaf397a6d060.description: A parser-based graphic adventure in the style of early Polarware and Scott Adams titles, one of six such games from Mark Data Products that first appeared on the Tandy CoCo.
dos:64adbaf397a6d060.title: The Vortex Factor

dos:64bdfef9c5895ef0.description: An isometric action adventure set in medieval Japan. The last survivor of a slaughtered ninja clan walks, jumps and fights his way to take revenge on the evil shogun responsible.
dos:64bdfef9c5895ef0.title: The Last Ninja

dos:64c09c3c1a176d4c.description: A shareware version of Hanafuda, the Japanese Flower Card game also known as Koi-koi, played alone against the computer. Collect families of cards by matching their pictures.
dos:64c09c3c1a176d4c.title: 1995Card+

dos:64c5f532246de91f.description: An RPG adventure in which the Evil Wizard Marbodaei has scattered stolen jewels across the Twelve Worlds of Tamrak. Travel from the home world to the other worlds to find each hidden jewel.
dos:64c5f532246de91f.title: The Fantasy Worlds of Tamrak

dos:64cc1b5ade8514f1.description: A shareware RPG with intricate tactical combat and extensive world exploration. Control a team of eight characters on a quest to find and destroy the demons of Omalin, with 100 spells and 300 monsters.
dos:64cc1b5ade8514f1.title: Nahlakh

dos:64d473699a0cbb7b.description: The first game of the Super Kroz trilogy: more puzzles, more monsters to kill or avoid, and more levels.
dos:64d473699a0cbb7b.title: Return to Kroz

dos:64e786472d4a98d9.description: An educational game for children under five in the Fun School series. Spend the day with Teddy in six activities, each with varying skill levels.
dos:64e786472d4a98d9.title: Fun School 4: For the Under 5s

dos:64e8713c7e7eddfb.description: A freeware episode of the Game of Robot series, made to introduce new players. Explore screens, solve puzzles and find all the keys scattered across 12 levels.
dos:64e8713c7e7eddfb.title: Robot Junior

dos:64e8956190b5b9b9.description: The second volume of the series lets you reenact five crucial battles of the American Civil War: Gaines Mill, Stones River, Gettysburg, Chickamauga and Chattanooga, in a turn-based, hex-based wargame.
dos:64e8956190b5b9b9.title: Decisive Battles of the American Civil War, Vol. 2

dos:651bb72d1fa5d276.description: A LORD-style BBS door RPG set in a near-future town where a mysterious force is possessing residents and driving them to violence with brutal hand weapons.
dos:651bb72d1fa5d276.title: Totally Smashed

dos:6523287779984ac9.description: A top-down shooter similar to Commando and Ikari Warriors. Terrorists have seized the control complex of a nuclear missile site, and you must infiltrate it and eliminate their leader before they launch.
dos:6523287779984ac9.title: Heavy Barrel

dos:6523f935102ebad3.description: An interactive fiction game about a young elf's adventures in a kingdom of ogres.
dos:6523f935102ebad3.title: Elf Quest

dos:652ee548647a2442.description: A baseball game for one or two players, played in parks, vacant lots and backyards with makeshift bases. Beyond normal rules, you cope with mud puddles, tree stumps and other hazards, in split-screen view.
dos:652ee548647a2442.title: Street Sports Baseball

dos:653dcd36a53e99d2.description: An educational platform game for practicing spelling. Control Boppie, a bouncing ball, and collect letters in the correct order to form words, one letter at a time.
dos:653dcd36a53e99d2.title: Boppie's Great Word Chase

dos:65431e87ed2431c3.description: An action puzzler similar to Lode Runner and Lemmings. Help prehistoric humans evolve by guiding a group of characters to discover tools, the wheel, weapons and fire.
dos:65431e87ed2431c3.title: The Humans

dos:654719527cd39cf4.description: A classic RPG about survivors after an apocalyptic event. Your characters must gather vehicle components to build a car and reach a haven, with character generation and skill modification.
