dos:654719527cd39cf4.title: Scavengers of the Mutant World

dos:65487a74f09ec167.description: A simple text-mode game in which you play a miner hunting for gold. A spot may hold a nugget or sand, stone, a cave, or an underground river that floods the mines beneath it.
dos:65487a74f09ec167.title: Gold Miner

dos:6548c62c0b314cae.description: A 3D first-person shooter and flight game in which you fly through mines. The Post-Terran Minerals Corporation's mining robots have been hacked and have taken the human workers hostage.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Flight Simulator; Vehicle Simulation
dos:6548c62c0b314cae.title: Descent

dos:654b9169d1a41f7f.description: A fighting game in which you choose one of 10 characters and pilot one of 10 huge robots in the year 2097, when one company called W.A.R. controls humanity.
dos:654b9169d1a41f7f.title: One Must Fall 2097

dos:6554315222d75ad5.description: The Jurassic Levels, an add-on with 80 more levels for the Lemmings-style puzzler The Humans (Evolution: Dino Dudes), with the objects collected in the first game available from the start.
dos:6554315222d75ad5.title: The Humans 2: Insult to Injury

dos:655ad61e4882d9ad.description: A shooter in which you play a death star that automatically fires anti-particles up, down, left and right. Move it so the particles hit and destroy other stars for points.
dos:655ad61e4882d9ad.title: Tommy's Starball

dos:6565635a14d766a3.description: An Italian first-person shooter in the style of Doom, available as a playable demo version 0.99 from 1998.
dos:6565635a14d766a3.title: Kaos

dos:656a782ab7f9a511.description: A space combat game like Wing Commander in which you pilot a ship as the lone hope of humanity against two alien races. Multiplayer modes like Race and Tag are available over IPX networks.
dos:656a782ab7f9a511.title: Darklight Conflict

dos:656de3fd337b60a7.description: King Graham collapses and can be saved only by retrieving a magical item, so his daughter Rosella journeys to fetch it in this entry of the King's Quest adventure series.
dos:656de3fd337b60a7.title: King's Quest IV: The Perils of Rosella

dos:656e3073061880d0.description: Drive your tank, shoot the bad guys and avoid getting shot.
dos:656e3073061880d0.title: Hyper Tank!

dos:656f086b15c45d76.description: A quiz game based on a CBS game show, with 1,000 questions. Play a friend or a computer opponent, earning money across two matches to rob the Vault.
dos:656f086b15c45d76.title: Combination Lock

dos:6576d7e3410398e2.description: An arcade racing game set in the hardest racing series in the known galaxy, where you race against the best pilots of the universe in a fight of life and death.
dos:6576d7e3410398e2.title: Battlerace

dos:6576fdb119ac95ca.description: A Finnish taxi simulation in which Pentti-Antero Sillankoykas, a lifelong disabled man cured by prophetic dreams, starts a taxi service for disabled people.
dos:6576fdb119ac95ca.title: Inva-taxi

dos:657775f2aa4e3223.description: A Dinamic soccer game carried out by ex-Real Madrid player Michel. It has two loads: Super Skills, test events that introduce you to the controls, and the main game.
dos:657775f2aa4e3223.title: Michel Futbol Master + Super Skills

dos:659109523ff65e0f.description: A naval strategy game, the spiritual successor to The Lost Admiral, with VGA graphics, more resources, research to unlock more powerful ships and an extra-powerful flagship with cruise missiles.
dos:659109523ff65e0f.title: The Grandest Fleet

dos:6598ca42b662974b.description: A strategic puzzle action game in which you clear the playfield of colored tiles before time runs out. Each playfield depicts a period of human history, such as Prehistory, Crusades, Prohibition or the Berlin Wall.
dos:6598ca42b662974b.title: Time Race

dos:659f6a70eb673e70.description: An adventure about a little monkey who finds life in a zoo too boring and dreams of a far-off monkey island full of fun and bananas. He needs your help to escape.
dos:659f6a70eb673e70.title: Runaway (1994)

dos:65a47f7503247ae3.description: Shredder will take over New York City in 48 hours. The Ninja Turtles, each with a different weapon, fight crime in a side-scroller that leads to him.
dos:65a47f7503247ae3.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Manhattan Missions

dos:65a76f7357d771db.description: A shooter released under the name Police Academy II on other platforms, in which you play a lawman training as a policeman.
dos:65a76f7357d771db.title: The Enforcer

dos:65a875d5bdb4271b.description: Electronic Arts' chess game, based on a competition-winning chess engine with a database of 500 games, an SVGA isometric chessboard and the license of world champion Garry Kasparov.
dos:65a875d5bdb4271b.title: Kasparov's Gambit

dos:65a9f78ddbb42d38.description: A variant of American checkers for one or two players, where the pieces are individuals with arms and armor bought at the outset, and RPG-style traits decide the outcome of moves.
dos:65a9f78ddbb42d38.title: Combat Checkers

dos:65aba50f7de47018.description: A pool simulation in which you can pick various jungle monkeys as your player.
dos:65aba50f7de47018.title: Billiards

dos:65d26450ccf072c3.description: A mix of space shooter, jump-and-run and beat 'em up starring Hulk Hogan as the Hulkster in a suburban setting.
tags: Action; Fighting / Beat 'em Up; Platform; Shooter / Scrolling shoot'em up
dos:65d26450ccf072c3.title: Suburban Commando

dos:65d48b3abb4691f8.description: A trilogy of Level 9 text adventures, Snowball, Return to Eden and Worm in Paradise, playable separately; for the maximum score, complete them in order.
dos:65d48b3abb4691f8.title: Silicon Dreams

dos:65e267b4e1ff4043.description: A keyboard-controlled edutainment title for teaching math through simple sums. The shareware version practices addition and subtraction.
dos:65e267b4e1ff4043.title: Adventure Math

dos:65e432d7fb75de6f.description: In the 22nd century, you are a gem prospector in the asteroid belt harvesting precious stones, while Commie Claim Jumpers, a group of space pirates, contest your mining rights.
dos:65e432d7fb75de6f.title: Master Miner

dos:65e51830e5004085.description: A scrolling shooter based on The Neverending Story, following Bastian's flight on Falcor.
dos:65e51830e5004085.title: La Historia Inolvidable

dos:65ed5cfce250ea91.description: A Paperboy-style game in which Pat drives his van to deliver telephone directories for Delivery Man Dan, who broke his leg, avoiding obstacles and fuel running out over five days.
dos:65ed5cfce250ea91.title: Postman Pat 3: To the Rescue

dos:65fdc9063bd88f88.description: The third volume of the series lets you reenact six battles of the American Civil War: Wilderness, Spotsylvania, Cold Harbor, Atlanta, Franklin and Nashville, in a turn-based, hex-based wargame.
dos:65fdc9063bd88f88.title: Decisive Battles of the American Civil War, Vol. 3

dos:6600de1889b88e02.description: A maze game in which theologian Vince M. Louis enters the Labyrinth of Zeux in search of the magical Silver Staff, collecting keys and treasures along the way.
dos:6600de1889b88e02.title: Labrynth of Zeux

dos:6600e5da117aa963.description: A freeware puzzle game in which barrels roll out of a factory toward a destination on an incomplete track. Arrange the available pieces of track to route them there.
dos:6600e5da117aa963.title: Baroll

dos:6611dc3825d1b3c7.description: A shareware code-breaking game. The computer picks a secret five-letter word and you have twenty attempts to deduce it from feedback on which letters your guesses contain.
dos:6611dc3825d1b3c7.title: Tommy's Jottomania

dos:6614ffd0b188cd7e.description: An interactive movie set in December 2042, as the world recovers from World War III and radioactivity has turned many humans into mutants.
dos:6614ffd0b188cd7e.title: Under a Killing Moon

dos:661ac56ba0f55a27.description: A CD-ROM re-release of Lone Wolf: The Mirror of Death, renamed Tower of Fear after the Lone Wolf license was lost.
dos:661ac56ba0f55a27.title: Tower of Fear

dos:66388da0a153d127.description: An implementation of the Monopoly board game for up to eight players, with the computer as an opponent in single-player, a short game mode, a super short game mode and a time limit.
dos:66388da0a153d127.title: Tommy's Monopoly

dos:66623b82c4cab65d.description: A character-graphics arcade game in which an ASCII smiley face erases solid blocks and trails left by streaking meteors while avoiding getting splattered by them.
dos:66623b82c4cab65d.title: Meteor

dos:66737beae623adeb.description: A text adventure made with the Computer Novel Construction Set. You are Bradford Scotts, a famous musician who comes to a town seeking refuge from his fans and wants to find peace and quiet by buying a house.
dos:66737beae623adeb.title: Strange Days

dos:668054e5f79ed73d.description: A version of LockerGnome Quest, Brian Provinciano's original SCI Studio demo game, with the sciAudio application added for digital speech.
dos:668054e5f79ed73d.title: LockerGnome Quest Redux

dos:668b84fa66c4fcc3.description: A game of four distinct sub-games based on the Eddie Murphy film. Axel Foley first visits a warehouse to shoot out bad guys in a sequence influenced by Green Beret, then goes on to other challenges.
dos:668b84fa66c4fcc3.title: Beverly Hills Cop

dos:669738ae93521fcb.description: A shareware package of eight educational mini-games for children that gives audio feedback and encouragement. It is a companion to 123-Talk.
dos:669738ae93521fcb.title: ABC-Talk

dos:66984f0387c2bf2a.description: An early 3D RPG set in the AD&D Ravenloft setting and sequel to Strahd's Possession, an advance over the step-by-step adventuring of games like Bard's Tale.
dos:66984f0387c2bf2a.title: Ravenloft: Stone Prophet

dos:669f0012f154d77c.description: A five-card draw poker game against photographed opponents. Manage your bets to win successive rounds, with optional data disks adding more opponents to the original two.
dos:669f0012f154d77c.title: Str♥p Poker: A Sizzling Game of Chance

dos:66a439169813a8da.description: An enhanced remake of Paraplane in which you learn and practice paragliding: taking off, landing and riding air currents, with several skill stages from practicing to free flying.
dos:66a439169813a8da.title: Paragliding

dos:66a60c5fa98bf69b.description: A PC implementation of the Rubik's Cube puzzle.
dos:66a60c5fa98bf69b.title: Rubic

dos:66b1577c1a41dc67.description: A Korean action platformer about a man arrested for crossing on a red light who must escape from prison. It has platforming reminiscent of Prince of Persia and fighting modes.
dos:66b1577c1a41dc67.title: Monmallineun Tarokbeom

dos:66d4125e1459ff79.description: A Korean fighting game for one or two players, with a short intro story and detailed but demanding graphics.
dos:66d4125e1459ff79.title: Fighter: Taklamakan Samak-pyeon

dos:66d460296e57227c.description: You play Rick Dangerous, an Indiana Jones type searching for the lost Goolu tribe in the Amazon. After his plane crashes among crazed natives, he must escape and later face the traps of an Egyptian pyramid.
dos:66d460296e57227c.title: Rick Dangerous

dos:66db32488e0fb70d.description: A Test Drive entry about racing on rough surfaces rather than tarmac. Choose from four monster trucks, a Hummer, Land Rover Defender 90, Jeep Wrangler or Chevrolet K-1500 Z71, each with its own handling.
dos:66db32488e0fb70d.title: Test Drive: Off-Road

dos:66e82ed26eb87b57.description: An early math program from the IBM Personal Computer Education Series, devoted entirely to mathematics despite its abstract title.
dos:66e82ed26eb87b57.title: Fact Track

dos:67136c745f24435a.description: An action game in which you steer an urthwurm, a worm that follows existing tunnels and stops dead when it hits an obstacle head-on.
dos:67136c745f24435a.title: Urthwurm

dos:671f0ae2ffcdf64b.description: A 3D arcade racing game with two vehicle types, F-1 cars and Stock Cars, each with different handling. Compete in a championship that covers circuits of increasing difficulty.
dos:671f0ae2ffcdf64b.title: Speed Haste

dos:6724a86a346890c1.description: A Tetris-style falling-block puzzle game made with the AGI engine.
dos:6724a86a346890c1.title: AGI Tetris

dos:67264a7a52e0c222.description: You play Abraham Lincoln or Jefferson Davis during the American Civil War, making the strategic, political and economic decisions: leading the government, mobilizing armies and picking generals.
dos:67264a7a52e0c222.title: No Greater Glory: The American Civil War

dos:6727040ec6efc9c1.description: An adventure RPG from Magnetic Scrolls and MicroProse. It is 1993, and your ancestors the Winthrops dealt with black magic and perhaps pacts with demons.
dos:6727040ec6efc9c1.title: The Legacy: Realm of Terror

dos:67277b41b44eaf38.description: A collection of 75 levels, including 15 multiplayer maps, selected from a contest for Redneck Rampage.
dos:67277b41b44eaf38.title: So You Wanna Be A Redneck

dos:673d889075129ae8.description: Pilot the F-16 on dogfights, bombing raids and reconnaissance. Plan your route by setting waypoints on the tactical map before takeoff and optionally choose your armament.
dos:673d889075129ae8.title: F-16 Combat Pilot

dos:6743d3ef2761bd2c.description: The sequel to Zool. Play the Ninja of the Nth Dimension, or his girlfriend Zooz, through 15 platform levels against the villains Mental Block and Krool, collecting treats along the way.
dos:6743d3ef2761bd2c.title: Zool 2

dos:6746b65399c27ecf.description: A chess game with a cyber, Tron-like theme. The board has pieces resting on intersections instead of squares, but play is identical to chess.
dos:6746b65399c27ecf.title: Cyberchess

dos:6750b97ad8146a27.description: A historical simulation of Magellan's voyage to circumnavigate the world. Deal with rough seas, unreliable maps, rebellious crews and unfriendly natives, with persons and situations based on real history.
dos:6750b97ad8146a27.title: Galleons of Glory: The Secret Voyage of Magellan

dos:67556d02f0b1bc69.description: A shooter in the vein of Missile Command. Control a single American SDI satellite and protect the USA from waves of Soviet attacks by zapping incoming missiles before the warheads strike.
dos:67556d02f0b1bc69.title: SDI: Strategic Defense Initiative

dos:676af99d7bab5c0c.description: A puzzle game in which you arrange colored balls, green, purple, blue or yellow, into quartets at several locations on the board. The locations are balls you can spin to send others through connecting paths.
dos:676af99d7bab5c0c.title: Log!cal

dos:676b4a42a8a7b664.description: A football simulation from the head coach of the Chicago Bears. Modify plays or design your own for 28 pro teams, with four passing methods and instant replay from 4 angles.
dos:676b4a42a8a7b664.title: Mike Ditka Ultimate Football

dos:677ee3dfb68dc976.description: A tile-matching game in which you remove matched tiles in pairs, and a tile can be removed only if it is open on its left or right side. Play in solitary or tournament mode.
dos:677ee3dfb68dc976.title: Tiles of the Dragon

dos:67886dbfd116a9de.description: Slater the Petrosaur and his friend Charlie visit various locations and take on tasks to enjoy a camping trip in the great outdoors, in an educational game.
dos:67886dbfd116a9de.title: Slater & Charlie Go Camping

dos:678a3e6ade78d6dc.description: A top-down shooter in which you save the world by going from arena to arena shooting at the other guy.
dos:678a3e6ade78d6dc.title: Cyberwars

dos:678b30600f44a786.description: You wake from reconstructive surgery with the face of Angel Devoid, the master criminal you were hunting, and now you are the hunted.
dos:678b30600f44a786.title: Angel Devoid: Face of the Enemy

dos:678ef6c2447855c8.description: A 3D Rubik's Cube controlled by mouse or keyboard. Rotate the cube around the axes and turn its faces with the number keys to restore each face to a solid color.
dos:678ef6c2447855c8.title: 3DCube

dos:67a6359c623ef1cf.description: A port of the Colossal Cave Adventure text game, based on Bob Supnik's DECUS implementation of Don Woods' 350-point version. Explore a cave and solve puzzles to find treasure.
dos:67a6359c623ef1cf.title: Adventure

dos:67b5c02c2b4b8105.description: An eight-player game of conquest. Assemble vast armies, conquer and loot cities, undertake quests, make and break alliances and wield magical artifacts on different worlds.
dos:67b5c02c2b4b8105.title: Warlords II Deluxe

dos:67b6ac1f19c51967.description: A simple target-shooting game with a swiveling ground gun pointed in five angles at birds streaking across the sky in ASCII.
dos:67b6ac1f19c51967.title: Skeet Shoot

dos:67c7be2977980315.description: A proof-of-concept side-scrolling platformer. A little man moves with the arrow keys and hops to dodge slowly falling bombs and collect the level's 39 gold coins.
dos:67c7be2977980315.title: Scroller

dos:67c98905c1ee249d.description: A tank-based action game. As a new tank pilot for the Nataka Corporation's Imperial Armored Cavalry, you are drawn into a full-scale war when a Nataka installation is attacked by forces from Network 53.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Vehicle Simulation
dos:67c98905c1ee249d.title: Gunmetal

dos:67cf7670efbf20bc.description: A collection of a dozen low-bandwidth mini-games for two players, some turn-based and some simultaneous, played by direct computer connection through a modem, with ANSI textmode graphics.
tags: Action; Board Game / Party Game; Sports
dos:67cf7670efbf20bc.title: Worthy Opponent

dos:67d1207c61107bc5.description: A flight simulator and follow-up to EA's earlier flight trainer. It offers many planes and flight modes such as formations, races and obstacle courses, plus a comprehensive flight training option.
dos:67d1207c61107bc5.title: Chuck Yeager's Advanced Flight Trainer 2.0

dos:67d182653f94f8a2.description: A word puzzle in which you turn one word into another by changing one letter at a time, with every step a valid English word. Rounds get harder, and an optional Expert Mode adds more difficulty.
dos:67d182653f94f8a2.title: Word Ladders

dos:67de87f5e11ef634.description: A strategy game set in medieval England, much like Defender of the Crown. Start as a young knight with a small fiefdom, develop your economy, raise an army and expand your territory.
dos:67de87f5e11ef634.title: Conqueror: A.D. 1086

dos:67e694ebc5262480.description: The first game in the Redcat series. Redcat sets out to retrieve stolen treasure from the mice across 10 levels, killing different kinds of mice with his sword and bombs.
dos:67e694ebc5262480.title: RedCat

dos:67fcbe43162985ae.description: The sequel to Universal Military Simulator, giving total control over nearly every aspect of a battle. Scenarios include the Normandy invasion of 1944 and the battles of Alexander the Great.
dos:67fcbe43162985ae.title: UMS II: Nations at War

dos:682e83a7c3d7e71f.description: An educational game set in a child's bedroom, the first of a trilogy with The Treehouse and The Backyard. Almost everything on screen can be clicked, rewarding the child with games, activities or an animation.
dos:682e83a7c3d7e71f.title: The Playroom

dos:683de842e3f4658d.description: A political strategy simulator inspired by a prediction of events in the Middle East. In 1997 the Israeli prime minister dies and you are appointed the new prime minister, making and following political policies.
dos:683de842e3f4658d.title: Conflict

dos:6848e76852e16062.description: A music composition tool: drag notes, sharps and other nomenclature onto a staff with a pointer, play your score, cut, copy and paste sections, and print it.
dos:6848e76852e16062.title: Will Harvey's Music Construction Set

dos:68502cb4de69de5e.description: A graphics war game of strategy and tactical troop deployment. You are the commanding general facing one of eight opposing generals.
dos:68502cb4de69de5e.title: Rapid Response

dos:6854abcaea654227.description: An isometric 3D arcade adventure released by Ocean, originally for the Sinclair Spectrum 128K, MS-DOS and Atari ST.
dos:6854abcaea654227.title: Where Time Stood Still

dos:68567a85ef343d34.description: A standard backgammon game in the short variation where opponent stones can be taken. Play against the computer, with moves made by letter keys.
dos:68567a85ef343d34.title: Backgammon (1982)

dos:6857169124f5c4b7.description: A sci-fi air-combat simulation set in an alternate history where World War II never happened and aliens invade instead. You fly the Corsair nicknamed Corncob against the invaders.
dos:6857169124f5c4b7.title: Corncob Deluxe

dos:68600eec56e519e9.description: A side-scrolling Scramble variant in which you fly your spaceship across six zones, starting with zone 5, avoiding or destroying missiles while avoiding walls and watching your fuel.
dos:68600eec56e519e9.title: Zeroth Zone

dos:68618c494191ce1b.description: A Gauntlet-style game in which you travel through 99 mazes before meeting the final demon. It has a two-player cooperative mode and a built-in level editor with pull-down menus.
dos:68618c494191ce1b.title: Demon Stalkers

dos:6861a88ec8d40ee7.description: A World War II flight simulator using a slightly modified RealSpace engine from Strike Commander. Fly US or Japanese planes in historic missions such as dogfights, bombing runs and missile attacks.
dos:6861a88ec8d40ee7.title: Pacific Strike

dos:6864d325d65edcb7.description: Based on a children's board game, guide a metal ball through a maze without touching it, controlling it with two knobs. Koolah is an English spelling of the Finnish word kuula, a metal ball.
dos:6864d325d65edcb7.title: Koolah

dos:686a833e067d810c.description: The classic sliding block puzzle, written in BASIC. A 4x4 board holds tiles 1 to 15 and one empty space; slide them into numerical order.
dos:686a833e067d810c.title: The 15 Puzzle

dos:68765eea4c196ad8.description: A casino game in which you choose your wager, pick five numbers and try to win money.
dos:68765eea4c196ad8.title: Fantasy Five Spot

dos:687f872c984ea315.description: A text-based golf game with tees of different lengths and pars. You pick a club for each swing from four woods, eight irons and a wedge.
dos:687f872c984ea315.title: Golf

dos:6883ad798748f0a2.description: A robot catches multicolored figures falling from above and avoids the colorless ones, to energetic music. It can also be made to jump.
dos:6883ad798748f0a2.title: Cyber Antero

dos:68886950dc4ea2cb.description: A shareware Pac-Man clone in which you run around a maze eating power-ups and avoiding green gremlins, unless they have eaten a big power-up and go monster hunting. A small twist comes when you lose a life.
dos:68886950dc4ea2cb.title: MaxMan

dos:689493e26dbb5971.description: Harald Hardtooth, a tooth with a face, arms, legs and a bowtie, shoots bacteria with a tube of toothpaste across levels made of platforms.
dos:689493e26dbb5971.title: Harald Hardtooth in The fight of the Clean Teeth

dos:68a036efc724d326.description: Four number games for pre-school ages. In Munch you steer a Pac-Man-like figure to eat the correct answer, and in Tiny Bomb you type answers to math problems before the bomb goes off.
dos:68a036efc724d326.title: Number Fun 1

dos:68cce7cd88533103.description: A two-player phrase-guessing game. A player keeps their turn as long as they guess correct letters; 500 phrases in ten categories.
dos:68cce7cd88533103.title: Phrase Master

dos:68d22ae05e9b6d04.description: Guide Moses through 100 levels to reach the promised land. The action half plays like Boulder Dash, collecting question marks and Manna to open the exit, and a question half tests Bible knowledge.
dos:68d22ae05e9b6d04.title: Exodus: Journey to the Promised Land

dos:68e34a73ccdb92bb.description: A single-player mouse-driven collection of solitaire card games, including Auld Lang Syne, Calculation, Canfield, Four Seasons, Golf, Klondike and Little Spider, with undo and scores for multiple players.
dos:68e34a73ccdb92bb.title: Bicycle Solitaire

dos:68e6e3f2cffa076c.description: A short text adventure in which you enter commands to find out what happens the day after a night out.
dos:68e6e3f2cffa076c.title: Madam Fifi's Wh♥rehouse I: The Next Day!

dos:68e83f06dfd631a6.description: A poker game against the computer in which you win money by completing hands rather than by beating other hands.
dos:68e83f06dfd631a6.title: EGA Poker

dos:68f71a53c30dad46.description: Run a railroad company and build your own railroad empire, with a mass transit system that helps your chosen city develop. There are a number of places to set up business.
dos:68f71a53c30dad46.title: A-Train

dos:68fa0d8e3988a213.description: A conversion of the coin-op arcade game. Dirk the Daring, a clumsy knight, sets out to rescue Princess Daphne from the dragon Singe. Only the first half of the game is included.
dos:68fa0d8e3988a213.title: Dragon's Lair

dos:68fcc068b52d96f4.description: An add-on to Cadaver that needs the original disc. It continues the story with four more isometric levels of puzzles, plus new spells, potions and baddies, and redesigned maps.
dos:68fcc068b52d96f4.title: Cadaver: The Payoff

dos:69031f1e70498091.description: A CGA Jam entry set in space. Use your graviton engine to attract or repel asteroids and fuel cells, which you need to keep going.
dos:69031f1e70498091.title: Graviton (2017)

dos:69070cbe4ef932fd.description: An undersea adventure in search of hidden treasure in the fabled pirate cove of Silver Eye on the sea bottom, fighting through the inhabitants of the dark underworld.
dos:69070cbe4ef932fd.title: Dive: The Conquest of Silver Eye

dos:690de03c8663dad5.description: A shareware clone of Eugene Jarvis's Defender with the same gameplay. Control a spaceship to stop aliens abducting people, playable by keyboard, mouse or joystick, with a high score table.
dos:690de03c8663dad5.title: Defender (1992)

dos:691b7dcaac17835a.description: A tactical wargame of the near future, set in 2020 or 2044 depending on whether you play the US or German version. Single-player, two-player or head-to-head by modem, with modern forces and heavy lasers.
dos:691b7dcaac17835a.title: Front Lines

dos:6920336c31548399.description: Guide Mutt, the bad-luck Litil Divil, through the Labyrinth of Chaos to retrieve the Mystical Pizza of Plenty, across five levels with over 50 rooms of killer spiders and other hazards.
dos:6920336c31548399.title: Litil Divil

dos:69335b791acbd064.description: A Sierra-style adventure for kids based on nursery rhymes like Humpty Dumpty. All the rhymes have gotten mixed up, and the child must find the missing pieces and give them back.
dos:69335b791acbd064.title: Mixed-Up Mother Goose Enhanced

dos:69450469aebc15a9.description: A Tetris-like game in which the pieces fly all over the place and you must attract disks of the same color together, completing sets of four or more.
dos:69450469aebc15a9.title: Pulse

dos:6945705b0872d12c.description: A Boulder Dash-like game in which each tile has terrain worth points. Levels hold earth, boulders, teleporters, balloons and monsters; collect all the treasures and kill all the monsters, then exit.
dos:6945705b0872d12c.title: Wanderer

dos:695454fee73d9b64.description: A dragon flight simulator set in the AD&D world of Dragonlance, flying dragons through the War of the Lance. Complete 20 missions to rank up, gain magic items and hit points or get a better dragon.
dos:695454fee73d9b64.title: DragonStrike

dos:6982775960e7a9f6.description: A simple text-graphics bowling game for one to four players, with a selectable difficulty. The ball oscillates at the end of the lane and you press space to throw it.
dos:6982775960e7a9f6.title: Bowling Champ!!

dos:69b1fe84763ff9a3.description: The Block Man continues his quest to win Princess Pentagwin's hand by collecting all the jewels, solving puzzles with teleports, elevators, boats and blocks. It has strong Sound Blaster support.
dos:69b1fe84763ff9a3.title: Block-Man 2

dos:69b5ad2bde75e0af.description: A Vietnam War flight simulation in which you pilot the Republic F-105 Thunderchief, known as the Thud, on strike missions over North Vietnam's target zones.
dos:69b5ad2bde75e0af.title: Thud Ridge: American Aces in 'Nam

dos:69b8f1a1112c7aed.description: An interactive fiction in which daredevil autoist Troy and singer Miss Melody Sweet, with help from mechanical genius Aloysius Pratt, thwart a madman's evil plan.
dos:69b8f1a1112c7aed.title: Fine Tuned

dos:69cb627600314ea4.description: Two Might and Magic games in one, Clouds of Xeen and Darkside of Xeen, set in the land of Xeen, ruled by two villainous overlords. Solve quests and puzzles to unravel its secrets.
dos:69cb627600314ea4.title: Might and Magic: World of Xeen

dos:69cb9fec1fdfee27.description: A two-player DOS version of a Commodore 64 game from Compute!'s Gazette. The objective is to hit your opponent with a boomerang.
dos:69cb9fec1fdfee27.title: Boomerang

dos:69d3b8b3b6c9eba8.description: A simulation that lets you open safes. First identify the safe's manufacturer, model and class and its lock, with three attempts per item.
dos:69d3b8b3b6c9eba8.title: Safe Opening Simulator

dos:69d9797e0b19aa13.description: An action adventure in the Dome, heavily influenced by the original Legend of Zelda: you begin by getting a sword from an old man in a cave. Unlike part 2, it is not a platformer.
dos:69d9797e0b19aa13.title: Robomaze III: The Dome

dos:69de0212c22169f5.description: A homebrew platformer from a Korean high school, influenced by Super Mario World with a distinctly Korean flavor.
dos:69de0212c22169f5.title: Hopang Man

dos:69e5b3be75c20c80.description: A brawler in which Suhee searches the shadier districts of the city for her father, a dentist who has vanished, using her fighting and negotiating skills.
dos:69e5b3be75c20c80.title: Darkside Story

dos:69e6db19a102f97b.description: A simple arcade shooter with a space-aliens theme. A circular red and green avatar shoots in its direction of movement down grid corridors as alien ships come one by one to hunt it.
dos:69e6db19a102f97b.title: X-Fire

dos:69eaa12cb29ecc1e.description: A clean-looking backgammon game with several game types, traditional, acey deucey, gioul, plakoto and dutch, and several skill levels.
dos:69eaa12cb29ecc1e.title: EGA Gammon

dos:69f827f6a21b640e.description: A craps and casino gambling game with primitive ASCII graphics.
dos:69f827f6a21b640e.title: Highroller (1985)

dos:69fb8e2be5e28fe8.description: A space conquest game for up to six players around one computer. Moves are entered by keyboard and hidden from other players, and ships are not visible in flight, in 80x25 text mode.
dos:69fb8e2be5e28fe8.title: Galactic Conquest

dos:69ff0aaad38fcbe0.description: A fantasy RPG from SSI. A long-foretold prophecy is about to be fulfilled as the Shadow Lords prepare to enter our world, and you must find a way to break the chain of events it foretells.
dos:69ff0aaad38fcbe0.title: Prophecy Of The Shadow

dos:6a0651c5d7567cf5.description: A detailed spaceflight simulator from the makers of Microsoft Flight Simulator, taking you on a journey through the Milky Way and beyond.
dos:6a0651c5d7567cf5.title: Microsoft Space Simulator

dos:6a0a66e51d340ef3.description: You crash your spaceship on an alien world and must collect diamonds across ten levels to power it up and get home. A very difficult platform puzzler where the slightest mistake sends you back to the start.
dos:6a0a66e51d340ef3.title: The Game With No Name

dos:6a1455d682bc5f88.description: Drive a tank on a special mission to destroy a new type of torpedo, launched from a torpedo-house instead of from your submarine.
dos:6a1455d682bc5f88.title: Tank2

dos:6a1ef63bcf3fe44d.description: A futuristic shooter that combines two styles of gameplay across multiple levels. A state-of-the-art space cruiser with an android pilot, the Star Breaker, is sent to purge the Rrampon invaders from the colony planets of New Chicago.
dos:6a1ef63bcf3fe44d.title: Star Breaker

dos:6a4f85acd1859c8f.description: A soccer management game, successor to the 8-bit Trener. Choose the Polish, English, German, Italian, Spanish or French league, a European league or League of Nations, or create your own league from 288 teams.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:6a4f85acd1859c8f.title: Pol-Gol!

dos:6a55cacc919b1eb3.description: A strategy game by Chris Crawford, designed as a study of artificial personality and a language of interaction, set on Kira, a moon.
dos:6a55cacc919b1eb3.title: Trust and Betrayal: The Legacy of Siboot

dos:6a6c067369beb435.description: An overhead-view action RPG in which an apprentice wizard with four minor spells aims to defeat 7 master wizards, returning six treasures to their owners and finding more powerful spells.
dos:6a6c067369beb435.title: Wizard Warz

dos:6a6e41c59bf44d99.description: A baseball-themed catching game: control a catcher running along the bottom of the screen to catch falling balls. Difficulty rises every five waves.
dos:6a6e41c59bf44d99.title: Catch: If You Can!

dos:6a8de92789a68f41.description: A four-color ASCII Reversi-style board game against the computer, always playing the black pieces, with five levels from easiest to hardest.
tags: Board Game / Reverse or Othello; Strategy
dos:6a8de92789a68f41.title: 8088 Othello

dos:6a94c85a3a0b0798.description: A god simulation played on bulletin boards as a BBS door, where many gods battle to decide who should rule the heavens.
dos:6a94c85a3a0b0798.title: On The Seventh Day

dos:6ab4d31fb62a9d35.description: An arcade game of racing the clock to pick up and drop off passengers, keeping your taxi moving by rotating road sections with the mouse.
dos:6ab4d31fb62a9d35.title: Taxi Run

dos:6abb81667112e084.description: A golf game based on the 1993 Ryder Cup at the Belfry course. Icons show or hide information like the current hole and wind, with two control methods for each shot.
dos:6abb81667112e084.title: Ryder Cup: Johnnie Walker

dos:6ac82957ee345abe.description: An unofficial port of the vertical shoot 'em up Sky Jaguar released on MSX and ColecoVision.
dos:6ac82957ee345abe.title: Sky Jaguar

dos:6ac86087defcaf82.description: A turn-based strategy game on the planet Chromos, where the Drullian people fight the out-of-control AI Skynet-Titan. The screen is split in two, one half for each player.
dos:6ac86087defcaf82.title: Battle Isle

dos:6ad8b60b6b5471c1.description: A shoot 'em up in which you control a gun on a tower and shoot down airplanes and parachutists. It has four levels and weapons including a regular gun, homing missiles and a flame thrower.
dos:6ad8b60b6b5471c1.title: Air-Strike

dos:6ae28a59d9cbdc4d.description: An Olympiad game of winter events: Downhill, Giant Slalom, Luge, 2-man Bobsled, Ski Jump, Cross Country, Biathlon and Speed Skating, using a basic 3D engine to simulate slopes.
dos:6ae28a59d9cbdc4d.title: The Games: Winter Challenge

dos:6ae6591eca227e0b.description: A demo of a beat 'em up from a company specialized in arcade machines. Fight through single-screen levels, defeating all enemies on screen to advance, alone or with a second player.
dos:6ae6591eca227e0b.title: Metal Saver

dos:6ae81ad077e21adf.title: Sesame Street Storybook: Me Look for Cookie

dos:6aed426dc6a08731.description: A simple dart game in which you set the height on the y-axis, then stop a moving x-axis to land on the board. You count your own points, with three darts per round.
dos:6aed426dc6a08731.title: PC Darts

dos:6aeeb85b9cc47edf.description: A platformer in which each level is set in and around a building. Collect specific items and demolish a percentage of the building using several types of bombs.
dos:6aeeb85b9cc47edf.title: Larax & Zaco

dos:6af0a0d47c69d5f9.description: In peaceful Khantun, the former leader Kaimen has turned his powers to evil, the Holy Ones are kidnapped and monks rule. You must vanquish Kaimen and restore the path of righteousness in this action RPG.
dos:6af0a0d47c69d5f9.title: Moebius: The Orb of Celestial Harmony

dos:6af7787356c81b8b.description: You're stranded on a desert island and must escape with as many treasures as possible before the tsunami strikes, within a 500-move limit. A small, old two-word parser game.
dos:6af7787356c81b8b.title: Island of Mystery Adventure

dos:6afca8ef213db40e.description: A poker game from Artworx's series, a second volume of card challenges in which you beat photographed opponents hand by hand.
dos:6afca8ef213db40e.title: Str♥p Poker Professional Volume II

dos:6aff933ebd2027b8.description: A space trading and flying game that predates Elite, with more adventure elements.
dos:6aff933ebd2027b8.title: Enterprise

dos:6b05a6a9d832f79b.description: A small French fighting game in which two gnomes, one red and one blue, fight each other with a punch and a kick for each player.
dos:6b05a6a9d832f79b.title: FastGame

dos:6b117df22cf62cf1.description: A strategy game of the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865. Play the North or South and take over a number of the opposing side's cities before the war ends.
dos:6b117df22cf62cf1.title: The Civil War (1995)

dos:6b16ea66a5547f49.description: A strategy game in which you manage a city's police department. Decide how many cars to send to a call and how many to keep on patrol, and build new police stations.
dos:6b16ea66a5547f49.title: To Serve and to Protect

dos:6b17de3e0d9f2fb8.description: A Star Trek adventure in which evidence of an unknown civilization has been found. Avoid Klingon suspicion and carry diplomats to the planet Gothica to make a good first impression for the Federation.
dos:6b17de3e0d9f2fb8.title: Star Trek: First Contact

dos:6b28525c5e69d85f.description: A sci-fi adventure in which you try to save Earth from a collision with a mechanically controlled asteroid, involving space travel and exploring a deserted mining colony.
dos:6b28525c5e69d85f.title: Earthrise

dos:6b2bb0315552d3b4.description: A peg-solitaire board puzzle on a board of thirty-seven round cells, all but one filled with balls. Jump a ball over another into an empty cell, removing the one you jumped.
dos:6b2bb0315552d3b4.title: Hex Jump

dos:6b331da6a07d34ee.description: An ASCII recreation of the 1976 Midway coin-op Sea Wolf. As a submarine captain you have one minute to torpedo as many PT boats, submarines and oil tankers as you can.
dos:6b331da6a07d34ee.title: Seawolf

dos:6b34a1e360a95818.description: In this Discworld adventure, Rincewind is back, and Death is on an extended vacation, leaving those whose time is up faltering in limbo. He must bring Death back.
dos:6b34a1e360a95818.title: Discworld II: Mortality Bytes!

dos:6b359ec8388bca54.description: A drill and practice program for addition and subtraction facts. Choose the operations, the specific facts and the number of seconds allowed to answer each.
dos:6b359ec8388bca54.title: Flash Facts Add Subtract

dos:6b3f65c77f732e60.description: A text adventure for vintage computers, set on August 27th, 1904, in which you play Emilia Vittorini and type commands to instruct your alter ego.
dos:6b3f65c77f732e60.title: The Queen's Footsteps

dos:6b56ffa972105751.description: A storybook authoring program in which children create and publish their own illustrated books, building writing, reading and vocabulary skills. The series was used in over 20,000 US schools.
dos:6b56ffa972105751.title: Once Upon a Time... Volume II: Worlds of Enchantment

dos:6b6851a2ce2ccf7d.description: Magic Boy becomes a master wizard by shooting enemies, putting them in a bag and throwing them away. He passes through four areas, Sand Land, Wet World, Plastic Place and Future Zone, collecting power-ups.
dos:6b6851a2ce2ccf7d.title: Magic Boy

dos:6b6c8ab3e4cb4d5d.description: A special edition of SkyRoads with three new Christmas worlds and a training course, though adding them means you can no longer play some of the original worlds.
dos:6b6c8ab3e4cb4d5d.title: SkyRoads: Xmas Special

dos:6b6fe99dfe42e278.description: A logic adventure in which you are taken into Robotropolis, an underground city of robots, and must program your helpers Sparky, Checkers and Scanner to solve puzzles and escape.
dos:6b6fe99dfe42e278.title: Robot Odyssey

dos:6b71821e0ae8c9ba.description: A low-budget 3D fighting game from the small Japan-based developer 47-Tek, with modes for fighting the computer, another player or training against an inactive opponent.
dos:6b71821e0ae8c9ba.title: Sento

dos:6b79149051636f82.description: A Pac-Man platform adventure in which Pac-Man travels through time in an Indiana Jones-like romp. There is little to eat; the object is collecting points.
dos:6b79149051636f82.title: Pac-In-Time

dos:6b7f07dce7ee3e90.description: An interactive fiction allegory for thousands of years of cyclical human history embroiled in military warfare and conflict.
dos:6b7f07dce7ee3e90.title: The Great Machine

dos:6b845561ec725ddb.description: A backgammon game for two human players or one human against three levels of AI, or you can watch two AI players. It follows the original rules and is played with a cursor.
dos:6b845561ec725ddb.title: Club Backgammon

dos:6b960a7f3fb4175c.description: A fan-made port of the Sega Genesis classic using the original sprites. At 50 coins you automatically become Super Sonic.
dos:6b960a7f3fb4175c.title: Sonic the Hedgehog

dos:6b979aadff30884b.description: The second Ford Simulator, an advertisement for Ford's 1990 product line in five sections, including a driving simulator with customizable controls, sound, difficulty and type of driving.
dos:6b979aadff30884b.title: Ford Simulator II

dos:6ba0e1f944d24553.description: The Time Thieves, plunderers of time-changing technology, have stolen the cutting-edge image processing technology of the city of DSPea. Engineering Jones, Senior Time Warden, and his robot buddy CirQuet must set things right.
dos:6ba0e1f944d24553.title: Engineering Jones and the Time Thieves of DSPea

dos:6ba4671dca674f3f.description: You are a Space Marshall investigating a distress call from the colony Delta 5-5. Your ship crash-lands on the planet, and you put on your Power Armor to explore the planet's surface.
dos:6ba4671dca674f3f.title: The Colony

dos:6bb5ed9ac74a9efe.description: Roger Wilco relaxes in his favorite pub somewhere in time and space when soldiers carrying a parting message from his old nemesis Sludge Vohaul come to execute him, in this Space Quest adventure.
dos:6bb5ed9ac74a9efe.title: Space Quest IV: Roger Wilco and the Time Rippers

dos:6bb7a72b83f5226a.description: The first EA Sports game with Virtual Stadium technology, giving a 3D feel and multiple camera angles. It has the NHL license with real teams and players, a full league and playoffs, and optional fighting and penalties.
dos:6bb7a72b83f5226a.title: NHL 96

dos:6bc1dedea7e405f8.description: An oceanographic simulation in which you begin as an inexperienced oceanographer and build your reputation exploring other lost vessels, then plan a Titanic search with funding, a ship, personnel and equipment.
dos:6bc1dedea7e405f8.title: Search for the Titanic

dos:6bc659fe1c05efd1.description: A first-person shooter in which Nick Hunter must thwart the evil Thorne Devereaux's plan to coat US currency with time-delayed explosive by infiltrating his base and mowing down nameless guards.
dos:6bc659fe1c05efd1.title: Lethal Tender

dos:6bc6f1caa943bd83.description: A freeware console-style RPG with hand-drawn 2D tile graphics, rendered battle backgrounds and an original score. You play Spear on a quest to discover your true identity.
dos:6bc6f1caa943bd83.title: Mysterious Song

dos:6bc9a2cbc2593450.description: The sequel to Nicky Boom. Nicky must find out who has been removing ladders and blocking caves in his homeland, in multi-directional maze-like platform levels with some brainwork.
dos:6bc9a2cbc2593450.title: Nicky 2

dos:6bce12d6084afd36.description: A translation of the famous mainframe BASIC game, a turn-based, text-based strategy game in a randomly generated galaxy. From the captain's chair of the Enterprise, you must blast a number of Klingon warships.
dos:6bce12d6084afd36.title: Star Trek

dos:6bd3026fb3900e63.description: An interactive fiction based on R.A. MacAvoy's fantasy novel. You play a young warlock, Damiano Delstrego, in a fantastical Italian Renaissance, and the angel Raphael gives you lute lessons.
dos:6bd3026fb3900e63.title: I, Damiano: The Wizard of Partestrada

dos:6bddc03ba2020c01.description: Strategic Simulations' baseball game simulating a full major league season. View statistics for every team, and play with one or two players or manage teams while the computer plays.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:6bddc03ba2020c01.title: Tony La Russa's Ultimate Baseball

dos:6beb5cefaa216233.description: A solitaire card game in which cards are laid in a row and you pile them all on top of one another, moving a card or pile one or two spaces left onto a card that matches in suit or value.
dos:6beb5cefaa216233.title: Accordion

dos:6c00c6d476705506.description: In World War II, as the Allies' top agent B.J. Blazkowicz, you go after the Spear of Destiny, taken by the Nazis from Versailles to the impregnable Castle Wolfenstein, in this first-person shooter.
dos:6c00c6d476705506.title: Spear of Destiny

dos:6c03717482a8d6c1.description: A shareware Pac-Man clone with few differences from the original apart from a two-player hot-seat mode.
dos:6c03717482a8d6c1.title: Pacmania

dos:6c0c0d5ce89492bc.description: A pirate board game with trivia. Choose a captain and play two other human or computer players, rolling dice to sail across the seaways and reach home port with as much booty as possible.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Quiz; Strategy
dos:6c0c0d5ce89492bc.title: Redhook's Revenge

dos:6c0f312f464f0277.description: A football game licensed to Joe Montana but not the NFL, so teams represent cities and the fictional rosters are fully editable. The action is viewed from the side.
dos:6c0f312f464f0277.title: Joe Montana Football

dos:6c1fdd84f818fb7e.description: A real-time strategy game set in a future where private security forces have become a corporate world police. You run the mercenary company Granite, researching components to build your own combat units, with a stock market.
dos:6c1fdd84f818fb7e.title: War Inc.

dos:6c24bf3b917fc065.description: A snake game in which your elongated hero roams an enclosed playfield for food without doubling back, hitting walls or biting its own tail. Pick up five pieces of food to clear each level.
dos:6c24bf3b917fc065.title: Serpent

dos:6c2f68c639ebcfa5.description: A variation on the original Star Trek computer game, in ASCII, from Windmill Software. The Klingon and Romulan empires form a United Front against the Federation and you command the USS Enterprise to counter them.
dos:6c2f68c639ebcfa5.title: Video Trek 88

dos:6c3e230c475c30f7.description: The third game in the MicroLeague Baseball series, using the EGA graphics of MLB2 with many more players, player ratings, stadium factors and enhancements.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:6c3e230c475c30f7.title: MicroLeague Baseball: The Manager's Challenge

dos:6c3f6cbc386a23a3.description: Finish building a high-rise while avoiding falling screws, vandals and the building inspectors.
dos:6c3f6cbc386a23a3.title: Hard Hat Mack

dos:6c422f14f176da20.description: A shooter in which you are the worst fighter of the Yanchooz, who are trying to destroy and enslave other races. After you botched your last 18 missions, your leader Xyfud Plasfoc wants you dead.
dos:6c422f14f176da20.title: Earth Invasion

dos:6c46d65b92372b54.description: A little-known arcade flight game set in the American West around World War I. You are an air stuntman in a biplane who later competes against other pilots in survival battles.
dos:6c46d65b92372b54.title: Dawgfight

dos:6c7152275abd9d79.description: A grand-strategic simulation of World War II in Europe in which you control land, sea and air action and manage limited production and research. Six historical scenarios run from Autumn 1939.
dos:6c7152275abd9d79.title: Storm Across Europe

dos:6c71ed1c16c017d0.description: A football management game similar to an early Championship Manager. Play any team in the English Premier League, with commentary and highlights shown by a graphical engine.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:6c71ed1c16c017d0.title: The Premiership

dos:6c8233121214abdf.description: A four-player trivia game about The Beatles.
dos:6c8233121214abdf.title: Fab Four

dos:6ca1c7b94494225b.description: A Ghosts 'n Goblins clone with nice graphics, decent gameplay and good level design.
dos:6ca1c7b94494225b.title: The Last Knight

dos:6ca219c16750ba52.description: A side-scrolling space shooter controlled with the mouse. Your sprite is fairly large, which makes it hard to avoid incoming fire.
dos:6ca219c16750ba52.title: Aliens (1996)(Christoph Roschter)

dos:6ca66f4cba26b180.description: You are Oscar, running and jumping through 7 Hollywood-style levels (Science Fiction, Western, Horror, Cartoons, Dino, Detective and Gameshow) to find Oscar statuettes. Levels can be played in any order.
dos:6ca66f4cba26b180.title: Oscar

dos:6caf59ccbfa9be2e.description: Maxis's planet simulation. Take charge of a whole planet over its 10 billion year lifespan, guiding it from single-celled life to inhabitants who reach the stars, against pollution, disease, famine and war.
dos:6caf59ccbfa9be2e.title: Sim Earth: The Living Planet

dos:6cafb5d907ffe7e3.description: An MS-DOS port of a 1982 CoCo adventure, Treasures of the Enrakian Empire, written over nine months by its authors.
dos:6cafb5d907ffe7e3.title: Enrak Adventure

dos:6cb749f7c19b17c1.description: An educational game that teaches geography. Bowser has set up headquarters in Antarctica and created portals to 25 famous cities for his Koopas, and has kidnapped Mario.
dos:6cb749f7c19b17c1.title: Mario is Missing! Deluxe

dos:6cc8987837af6c40.description: A vertically scrolling space shoot 'em up over 16 short levels. Your fighter shoots swirling alien patterns and stationary cannons, collects extras and fights bosses, with a two-player option.
dos:6cc8987837af6c40.title: Bedlam (1988)

dos:6ccae2349bb96727.description: A shareware platform game in which you control a robot called Heels through rooms, avoiding alien creatures and holes.
dos:6ccae2349bb96727.title: Platform Heels

dos:6cd0408f8816d8e7.description: A graphical adventure in which you are a private investigator solving a case in a district of the fictitious city of Falcity, exploring streets and buildings in full-screen color tile graphics.
dos:6cd0408f8816d8e7.title: Falcity

dos:6cebba37e096671e.description: A short text adventure about fixing a broken space station, written to test the author's game engine.
dos:6cebba37e096671e.title: The Orbital Observatory Adventure

dos:6cee04371864c5db.description: A text-based, turn-based simulation of the battle for the Mediterranean from December 1941 to August 1942. Each turn is three weeks, with strategic and operational decisions.
dos:6cee04371864c5db.title: Malta Storm

dos:6cee8bf4b0410e4d.description: Miner Willy discovers a network of caverns of an extinct civilization and sets out to collect all the treasures in 20 caverns before his air runs out, avoiding nasty creatures.
dos:6cee8bf4b0410e4d.title: Manic Miner

dos:6ceec60497d2c435.description: Control a turret fixed in the middle of the screen, change its angle and shoot down enemy paratroopers as they drop from planes. There are three difficulty levels.
dos:6ceec60497d2c435.title: Ack-Ack Attack!

dos:6cfbdc416f2a8e68.description: An anti-terrorist game with strategic planning and real-time action in a third-person over-the-top view like the original X-COM, a precursor to Rainbow Six. You face threats from fanatical cultists to terrorists.
dos:6cfbdc416f2a8e68.title: Deadline (1996)

dos:6d06a1a5b49275b9.description: A commercial mod of Quake that needs the registered game but acts as a stand-alone, with its own characters, weapons and environments. You play a mercenary named Damage working for an underground crime boss.
dos:6d06a1a5b49275b9.title: Malice: 23rd Century Ultraconversion for Quake

dos:6d09eb24fcd81c34.description: A converted Altair BASIC game in which 2 to 4 players become stock market sharks, buying shares in interstellar shipping companies to amass a fortune.
dos:6d09eb24fcd81c34.title: Star Traders

dos:6d0d4e8d153a670a.description: A shareware crazy golf game for up to 9 players. After each hole it shows shots per hole and the running total; the shareware version has 9 holes of increasing complexity.
dos:6d0d4e8d153a670a.title: AM's Mini Golf 3D

dos:6d11564bd4189d72.description: A logic platform game starring a ball named bal. Over 25 static screens, collect all the flags on platforms in a time limit and reach the exit, with bombs to help from the second level.
dos:6d11564bd4189d72.title: Aktie-bal

dos:6d1636f5f587969d.description: A Korean beat 'em up based on a comic series. The story follows three kids, all playable at once by up to three players.
dos:6d1636f5f587969d.title: My Love

dos:6d1ca26847870f7c.description: Putt-Putt is blasted to the moon by an accident at the Fireworks Factory and meets Rover, a lunar rover. Together they rebuild a rocket and do good deeds for the Moon People.
dos:6d1ca26847870f7c.title: Putt-Putt Goes to the Moon

dos:6d34f555ea831f5a.description: A side-scrolling beat 'em up from Korea.
dos:6d34f555ea831f5a.title: Action Fighter (1994)

dos:6d398ff2266a2f36.description: A shareware implementation of Cribbage, the two-player, six-card game, playable by keyboard or mouse in color or monochrome.
dos:6d398ff2266a2f36.title: Cribbage (1991)

dos:6d39a5b100a735bf.description: A little-known RPG with a fairly large world to explore and many NPCs to talk to, in an isometric perspective, plus battles.
dos:6d39a5b100a735bf.title: Realm of the Paladin: Deceptions Plague

dos:6d49d2fa6770d426.description: Colonists have settled in the Astral complex on an asteroid, but raiding ships full of bloodthirsty monsters arrive. You and up to two friends play armed colonists retaking infested colony chambers.
dos:6d49d2fa6770d426.title: Threat

dos:6d4d4837b6511067.description: A linear Final Fight-style beat 'em up where you play Iron Man or X-O Manowar. Each sidescrolling level ends in a comic book boss, starting with Nuclear Plant Siege against Mr. Hyde and the Melter.
dos:6d4d4837b6511067.title: Iron Man / X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal

dos:6d55fb5d53a0d8f6.description: A two-player game of timed duels in which each player controls a spaceship flying around a star and shooting at the other. Ships keep constant speed and direction until changed.
dos:6d55fb5d53a0d8f6.title: Starduel

dos:6d565213512c05b1.description: An educational game and sequel to Operation Wildlife that teaches children about U.S. Presidents plus logic and language skills using five decoder alphabets: English, American Sign Language, Braille, Morse Code and Semaphore.
dos:6d565213512c05b1.title: The Secret Codes of Cypher: Operation U.S. Presidents

dos:6d580c22b82231bf.description: The evil sorcerer Blackmagic has taken over the village of Jolimy. Serguei must build up his power with mini quests, then fight him. Type commands such as open door and get star.
dos:6d580c22b82231bf.title: Serguei's Destiny

dos:6d5aaf26d2fab08b.description: An adventure like Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego, with questions on science, weather and history as well as geography, as each puzzle is a step toward stopping Dr. Data.
dos:6d5aaf26d2fab08b.title: The Second Kids' World Almanac Adventure

dos:6d7a722e381c37fe.description: With the scrolls in hand, the Last Ninja trains a new order of ninja but is mysteriously transported to 20th-century New York, where the Evil Shogun has returned.
dos:6d7a722e381c37fe.title: Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance

dos:6d7cb72ce7bff422.description: A language-skills program for children with animations tied to key nouns and verbs. Typing phrases like The Girl Jumps Over the Flower shows the animation, letting players build short stories.
dos:6d7cb72ce7bff422.title: Story Machine

dos:6da5f5187c82b3f4.description: An open-world, turn-based RPG with no specific backstory and one primary goal, to wander. You may try to kill the evil mage in the citadel; killing him or dying in a duel ends the game.
dos:6da5f5187c82b3f4.title: Magus: 2nd & 3rd Editions

dos:6da95d1d96e71e35.description: Inspired by the 1986 film, a dogfighting air combat simulation set on the carrier USS Brigham off Libya and the Middle East. Choose the F-14 Tomcat, with a Radar Intercept officer, or another aircraft.
dos:6da95d1d96e71e35.title: Top Gun: Danger Zone

dos:6dac1aef3fd1c257.description: A minesweeper-like game in which you move your man through a field avoiding mines, and the game tells you how many mines are near you.
dos:6dac1aef3fd1c257.title: Bangalore

dos:6db48afb94f08f78.description: A tactical action real-time strategy game often likened to Syndicate. A sequel called Zero Hour followed.
dos:6db48afb94f08f78.title: Aimpoint

dos:6db595a5f2ec3b56.description: An unofficial Pac-Man. Move through a maze eating dots for a high score while four monsters chase you; eating one of the four stars lets you eat the monsters.
dos:6db595a5f2ec3b56.title: Pac

dos:6dc4f206d7e88a3c.description: The third in Dinamic Multimedia's PC Basket series of inexpensive basketball management games, with a 1995 database of Spanish basketball teams and an improved basketball simulator.
dos:6dc4f206d7e88a3c.title: PC Basket 3.0

dos:6dc644d5b4cc07b5.description: A tennis game endorsed by Jimmy Connors, with tournament and single play on multiple court types. Aim your shots with crosshairs and try for an Ace.
dos:6dc644d5b4cc07b5.title: Jimmy Connors Pro Tennis Tour

dos:6dcea62bedf5cbcd.description: A Tetris clone in which you clear lines to keep blocks from stacking to the top. Clearing four lines at once earns a NOT, which cuts a notch out of the border on each side.
dos:6dcea62bedf5cbcd.title: Notrus

dos:6dd3bc9ed8b6f6ad.description: An animated 3D graphic adventure in which you play Mel Odius, an up-and-coming young guitarist whose guitar has been stolen, and help him find it.
dos:6dd3bc9ed8b6f6ad.title: Mel Odius goes Six String Searchin'

dos:6dd6c570c3687d2e.description: A Czech action game for one to four players, set in a pub where the patrons build home-made catapults and fire on each other.
dos:6dd6c570c3687d2e.title: Katapult

dos:6dde9adb6d1c9e27.description: You are trapped in a labyrinth with several Beasts, shown as slim Hs, and your goal is to survive rather than escape, in ASCII graphics.
dos:6dde9adb6d1c9e27.title: Beast

dos:6df7d765bb645a66.description: A 2D educational adventure about ocean life. Explore the sea in a submarine and learn geology, marine biology, oceanography and ecology through nine mini-games, with hundreds of photos and movies of undersea life.
dos:6df7d765bb645a66.title: Undersea Adventure

dos:6dfcc4df27a96a6f.description: A tactical simulation of the South's last major offensive of the American Civil War, using a refined version of SSI's Gettysburg system over 13 turns of two hours each.
dos:6dfcc4df27a96a6f.title: Rebel Charge at Chickamauga

dos:6e12b83bdf220005.description: A text-mode puzzle-action game, the third in the original Kroz trilogy, continuing Kingdom of Kroz.
dos:6e12b83bdf220005.title: Caverns of Kroz

dos:6e220c870c32d99e.description: Freddy the Frog presents six games to help school-starting children build numeracy and literacy skills. In one, Freddie builds a house and can add a log only if you solve a math question.
dos:6e220c870c32d99e.title: Fun School 4: For 5 to 7 Year Olds

dos:6e263c74ab69f434.description: The first game based on the Australian Touring Car Championship and Bathurst 1000, and the first racing game to use Full Motion Video. Only the Bathurst track is included.
dos:6e263c74ab69f434.title: Touring Car Champions

dos:6e305f4a9423af73.description: A short, unofficial Star Trek text adventure about an evening with Beverly, told by typing commands.
dos:6e305f4a9423af73.title: A Night with Beverly

dos:6e366d489cda96e0.description: A 3D World War II tank simulator with three campaigns, Normandy, Ardennes and Desert. Command up to four M4 Shermans, two jeeps and artillery against German tanks and bunkers.
dos:6e366d489cda96e0.title: Sherman M4

dos:6e46976f20fb51f2.description: A mini-demo of Lemmings 3D with snowy graphics, with the same gameplay and 6 levels not in the full game.
dos:6e46976f20fb51f2.title: 3D Lemmings Winterland

dos:6e590d4538fe84eb.description: An RPG made in 1994 by Paint.NET author Rick Brewster when he was 12, with an odd combination of CGA graphics and Sound Blaster music.
dos:6e590d4538fe84eb.title: Golden Flute IV, The: The Flute of Immortality

dos:6e7005a2941a4d55.description: A tennis game about the Davis Cup, with 16 qualifying countries and 48 players with different attributes and skills.
dos:6e7005a2941a4d55.title: Davis Cup Complete Tennis

dos:6e70ea7761ee1f7a.description: A first-person adventure in which you solve puzzles and fight undead creatures that have overrun Elvira's Castle. It has dozens of different death sequences.
dos:6e70ea7761ee1f7a.title: Elvira: Mistress of the Dark

dos:6e7107a627e9d397.description: A non-violent Christmas first-person game from Pie in the Sky Software. As a snowman you rescue Santa from an Ice Wizard using a magic candy cane.
dos:6e7107a627e9d397.title: 3D Xmas Adventure: Santa's Rescue

dos:6e7555593ad42544.description: A text adventure in which you work for the C.I.A. and must recover a valuable ruby stolen by a spy ring called Chaos. It was being used in a top-secret laser project.
dos:6e7555593ad42544.title: CIA Adventure

dos:6e779b004f60b47a.description: A detective simulator in which, as J.B. Harold, you investigate the murder of a wealthy businessman: find clues, gather evidence, interrogate suspects and bring the killer to court.
dos:6e779b004f60b47a.title: Murder Club

dos:6e7b24a8862edf99.description: A conversion of Blackjack: bet, then try to reach the highest hand without going over 21. Hit or stand, and for the player double, split or surrender.

dos:6e7d0095a0312421.description: A TRON-inspired light cycle game. Steer the Laser Cycle in an arena, avoiding walls and homing missiles, and turn its trail into an energy barrier for short stretches to block them.
dos:6e7d0095a0312421.title: Laser Cycle

dos:6e83bb2b97a4e016.description: A cross between Wolfenstein 3D and Pac-Man. Navigate a 3D maze, shooting and running from wireframe pyramid enemies; kill them all to exit to the next maze.
dos:6e83bb2b97a4e016.title: Maze Wars

dos:6e87abfcb29f4fff.description: A shareware keyboard-controlled shooter like Robotron 2084. Stay alive in the center of the screen while baddies warp in at random positions and shoot them all.
dos:6e87abfcb29f4fff.title: Roboto

dos:6e9b71a16116aae2.description: A German puzzle game based on Swap. Clear the field of colored blocks by switching their positions; blocks of the same color next to each other disappear.
dos:6e9b71a16116aae2.title: Swapper

dos:6ea588cf139523b0.description: A shareware word-building game using domino-like tiles with two pairs of letters. Place a tile next to an existing one to make one or more four-letter words.
dos:6ea588cf139523b0.title: Denomino

dos:6ea6e3141d06087a.description: A 3D snooker simulator. The table and cue can be turned through almost any angle with adjustable strength and spin, a dotted line shows your ball's path, and a trick-shot mode recreates classic shots.
dos:6ea6e3141d06087a.title: Jimmy White's 'Whirlwind' Snooker

dos:6eab361705e4d20d.description: A shareware text and graphic adventure for newcomers to the genre, set in 1950s Hollywood, where you play the down-on-his-luck private detective Jim Novak in the film noir tradition.
dos:6eab361705e4d20d.title: The Hollywood Murders

dos:6eb54aaa1523cb1f.description: A game based on the board game about the 1942 fighting around the Russian village of Velikiye Luki. Six scenarios let you play the German or Russian side.
dos:6eb54aaa1523cb1f.title: White Death

dos:6ebe7b7ff47094d3.description: A shareware archery game for one or two players. Aim with the left and right arrows and fire with Enter, while wind and draft deflect the arrows.
dos:6ebe7b7ff47094d3.title: Bulls-eye!!

dos:6edc528ff38a9cd9.description: An American Laser Games arcade conversion, a point-and-click shooter where you fight a gang of lawbreakers in a small town.
tags: Action; Interactive Movie; Shooter / Rail shooter
dos:6edc528ff38a9cd9.title: Drug Wars

dos:6ef34b0fbec25fde.description: An extras pack for Descent II that adds 23 missions and some of the original Descent II music as Redbook audio, bundled with the Mission Builder II pack.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Shooter; Vehicle Simulation
dos:6ef34b0fbec25fde.title: Descent II + Vertigo Series

dos:6ef53cfe8c575391.description: A sci-fi strategy game converted from the Games Workshop and Milton Bradley board game. You control a commander and four marines sent on missions aboard hostile alien starships.
dos:6ef53cfe8c575391.title: Space Crusade

dos:6efc369c131f5476.description: A real-time puzzle game in which you guide a ricocheting ball into the exit hole by moving a cannon along the perimeter walls and shooting to manipulate the ball and other objects.
dos:6efc369c131f5476.title: Cannonade

dos:6f092b427c7ad60a.description: A shareware historical trading simulation set in 18th-century China. As the young adventurer Atlas Pathfinder, explore sea and land, trade with Chinese cities and build a commercial empire.
dos:6f092b427c7ad60a.title: Canton: An Atlas Pathfinder Adventure

dos:6f0d0619811eba14.description: A 3D arcade and strategy game loosely derived from Carrier Command. In the Ultra War, fought between the two dominant races in the New World, you use the Mauler, an Armored Fighting Machine.
dos:6f0d0619811eba14.title: Battle Command

dos:6f1866ab7e5afeeb.description: One of the first chess games designed for experts. It can be played from an isometric 3D or a traditional 2D view, with an optional clock and analysis mode.
dos:6f1866ab7e5afeeb.title: Cyrus

dos:6f2c11c15e5b1b02.description: One of the earliest shareware games. Fly a prop plane shown in 3D from horizontal and vertical views, fight off vandals and punks before they reach your city, and refuel from your blimp.
dos:6f2c11c15e5b1b02.title: Flightmare

dos:6f2c9c22ed442017.description: Captain Klondike's ship has crash-landed on an asteroid, and he must find fuel while collecting coins, gems and power-ups, battling creatures and avoiding traps, up to a final confrontation with G.O.R.G.
dos:6f2c9c22ed442017.title: Gateworld: The Home Planet

dos:6f3d3e22eb6455fc.description: A sci-fi first-person shooter in which you play a Marine named Bitterman in Operation Alien Overlord, a counterattack on the home planet of the cybernetic Strogg to protect Earth.
dos:6f3d3e22eb6455fc.title: Quake II (Q2DOS)

dos:6f3f592f2f0bf64c.description: You are a little pink guy with a white collar, moving with the arrow keys and thrusting upward with space, passing through doors between rooms and collecting X's.
dos:6f3f592f2f0bf64c.title: Meridian Gravitas

dos:6f45ee47e6e40690.description: A multiplayer snake game in which you die by being shot by other players instead of running into walls.
dos:6f45ee47e6e40690.title: Parawormer II

dos:6f52af412bd89b6c.description: A Wolfenstein 3D modification inspired by the original Rise of the Triad, which began as an add-on to Wolfenstein 3D and whose roots in its engine are visible.
dos:6f52af412bd89b6c.title: Rise of the Triad: Wolfenstein 3D Part II

dos:6f577c87bc77bf01.description: A tennis game with 3D characters named for the French tournament. Choose from 10 men, 7 women or 3 futuristic players and play on five courts, two of which must be unlocked.
dos:6f577c87bc77bf01.title: Roland Garros 97

dos:6f5b31476048f781.description: You control a trampoline moved horizontally along the bottom of the screen. Bob jumps higher each time he hits it, collecting items at the top.
dos:6f5b31476048f781.title: Construction Bob in the Bouncing Factory

dos:6f6467c132d076d1.description: An educational arcade shooter from Scetlander. You play Hal, the American cousin of Henrietta, helping her with spelling.
dos:6f6467c132d076d1.title: Spellbound!

dos:6f7313b9a91ce808.description: A card game, visual puzzle and physical pendulum puzzle in one, with hundreds of puzzles playable individually or in sequence in a Pilgrimage rewarded with zen koans.
dos:6f7313b9a91ce808.title: Heaven & Earth

dos:6f83734babc0f50a.description: A compilation of four sports games: Archery, Olympic Slalom, Par 4, a text-based golf game with three courses, and Quarterback Crunch, an American football game with nine gambits.
dos:6f83734babc0f50a.title: Sports Spectacular

dos:6f8fbb425e953bed.description: A shoot 'em up from Dutch developers with a strangely shaped aircraft and an attempt at realistic flight handling.
dos:6f8fbb425e953bed.title: Enemy Star

dos:6f940f6c1d3fce6f.description: A multiplayer vehicle combat game in CyberCity where you pilot a Cyberpod, collect power-up modules, and compete in four teams of four for control of city squares. Kill or be killed.
dos:6f940f6c1d3fce6f.title: CyberStrike

dos:6fa678f68f4e6a43.description: A snake game for up to six players, three at a time, originally designed as a BBS door game. Eat dots to grow and avoid other snakes, aiming to be the last one standing or reach a size of 200.
dos:6fa678f68f4e6a43.title: Flash Worm

dos:6faecae24399f553.description: The very rare sequel to Last Half of Darkness Part II. You are stranded alone on an island inhabited by living dead and must find the girl you saved in the earlier chapters.
dos:6faecae24399f553.title: Last Half of Darkness III

dos:6fb3d239b2a79bf6.description: The first Warlords game, a medieval strategy game of world domination for up to 8 players on one machine. Control 80 cities in the realm of Illuria and wipe out your 7 opponents.
dos:6fb3d239b2a79bf6.title: Warlords

dos:6fb8fd680759fbe7.description: A helicopter simulation in a Hughes 530 MG Defender, with modes including training, rescue and combat missions, and sea rescue.
dos:6fb8fd680759fbe7.title: Thunderchopper

dos:6fcb3bce354e4fee.description: A top-view arcade racing game. Reach the finish line before time runs out, avoiding other cars, trucks and obstacles and refueling from special trucks along the way.
dos:6fcb3bce354e4fee.title: Road Fighter

dos:6fcc94dd920a5592.description: The Atomic Edition of Duke Nukem 3D contains the three original episodes of the main game and the Plutonium Pak expansion, plus Windows themes, screensavers, jigsaw puzzles and an image carousel.
dos:6fcc94dd920a5592.title: Duke Nukem 3D: Atomic Edition

dos:6fccbb8d9884ea34.description: An adventure series in which you play Rolan, a fur-covered person with both human and animal blood, who must stop a terrible evil threatening the land by exploring a maze of trees and bushes.
dos:6fccbb8d9884ea34.title: The Darkest Night

dos:6fda73228fdc5f1b.description: A shareware Missile Command-style game that teaches math, spelling and touch typing. Missiles drop one at a time; type an answer and press Enter to fire.
dos:6fda73228fdc5f1b.title: Big Math Attack!

dos:6fee1dabda05c1b0.description: A comic adventure in which an ancient prophecy says King Fudd the Bewildered will die peacefully with his daughter beside him, but Princess Lorealle is abducted by her stepmother Morgana.
dos:6fee1dabda05c1b0.title: Eric the Unready

dos:6ff12587ffef7c6e.description: A three-dimensional football game offering a variation on the FIFA series.
dos:6ff12587ffef7c6e.title: Actua Soccer

dos:6ff520a1421a0d65.description: A shareware video poker machine simulator. The default game is Jacks or Better, and it can be configured for Second Chance Poker, Joker Wild Poker, Deuces Wild Poker and others.
dos:6ff520a1421a0d65.title: Video Poker Slot

dos:6ffc3d3159879b26.description: You play Matt Stuvysant, a man of Polish descent and criminal persuasion who arrives in London with only the clothes on his back, planning to become the greatest criminal mind of the century, starting with small shops.
dos:6ffc3d3159879b26.title: The Clue!

dos:700ad2c13cfd68d7.description: An arcade-style tank war game claiming to simulate real battle tanks, with tanks that move faster than in reality and ammunition recharges to collect in the field.
dos:700ad2c13cfd68d7.title: Tank Commander

dos:700f364cb97612fd.description: The third edition of the Wheel of Fortune games, with new puzzle phrases. Up to three contestants spin the wheel and guess hidden letters to solve puzzles.
dos:700f364cb97612fd.title: Wheel of Fortune: New Third Edition

dos:7011272dc804dad0.description: In the year 2009, you are Nick Vrenna, falsely imprisoned in a high security prison where genetic experiments and a riot have turned guards and inmates into mutants. You must escape.
dos:7011272dc804dad0.title: Abuse

dos:70119e5c77c21011.description: An adventure in which you decide the fate of the heroes and direct them to their aim. Discover many locations and events, with different stories depending on your directions.
dos:70119e5c77c21011.title: Passengers on the Wind II

dos:7014c342ce4adca3.description: You are a forklift searching for switches and keys through a warehouse of enemies, lasers and traps. Your fuel keeps dropping, so you must find canisters, and in the end locate a missile and bring it back.
dos:7014c342ce4adca3.title: Sabotaje

dos:70190e051c2e9ba7.description: A mission-based role-playing game with missions of varying difficulty that you can take in any order or repeat. Each has four or five chapters of dungeon exploring, fighting enemies and grabbing loot.
dos:70190e051c2e9ba7.title: Amulets & Armor

dos:701e9f929e13e3fd.description: As Mac, rescue hostages in 15 buildings now controlled by the evil Calawarr brothers and their army, finding hostages in each stage and taking them to the exit while avoiding enemies.
dos:701e9f929e13e3fd.title: Piso Zero

dos:701ed6742622aac3.description: An upgraded AV-8B Harrier Assault in SVGA resolution (640x480). You lead a marine expeditionary force trying to occupy West Timor with a full Amphibious Assault Group.
dos:701ed6742622aac3.title: Super-VGA Harrier

dos:701f4c21e92ac126.description: A turn-based fantasy strategy game. Capture cities, use them to create armies and send them against your opponents. It still has a devoted following on the internet.
dos:701f4c21e92ac126.title: Warlords II

dos:7022a3998e701ac4.description: A freeware remake of the 1984 classic with updated graphics and sounds and a classical melody for each room. As Willy, the miner turned millionaire, you wander through his mansion.
dos:7022a3998e701ac4.title: Jet Set Willy

dos:702639e8a8dbd6da.description: A collection of three magic-themed text adventures by John Olsen, including Merlin's Magic Forest, where you are transported to ancient England and must search for ingredients to free Merlin from Morgana's spell.
dos:702639e8a8dbd6da.title: Tales of Magic

dos:702ccaf27aaf0415.description: Three Vikings, Eric the Swift, Olaf the Stout and Baleog the Fierce, are kidnapped by the alien Tomator. Combine their unique skills to solve puzzles and defeat him and his aliens, robots and giant snails.
dos:702ccaf27aaf0415.title: The Lost Vikings

dos:7034e64dfa2692de.description: A Tetris sequel with additional features such as two-player cooperative and competitive modes and new block types, including lightning bolts that eliminate an entire row.
dos:7034e64dfa2692de.title: Super Tetris

dos:70499a6de252d243.description: An educational game in which dinosaurs of the past are brought to the present. Learn to track and identify them with the help of the Dinosaur Encyclopedia and Dexter the talking Dinodroid.
dos:70499a6de252d243.title: Zombie Dinos from Planet Zeltoid

dos:706dc0b0d56d9228.description: A single-player space strategy game that plays like the Star Trek variants without referencing that universe. You command the Argo to end hostilities near the Xanadu base against enemy ships.
dos:706dc0b0d56d9228.title: Argonaut

dos:7076d51586fd978d.description: An unofficial DOS port of the 2D side-scrolling arcade game like Super Mario Bros. Giana finds herself in a mysterious dreamworld and fights monsters and huge spiders through 32 levels.
dos:7076d51586fd978d.title: The Great Giana Sisters

dos:7082c1cb361ab822.description: Set in 2017 of an alternate timeline in which the Soviet Union still exists, you are General Sloan McCormick commanding the US Strategic Defense Initiative against a Soviet extremist group of KGB members.
dos:7082c1cb361ab822.title: S.D.I.

dos:708db4c76282415c.description: A freeware falling block puzzle game for up to four players, played by keyboard, with a soundtrack, high score table and customizable keys. Special blocks can be captured by clearing their row.
dos:708db4c76282415c.title: Varmint's Eittris

dos:7094ad406ae0aac8.description: Based on the arcade sequel, you drive an F-1 racer in a timed qualifying run to win the pole position and then race for the top spot. This game offers four tracks to choose from.
dos:7094ad406ae0aac8.title: Pole Position II

dos:709a00e214ea1966.description: A pure action title, the last DOS-based game of the StarFight series, with short cutscenes and in-game dialogue and better compatibility with new hardware than its predecessors.
dos:709a00e214ea1966.title: StarFight V: Hell's Gate

dos:70b2a68e92b268b4.description: While Jack drinks a beer, he absorbs Ar'Kritz, a microscopic extraterrestrial police officer. As Ar'Kritz causes mutations with a toxic substance, Jack is about to turn into a powerful monster.
dos:70b2a68e92b268b4.title: Ar'Kritz the Intruder

dos:70b54236f4a6dd39.description: A text and graphic adventure adaptation of Rod Serling's television show, built like an episode with its own mystery. Type verb and object commands and move with N, S, W and E.
dos:70b54236f4a6dd39.title: The Twilight Zone

dos:70b7e62ee7a6d7e8.description: A DOS port of an Amiga platform game with beautiful graphics.
dos:70b7e62ee7a6d7e8.title: Mysterious Worlds

dos:70c53c3e1a927dd9.description: A helicopter simulator and shooter, the sequel to Core's Sega CD game AH-3 Thunderstrike. It has multiple weapons, full freedom of movement and missions, with lots of enemy tanks and helicopters.
dos:70c53c3e1a927dd9.title: Thunderstrike 2

dos:70c68145cba09def.description: A simple overhead shooter in the spirit of Raiden and Raptor. In 2047 a terrorist organization travels back to 1943 to sell weapons to the Axis powers, and an elite group of fighters must stop them.
dos:70c68145cba09def.title: Flying Tigers

dos:70d825751ece919d.description: A 2D Wing Commander-like space shooter. Pilot a combat ship through 40 linear missions, destroying enemies or protecting friendly shuttles, with the goal of defeating an alien race.
dos:70d825751ece919d.title: Star Hammer

dos:70d9dd11f845a180.description: A computerized version of backgammon: both sides roll dice in turn and move, trying to clear all their checkers from the board before the opponent. This version supports a single human player.
dos:70d9dd11f845a180.title: Backgammon (1983)
