dos:70e64a9c94eb7735.description: A fantasy interactive fiction in which you play the black dwarf Grimbis, who must recover a magical orb stolen by elves by typing verb-noun commands.
dos:70e64a9c94eb7735.title: 4K Adventure

dos:70f44ef3bfba6c00.description: A space shooter in which you hunt space-faring business school graduates whose myopic quantitative concepts have ruined Earth's economies and are now spreading the plague to other planets.
dos:70f44ef3bfba6c00.title: Quantoids of Nebulus IV

dos:71013dabdb2e4619.description: A text adventure in which the Golden Baton in the throne room has suddenly become tarnished and gloom has settled over the kingdom. Find the source of the evil before it is too late.
dos:71013dabdb2e4619.title: Mysterious Adventure No. 3: Arrow of Death Part 1

dos:7101df156a29f6af.description: In an all-out galactic war, the conquering Eclons have invaded the Zuran galaxy. As a Zuran Defender you must cleanse the stellar neighborhood of Eclon forces.
dos:7101df156a29f6af.title: Zuran Defender

dos:7104bf3023407422.description: In 1996 you are William Tibbs, an American law student in Paris, who must take up the challenge of Wolfram to save your fiancee Juliette, after a final cry for help from the last Knight Templar.
dos:7104bf3023407422.title: Time Gate: Knight's Chase

dos:710e9b350ab86534.description: A World War I flight simulation structured around an interactive gallery of pilot biographies that change as events unfold, with 150 missions.
dos:710e9b350ab86534.title: Dawn Patrol

dos:711f8b6747cd9543.description: From the Worlds of ZZT, a game where your goal is to escape the city, with its bureaucracy, smog and desperate weirdos, by mastering 30 game boards.
dos:711f8b6747cd9543.title: ZZT's City

dos:712b081b0af46c86.description: An arcade game in which you shoot numerous spiders descending from the top of the screen with your laser. Ammo is limited but more appears when you run low.
dos:712b081b0af46c86.title: Spyder

dos:712fbe5c6d99fd16.description: Hocus Pocus, a young magician's apprentice, wants to join the Council of Wizards in the land of Lattice and marry his sweetheart Popopa. First he must gather magical crystals for the wizard chief Terexin in this platformer.
dos:712fbe5c6d99fd16.title: Hocus Pocus

dos:713ad207bd5e76af.description: A shareware clone of Space Invaders. Control a cannon at the bottom of the screen and destroy waves of advancing alien ships for a high score, with three lives.
dos:713ad207bd5e76af.title: Kurt's Spaced Invaders

dos:7140aa5d80aef2fd.description: A point-and-click adventure sequel to Ringworld, based on Larry Niven's Known Space novels, in which Quinn and Miranda Rees continue after saving the puppeteer race from extermination.
dos:7140aa5d80aef2fd.title: Return to Ringworld

dos:7142959ca0ff5669.description: Manage a team through the 1996 championship and beyond, with full control of engineers, contracts, sponsors, training, drivers, merchandising, design, development, testing and race weekends.
dos:7142959ca0ff5669.title: F1 Manager

dos:71536d99e30602f9.description: Sonny Bonds, a small-town policeman, fights the rising tide of drugs in his city. Based on real police procedure, he moves from patrol officer to detective and chases the infamous Death Angel.
dos:71536d99e30602f9.title: Police Quest: In Pursuit of the Death Angel

dos:715ae2218c83d3d0.description: A late, high-quality clone of the arcade game Q*bert. Jump on every step of a pyramid to change its color and move on to the next level while enemies hinder you.
dos:715ae2218c83d3d0.title: PC*Bert

dos:7161349d44c16d4b.description: An all-strategy baseball simulator done entirely in text. Use existing teams, draft from them or create your own, and answer yes/no questions about fielding and baserunning.
dos:7161349d44c16d4b.title: Full Count Baseball

dos:716164b229037061.description: A football management sim, successor to the original Championship Manager, released in fall 1995. It became the benchmark of the genre and remains popular.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:716164b229037061.title: Championship Manager 2

dos:716960a3584a2c99.description: A cricket game about the Ashes, the tours between England and Australia, in which you play test matches.
dos:716960a3584a2c99.title: Battle for the Ashes

dos:716a24f052d01235.description: Four hopeful explorers try to make a fortune on a virgin planet by producing Food, Energy, Smithore and Crystite. Each good has its uses, and shortages cut your turn time or output.
dos:716a24f052d01235.title: M.U.L.E.

dos:7174b21e30721a7a.description: Rockwart the Troll has cast a spell on Daisy, putting her to sleep for 100 years. Dizzy sets out to fix it in a compact arcade adventure, starting trapped underground.
dos:7174b21e30721a7a.title: Dizzy: Prince of the Yolkfolk

dos:717e22a7d37b3d0d.description: A pattern-recognition game with 3x3 grid puzzles of abstract shapes with one empty space. Work out the logic and pick the shape that fills the gap; scoring depends on reaction time.
dos:717e22a7d37b3d0d.title: Matrix Madness

dos:718854bc3ae40f41.description: Roger Wilco, the interstellar janitor, finds himself accused of violating galactic law and stripped of his honors, and travels into the Spinal Frontier to set things straight.
dos:718854bc3ae40f41.title: Space Quest VI: Roger Wilco in the Spinal Frontier

dos:718b4b40a24ff4a8.description: A Polish math program for children that teaches adding, subtracting, dividing and multiplying at three difficulty levels, with two mini-games, a slot machine and a match puzzle.
dos:718b4b40a24ff4a8.title: Rachunkowe Abecadlo

dos:718fb14a6b87ee47.description: Play Sir Graham, a brave knight sent to retrieve three stolen treasures: a shield that protects against invaders, a mirror that foretells the future and a chest forever filled with gold.
dos:718fb14a6b87ee47.title: King's Quest I: Quest for the Crown (1987)

dos:71903527bab71ad0.description: A DOS remake of the BASIC game Wizard's Castle. Explore an 8x8x8 castle by short text commands, killing monsters and grabbing treasures to find a powerful item.
dos:71903527bab71ad0.title: Leygref's Castle

dos:7194f53b30c46fa1.description: A chess game in which the pieces are small realistic figures that walk around the board and, when one takes another, fight in an animated battle that is different for each pairing.
dos:7194f53b30c46fa1.title: Battle Chess

dos:71969a7d505bab8c.description: Help the land of Metavira: hire mercenaries as you explore, capture and hold territory so the natives can harvest trees that yield a revolutionary medicine. More trees mean more money.
dos:71969a7d505bab8c.title: Jagged Alliance

dos:71a0e8f77470fca8.description: An arcade-style game based on the UK TV series. Control one of the Mr. Gumbies through multiple screens, throwing fish at flying feet and other surreal enemies, with non-sequitur asides.
dos:71a0e8f77470fca8.title: Monty Python's Flying Circus

dos:71a1b3dcb5b2aeaf.description: A freeware clone of Galaxian. Move your ship from side to side with the cursor keys and fire with Space against enemy ships that swoop around the screen.
dos:71a1b3dcb5b2aeaf.title: The Galaxians

dos:71a3396db6eadd2e.description: A Sierra-style adventure for kids based on nursery rhymes like Humpty Dumpty. The rhymes have gotten mixed up and the child must find the missing pieces and give them back.
dos:71a3396db6eadd2e.title: Mixed-Up Mother Goose

dos:71a73c4fec71ef85.description: Number 8 in the Scott Adams adventure series. On an Egyptian treasure hunt deep inside a newly discovered pyramid, find all the treasures and escape alive, using a 2-word parser.
dos:71a73c4fec71ef85.title: Pyramid of Doom

dos:71a84b6cd302af66.description: A Bomberman-like game in which players in a maze plant time-bombs to eliminate their opponents by detonating explosives when the enemy is in range.
dos:71a84b6cd302af66.title: Mega Blast

dos:71b216e4d83db673.description: A jigsaw puzzle game with interesting options such as fractal images.
dos:71b216e4d83db673.title: Moraff's Explorer

dos:71b82e44e9e6fd14.description: A science quiz racing game. Quarky and Quaysoo organized Los Turbos to beat rival teams, and you answer questions correctly to earn money to move between checkpoints and win races.
dos:71b82e44e9e6fd14.title: Quarky & Quaysoo's Turbo Science

dos:71c87215d90cd076.description: Simulates the annoyance of being pestered by a housefly while reading in your easy chair, as you pull out a flyswat and try to swat it.
dos:71c87215d90cd076.title: Flyswat

dos:71d1cdcb13dcffb0.description: A public domain version of Defender. Fly a spaceship left or right through a tunnel, destroying alien ships and rescuing the people being abducted.
dos:71d1cdcb13dcffb0.title: PC-Fender

dos:71ec693c4c28e476.description: A puzzle game first published with the Spanish edition of Computer Gaming World in 1997. Eliminate all bricks in each level by grouping them by color range, avoiding leaving any alone.
tags: Puzzle / Sliding block & tile; Puzzle / Tile matching
dos:71ec693c4c28e476.title: Bricks Deluxe Edition

dos:71f5e7fb690e28af.description: A textmode maze game in which a secret agent, an X, searches a random maze of destructible and indestructible blocks for three randomly assigned espionage objects, gathered in sequence within a limited number of moves.
dos:71f5e7fb690e28af.title: Maze Mission Adventure Game

dos:71f78b4be0d60b8b.description: A demo of a cancelled game, described as a cross between The Sims and Jones in the Fast Lane. It is SimCity-like but aims to keep individual people happy rather than the whole city.
dos:71f78b4be0d60b8b.title: Citizens: Backwater Affairs!

dos:71fc6dd20101c148.description: An arcade flying game with 256 levels, parallax scrolling and procedurally generated terrain packed into just 256 bytes of machine code. Get your starship across an increasingly dangerous environment.
dos:71fc6dd20101c148.title: Indecent

dos:7213b6f02cbfd978.description: A shareware dice game based on Zilch, played with six dice by up to nine people including the computer, with a two-player Mutant Trash variant and a Rotary Club mode.
dos:7213b6f02cbfd978.title: Tommy's Trash!

dos:721ad338ada46f87.description: An American football simulation where you play as head coach. Select home and visiting teams, human or computer controlled, make roster changes and call the plays.
dos:721ad338ada46f87.title: MicroLeague Football: The Coach's Challenge

dos:7221edbbfcd32784.description: A commercial Othello simulator with ASCII graphics. Play against the computer or another player and capture more pieces than your opponent.
dos:7221edbbfcd32784.title: Othello (1988)

dos:7226782b3409f1b3.description: A text adventure in which you explore the immediate vicinity of your office and discover that supernatural beings such as dwarves, elves and trolls live in a modern-day environment.
dos:7226782b3409f1b3.title: Cercla: The Game

dos:7235ded0a07a2c7b.description: Skunny the squirrel travels back to ancient Rome to stop an evil chef from destroying the invention of the pizza, jumping from platform to platform and onto the heads of Roman legions.
dos:7235ded0a07a2c7b.title: Skunny: Save Our Pizzas!

dos:7242166a4537bb33.description: A popular shareware side-scrolling shooter with a variety of weapons and enemies in 4 episodes.
dos:7242166a4537bb33.title: Tubular Worlds

dos:72529531a386c761.description: A real-time, 3D view game mixing Civilization-style play with the Dungeons and Dragons universe. Build a small village into a Stronghold, recruiting and training Fighters, Thieves and other classes.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Role-Playing; Strategy
dos:72529531a386c761.title: Stronghold

dos:7256cb48b40c31f0.description: You are a small ant who goes into an anthill to rescue a friend's bag of cookies after the dog lost his balance, in a platform puzzle game.
dos:7256cb48b40c31f0.title: Pushover

dos:7256eeb56cf5c86f.description: A turn-based wargame about managing only air forces in combat operations, a forerunner of Air Force Commander and WW2 Air Force Commander from the same developers.
dos:7256eeb56cf5c86f.title: Fighter Command

dos:726741a29366d59f.description: A very simple QBasic shooter in which you fire at Bob Saget with sitcom audience moans and demented circus music, targeting specific areas of his body.
dos:726741a29366d59f.title: Bob Saget Killer 2000

dos:72793f5bda4cee27.description: A DOS shareware remake of the Donkey Kong arcade game with two modes, the original Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode.
dos:72793f5bda4cee27.title: CHAMP Kong

dos:727e043a4accf25d.description: A short text adventure built with the Text Adventure Generator Runner, set in the fictional Abyssville, where the energy companies' man-made singularity has had unforeseen side effects.
dos:727e043a4accf25d.title: Edge of the Abyss

dos:728749aaaeb40e4f.description: A 2D wrestling simulator from indie developer MDickie. Defeat the opponent while earning a better match rating, hitting him with chairs, throwing him on tables and climbing the cage.
dos:728749aaaeb40e4f.title: Federation Online

dos:7287d7708750f2dc.description: A futuristic economic real-time strategy game from Australian developers about what could happen to companies scamming people by selling land on the Moon and planets.
dos:7287d7708750f2dc.title: Klondike Moon

dos:7290454d5c98d9a8.description: A real-time text adventure for one or two players, cooperative or competitive, with random treasure placement and character classes. Find the Black Orb to save your home from becoming a barren wasteland.
dos:7290454d5c98d9a8.title: Zyll

dos:729de9d1b1e07caa.description: A sci-fi RPG in which you are sent to a fleet of spaceships invaded by escaped aliens. Walk around fighting aliens and collecting keys for doors, handling toxic coolant carefully, with 6 programmable robots.
dos:729de9d1b1e07caa.title: Spacewrecked: 14 Billion Light Years From Earth

dos:729f943974559b33.description: The sequel to Dark Sun: Shattered Lands, set on the burning wasteland planet Athas. Characters can be imported, and the party journeys to the liberated city of Tyr.
dos:729f943974559b33.title: Dark Sun II: Wake of the Ravager

dos:72ae090a5277e09e.description: A freeware Lemmings clone in which you control a green duck leading orange ducks to a rocket ship. Holding the right mouse button makes the leader move toward the cursor.
dos:72ae090a5277e09e.title: Ducks

dos:72b9247933b6a513.description: The fifth Dragon Slayer game, set in the fantasy land of Pentawa. The king hires a party of adventurers to protect its inhabitants from ferocious creatures, beginning with retrieving a precious sceptre from a dungeon.
dos:72b9247933b6a513.title: Sorcerian

dos:72b9570543aa8e9b.description: You play Nick, rescuing your true love Xianna from gangsters. Start in one of five cities, Denver, Atlanta, Detroit, Los Angeles or New York, which differ in the number of turfs to clear.
dos:72b9570543aa8e9b.title: Street Fighting Man

dos:72bcef9877a4ebdd.description: A hand-drawn side-view platformer set in Zulaland, starring Zulus Twiggy, who was born a little different from his fellow tribesmen.
dos:72bcef9877a4ebdd.title: Voodoo Lunch

dos:72bf5127d3581e98.description: Chase Carmen Sandiego and her American gang across the USA. As an ACME detective you travel from town to town on the suspect's trail, using clues and evidence to put the suspect in jail.
dos:72bf5127d3581e98.title: Where in the U.S.A. Is Carmen Sandiego?

dos:72cabd5fb3c20844.description: The villain I.M. Meen hates it when children study, so he creates a magical book that traps them in his evil labyrinth. You are one of two new children trapped in the maze, trying to free the others.
dos:72cabd5fb3c20844.title: I.M. Meen

dos:72cb69fbfc46508c.description: A point-and-click adventure in which Floyd is ordered to sneak aboard the Starship Longshot and remove the Prime Minister of Bubba Star Six from the picture.
dos:72cb69fbfc46508c.title: Floyd SB the Company Man

dos:72cd7789cb8d3264.description: Drive your remote controlled Gemini tank with the arrow keys and shoot with the space bar, battling enemies on remote planets and killing three of their tanks before they destroy yours.
dos:72cd7789cb8d3264.title: Gemini-2

dos:72cf5bc359ab6a1f.description: A shareware educational game about the capitals of the world as they were in 1990. An outline map may show surrounding countries or cities as clues for the target city you must identify.
dos:72cf5bc359ab6a1f.title: The World Name Game

dos:72cfaae74edd04d7.description: A card game that originated in Hong Kong, played by almost all the oriental population and second only to Mahjong in social entertainment.
dos:72cfaae74edd04d7.title: BIG2

dos:72d3fec8237e1325.description: A digging arcade game in the spirit of Digger and Dig Dug, starring Bob the Hamster.
dos:72d3fec8237e1325.title: Bob the Hamster

dos:72f12598a92ea196.description: A first-person adventure made of still screens. A mad scientist's elixir has made the protagonist's dreams real, and he must stay alive, leave the forsaken place and return to the real world.
dos:72f12598a92ea196.title: Dream Zone

dos:72fdf380746eef34.description: A Breakout clone in Tandy 1000 BASIC. A wall of bricks sits at the top of the screen and you deflect the bouncing ball with a paddle to knock down the wall.
dos:72fdf380746eef34.title: Breakoff

dos:72fe29fe97badd30.description: A one-on-one soccer-like sport played in hovercraft in a future without violence. The goals move, the arena is oddly shaped, and money from goals buys weapons and power-ups.
dos:72fe29fe97badd30.title: 3D Ball Blaster

dos:7301617b0832760d.description: A puzzle game from Soleau Software similar to Boloball, in which you get your 25 colored balloons as high as possible on the board; the higher a balloon goes, the more points.
dos:7301617b0832760d.title: Balloon Challenge

dos:73019f33e5b132b0.description: A Spanish action arcade game in which you play a Viking wandering various locations and battling opponents, with no particular plot.
dos:73019f33e5b132b0.title: La Leyenda del Vikingo

dos:7304c4552580f94b.description: A Mortal Kombat-style fighting game with human, alien and robot characters in a futuristic setting, with 3D-rendered SVGA characters and animated backgrounds, and single, two-player and practice modes.
dos:7304c4552580f94b.title: Overkill (1996)

dos:730efd1a216dff82.description: An RPG with an interface like the Bard's Tale series or Dragon Wars. Create a party of six and try to stop a crusade of slaughter against the elvish race, corrupted by an unspeakable evil.
dos:730efd1a216dff82.title: Legend of Faerghail

dos:7316ecd5f1a33c61.description: A computer version of the Connect Four party game for one player against the computer or two players.
dos:7316ecd5f1a33c61.title: Link Four

dos:731c5d5d119628b0.description: A shareware card game for three to eight players, where the computer fills in if fewer than three play. It includes the original game and the Sevens/Parliament, Five or Nine and Pay or Play variants.
dos:731c5d5d119628b0.title: Tommy's Fan Tan

dos:7325612671081740.description: A custom launcher for over 200 top Descent levels for Descent 1, 2 and Vertigo, mostly picks from the user Diedel plus entries from level contests, with notes on game types and player counts.
dos:7325612671081740.title: Descent: eXoHOG

dos:732cab2c1924ec65.description: An expanded Railroad Tycoon with additional scenarios and settings, enhanced graphics and several more types of trains.
dos:732cab2c1924ec65.title: Sid Meier's Railroad Tycoon Deluxe

dos:732dfab3a7047000.description: Two action helicopter sims in one, Werewolf and Comanche 2.0, similar to the original Comanche. In some missions you can land to refill fuel and ammo.
dos:732dfab3a7047000.title: Werewolf vs. Comanche

dos:73308b312e90b6fb.description: A turn-based war game that is easy to learn, with terrain effects, multiple difficulty levels, plenty of units, a scenario editor, full campaigns and multiple zoom levels.
dos:73308b312e90b6fb.title: Perfect General II

dos:73397f68977af5bf.description: A card game simulation, Volume Sixteen of the Coffee Break series, with four poker varieties, 5 Card Stud, 7 Card Stud, Chicago and Hold 'Em, against three computer opponents.
dos:73397f68977af5bf.title: Ruckus Poker

dos:733f716275895542.description: An educational CD-ROM exploring the Wild West from 1500 to 1900 AD. You play a character and earn points by making choices in 10,000 possible scenarios, with narrated intros for each time period.
dos:733f716275895542.title: Dare, Bluff, or Die

dos:734009e9ef26c48f.description: A dungeon crawler with heavy RPG elements, moving about an ASCII map in a minimalist interface.
dos:734009e9ef26c48f.title: Dungeon (1990)

dos:7340335e06f09f2e.description: A futuristic sports game played in a hall like a basketball court with a basket in the middle. Throw a charged energy ball into the basket; it is charged in energy fields in your opponent's half.
dos:7340335e06f09f2e.title: Professional Underground League of Pain

dos:7353a100ccfc4f98.description: An Eamon adventure disk. In the Eamon RPG you are a free-wheeling adventurer who takes dangerous quests against many enemies to earn riches and experience.
dos:7353a100ccfc4f98.title: Eamon Adventure Disk 3: Assault on the Clone Master

dos:736622d45abd7ad9.description: SimCity with multimedia enhancements on CD, such as video clips. Build up your city and provide your citizens with what they need.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation / City Building; Strategy
dos:736622d45abd7ad9.title: SimCity Enhanced CD-ROM

dos:7381b3339d9cba83.description: The table football game recreated as a turn-based strategy game. Each player has 30 seconds to move in a 30-minute match, selecting a player and aiming.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Sports / Soccer; Strategy
dos:7381b3339d9cba83.title: Subbuteo

dos:7389a14203579cc7.description: The ancient demon Jashiin awakens after two thousand years and destroys the kingdom of Zeliard with a 115-day sand rain, then turns Princess Felicia to stone. You set out to put things right.
dos:7389a14203579cc7.title: Zeliard

dos:7394584f34082b75.description: A German football management simulation and sequel to Bundesliga Manager Professional for up to four players. Lead your favorite team to sporting and financial success, taking loans and investing in real estate.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:7394584f34082b75.title: Football Limited

dos:739ade8f2a54211e.description: A top-down hockey game against Canada or the USA with many options for difficulty, speed and referee behavior, and an editor for new tactics, lineups and abilities.
dos:739ade8f2a54211e.title: Wayne Gretzky Hockey 2

dos:739bd25c9e1b37a3.description: In the 12th century, Gao Qiu overthrows the Song Dynasty emperor Hui Zhong. As an exiled ruler you must build your stats to challenge and destroy Gao Qiu and restore Hui Zhong to the throne.
dos:739bd25c9e1b37a3.title: Bandit Kings of Ancient China

dos:73acc4f9af404614.description: A shareware adaptation of the Epyx classic with all the levels from Jumpman and Jumpman Junior, plus original levels and an editor.
dos:73acc4f9af404614.title: Jumpman Lives!

dos:73ad520f7d745397.description: A side-scrolling shooter with unintuitive controls and a variation on Defender, in which you fly left or right and try to save your men while dodging enemy fire.
dos:73ad520f7d745397.title: Space Havoc 2

dos:73b285367ffbbb86.description: A tile-based real-time wargame of the Battle of Austerlitz on 2 December 1805. Command either the French or the Russo-Austrian armies.
dos:73b285367ffbbb86.title: Napoleon vs. The Evil Monarchies: Austerlitz 1805

dos:73b49072f998f0cb.description: The second game by John Como, from the Villa Crespo budget coffee series: a peaceful, family-friendly game of Hearts.
dos:73b49072f998f0cb.title: Hearts

dos:73bb434c6489b161.description: One of the first Space Invaders clones on the PC, with the same concept and different graphics.
dos:73bb434c6489b161.title: Xtron

dos:73c1ee97d7ca1b85.description: A simple textmode Pac-Man hidden inside the RemorseView application for viewing ASCII artwork, in which a yellow gobbling mouth moves through a maze.
dos:73c1ee97d7ca1b85.title: RemorseView (hiddengame)

dos:73c30e09c425faf9.description: A word association game for one, two or four players, based on free association word chains like the UK party game Tennis-Elbow-Foot.
dos:73c30e09c425faf9.title: Tommy's Connecting Point

dos:73c3cc33681c1628.description: An operational-level wargame of a hypothetical World War III in central Europe in the early 1990s. As the Soviets, sweep aside NATO and capture the Ruhr; as NATO, stop the Russians.
dos:73c3cc33681c1628.title: Red Lightning

dos:73c5db1209425aa1.description: The fourth Sierra Hoyle game, a collection of eight card games: Bridge, Euchre, Old Maid, Gin Rummy, Hearts, Cribbage, Crazy Eights and Klondike, with rules and an interface tutorial.
dos:73c5db1209425aa1.title: Hoyle Classic Card Games

dos:73cd154341aebfaf.description: A mystical fantasy RPG that takes you underground to battle bizarre monsters and find riches in and beneath the city of Locklaven, controlling a party of four explorers by keyboard or mouse.
dos:73cd154341aebfaf.title: Ancients 1: Death Watch

dos:73dc485d7ecd8945.description: A comic space adventure in which Brad Stallion, helped by the computer Sandie, tracks a band of interstellar raiders across two planets, a space station and his ship by solving puzzles.
dos:73dc485d7ecd8945.title: S♥x Vixens From Space

dos:73e088f01302994b.description: Don Bluth's second laserdisc conversion after Dragon's Lair. You play Dexter, fighting the madman Borf, who has kidnapped Kimberly and threatens the world with the Infanto Ray, which turns adults into children.
dos:73e088f01302994b.title: Space Ace CD

dos:73e7200db9ddc2f3.description: A game loosely inspired by Duck Hunt, played with the space bar. An armed ASCII man at the bottom center fires at birds flying above, timing his shot to intercept them.
dos:73e7200db9ddc2f3.title: Duck Hunt (1993)

dos:73ecdc0ea871307a.description: You are a thief breaking into a Spanish bank who needs tools such as a torch and pincers, avoiding policemen, gorillas, kung-fu experts, women sweeping and paper airplanes.
dos:73ecdc0ea871307a.title: Goody

dos:73fae3b292eda614.description: Released after Pinball Illusions, a pinball game with nine tables based on places around the globe, including Africa, Australia, Hollywood, New York and the North Pole.
dos:73fae3b292eda614.title: Pinball World

dos:74011fab0a7d5aa1.description: The widest-scope strategy game of its time. Lead a nation from the Stone Age to the 21st century and become the dominant civilization, by conquest or otherwise.
dos:74011fab0a7d5aa1.title: Sid Meier's Civilization

dos:740c694629591ca9.description: A simulation of the Battle of Midway in June 1942. The computer commands a huge Japanese force trying to invade the island, while you command the badly outnumbered American forces.
dos:740c694629591ca9.title: Midway Campaign

dos:74111431cc4f0d54.description: An interactive fiction in which Terry, in rehab for nicotine addiction, stands in a muddy glade in the rain. A head buried in the mud tells him he has pieces to recover.
dos:74111431cc4f0d54.title: Losing Your Grip

dos:741347b3e3215ce0.description: A trivia game with a hundred multiple-choice questions on the Star Trek television series, covering the Enterprise crew, aliens and enemies, episode names, technical data and dialogue.
dos:741347b3e3215ce0.title: Trek Trivia

dos:7429ddb9eee6a3e2.description: A medieval strategy game with action and light adventure elements and hand-drawn graphics. You return to find your ancestral castle in ruins and a huge army marching on your land, and must raise an army.
dos:7429ddb9eee6a3e2.title: Iron Lord

dos:742a465a55b6cb48.description: Realistic armored warfare across numerous tactical theaters, with modern US and Soviet armored vehicles to choose from. It was one of the earliest tank sims with a broad mission editor.
dos:742a465a55b6cb48.title: Armored Fist

dos:743731ae01bc1f4c.description: A shareware compendium of fifty-seven puzzles in categories such as Anagram Word Find, where the words in a word-find puzzle are anagrammed, and Antograms.
dos:743731ae01bc1f4c.title: Computer Puzzles Unlimited

dos:74425f410b78bfb6.description: A shareware dungeon crawl. Two hundred years ago you served the good Lord Trentarus, whose mages built a sarcophagus of pure wizidrium to ensure his reign continued; this is the sequel to The Cyan Sarcophagus.
dos:74425f410b78bfb6.title: Skull Quest II: The Vortex

dos:744386e7d9cfee5a.description: A winter Olympic sports game and successor to SuperSki III. Choose a mode and difficulty and compete in Downhill, Giant Slalom, Slalom, Snowboard, Snowboard Slalom or Ski Jump.
dos:744386e7d9cfee5a.title: SuperSki Pro

dos:74633fad6dbe3440.description: A two-on-two beach volleyball game from an angled overhead view. Up to four players can share a computer, with computer-controlled teammates filling the other positions.
dos:74633fad6dbe3440.title: Haebyeon-ui Baegu

dos:746a319c605780b3.description: Build factories on land, but people get angry if you keep building. Move with the arrow keys and advance one turn with Q, which increases money and reduces anger.
dos:746a319c605780b3.title: Economitopia 2

dos:746bb1d8f238949f.description: Abe, a Mudokon in a race enslaved by the Glukkons, overhears the corporate leaders plan a new meat product and sets out to free his people in this puzzle platformer.
dos:746bb1d8f238949f.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee

dos:746c6f24cce614b8.description: A 1995 interactive fiction by Andrew Plotkin in which you are caught in a rainstorm in the countryside. It won the Inform category at the inaugural Interactive Fiction Competition.
dos:746c6f24cce614b8.title: A Change in the Weather

dos:74748db589ec2f3f.description: As brave knight Sir AddaLot, defeat the dragon Scorch, who terrorizes castles, by eliminating equal results of math expressions while walking from castle to castle.
dos:74748db589ec2f3f.title: Sir AddaLot's Mini Math Adventure

dos:7478d609627ed984.description: A Centipede-style shoot 'em up. Shoot a giant centipede moving down the field and the mushrooms for extra points, watching out for spiders and the indestructible hungry Pacperson.
dos:7478d609627ed984.title: Mushroom Mania

dos:7482b14b41830260.description: The sequel to the arcade-style racer Screamer, with an improved SVGA engine, new cars and tracks, trackside details like cows and helicopters, and a Techno CD audio soundtrack.
dos:7482b14b41830260.title: Screamer 2

dos:748c18d8a98acdd6.description: A rally arcade racing game looking like Gaelco's World Rally Championship but with a larger car sprite. Modes are training, single race and championship over 30 circuits.
dos:748c18d8a98acdd6.title: PC Rally

dos:7490ac49a00b251e.description: When the town of Word-Ville runs out of words, Reader Rabbit and his friend Matt collect them in four activities: Vowel Pond, Word Mine, Word Patch and Alphabet Dance. For ages 6 to 8.
dos:7490ac49a00b251e.title: Reader Rabbit 2

dos:74a226e83139ef3a.description: A shareware adventure in which you are a bar man on an intergalactic cruiser who wakes to find the ship deserted and must explore it to escape alive.
dos:74a226e83139ef3a.title: Intergalactic Bar Mans Pub Crawl

dos:74a5a6fbb88cffd1.description: An Infocom interactive fiction by Brian Moriarty, written to be easier than typical Infocom releases as an introduction for newcomers to text adventures.
dos:74a5a6fbb88cffd1.title: Wishbringer

dos:74a91096f390f7e0.description: Ride your bike across funky terrain while collecting apples.
dos:74a91096f390f7e0.title: Action SuperCross

dos:74ba2c273b36e8e3.description: A split-screen tennis game with the camera close behind the athlete. Play exhibition singles or doubles, training, the Davis Cup or the four Grand Slam tournaments with one of 32 athletes or your own.
dos:74ba2c273b36e8e3.title: Tennis Cup

dos:74c916fcb6eda4a7.description: A puzzle game whose object is to eliminate all tiles from a board of black squares by selecting a tile with the cursor and pressing an arrow key.
dos:74c916fcb6eda4a7.title: Entropy

dos:74c9f8e13db4d076.description: A crude text-based wargame of a sea war between the USA and the USSR. Deep and complex with almost no help available.
dos:74c9f8e13db4d076.title: Red Sky at Morning

dos:74d82070409e7df4.description: The second Micro Machines game, in which you race extremely small cars around a table, a treehouse and other places, in top-down view where the control is sometimes difficult.
dos:74d82070409e7df4.title: Micro Machines 2: Turbo Tournament

dos:74dbd2909c6fab88.description: The third game of the Daemon's Quest series, an interactive fiction.
dos:74dbd2909c6fab88.title: Daemon Quest, The Third Saga: The Road to the High Tsani

dos:74dc5718786615ea.description: Gavrila, a charming loader, solves weighing puzzles in a limited time for points. Entering rooms in a multi-storey building, he puts the proper boxes on the weighing machine and labels them.
dos:74dc5718786615ea.title: Gavrila

dos:74dcc68d73e1c6da.description: The first version of MECC's educational application that lets children aged 6 to 12 write their own fairy-tale stories, creating illustrated books of pages.
dos:74dcc68d73e1c6da.title: Storybook Weaver

dos:74fc8c0ccd71bad8.description: A re-release of Hole-In-One Miniature Golf with 3 more courses, 8 in total with 144 holes.
dos:74fc8c0ccd71bad8.title: Hole-In-One Miniature Golf Deluxe!

dos:7507b6be36e9ce7a.description: A top-down football simulation where you pick the strategies. On offense you control the ball carrier, then the quarterback after the snap, then the receiver; on defense you control the middle linebacker.
dos:7507b6be36e9ce7a.title: Cunning Football

dos:750c04bb8cffac91.description: A traditional space shooter with 42 rounds of battle against invading aliens, each with different movement and firing patterns. You have an auto-fire cannon and a single-fire targeting laser.
dos:750c04bb8cffac91.title: Round 42

dos:7513ac913e67c56e.description: A Breakout variant by Ken Silverman, the author of the Build engine, in which the paddle can move vertically as well as horizontally. There are no falling bonuses; just clear the screen.
dos:7513ac913e67c56e.title: Breakout (1991)

dos:751526af39d2ec6a.description: You are an energy guardian who must stop the enemy from breaching your inner globe. On a grid fifteen nodes wide by eight high, you move a character along the lines.
dos:751526af39d2ec6a.title: Tommy's Enet

dos:751aee0a65f2e6f4.description: A strategy game where you reach the far end of a large grid filled with enemies, holes and walls. You can create and fill in holes to block enemies or reach new areas, and the enemies vary in intelligence.
dos:751aee0a65f2e6f4.title: Moraff's Entrap

dos:752e96c4aa4f6698.description: An Italian platformer for a younger audience starring an anthropomorphic stack of sweets with arms, legs and expressive eyes.
dos:752e96c4aa4f6698.title: Mister Fruit Joy

dos:75388fefb840ea4a.description: A small modern boy finds himself in a magical land ruled by Dr. Malvado, whose name means Evil in Spanish, and must stop him while facing opponents like bears, wasps and spiders.
dos:75388fefb840ea4a.title: The Castle of Dr. Malvado

dos:75402b3fca5b9b4d.description: An Infocom comic science-fiction text adventure: in 1936 the protagonist is abducted by invaders from Phobos and must escape and foil their plan for Earth, collecting items and solving puzzles by typing commands.
dos:75402b3fca5b9b4d.title: Leather Goddesses of Phobos

dos:7540d13667ee33ff.description: The well-loved card game with many local house rules, some set in a menu. Collect 500 points and avoid -500, playing in teams against two other players.
dos:7540d13667ee33ff.title: Five Hundred

dos:754629685951153e.description: A simple top-view shooter for 2 or 3 players with DeathMatch and Capture the Flag modes. Choose a map and buy weapons with money earned in battle.
dos:754629685951153e.title: Men in War

dos:75568c188be322bf.description: A text-based game in the Wizard's Castle family, originating in 1981 on DEC mainframes. Descend into a dungeon in a haunted mansion to find the all-powerful Globe.
dos:75568c188be322bf.title: Bones: The Game of the Haunted Mansion

dos:755c1fd2f89e873a.description: A 2D naval simulation in which you captain a US Navy Destroyer in World War II, commanding sub-hunter, rescue, blockade running, bombardment, scout and convoy escort missions.
dos:755c1fd2f89e873a.title: Destroyer

dos:75721c8e98bbaf12.description: A conversion of Capcom's arcade game. Shoot everything in sight as the hero runs back and forth along the bottom of the screen, dodging bullets and grenades, alone or with a second player.
dos:75721c8e98bbaf12.title: Cabal

dos:757276f7620396a3.description: A Korean platformer from Object Square Team, a team of only two people, with music by TeMP.
dos:757276f7620396a3.title: Astrocounter of Crescents

dos:757503ccaa12dce0.description: A street dealer's buying, selling and fighting game based on the New York drug market. Pay off your debt to the loan shark, then make as much money as you can in one month.
dos:757503ccaa12dce0.title: Drug Wars: A Game Based on the New York Drug Market

dos:757569ed29594dd1.description: A puzzle game in which you collect all the keys, reach the door and don't die.
dos:757569ed29594dd1.title: Arcy 2

dos:757959b66ecaf32a.description: A Christian game from Bridgestone in which, with the Sword of the Spirit and the Shield of Faith, you help Captain Bible fight evil in the Dome of Darkness.
dos:757959b66ecaf32a.title: Captain Bible in the Dome of Darkness

dos:757d9d948692a27a.description: A conversion of the arcade game for up to four players, a wizard, warrior, elf and valkyrie, who make their way through mazes, collecting treasures and potions and fending off creatures and ghosts.
dos:757d9d948692a27a.title: Gauntlet II

dos:758ee48f994b9c76.description: A platformer with a huge nonlinear playfield of several terrains. As Captain Comic, galactic hero, you must recover three treasures stolen from the planet Omsoc and hidden on remote Tambi.
dos:758ee48f994b9c76.title: The Adventures of Captain Comic

dos:759f11ec89d16396.description: A simple aliens-attack-Earth game in which you must ram all the defenseless alien ships before they land, while avoiding the alien Droids who try to ram you.
dos:759f11ec89d16396.title: Aliens (1989)

dos:75a23023e0bd07c1.description: Based on the Spanish animated series broadcast on Television Espanola in the late eighties, set in the System of the Double Sun with seven planets and twelve moons.
dos:75a23023e0bd07c1.title: La Corona Mágica

dos:75a3c8b11893041b.description: A Contract Bridge game with adjustable bidding conventions for both partners, such as Cue Bid, Weak Two-Bid, Jacoby Transfer and Gambling NT. Games can be saved and restored.
dos:75a3c8b11893041b.title: Grand Slam Bridge

dos:75a5bb79e30a78dd.description: A simple keyboard-controlled ski jumping simulator, available as shareware with a modest registration that unlocks extra features.
dos:75a5bb79e30a78dd.title: Ski Jump International

dos:75af06a68a92ff48.description: A Taiwanese first-person shooter borrowing heavily from Doom, Duke Nukem 3D and Shadow Warrior, set in a post-apocalyptic future after a nuclear holocaust started by a self-aware AI defense system.
dos:75af06a68a92ff48.title: Mars 3D

dos:75afb2ba6c2970b8.description: A basic CGA translation of the Wheel of Fortune game show: guess letters until you can solve the phrase across three rounds and a bonus round, against 2 computer players or friends.
dos:75afb2ba6c2970b8.title: Wheel of Fortune (1987)

dos:75b507a3fadd84f8.description: Fly an Apache AH-64 helicopter to rescue downed pilots behind enemy lines in a 3D remake of Choplifter.
dos:75b507a3fadd84f8.title: Battle Chopper

dos:75b64f156f8a89f8.description: A robot combat simulator driven by AI profiles. Edit and create your own AI profiles, then pick several to battle and see who wins.
dos:75b64f156f8a89f8.title: AT-Robots

dos:75bbc39499c635bd.description: A shareware partnership whist game for four players in two teams, where you sit as North and the computer plays the other three hands. A match is a series of games.
dos:75bbc39499c635bd.title: Tommy's Whist

dos:75bd069708ea8dac.description: Rockford the Ant returns with 15 new levels and an easy-to-use editor. Build, save and play your own levels and sequence them on a separate game disk.
dos:75bd069708ea8dac.title: Boulder Dash Construction Kit

dos:75ca891050fd0d4e.description: An isometric puzzle game for four players, any mix of human and computer, similar to Virgin's Spot. Move your pieces next to pieces of another color to take control of the largest area of the board.
dos:75ca891050fd0d4e.title: The Ball Game

dos:75cb05a0d3379dcb.description: Pyl (Dust), a 3D first-person shooter that emphasizes sneaking to save ammunition. The action takes place across a series of maps visited by a character searching for artifacts.
dos:75cb05a0d3379dcb.title: Pył

dos:75cc0400c9612731.description: A science-fiction comedy adventure. An alien crash-lands near Atom City in 1958 seeking help for his occupied home world, and you play Barth, gas-station owner Zeke or astronomer's daughter Lydia.
dos:75cc0400c9612731.title: Leather Goddesses of Phobos 2: Gas Pump Girls Meet the Pulsating Inconvenience from Planet X!

dos:75cf5de58a782412.description: As a rookie detective, identify the thief behind the theft of some of the world's most priceless treasures, obtain an arrest warrant and track down the crook before time runs out. Your rank rises as you solve cases.
dos:75cf5de58a782412.title: Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego? Deluxe Edition

dos:75d595d3521f21cf.description: Two text adventures with graphics, Shard of Inovar and Venom.
dos:75d595d3521f21cf.title: Shard of Inovar / Venom

dos:75d595d3521f21cf.1.description: A text adventure about the Inovar, a magical artifact created by the ancient Elfin race Eharin to defeat the plague Nagroma that swept the land.
dos:75d595d3521f21cf.1.title: Shard of Inovar

dos:75d595d3521f21cf.2.description: A text adventure with graphics. The evil Traklan, condemned underground by Lord Mirosima, has risen again to threaten the land of Armosin, and you play the warrior Rikka.
dos:75d595d3521f21cf.2.title: Venom

dos:75d5e33143c05969.description: A strategy shooter in which you control a robot starting in the center of the game area, surrounded by baddies, and must rescue all the humans on the screen. Some baddies attack the humans instead of you.
dos:75d5e33143c05969.title: Robotica

dos:75e15f5416ac5a66.description: A rail shooter in which humans have left Earth and the journey to the stars outlasted expectations. When the mysterious Scarab-X forces attack, the Scavenger 4 squadron responds.
dos:75e15f5416ac5a66.title: Novastorm

dos:75ea161c2d0ede6a.description: A DOS shareware remake of Space Invaders with three modes: Classic, Deluxe and the enhanced Champ mode.
dos:75ea161c2d0ede6a.title: CHAMP Invaders

dos:75fc9dfb83e46cd2.description: A Pac-Man-like maze game with an overhead view. Help the farmer rid his farm of mice by moving the maze walls to corner them for the cat. A female mouse that reaches cheese will reproduce.
dos:75fc9dfb83e46cd2.title: Mouser

dos:75ff273ccc600dea.description: A historical wargame in which you play either side in four of Napoleon's battles: Auerstadt, Borodino, Quatre Bras and Waterloo, with a scenario construction set for designing your own.
dos:75ff273ccc600dea.title: Battles of Napoleon

dos:7604692b8dc72701.description: A puzzle game based on Puzzle Bobble. Aim colored faces from the bottom of the screen, off the walls if necessary, to hit matching groups on the grid.
dos:7604692b8dc72701.title: Snood

dos:7609122ebdfe6e8a.description: A memory game: watch a pattern of 4 circles and then recreate it. Written in only 55 lines of BASIC.
dos:7609122ebdfe6e8a.title: Flash Back

dos:76173e1eb1de64f4.description: A Tetris clone with interesting piece shapes. Complete lines to keep the wall low and don't let blocks reach the top of the drop tube.
dos:76173e1eb1de64f4.title: Flip-N-Drop

dos:7634c2c9b1f431a7.description: The Dark Army is on the move, led by the sorceress Scotia, who aims to destroy Gladstone Keep and King Richard. Scotia, empowered by the Mask, can shape shift and infiltrate.
dos:7634c2c9b1f431a7.title: Lands of Lore: The Throne of Chaos

dos:763997421dbef746.description: A tenpin bowling game from Leader Board authors Bruce and Roger Carver. Time a succession of clicks to set angle, speed and curve, with three skill levels.
dos:763997421dbef746.title: 10th Frame

dos:7653e9aada355e06.description: A text adventure set in a single room, your dilapidated apartment, as you prepare to leave for a festival in Death Valley. The nearer you get to leaving, the more problems befall you.
dos:7653e9aada355e06.title: Shade

dos:76666ec21b5408cc.description: The trading vessel Princess Blue is ambushed and destroyed by Manchi raiders after finding a derelict ship. As the only surviving crew member, you start a space career in this mix of flight, trading and RPG.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Role-Playing; Vehicle Simulation
dos:76666ec21b5408cc.title: Space Rogue

dos:766d4510499ac103.description: A text adventure in which you are the only witness to a kidnapping and must go to the rescue. It has a two-word parser, function key macros and a split-window format.
dos:766d4510499ac103.title: Crime Adventure

dos:76800b20d44953b7.description: A turn-based strategy game in which you control a medieval country and conquer all other countries. Raise armies, improve your castle and defenses, conduct diplomacy and grow your economy.
dos:76800b20d44953b7.title: Kingdom at War

dos:7683494514209bf2.description: A trivia action game. Move your muncher around a grid and eat the words that fit a given clue or category, while incorrect words and critters get in the way.
dos:7683494514209bf2.title: Super Munchers: The Challenge Continues...

dos:768e4bde924e5faa.description: An Olympic-style sports game with arcade gameplay. Events include barrel jumping, bull riding, caber toss, cliff diving, log rolling, pole vault, skiing, sumo wrestling and weightlifting.
dos:768e4bde924e5faa.title: World Games

dos:768f71eba6693ca5.description: A strategy game with light RPG and business simulation elements. You play the former king's son in a medieval kingdom dominated by an evil sorceress called Medusa.
dos:768f71eba6693ca5.title: Rings of Medusa

dos:7693de1c19e04728.description: A rugby game released alongside the 1991 Rugby World Cup. Recreate the full 16-team event, play friendlies or an 8-team league, with 10 skill levels and customizable options.
dos:7693de1c19e04728.title: World Class Rugby

dos:76965738286d2268.description: A text adventure in which you journey between short stories connected solely by color: speeding on the road with a friend, landing on Mars, teaching your daughter astronomy.
dos:76965738286d2268.title: Photopia

dos:76a5c4047645bd05.description: A space adventure developed by the small French studio Legend Software, which took over development in the late 1980s. It was originally intended for the Amiga, then the Atari.
dos:76a5c4047645bd05.title: Nishiran

dos:76b54b0ab1d176df.description: A role-playing simulation in which you sit in the cockpit of a B-17 Flying Fortress bomber with the 8th Air Force in World War II. The name refers to the crushed service cap of veterans of 50 missions.
dos:76b54b0ab1d176df.title: 50 Mission Crush

dos:76b7e09bb27622ba.description: A biology quiz in five levels, including Systems, Plants, Animals, where you place animals in the correct phylum and class, and Pioneers, a quiz on the history of biology.
dos:76b7e09bb27622ba.title: Biology 101

dos:76b9b83cecde8fd4.description: A Flappy Bird clone made for Mini Ludum Dare 71: The Retro Challenge. Make the bird flap through pipes without hitting the ground or pipes.
dos:76b9b83cecde8fd4.title: Flapscii

dos:76cc4c635602dcfd.description: A Missile Command variant. Protect six cities along the east coast from the enemy's 12 missiles by moving a cursor and firing anti-ballistic missiles.
dos:76cc4c635602dcfd.title: Anti-Ballistic-Missile

dos:76d312cb754d0d68.description: A DOS shareware remake of Namco's 1980 Galaxian arcade shooter, with the original Classic and enhanced Champ modes.
dos:76d312cb754d0d68.title: CHAMP Galaxia

dos:76db4a9481b0e66b.description: You are the sibling of the sailor who washed ashore in the first game. Your father united twelve warring tribes, but after his retirement they are at war again, and you must unite them.
dos:76db4a9481b0e66b.title: Island Conquest II

dos:76e53d387d389ea4.description: An air traffic control simulator. Take charge of a sector, guiding every aircraft to its destination safely on a radar screen where planes appear as green dots.
dos:76e53d387d389ea4.title: Tracon II

dos:76e5a7df2c0f4d54.description: A Concentration card game with Bible images, meant to teach players about Bible stories. One to three players take turns turning over cards to find matching pairs.
dos:76e5a7df2c0f4d54.title: Christmas Matchup

dos:76ec0312bf369c77.description: Based on the 1980s game show. Play one of three contestants in a quiz round and a shot at the big board, where correct answers earn spins.
dos:76ec0312bf369c77.title: Press Your Luck

dos:76f79609d9995fc7.description: The first in a line of pinball games from 21st Century and Digital Illusions, with four tables: Steel Wheel in the wild west, Ignition in space, Nightmare in a haunted graveyard and Beat Box in pop music.
dos:76f79609d9995fc7.title: Pinball Dreams

dos:76fdbfd04834d064.description: A shareware keyboard-controlled Risk-like game in which you play the Olympians and conquer all eight islands against three computer adversaries: the Calydonians, Argonauts and Titans.
dos:76fdbfd04834d064.title: Battle for Atlantis

dos:7709165837803ec4.description: A hybrid action-strategy game originally released on the 3DO, in an FMV edition for the REEL Magic MPEG card.
dos:7709165837803ec4.title: The Horde (REEL Magic)

dos:7709d3f06d465701.description: A first-person shooter built with the Pie 3D engine. Explore thirty levels, search corridors for equipment, collect weapons and fight through waves of unusual enemies.
dos:7709d3f06d465701.title: Duke Scr♥w 'Em 38D

dos:7717a9ff82a34858.description: A shoot 'em up with a complex plot. You are Trent Hawkings, the galaxy's ace solo fighter pilot, who fights off MicroSol, a company bent on taking over the galaxy.
dos:7717a9ff82a34858.title: Tyrian

dos:771eb88d7b9bd706.description: A side-scrolling space shooter, whose Greek title means Runaway.
dos:771eb88d7b9bd706.title: Apodrasi (Runaway)

dos:77200726c63b4c60.description: Nevada Smith, a lowly research assistant, hopes to make his name by finding a lost tomb, but the professor he assists steals his glory. He sets out to explore the Pharaoh's tomb himself in this platformer.
dos:77200726c63b4c60.title: Pharaoh's Tomb

dos:7727bef3292816a5.description: A text-based game in which you lead three aircraft patrolling terrain to suppress enemy forces in the distant future, with ultra-modern weapons and protection.
dos:7727bef3292816a5.title: Wasteland Rebels

dos:775031391011377b.description: A Final Fight-style beat 'em up featuring Batman and Robin, based on the Batman Forever movie, using batarangs and a bat grapple with the film's plot, characters and quotes.
dos:775031391011377b.title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game

dos:775a9a55e1ce8e65.description: An arcade game of guiding a permanently bouncing ball through a vertically scrolling field of obstacles, controlling its horizontal movement and the speed of vertical movement.
dos:775a9a55e1ce8e65.title: Jump!

dos:77634a4fd949dab9.description: A shareware keyboard-controlled Rubik's Cube puzzle. Start with a solved cube and randomize it with commands, or let the computer randomize it for you to solve.
dos:77634a4fd949dab9.title: Rubik Cube

dos:7764931342601e2d.description: An isometric action puzzle game with Epsitec's yellow egg-shaped Blupi characters. Guide Blupi safely to the exit, a purple balloon, by manipulating the environment in many ways.
dos:7764931342601e2d.title: Blupimania

dos:776619dfc8095d37.description: Two games, Flashy Cars and Turbo Flashy Cars, combining picture puzzles with a cartoon car race.
dos:776619dfc8095d37.title: Flashy Cars / Turbo Flashy Cars

dos:776619dfc8095d37.1.description: A picture puzzle in which you unscramble an image by moving pieces around with a joystick or the keyboard (QZOP).
dos:776619dfc8095d37.1.title: Flashy Cars

dos:776619dfc8095d37.2.description: Two games in one: a puzzle in which you assemble an image of a drawn car from pieces, and a top-down cartoon race in a retro-style machine over a difficult route.
dos:776619dfc8095d37.2.title: Turbo Flashy Cars

dos:7767e8b47f9e0ad0.description: The sequel to Whale's Voyage, set twenty years after the crew of the spaceship Whale won a great battle and abolished a dictatorship. All the money is spent, so the four heroes start trading again.
dos:7767e8b47f9e0ad0.title: Whale's Voyage II: Die Übermacht

dos:77781fa5eaa1865f.description: A Tron-inspired light cycle game for 1 or 2 humans, with computer rivals for up to 6 players. Block the others with the trail you leave behind without running into any trail yourself.
dos:77781fa5eaa1865f.title: Blockade

dos:777a132859f67fd3.description: An early edition of the Triple Play baseball series, licensed by the MLB and players associations, with a manager mode that allows players to be traded.
dos:777a132859f67fd3.title: Triple Play 97

dos:7781de05841b0163.description: In 2027 the world is split between two superpowers. A spy reveals the secret Cyberia Complex in Siberia where a mysterious weapon is being developed, and you are sent in.
dos:7781de05841b0163.title: Cyberia

dos:7783a1d0e9b99eba.description: A conversion of Atari Games' first-person shoot 'em up based on the original film. As Luke Skywalker you must pass swarms of TIE Fighters to attack the weak spot of the Death Star.
dos:7783a1d0e9b99eba.title: Star Wars

dos:778ee8dcb0d6e592.description: A strategy game in which you construct and manage a commercial space station, like Project: Space Station. First get the station running by sending up all the required personnel and modules.
dos:778ee8dcb0d6e592.title: Space M+A+X (1992)

dos:779104e498f8b2e3.description: A side-scrolling shooter with 3D backgrounds, colorful graphics and a storyline. A ship leaves Earth in 2616 with 1,000 settlers, loses contact, and the action moves to 4720 when a city is attacked.
dos:779104e498f8b2e3.title: Katharsis

dos:77a9de935446b921.description: A platform game in which, as a Super Solver, you recover hidden treasures of the ancient world in four caverns (Greece & Rome, Egypt, India & China and the Near East) to reach the final cavern.
dos:77a9de935446b921.title: Super Solvers: Challenge of the Ancient Empires

dos:77ab4e403111bf0e.description: A Columns variant that pokes fun at Microsoft's operating system. Groups of three Windows 3.x icons descend and pile at the bottom instead of colored blocks.
dos:77ab4e403111bf0e.title: Windoze

dos:77b49dc598c84ff7.description: Play Wendell, a rookie acrobat who must retrieve the ringmasters' hats and stop the chaos caused by their disappearance, while clowns armed with knives and beach balls get in his way.
dos:77b49dc598c84ff7.title: Big Top

dos:77b9f15a3f1884ff.description: A Finnish platformer about Pekka the chicken, who grew tired of living by the laws of nature and decided to civilize an animal society and lead it to democracy.
dos:77b9f15a3f1884ff.title: Pekka Kana

dos:77bcf2168cb05f96.description: Kirt thinks he is an ordinary human until he learns he is the last of The People, an ancient race able to shapeshift into magical creatures. He takes on a quest in this first-person adventure.
dos:77bcf2168cb05f96.title: ShadowCaster

dos:77becbbbb55c9db3.description: Sequel to President is Missing, an adventure without a text parser with an involving story and puzzles solved by logical deduction and attention to detail. You are an official investigator.
dos:77becbbbb55c9db3.title: Presumed Guilty!

dos:77c5e4545f7c1a4a.description: An arcade-puzzle game with a top-down view of a railway network of stations and junctions. Trains are released at random, each with a destination, and you must get a set number there within a time limit.
dos:77c5e4545f7c1a4a.title: Locomotion

dos:77c960fbc77afe23.description: Another interactive book for kids in the Once Upon A Time series. A child brought up by the dragon in one of the kingdom's four houses is now a brave boy, left alone one night when his parents go out.
dos:77c960fbc77afe23.title: Once Upon A Time: Abracadabra

dos:77d16bddda96c359.description: A science-fiction first-person shooter in which you are a crashed space pilot stranded on a derelict vessel. Collect key cards, insert them in terminals and use the codes to open lockers with weapons.
dos:77d16bddda96c359.title: In Extremis

dos:77dd2c37c35f0bea.description: A text-mode action and puzzle game. Reach the exit on each level past obstacles like trees, which can be destroyed, and monsters, using various one-off puzzle objects.
dos:77dd2c37c35f0bea.title: Kingdom of Kroz

dos:77dfa06da8db8b32.description: Loosely a sequel to MicroProse Soccer, with the ball sticking to your player's foot, but in pure 3D polygons viewed from just behind the ball as you move up the pitch.
dos:77dfa06da8db8b32.title: International Soccer Challenge

dos:77e023fb30d0526d.description: A turn-based action-strategy game in the vein of Jagged Alliance or X-COM though less complex. The Grey Cows and Brown Cows battle each other on one big battleground.
dos:77e023fb30d0526d.title: Crazy Cows

dos:77e62d52aba4c8c7.description: Moraff's World and Moraff's Revenge with a story. Dungeon crawl, slaying evil garbage cans, Lesdidian warriors and toxic waste barrels, trading their worthless dollars for real money.
dos:77e62d52aba4c8c7.title: Moraff's Dungeons of the Unforgiven

dos:77e7ea26a55070e9.description: A camera simulation over three photographic scenes. Pan with the mouse, zoom with its buttons and record camera movements for later playback.
dos:77e7ea26a55070e9.title: Adult Film Cameraman

dos:77f274b8481e638b.description: An Enchanter saga text adventure. The world of magic guilds is threatened with destruction, and you, who defeated the warlock Krill, are among the young Enchanters called to the task.
dos:77f274b8481e638b.title: Spellbreaker

dos:77f95d0de5bee22c.description: Based on the film, tiny aliens invade Looney Tunes land and the Tunes' fate is decided by a basketball game against the aliens turned huge Monstars. Two thirds basketball sim and the rest mini-games.
dos:77f95d0de5bee22c.title: Space Jam

dos:77fabfe798ffbfa6.description: An RPG typing game designed to run on an IBM XT286 with a CGA graphics card, made in QBasic with the source code included.
dos:77fabfe798ffbfa6.title: Princess Red Keyboard Warrior

dos:77ffc98fee161446.description: A logic game combining elements of Boulder Dash, Dyna Blaster and Sokoban. Collect all the keys and reach the exit door of each level without getting killed. There are around fifty levels and a built-in editor.
dos:77ffc98fee161446.title: Buddyros

dos:7801bcb934b8a8e9.description: A shareware space shooter controlled entirely with the mouse: one button fires the thrusters, another the guns, and moving the mouse rotates the ship.
dos:7801bcb934b8a8e9.title: The Orion Project

dos:780b0dea89df04a4.description: The sequel to Pee & Gity Special, continuing the brawler gameplay. The protagonists work together punching waves of enemies until the last is eliminated, then advance.
dos:780b0dea89df04a4.title: Py & Gity 2: The Industrial Age

dos:7810f2c7fc0d7f79.description: In the year 15432, a mysterious group called A.V.C. contacts the acquisition squad Red Hunter to perform missions in dangerous environments, in this first-person shooter.
dos:7810f2c7fc0d7f79.title: In Pursuit of Greed

dos:781d558c25e03bbb.description: A side-scrolling arcade shooter in which you pilot a space jet infiltrating the planet Kaeon through six stages, including Orbiting Defence Station, Atmosphere, Alien Forest, Capital City and Underground.
dos:781d558c25e03bbb.title: Kaeon

dos:781e19f267aa738a.description: Louie, a martial arts expert, must save his master from a local gang called the Martial Arts Posse. Battle through the city to a final confrontation with the leader.
dos:781e19f267aa738a.title: Kung Fu Louie Vs. The Martial Art Posse

dos:7827cc9895a32355.description: The same gameplay as the original Incredible Machine: solve each puzzle using only the parts provided. It includes all 87 puzzles of the first game plus 73 new ones, new parts and music.
dos:7827cc9895a32355.title: The Even More Incredible Machine

dos:7837eb453d314ca0.description: A fast-paced puzzle game, somewhat like Tetris, in which you eliminate approaching colored shapes before they reach the top by pointing your own colored piece at them and firing.
dos:7837eb453d314ca0.title: Zoop

dos:784efb995a460089.description: Jerrod Wilson gets a letter from his long-lost brother, who fled Brooklyn after being falsely convicted, asking him to join him in Sacramento, California, in the gold rush.
dos:784efb995a460089.title: Gold Rush!

dos:785171ac3434b004.description: A platformer in which George Jetson must survive an electronics rebellion, with the option to ask Rosie for help.
dos:785171ac3434b004.title: The Jetsons in By George, in Trouble Again

dos:787070f6be985835.description: A 3D Tetris clone. Rotate blocks in 3D to fit them into the pit, with odd three-dimensional pieces and adjustable pit sizes for advanced players.
dos:787070f6be985835.title: Blockout

dos:7876fa2b783037e2.description: A fantasy text adventure in which you play an ordinary man named Philip, whose home becomes the site of a portal to another dimension through which a cleric steps.
dos:7876fa2b783037e2.title: The Battle of Philip against the Forces of Creation

dos:7877c2e617771b63.description: An adaptation of Storybook Weaver for children aged 8 to 14 to write their own stories, based on everyday contemporary situations with illustration objects from real life.
dos:7877c2e617771b63.title: My Own Stories

dos:787d17d4df7c021b.description: A Breakout variant with two linked paddles that keep a ball in play while breaking blocks. The ball can escape from any side, and completing a stage reveals a gallery image.
dos:787d17d4df7c021b.title: Uncover It

dos:787fed6d21dae468.description: Move with WASD collecting keys and items, avoiding monsters, unlocking doors and finding treasure. The graphics resemble roguelikes, but nothing is random.
dos:787fed6d21dae468.title: Escape From The ASCII Trolls

dos:7888066314645eac.description: You play Bounty Bob, exploring every inch of an abandoned mine. Walk over each floor section to change its color; when all are changed, you advance to a harder level.
dos:7888066314645eac.title: Miner 2049er

dos:788a3585432a80a4.description: A top-view educational maze game in which you race around collecting scattered letters. Two teleporters warp you to random spots, and each maze has a picture of an object in the middle.
dos:788a3585432a80a4.title: Alphabet Zoo

dos:78924992d4e46a7c.description: A simple horizontal adaptation of Pong against the computer or a human. Each player controls a red or blue line paddle at the top or bottom of the screen.
dos:78924992d4e46a7c.title: The Paddle

dos:789e3d055def568f.description: A live-action video game in which you watch a lakeside house through security cameras and trigger traps to protect its visitors, following events across rooms and timing your actions.
dos:789e3d055def568f.title: Night Trap

dos:789f9bb4cab48515.description: A first-person Bible and Christian quiz game. Travel through mazes and obstacles using quotes from the Bible, with hints to help you answer moral and biblical questions.
dos:789f9bb4cab48515.title: LifesBattle

dos:78aa7f4b3eb317a8.description: Buy a rally car such as a Lancia Delta or Toyota Celica and race against the clock on different locations, collecting money and items. After qualifying, race to win prizes and repair or upgrade your car.
dos:78aa7f4b3eb317a8.title: Rally Championships

dos:78ae3d0c6c28e7f2.description: Osiris is slain by Set and his body is scattered over the desert. Scour the countryside of Egypt to obtain the pieces and prepare for the final showdown against Set.
dos:78ae3d0c6c28e7f2.title: The Seven Spirits of Ra

dos:78c418c44c4eb096.description: Roger Wilco's escape pod is picked up by an interstellar garbage hauler and he wakes in a pile of trash. He must escape in this Space Quest adventure.
dos:78c418c44c4eb096.title: Space Quest III: The Pirates of Pestulon

dos:78cc4988601b6207.description: A 90s Pac-Man clone in which a yellow circle eats dots in a maze that changes color and shape each time you advance. Hourglasses and bombs around the maze help you collect the dots.
dos:78cc4988601b6207.title: Gobman

dos:78cd20608e8be932.description: A Polish adventure set in the city of Wachock, famous for jokes. You play the village head and must find your daughter's missing husband.
dos:78cd20608e8be932.title: Soltys

dos:78cf3fae41dd79e2.description: Fly a Sopwith biplane, shooting down enemy planes and destroying enemy buildings, alone or in skirmishes against the AI.
dos:78cf3fae41dd79e2.title: Sopwith

dos:78d0ded8f0dccea6.description: The third Zork game. A nameless adventurer is cast into a deep dungeon and hears a mysterious voice saying that all the tests have been passed but one.
dos:78d0ded8f0dccea6.title: Zork III: The Dungeon Master

dos:78db8ddf925ab2a4.description: A set of four horror-themed puzzle games for two players from InFluid Software, including Crypt Tac Toe, a Tic Tac Toe variation.
dos:78db8ddf925ab2a4.title: Haunted Childhood

dos:78e726e61057135f.description: A compilation of Test Drive II and all its add-ons: the car disks Musclecars and The Supercars and the scenery disks California Challenge and European Challenge.
dos:78e726e61057135f.title: Test Drive II: The Collection

dos:78fe8afa511f859e.description: An educational game for children. Work out the cheapest way to connect the neighborhood to the water supply, deciding what kind of pipe to buy and where to put it on a limited budget.
dos:78fe8afa511f859e.title: Pipes

dos:7919f5f0a7bccbc9.description: A Risk-influenced conquest game. You and your opponent take turns selecting countries on a map that is random, one of 19 predefined or made in the built-in editor, then build armies.
dos:7919f5f0a7bccbc9.title: Lords of Conquest

dos:791aeeef840ebcf3.description: A simplified pinball game for younger players with Britt Alcroft's train characters. Four tables are based loosely on Thomas, James, Percy and Toby, and up to 8 players can take part.
dos:791aeeef840ebcf3.title: Thomas the Tank Engine and Friends Pinball

dos:791c0a97927f24c7.description: A single-player version of Yahtzee: roll the dice and pick where you want the numbers to go, with primitive voice synthesis.
dos:791c0a97927f24c7.title: Easy-Play Yaht-Z

dos:791df843d5de83eb.description: A 2.5D game with no enemies. Wander a submerged space station finding and turning pumps and valves to stop the level flooding, within a time limit.
dos:791df843d5de83eb.title: Space Plumber

dos:791f516e11d5a169.description: A strategy board game on an eight-by-eight board of numbered squares. Collect points while limiting your opponent's options, one player moving horizontally and the other vertically.
dos:791f516e11d5a169.title: Blue Angel 69

dos:79209e53e47ad6aa.description: A classic jigsaw puzzle where you lay down an image, such as a landscape, object, vehicle or the series' bear mascot, from scattered fragments.
dos:79209e53e47ad6aa.title: Gaminours and the Puzzle

dos:79243d0958d812a0.description: An enhanced version of The Civil War with better AI and graphics. Pick a side, then one of eight historical battles or the whole campaign from 1861 to 1864.
dos:79243d0958d812a0.title: The Civil War: Master Players Edition

dos:792b9050e35abe9b.description: A small but very hard Spanish arcade action game with no apparent plot. You are a knight wading through a dark dungeon full of traps and enemies and, it seems, without any weapons.
dos:792b9050e35abe9b.title: Death Tower

dos:7933375db42d9a6e.description: A Tetris variant where you stack words instead of bricks. Choose the correct spelling from options at the bottom of the screen using the left or right cursor.
dos:7933375db42d9a6e.title: IQ Master

dos:79351d41eaec210f.description: Five years after Maniac Mansion, Purple Tentacle drinks toxic sludge from Dr. Fred's laboratory, grows flipper-like arms and a vastly increased intelligence, and develops a thirst for global domination.
dos:79351d41eaec210f.title: Maniac Mansion: Day of the Tentacle

dos:79411b5a14254d56.description: A mouse-driven version of Sudoku in 320x200 graphics, written as a 16-bit application with 8086-compatible instructions.
dos:79411b5a14254d56.title: Sudoku86

dos:7943b872b0d4a0b3.description: A Risk-type game of global conquest with nuclear weapons and real-time action. Click countries and invade to expand your empire, with a Cold War setup or random starting countries.
dos:7943b872b0d4a0b3.title: The Final Conflict

dos:794eab4f06c0e40b.description: The sequel to Luigi & Spaghetti, an unofficial game that is basically a level modification of its predecessor, this time without Spaghetti's help.
dos:794eab4f06c0e40b.title: Luigi en Circusland

dos:7954c6319f3654e9.description: A text adventure in which you are a spy who has to recover the Secret Formula, with a very fussy parser.
dos:7954c6319f3654e9.title: Intercept

dos:795e20fc695e55d2.description: You are an explorer investigating the burning of the Amazon Rain Forest. Natives tell of menacing ants as large as wolves, and you ask one to lead you to a large ant hill.
dos:795e20fc695e55d2.title: Anthill Volume 2

dos:795f4aebf8776610.description: A World War I flight simulator with 28 aircraft from both the Allied and German sides in 3D graphics. Start a career as a pilot and rise through the ranks to become the most feared ace.
dos:795f4aebf8776610.title: Red Baron

dos:7960d580fe0f4ad1.description: A billiards game with eighteen selectable settings across the top of the screen: eight for side/English, follow and draw and nine for vector/point selection.
dos:7960d580fe0f4ad1.title: 1994Pool+

dos:79617d7445581f4c.description: A matching puzzle where you must make chains of three identical pictures. Cards on a 7x7 field are face down, each with several patterns that cycle.
dos:79617d7445581f4c.title: Three Fold

dos:796b3ef5f75873a9.description: A point-and-click adventure based on the Spielberg movies. Fievel Mousekwitz, a young Russian mouse emigrating to America, is tossed overboard in a storm at sea.
dos:796b3ef5f75873a9.title: An American Tail: Fievel Goes West

dos:79771746003bdab1.description: A classic artillery game taken further with equipment production, repairs and high-resolution graphics.
dos:79771746003bdab1.title: Pro Artillery

dos:797c5bbb077412be.description: A pinball game with two tables, Rocket and Graveyard, derived from the Amiga game Pinball Dreams by Digital Illusions. It supports up to 8 players.
dos:797c5bbb077412be.title: Pinball 2000

dos:7983ddac01a2c5c1.description: The follow-up to The Web, with a single complex table in 3D with 4 viewpoints. The goal is to travel through time by collecting crystals across Roman, Prehistoric, Futuristic and present-day settings.
dos:7983ddac01a2c5c1.title: Pro Pinball: Timeshock!

dos:7987d382aab39b01.description: A puzzle game in which you build streams of light from a laser to a target on a field of cells, using mirrors and other elements.
dos:7987d382aab39b01.title: Labyrinth of Light

dos:798c9ae03fe1ce8e.description: A version of Pac-Man created with Sierra's SCI adventure game engine.
dos:798c9ae03fe1ce8e.title: SCI-Man

dos:798d8b85ad96b3cb.description: A wolf simulator. Take the role of a wolf in a mission, such as surviving for a day, or in a simulation mode, with all aspects of wolf life simulated, from hunting to avoiding hunters.
dos:798d8b85ad96b3cb.title: Wolf

dos:798f710fa97cdbca.description: An unusual football management game with virtually no statistics. Up to four managers lead their teams through the World Cup, from qualifying to the tournament, where tactics and training matter hugely.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:798f710fa97cdbca.title: On the Ball: World Cup Edition

dos:79a2e175b1e7474f.description: A small Lemmings clone with a twist: you must kill the Lamers instead of saving them, to stop them reaching the computer and destroying it. Weapons include a handgun, machine gun and bombs.
dos:79a2e175b1e7474f.title: Lamers

dos:79a83b2c7ca8d471.description: Steg the slug must feed his family of T'yungunz by blowing bubbles to catch grubs and guiding them past obstacles to the nest. Get a certain number of T'yungunz fed to complete each level.
dos:79a83b2c7ca8d471.title: Steg the Slug

dos:79ac137f6e491151.description: An adventure based on the French comic series by Francois Bourgeon. As the French Revolution approaches, Hoel and Isa find themselves in Brittany and face a thousand dangers from European to African shores.
dos:79ac137f6e491151.title: Passengers on the Wind

dos:79bb016534a6ddb9.description: In 3045 A.D., as Captain Timebound you use the world's first time machine to see dinosaurs, starting 150 million years B.C., and bring back first-hand information.
dos:79bb016534a6ddb9.title: Dyno-Quest

dos:79bd2c5e3cf55767.description: Based on the movie, terrorists have taken control of a high rise tower to steal $600 million. Rescue your trapped wife and stop them, searching the building for useful items from a 3D point of view.
dos:79bd2c5e3cf55767.title: Die Hard

dos:79c0b33ec6bbca88.description: A text adventure at an abandoned ski resort, SnoFlake, where you play a lost camper trying to find his way home.
dos:79c0b33ec6bbca88.title: Ski Adventure

dos:79c1881414a562e4.description: Guide your floppy disk through a maze, avoiding dust and magnets.
dos:79c1881414a562e4.title: Floppy Frenzy

dos:79c4394f9ee632fe.description: A 2D versus fighting game with cartoon graphics. Seven characters have standard and special attacks, with a tournament mode, single fights against the AI and a two-player mode.
dos:79c4394f9ee632fe.title: Antagony

dos:79c9abb59376a242.description: Koei's fantasy strategy game. Six magicians, each trapped inside a gem, are freed from the crown Gemfire by Princess Robyn, daughter of King Eselred, the tyrannical ruler of Ishmeria.
dos:79c9abb59376a242.title: Gemfire

dos:79d2ab184899e67e.description: A horror graphic adventure with a fully explorable 3D environment, animation and ellipsoid-based graphics, in which you try to free Ecstatica.
dos:79d2ab184899e67e.title: Ecstatica

dos:79de6939519b557e.description: A wargame of the Battle of Stalingrad. Command the Soviet or German forces; historically the Soviets won at great cost, but you can try to change the outcome.
dos:79de6939519b557e.title: Stalingrad

dos:79ded09890f59ba9.description: Oxyd magnum! Gold contains an extra 20 levels not originally published with Oxyd magnum!
dos:79ded09890f59ba9.title: Oxyd magnum! Gold

dos:79f05b1103fdbe32.description: A freeware 3D Bomberman. Run through a 3D maze laying time-delayed bombs to blow up the other Bomberman, scoring a point each time.
dos:79f05b1103fdbe32.title: 3D Bomber

dos:7a0553805070e491.description: A strategy BBS door game written by Amit Patel in 1990, started as a PC clone of the Atari ST game Space Empire Elite.
dos:7a0553805070e491.title: Solar Realms Elite

dos:7a05b92986470ccc.description: The third of Questprobe's Marvel Comics text adventures with graphics. Play the Thing and the Human Torch, switching between them at any time, to free Alicia Masters from Doctor Doom.
dos:7a05b92986470ccc.title: Questprobe featuring Human Torch and the Thing

dos:7a10962970e86beb.description: A set of circus games: flying on a trapeze, walking a rope with tricks, controlling a trained tiger through an obstacle marathon, and doing tricks on the back of a frantic horse.
dos:7a10962970e86beb.title: Circus Games (1989)

dos:7a1d41a62e158369.description: A complex game in which you create your own ecosystems, animals or plants, then watch them eat, evolve, mate or die. You can even edit their DNA.
dos:7a1d41a62e158369.title: SimLife

dos:7a21a5e9b4c5f542.description: Six small educational games starring Freddy the Frog, with simple controls. In Adding, Freddy faces a network of lily pads, and he must move to various important buildings on screen.
dos:7a21a5e9b4c5f542.title: Fun School 3: for 5 to 7 Year Olds

dos:7a226c8f0053db24.description: A first-person 3D shooter in which you escape an underground labyrinth full of monsters while trying to rescue your dog Sparky, similar to Wolfenstein 3D.
dos:7a226c8f0053db24.title: Ken's Labyrinth

dos:7a45fccc4293106c.description: Returning from R&R in Saigon, your helicopter is forced down by Viet Cong guerillas in the Central Highlands, and you must lead the survivors to the nearest US base.
dos:7a45fccc4293106c.title: Lost Patrol

dos:7a4dc5f83c312374.description: A tank simulation based on Harold Coyle's bestseller. As Commander Sean Bannon you lead Team Yankee in tanks such as the Abrams M1, Bradley M2, T-72 and T-62.
dos:7a4dc5f83c312374.title: Team Yankee

dos:7a5d162c774ec572.description: In the ninth century of the Second Era, Cyrus, a Redguard mercenary and hero, finds that his sister Iszara has disappeared under mysterious circumstances in Hammerfell.
dos:7a5d162c774ec572.title: The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard

dos:7a61bb0c87bc6681.description: You land your crippled ship at the deserted Atargis mining station and must enter it to find a way off the asteroid, wondering what happened to the 200 personnel in the mines below.
dos:7a61bb0c87bc6681.title: Xenomorph

dos:7a785ddb9fb613cb.description: The fourth Might and Magic RPG. Control a party of 6 heroes to save the world from the evil Lord Xeen, with nearly the same interface and graphics as Isles of Terra.
dos:7a785ddb9fb613cb.title: Might and Magic IV: Clouds of Xeen

dos:7a787490745e84ff.description: A top-down shooter in which you fly a megadestroyer against heavily armed space platforms, shooting enemies, turrets and command centers. You have three lives.
dos:7a787490745e84ff.title: MegaDestroyer Frantis

dos:7a79ba7a16ea50d6.description: Collect all the fast food on screen, meaning food that is moving fast, while avoiding monsters. There are 30 levels of increasing difficulty.
dos:7a79ba7a16ea50d6.title: Fast Food

dos:7a7c9b3cd2ebb43a.description: A Korean brawler in which two anthropomorphic animals return to their rural house to find it invaded by enemies. Play Pee, Gity or both in two-player mode.
