dos:7a7c9b3cd2ebb43a.title: Pee & Gity

dos:7a7f0f237ed24e19.description: A platform game based on the arcade game Space Panic. A digger with a shovel kills evil legged apples, walking left and right and climbing ladders, with no jumping.
dos:7a7f0f237ed24e19.title: Apple Panic

dos:7a89caf385293f38.description: A pinball game with a dinosaur theme.
dos:7a89caf385293f38.title: Time Hunters Pinball

dos:7a95360e04cd6a98.description: The third Ishar game, where characters can be imported from Ishar or Ishar 2. Travel through Portals of Time in pursuit of the dragon of Sith to protect the Citadel.
dos:7a95360e04cd6a98.title: Ishar 3: The Seven Gates of Infinity

dos:7a988513eb6871b7.description: A two-player chess variant with laser weaponry. The goal is to defeat the opponent's king, and you can move and rotate all the pieces; there are eight types of pieces.
dos:7a988513eb6871b7.title: Laser Chess (1987)

dos:7aaf3f3fc2c22bed.description: A sidescrolling game in which you collect coins or buttons for points, with a multiplayer mode and a level editor.
dos:7aaf3f3fc2c22bed.title: The Pack Rat

dos:7abb6a24722d3bda.description: A submarine simulation as part of the US Navy Silent Service after Pearl Harbor. Take a fleet boat on patrols of up to 2 months from Hawaii, Australia or New Zealand.
dos:7abb6a24722d3bda.title: Silent Service

dos:7ac1cf9540293628.description: A Spanish Pac-Man clone with different levels, ghosts eaten during the bonus placed differently at each rebirth, and a built-in level editor.
dos:7ac1cf9540293628.title: Luxman

dos:7ac97c6ce18f1f7c.description: A text-mode action game: guide a character through seven rooms, collect gold and bring it back to the start. Each room is populated by robots.
dos:7ac97c6ce18f1f7c.title: Game of Robot

dos:7acd761b7ee77f60.description: A sci-fi rail shooter like the Rebel Assault series with missions of ship-to-ship combat, mechanised warrior battles, planetary warfare and tail-gunning, and a story with live-action video.
dos:7acd761b7ee77f60.title: The Raven Project

dos:7ad7f428878541cb.description: The multimedia version of Battle Chess in which the pieces come to life, each with different animations for capturing and being captured.
dos:7ad7f428878541cb.title: Battle Chess: Enhanced CD-ROM

dos:7adaa397ca87ae90.description: A package of two card games, Gin and Cribbage, and two board games, Checkers and Backgammon. Gin and Cribbage have personality-based AI advisors and opponents.
tags: Board Game / Backgammon; Board Game / Checkers & Draughts; Casino
dos:7adaa397ca87ae90.title: The Games People Play: Gin ∙ Cribbage ∙ Checkers ∙ Backgammon

dos:7adb352f360a59d5.description: An isometric puzzle game in which you save comrades imprisoned in a dungeon, moving your character through each screen past guards.
dos:7adb352f360a59d5.title: Sadko

dos:7adcd654e431fbaf.description: A five card draw poker game, originally a BBS door game in which players tried to post a high score in money earned.
dos:7adcd654e431fbaf.title: Five Card Draw Poker

dos:7adec47bd4b79b39.description: A modern take on Cabal gameplay across five locations: 1896 China, a 1966 air force base, 2006 London streets, 2106 hangar with cyborgs and 2207 spiders and bats.
dos:7adec47bd4b79b39.title: Time Circle

dos:7aee0e30709beed1.description: All the characters from the first three Mortal Kombat games return, including Kano, Reptile, Mileena, Kung Lao, Shang Tsung, Sindel, Sub-Zero and Scorpion, for the ultimate battle.
dos:7aee0e30709beed1.title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy

dos:7aee8586c59b4ac6.description: A scrolling shooter: kill anything that moves or fires at you and avoid rocks and stationary objects, most of which kill you on impact.
dos:7aee8586c59b4ac6.title: Flux (1995)

dos:7af5cd7f855c4c47.description: A guess-who board game in which the computer picks a character and you use hints such as hair color, sex and eye color to work out who it is.
dos:7af5cd7f855c4c47.title: ¿Quien es Cualo?

dos:7af66499744d41a1.description: A platformer in which Bart Simpson must stop the Space Mutants from invading Springfield. On each of five levels he collects or gets rid of the ingredients they want for their machine.
dos:7af66499744d41a1.title: The Simpsons: Bart vs. the Space Mutants

dos:7af6f9e929584b3e.description: Kill endless waves of aliens by flying around the screen with a rocket pack and shooting them with a machine gun.
dos:7af6f9e929584b3e.title: Alien Worlds

dos:7b0e849c2c6b9ad4.description: A shareware Wheel of Fortune game for one to six players based on the TV game, with between three and six rounds plus a bonus round.
dos:7b0e849c2c6b9ad4.title: Tommy's Wheel of Misfortune

dos:7b11a6ccd2da0954.description: Transformable Arcade Zone, a Breakout clone with multiple paddles, 64 levels and a built-in level construction set. Each level has a different paddle layout.
dos:7b11a6ccd2da0954.title: TRAZ

dos:7b200f55f89083b2.description: A World War II submarine simulation set in the South Pacific. Destroy Japanese convoys in practice, campaign and historical modes.
dos:7b200f55f89083b2.title: Up Periscope!

dos:7b235e4d2345f0b1.description: You are a silencer, an elite soldier of the World Economic Consortium sent to hunt down the Resistance, but you slowly realize the WEC is not what it appears to be.
dos:7b235e4d2345f0b1.title: Crusader: No Remorse

dos:7b26d3f76f3f2e05.description: The sequel to Heretic. Three humans who escaped the slaughter by the Serpent Riders seek vengeance on Korax, the Serpent Rider who remains in their world.
dos:7b26d3f76f3f2e05.title: Hexen: Beyond Heretic

dos:7b3171893d3e93d8.description: A 2D post-apocalyptic RPG set after the Great Apocalypse, several months after the Day Time Stopped. You can't last much longer on your supplies.
dos:7b3171893d3e93d8.title: Visions of Aftermath: The Boomtown

dos:7b33d2a98f24f56e.description: Recover the Golden Baton, a priceless artifact that maintains the balance between good and evil, stolen from King Ferrenuil's palace, which has caused drought and pestilence.
dos:7b33d2a98f24f56e.title: Mysterious Adventure No. 1: The Golden Baton

dos:7b3476766f3ea57e.description: The sixth Commander Keen game. Molly, the babysitter of eight-year-old genius Billy Blaze, has been kidnapped by the Bloogs of Fribbulus Xax, and Keen sets off to rescue her.
dos:7b3476766f3ea57e.title: Commander Keen 6: Aliens Ate My Baby Sitter!

dos:7b43c00972797680.description: Quasimodo, the Hunchback of Notre Dame, runs an obstacle course dodging fireballs and arrows and leaping over pits and pikemen to rescue his beloved Esmeralda.
dos:7b43c00972797680.title: Hunchback

dos:7b4495509edecc41.description: An arcade racing game with shooter elements. Choose a Speed Boat or Dune Buggy and race viewed from behind, with a multiplayer mode.
dos:7b4495509edecc41.title: SpeedRage

dos:7b44aac723568b9b.description: A shareware Missile Command-style game. Protect the cities along the bottom of the screen with two missile sites against successive waves of incoming warheads.
dos:7b44aac723568b9b.title: Patriot Command

dos:7b4acdc0349674c7.description: Make your way from chamber to chamber of an ancient pyramid, uncovering treasures, avoiding traps and facing various enemies to escape.
dos:7b4acdc0349674c7.title: Lost Tomb

dos:7b5563729ce1cf6f.description: A sports game in which the races of the fantasy world of GHoLD meet for the Grand Monster Slam every five years. You must win 9 matches and negotiate two sub-games.
dos:7b5563729ce1cf6f.title: Grand Monster Slam

dos:7b5963f180ef3828.description: An educational title with three separate modules for young children: Colors, Music and Puzzles, featuring the Berenstain Bears.
dos:7b5963f180ef3828.title: The Berenstain Bears: Learning Essentials

dos:7b667a71b139e075.description: A graphic adventure with a key-based verb interface. A set of jewels and the curator guarding them have been stolen, with Norman Bates the suspect, and a detective drives out to the Bates Motel.
dos:7b667a71b139e075.title: Psycho

dos:7b6c813d601a65d7.description: A compilation of F-15 Strike Eagle II and the Operation Desert Storm scenario disk, with campaigns in Libya, the Persian Gulf, the Middle East and Vietnam in which you destroy primary and secondary targets.
dos:7b6c813d601a65d7.title: F-15 Strike Eagle II (Deluxe Edition)

dos:7b7462075ab1b673.description: A power boat racing game against four AI opponents. Manage the engines to avoid overheating, adjust trim as you go, and sometimes stop for repairs.
dos:7b7462075ab1b673.title: Heat Wave: Offshore Superboat Racing

dos:7b7f5c5d755778ba.description: A shareware submarine strategy game with character graphics. Your sub sits in the center of a grid map while a big convoy of ships, submarines and anti-submarine helicopters passes left to right.
dos:7b7f5c5d755778ba.title: Tommy's Seawolf

dos:7b8a1957ec7ab13f.description: Picking up right after Manhunter: New York, you crash-land your stolen ship in San Francisco after chasing the enigmatic serial killer Phil, take on the identity of a local Manhunter and solve more crimes.
dos:7b8a1957ec7ab13f.title: Manhunter 2: San Francisco

dos:7b928a299e4e4a98.description: A licensed Liverpool FC football game from Arc Developments, with a third-person 3D view similar to Striker.
dos:7b928a299e4e4a98.title: Liverpool: The Computer Game

dos:7b982345b6d165bc.description: The first Blake Stone game, in which a British secret agent faces Dr. Pyrus Goldfire, a madman planning to unleash a mutant army upon Earth using genetic engineering.
dos:7b982345b6d165bc.title: Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold

dos:7b9d2806ffce20a5.description: The game show for one to three players in which you give answers in the form of a question.
dos:7b9d2806ffce20a5.title: Jeopardy! 25th Anniversary Edition

dos:7ba30baa635e3739.description: A shareware strategy game similar to Reversi. Players start with counters on the corners of a 7x7 grid and move pieces to any adjacent square to duplicate them.
dos:7ba30baa635e3739.title: Dots

dos:7ba8787eef6aba38.description: The sequel to Spellcasting 101. Young Ernie Eaglebeak is a sorcerer's apprentice in what turns out to be a training simulation in his sophomore days at the Sorcerer University.
dos:7ba8787eef6aba38.title: Spellcasting 201: The Sorcerer's Appliance

dos:7bbc15d9be7d816f.description: An educational title about volcanoes: their formation and classification, the geology and physics of eruptions, and their impact on people. Information comes in animated slideshows divided into chapters.
dos:7bbc15d9be7d816f.title: Volcanoes

dos:7bc8028853f4723b.description: A Soleau Software word game in which you spell as many words as you can from the letters of a master word, checked against a dictionary of over 80,000 words, with up to 8 personal scorecards.
dos:7bc8028853f4723b.title: WordMax

dos:7bcee11f0ae89d98.description: A standard fighting game based on great martial arts masters.
dos:7bcee11f0ae89d98.title: Jinyong Fighter

dos:7bd2d7669e2d119b.description: The DOS version of the arcade classic Bomb Jack, released in 2002 by an unknown author.
dos:7bd2d7669e2d119b.title: Bomb Jack

dos:7bd914bb0954f988.description: A first-person adventure using live actors and video, with a Myst-like interface. Rotate the viewpoint to find items and talk to characters through a dialog system.
dos:7bd914bb0954f988.title: Return to Zork

dos:7bdfe4c6654c66fa.description: A tactical wargame set in World War II on the Eastern Front. Play the German or Soviet side, with armored vehicles, various ammunition types, artillery, infantry and engineers.
dos:7bdfe4c6654c66fa.title: Tigers on the Prowl

dos:7be3d628f796ed2c.description: Asteroids in a 3D space viewed from the cockpit, like Wing Commander. Destroy a quota of asteroids on each level before moving on, rotating in 720 directions, thrusting and firing.
dos:7be3d628f796ed2c.title: Outer Ridge

dos:7beaa0918008ed5f.description: A pipe-laying style puzzle in which you lay paths that a bomb follows. Gather all the fruit on the field, then make your CPU opponent explode against a wall or barrier.
dos:7beaa0918008ed5f.title: Loopy

dos:7bf0256aff45ed97.description: It is 1986 and you play the US President or the Soviet General Secretary, commanding industry, covert forces and military might to make your country the world's most powerful over eight years.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation / Political; Strategy
dos:7bf0256aff45ed97.title: Balance of Power

dos:7bf2cdbe73e8cba1.description: A 2000 remake in 256 colors of the Spanish adventure based on Umberto Eco's The Name of the Rose, in which William of Baskerville and his disciple Adso investigate an abbey.
dos:7bf2cdbe73e8cba1.title: La Abadía del Crimen (Remake)

dos:7bf44b8a8a9c4cf1.description: A first-person shooter set in paintball matches.
dos:7bf44b8a8a9c4cf1.title: Extreme Paintbrawl

dos:7bfb731c294462fb.description: Elite soldiers Hank Guts Carter and Stacy Garters Pringle are sent to stop General Wort and his minions. Played like Cabal, you control Guts or Garters by keyboard and mouse across static screens.
dos:7bfb731c294462fb.title: Guts 'n' Garters in DNA Danger

dos:7c0fa66b5a8b918b.description: A tactical simulation of World War II land combat with men and weapons from the United States, Germany and Russia. Nine scenarios range from open field firefights to house to house conflict.
dos:7c0fa66b5a8b918b.title: Under Fire

dos:7c1b0c6a77a3cd62.description: One of the first realistic cricket games, with test and one-day matches and a choice of 8 teams. You set your field, bowlers and batsmen, with commentary and video options.
dos:7c1b0c6a77a3cd62.title: Cricket 96

dos:7c1ba52abdbbb4b5.description: A German Tetris-like game with gameplay very similar to Xixit and Chain Reaction.
dos:7c1ba52abdbbb4b5.title: Geometrix 2.0

dos:7c2d0e329b58ece1.description: An educational game that teaches children about mammals and logic and language skills with 5 decoder alphabets: English, American Sign Language, Braille, Morse Code and Semaphore. You must locate and decode CYPHERGRAMS.
dos:7c2d0e329b58ece1.title: The Secret Codes of C.Y.P.H.E.R.: Operation Wildlife

dos:7c36a4bb8312bf3b.description: Help Rolling Ronny, an errand boy, rollerskate and shoot his way through nine levels of parkland, city streets, office complexes and sewers, collecting cash by running errands.
dos:7c36a4bb8312bf3b.title: Rolling Ronny

dos:7c421632de3bb156.description: A quiz game in which the computer asks questions on US capitals and French words.
dos:7c421632de3bb156.title: Evidences

dos:7c4c1d6936e4877b.description: A German adventure set in an alternative history in which Caesar conquered the world and you live in the 20th-century Roman Empire.
dos:7c4c1d6936e4877b.title: Imperium Romanum

dos:7c52fa704829860e.description: A Japanese platform shooter with many levels and enemies of rising difficulty. You pilot a robot that can switch from a mech into a jet at any time and has an auto-aiming weapon that uses rechargeable energy.
dos:7c52fa704829860e.title: Thexder

dos:7c6719643487db14.description: The evil sorcerer Suzar and his mutated army have defeated the warriors of the land of Anar. You, the only escapee, are brought to King Darius and set out following ancient legends.
dos:7c6719643487db14.title: Legend of the Sword

dos:7c6b50f4f3b9d6c7.description: A Mahjong tile-matching game in which tiles are matched by line of sight and proximity, rewarding you with images of Chinese women.
dos:7c6b50f4f3b9d6c7.title: SaChun

dos:7c6f8df459a5620f.description: A short EGA game that helps children estimate which of two zoo animals is bigger or smaller by pressing 1 or 2, with feedback after each of 10 screens.
dos:7c6f8df459a5620f.title: How to Weigh an Elephant

dos:7c835ed97a62fe58.description: A simple computer version of the card game Durak.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Casino; Strategy
dos:7c835ed97a62fe58.title: Durak

dos:7c852af9ad296bc9.description: A 2D turn-based strategy game like the Panzer General series that covers all the major battles of the September Campaign against Poland in 1939, with original historical sounds.
dos:7c852af9ad296bc9.title: Fall Weiss 1939

dos:7c978ff17b26ac39.description: Based on the original Paratrooper, with new features such as a 2-player mode and new graphics and sounds.
dos:7c978ff17b26ac39.title: Paratrooper II

dos:7c9b4fcb982fe665.description: A big adventure in the tradition of Colossal Cave and Zork with several hundred locations and heavy emphasis on treasure-hunting and exploration, set in a more coherent world.
dos:7c9b4fcb982fe665.title: World

dos:7ca28c92df9048ec.description: A kid's game in which you guide a hamster through a maze, eating enough fruit to advance. Beware giant mice, which you can kick or hit with strawberry bombs.
dos:7ca28c92df9048ec.title: 3D Hamster's Adventure

dos:7ca5e80128d87917.description: A party game similar to Scruples where you digitize thoughts, compare them with others and play out various roles.
dos:7ca5e80128d87917.title: Timothy Leary's Mind Mirror

dos:7cc10500f5099574.description: Europe suffers the same bio-war as in Roadwar 2000. Terrorists have destroyed one city, and your gang must locate and disarm their bio-bombs and destroy their headquarters.
dos:7cc10500f5099574.title: Roadwar Europa

dos:7cc18c77d2df8543.description: A caravan of adventurers heads toward Accardi-By-The-Sea, each with their own motivation: the magician Frobwit, the lovely Acia, the merchant Gurthark and the scout.
dos:7cc18c77d2df8543.title: Zork Quest: The Crystal of Doom

dos:7cc43e24619bfe32.description: The sequel to The Legend of Kyrandia, in which you play the young sorceress Zanthia. Kyrandia is disappearing and the high council's cure is the anchor from the center of the world.
dos:7cc43e24619bfe32.title: The Legend of Kyrandia: Book Two - The Hand of Fate

dos:7cc7e850b7319295.description: An early tennis game with quarter-final, semi-final or final matches of 3 or 5 sets, where winning moves you on to the next.
dos:7cc7e850b7319295.title: Tournament Tennis

dos:7ccab2d3b30742c8.description: A complete text adventure written by an author learning to program in Borland C, the only game of the RoachCrunch exercise series.
dos:7ccab2d3b30742c8.title: Chesterland Adventure

dos:7cd8448e8e046212.description: An SSI sci-fi RPG designed by Phantasie designer Winston Douglas Wood, with a huge universe, detailed character generation, exotic aliens and tactical space and squad-level combat.
dos:7cd8448e8e046212.title: Star Command

dos:7cf4e6868cff3a9d.description: An enhanced remake of Tetris: control the position and rotation of falling blocks and clear lines before the play area floods.
dos:7cf4e6868cff3a9d.title: Tetris Classic

dos:7cf57391effba206.description: After crashing your plane at sea you drift to a small island that was once inhabited. A text adventure in the Infocom mold: why did the people leave, and why is there a fence around the white house?
dos:7cf57391effba206.title: Tristam Island

dos:7cfadfb5a0fbbb38.description: In 2147 the first colony ship is launched toward the asteroid Theta-2, but the second vessel with the colonists meets a terrifying disturbance in space. A first-person shooter and flight game.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Flight Simulator; Vehicle Simulation
dos:7cfadfb5a0fbbb38.title: Radix: Beyond the Void

dos:7d0ac6252a98d858.description: A boxing game with dozens of boxers rated on attributes like Power, Defence and Punishment. Play a single match or an entire championship, with an announcer introducing each bout.
dos:7d0ac6252a98d858.title: 3D World Boxing

dos:7d0b21aa69a34d63.description: An arcade game in the tradition of Beetlejuice in which you go around a building shooting gremlins and collecting items, with an alarm system, two weapons and various scenery.
dos:7d0b21aa69a34d63.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch (1991)

dos:7d1553b0ac50ce64.description: A conversion of Avalon Hill's 1965 board game Blitzkrieg, set in the Battle of the Bulge. A turn-based strategic wargame on a hexagonal map.
dos:7d1553b0ac50ce64.title: Blitzkrieg: Battle at the Ardennes

dos:7d266a45cbefbcdc.description: An odd Korean bowling game whose name translates to Burst of Laughter, from the developers of the Sango Fighter series, with an unusual cast of playable celebrities.
dos:7d266a45cbefbcdc.title: Pokso Bowling

dos:7d2f6ec8f8412047.description: A Tetris-style puzzle game. Symbols are arranged in columns on screen, and you move them to make columns of identical symbols, which then disappear.
dos:7d2f6ec8f8412047.title: Pick 'n Pile

dos:7d31a627f8c708fe.description: The sequel to Hoyle's Book of Games, made up entirely of solitaire games in many different versions.
dos:7d31a627f8c708fe.title: Hoyle Official Book of Games: Volume 2

dos:7d34105f110729f2.description: You are a freedom fighter storming the tower of your country's dictator, defended by robots with genetic parts. A platform shooter across three episodes with EGA graphics: shoot robots, get keys and move on.
dos:7d34105f110729f2.title: RoboMaze II

dos:7d3b2619ae5f005d.description: An Electric Crayon coloring book with 30 Inspector Gadget illustrations carrying safety education messages, with 16 on-screen colors and a mix option.
dos:7d3b2619ae5f005d.title: Inspector Gadget: Mission 1 – Global Terror!

dos:7d42720e03409b4b.description: In a medieval fantasy world a strange substance is causing addiction among the population, and it all seems to come from one point controlled by a mysterious stranger. Lead a group of heroes to trace it.
dos:7d42720e03409b4b.title: Spirit of Adventure

dos:7d4cd7caa762d329.description: An edutainment product for creating 3D models of any structure: homes, office buildings, theaters, shops and schools, from scratch or from provided templates.
dos:7d4cd7caa762d329.title: Hometown, U.S.A.

dos:7d53c7b17376413f.description: An MSX version of The Goonies with different levels and enemies than the Famicom game. You play Sloth and must rescue seven Goonies per stage.
dos:7d53c7b17376413f.title: The Goonies

dos:7d53e2add1279890.description: An educational game in which A.J. invites kids to numerous mini-games, including an Arkanoid clone and a funny face maker where you can change facial features or generate a face at random.
dos:7d53e2add1279890.title: A.J.'s World of Discovery

dos:7d5df04bb7780eb4.description: A shareware maze game in which barriers across the play area form the maze, and you navigate your marker to the exit point.
dos:7d5df04bb7780eb4.title: Amazing

dos:7d63878db14f22e8.description: A side-scrolling shooter for 1 or 2 players. Even on easy mode things get hectic, and levels appear to be procedurally generated.
dos:7d63878db14f22e8.title: Marrs

dos:7d64dbd77a4c6f92.description: A turn-based Scorched Earth-style artillery game in 3D. Choose a weapon, bearing, power and height, and fire; the last player alive wins.
dos:7d64dbd77a4c6f92.title: Genocide

dos:7d679d042d11cf39.description: A one-on-one future sport combining ideas from real-world competitions, notably netball. The isometric action has you move a droid and score goals.
dos:7d679d042d11cf39.title: Vectorball

dos:7d7180aa58ed06a0.description: Virtual Reality Studio with enhancements: double the controls and commands, plus transparent and fading objects and rounded objects like flexicubes and spheres.
dos:7d7180aa58ed06a0.title: Virtual Reality Studio 2.0

dos:7d77682c5c7dbc06.description: A short platformer programmed for MS-DOS in C, a real-time game rather than a turn-based puzzle like the author's previous DOS game.
dos:7d77682c5c7dbc06.title: Plumber No More

dos:7d777fbfa8873d6a.description: A stock market simulation. Start with a net worth of $10,000 on the US market with companies from Computer, Oil & Gas, Retail Sales, Auto and Heavy Industries, whose stock prices change each week.
dos:7d777fbfa8873d6a.title: Millionaire: The Stock Market Simulation

dos:7d83bbec01932d8f.description: A fan-made VGA remake of the original King's Quest using the Adventure Game Studio engine, with upgraded graphics, a point and click interface and optional voices and MP3 music.
dos:7d83bbec01932d8f.title: King's Quest I: Quest for the Crown (2001 Remake)

dos:7d8671cf46993319.description: A kids' package with an unusual Paint program and accessories, funny coloring pictures, mini-games like a labyrinth, a space journey and an identikit, and a melody synthesizer.
dos:7d8671cf46993319.title: Fun 'N Games Deluxe

dos:7d8fdf6380bdcd73.description: The computer adventure based on Tolkien's book. As Bilbo, the reluctant hobbit, you set out on a journey with Gandalf and the dwarves.
dos:7d8fdf6380bdcd73.title: The Hobbit

dos:7da1eaf25fd15df4.description: A football game with every team of the 1996 NFL season, real player numbers and stats, 32 offensive plays and 16 defensive plays. Choose quarter lengths from one to 15 minutes and Preseason or Playoff modes.
dos:7da1eaf25fd15df4.title: NFL Quarterback Club 96

dos:7da793bc7eac72d7.description: A PC conversion of the 1984 game. Doomdark's forces aim to take control of the 4000 screens of the land of Midnight, and your party of four includes Luxor the Moonprince, Morkin, Corleth the Fey and Rothron the Wise.
dos:7da793bc7eac72d7.title: The Lords of Midnight

dos:7dad1cf9ca689ef7.description: A platformer in which a coyote runs through various worlds, throwing ice cubes that freeze birds and penguins so you can smash them.
dos:7dad1cf9ca689ef7.title: Fire & Ice: The Daring Adventures of Cool Coyote

dos:7db369d8adf5138c.description: Lord Dhelt of Elturel is attacked in his castle and an assassin steals the Holy Symbol of Helm. You kill the assassin and retrieve the amulet, but are teleported to an unknown area.
dos:7db369d8adf5138c.title: Ravenloft: Strahd's Possession

dos:7dc342af59ab0189.description: A text-based BBS door RPG set on the continent of Ashrella in the world of Daagrung, a peaceful land until unknown creatures came to destroy crops and kill.
dos:7dc342af59ab0189.title: The Enigma of Ashrella

dos:7dc3b96103d12924.description: A collection of six card games: hearts, spades, bridge, cribbage, gin rummy and pinochle, limited to two players.
dos:7dc3b96103d12924.title: House of Cards

dos:7dd80bcc420b59d7.description: A 4X space game like Master of Orion in which you play one of many races with special abilities and traits, exploring space, building colonies with individual purposes and fighting battles.
dos:7dd80bcc420b59d7.title: Ascendancy

dos:7dd8494689fdc283.description: Fly the futuristic helicopter Vulture into battle against enemies with multiple weapons across enormous levels, with dual player mode and four-way parallax scrolling.
dos:7dd8494689fdc283.title: Operation Vulture III: Cyber Chopper

dos:7dd94c4dfac61e2d.description: An RPG based on the classic Korean novel Tale of Hong Gildong, in which the title character, an illegitimate child, becomes a bandit who steals from the rich and gives to the poor.
dos:7dd94c4dfac61e2d.title: Hong Gildong-jeon

dos:7ddd7a984782be3f.description: A bizarre sumo fighting game among members of the Glootz race on the planet Musculia, in which radioactive wrestlers weighing several megatons fight on a concrete desert.
dos:7ddd7a984782be3f.title: The Fight of the Sumo-Hoppers

dos:7de3a3da5ccc4ac4.description: A simple CRPG probably inspired by Wizardry. Create a wizard or warrior in a text-only town, equip at the store and descend into the 8-level dungeon.
dos:7de3a3da5ccc4ac4.title: Swords of Glass

dos:7de411131d613b59.description: An on-rails shooter with light adventure elements, in which helicopter rescue pilot Ted Irvin, who has budding psychic powers, battles a strange cult called The Sect.
dos:7de411131d613b59.title: Hardline

dos:7dea06ae44a10899.description: In 1966, Marine Corps sergeant Alan The Bear Westmoreland is sent behind enemy lines during the Vietnam War in this first-person shooter.
dos:7dea06ae44a10899.title: NAM

dos:7e0348566fec9fd8.description: An unofficial port of Hopper, a Frogger clone. Lead your frog across a street with five lanes of traffic, then across the river by hopping onto logs.
dos:7e0348566fec9fd8.title: Hopper

dos:7e0bce979f5a8625.description: A hi-res 3D Tetris variant from Sweden with a Mandelbrot fractal as the background.
dos:7e0bce979f5a8625.title: Frac

dos:7e0f1595c469a318.description: A New Year 1993 game in which Santa Claus, flying at the bottom of the screen, throws wrenches from his sleigh at the rockets of two aliens above.

dos:7e0f86027ca1b961.description: A Qix game in which you guide a marker that draws rectangles to claim territory, fast or slow, with slow drawing earning the most points.
dos:7e0f86027ca1b961.title: QIX

dos:7e180d6048099ddf.description: A third-person shooter with RPG elements and an over-the-shoulder camera, in which you pick from six characters each level and move between levels on a map of China.
dos:7e180d6048099ddf.title: 3DHero

dos:7e262bf82bb4a6f4.description: A game of logic and deduction: use clues to eliminate possibilities and determine the locations of 36 blocks.
dos:7e262bf82bb4a6f4.title: Sherlock

dos:7e2a2caca4970d94.description: A basketball game emphasizing realism. Choose from all the NBA teams, create a team or pick an All-Star squad of the East or West, and customize created players.
dos:7e2a2caca4970d94.title: NBA Live 97

dos:7e3b8ec44cd66732.description: A demo promoting Oh No! More Lemmings, with two levels from that game and two new Christmas-themed levels with snowy landscapes, snowmen, festive lights and Lemmings dressed as Santa.
dos:7e3b8ec44cd66732.title: Xmas Lemmings 1991

dos:7e4761f123148535.description: The third and final part of the Eye of the Beholder trilogy. A man with a tale of a dangerous lich asks your party for help and teleports them to deal with it.
dos:7e4761f123148535.title: Myth

dos:7e595b230fe396dd.description: A whimsical shareware piece that doesn't explain itself, leaving you to decide if it's a game, a time filler or one of Tommy's joke programs.
dos:7e595b230fe396dd.title: Tommy's Wizards

dos:7e5961e9daa91f0d.description: A shareware cricket management game based on eight English county teams. Play an eight-week season of forty-over cricket with a three-round playoff.
dos:7e5961e9daa91f0d.title: Sticky Wicket

dos:7e6ca47c21774695.description: A strategy marble maze arcade game against the computer. Get your marbles to the bottom of a maze of ramps, walls and black holes, and block your opponent by pushing marbles into position.
dos:7e6ca47c21774695.title: Bolo Ball

dos:7e779ece54c961ee.description: The sequel to Mad Dog McCree from American Laser Games, with motion-captured graphics. Choose from 3 guides for 3 different routes.
dos:7e779ece54c961ee.title: Mad Dog II: The Lost Gold

dos:7e81b8b265ec431d.description: Race your Corvette against a human or computer player through an accurate reproduction of San Francisco. Choose a stock, ZR1 or tricked-up twin turbo model and pick your route on the map.
dos:7e81b8b265ec431d.title: Vette!

dos:7ea297a3cf82528b.description: A Sokoban variant that adds cement to cover holes in later levels. Get the box to the red glowing square without trapping yourself or pushing the box somewhere immovable.
dos:7ea297a3cf82528b.title: Factory John

dos:7ea78ad0b61e67ba.description: A translation of classic checkers: jump over the opponent's buttons, and the last one standing wins. Player versus player only, unless you register for the full version.
dos:7ea78ad0b61e67ba.title: Argo Checkers

dos:7eaabb39bac29eca.description: A short text adventure in which you are the sole survivor of a space disaster involving the luxury liner Adonis, stranded on a hostile planet full of monsters. It uses a simple two-word parser.
dos:7eaabb39bac29eca.title: Alien

dos:7eae57c85bb0c640.description: A side-scrolling action game from Titus tied to the 1990 Dick Tracy movie, in which you control the detective.
dos:7eae57c85bb0c640.title: Dick Tracy

dos:7eb160ac98b372d1.description: A 2D platformer with several action-packed stages, set in Bitland, a world under terrible danger after the invasion of Necterion and his army.
dos:7eb160ac98b372d1.title: Guimo

dos:7eb632ea651bdc1a.description: The first of a series about forming straight lines in 3D space. Planes can be rotated to change the lines and thus the score, and you play against a learning machine.
dos:7eb632ea651bdc1a.title: Euclid I

dos:7ebe313c0f0e43df.description: An unofficial add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator 5.0 that gives you all the aircraft flown by the US Thunderbirds demonstration squadron, with their USAF equivalents.
dos:7ebe313c0f0e43df.title: Virtual Squadron: Thunderbirds Past, Present and Future!

dos:7ec068d1cbbaf123.description: A football game with a forced-perspective 3D view, large players and a scanner to help with long passes. The ball sticks close to the feet and there are 64 international teams.
dos:7ec068d1cbbaf123.title: Striker (1992)

dos:7ec45ac795bc8f8b.description: The sequel to Argo's Hexxagon with improved graphics, better AI and better board configuration options, keeping the same fundamental gameplay.
dos:7ec45ac795bc8f8b.title: Hexxagon II

dos:7ec5cd4152957072.description: A strategy logic game in which you push faces on a 12x8 grid onto their negative images with your animated man. All solutions are provided for the 40 puzzles.
dos:7ec5cd4152957072.title: Facetrex

dos:7ec68c12d92e6f4a.description: A top-down dungeon escape in which you find keys, use helpful items and navigate the maze before time runs out, while keeping a status meter under control.
dos:7ec68c12d92e6f4a.title: Madame Ching's Dungeon of Ecstasy

dos:7edc813c09588a8d.description: A rail shooter set in 2071, when the Kesh Rhan aliens have destroyed the human colonies on Mars and Pluto. You play Jessica Darkhill, the Orbital Defence Forces' best pilot, in the last counter-attack.
dos:7edc813c09588a8d.title: Chaos Control

dos:7ee0a276e869f5e5.description: A vertically scrolling space shoot 'em up against hordes of aliens and surreal fruits, with power-ups that improve firepower, speed or fuel.
dos:7ee0a276e869f5e5.title: Jackson City

dos:7eeca910cc96bca0.description: A golf game at Puerto Rico's Hyatt Dorado Beach course with fictional golfers or your own in 18 holes, 15 tournament types and a driving range.
dos:7eeca910cc96bca0.title: World Cup Golf: Hyatt Dorado Beach

dos:7eef6404df098e37.description: Cargo ships are disappearing near the planet Lotis IV, home of the Lumpies, and you investigate in a first-person dungeon crawler, crash-landing and sneaking around their underground habitat unarmed.
dos:7eef6404df098e37.title: Lumpies of Lotis IV

dos:7ef7da2d4d4b3398.description: You return to your home planet to find it destroyed by a warlike alien race, and take revenge by fighting through planets packed with enemies to destroy the Battle Star.
dos:7ef7da2d4d4b3398.title: OverKill (1992)

dos:7ef94b6ebd653b04.description: A keyboard-controlled Pac-Man-style platform puzzle game. Guide your character around platforms, crates, lifts and explosives to eat a fixed number of pills.
dos:7ef94b6ebd653b04.title: Mr Pacford

dos:7efcf079a9bb0024.description: On the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the Spice, the Emperor invites three powerful houses to compete for control of production in this real-time strategy game.
dos:7efcf079a9bb0024.title: Dune II: The Building of a Dynasty

dos:7f01c3122b4d2d86.description: An action game in which you train as an Olympic decathlete, starting in high school and progressing through college, national and world track meets, with full rules for each event.
dos:7f01c3122b4d2d86.title: Carl Lewis' Go for the Gold

dos:7f0b7d5d1b30f4c6.description: A dungeon game with 25 levels of brick walls, wooden doors and fanged monsters seen far down 3D corridors, with spells to cast and many monster types to fight.
dos:7f0b7d5d1b30f4c6.title: Moraff's World Beginner's Version

dos:7f146497a3b4f489.description: A baseball game combining management and play. Pick from 25 recent World Series, All-Star and All-Time Classic teams and set your lineup by batting average, fielding percentage or ERA.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:7f146497a3b4f489.title: The World's Greatest Baseball Game

dos:7f1dcbd1f9229884.description: A platformer set in a surreal world near the end of the Cretaceous period populated by anthropomorphic, intelligent and civilized dinosaurs.
dos:7f1dcbd1f9229884.title: Dinosaur Detective Agency

dos:7f1f702ed52e86ea.description: A TRON-inspired unlicensed light cycle game. Zoom across an enclosed grid with other bikes that leave impassable lines, which makes it harder to avoid collisions as the field fills.
dos:7f1f702ed52e86ea.title: Zona 0

dos:7f204376d5190bf8.description: A single player strategy game in which you control a tactical ant leading a party of princess ants through tunnels to the open air by destroying enemies, laying arrows and moving bricks.
dos:7f204376d5190bf8.title: Ants - The Exodus

dos:7f2292e4bd82e1e7.description: A graphical adventure in which you take control of the Blub family, a family of tiny aliens who crash-land in a dump on Earth. In each chapter you play a different member.
dos:7f2292e4bd82e1e7.title: Down in the Dumps

dos:7f2a5aea5bf52888.description: A text adventure in an old English country church, using the rules of Colossal Cave Adventure. Explore the church and churchyard, then the dark chambers of the crypt below.
dos:7f2a5aea5bf52888.title: Crypt

dos:7f35d50739d93835.description: An arcade-leaning GT racer with cars including the Predator and the Hurricane, viewed from inside or outside the car, with training and championship modes.
dos:7f35d50739d93835.title: GT Racing 97

dos:7f45f9be72db7870.description: A football simulation focused on international football. Play a tournament with up to 8 human players or single friendlies, with three skill levels and variable match lengths.
dos:7f45f9be72db7870.title: Rick Davis's World Trophy Soccer

dos:7f4d164e15d47c62.description: You are Hunting Harry, the sole denizen of a volcano-side village overrun by ghostly Druts. Shelter inside buildings and disperse them with bombs on timed fuses.
dos:7f4d164e15d47c62.title: Volcano Hunter

dos:7f54bc833edbc6ba.description: A game starring a penguin who collects frozen treats while avoiding monsters.
dos:7f54bc833edbc6ba.title: Ice Man

dos:7f779019a15bc65c.description: A graphic adventure in an alternate world where the Nazis won World War II and the world is crumbling from pollution. You play Hoffman, a government member searching for his missing son.
dos:7f779019a15bc65c.title: Kronolog: The Nazi Paradox

dos:7f797a213bc14575.description: A PC version of Mahjong for one human against three computer rivals. Like rummy, each player holds 14 tiles, discarding one and drawing one per turn.
dos:7f797a213bc14575.title: Mahjong

dos:7f92ce73c3914e6b.description: A shooter in which you are a flying beer in space, using your beer power to fight off waves of corporate beer sent by evil corporations.
dos:7f92ce73c3914e6b.title: The Last Eichhof

dos:7f970b5ee76bb913.description: A two-dimensional gravitational cave flying game, best played by 2 to 4 players in local split screen, with a single-player mode for practice.
dos:7f970b5ee76bb913.title: KOPS

dos:7f98f3b69682e691.description: A shareware recreation of the American version of Monopoly, played with mouse or keyboard. Players start by deciding on their credit limit.
dos:7f98f3b69682e691.title: TEGL Monopoly

dos:7fa2a0f5df2ff124.description: The fourth MicroLeague Baseball with improved graphics, digitized video and network support. Manage a Major League team in exhibition and league play, with a schedule and playbook editor.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:7fa2a0f5df2ff124.title: MicroLeague Baseball IV

dos:7fa2b69e7a57d6aa.description: An early edutainment game from The Learning Company that teaches pattern recognition and logic to children aged 4 to 7. Choose traits of Moppet creatures to line up a queue obeying given rules.
dos:7fa2b69e7a57d6aa.title: Moptown Parade

dos:7fa57c7490676356.description: Ingrid Bottomlow, a gifted gnome with a degree from the Institute of Gnome Economics, is exiled by her family and left lost in the forest. Your job is to keep her safe in this interactive fiction game.
dos:7fa57c7490676356.title: Gnome Ranger

dos:7faa943bf70e6030.description: The Slordax, a race of super beings who tried to conquer the galaxy, are back after being repelled seven hundred years ago. The Intergalactic Defense Alliance gives you the task of taking them out in this shooter.
dos:7faa943bf70e6030.title: Slordax: The Unknown Enemy

dos:7fc3d616e6526a91.description: You are a taxi driver trying to escape the violent prison city of Kemo. Deliver passengers to earn money to upgrade your cab, with cab-mounted weaponry and undercover missions.
dos:7fc3d616e6526a91.title: Quarantine

dos:7fc692e7a73f3154.description: You are Chauncey, a serving lad rewarded with a magical sword, Grimthwacker, and a village for saving the king from choking, and you must defend it from waves of Hordlings bent on eating everything.
dos:7fc692e7a73f3154.title: The Horde

dos:7fd72c99c051a623.description: The second Unnkulian text adventure, made with TADS. After escaping the Unnkulian Underworld, you continue to seek fame and glory in new locations.
dos:7fd72c99c051a623.title: Unnkulian Unventure II: The Secret of Acme

dos:7fdc6fbc3249ea85.description: Mirinae's second vertical scrolling shooter, built around three upgradeable and switchable weapon systems with fine animations and scrolling.
dos:7fdc6fbc3249ea85.title: Blur Way

dos:7ff48570acfc6b55.description: A game to help children and adults learn the books of the Old Testament, which are scrambled and must be selected in the proper sequence by mouse or keyboard.
dos:7ff48570acfc6b55.title: Animated Old Testament, The

dos:8000557bbc196656.description: An award-winning educational game in which you are Donald working to earn money to buy playground equipment for Huey, Dewey and Louie. The first job is guiding the Amquack Express around a top-down map.
dos:8000557bbc196656.title: Donald Duck's Playground

dos:80009df3a4300f95.description: A mix-and-match program for kids, one of the earliest games coded by John Romero at SoftDisk. Create fictional dinosaurs from various parts and save or print them.
dos:80009df3a4300f95.title: Dino-Sorcerer

dos:8022120790bedf83.description: A platformer in which you control a soldier collecting 5 items scattered around 5 levels, using a code in a teleportation machine to reach each one.
dos:8022120790bedf83.title: Lazarus

dos:80281bcd2bba8166.description: A real-time role-playing game from the developers of Ancient Evil. In third-person view, create a character to face the Trialmaster's trial and win unimaginable wealth.
dos:80281bcd2bba8166.title: Trial by Magic

dos:802b0237fbb9c5c2.description: A simple Q*Bert clone. Move around a pyramid changing the colors of blocks by stepping on them while avoiding monsters and falling rocks, with teleport disks on each side.
dos:802b0237fbb9c5c2.title: Pyramid Power

dos:802c2e16fec38945.description: You are a secret agent code-named Barracuda, recovering segments of a top-secret nuclear weapon from the ocean floor before an Iraqi salvage fleet can secure them. A mix of different game styles.
dos:802c2e16fec38945.title: Barracuda: Secret Mission 1

dos:802d30b3420e4914.description: A point and click adventure in which you play a good Wizard taking on a less good one. To fulfill a prophecy in 3 days, go on 3 quests solving puzzles to be rewarded with 3 grains of sand for an hourglass.
dos:802d30b3420e4914.title: Ween: The Prophecy

dos:803e4ccb062da027.description: A creativity program modeled on the Etch A Sketch drawing toy, in which you draw whatever you like.
dos:803e4ccb062da027.title: Etch a Sketch

dos:8048e7e5fa95ebda.description: A jigsaw puzzle program with six pictures (Ferrari, Castle, Pets, Sailboat, Sunset and World Map) in sizes from 6 to 294 pieces, with high scores by size and time.
dos:8048e7e5fa95ebda.title: Electric Jigsaw

dos:804cda8a3bade5d1.description: A collection of four arcade games built from scenes of the movie. Marty McFly and Doc Brown are in 1885 facing Mad Dog Tannen's gang and need a way back to the present.
dos:804cda8a3bade5d1.title: Back to the Future Part III

dos:805358afdb15e279.description: A Q*Bert-style game with an Egyptian theme. Archaeologist Buster Cheops treasure-hunts in a pyramid, jumping on every block to change its color while the tomb's residents try to stop him.
dos:805358afdb15e279.title: Tut-Busters

dos:8056790eaeb61d9a.description: A compilation of the turn-based strategy game Worms and its add-on Worms: Reinforcements. Up to 4 teams of 4 worms try to destroy each other on generated terrain.
dos:8056790eaeb61d9a.title: Worms United

dos:8059baae9d55923b.description: A text-only action game in which you play a lawn mower that must mow the entire lawn in a set time, earning more money the faster you finish.
dos:8059baae9d55923b.title: Lawn Mower

dos:805a88b9f15b9520.description: Pilot an Apache helicopter through enemy terrain to save captured F-14 pilots, fighting tanks, soldiers and air units with chainguns and missiles and destroying strongholds.
dos:805a88b9f15b9520.title: Hellfire Zone

dos:806077b6a3c23e32.description: A football game from ABC Sports and Data East with voice synthesis. Change receivers on the fly and throw blitz plays at the quarterback.
dos:806077b6a3c23e32.title: ABC Monday Night Football

dos:80852011aa8e856a.description: A one or two player shareware version of the 1981 classic Ms. Pac-Man: clear mazes by eating all the pills while avoiding four ghosts.
dos:80852011aa8e856a.title: CHAMP Ms. Pacman

dos:808ee5be3eba7e2b.description: A spin-off made during the development of Alone in the Dark 2 and used as a Christmas 1993 promotional game, later included with the CD versions of the first two Alone in the Dark games.
dos:808ee5be3eba7e2b.title: Jack in the Dark

dos:80a55e4bbe27a14b.description: An educational adventure in which the Master of Mischief destroys the Rainbow Bridge, dropping its jewels to the bottom of the sea while Goobies seep out of the sea floor.
dos:80a55e4bbe27a14b.title: Super Solvers Treasure Cove!

dos:80a734b4752fe87a.description: A shareware peg solitaire game in which you remove all thirty-two pegs by jumping over pegs. It is keyboard controlled and has save and load.
dos:80a734b4752fe87a.title: Tommy's High IQ

dos:80b87ccd6e259b3b.description: The first complete Keen 4 mod, by Ceilick with music by KeenRush, and the first episode of the unofficial The Universe Is Toast trilogy.
dos:80b87ccd6e259b3b.title: Commander Keen 7: The Keys of Krodacia

dos:80b93351d45b333f.description: Six months after Pharaoh's Tomb, treasure hunter Nevada Smith is determined to find another great prize to prove his earlier success was not beginner's luck.
dos:80b93351d45b333f.title: Arctic Adventure

dos:80c4eb00ceba403d.description: A game simulating American operations in the Vietnam war. Missions include Patrol, Ambush, Demolition, Rescue, Recover, Snatch and Observe, giving orders to a squad.
dos:80c4eb00ceba403d.title: SEAL Team

dos:80d5c1d243272943.description: Race Formula-1 on several tracks against a computer or human opponent. Watch your fuel and tires and drive into the pit stop to swap them and refuel.
dos:80d5c1d243272943.title: Pitstop II

dos:80e173cc31ab424e.description: As a devil named Little Giovanni, beat about 40 levels. Find three hidden golden hairs in each level to open the exit. You have no weapons but can kill some enemies by jumping on their heads.
dos:80e173cc31ab424e.title: Devil Land

dos:80e22b33ce06e864.description: In this sequel the mutant space bats of doom invade Earth again. Collect colored gems that raise firepower, slow enemies or add lives, and in the bonus stage turn into a bat.
dos:80e22b33ce06e864.title: Return of the Mutant Space Bats of Doom

dos:80f11125f276985c.description: A volleyball game between two aliens, with obstacles on the court including a Pac-Man-like creature that constantly chases the ball.
dos:80f11125f276985c.title: Eyeball

dos:811269e18605fd20.description: A text adventure in which you are a human guinea pig for a race of super intelligent beings with no bodies, plucked from your bed to sustain them, and must live up to Alexander the Great.
dos:811269e18605fd20.title: Mysterious Adventure No. 7: Feasibility Experiment

dos:8115893037ee4710.description: A single-player shareware RPG released to promote the Azalta Creator game development product and the full game Azalta Traveller.
dos:8115893037ee4710.title: Azalta: Cult of the Raven

dos:811e78df630ac33c.description: A remake and follow-up to Ballblazer, a futuristic sport played in vehicles called Rotofoils. Get the ball, the Plasmorb, into a goal that moves along the edge of the field.
dos:811e78df630ac33c.title: Masterblazer

dos:81214ba268770dcb.description: Lo Wang has worked as a Shadow Warrior for the Zilla Corporation, but left in disgust on discovering Zilla's plan to summon monsters from other dimensions. Zilla sends his assassins after him.
dos:81214ba268770dcb.title: Shadow Warrior

dos:812dc156899e6865.description: Aliens have infested Earth and are spreading a deadly virus. A shooter viewed in remote 3D in which your score depends on the percentage of uninfected land.
dos:812dc156899e6865.title: Virus

dos:812e803f103d8622.description: Dirk the Daring is called back when his wife Daphne is kidnapped by the evil wizard Mordroc. He escapes to Singe's old castle, where he finds a time machine.
dos:812e803f103d8622.title: Dragon's Lair II: Time Warp

dos:81317f5c92740493.description: A mystery text adventure in which you play a disillusioned circus goer who decides to help find the owner's kidnapped daughter by searching the arena, tents and back areas for clues.
dos:81317f5c92740493.title: Ballyhoo

dos:81326e54ddab5c17.description: A puzzle game like Atomix. Play the blob Max, who must collect all the hearts in a level and go to his girlfriend Mimi within a time limit, but only stops walking when he touches a block.
dos:81326e54ddab5c17.title: The Power

dos:81439ae81ddffb7a.description: An advertisement for Ford's 1992 product line. Examine each model, price its parts and write your order, and drive a chosen model to Lake Wakatonka while avoiding the police.
dos:81439ae81ddffb7a.title: Ford Simulator III

dos:814e1b31eb3d7da6.description: A Mortal Kombat clone from Czechoslovakia.
dos:814e1b31eb3d7da6.title: Unlimited Warriors

dos:81556baae4c27a90.description: A first-person shooter on a modified DOOM engine. The planet Bazoik is overrun by Flemoids that consume the IFC's nutritious foods, and you must rid the levels of them.
dos:81556baae4c27a90.title: Chex Quest

dos:8156946b8e4d1921.description: A side-scrolling shoot 'em up created with Game Maker.
dos:8156946b8e4d1921.title: Ego Force

dos:815869c86d719f18.description: A platform shooter starring a kangaroo special agent sent to protect a city of anthropomorphic animals from a monster assault, armed with a laser pistol that shoots in two directions.
dos:815869c86d719f18.title: Captain Kang

dos:815cfea135021322.description: The third Super Solvers game, an educational game teaching children aged five to nine reading, basic math and logic skills.
dos:815cfea135021322.title: Super Solvers: Treasure Mountain!

dos:8160c4c1288effee.description: A Tic-Tac-Toe-style game in which you and the computer compete to be first to make a 2x2 square in a 10x10 grid. The AI has five levels, and you can save and resume.
dos:8160c4c1288effee.title: Squares

dos:8162d82081c29d1f.description: A roguelike inspired by the Assembly demoparties in Helsinki, in this virtual demo party simulation you control the DemuLamu, an at-sign wandering the party place and encountering ELiTE dudes.
dos:8162d82081c29d1f.title: Mazzembly 1997

dos:81649fac2476b905.description: An educational geography game from PC Globe Inc. which turns country-specific info into a strategy board game about treasure hunting around the globe.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Education; Strategy
dos:81649fac2476b905.title: Bush Buck: Global Treasure Hunter

dos:8167401ce5d7f78c.description: A shareware backgammon game playable with keyboard or mouse in color or monochrome, with three skill levels.
dos:8167401ce5d7f78c.title: Backgammon (1991)

dos:816a9b7c4aac4a53.description: A snake-style game in which one or two players each control a worm, eating bonuses to grow and score while avoiding walls, the opponent and themselves.
dos:816a9b7c4aac4a53.title: WormWars 3

dos:816b97bd141d3d2c.description: A virtual casino with 12 classic casino games from Video Blackjack to Craps and Slot Machines, for 1 to 4 human players with a starting bankroll.
dos:816b97bd141d3d2c.title: 4 Queens Computer Casino

dos:817deffe4d6bc69a.description: A Korean Tetris sequel in which you save miniature Koreans from their blocky prisons.
dos:817deffe4d6bc69a.title: Korean Tetris II

dos:8180522a86eea744.description: A keyboard-controlled single-screen game with boulders, numbered keys and an exit door. Move your torch around the screen; its beam shows the number of each key it lights.
dos:8180522a86eea744.title: The Catacombs of Nemon

dos:8181100a4c35d067.description: A straightforward arcade bowling game for up to four players in which you control only the tail end of your roll, steering the ball up or down.
dos:8181100a4c35d067.title: PCBOWL - Electron Lanes

dos:818286e1b2f5d403.description: The enhanced CD-ROM version of Star Wars: X-Wing, with 6 new missions, improved 3D graphics, voice and upgraded sound, plus the two Tour of Duty extensions, Imperial Pursuit and B-Wing.
dos:818286e1b2f5d403.title: Star Wars: X-Wing (Collector's CD-ROM)

dos:81922420a57641ab.description: A compilation of three interactive fiction games about wizards and time travel with enhanced versions: Lords of Time, Red Moon and The Price of Magik.
dos:81922420a57641ab.title: Time and Magik: The Trilogy

dos:819a69a06d5042ed.description: The ancient game from India, ancestor of Sorry! and Ludo. Roll a die and move counters around a cross-shaped area. For four players, and the computer can substitute for one.
dos:819a69a06d5042ed.title: Pachisi

dos:81bfb03baa07cb73.description: A science-fiction text adventure in a galaxy that fell into a ten-thousand-year dark age after the fall of the Second Galactic Union, and a treaty between empires in 11,203 GY.
dos:81bfb03baa07cb73.title: Stationfall

dos:81c450fbda98cd47.description: A continuation of Bloxinies with more enemies and a 256-color palette. Escape worlds by collecting all the diamonds and reaching the exit door.
dos:81c450fbda98cd47.title: Bloxinies II

dos:81d4baf9ad185053.description: The unofficial sequel to PHM Pegasus. Command a complete fleet of warships on missions tied to political events of the time.
dos:81d4baf9ad185053.title: Strike Fleet

dos:81dedc16989c6a8e.description: In 1834, in the New England fishing village of Illsmouth, the British scientist Lord Boleskine lost his mind observing Halley's comet after studying manuscripts of evil repute. A Lovecraftian adventure.
dos:81dedc16989c6a8e.title: Call of Cthulhu: Shadow of the Comet

dos:81e220979dbe9b5c.description: A combat flight sim about the Battle of Britain, split into four stages. Take part for the Royal Air Force or the German Luftwaffe, either flying or taking Controller duties.
dos:81e220979dbe9b5c.title: Reach for the Skies

dos:81e5a5c993704cc1.description: A World War II submarine simulation in which you play the American or German side with six submarines across 60 missions. Navigate with five mapping levels and plan attacks around weather and surroundings.
dos:81e5a5c993704cc1.title: Sub Battle Simulator

dos:81edfd2babaf78e7.description: You accidentally launch an alien space/time vehicle found in the woods and damage the circuit that would return you to Earth. A big game with several alien environments to explore, mostly mechanical puzzles.
dos:81edfd2babaf78e7.title: Lost (Jeffrey Hersh)

dos:81eedbc5bf579528.description: A reflex game in which you guard a castle with a bat against a bouncing ball that quickly crumbles the surrounding brick wall.
dos:81eedbc5bf579528.title: Bat'n Ball

dos:81f91ad472d65db0.title: Kahjar: The Bratockian Saga Part III

dos:82000c1aef5cfee0.description: A flight simulator focused on gliders, which have no engines and use thermals to stay aloft for long periods, with a sophisticated flight model.
dos:82000c1aef5cfee0.title: The Soaring Simulator

dos:820802dd584383b6.description: An extremely simple fighting game from the Taiwanese developer Dysing Information with several heroes from the Chinese pantheon of myths.
dos:820802dd584383b6.title: Violent Myth

dos:8226561ffad339b4.description: A platformer with cartoonish characters. You are a little hairy creature with a great jump who must eat all the bombs in each level before time runs out, avoiding traps and enemies.
dos:8226561ffad339b4.title: Komebumb

dos:82276761a7ee14b3.description: A two-player ASCII arena combat game. You and your co-pilot are busted for smuggling and tossed by Galactic police into a labyrinth to fight each other like gladiators.
dos:82276761a7ee14b3.title: Batalia

dos:823586db37d9bf92.description: An enhanced version of Capitalism in which you build a business empire, controlling the whole production chain from raw materials to retail, or concentrating on specific sectors.
dos:823586db37d9bf92.title: Capitalism Plus

dos:823c56ea0d83c63e.description: A dungeon crawl RPG similar to Telengard. Play a fighter or a sorcerer exploring multi-level caverns for gold and treasures in a top-down view where only the area near you is visible.
dos:823c56ea0d83c63e.title: Caverns of Zoarre

dos:8242643f782fad88.description: A flight simulation covering fighter models from World War 1 to the present, including the Sopwith Camel, Spitfire, F-4 Phantom, Harrier, F-16 Fighting Falcon, Fokker DR1 and MiG-23.
dos:8242643f782fad88.title: Dog Fight: 80 Years of Aerial Warfare

dos:824426c891258b93.description: The third Might and Magic RPG, with a plot full of twists. Lead a party of adventurers to meet the legendary wizard Corak, from dark dungeons to many other places.
dos:824426c891258b93.title: Might and Magic III: Isles of Terra

dos:824c0cf70fab60c5.description: Similar to the ZZT series, you explore an ASCII world with a single objective: to find the sword Retaliator.
dos:824c0cf70fab60c5.title: Falcon Lord

dos:8258fc30281cccd7.description: In 2631 a meteorite falls on the Galuga archipelago, and the terrorist group Red Falcon seizes the island for an alien invasion. Contra marines Bill Rizer and Lance Bean are sent in.
dos:8258fc30281cccd7.title: Contra

dos:826152197f844966.description: A shareware graphical adventure with optional sound, playable by keyboard, mouse or both, in which five galley slaves washed up on a tropical island centuries ago.
dos:826152197f844966.title: Weird Island

dos:8261636c729c8623.description: A Pac-Man-like game rendered completely in ASCII art. A white smiling face collects all the dots and symbols and escapes Red Faces, with destructible and indestructible blocks on the field.
dos:8261636c729c8623.title: RAMSAK

dos:8275a128e955d607.description: A puzzle game in which you flip tokens in a grid, from 3x3 to 6x6, until they are all the same color. Fewer flips are better.
dos:8275a128e955d607.title: Flipper (2003)

dos:8281f701ff616a3f.description: A puzzle strategy game on a field of 3x3 cells, growing to 4x4 and 5x5 in later levels, with one empty cell and maze elements in the rest. A man appears in a cell and must be guided.
dos:8281f701ff616a3f.title: Timewalk

dos:828d80807e750a7e.description: An illustrated text adventure in which your uncle Chez Burger leaves you a house called Carfax Abbey. As Ham Burger you inherit something evil and sinister on a journey into the world of ghosts and demons.
dos:828d80807e750a7e.title: Ooze: Creepy Nites

dos:8299e36143be9182.description: An isometric action game in which you are an agent in a combat suit with a laser helmet, descending into a factory to find and kill the agent Halox, who stole the formula for the bomb MEGATRON. Explore 80 rooms.
dos:8299e36143be9182.title: Mission

dos:829b8324d98fe6ad.description: An adventure with a romantic theme reminiscent of Raiders of the Lost Ark. Guide former WWI ace Jake Masters through 1930s Asia to rescue Kate Lomax, kidnapped daughter of an American land baron.
dos:829b8324d98fe6ad.title: Heart of China

dos:82a93656a1112881.description: An adventure game developed by Adeline Software and published by Activision in 1997, starring Twinsen.
dos:82a93656a1112881.title: Twinsen's Odyssey

dos:82acf83f8741da58.description: The moonstone is the only hope for the lands, and you, a chosen knight of the druids, must find it. One to four players can play at once and the story stays the same.
dos:82acf83f8741da58.title: Moonstone: A Hard Days Knight

dos:82b1783ebf287e35.description: You are janitor Slott, cleaning the galaxy of accumulated debris with a spacecraft armed to destroy waste and capable of improvement. An ordinary side-scroller of two-minute stages with no enemies, only garbage.
dos:82b1783ebf287e35.title: Sergeant Slotte: Galaxy Janitor

dos:82bb265fec695dbc.description: A Tetris-like game in which you control a mole at the bottom of a board filled with debris dumped by a sadistic owner, removing blocks so none remain.
dos:82bb265fec695dbc.title: Kret

dos:82c786dc0ae0c18b.description: A fast-paced shoot 'em up for two to four players. Fly small rockets through levels fighting enemies with several weapons; the last one standing wins.
dos:82c786dc0ae0c18b.title: Rocket Chase

dos:82c9356532c33bf7.description: An ice hockey game with 20 unlicensed NHL teams in 4 groups of 5. After the regular season the best 2 teams in each group qualify for the playoffs, and you always play the center.
dos:82c9356532c33bf7.title: Superstar Ice Hockey

dos:82cc71586c3cd0b7.description: A fighting game in which you enter MeCha Island's robot-fighting tournament and investigate its secrets, choosing machines with different strengths, earning money and buying upgrades between bouts.
dos:82cc71586c3cd0b7.title: Metal & Lace: The Battle of the Robo Babes

dos:82d63053452f3219.description: A point-and-click puzzle adventure made by Coktel Vision with the Gobliins engine to advertise Findus's Croustibat fish sticks, starring the mascot Croustibat.
dos:82d63053452f3219.title: Croustibat

dos:82da05a02e9970f6.description: Probably the first first-person pinball game, from Tynesoft. Up to four players can join, including 2 computer players, and there is a traditional overhead view.
dos:82da05a02e9970f6.title: 1st Person Pinball

dos:82dd698bf8da558e.description: The second Alge-Blaster educational game for learning algebra, with five activities including Learn, with step-by-step instructions, and Solve.
dos:82dd698bf8da558e.title: Alge-Blaster Plus!

dos:82f671d954da9f44.description: A football management sequel to Addictive's Football Manager. Choose formations, assign man-to-man marking and manage players with individual skills and fitness ratings.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:82f671d954da9f44.title: Football Manager 3

dos:82fe8b29c064df7c.description: A Lemmings-style puzzle game in which you issue instructions to individual hamsters to usher them to a level exit, through 83 levels in the registered version, under a time limit.
dos:82fe8b29c064df7c.title: Hamsters

dos:830a6d319d25b4fc.description: An artificial life game in which two digital species compete for survival, each governed by a 3x3 grid of arrows and icons that respond to different stimuli.
dos:830a6d319d25b4fc.title: Evolve! Lite

dos:830f92fca0af6d13.description: A multi-language educational game for learning fast touch typing, with adjustable difficulty and levels matching the number of keyboard characters learned.
dos:830f92fca0af6d13.title: BabyType

dos:83125e17c1c97f5e.description: A shareware side-scroller in which you guide Scuba man to collect treasure under the sea while avoiding being killed or eaten, across ten levels such as Shark Attack and Ship Wreck.
dos:83125e17c1c97f5e.title: Scubaman's Quest

dos:83126f697589d3ef.description: A three-dimensional Arkanoid: a rectangular glass tunnel goes deep into the screen with blocks to knock out, and your racket sits in the foreground.
dos:83126f697589d3ef.title: Arcanoid

dos:83204353c7555612.description: The dark magician Amargol has stolen the magic golden shield from the village of Nargoot, and as the shepherd Arn you must recover it within four days in a side-scrolling action game.
dos:83204353c7555612.title: Sirwood

dos:834073c5a2f9f6ad.description: An adventure/action game in the land of Vol Terra, where you play Elkinloor, a half-man, half-elk creature in a forest, as trouble brews between the Elkin tribes and humans.
dos:834073c5a2f9f6ad.title: Elkinloor

dos:8340bc423dba2a29.description: A horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up in which you control a transformer spaceship against mechanical and organic aliens, with special moves such as mecha transformation.
dos:8340bc423dba2a29.title: Super Beemger

dos:834349f837a1d787.description: A pop music quiz show recreated from BBC Radio 1 DJ Mike Read's show, with questions from the 50s to the 80s. Play against the computer or a human, choosing a specialist subject.
dos:834349f837a1d787.title: Mike Read's Computer Pop Quiz

dos:8348250ba8df4727.description: A chess game with 12 skill levels from novice to grandmaster, an opening library, a move history printout, and a teach mode that shows all legal moves.
dos:8348250ba8df4727.title: The Chessmaster 2000

dos:834ec55162cecbcf.description: A shareware 3D space shooter like Wing Commander in which you are a space marshal completing 10 scenarios of missions from asteroid blasting to pirate elimination, patrols and escorts.
dos:834ec55162cecbcf.title: LineWars II

dos:8352ca638f810612.description: An ambitious interactive movie that uses the CD-ROM's capacity for hours of digital movies. You play a voyeur, aiming for the most flexible interactive movie in history.
dos:8352ca638f810612.title: Voyeur

dos:8372941fb1009a1b.description: An Ultima-like RPG in which you travel the world of Quilinor fighting goblins, giants and zombies while picking pockets, robbing dungeons and picking locks.
dos:8372941fb1009a1b.title: Vampyr: Talisman of Invocation

dos:8386d73d59e4b00e.description: A computer version of the Judge Dredd pinball machine with new additions, multiple graphics settings, key remapping, and a partly video, partly standard pinball game.
dos:8386d73d59e4b00e.title: Judge Dredd Pinball

dos:838c03db53e7e12a.description: A simple platformer with no menu in which you play a sympathetic creature that must exterminate all the enemies of each level by jumping on them, then catch as many stars as possible.
dos:838c03db53e7e12a.title: Sila's Quest

dos:838d6bcf0e91097a.description: A 4 KB retro remake of Universal's Lady Bug. Control a ravenous ladybug in a maze filled with x symbols to devour to reach the next level.
dos:838d6bcf0e91097a.title: LadyBug

dos:83902a46ba9952d6.description: Based on the movie series: play Martin Riggs or Roger Murtaugh to complete four main missions and a final bonus one, kicking, shooting, jumping and swimming to stop crimes.
dos:83902a46ba9952d6.title: Lethal Weapon

dos:83ba31169244d4ff.description: Game designer Bob Morlock finds himself inside the spaceship of his own sci-fi video game after a hyperspace accident clones him thirty times, each clone taking a portion of a vital fluid.
dos:83ba31169244d4ff.title: Captain Blood

dos:83c84aa74e98810a.description: A tank simulation with multiple theaters from Cuba to Europe. Move between the Commander, Gunner and Driver positions inside the tank, or stay in the Commander's seat and give orders.
dos:83c84aa74e98810a.title: Steel Thunder

dos:83e3af72f341e139.description: A role-playing game following the second book of Tolkien's trilogy. Control multiple characters from the book as they struggle to reach the Two Towers on the quest to destroy the One Ring.
dos:83e3af72f341e139.title: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings, Vol. II: The Two Towers

dos:83eaab278e9b786b.description: Physics professor Lester finds himself on a strange alien world after a particle experiment goes wrong, and must fight for his life, first with bare hands, then with a gun he finds.
dos:83eaab278e9b786b.title: Out of this World

dos:83f070ffaa6d5210.description: A one or two player keyboard-controlled trivia game with modes including Fifty Questions, in which you score two points for a correct answer and lose two for a wrong one, and Beat The Clock.
dos:83f070ffaa6d5210.title: Tommy's Trivia

dos:83fd2b975b2d2f5d.description: The final game of the Double Dragon trilogy. Billy and Jimmy Lee are told by a fortune teller of a great evil in Egypt and how the Rosetta Stones can help, with weapon shops to buy power-ups.
dos:83fd2b975b2d2f5d.title: Double Dragon III: The Rosetta Stone

dos:83ff83d15c9327a0.description: Set during the Gulf War, with twenty missions in Middle East locations of three types: Scud Defense, Jet Defense and Tomahawk Offensive. The defense missions recall Missile Command.
dos:83ff83d15c9327a0.title: Sandstorm

dos:840a74ca9b396ed3.description: An early UK baseball simulation for one or two players over 3, 6 or 9 innings, with 3 computer skill levels and arcade-style gameplay.
dos:840a74ca9b396ed3.title: The Slugger

dos:841804cfdd107edb.description: A comic text adventure that reworks scenes from Zork II in an urban setting. Solve a compact sequence of parody puzzles and confront an unusual musical villain.
dos:841804cfdd107edb.title: Pork 2: The Gizzard of Showbiz

dos:8419939be40b58aa.description: The third in a row of Napoleonic wargames after Waterloo and Borodino. Re-fight the Battle of Austerlitz on December 2, 1805, as Napoleon or Czar Alexander, alone or with a second player.
dos:8419939be40b58aa.title: Austerlitz

dos:842292b3d2bd7e83.description: A sliding puzzle game in which you move cards on your side to match the pattern laid out on the right.
dos:842292b3d2bd7e83.title: Fifteen Game

dos:842d84ad31053335.description: A simple puzzle game in which you and the computer take turns selecting a brick from a wall; the bricks on top of it fall too, and the more fall, the more points you get.
dos:842d84ad31053335.title: Tear Down the Wall

dos:842da1488524a53f.description: After a long trip you arrive at the Nexus space lab, where scientists are to examine your psychic potential, only to be awoken by screams and your examiner being eaten by huge rats.
dos:842da1488524a53f.title: Psionics

dos:8432cf296c916c84.description: A Breakout game in 320x400 Mode X VGA. Monsters from the dimension of Brickania have built a big wall around Earth, and you control the X-PAD to destroy it.
dos:8432cf296c916c84.title: Break Machine

dos:843317b8f11ffe47.description: A mouse-driven starship command simulation with an interface called LYCAR, similar to LCARS from Star Trek: The Next Generation. Create yourself as Fleet Commander and assign a mission.
dos:843317b8f11ffe47.title: Rules of Engagement

dos:844133160ebe3347.description: A simulation of the Korean two-player board game similar to Chinese Chess, played on a 9x10 point board. Select a unit, examine where it may move, and win by capturing the opposing general.
dos:844133160ebe3347.title: Jang-gi

dos:84427206bda2bca1.description: A trivia game with a map of the United States that quizzes you on states and capitals, with settings for question types and the number of multiple-choice answers.
dos:84427206bda2bca1.title: Handy Caps

dos:844a04b0a0f78ce8.description: A funny arcade/simulator hybrid. Choose your pilot in the barracks and your opponent at headquarters and get a mission assignment before flying.
dos:844a04b0a0f78ce8.title: Manfred Von Krashenberns Flying Circus

dos:844d53b2e4c17bc8.description: Based on the MegaTraveller tabletop game, you must prevent war between the Zhodani Consulate and the Imperium after Zhodani officials bribed Imperium counterparts to try to bring one about.
dos:844d53b2e4c17bc8.title: MegaTraveller 1: The Zhodani Conspiracy

dos:844ffbe941673ac2.description: A Tetris clone using pieces of 5 blocks instead of 4, with 18 different figures plus smaller ones of 3, 2 and 1 blocks.
dos:844ffbe941673ac2.title: Pentix

dos:845132c6af25a5fc.description: A chess game much like Battle Chess, but with full motion video cutscenes for each capture. Switch between 2D and isometric 3D, with 8,000 openings and classic games with 60,000 historical moves.
dos:845132c6af25a5fc.title: Chess Wars: A Medieval Fantasy

dos:845a543aa82d25b8.description: The planet Ranax is under attack by the Maaron empire. The last Ranaxian soldier must find and use a digital code to shut down the empire's mind-controlling satellite, shooting fireballs from his hands at aliens.
dos:845a543aa82d25b8.title: Rebel Runner - Operation: Digital Code

dos:8467aef02a018f7b.description: Rambo's mission is set deep in Afghanistan, as Colonel Trautman has been kidnapped by the Soviets and you go in to rescue him in a three-part operation following the film.
dos:8467aef02a018f7b.title: Rambo III

dos:8479391840e5a348.description: A 1993 CD-ROM from Spectrum HoloByte with all their Tetris games and spinoffs: Tetris, Super Tetris, Tetris Classic, Wordtris, Faces...Tris III, Welltris and a prototype of Tetris.
dos:8479391840e5a348.title: Tetris Gold

dos:847e6b8ed3db5496.description: Demons from Hell have overrun the planet and you, a space marine, must defeat them. A full copy of DOOM with a fourth episode, Thy Flesh Consumed, adding nine more levels.
dos:847e6b8ed3db5496.title: The Ultimate DOOM

dos:848df30878c28ea0.description: A shareware Pong variant with three modes: Wall Play against a wall, Match Play against the computer in singles, and Mixed Doubles with the computer controlling the other three bats.
dos:848df30878c28ea0.title: Tommy's Paddles (1986)

dos:8496e721d67cb533.description: A remake of Hero's Quest: So You Want To Be A Hero with 256-color VGA graphics, re-drawn locations, character portraits in conversations and an icon-based interface instead of text input.
dos:8496e721d67cb533.title: Quest for Glory: So You Want to Be a Hero

dos:84977858b2d7870b.description: Create a party of eight characters from the usual D&D classes and lead them in a quest in a 2D top-down game with symbolic representations on a grid map.
dos:84977858b2d7870b.title: Disciples of Steel

dos:849b129e3d72f327.description: An interactive fiction in which you are summoned before the Gods for a crime against them, a rare event since most offenders are executed, and they reveal why they have spared you.
dos:849b129e3d72f327.title: Cornucopia

dos:84a6b0bb1884e1a7.description: A surreal scrolling shooter with four-color CGA landscapes. Move through science-fiction scenery and fire at waves of bizarre enemies.
dos:84a6b0bb1884e1a7.title: Astrot♥t

dos:84aaaa572a9a49f5.description: In an alternate history, Einstein uses a time machine to eliminate Hitler, preventing World War II, but creating another evil: Stalin's Soviet Union poised to conquer Europe, which the Allies must stop.
dos:84aaaa572a9a49f5.title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert

dos:84b2460952e89af2.description: A football game with many of the same gameplay elements as Madden NFL 97, including the kicking T-meter and the three-quarter overhead camera, with fluid player animations.
dos:84b2460952e89af2.title: NFL Quarterback Club 97

dos:84b7aa0543f9ba02.description: A Korean platform game in which you try to save women from a presumably icy monster.
dos:84b7aa0543f9ba02.title: Ice Kiss

dos:84c1c2194af8dd72.description: Papyrus's third racing game, moving from open-wheeled cars to closed-cockpit NASCAR stock cars. A detailed simulation with realistic car models and controls and nine tracks.
dos:84c1c2194af8dd72.title: NASCAR Racing

dos:84c2fbb502383fd3.description: A simple 5x5 jigsaw puzzle game with a time limit. Reveal a random piece on an empty field and move items with the arrow keys; bonus items like alarm clocks add time.
dos:84c2fbb502383fd3.title: Puzza

dos:84c8c574922702da.description: A combination of Tetris and Poker. Form 5-card hands by maneuvering falling cards with the arrow keys; pairs, three of a kind and other poker hands clear the cards.
dos:84c8c574922702da.title: Finagle

dos:84ce25e8a0774552.description: A Space Invaders variant with power-ups and pre-rendered ship graphics.
dos:84ce25e8a0774552.title: Enemies from Space

dos:84d37b95f002d7b0.description: An out-of-canon adventure of gamebook hero Lone Wolf, who scales the inside of the warlock Gorazh's inverted pyramid tower Kazan-Gor to reach a Lorestone of Nyxator at the top.
dos:84d37b95f002d7b0.title: Lone Wolf: The Mirror of Death

dos:84e3137ffc3ae95d.description: You play a young college graduate given a large sum by your parents to set up a company, starting in a crummy office and growing it through the stock market, with trips to the mall to buy things.
dos:84e3137ffc3ae95d.title: Rags to Riches: The Financial Market Simulation

dos:84e580cae85d5257.description: Based on the arcade game, a basketball action game for one or two players. Choose time limits and teams and play, controlling each player on the team one at a time.
dos:84e580cae85d5257.title: Double Dribble

dos:84f26559d283cb9a.description: Two animal cops live in New York City: Firo, an orange ape, and Klawd, an alley cat. When counterfeit crimes push the city to its limits, they put aside their differences to clean up.
dos:84f26559d283cb9a.title: Firo & Klawd

dos:84f75f031e2fdb92.description: An educational game in which you play a knight entering a castle to accomplish tasks. The game gives instructions that you memorize and then answers questions on what to do next.
dos:84f75f031e2fdb92.title: Memory Castle

dos:84fd661017654283.description: A platformer from SiEn Art with hi-res VESA graphics.
dos:84fd661017654283.title: Indicate

dos:84ffe02dc16263b2.description: A recreation of the largest daylight airborne operation in history on September 17, 1944. Direct the American 82nd and 101st Airborne Divisions, the British 1st Airborne and the 30th Corps to their objectives.
dos:84ffe02dc16263b2.title: Operation Market Garden: Drive on Arnhem, September 1944

dos:850644789b1f7aa8.description: A business simulation, like Millionaire, in which you invest in the commodity market. Start with $10,000 and buy and sell commodities; each turn is one week.
dos:850644789b1f7aa8.title: Tycoon: The Commodity Market Simulation

dos:8513ac142966ad2f.description: A conversion of the arcade racing game. Qualify with a lap in 73 seconds or less, then enter the Grand Prix to race for the highest score in the shortest time.
dos:8513ac142966ad2f.title: Pole Position

dos:8517e80923bf6aed.description: A Tolkien game focused on the Two Towers story, starting before the siege of Helm's Keep between the defending forces of Rohan and the legions of the wizard Saruman, in the style of War in Middle Earth.
dos:8517e80923bf6aed.title: J.R.R. Tolkien's Riders of Rohan
