dos:852030af9dc540be.description: A very brief adventure originally written as an MS-DOS batch file. Wake at the bottom of a pit, climb a rope and negotiate with a troll for a key.
dos:852030af9dc540be.title: VENTURE (pci)

dos:8547dfb3146c26dc.description: A platformer heavily inspired by Apogee's Secret Agent, starring a hero depicted as a baby on the title screen, with unforgiving level designs.
dos:8547dfb3146c26dc.title: Little Willy

dos:854ba56ef812eff7.description: You have been framed and thrown into a foreign jail. Escape and prove your innocence in a side-scrolling arcade game in the style of Commander Keen with a deeper plot and adventure elements.
dos:854ba56ef812eff7.title: Framed

dos:8552a910dad8ac19.description: Codemasters' second Pete Sampras tennis game. Play as a man or woman in singles or doubles and win 8 matches representing the finals of 8 tournaments, with the four Grand Slam venues unlocked by winning others.
dos:8552a910dad8ac19.title: Pete Sampras Tennis 97

dos:855f53beaf59d033.description: Take control of The Fleet (humans), the Khalians, or five other races to battle for the local cluster, conquering enemy planets with troops and building research centers for better ships. Play random maps or scenarios.
dos:855f53beaf59d033.title: Star General

dos:856a6356a6e434a1.description: A shareware fantasy shooter in which the paladin Roman defends the castle of Olin against an army of magic beasts sent by the evil ruler Medak through the corridor known as The Abyss.
dos:856a6356a6e434a1.title: Beyond the Abyss

dos:857ccd38a8af438a.description: A one or two player shareware computerized wargame of the Battle of Gettysburg, played on a hexagonal grid, with a full battlefield overview.
dos:857ccd38a8af438a.title: Gettysburg (1993)

dos:858b12ac07abb913.description: An ASCII puzzle game. Each level describes the mission goal, and your X character moves through a labyrinth finding things left by previous researchers, such as oxygen cylinders.
dos:858b12ac07abb913.title: MadMaze

dos:859c3e430b902e75.description: The gold edition of Advanced Tactical Fighters, the first game from Jane's Combat Simulations, sequel to USNF and built on the same engine, with the Nato Fighters add-on.
dos:859c3e430b902e75.title: Jane's Combat Simulations: Advanced Tactical Fighters - Gold Edition

dos:85a341690795f190.description: An AGI-style adventure in which the animals have plans for you.
dos:85a341690795f190.title: The Farm Nightmare

dos:85a4aa349bbcbcee.description: You command a fleet of BattleStar ships and must destroy the enemy before it destroys you. Place your ships to evade fire and search methodically for the enemy's; play against the computer or another player.
dos:85a4aa349bbcbcee.title: BattleStar (1992)

dos:85aec4778aaa0915.description: A shareware chess game with character graphics, not a program meant to give grandmasters a game.
dos:85aec4778aaa0915.title: Tommy's Chess Set

dos:85c2996d9ea74315.description: A Pac-Man inspired maze game based on the Tom Sawyer's Island attraction at Disneyland. Maneuver Tom Sawyer along the paths to gather berries while Aunt Polly, Injun Joe and, after level three, a bear chase him.
dos:85c2996d9ea74315.title: The Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island

dos:85cebb705965efa7.description: Larry starts over on a tropical island after losing his home and job. Follow his misadventures and the story of musician Patti through exploration, dialogue and inventory puzzles.
dos:85cebb705965efa7.title: Leisure Suit Larry 3: Passionate Patti in Pursuit of the Pulsating Pectorals

dos:85d433a02925a30a.description: The classic 1992 Pacific wargame, revamped with new artwork and units, with every plane, ship, gun and tank accounted for. Play against the computer, watch it play both sides, hotseat or play by e-mail.
dos:85d433a02925a30a.title: Gary Grigsby's Pacific War (2000)

dos:85d8408b8565f9c8.description: A carnival-style shooting gallery with targets moving left and right. Slide your gun and fire.
dos:85d8408b8565f9c8.title: Shooting Gallery (1986)

dos:86211d7a2d331710.description: A motorcycle racing game based on the Spanish rider Sito Pons. Race as Pons in the 500cc World Championship across 14 circuits.
dos:86211d7a2d331710.title: Sito Pons 500cc Grand Prix

dos:86287b1fa8c97a35.description: A follow-up to The Computer Quiz with a hundred questions on the BASIC programming language. You have three men and lose one for each wrong answer, earning bonus men for ten correct in a row.
dos:86287b1fa8c97a35.title: The IBM BASIC Quiz

dos:862d582a2ef7389b.description: Control the cyborg Ranx in an action adventure adapted from the Italian comic. Deliver an antidote in New York, continue on a rescue mission in Rome and collect supplies for repairs while fighting through the streets.
dos:862d582a2ef7389b.title: Ranx: The Video Game

dos:863428d83b45b67c.description: In the 25th century humanity is attacked by the Xatax, aliens that consume the life force of planets of the galactic Alliance. The nearly disarmed humans have no choice but to fight in this scrolling shooter.
dos:863428d83b45b67c.title: Xatax

dos:8636a3a17dabd2aa.description: A shareware strategy game on a gridded arena with goals at both ends. Players take turns making three moves horizontally, vertically or diagonally, aiming to end up in the opponent's goal.
dos:8636a3a17dabd2aa.title: Soccer

dos:86392882fd3cfa86.description: A fantasy adventure in which you explore a castle of eight levels of sixty-four rooms each, randomized at the start, in search of eight major treasures including the palantir and the silmaril.
dos:86392882fd3cfa86.title: Amulet of Yendor

dos:863c2dff23a33898.description: A roguelike in a futuristic post-apocalyptic setting with ASCII graphics. It offers difficulty settings, saving at any time and multiple characters.
dos:863c2dff23a33898.title: AlphaMan

dos:86444052f4f00e73.description: A very original and difficult adventure set in a distant future, without wars, detailed history or high technology, unlike any science fiction artist has portrayed.
dos:86444052f4f00e73.title: Terran Envoy

dos:864adc6993939bce.description: A side-scrolling action game in which you control two different robots, each with different weapons, levels and looks, through a futuristic society.
dos:864adc6993939bce.title: Iron Blood

dos:864f8571a6404f0b.description: The fourth and last game in the Freescape first-person solid 3D series after Driller, Dark Side and Total Eclipse. As a Prince or Princess with a slingshot, explore a medieval castle to free your beloved from the Magister.
dos:864f8571a6404f0b.title: Castle Master

dos:86508ac07a9b42e6.description: Based on the board game of the same name, you lead a nation in the Mediterranean to become the supreme ruler over about 8000 years, from the start of agriculture to the rise of Rome.
dos:86508ac07a9b42e6.title: Advanced Civilization

dos:866e68855f6a8d29.description: E.S.S., the European Space Simulator, challenges you to manage a space shuttle trip starting with 200,000 coins in cash, with events beginning on New Year's day 2010.
dos:866e68855f6a8d29.title: E.S.S.

dos:8676cf66e82c8ba2.description: A text adventure built on puns and wordplay. In the town of Punster, idioms and cliches have become real objects that you must sort out, in seven scenarios playable in any order plus a final one.
dos:8676cf66e82c8ba2.title: Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It

dos:869ddda03b464d81.description: You are Lala, an apprentice witch left alone in the Academy after the professor leaves the windows open and all the formulas and potions escape. Recover the potions before you drop a row of fifteen balloons.
dos:869ddda03b464d81.title: Lala Prologue

dos:86a4773d8c7e7780.description: It is 1901 and bored with life on the farm, you hear the call of the stage and decide to become a world-renowned actor. The road to success is long and filled with setbacks.
dos:86a4773d8c7e7780.title: Battune Becomes an Actor

dos:86a70e87917adb40.description: Based on the BBC Micro game Magic Mushrooms, in this DOS version you control a car that zooms around each level collecting every mushroom to open the exit block.
dos:86a70e87917adb40.title: Magic Maycabs

dos:86aec3288432b7a9.description: Jim Hawkins works at his parents' inn, the Admiral Benbow, when the sea captain Billy Bones stays for months and a blind man called Pew arrives. A text adventure after the novel.
dos:86aec3288432b7a9.title: Treasure Island

dos:86aef1e116bfa2d2.description: An unofficial PC version of Pong. The paddle on the left is computer controlled and the one on the right is yours; hit the ball so the computer can't return it to earn a point.
dos:86aef1e116bfa2d2.title: PC-Tennis

dos:86b69c02dfab64c0.description: You've been ambushed by mummies in an ancient Egyptian tomb with no weapons and no escape. Outsmart them by maneuvering them into the pits that litter the burial chamber.
dos:86b69c02dfab64c0.title: Mummies

dos:86d601e167e668ff.description: A football management game in which you decide which players to buy, stadium improvements, tactics, training and shares, with 3D highlights and commentary.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:86d601e167e668ff.title: Total Football Management

dos:86e56e5357676b4c.description: A digital Battleship in which man faces machine. Both sides hide five ships of various sizes on their boards and fire in turn by selecting a target.
dos:86e56e5357676b4c.title: Hide and Sink

dos:86e98d363343b168.description: A wordless educational game for young children, sequel to McGee, played independently without an adult. This time it takes place on a farm and McGee is joined by his cousin.
dos:86e98d363343b168.title: Katie's Farm

dos:86f0d1230db9c9ab.description: A computer adaptation of Mille Bornes, the French card game sold by Parker Brothers that simulates a 700 kilometer car race.
dos:86f0d1230db9c9ab.title: Mille Bornes

dos:86f62eb14356d83c.description: A multi-stage action game based on Herge's Tintin episode. Reaching the Moon is your challenge.
dos:86f62eb14356d83c.title: Tintin on the Moon

dos:86f88635db8eab6b.description: A cave-flier in the tradition of AUTS and Turboraketti clones. V-shaped ships drawn with two lines fly around platform landscapes and shoot each other with weapons.
dos:86f88635db8eab6b.title: V-Wing

dos:86f95a1176683c07.description: A Korean fighting game about the martial art Geuk Cho Ho Kwon, which prospered during the Myoung dynasty and resurfaced as Western powers strive to use it.
dos:86f95a1176683c07.title: The Eye of Typhoon

dos:86febfc7b9690ff7.description: subLOGIC's football strategy and action game with full rosters of fictional players. Pick a play from quick menus, then control the action, alone or against a friend.
dos:86febfc7b9690ff7.title: Football (1986)

dos:870cc57c404c0b60.description: You are called to another world to defeat the evil Colnar and find the prism, with various pitfalls and real-time traps and monsters. A cartoon adventure with a text parser.
dos:870cc57c404c0b60.title: Questmaster I: The Prism of Heheutotol

dos:87117526c0ae7f8b.description: The fortified nation Outer Heaven threatens the West with the development of Metal Gear, a walking tank able to launch nuclear warheads, and you infiltrate it.
dos:87117526c0ae7f8b.title: Metal Gear

dos:8716e3cb1dbacff0.description: A soccer game with 4 independent sub-games, including 11-A-Side Soccer with the default rules and Indoor Soccer with five players per team.
dos:8716e3cb1dbacff0.title: 4 Soccer Simulators

dos:874339ab24d84341.description: A hotseat multi-player strategy game in which you build Barracks, Mining, Academic and Trading buildings, explore the map and defeat your opponent.
dos:874339ab24d84341.title: Fantasy Lord

dos:87452f999a9316e4.description: A side-scrolling shoot 'em up in which you explore 7 different planets, collecting pods to discover the secret of the 7th Planet.
dos:87452f999a9316e4.title: CyberGenic Ranger: Secret of the Seventh Planet

dos:87538f96aa88218a.description: A conversion of Taito's scrolling beat 'em up set on the streets of Brooklyn, where you meet your girlfriend and rescue her from kidnappers over five levels.
dos:87538f96aa88218a.title: Renegade

dos:875ea8570d84b7a1.description: In the 35th century mankind banished its Cyborg slaves to a distant star system after a war, and 500 years later you face their return in this first-person shooter.
dos:875ea8570d84b7a1.title: Rex Blade: The Apocalypse

dos:8775e6fa40269e70.description: A conversion of the casino game for up to six human players, challenging you to beat the dealer. Five predefined rule sets can be tweaked individually.
dos:8775e6fa40269e70.title: Championship Blackjack

dos:8779b01f21a00963.description: Rif of the Fox Tribe and his friend Rhene are falsely accused of stealing the Orb of Storms. Rif is released on condition that he finds the real culprit and recovers it.
dos:8779b01f21a00963.title: Inherit the Earth: Quest for the Orb

dos:877d65dd33bf604e.description: An adaptation of Battleship that parodies the collapse of the USSR, with a fictional conflict between the Russian Federation and Ukraine over the Black Sea. You command the Russian fleet.
dos:877d65dd33bf604e.title: The Battle on the Black Sea

dos:878d8d84222c8528.description: An educational game in which you help Snap Dragon and his friend Teddy Bear make a photo album. Choose one of six locations, sort items on screen and take shots to add photos.
dos:878d8d84222c8528.title: Snap Dragon

dos:878ec6179db07b78.description: A Pac-Man variant with a bird's eye view of each level. Navigate the maze eating pellets to advance and avoid the ghosts chasing you.
dos:878ec6179db07b78.title: Mad Mix Game

dos:879d94e9f5f8fecc.description: An educational title that teaches basic economic principles.
dos:879d94e9f5f8fecc.title: The Market Place

dos:87aaa4fe723f2e8a.description: In the near future, a group of mercenaries, the Mercenary Alliance, begins capturing oil fields in the Middle East and North Africa while the UN does nothing, and you fly the gunship to stop them.
dos:87aaa4fe723f2e8a.title: Cobra Gunship

dos:87ba9e3158210867.description: A sports-themed edition of the Jeopardy! quiz game show.
dos:87ba9e3158210867.title: Jeopardy! Sports Edition

dos:87c85b445d03c91a.description: An evil army of space soldiers has invaded a space station. As the fictional hero Bob Morane, recover the base by locating and destroying all the enemies in a multi-directional scrolling shooter.
dos:87c85b445d03c91a.title: Bob Morane: Science Fiction 1

dos:87d9ed2befbe19a2.description: A computer version of the Chinese board game weiqi, Go, with Chinese scoring rules. Either side can be human or computer, on 9x9, 13x13 and 19x19 boards.
dos:87d9ed2befbe19a2.title: TurboGo

dos:87e52be5e5a2da44.description: A Worlds of Ultima title that takes the Avatar to Eodon, an Amazonian world dominated by dinosaurs, with dozens of characters to interact with including stone-age tribes, mad scientists and lizardmen.
dos:87e52be5e5a2da44.title: Worlds of Ultima: The Savage Empire

dos:87e5f72a77d356f2.description: A snooker simulator named for champion Alex Higgins, with a top-down view of the table. Place the cue ball, then aim and adjust your shot.
dos:87e5f72a77d356f2.title: Alex Higgins' World Snooker

dos:87f28f4f9b2fd5ec.description: While the Sultan of Persia is at war, his Grand Vizier Jaffar stages a coup and kidnaps the Sultan's daughter. The man she loves is thrown into the dungeon and must escape and rescue her.
dos:87f28f4f9b2fd5ec.title: Prince of Persia

dos:87f928d3a82f701f.description: In 1193, after the Third Crusade, King Richard the Lionheart is ambushed and abducted by the Austrian duke Leopold, who demands a large ransom. You play Robin Hood in this adventure.
dos:87f928d3a82f701f.title: Conquests of the Longbow: The Legend of Robin Hood

dos:87fcecd8d95599dc.description: A shareware Risk-like game on a map of America, fought over states. It doesn't adhere to the rules of Risk; winning a battle earns propaganda cards.
dos:87fcecd8d95599dc.title: 1998 Amerika

dos:88061d125cf92628.description: The sequel to Life & Death. You play an up-and-coming surgeon who performs simulated surgery on patients, this time focusing on the brain instead of the abdomen.
dos:88061d125cf92628.title: Life & Death II: The Brain

dos:8818911dc24b4114.description: A space shuttle simulation balancing realism and playability, with 3D-modelled graphics, an in-game space database and one long campaign.
dos:8818911dc24b4114.title: E.S.S. Mega

dos:881b90c30d05a5d3.description: You decide to be a human guinea pig for a professor's computer, which generates a world from the computer's mind until the computer itself goes mad.
dos:881b90c30d05a5d3.title: Dr. Dumont's Wild P.A.R.T.I.

dos:88261cf72e6aeed7.description: An electronic version of Roulette. Join the table with a sum of money, place inside and outside bets against the bank, and play with up to four additional computer players.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Casino; Strategy
dos:88261cf72e6aeed7.title: Ruckus Roulette

dos:8829d117e1b8b51a.description: A multimedia interactive CD with mini-games, based on an IMAX documentary on historical figures who advanced science, from a book by Daniel Boorstin. The film is included in its entirety.
dos:8829d117e1b8b51a.title: The Discoverers

dos:882cc528a78d774c.description: As rebel forces close in on the space station Gallion, you launch strikes against enemy-controlled planets in the space fighter Thunder Cloud II, in action sequences in an Afterburner-like pseudo-3D view.
dos:882cc528a78d774c.title: Galactic Conqueror

dos:8838017a05682347.description: A DOS port of the 1989 Amiga game Mindbender and the C64 game Deflektor. Use a laser to destroy grey bubbles without overheating.
dos:8838017a05682347.title: Mirror Magic II

dos:883e44822544cd5d.description: A top-down maze shooter in the vein of Gauntlet and Alien Breed with economic elements, alternating between equipment management and a remote-controlled robot shooting mechanical enemies.
tags: Action; Shooter; Construction and Management Simulation
dos:883e44822544cd5d.title: The Machines

dos:884d7cec6949ce2d.description: Track Carmen's villains around the world, arrest them and ultimately arrest Carmen herself. Go to the country where the crime took place, then follow hints about where the thief went next.
dos:884d7cec6949ce2d.title: Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego?

dos:885133009796dc19.description: A top-down racing game like Micro Machines in which you control 4x4s, buggies, super sports cars and GP cars on 20 courses across five terrains, with two-player support.
dos:885133009796dc19.title: Overdrive

dos:8851adaf6911e20c.description: The city of Mittledorf is in chaos, oppressed by the King's evil cousin. When your cousin Sven disappears, you go there to find him in an RPG with an Ultima Underworld-like movement system.
dos:8851adaf6911e20c.title: Legends of Valour

dos:8858a72ba4c4df78.description: The only official expansion of Hexen. The protagonist picks up the Chaos Sphere and is transported to the realm of the dead, and must reach the citadel and slay the Death Kings.
dos:8858a72ba4c4df78.title: Hexen: Deathkings of the Dark Citadel

dos:8860b44acc15423d.description: The first entry in R. T. Smith's World War II trilogy, simulating the Allied assault to take the bridge at Arnhem in September 1944, with British, Irish, Welsh, Polish and American units against German forces.
dos:8860b44acc15423d.title: Arnhem: The 'Market Garden' Operation

dos:8870a52bfa071250.description: In the 2300s the Earth comes back to life after a great disaster. As leader of the New City, rally citizens, expand your power and found new cities in real time on a map of the USA or Europe.
dos:8870a52bfa071250.title: Survival

dos:8874528b534be35e.description: An updated version of White Wolf's Empire. One to six players, human or computer, compete to conquer the world with ground, air and sea units, in basic, standard and advanced versions.
dos:8874528b534be35e.title: Empire Deluxe

dos:887cc0e6b79b8167.description: One of the most challenging logic games from Soleau Software, with three parts of 40 levels each. There are no enemies and no time limit; each level is a separate screen puzzle.
dos:887cc0e6b79b8167.title: Aqua Man

dos:8884dcf5d4a8cf1d.description: A complex and detailed football simulation with European and domestic cups, team kits and computer-controlled teams.
dos:8884dcf5d4a8cf1d.title: Football Masters 98

dos:888ad2919cce1417.description: A real-time strategic warfare game in which you manage large armies, economic capital and political stability across extra-dimensional star systems as the ruler of the Epsilon Galaxy.
dos:888ad2919cce1417.title: Overlord (1990)

dos:888f4ac8babe37e3.description: An interactive story book by Richard Scarry. Explore Busytown with the mouse, from building a house with construction tools to delivering something to repair a ship.
dos:888f4ac8babe37e3.title: Richard Scarry's Busytown

dos:889508c12b6068e9.description: A driving simulation of all the stages of the Lombard RAC Rally, with day and night stages, fog and snow, and a workshop to repair and tweak your car.
dos:889508c12b6068e9.title: Lombard RAC Rally

dos:889b64d7b88f7acb.description: A shareware simulation of a nuclear power station. Maintain a stable reaction and generate electricity by manipulating the control rods and the primary and secondary cooling pumps.
dos:889b64d7b88f7acb.title: The Oakflat Nuclear Power Plant Simulator

dos:88a9bdcda7d32801.description: A long-running stock market trading game for one to five players with the computer optionally taking a role. Set the difficulty and the number of game years at the start.
dos:88a9bdcda7d32801.title: Wall $treet Raider

dos:88b1257b67fb766e.description: A puzzle game in which you play a ball jumping along tiles hanging in space. Jump across each tile so it repaints white, with a limited supply of energy.
dos:88b1257b67fb766e.title: System-4: Mister Tengus Adventure

dos:88ba085c16fbb87e.description: A Spanish-language adventure in which Gaston Miller tries to locate the Peruvian Idol.
dos:88ba085c16fbb87e.title: Gaston Miller

dos:88bfbd0311a72da6.description: An educational game for children aged 3 to 7. Complete a rainbow by solving number problems with groups of balloons.
dos:88bfbd0311a72da6.title: Learn to Add

dos:88f096e4b3ef2521.description: A racing game with sixteen experimental cars on ten tracks ranging from Mid-Ohio to a Mayan temple and downtown Seattle. Cars can be tweaked, tuned and overhauled.
dos:88f096e4b3ef2521.title: XCar: Experimental Racing

dos:88f360464ca08cba.description: A board game in which you transport all nine of your balls to the opposite corner, moving a chip in a straight line or diagonally or jumping over a neighbor, taking turns.
dos:88f360464ca08cba.title: From Corner to Corner

dos:88f76d7ce94f73b4.description: A text adventure set in Newark, Delaware, in which you are a student of the English Language Institute with many things to do over a weekend, including classwork due on Monday.
dos:88f76d7ce94f73b4.title: Weekend Survival

dos:88fb134bde7231dd.description: A photo safari shooter similar to Safari Guns with new scenarios (America, Arctic, India and Australia). In each level you must photograph three animals by aiming a crosshair, like Operation Wolf.
dos:88fb134bde7231dd.title: Wild Life

dos:890f95dac5eb9835.description: A captured resistance member must escape Madame Ching's palace on the planet Tralfaz. Search the maze for keys and supplies while managing a rising status meter.
dos:890f95dac5eb9835.title: Madame Ching's Palace of Pleasure

dos:8911401628324057.description: Zulula is a town in the land of Akistar famous for fighting tournaments. Creatures and warriors enter to prove their worth, while evil plots below.
dos:8911401628324057.title: Champions of Zulula

dos:891c3b1425207f88.description: The first of Westwood's Kyrandia trilogy. You play Brandon, grandson of the wizard Kallak, against Malcolm, a jester imprisoned in the past who has broken free and wants revenge.
dos:891c3b1425207f88.title: The Legend of Kyrandia: Book One

dos:8922df4c6b7671d1.description: A Front Mission clone: an isometric turn-based strategy game with mechs and some RPG elements, with text split between English and Taiwanese.
dos:8922df4c6b7671d1.title: Ultimate Mission

dos:8928c1cf871d1bb2.description: Part two of Boulder Dash: mine diamonds while avoiding falling rocks and cave monsters, with more puzzle elements added in later levels.
dos:8928c1cf871d1bb2.title: Boulder Dash II: Rockford's Revenge

dos:892b0d0aefcdfd75.description: The evil demon lord Vissuluth has taken control of the realms of the Netherworld, and the magician Kafkar sends his apprentice, you, to stand up to him in this flying first-person shooter.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Flight Simulator; Vehicle Simulation
dos:892b0d0aefcdfd75.title: Magic Carpet 2: The Netherworlds

dos:892f6b5e6387f0c2.description: A single-player freeware game issued for other companies to give to customers as a freebie. Guide an aircraft on the left of the screen over a scrolling landscape.
dos:892f6b5e6387f0c2.title: Moraff's Flygame

dos:893b453e84bb0331.description: A Centipede variant for one or two players clearing a mushroom patch of Fleas, Spiders, Scorpions and the Centipede, with difficulty levels and Classic or Champ modes.
dos:893b453e84bb0331.title: CHAMP Centiped-em

dos:895993d2d3d3de0b.description: Earth's water supply has been tainted by industrial contamination and the remaining unspoiled water converted into stable water crystals. Planetary defenses weakened, and you fight on in this RPG.
dos:895993d2d3d3de0b.title: Operation: Overkill II

dos:895f178b802c3909.description: A collection of 6 card games: Spades, Hearts, Gin Rummy, Oh Hell!, Whist and Crazy 8's, with 12 opponents of different skills who may advise you, and replay of game progress.
dos:895f178b802c3909.title: Ultimate Cards

dos:896036d7c8dce428.description: A shareware coloring game for young children using pre-drawn templates and figures. Selecting an animal shows its name in big letters and a voice says it.
dos:896036d7c8dce428.title: Bert's Dinosaurs

dos:896cf7cf15aba5aa.description: A golf simulation from Arc Developments licensed around Nick Faldo, with a 3D engine, two courses plus a hidden 9-hole course on Mars with reduced gravity, and 8 computer players.
dos:896cf7cf15aba5aa.title: Nick Faldo's Championship Golf

dos:896dd4338979f9ea.description: A simple Polish platform game in which you can only walk, with no jumping. Gather all the treasures in each chamber, avoiding bats and obstacles, and open doors.
dos:896dd4338979f9ea.title: Przygody Krzysia

dos:89819f174f4f503c.description: A flight game set in a San Francisco ravaged by an orange death smog layer called the Killing Cloud, hovering around the middle of the skyscrapers for a claustrophobic low-level experience.
dos:89819f174f4f503c.title: Killing Cloud

dos:8991246b9ee8b99a.description: The sequel to Cannon Fodder. Guide a team of soldiers through levels of trees, huts and lakes, with a plot involving time travel.
dos:8991246b9ee8b99a.title: Cannon Fodder 2

dos:89991cb9dd4ef172.description: A platformer where you play a simpleton and must get through platform levels while keeping yourself and your pet dog safe. The game scrolls from right to left with the dog following.
dos:89991cb9dd4ef172.title: Doofus

dos:899d9f7b4f8be466.description: Based on the comics series, you play Lucky Luke and must arrest the four Dalton brothers, Averell, William, Jack and Joe, shooting bad cowboys, jail-breakers and bandits along the way.
dos:899d9f7b4f8be466.title: Lucky Luke (1997)

dos:899e30b6678f0e3e.description: A scrolling shoot 'em up written in BASIC that fuses Gradius-style play with the wire-frame look of Asteroids, in black and white, across space and hordes of aliens.
dos:899e30b6678f0e3e.title: Mono Space

dos:89a8e460dc1401d5.description: A fly-around space shoot 'em up with elements of the arcade game Star Castle. Destroy the shields around the Star Fortress and then its energy cannon while avoiding its defenses.
dos:89a8e460dc1401d5.title: Star Fortress

dos:89b4fcd795b7230c.description: A clone of Centipede. A centipede forms at the top of the screen and moves down; control a small droid that shoots it before it reaches the bottom.
dos:89b4fcd795b7230c.title: The Exterminator

dos:89bdde8e91378887.description: Arcade driving action from an overhead view. Your car has machine guns to get past enemies on the road, without shooting civilians, and you can pick up weapons from a weapons van.
dos:89bdde8e91378887.title: Spy Hunter

dos:89c18b55d9a95ea9.description: A first-person adventure and shooter developed by Gremlin Interactive, using the 3D engine borrowed from its game Normality.
dos:89c18b55d9a95ea9.title: Realms of the Haunting

dos:89c958eff92932aa.description: A first-person RPG set in the eight kingdoms of Tessara. As a dying priest, you set out to find and wake N'Gnir, an Old God rumored to slumber in one of them, across 94 landscapes.
dos:89c958eff92932aa.title: Sleeping Gods Lie

dos:89d52b987e78f3c3.description: The only game on The Puzzle Gallery engine, similar to Are We There Yet? and The Fool's Errand, with word searches, jigsaws, block puzzles, crosswords, cryptograms and mazes.
dos:89d52b987e78f3c3.title: At the Carnival

dos:89d701d7bc6b169e.description: An arcade conversion in which you guide a frog across a treacherous road and river to safety at the top of the screen, past cars, trucks and other hazards that cost a life.
dos:89d701d7bc6b169e.title: Frogger

dos:89dc8769cfed69c1.description: A puzzle game in which you control a small black ball with the mouse and bounce it against blocks displaying a symbol, then find the matching symbol, a mix of Marble Madness and Memory.
dos:89dc8769cfed69c1.title: Oxyd Extra

dos:89f88ddd8e6712a6.description: Set in the time of Desert Storm, you play the Iraqi or Coalition forces as a General Officer, discovering the plans of a battle staff and changing plans, paths and formations before the action begins.
dos:89f88ddd8e6712a6.title: Patriot

dos:89fa378561d42403.description: A licensed American football game, played in real time with many coaching options. Unlike its predecessor NFL Football you can choose all the NFL teams.
dos:89fa378561d42403.title: NFL 94

dos:89fae6bf29c9fb94.description: A side-scrolling platformer starring Jazz, who must survive three areas of Holidaius fighting mongrels, monkeys, ski turtles and devils, with Christmas-themed graphics.
dos:89fae6bf29c9fb94.title: Jazz Jackrabbit: Holiday Hare 1994

dos:8a1b6be9ae955a25.description: Drive sports cars such as the Dodge Viper, Lamborghini, Ferrari, Porsche, Corvette, Mazda RX7, Toyota Supra Turbo and Acura NSX through fast tracks, with cops in hot pursuit on open roads.
dos:8a1b6be9ae955a25.title: The Need for Speed

dos:8a2e9ad999b4391b.description: The sequel to Crystals of Arborea. Morgoth and Morgula's child Krogh, based in the fortress Ishar, plans to reduce the population of Kendoria.
dos:8a2e9ad999b4391b.title: Ishar: Legend of the Fortress

dos:8a36a00d643438d9.description: A simple maze navigation game with random screens in 10 skill levels. Start in the middle of the left wall and find a path to the right side against the clock, leaving a trail of dots.
dos:8a36a00d643438d9.title: Maze

dos:8a419cd76480bc28.description: A pinball game boasting the largest table ever created, the 99-level Wasteland, along with two smaller ones, and three game modes including Adventure.
dos:8a419cd76480bc28.title: Living Ball

dos:8a4a21ac234d3b8e.description: A futuristic hover car racing game in the line of Wipeout, using a modified Magic Carpet 2 engine. Steer and fire a minigun, missiles or charge the booster.
dos:8a4a21ac234d3b8e.title: Hi-Octane

dos:8a4b49112331fa45.description: A spin-off of Sir-Tech's Wizardry universe. Find your true heritage and save the world from unspeakable evil, exploring a huge, fully rendered world.
dos:8a4b49112331fa45.title: Nemesis: The Wizardry Adventure

dos:8a51ea52eafba625.description: A freeware Tetris clone with ten starting levels and adjustable game speed for different processors.
dos:8a51ea52eafba625.title: The Soviet Block

dos:8a540f4de05d8027.description: A fixed-screen vertical shoot 'em up close to Space Invaders with diverse opponents in waves with a clear order of battle and intense firing.
dos:8a540f4de05d8027.title: Astro Blaster

dos:8a589c02090008af.description: A turn-based maritime strategy game about pirate ship battles at sea, with no tie to historical events, for two to fourteen players, human or computer.
dos:8a589c02090008af.title: Captured by Pirates!

dos:8a5aad313e125885.description: A tank simulator on the Comanche 3 engine, using NovaLogic's VoxelSpace technology to model the US Army's M1A2 Abrams main battle tank over realistic terrain.
dos:8a5aad313e125885.title: Armored Fist 2

dos:8a60300ec2209c19.description: A shareware backgammon game against the computer, entirely keyboard controlled, with a history of the game, rules and detailed instructions.
dos:8a60300ec2209c19.title: Backgammon (1985)

dos:8a65390a9aaee326.description: The first EcoQuest game. Adam tries to help a dolphin his father has rescued and sets out to find Cetus, the whale king of the underwater kingdom Eluria.
dos:8a65390a9aaee326.title: EcoQuest I: The Search for Cetus

dos:8a69a0acba3741a6.description: An RPG set in the realm of Midkemia, where elves, dwarves and man once battled an unimaginable evil across rifts in time and space, starting with a boy named Pug.
dos:8a69a0acba3741a6.title: Betrayal at Krondor

dos:8a72c4ad26096b01.description: A Space Harrier-like 3D arcade shooter for one or two players with eight characters from various Family Production games, including the ships from Illusion Blaze and the heroes from Pee & Gity.
dos:8a72c4ad26096b01.title: Olmang Jolmang Paradise

dos:8a7698303a901bac.description: A cross-country racing game from New York to Pennsylvania against the clock, the course and obstacles, in which you earn money and buy things for your car.
dos:8a7698303a901bac.title: Fastrack

dos:8a76ccd876eaa7b5.description: A very simple fixed screen shooter in which you move left and right and fire at a fairly static enemy.
dos:8a76ccd876eaa7b5.title: Fighter (2003)

dos:8a78e934ae02537a.description: You play two adventurers, with two more to recruit, who have just returned from fighting an evil enemy in Icewind Dale when a drow raid searching for Drizzt attacks their village and takes hostages.
dos:8a78e934ae02537a.title: Menzoberranzan

dos:8a87ebe4f6cfaafc.description: A Korean horizontal shoot 'em up in which you play an angel, with an all-Korean story.
dos:8a87ebe4f6cfaafc.title: Shit Fighter

dos:8a8cbf612f4c61e5.description: The Blodroid Empire has launched a mass attack on Earth, and you fly your Astrohunter through hostile territory to destroy the single generator powering all its ships' shields.
dos:8a8cbf612f4c61e5.title: Star Dust

dos:8a96630435cc1859.description: Set in the fourth millennium, you must rebuild the Human Empire, starting as a young lieutenant given missions, advancing in rank and getting more ships and commands.
dos:8a96630435cc1859.title: Imperium Galactica

dos:8a97deadd7f4fc78.description: A simulation of off-road motorcycle races. In championship mode you control a 125cc motorcycle in leagues on different continents, creating your rider and tuning your bike.
dos:8a97deadd7f4fc78.title: International Moto X

dos:8a9adea4597410b6.description: An F1 racing game based on actual F1 race data, with official cars, drivers and courses, 2-player split screen, LAN multiplayer and support for steering wheels and joysticks.
dos:8a9adea4597410b6.title: Power F1

dos:8ab4f3ac9bd7f178.description: A game that teaches the alphabet through fun animations.
dos:8ab4f3ac9bd7f178.title: The Animated Alphabet

dos:8ac39b9502c21bba.description: A computer board game on a fold-out hex map in war-gaming style, split into four countries with varied terrain. Command four armored divisions to destroy the enemy's bases.
dos:8ac39b9502c21bba.title: Tank Attack

dos:8ac6484468988a83.description: Xiao Jianren discovers his connection to an ancient alien race and must stop a new struggle for Earth. Choose attack and defense commands in timed turn-based fights, or select characters for one- or two-player versus battles.
dos:8ac6484468988a83.title: L-MAN

dos:8acbbe2a93c28f25.description: Janosik stands up to greedy nobles in the Carpathian Mountains. When the baron Herburt captures his love Maryna, Janosik must free her from the castle in this platformer.
dos:8acbbe2a93c28f25.title: Janosik

dos:8acfd7a5dc0ce150.description: An Infocom interactive adaptation of James Clavell's novel in which you play John Blackthorne, the first Englishman to set foot on Japanese soil.
dos:8acfd7a5dc0ce150.title: James Clavell's Shogun (1989)

dos:8b042b0b575d7332.description: A computer version of the Wheel of Fortune TV game show for up to three players, who spin the wheel and guess letters to solve word puzzles.
dos:8b042b0b575d7332.title: Wheel of Fortune: Third Edition

dos:8b2b9f417a9d1b84.description: An update of the hardcore Falcon flight simulation from Spectrum Holobyte, with better missions and the ability to fly in an 8-plane force, linked to another computer by dialup modem or network.
dos:8b2b9f417a9d1b84.title: Falcon 3.0

dos:8b4201188c602ec7.description: A Chinese Checkers game, jump chess, with Chinese themes in which the computer players are named for deities of the ancient Chinese pantheon.
dos:8b4201188c602ec7.title: Tiào Ch'i

dos:8b6bd85c47e264d5.description: An operational-level simulation of Rommel's North African Campaign of WWII, from March 1941 to February 1943 in 12 two-month turns, sweeping across the northern coast of Africa.
dos:8b6bd85c47e264d5.title: Knights of the Desert: The North African Campaign of 1941-43

dos:8b72010b3bd53164.description: An interactive book teaching basic facts about baby animals through mini-games like Who Am I?, which shows part of an animal photograph, and a photo safari.
dos:8b72010b3bd53164.title: Kid's Zoo: A Baby Animal Adventure

dos:8b74281aa54132f6.description: A maze action game loosely like Pac-Man, with different maze layouts and monsters on each level. Instead of eating dots, flip the blue squares to red by walking over them.
dos:8b74281aa54132f6.title: Fluf!

dos:8b7510e46d84539e.description: A children's adventure in which you open a manhole and find a gigantic beanstalk that leads to fantastic worlds.
dos:8b7510e46d84539e.title: The Manhole

dos:8b7d7be7916dd937.description: A CD-ROM adventure based on Arthur Conan Doyle's novel, presented as a dressed-up electronic book version of the story.
dos:8b7d7be7916dd937.title: Hound of the Baskervilles

dos:8b806720a09e6d64.description: You control the ninja Shinobi, battling through each level to rescue hostages with shurikens, kicks, punches and powerful ninja magic that clears the screen of enemies.
dos:8b806720a09e6d64.title: Shinobi

dos:8b86b00b8c447cb2.description: A game of reversi in which the objective is to cover more squares on the board with your pieces.
dos:8b86b00b8c447cb2.title: Flippit (1989)

dos:8b878d1ff801b205.description: An adventure based on Nickelodeon's TV series, telling a mystery tale with full motion video, 3D animation and actors from the show.
dos:8b878d1ff801b205.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark? The Tale of Orpheo's Curse

dos:8b946f64ba2076e8.description: A tongue-in-cheek text adventure that starts you in unfamiliar territory. Muddle along until you discover what you must do to win.
dos:8b946f64ba2076e8.title: Trouble at the Quatt Wunkery

dos:8b95bee33ceb1359.description: An interactive movie based on the TV series, starring R.J., Spence and Martin Brubaker, built around the supersonic boat Thunder.
dos:8b95bee33ceb1359.title: Thunder in Paradise Interactive

dos:8b96081538ada1cb.description: A collection of simple puzzles accompanied by photographic images.
dos:8b96081538ada1cb.title: Femme Fatale

dos:8badaa139264f7bc.description: A freeware Puzzle Bobble-style game in which a cannon fires colored fruit at a stack at the top of the screen. Three or more of the same color explode for bonus points, on timed levels.
dos:8badaa139264f7bc.title: Fruit Salad

dos:8bc252540df4256d.description: A ball and paddle game with three modes: Brick Walls, Falling Walls and Super Blast, for one or two players or the computer, with keyboard, mouse or joystick control.
dos:8bc252540df4256d.title: Moraff's Super Blast

dos:8bcd4af510d4c508.description: Move a cup back and forth catching gifts from God while avoiding evil objects like money.
dos:8bcd4af510d4c508.title: Every Good and Perfect Gift

dos:8bd5ed513b03c4ac.description: Play Homey D. Clown from In Living Color, guiding him through a typical day on the streets of New York and using his sock to bop annoying people, in a point-and-click game.
dos:8bd5ed513b03c4ac.title: Homey D. Clown

dos:8bd60d8f84fce549.description: A first-person action game in which you explore the maze-like levels of an alien spacecraft in 3D vector graphics, evading robots that blast intruders, destroying power generators and escaping.
dos:8bd60d8f84fce549.title: Voyager I: Sabotage of the Robot Ship

dos:8bd619fac804c86f.description: Two players each control a one-pixel flea, moving, jumping and firing at each other until one runs out of life.
dos:8bd619fac804c86f.title: Flea Wars

dos:8be22324eece123c.description: A simulation of video poker machines with six variants, including Jacks or Better, the most popular, and Joker Poker, which adds a Joker card.
dos:8be22324eece123c.title: Poker Galore

dos:8be41ac19966bd41.description: In the year 5069 A.D., aliens have devastated Earth. Its last hope is a Biomech cyborg who travels through five realms to destroy the alien menace.
dos:8be41ac19966bd41.title: Alien Terminator

dos:8bf6d2da65f9737c.description: Guide a projectile-firing hero through 10 levels in the DOS version, with little, big and Really Big shots, in this early first-person-style action game.
dos:8bf6d2da65f9737c.title: Catacomb

dos:8c0962f14d1bcd70.description: Usually considered the first roguelike with a traditional plot. You play a person from Earth transported to another world by the Omega Project.
dos:8c0962f14d1bcd70.title: Omega

dos:8c1b6a4a64d8a7fd.description: The sequel to Mad TV in which you run a TV station, taking care of employees, the TV schedule and advertisements, in cartoonish graphics.
dos:8c1b6a4a64d8a7fd.title: Mad TV 2

dos:8c1f7d427794f6d5.description: A Worms-like artillery strategy game in the vein of Tank Wars and Scorched Earth.
dos:8c1f7d427794f6d5.title: Duck Mr Duck

dos:8c212d71dc9fb37f.description: A simulation of an 8-way pay slot machine. Start with $100, bet 1 to 8 dollars with the space bar and pull the handle with Enter.
dos:8c212d71dc9fb37f.title: SLOT-8

dos:8c2e005b82bb4829.description: As an interplanetary secret agent, roam the galaxy in a fuel-conscious space ship with only 500 gallons to the nearest planet in this text adventure.
dos:8c2e005b82bb4829.title: The Tracer Sanction

dos:8c3b684845e917d7.description: An update of NetWars released with OpenDOS, with more advanced graphics. Take the cockpit of a space fighter for networked combat over IPX.
dos:8c3b684845e917d7.title: Advanced NetWars

dos:8c3c33a0f3c0dd2e.description: A DOS Tetris clone for one to six players using the numeric keypad to move and rotate falling blocks; complete a row without gaps and it disappears.
dos:8c3c33a0f3c0dd2e.title: Tommy's Nyet

dos:8c540fbbcb1a4d31.description: A book and disk package with 24 new Doom levels, no new weapons, with a detailed guide to the levels and stories.
dos:8c540fbbcb1a4d31.title: The Lost Episodes of Doom

dos:8c5b290396b832ed.description: A scrolling shoot 'em up in which aliens want to kill the human race. Earth has been decimated and humans have only one fighter ship left.
dos:8c5b290396b832ed.title: Ultra Violent Worlds

dos:8c660b53d75d71a7.description: A puzzle game from Soleau Software, the only one of its kind they made.
dos:8c660b53d75d71a7.title: Bloxit

dos:8c68cf70b1b34451.description: A wrestling game in which you play Triple H and must win the attention of Stephanie McMahon while Kurt Angle tries to do the same, with wrestlers like The Rock, Edge & Christian and Mick Foley.
dos:8c68cf70b1b34451.title: THAT Love Triangle

dos:8c6ae8b1a4969404.description: A version of the old Norse board game King's Table. The black and white teams have different pieces; white has 13, led by Odin the King, who starts in the center of the 10x10 board.
dos:8c6ae8b1a4969404.title: King's Table: The Legend of Ragnarok

dos:8c8603038354f6b3.description: A turn-based wargame of the US Civil War, played against the computer or a person, in which divisions move between key points, namely cities.
dos:8c8603038354f6b3.title: VGA Civil War Strategy

dos:8c91c519c15ebb93.description: You are the newly promoted Guildmaster, the world's greatest adventurer, in a strange underground world inhabited by an entire race of people, with danger around every corner.
dos:8c91c519c15ebb93.title: The Great Ultizurkian Underland

dos:8cb697dcd45e1501.description: An adventure in Silverload, an Old West mining town that was once a silver boom-town and is now a ghost town surrounded by perpetual storms, after an earthquake and perhaps an Indian curse.
dos:8cb697dcd45e1501.title: Silverload

dos:8cc2764b97e9ab8d.description: An interstellar space war simulator. As a Lyran, build up your forces by constructing bases and hunting the invading Morte Star Empire to drive them out of the sector.
dos:8cc2764b97e9ab8d.title: Facing the Empire

dos:8cc674ca844bcd5c.description: A Spanish platformer in which Eco-Kid sets off to save the Amazon forest.
dos:8cc674ca844bcd5c.title: Eco-Kid: Amazonia Conection

dos:8cc9418f143af2a4.description: A Space Invaders-style shooter against eleven different waves of aliens that recur over infinite levels. You move horizontally and to a limited degree vertically, with a shield on a button.
dos:8cc9418f143af2a4.title: Galactic Battle (1990)

dos:8cccf94dcf463334.description: A one- or two-player shareware implementation of Tetris and Vertris (Columns) on a vertically split screen.
dos:8cccf94dcf463334.title: Ultris: The Ultimate Tetris

dos:8ce92e8383b91383.description: A shareware logic puzzle in which King Triangulos of the kingdom Bentangle loves blocks nearly as much as his daughter, Princess Pentaguin.
dos:8ce92e8383b91383.title: Block-Man 1

dos:8ce93a76f567e57d.description: A word processor teaching children to write and print words, sentences and stories, with help from Big Bird, Cookie Monster, Oscar the Grouch and Elmo.
dos:8ce93a76f567e57d.title: Sesame Street: First Writer

dos:8cfd2af9cf4983c8.description: A rare French Pang-style game in which a little man with green hair in the mohawk style, in outer space without a spacesuit, destroys bouncing balloons with blaster shots.
dos:8cfd2af9cf4983c8.title: Bang

dos:8d014d22be2d6a18.description: A text adventure in which you are stuck in a seemingly haunted house and must solve puzzles and riddles to find your way out, meeting others in the house.
dos:8d014d22be2d6a18.title: Final Soul

dos:8d01c10d62d4d6a7.description: A shareware jigsaw puzzle game that divides the picture into shuffled rectangles. Version 1.1 has four pictures and four levels of difficulty, starting with a kids level that breaks it into a 3x3 grid.
dos:8d01c10d62d4d6a7.title: PC Jigsaw

dos:8d0f04f15cd07700.description: A space battle game where you go head to head with the computer or another player, spending cash to build up your fleet from various ships, in tournament-style brackets.
dos:8d0f04f15cd07700.title: Elite Fighters

dos:8d17644552f4258e.description: A shareware Tetris clone with redefinable keys, an optional next-piece display and a choice of regular, small, large, wide or skinny blocks.
dos:8d17644552f4258e.title: SITris

dos:8d17b37280f51f0a.description: A satirical side-scrolling beat 'em up in which you play Gewt Ningrich, a parody politician racked with corruption allegations who needs to raise cash to stay in power.
dos:8d17b37280f51f0a.title: The Politically Incorrect Adventures of Gewt Ningrich

dos:8d1a3e5d26212dac.description: A small racing and sports game in which you control a mountain bike through twelve time-limited tracks, adjusting your speed and pressing jump at obstacles.
dos:8d1a3e5d26212dac.title: Mountain Bike Racer

dos:8d227cc47ca9518b.description: A re-edition of Actua Soccer with the 20 teams of the English Premiership instead of international competitions, with new commentary and some historical Premiership data.
dos:8d227cc47ca9518b.title: Actua Soccer: Club Edition

dos:8d24ebb0997ae64a.description: Moving the Cauldron series forward, you play a witch negotiating four worlds, each split into small chunks and populated by bats, trolls and snakes.
dos:8d24ebb0997ae64a.title: Super Cauldron

dos:8d2cb2e60666701c.description: A simple two-player, human or computer, volleyball-like game in which you bang the ball so it hits the opposing player's ground. A round is lost if the ball touches the ground or a player touches it three times.
dos:8d2cb2e60666701c.title: Arcade Volleyball

dos:8d57b7865970e029.description: A top-down space shooter in the style of Galaxian and Galaga. Move along the bottom of the screen, avoiding enemy ships and shots while launching your own attacks.
dos:8d57b7865970e029.title: Galacta: The Battle for Saturn

dos:8d616200fbca895d.description: The Demon King defeats you, the First Samurai, and your master, who with his last breath summons the Wizard Mage. You are sent back in time to fight the Demon King in this action platformer.
dos:8d616200fbca895d.title: First Samurai

dos:8d69930ebaf25ec5.description: A mix of Rogue and Doom: you are a soldier performing monotonous duties in a space base on Phobos when the invasion from Hell begins, in a roguelike dungeon crawl.
dos:8d69930ebaf25ec5.title: DOOM, the Roguelike

dos:8d6a6995c5f99080.description: A first-person fantasy RPG and dungeon crawler.
dos:8d6a6995c5f99080.title: Revolt of Don's Knights

dos:8d6f8e5e28fab099.description: A compilation of four arcade games about the US operation in the Middle East: first-person shooting, chasing a truck by tank, defending the base from the air force and more.
dos:8d6f8e5e28fab099.title: Desert Storm Command Deluxe

dos:8d75446fc0f31151.description: An educational adventure of 7 different games in one, carrying a message to children about the deception in cigarette advertising and the dangers of tobacco use, with prizes for a perfect score.
dos:8d75446fc0f31151.title: Puffwort's Evil Scheme

dos:8d80d348c45bf991.description: Giant dill-pickle aliens are about to conquer the human colony of Arcadia, and only Dave, armed with a Salad Shooter, can face them by finding ancient weapons in this platformer.
dos:8d80d348c45bf991.title: Pickle Wars

dos:8d8710f68de9c500.description: A strategy game based on the Wing Commander universe in which you command the Terran or Kilrathi empire in a bid to conquer a sector of space, with a tactical Armada mode and a quick play mode.
dos:8d8710f68de9c500.title: Wing Commander Armada

dos:8da2dfed621c08c2.description: A DOS Mario platformer with 5 levels, good graphics and gameplay, and unusual controls.
dos:8da2dfed621c08c2.title: Super Mario World DX

dos:8dade2b71d21e4d9.description: An ASCII maze and adventure game, also known as Amaze, in which you find your way through the maze collecting items, avoiding enemies and picking up clues.
dos:8dade2b71d21e4d9.title: Insanity

dos:8daf47386ccf0b0f.description: A series of multi-player BBS door games that put RPG trappings in an elementary school cafeteria. Players throw food at each other instead of fighting to the death.
dos:8daf47386ccf0b0f.title: Food Fight

dos:8db26136b528359b.description: Set in the Tri-Island Area of the Caribbean, months after The Secret of Monkey Island. Guybrush Threepwood hangs from a rope above a hole narrating events to Elaine Marley, then flashes back.
dos:8db26136b528359b.title: Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge

dos:8db54c80e52185a9.description: A platform game inspired by Flashback.
dos:8db54c80e52185a9.title: Logan’s Fight

dos:8dbb0357e5e40f42.description: An implementation of the sliding-block puzzle 2048 squashed into 256 bytes of executable code, written in assembly, with source included.
dos:8dbb0357e5e40f42.title: 2048x2048

dos:8dbb5e5585f3a1ea.description: A text-mode BASIC game in which you gobble up dots in a large room without getting caught by four patrolling enemies. Four side tunnels help you outsmart them.
dos:8dbb5e5585f3a1ea.title: Gobble Man (1982)

dos:8dbc398e6dcbf0a4.description: The least known mini-wargame from Impressions Games, about a battle between regular American troops and Mexican bandits in 1880 in the Wild West during the gold rush.
dos:8dbc398e6dcbf0a4.title: Fort Apache

dos:8dce4fd2c9558e32.description: A shareware game combining Missile Command-style play with a typing tutor. Command a missile base in Kansas where each incoming missile has a number or letter to type.
dos:8dce4fd2c9558e32.title: Tommy's Silo

dos:8ddafdb1e595cb9c.description: A text adventure structured as a treasure hunt, but instead of objects you recruit party members. It is 28 AD and your name is Jesus.
dos:8ddafdb1e595cb9c.title: Jesus of Nazareth

dos:8ddcebb5dd8f5312.description: A point-and-click adventure developed by Synthetic Dimensions and released by Psygnosis in 1996, based on Arthurian legends, originally titled King Arthur: The Quest of The Fair Unknown.
dos:8ddcebb5dd8f5312.title: Chronicles of the Sword

dos:8ddef62db597b4ff.description: The sequel to Barbarian: the Wizard Drax is back, but this time the princess you saved has taken up a sword to join you. Explore the tunnels of his dungeon and defeat monsters.
dos:8ddef62db597b4ff.title: Axe of Rage

dos:8df571caaa7c131e.description: An action-oriented fantasy RPG in which Zeus chooses you to leave the Land of the Gods and become mortal on Earth, configuring lifepoints for intelligence, charisma, strength and other traits.
dos:8df571caaa7c131e.title: Cavequest

dos:8e161d7ad77f92b7.description: An educational action game in which you are Daffy Duck, Private Investigator. Letters have escaped from their words, and you must find them and fill in the words.
dos:8e161d7ad77f92b7.title: Daffy Duck, P.I.: The Case of the Missing Letters

dos:8e183b9d32435a26.description: The Cybercon III computer was built to look after the world but killed people instead, leaving the world in chaos. As one of the few survivors, you must destroy it.
dos:8e183b9d32435a26.title: Cybercon III

dos:8e1c0698804590fe.description: In 2005, Mortal Coil is a covert agency of undercover mercenaries funded by governments, sent to investigate sabotage and terrorist attacks on research installations. A team-based first-person shooter.
dos:8e1c0698804590fe.title: Mortal Coil: Adrenalin Intelligence

dos:8e3e3c66271a7e0c.description: A reflex game for one player against the computer or another person. Finish off your opponent by knocking him off the platforms or making a platform disappear, throwing a disc as your weapon.
dos:8e3e3c66271a7e0c.title: Disc

dos:8e48945553b32f89.description: You are a NASA explorer sent to investigate a newly discovered star system and collect specimens from the new galaxy.
dos:8e48945553b32f89.title: Nebula

dos:8e615ea922ae714e.description: A shareware Mahjong game playable with keyboard or mouse that plays like the card game Gin, in which you accumulate straights or runs to win.
dos:8e615ea922ae714e.title: Hong Kong Mahjong

dos:8e643231fe6dca28.description: Set during the collapse of the Soviet Union, you control a Soviet tank exploring Vilnius and Baku to rescue all Russian citizens while rebel armies attack, in an overhead view.
dos:8e643231fe6dca28.title: Soviet

dos:8e68d608cf405c87.description: A multiplayer 3D tank game paying homage to Battlezone, with a capture-the-flag mode and futuristic graphics. It updates the original Spectre with better graphics and more tank types.
dos:8e68d608cf405c87.title: Spectre VR

dos:8e7d75ed2c76acbc.description: A parody by Finnish programmers of a day in the life of Bill Gates, in which you start with a pile of cash and decide how to allocate it among big business decisions.
dos:8e7d75ed2c76acbc.title: Micro$oft Simulator

dos:8e7e8efb318191bf.description: A fan-made DOS version of Puzzle Bobble that stays true to the original, with some music tracks copied from famous Disney songs.
dos:8e7e8efb318191bf.title: Puzzle Bobble

dos:8e90b010c820bc83.description: An interactive fiction in which you must unravel the mystery of why you ended up on a lonely beach beside a man who eats only locusts and honey, and find the parchments in a haunted, magical setting.
dos:8e90b010c820bc83.title: Fetter's Grim: How I Became a Zombified Hitman for Jesus

dos:8ea0e282ceb657da.description: As in the film, the melting of the polar ice caps has flooded the world. As the leader of a group of survivors, complete 22 missions of real-time strategy.
dos:8ea0e282ceb657da.title: Waterworld

dos:8eafbb3894f38bd4.description: The Need for Speed Special Edition adds new cars and tracks, changeable time of day, 8-player network and modem support and Windows 95 support. Drive 8 cars including the Lamborghini Diablo VT and Ferrari 512TR.
dos:8eafbb3894f38bd4.title: The Need for Speed: Special Edition

dos:8ece82af4788da80.description: Each character in the Hundred Acre Wood has lost an item of value. Collect the missing items and return them to their owners, one item at a time.
dos:8ece82af4788da80.title: Winnie the Pooh in the Hundred Acre Wood

dos:8ee1de2854581d7e.description: A coin-op conversion in which you infiltrate an alien fortress over 6 levels, piloting a remote controlled drone that is a jet fighter in behind view and a helicopter gunship in top-down view.
dos:8ee1de2854581d7e.title: Ajax

dos:8eeeb5f065e7cec9.description: The second adventure-puzzle game in the series, with two imps to control instead of three. The prince has been kidnapped and Winkle, a reckless jokester, and Fingus, who is careful, must rescue him.
dos:8eeeb5f065e7cec9.title: Gobliins 2: The Prince Buffoon

dos:8ef7a7ee11b4f571.description: A tool for the murder party host. Input data on the guests and it mixes it with the story and generates a murder, motives and clues, printed into personal booklets.
dos:8ef7a7ee11b4f571.title: Make Your Own Murder Party

dos:8f0a328b45171477.description: A deserted frontier town hides thirteen treasures in its closed mine and Boot Hill. Use a VERB NOUN parser to uncover secret passages, ride a bucking bronco and crack a safe.
dos:8f0a328b45171477.title: Ghost Town

dos:8f0e6a3d35476410.description: You are Emilia Vittorini, daughter of Augusto Vittorini, who founded the Industria Torinese Automobili with his brother Tullio. Your father is abroad raising funds when something goes wrong, and you must find out what happened.
dos:8f0e6a3d35476410.title: Two Days at the Race

dos:8f1193f63e45759f.description: A platform game with the mistress of the dark in two huge levels, fire and ice. Pick up many weapons and power-ups and kill many different enemies.
dos:8f1193f63e45759f.title: Elvira: The Arcade Game

dos:8f15281d9d1d8aff.description: The sequel to Ishar: Legend of the Fortress. After Krogh's defeat, Ishar became a cultural center in Kendoria and a city named Zach's Island developed, where a monk named Shandar appears.
dos:8f15281d9d1d8aff.title: Ishar 2: Messengers of Doom

dos:8f21b7536a260dc6.description: A multi-genre game combining arcade action with tactical strategy, meant to be one of Bullfrog's three masterpieces of 1997 along with Syndicate 2 and Dungeon Keeper.
dos:8f21b7536a260dc6.title: Creation

dos:8f2be2948571164a.description: Pilot a spaceship through levels of increasing difficulty in a pseudo-3D vertically scrolling field, shooting everything in your path. New weapons become available as you gather points, and the music was a selling point.
dos:8f2be2948571164a.title: Silpheed

dos:8f32f8db7bb01498.description: An action-adventure in a fantasy world with two episodes of eight and eighteen levels. You play the wizard Kairtan, who has just graduated from the Academy of Magic.
dos:8f32f8db7bb01498.title: Desperabis

dos:8f34f4621f6247d5.description: God Jul! means Merry Christmas in Swedish. Help a janitor clear the snow from the staircase of a small house in three stages, scored on how clean you leave it.
dos:8f34f4621f6247d5.title: God Jul!

dos:8f4481b28bb784a1.description: The CIA learns that giant mutants are wreaking havoc in Metro City, caused by a scientist calling himself Dr. Mangle. They send top agent Snake Logan to fly over, investigate and report back.
dos:8f4481b28bb784a1.title: Bio Menace

dos:8f466539921b5969.description: A little-known Italian Christmas platformer starring Babbo Natale, with an unusual main menu shown as a bird's-eye view of the area and a snowman's head as the cursor.
dos:8f466539921b5969.title: Bianco Natale

dos:8f4930252545925e.description: Colossal Cave Adventure, the text adventure first written by Will Crowther for the PDP-10 in 1976 and expanded with Don Woods, in which you explore a cave for treasure.
dos:8f4930252545925e.title: Microsoft Adventure

dos:8f5a5cdaeb4e6b3a.description: A strategy and educational business game: build a theme park showing off dinosaurs, borrowing money, buying and selling dinosaurs and buying fences, including electric fences, to keep them in.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Education; Strategy
dos:8f5a5cdaeb4e6b3a.title: DinoPark Tycoon

dos:8f5a77fe4b3b210b.description: A pinball game with three tables.
dos:8f5a77fe4b3b210b.title: Steel Shot

dos:8f5c4be3baed5882.description: A turn-based game in which you play the Carthaginian warlord Hannibal against the Roman Empire, managing resources from mines and the economy, recruiting armies including elephants and besieging cities.
dos:8f5c4be3baed5882.title: Hannibal

dos:8f6e57ed032d3311.description: Sets of blocks fall down a shaft and you rotate them before they reach the bottom. Fill a horizontal line and it disappears; if blocks reach the top the game is over.
dos:8f6e57ed032d3311.title: Blocks from Hell

dos:8f6e8eb3c975af13.description: An animated, interactive horse racing game. Jockey abilities, track conditions, horse abilities and race length combine to make each race unique, and you bet from $2 to $100 in Win, Place, Show, Exacta, Quinella and Daily Double bets.
dos:8f6e8eb3c975af13.title: Digital Downs

dos:8f6fb92b43c49179.description: You play a woman driving a moving van across the US to a new job in New York City who runs out of gas in Chewton, Arizona, during the town's 40th annual rock festival, celebrating actual rocks.
dos:8f6fb92b43c49179.title: Everybody Loves a Parade

dos:8f779e1831a005eb.description: A 2D combination of Rubik's Cube and the harder levels of Q*Bert. Flip tesserae, or tiles, over adjacent squares in a simple symbol-graphic puzzle.
dos:8f779e1831a005eb.title: Tesserae

dos:8f8060b32813d02d.description: Construction Bob finds himself in Hell after leaping into a large pit and must escape in this platformer.
dos:8f8060b32813d02d.title: Construction Bob Escapes from Hell

dos:8f82acbad0c2a085.description: A WW2 naval combat simulation in which one or two players command German U-boats, US destroyers or Allied merchant ships, operating in small groups with full status screens.
dos:8f82acbad0c2a085.title: Wolf Pack

dos:8f848370705259e9.description: A freeware 90s Snake clone whose title means Train in Czech. Control a train that collects items scattered around the area, adding a new wagon for every item, while avoiding crashes.
dos:8f848370705259e9.title: Vlak

dos:8f859363fabaf881.description: A graphic action-adventure in which a journalist traveling to the town of Downforth for a story is shot at from a military base used for experimental weapons, and zombies appear.
dos:8f859363fabaf881.title: Zombieville

dos:8f92f69e398cbb6a.description: A text-based simulation in which you create a customized fantasy scenario and explore it through typed commands.
dos:8f92f69e398cbb6a.title: P♥rno Adventure

dos:8f97629a48e56552.description: You are locked in a castle by the Erlking of Errors, the Spelling Serpent. Move through the rooms, typing each flashing word before it fades, to find the Key of Gold and escape.
dos:8f97629a48e56552.title: Spelling Fun One

dos:8fa2d6964698b947.description: An American football simulation, the first of MicroProse's short-lived series, with the teams and players of the 1993 NFL season, single game and league modes and team and playbook editors.
dos:8fa2d6964698b947.title: NFL Video Pro Football

dos:8fab6ba148f1a990.description: A fan-made DOS port of Hexen II. The oldest and most powerful of the demon Serpent Riders, Eidolon, is the only one standing between slavery and liberation for the world of Thyrion.
dos:8fab6ba148f1a990.title: Hexen II: Hammer of Thyrion

dos:8fb53fbc46ecdeb3.description: An ordinary arcade shooter with a side view in which you control a buggy-like machine with a cannon through five levels of enemies, including one where it must swim.
dos:8fb53fbc46ecdeb3.title: Supercyber

dos:8fc033cb7455f6d7.description: A simple game in which you pilot a plane, blowing up other planes while carrying out your missions; a combination of Defender and Scramble.
dos:8fc033cb7455f6d7.title: Jumpjet

dos:8fc1855b36fdf978.description: A BBS game written in 1992 by Seth Able, author of Legend of the Red Dragon. Conquer all the planets, buying better ships, more fighters and more shield power through economic endeavors.
dos:8fc1855b36fdf978.title: Planets: The Exploration of Space

dos:8fd1601d8c94a7dd.description: You are Ser Lev Arris in this sequel to Privateer, searching to regain your identity and memory in an interactive movie and space combat game with trading, missions and unusual planets.
dos:8fd1601d8c94a7dd.title: Privateer 2: The Darkening

dos:8fda0092ad0cf52e.description: An old-school horizontal shooter. A space freighter of terrestrial settlers reappears with an alien crew who want to conquer Earth, and you escort a super bomb to the carrier to destroy it.
dos:8fda0092ad0cf52e.title: Blaster!

dos:8fe895e7fe278f51.description: A shareware quiz game for up to four players in a trivia shell where question packs can be swapped, with three levels of difficulty.
dos:8fe895e7fe278f51.title: Around the World Trivia

dos:8ff7d0439b9e49fd.description: A humorous Olympiad-style game with cartoon characters and graphics and 8 events, such as Swimming, 100 meter sprint, Long jump, Javelin and Archery.
dos:8ff7d0439b9e49fd.title: Reach out for Gold

dos:9000ef9c874ee837.description: Play Ryu on a world tour through Japan, the USA, England, China and Thailand, defeating two opponents in each country. Bonus rounds between countries offer extra points.
dos:9000ef9c874ee837.title: Street Fighter

dos:9007f39d4ff48741.description: An early educational mystery in which young detectives investigate a ghost haunting the Kim family's new home. Players search the town, follow clues and use the SnoopNet computer to solve the case.
dos:9007f39d4ff48741.title: Snooper Troops: Case #1 - The Granite Point Ghost

dos:900800e3785f299c.description: A Dutch action puzzle game in which the player moves a square around a field where stars appear at random. Enclosing exactly three stars scores points and removes two of them, and the game ends when 170 stars fill the field.
dos:900800e3785f299c.title: Driester

dos:901c1daa2b8cb6e2.description: A text adventure set in a castle, published as one of four type-in programs in the book Creating Adventure Games On Your Computer. It was written in BASIC to teach how interactive fiction is built.
dos:901c1daa2b8cb6e2.title: Chateau Gaillard

dos:901dab35fdec1d9d.description: A text adventure in which you are stranded on an abandoned planet amid the ruins of a lost civilization, with only vague goals to guide you.
dos:901dab35fdec1d9d.title: Rimworld

dos:9022911b06fd7e52.description: A free fifth episode for Doom, released by John Romero for the game's 25th anniversary. After the Spiderdemon's defeat, you return to Earth to stop a new hellish invasion.
dos:9022911b06fd7e52.title: Sigil

dos:903cce07df91b471.description: A turn-based strategy game that simulates pitched battles of the ancient world, up to the fall of the Western Roman Empire in 475 A.D. Players can design terrain and units and set up each side's troops before the fight.
dos:903cce07df91b471.title: Encyclopedia of War: Ancient Battles

dos:903e3e838c3641d3.description: A shareware version of Reversi, also known as Othello, played on an 8x8 board with black and white pieces. Trap your opponent's pieces between yours to flip them and finish with the most pieces.
dos:903e3e838c3641d3.title: Tommy's Othello

dos:9048ed3c2938798c.description: A political simulation of the Polish underground movement that led to the Solidarity trade union. Starting from the imposition of martial law in December 1981, you work to win over the public and weaken the government.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation / Political; Strategy
dos:9048ed3c2938798c.title: Solidarność

dos:904a865b7d1bd22e.description: A shareware puzzle game for one or two players. Balloons hang on shelf-like levels, and players take turns bursting balloons from a single row; whoever pops the last one loses.
dos:904a865b7d1bd22e.title: Balloons (1996)

dos:904db052a72eee61.description: A crime strategy game for up to four players set in a near-future city. Climb the criminal ranks through burglary, robbery, kidnapping, smuggling and more, each played as its own minigame.
dos:904db052a72eee61.title: Crime Fighter

dos:904df1f090efe6a4.description: Fly dogfight missions as a pilot to improve your ranking, or act as strategist and decide how, when and where the fighting is done while tracking events.
dos:904df1f090efe6a4.title: Navy Strike

dos:9068c4797b15843b.description: A VGA version of the card game Crazy Eights, played against the computer.
dos:9068c4797b15843b.title: Crazy Eights (1992)

dos:9078484299d332df.description: A grid-based Star Trek strategy game of exploring sectors and fighting enemies.
dos:9078484299d332df.title: Super Star Trek v2.0

dos:907d44eb68064890.description: A side-scrolling platformer in which Vixen, raised by foxes and the last human on a world ruled by dinosaurs, fights to retake the planet. She moves left to right through timed levels armed with a whip.
dos:907d44eb68064890.title: Vixen

dos:908509a2af9701b2.description: A space shooter in the style of the old Star Trek games. A 4x4 grid map shows enemies and star bases, and you fly your ship through each sector, fighting as you go.
dos:908509a2af9701b2.title: Battle Beyond

dos:9086a9e9379cb934.description: An isometric action game with stealth elements and light strategy. You play an American commando on more than fifty missions in hostile countries such as Afghanistan, Libya and North Korea.
dos:9086a9e9379cb934.title: Assault Trooper

dos:908f3b7bac9b3dfd.description: A horizontal shooter that reuses artwork from the Langrisser role-playing series.
dos:908f3b7bac9b3dfd.title: Shooting Langrisser 2

dos:909a488ca7f039ca.description: Lead the defense of four moons against an alien invasion as Admiral Leighton. Each mission begins at a tactical map and moves to the combat, on terrain from lava fields to mountains, forest and underground.
dos:909a488ca7f039ca.title: Strike Base

dos:90a48b28f4ed84bf.title: Space Aliens Laughed at My Cardigan

dos:90b12d12c8d31937.description: An athletic competition for alien athletes with four events: piloting a ship through time and space, racing around the rings of Saturn, a fast electronic puzzle and a futuristic obstacle course.
dos:90b12d12c8d31937.title: Purple Saturn Day

dos:90b941e87a0cf3a1.description: A miniature golf game with four courses, Deluxe, Classic, Traditional and Challenge, each at its own difficulty. Up to four players can play a round or practice any hole.
dos:90b941e87a0cf3a1.title: Mini-Putt

dos:90bc342f365c2351.description: A graphical space trading and combat game inspired by TradeWars 2002. Explore 1,000 sectors with the mouse, collect cargo, battle enemies and sell goods at space stations to upgrade or buy ships.
dos:90bc342f365c2351.title: Conquest 4000

dos:90c3708e4e16db1f.description: A licensed platformer based on the Hanna-Barbera cartoon, with eight levels alternating between side-scrolling and driving George's Jetcar. Each member of the Jetson family has a themed level.
dos:90c3708e4e16db1f.title: Jetsons: The Computer Game

dos:90c5e6bf2d381ea6.description: A boxing game with role-playing elements. Create a beginner boxer, choose a manager and trainers with different specialties, and fight your way toward the world championship.
dos:90c5e6bf2d381ea6.title: TV Sports: Boxing

dos:90c90f665d439c61.description: An ASCII-graphics spin-off of Space Invaders for two alternating players. Each controls a small missile launcher against descending aliens, and when one loses a life the other takes over.
dos:90c90f665d439c61.title: Super Stupid Space Invaders

dos:90d52b52a35c3a34.description: A 3D maze game in first-person view. The shareware version has 8 mazes and the registered version over 50, with ramps, slopes and multi-level platforms.
dos:90d52b52a35c3a34.title: Get Lost!

dos:90e1bf9c9f39a78d.description: A guessing puzzle in which you hunt for the elusive Grinch hiding in a 10-by-10 field of bean bushes. Each place you examine produces a sound that hints at where he is.
dos:90e1bf9c9f39a78d.title: El Grinch

dos:90e890112485263b.description: A BASIC version of tic-tac-toe for two players or against the computer, whose skill level can be set.
dos:90e890112485263b.title: Tic Tac Toe (1982)

dos:90ec60432713e9cd.description: A platformer in which Professor Bob Jumpalot searches caverns for the holy statue of an ancient tribe.
dos:90ec60432713e9cd.title: Caverns of Bob!

dos:90eccf4b7bbcbe68.description: A text-based mystery in which the US President and other heads of state have been kidnapped. As a special investigator, you sift information and send agents into the field to catch the culprits.
dos:90eccf4b7bbcbe68.title: The President is Missing

dos:90f68d40a14b5197.description: A platform-action game from Alive Software in which Snow White gathers flowers and fruit for the Evil Queen while forest animals attack her.
dos:90f68d40a14b5197.title: Snow White's Voyage

dos:90f800fd4bb37a38.description: An action puzzle game in which you control a magical orb, choosing from three with different special powers. You roll left and right across each level collecting human souls.
dos:90f800fd4bb37a38.title: Deathball Incarnate

dos:90fcd28bb512a3d3.description: The second Quest for Glory adventure, set in the land of Shapeir. Elementals threaten the land and the Emir of a neighboring city is missing, and you must meet new friends and set things right.
dos:90fcd28bb512a3d3.title: Quest For Glory II: Trial By Fire

dos:9112624cb8cfa5f4.description: A three-part text adventure retelling the Arthurian saga, from the founding of the Round Table to the quest for the Holy Grail, with Lancelot as the hero.
dos:9112624cb8cfa5f4.title: Lancelot

dos:911fc6e846bdc728.description: A text adventure based on the Anna Popkess book, set in a post-apocalyptic world where guards struggle to control mutated mobs. It uses the SWAN interactive fiction system.
dos:911fc6e846bdc728.title: Mindfighter

dos:912e5d2d80bd3a47.description: An educational multimedia title made of several vignettes covering a wide range of scientific concepts.
dos:912e5d2d80bd3a47.title: Isaac Asimov: Science Adventure 2

dos:913953dcf5c4cd9e.description: The Carmen Sandiego series set in American history. Search for clues and trail Carmen's gang of thieves through the nation's past to capture them one by one.
dos:913953dcf5c4cd9e.title: Where in America's Past Is Carmen Sandiego?

dos:913a922795941598.description: A Spanish-language platformer in which Eco-Kid sets out alone to rescue the Arctic.
dos:913a922795941598.title: Eco-Kid: Rescate en el Artico

dos:9140578a7a235f54.description: A Frogger-style game in which a little green toad crosses a busy city street and then a river by hopping on logs and lily pads.
dos:9140578a7a235f54.title: Toad Road

dos:9140cff86d280d3a.description: A text adventure in which Count Cristo, struck by a Voodoo curse, explores his castle in search of the recipe and words needed to lift it. It begins with the Count standing over his own coffin.
dos:9140cff86d280d3a.title: Voodoo Castle

dos:9142964563c4d715.description: A jigsaw puzzle game from Alive Software with screen resolutions up to 800x600, 48-piece puzzles, and support for your own PCX and GIF pictures.
dos:9142964563c4d715.title: VGA Jigsaw

dos:91451c4f1a4d9dce.description: A puzzle game of 120 levels in which you move colored bricks with pusher devices so that same-colored bricks connect and disappear. Each completed level reveals more of a picture.
dos:91451c4f1a4d9dce.title: Bricks Gold

dos:9148a07d729f2335.description: A fast puzzle game in which water pours into a grid of boxes joined by rotatable pipe pieces. Rearrange the pieces to fill every box before leaks flood the bottom of the screen.
dos:9148a07d729f2335.title: Waterputer

dos:914b22844b9488fd.description: An environmental management simulation by Chris Crawford, successor to Balance of Power. You manage global concerns affecting Earth's ecosystem.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation / Political; Strategy
dos:914b22844b9488fd.title: Balance of the Planet

dos:915f43006f94311b.description: A one-on-one fighting game with eight characters, Ryu, Ken, Blanka, E. Honda, Zangief, Chun Li, Guile and Dhalsim. Beat the other seven, then four bosses: M. Bison, Vega, Sagat and Balrog.
dos:915f43006f94311b.title: Street Fighter II

dos:915fd566b5f5fb2a.description: A platformer based on the movie, in which Captain Neweyes and the dinosaurs set out to rescue Louie and Cecilia from Professor Screweyes. Unlike the movie, it follows its own storyline.
dos:915fd566b5f5fb2a.title: We're Back!: A Dinosaur's Story

dos:91644d8cc4ce19d0.description: A fantasy role-playing game in which you recover artifacts held by the Mad Mage Inshanis to save the kingdom of Hamnlin. Recruit adventurers from various professions, explore dungeons, and level up.
dos:91644d8cc4ce19d0.title: Dungeons of Kairn

dos:916e7b5237c33481.description: A little-known first-person sailing race that aims for realism, with a radar, wind speed and power readouts.
dos:916e7b5237c33481.title: Dolphin Boating Simulator

dos:917d226bd15a4a8c.description: A keyboard-controlled Bomberman variant for two to four players, played over one to four matches. Start in opposite corners, plant bombs to blow through bricks, and escape the blast before it reaches you.
dos:917d226bd15a4a8c.title: Bomber Boy

dos:917db41d70b34f16.description: Catch every falling object with a paddle that shrinks each time you miss one. Each level drops a different object, and catching a bad one such as a lightning bolt also costs a life.
