dos:917db41d70b34f16.title: Catch 'Em (1989)

dos:91809682791813a4.description: A colorful Korean platformer in which a boy named Zis finds a letter in a bottle and travels to the land of Lisnia to save its people from pirates. He fights with a slingshot and collects watermelons for bonuses.
dos:91809682791813a4.title: Zis the Adventure

dos:9182bd63cb7dbd3c.description: A side-scrolling space shooter in the vein of R-Type for one or two players. Earth, ruled by a terrorist army, is then visited by an alien race.
dos:9182bd63cb7dbd3c.title: Nebula Fighter

dos:9191eed350e9d3e1.description: A tactical wargame and adventure based on the GDW tabletop role-playing game. In war-ravaged Poland you must take on the warlord Baron Czarny, who wants to take over what is left of the country.
dos:9191eed350e9d3e1.title: Twilight: 2000

dos:91923945ba3654e9.description: A maze game that generates mazes in shapes from triangles to 61-sided polygons. You travel along a grid from the perimeter to the center, and each maze has 2 to 18 levels.
dos:91923945ba3654e9.title: PolyMaze

dos:91a65c65f568a82a.description: A Pong clone for two players or against the computer, with a practice mode against the wall and a demo clock mode. Each player controls a paddle drawn as a white line.
dos:91a65c65f568a82a.title: Emeritus Pong

dos:91ad803c70236df8.description: A Pac-Man sequel in which Pac eats fruit and prizes instead of dots, many hidden in passages behind gates. Items include apples, bananas, doughnuts, hamburgers and shamrocks.
dos:91ad803c70236df8.title: Super Pac-Man

dos:91b111443a2568a1.description: A keyboard-controlled shareware blackjack game for up to seven players. Empty seats can be filled by computer players that follow strategy guidelines from the book Green Felt Money.
dos:91b111443a2568a1.title: Turbo Blackjack

dos:91b62f3552b46311.description: A five-card stud poker game bearing the name of professional gambler Amarillo Slim, and the first release from Villa Crespo Software.
dos:91b62f3552b46311.title: Amarillo Slim's Real Poker: 5 Card Stud

dos:91b74922b72f0f3b.description: The sequel to MicroIllusions' role-playing classic. The three brothers from the first game are teleported to a foreign land and must save its people from spreading evil in a large world with Ultima VIII-style graphics.
dos:91b74922b72f0f3b.title: Halls of the Dead: Faery Tale Adventure II

dos:91c25b5cc4a9e7a5.description: Run a construction company in a city where property goes to whoever develops it first and any means of sabotaging rivals are allowed. Start with a single plot, a headquarters, a construction team and a repairman.
dos:91c25b5cc4a9e7a5.title: Constructor

dos:91d9e3e0e72305b1.description: A text adventure that sends you through seemingly unrelated locations: a jet cockpit, ice caves, rooms of buttons, levers and keypads, and an old theatre.
dos:91d9e3e0e72305b1.title: The Pilot, or: A Flight into Fantasy

dos:91fb474d0bcbfe26.description: A medieval platformer in which a well-meaning but silly knight, lost in a labyrinthine castle, makes his way to the throne room armed with a sword.
dos:91fb474d0bcbfe26.title: Silly Knight

dos:91fc7ebf4095773d.description: A turn-based chase game in the style of the UNIX game Robots. You move on a grid scattered with killer Daleks, trying to destroy them before they catch you.
dos:91fc7ebf4095773d.title: Daleks

dos:92009b4886e513aa.description: A simple Hangman game in which the computer picks a random word from a file and you guess it letter by letter. You can add your own words or vocabulary files; English, French, German, Dutch, Polish and Hungarian are supported.
dos:92009b4886e513aa.title: Hangman (2005)

dos:920903551311f6dc.description: A puzzle platformer remaking a 1994 ZX Spectrum game of the same name. Each single-screen level requires shooting and avoiding enemies, destroying blocks and pushing blocks around.
dos:920903551311f6dc.title: Boovie

dos:920c023f87eaa0a3.description: A falling-block puzzle follow-up to Tetris and Welltris in which the pieces are parts of faces. Rotate and arrange them to assemble complete faces, which can be matched to a famous person.
dos:920c023f87eaa0a3.title: Faces ...tris III

dos:9216b6d3a66c8840.description: A single-screen shooter in which you operate a gun turret with unlimited ammo and a limited firing angle, shooting down helicopters and the paratroopers they drop before they overrun you.
dos:9216b6d3a66c8840.title: Paratrooper

dos:92187cddeb2d9146.description: A turn-based empire-building strategy game set in the ancient Arab world. Seasonal turns have you establish trade, raise armies and run your economy, expanding by conquest or diplomacy.
dos:92187cddeb2d9146.title: Khalaan

dos:921e4ee451ff9a58.description: A Soviet-era arcade tennis game for one player against the computer or two players together, with player names taken from real tennis stars.
dos:921e4ee451ff9a58.title: My Tennis

dos:9225ac3dc01819d8.description: A first-person tank shooter and sequel to Stellar 7 from Dynamix. Captain John Alex takes the experimental Raven II tank to answer a distress call from Nova 9, with the villain Gir Draxon still at large.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Vehicle Simulation
dos:9225ac3dc01819d8.title: Nova 9: The Return of Gir Draxon

dos:922659718f433288.description: A remake of Grand Slam Bridge with VGA graphics, music and animation. It plays Contract Bridge with a choice of bidding conventions for both partners.
dos:922659718f433288.title: Grand Slam Bridge II

dos:922fc7426f980b48.description: A 1991 missile-defense game set during the Gulf War. Operate Patriot batteries to intercept incoming Scud missiles before they hit the buildings below.
dos:922fc7426f980b48.title: Scud Atak

dos:9241df22498d3a4e.description: A shareware text adventure based on the earlier Stoneville Manor. Wealthy Old Mr Tommy has died, leaving his fortune to whoever finds and opens his secret safe, so you explore the manor and gather useful items.
dos:9241df22498d3a4e.title: Tommy's Manor

dos:924a2926b9c4c50f.description: A Pac-Man clone in which you are a square block eating 468 pellets in a maze while avoiding ghosts shaped like hearts, clovers, diamonds and petals. A numeric option sets the game speed.
dos:924a2926b9c4c50f.title: Pac-Gal

dos:924a66e5ea889b69.description: The Taito brick-breaking game in which a Vaus spaceship serves as the bat. Catch and direct the ball to clear the bricks at the top of the screen.
dos:924a66e5ea889b69.title: Arkanoid

dos:9251de4c6cd3c23d.description: An educational game for ages two to six. In a narrated storybook, help Barney Bear wake up and get ready for school by clicking on objects in each scene.
dos:9251de4c6cd3c23d.title: Barney Bear Goes to School

dos:92540adb20276afe.description: A keyboard-controlled Pac-Man clone with fourteen levels and random bonus items. Ack! Man eats pills in a maze and chases the ghosts Finky, Stinky, Dinky and Clyde after a power pill.
dos:92540adb20276afe.title: ACK! Man

dos:925ba47d92d7cec8.description: A puzzle game based on Kwirk, in which you guide the green hero through each level to the exit. It has two modes, Going Up and Heading Out, which differ in how the exit and field are laid out.
dos:925ba47d92d7cec8.title: The Quest of Kwirk's Castle

dos:925fb816a1530e7b.description: A rally game covering the African part of the 12th Paris-Dakar route, starting from Tripoli, Libya. Unlike its predecessor, you drive from a cockpit view.
dos:925fb816a1530e7b.title: Paris Dakar 1990

dos:92651e25e6286310.description: An Infocom text mystery in which you are accused of a murder you could not have committed. You must prove your innocence among the upper crust before you are judged guilty.
dos:92651e25e6286310.title: Suspect

dos:92679cbe86d4a9c8.description: Command a naval cruiser to defend the Persian Gulf in three missions: Convoy Escort, Patrol or Dawn of Death.
dos:92679cbe86d4a9c8.title: Navcom 6: The Persian Gulf Defense

dos:926ec0b4e3d3ea19.description: A futuristic vertical-scrolling shooter. Fight waves of enemy fighters, ground vehicles and defense installations while dodging attacks and collecting power-ups, with Mini Missiles as one of two weapons.
dos:926ec0b4e3d3ea19.title: Mission Mopreme 32K

dos:92717d2c39c1d0fb.description: A drag racing simulation with five types of dragster. Control the throttle and shift through two to four gears to win races against a human or computer opponent.
dos:92717d2c39c1d0fb.title: Drag Race Eliminator

dos:927eaf236b60e5a9.description: A paddle game in which the goal is to clear the screen. A ball turns the white screen black wherever it travels, and the paddle keeps it in play for three rounds.
dos:927eaf236b60e5a9.title: Clearer

dos:928363be45089252.description: Guide the green Super Bubble around the screen, dodging hazards and traps, to reach the yellow doorway on each level.
dos:928363be45089252.title: JimBall

dos:9299577c1c08dba1.description: The fourth game in 21st Century's pinball series, developed by Spidersoft. Its four tables are Kick Off (soccer), Jail Break (prison), Tarantula (a spider) and Jackpot (gambling).
dos:9299577c1c08dba1.title: Pinball Mania

dos:929ba2d811178b67.description: A shareware Wheel of Fortune game for one to three players. Take turns guessing letters to solve blanked-out phrases, names and things, following the television game show.
dos:929ba2d811178b67.title: VGAWHEEL

dos:929fffb5aba8b35e.description: The deluxe edition of Rise of the Triad, a first-person shooter. It contains the ten single-player and eight multiplayer levels of the shareware version plus six new levels.
dos:929fffb5aba8b35e.title: Rise of the Triad: The HUNT Begins (Deluxe Edition)

dos:92a98c93f616fe29.description: Read the patient's medical chart, then control a robot probe inside the body to treat the problem with aspirin, antiseptic or ultrasonics.
dos:92a98c93f616fe29.title: Microsurgeon

dos:92bd437d3177946f.description: An action platformer with Sonic-like backgrounds.
dos:92bd437d3177946f.title: Reon's Adventure

dos:92c193c5351663cb.description: A text adventure in which you play Dr. Peter Basham, a pediatrician treating victims of a smallpox pandemic in a hospital.
dos:92c193c5351663cb.title: Mercy

dos:92c2aca837d70303.description: An educational car design game for children. Modify tires, suspension, engine and body, then test the finished car in a wind tunnel and on a test track.
dos:92c2aca837d70303.title: Car Builder

dos:92dfbde8b1b10ddb.description: A single-player Breakout clone. Move a paddle left and right to fire the ball and break bricks laid out differently on each level.
dos:92dfbde8b1b10ddb.title: Super Ball!

dos:92e904ee1b862361.description: A role-playing game in which Desmond, robbed of his possessions, takes a job that sends him across towns and dungeons. Build the party, gather equipment, and pause the automatic battles to use items, cast spells or change tactics.
dos:92e904ee1b862361.title: Knights of Xentar

dos:92f65f3c8e7648de.description: A freeware two-player Asteroids clone with VGA graphics.
dos:92f65f3c8e7648de.title: Rad Fighter

dos:92f8c27cb40de26a.description: You are a treasure hunter at a collapsed mine whose gear, including the dynamite, was stolen by bandits. Get your weapons and dynamite back to open the entrance.
dos:92f8c27cb40de26a.title: Perils of Treasure Mountain

dos:92fbbb9f1f460fbc.description: An educational action game teaching math to children in grades 1 through 6, covering addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, percents and decimals.
dos:92fbbb9f1f460fbc.title: Math Blaster!

dos:93078cf02e996d05.description: A playable demo of an unreleased sequel to Renegade: Battle for Jacob Star. It plays like an add-on to the original flight combat game, with new missions.
dos:93078cf02e996d05.title: Renegade II: Return to Jacob Star

dos:9314fd4191abc73f.description: The second Magic Candle role-playing game, with an enhanced VGA engine. Choose your party and roam the land to uncover the secret of the Four and Forty.
dos:9314fd4191abc73f.title: The Magic Candle II: The Four and Forty

dos:93256c7f2f9e5cb9.description: A strategic war game for up to 25 players set in a future where nuclear destruction has left a barren world. As a baron under a great king, expand your barony across the planet.
dos:93256c7f2f9e5cb9.title: Barren Realms Elite

dos:93281ed571f6bc47.description: An adventure with action elements such as space combat. As a time-traveling space pilot, you land in South America during the European invasion to find the treasure of the Inca.
dos:93281ed571f6bc47.title: Inca (1992)

dos:93326d768ee210e8.description: An interactive movie based on the IMAX film Speed, tracing humanity's quest to go faster from running on foot through the wheel, chariot and automobile and beyond.
dos:93326d768ee210e8.title: Speed

dos:933abfb89aed7c81.description: An action-oriented strategy game set in ancient Egypt, also known as Nil Dieu Vivant. As the exiled heir of a Pharaoh, you return to Cairo to claim the throne by conquering neighboring lands and defending your own.
dos:933abfb89aed7c81.title: Day of the Pharaoh

dos:9347e5093d04c463.description: A fast puzzle game in which you steer a yellow cube around a board to capture grids by traveling all four sides, while red cubes chase you through 50 levels.
dos:9347e5093d04c463.title: Squarex

dos:934b3d64c433c600.description: A helicopter simulation with an arcade focus. Choose your missions and one of four helicopters, the Apache, Blackhawk, Osprey or LHX, to fight enemy targets in places such as Libya and East Germany.
dos:934b3d64c433c600.title: LHX: Attack Chopper

dos:934b51083f3362ec.description: A stock market simulation in which you watch companies come and go and buy shares in those you think will profit. For the right price you can tamper with how stocks move.
dos:934b51083f3362ec.title: Tamper

dos:934d2130aadb739f.description: A board game in which you compete against the computer to claim squares and reveal a hidden photograph, with several difficulty levels and a selection of images.
dos:934d2130aadb739f.title: Centerfold Squares

dos:934d83534f4dcb4f.description: A futuristic tennis-like game for two players. Each uses a racket to send the ball past the opponent into their wall, with gravity and momentum affecting the ball and jetpacks for each player.
dos:934d83534f4dcb4f.title: Hover

dos:936177718344d470.description: A real-time adventure set on a train in 1914, just before the First World War. As Robert Cath, you must solve the mystery before the train reaches its next station, or events may unfold without you.
dos:936177718344d470.title: The Last Express

dos:936aaed31ab26573.description: A humorous SimCity-style strategy game in which the afterlife runs on a market economy. You manage heaven and hell together, building zones for the seven sins and the matching virtues as new souls arrive.
dos:936aaed31ab26573.title: Afterlife

dos:936bfbd79c8b88e6.description: A text adventure trilogy in which Aarbron stows away on a ship because he is enamored with Queen Jade of the Amozons, who is returning from a trade mission to the city of Silverton.
dos:936bfbd79c8b88e6.title: The Chronicles of Aarbron Trilogy

dos:936db355a5d8468f.description: A computer coloring book based on the animated film FernGully: The Last Rainforest. Choose from five backgrounds and over 20 characters to create and color your own pictures.
dos:936db355a5d8468f.title: Fern Gully: The Last Rainforest Computerized Coloring Book

dos:9390e240717fd210.description: A falling-block puzzle game in which you move and rotate blocks to complete horizontal rows. Each cleared row reveals part of an animated panel, and the level ends when the panel is complete.
dos:9390e240717fd210.title: P♥rntris

dos:9397b0db8e98e3d4.description: A text adventure in which you are the lone astronaut on a deep-space probe of the Horse Head Nebula. A giant alien ship destroys your craft and captures you.
dos:9397b0db8e98e3d4.title: Starship Encounter

dos:93996e1f171b3eac.description: A video poker machine simulation. Start with 20 coins and aim for winning hands, such as a Royal Flush and Four of a Kind, with five skill levels.
dos:93996e1f171b3eac.title: Las Vegas Video Poker

dos:939983052067b624.description: An action game with adventure elements, visually much like Another World. A lone hero faces a mysterious demon and his cyborg minions who threaten a megalopolis.
dos:939983052067b624.title: Father World

dos:93b60721b8e9e556.description: An EGA tactical wargame based on battles of the American Civil War, evolved from a prize-winning ASCII game. It is easy to play but difficult to master.
dos:93b60721b8e9e556.title: EGA Civil War Battle Set

dos:93b7e23237d64542.description: An educational game that teaches facts about the solar system. You chase a UFO exploring the solar system from planet to planet, learning more with each stop.
dos:93b7e23237d64542.title: Mission UFO

dos:93c0ed236762fe56.description: A detailed wargame of the first year of the Korean War from Strategic Simulations. Three historical scenarios let you command as General MacArthur or lead the North Korean forces, plus a hypothetical 1995 scenario.
dos:93c0ed236762fe56.title: Conflict: Korea - The First Year 1950-51

dos:93c260debf4b7f0d.description: A vertical arcade shooter in which you fly a green plane seen from above, moved with the numeric keypad, against enemy aircraft that arrive alone or in formations from all directions.
dos:93c260debf4b7f0d.title: Mustang

dos:93c833c33ddb0ac9.description: An F/A-18 Hornet air combat simulator with 50 combat missions, 8 training missions and free flight. It includes a mission creator, a flight instructor mode and a flight recorder for replays.
dos:93c833c33ddb0ac9.title: Black Knight: Marine Strike Fighter

dos:93ce54518c23c407.description: The sequel to Lands of Lore, an action role-playing game in real-time 3D with computer-graphics and live-action video sequences across four CD-ROMs. You play Luther.
dos:93ce54518c23c407.title: Lands of Lore: Guardians of Destiny

dos:93ebff9a789318ea.description: The second Robot game, a German adventure of 85 screens with outdoor locations and riddles. A telegram from an old friend in the South Pacific sends you on a dangerous journey to the port.
dos:93ebff9a789318ea.title: Robot II: Das Labyrinth im Wald

dos:940d9178b1ec0ecd.description: A surreal side-scrolling platformer with ZX Spectrum-style graphics. Gather every required item, tell useful pickups from hazards, and shoot the enemies that pursue you.
dos:940d9178b1ec0ecd.title: H♥j H♥jowi Nie Rowny

dos:940e9ce6629e8a02.description: The first game in the Rally Championship series, based on the long-running British RAC rally. Choose from five cars, including the Toyota Celica, Ford Escort and Subaru Impreza.
dos:940e9ce6629e8a02.title: Network Q RAC Rally

dos:940fcb38f7c59585.description: A collection of 2D Rayman: the original game, its level editor with 24 new levels, and 40 of the best fan-made levels from the Ubisoft Rayman website.
dos:940fcb38f7c59585.title: Rayman Forever

dos:9418f21817f2ba7a.description: A top-down role-playing game set in Ymros, the land from Shard of Spring, with a world 32 times larger than its predecessor's. Build a party of humans, elves, dwarves or trolls, and choose among 10 classes.
dos:9418f21817f2ba7a.title: Demon's Winter

dos:941c75dcbcf36cbd.description: An official add-on for Rise of the Triad with forty-two new levels that are harder than the original's. It also includes user-made level editors, a random level generator and sound files.
dos:941c75dcbcf36cbd.title: Extreme Rise of the Triad

dos:941faac3abb11e79.description: A BASIC miniature golf game for 1 to 10 players from SoftSide magazine. Nine holes are viewed top-down, and you aim the putter and choose a swing force from 1 to 9 against each hole's par.
dos:941faac3abb11e79.title: 9-Hole Miniature Golf

dos:9425388003cd3aeb.description: A Christmas edition of the scrolling shooter Interpose. An evil scientist has built an army of robotic Santas and reindeer, and you fight them through festive backgrounds.
dos:9425388003cd3aeb.title: Interpose X-mas Greetings

dos:942de794e65782be.description: More Lemmings with new skills and obstacles. Three islands each feature a different tribe to save: Classic, Egyptian or Shadow Lemmings.
dos:942de794e65782be.title: The Lemmings Chronicles

dos:943c3e2b20a28e1e.description: A text adventure set in West End Games' dystopian Paranoia universe. You play Troubleshooter Philo-R-DMD and his clones, taking on a holiday-season assignment for the Computer.
dos:943c3e2b20a28e1e.title: Paranoia

dos:9447c4fd6ec2d544.description: A set of eight ASCII-graphics games for the original IBM PC, working even with a monochrome adapter. Most are replicas of early 80s games, such as Pac-Man variants, and a Boss Key is included.
dos:9447c4fd6ec2d544.title: FriendlyWare P.C. Arcade

dos:9450f954f26fb592.description: A single-player game in which a gun fires automatically in turn up, left, down and right. It cannot fire while the previous shot is on screen, so each shot has to count.
dos:9450f954f26fb592.title: Tommy's Gorilla Ball Pythons

dos:9453a8d09de99213.description: Eggs roll toward you from one of four locations. Use the keys to move your farmer's bucket to the foot of the right ramp, and you lose a life for each egg you miss.
dos:9453a8d09de99213.title: Jajka

dos:945a9d36738aab53.description: A fantasy dungeon crawler in which you, a descendant of the royal House of Quilan, descend into the dungeon beneath Karkoth's keep to find the magical sword Ramdahl and defeat the undead witch king.
dos:945a9d36738aab53.title: Karkoth's Keep

dos:945afadf9764550b.description: A re-release of Diamond Digger with a better palette.
dos:945afadf9764550b.title: Raiders of the Forbidden Mine

dos:945ef28421a62cdb.description: The game show Wheel of Fortune with Vanna White. Players take turns spinning the wheel and guessing letters to solve word puzzles, risking bankruptcy on a bad spin.
dos:945ef28421a62cdb.title: Wheel of Fortune featuring Vanna White

dos:946147add4d22328.description: A Minesweeper variation by the French demo group Eclipse. An 8x8 grid hides an adjustable number of mines, 10 by default, which you uncover or flag.
dos:946147add4d22328.title: Demineur

dos:947d79f9a8c726b8.description: A detailed wrestling simulation in which you create circuits, hire wrestlers and book cards.
dos:947d79f9a8c726b8.title: TNM 7: The Wrestling Simulator - Second Edition

dos:948009b30d9aeaf5.description: A mouse-controlled 3D vector-graphics strategy game set in a violent future TV show. As a contestant, you command a fleet of Skimmers to destroy groups of combat vehicles such as Cycloids, Scouts and Defenders.
dos:948009b30d9aeaf5.title: Tracker

dos:94909aee0f129514.description: The sequel to I.M. Meen. Ophelia Chill, wife of I.M. Meen, has torn the pages out of the Book of Ages and is changing them, and you set out to restore them.
dos:94909aee0f129514.title: Chill Manor

dos:94b18e852883dae1.description: A Wild West shooting gallery set in the late 19th-century American frontier.
dos:94b18e852883dae1.title: Far West

dos:94b35ad5ad4e214c.description: A single-player game in which you play a good blob against the computer's bad blob. Every square your blob touches becomes another good blob.
dos:94b35ad5ad4e214c.title: Tommy's Blob

dos:94bc381f58182675.description: Accolade's 1996 American football game, shifting toward team management and coaching. Buy teams, make trades, set salary caps, and manage rosters and injuries.
dos:94bc381f58182675.title: Unnecessary Roughness '96

dos:94d68848bdeb9ccd.description: An air hockey-style game in which you face one computer opponent at a time, deflecting the puck around the walled table with your bat to knock it into their goal. Several opponents are available.
dos:94d68848bdeb9ccd.title: Shufflepuck Cafe

dos:94febab4edea8bc5.description: Pilot a submarine through a series of screens, destroying every enemy with your missiles.
dos:94febab4edea8bc5.title: Submarine Fury

dos:9507582f23139b5e.description: A short text adventure from Temple Software in which you explore Granny's house. Most puzzles involve finding objects and handing them to the right character with a small set of typed commands.
dos:9507582f23139b5e.title: Granny's Place

dos:950a996a36729164.description: Fly the A-10 Thunderbolt II, the Warthog, hunting enemy tanks and destroying roads and bridges. It has a 30mm cannon, multiple camera angles and automated landing.
dos:950a996a36729164.title: A-10 Tank Killer

dos:9519a764c7487737.description: A simulation of the NBA All-Star three-point shooting contest, played with the mouse by setting each shot's power and angle. It has a tournament mode and a practice mode.
dos:9519a764c7487737.title: 3 Point Basketball

dos:9521e7bddd97b771.description: A Star Trek: The Next Generation adventure from Spectrum HoloByte in which you command Captain Picard and the Enterprise D crew. It mixes point-and-click adventure with space exploration, diplomacy and ship combat.
dos:9521e7bddd97b771.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation - A Final Unity

dos:95221abd4c858a4b.description: An action game in three differently styled parts, starring a muscular warrior who breaks out of a castle prison. Codes earned by completing a level grant extra lives on levels 2 and 3.
dos:95221abd4c858a4b.title: Savage

dos:95246b6864a84547.description: A shooter in which a worm hole throws your ship into another galaxy where you are the enemy. Alien races attack you, and their shots damage your shields.
dos:95246b6864a84547.title: Space Pilot

dos:954fbf397844ecf4.description: Steer your ship with the mouse and shoot enemy ships. When you finish, you get a time to beat.
dos:954fbf397844ecf4.title: Energies

dos:95597321b4258921.description: A Joust-style game in which a hungry tropical bird, flapping its wings for lift and momentum, tries to catch a fat fish swimming in the river below.
dos:95597321b4258921.title: Bird Brain

dos:955b6155f7adf31b.description: Ride your bicycle down the street delivering papers, avoiding dogs, cars and other obstacles, and throwing papers only at the right houses.
dos:955b6155f7adf31b.title: Paperboy 2

dos:956200ca838b11db.description: A typing tutor based on the Wizard of Id comic strip, built to help keyboard novices improve their accuracy and speed. In the first section you play the Wiz and match wits against an Evil Spirit.
dos:956200ca838b11db.title: Wizard of Id's WizType

dos:95632ce6bb657075.description: An arcade game in which a boy and a large monkey work around the clock producing coconut milk. The boy catches coconuts that fall from palm trees, gives them to the monkey and waters the palms.
dos:95632ce6bb657075.title: Friday on the Island

dos:95637c407d4b3796.description: A football game licensed around England player Paul Gascoigne that combines arcade action and management. It has a four-division Super League of top European clubs, player transfers and tactical setups, with side-scrolling matches.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:95637c407d4b3796.title: Gazza II

dos:9578d1d39e6869e0.description: A three-player Reversi game similar to Tribolo, played on a 12x12 board with random point values scattered across it. Players take turns placing pieces that sandwich the opponents' pieces.
dos:9578d1d39e6869e0.title: Numlo

dos:9579f108fb39ff6f.description: A pinball-like maze game in which you steer a train to safety with the keyboard, using bumpers, switches and tunnels while avoiding bombs.
dos:9579f108fb39ff6f.title: TrainBall

dos:957ba6c8c2e5089c.description: A single-player Defender clone in which you fly a spaceship to stop aliens from abducting people. It has a high score table and joystick support.
dos:957ba6c8c2e5089c.title: Abductor

dos:957cc3a11b5db9ea.description: A platformer in which Jim, an earthworm, comes into possession of a powerful super suit that the villainous Psy-Crow and Queen Slug-for-a-Butt are after.
dos:957cc3a11b5db9ea.title: Earthworm Jim

dos:9580e6a4bd7fc492.description: A text adventure in which the protagonist falls in with the Breakers, an ancient people awaiting a Messiah, and must convince them that he is the one they have been expecting.
dos:9580e6a4bd7fc492.title: Breakers

dos:958bb1662e09e585.description: A horizontal shooter in which you choose one of three ships to fly against the Dominators, a ruthless force bent on destroying all life. The screen scrolls slowly as waves of enemies attack.
dos:958bb1662e09e585.title: Firewind

dos:958bfec3b650fe3d.description: A Spanish arcade game about a man trying to escape from giant slugs and similar creatures.
dos:958bfec3b650fe3d.title: Hole-Man

dos:959186b8e45557d3.description: A World War I flight combat simulator with 20 craft that each handle differently, from simple missions to a full campaign of patrols and encounters with enemy aces. You can also attack balloons and blimps.
dos:959186b8e45557d3.title: Knights of the Sky

dos:9592513be0477838.description: A text adventure in which you search for a Pharaoh's tomb, meeting ghosts and other creatures along the way, and then find your way out through many hazards.
dos:9592513be0477838.title: The Tomb of the Ancient Pharaohs

dos:959805b985019b31.description: A basic side-scrolling shooter controlled with F to fire and WASD to move.
dos:959805b985019b31.title: Feza

dos:959b18f17bc6254e.description: A small Tetris game that stays memory-resident (TSR) in DOS so it can be started at any time. It uses only about 4KB of memory and can be played without suspending the running program.
dos:959b18f17bc6254e.title: TetRAM

dos:95b484548395744f.description: An underwater arcade game in which a scuba diver, deployed from a submarine, hunts for Atlantis's treasure through labyrinths, caves, wrecked ships and ruins.
dos:95b484548395744f.title: Locman I

dos:95b7c8ebb7df92b2.description: A top-down dungeon-crawl role-playing game written in BASIC, most similar to the Warriors of Ras series. Create a character from seven standard classes before heading into the dungeons.
dos:95b7c8ebb7df92b2.title: Dungeon Quest

dos:95c6489b3fc828b0.description: A primitive CGA pinball game with only five bumpers on the table.
dos:95c6489b3fc828b0.title: Rain

dos:95c8263c46eb18c8.description: A hex-based, turn-based wargame of the Battle of the Little Bighorn, fought on June 25-26, 1876. You can play either Custer's side or the Indians' side, with optional alternate setups.
dos:95c8263c46eb18c8.title: Custer's Last Command

dos:95cba9bac4ccafa6.description: A beta version of an unreleased 3D first-person shooter that has only a few levels.
dos:95cba9bac4ccafa6.title: Subterraneans

dos:95cbfbd6f658c6fc.description: A shareware game in which the player wakes in a room of huge pounding anvils and giant spiders from Mars. Move left and right along the bottom of the screen to avoid the stomping anvils.
dos:95cbfbd6f658c6fc.title: Tommy's Stompers

dos:95d1d87df6656340.description: A German shareware game in which a hero explores the evil wizard Schulzasar's castle. Visit its 56 rooms, destroy the wizard's robots and solve puzzles to kill him and steal his gold.
dos:95d1d87df6656340.title: The Game of Robot

dos:95dd2214a85472df.description: Tetris combined with Mahjong, with many different types of pieces.
dos:95dd2214a85472df.title: Mahjong Tetris

dos:95e735c936731045.description: Defend a castle by moving left and right along the top of the screen. Enemies along the bottom raise ladders at random points to climb the walls.
dos:95e735c936731045.title: Tommy's Gorilla Ball Ramparts

dos:961060a748763b74.description: A character simulation in which you converse with Tracy by typing, using voice, text and live-action video. Status panels track the conversation, her mood and the current setting.
dos:961060a748763b74.title: Girlfriend Tracy

dos:96169e55b7bb159d.description: An early two-player split-screen tank game in which both players start underground. You tunnel around to find your opponent and destroy them before they destroy you.
dos:96169e55b7bb159d.title: Tunneler

dos:961c67088e00ad63.description: A side-scrolling action platformer across six levels, each with a three-minute limit, through forest, village, mountain and cavern settings. Arthur the knight must rescue his Princess from the Demon King Astaroth.
dos:961c67088e00ad63.title: Ghosts 'N Goblins

dos:96227c9bdfa4752f.description: A Lemmings-style puzzle game in which you command five alien miners from one of four clans to dig for treasure. Each excavation area has a money target to reach by selling treasure to the bank.
dos:96227c9bdfa4752f.title: Diggers

dos:9622dade7d6d6da1.description: A racing game with licensed cars such as the Subaru Impreza Turbo, Ford Escort RS Cosworth, Renault Maxi Megane and Volkswagen Golf GTI.
dos:9622dade7d6d6da1.title: Rallye Racing 97

dos:96232c68e4e2e759.description: Score points by boxing in objects that pop up on the screen without hitting them. Move a line with the cursor keys or mouse to form a closed rectangle, with bonuses for boxing several objects at once.
dos:96232c68e4e2e759.title: Relix

dos:9627158620ecd0fb.description: An interactive children's book starring Mickey Mouse.
dos:9627158620ecd0fb.title: Follow the Reader

dos:962c3253c7e7ca8b.description: A Super Solvers educational game about physical science. Morty Maxwell has taken over the Shady Glen Technology Center and challenges you to a race, so you build the fastest vehicle.
dos:962c3253c7e7ca8b.title: Super Solvers: Gizmos & Gadgets

dos:962c969b6904cf16.description: You are Vietnam veteran turned adventurer Bret Conrad, who receives an old map to the lost city of Quetzacotl and its gold. Gameplay is similar to Psygnosis' Barbarian.
dos:962c969b6904cf16.title: The Gold of the Aztecs

dos:964063a4d916cafe.description: A survival simulator and low-fantasy roguelike set in Iron Age Finland around 1000 A.D., among pagan tribes who hunt, fish, farm and trade furs. Keeping your character fed and warm is a challenge, especially in winter.
dos:964063a4d916cafe.title: UnReal World

dos:9648a9b74f17a05c.description: A keyboard-controlled game similar to Meteor Mission, in which you swoop up astronauts abandoned on a desolate planetoid and bring them home.
dos:9648a9b74f17a05c.title: Meteor Rescue

dos:964f8d010f06bfbe.description: You play a god competing against another god, helping your chosen people take over the world and wipe out the rival's worshippers. Each god starts with a single human in the wilderness.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Strategy / God game
dos:964f8d010f06bfbe.title: Populous

dos:96597505ee1607fa.description: A puzzle game in which you help Larry Lontrose, an ambitious part-time dock loader, climb the corporate ladder by solving 40 puzzle rooms. Use boxes, balloons and TNT to reach each room's door.
dos:96597505ee1607fa.title: Loader Larry

dos:965a680ea880fa87.description: A chess-like game in real time with projectiles and three modes: Medieval, Great War and Contemporary. The modes play alike but each has different units, from swordsmen and archers to aircraft.
dos:965a680ea880fa87.title: Theatre of War

dos:9673188f2903c5c2.description: A strategy-focused licensed baseball game with real teams and players plus classic teams, and many data disks of additional lineups. Each play is shown with running commentary and a wide range of strategies.
dos:9673188f2903c5c2.title: MicroLeague Baseball

dos:96819b937ccc29a3.description: The sequel to Moebius, combining role-playing with side-view fighting. You and Moebius travel to master the martial arts, fighting thieves, guards and assassins in real time.
dos:96819b937ccc29a3.title: Windwalker

dos:968219810b402cbc.description: A first-person shooter in the style of Blake Stone. After Earth's destruction, aliens vow to destroy your space station, and you fight through its levels against aliens and the station's security drones.
dos:968219810b402cbc.title: Space Station Escape

dos:968e214e36c186d1.description: A rally game licensed from Toyota Great Britain, racing on gravel, asphalt and ice over series of short stages. After each stage your times are compared with your rivals', and up to four humans can play.
dos:968e214e36c186d1.title: Toyota Celica GT Rally

dos:9690baff76b969c9.description: A Breakout clone in which you bounce a ball with a paddle to break all the bricks. Some bricks hide random power-ups, mostly helpful but a few harmful, such as lengthening or shortening the paddle.
dos:9690baff76b969c9.title: Krypton Egg

dos:96947f1348ca0de9.description: A platformer in which Skunny the squirrel, after his trip to ancient Rome, ends up in the Wild West because his mother altered the time machine. He sets out to return stolen sheep and right old wrongs.
dos:96947f1348ca0de9.title: Skunny: In The Wild West

dos:96a9ace130c48ae9.description: A 3D shooter in which an evil alien race is changing the past with special orbs. Collect three orbs per level and eliminate the aliens, using a set of both ordinary and alien weapons.
dos:96a9ace130c48ae9.title: Quiver

dos:96bf3c031eca6880.description: A shareware Tetris clone in which a meteor spotted in deep space on November 13, 2005 is headed for Earth. Your mission is to help stop it.
dos:96bf3c031eca6880.title: Iko San

dos:96c5fbb558c13faf.description: An arcade racing game with 16 vehicles, including boats, trucks, spacecraft and helicopters, on 24 circuits across 7 terrains such as dirt, inner city and sci-fi. Multiplayer is split-screen, modem or network.
dos:96c5fbb558c13faf.title: Big Red Racing

dos:96c8f633ed41570c.description: The original Russian version of Lines. Each turn three randomly colored balls drop onto a 9x9 board, and you move one ball per turn to form lines of five or more of the same color.
dos:96c8f633ed41570c.title: Color Lines

dos:96ce0e6f507ee8eb.description: A licensed 3D drag racing simulation with a first-person view, featuring 22 NHRA events on 19 tracks and real drag racing stars. Choose among vehicles such as nitro dragsters and funny cars.
dos:96ce0e6f507ee8eb.title: NIRA: Intense Import Drag Racing

dos:96e152527173db43.description: A 4X space strategy game like Master of Orion or Ascendancy, with a heavy focus on ship design. Pick engines, shields, scanners and weapons for each hull, and add modules such as colonization or fighter bays.
dos:96e152527173db43.title: Remember Tomorrow

dos:96e8fbe3d43818ed.description: A fast futuristic racing game based on the arcade game, in which you guide your spaceship between pylons and shoot down enemy racers.
dos:96e8fbe3d43818ed.title: Buck Rogers: Planet of Zoom

dos:96f996476ddab6c5.description: Solve three cases as Sherlock Holmes by interviewing people and using logic and reasoning. It is arguably the first multimedia CD-ROM PC title, with over 90 minutes of video of Holmes with everyone on Baker Street.
dos:96f996476ddab6c5.title: Sherlock Holmes: Consulting Detective Volume I

dos:96fef8807ddec9f9.description: The second part of a text adventure in which a map leads to the palace of an evil necromancer who tried to take over the world 150 years ago. The wizard Vandard gives you an important task inside.
dos:96fef8807ddec9f9.title: Legacy of the Necromancer: Part II: The Palace of the Necromancer

dos:97041851fad2a3fd.description: A promotional platformer from Nestle, given away in Nesquik cereal boxes. As Quicky the Nesquik bunny you recover stolen secret recipes from a crazy doctor across fifteen chocolate cereal-filled levels.
dos:97041851fad2a3fd.title: Tricky Quiky Games: Die Suche nach den verschollenen Seiten II

dos:9705eff282323d5e.description: An arcade hockey game based on the arcade original, without statistics or team customization. Play two players or against the computer, with single game and tournament modes, and occasional fights.
dos:9705eff282323d5e.title: Blades of Steel

dos:9741ef85c6cb028a.description: The sequel to Star Trek: 25th Anniversary, with the whole Enterprise crew in 8 new episodes. Strange events in distant space, such as dead planets spawning life, call for navigating space and sending away teams to planets.
dos:9741ef85c6cb028a.title: Star Trek: Judgment Rites (Limited CD-ROM Collector's Edition)

dos:975429bae86e6c52.description: A toolkit for creating your own 3D worlds with the Freescape technology of Castle Master and Driller. Use pull-down menus to create and place objects, define animation, and build networks of rooms, with a simple BASIC-style language.
dos:975429bae86e6c52.title: Virtual Reality Studio

dos:9758f7c70b883fe6.description: A Columns-style falling-block puzzle in which groups of three colored blocks drop into a 6x18 grid and you arrange them into groups of the same color.
dos:9758f7c70b883fe6.title: Stack Up

dos:97610d0d50513050.description: A trading simulation set in medieval times and the Hanseatic League, for up to four players. Build sea routes among the 16 cities of the North and East Sea, with the goal of becoming governor of your hometown.
dos:97610d0d50513050.title: The Patrician

dos:97624b7a3dd902f4.description: A platformer in which aliens trying to steal the World Cup crash and break it into pieces across the globe. As Soccer Kid you retrieve the pieces in Britain, Italy, Russia, Japan and the States, using a football.
dos:97624b7a3dd902f4.title: Soccer Kid

dos:977297c98923c33d.description: The commercial sequel to Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold, with the same first-person shooter play. The elevator is replaced by a bomb on each map that you carry to a security cube.
dos:977297c98923c33d.title: Blake Stone: Planet Strike

dos:9783741f0bb7c1d5.description: An arcade puzzle game in which Zoomer, a Pac-Man lookalike with arms and legs, traces the outline of squares on the board to light them up. You advance when all the squares are lit.
dos:9783741f0bb7c1d5.title: Zoom!

dos:97899dd5bde0e849.description: A Christmas add-on for Ducks with two four-level episodes, Mulled Wine and Figgy Pudding. It adds new items and Christmas backgrounds that also work with the original levels.
dos:97899dd5bde0e849.title: Xmas Ducks 2000

dos:9790a48f18176552.description: A short freeware text adventure made with TADS to advertise Unnkulia Zero. You are an Acme salesman working out of the Golden Dragon Inn, next to Dread Unnkulia.
dos:9790a48f18176552.title: Unnkulia One-Half: The Salesman Triumphant

dos:97a3f8e43760a5b6.description: A detailed Formula One simulation in which you drive a Ferrari 187/88C, McLaren MP4/4 or Williams FW12, each with its own traits. Rival drivers have their own styles, and pit stop timing matters.
dos:97a3f8e43760a5b6.title: Grand Prix Circuit

dos:97a6f915f61edec7.description: A keyboard-controlled tribute to Bomberman from Dodgy Posse, with Adventure and Battle modes and three sizes of play area. In Battle mode you face a computer-controlled bomberman.
dos:97a6f915f61edec7.title: I Can't Believe It's Not... Bomberman

dos:97a9b68a3ca3cd28.description: A two-player artillery game with a preset number of battles on randomly generated terrain. Players on opposite sides take turns firing missiles at each other until only one remains.
dos:97a9b68a3ca3cd28.title: PC Pillbox

dos:97b23d0b4ff408e1.description: The first Caesar city-building strategy game, set in the Roman Empire at its peak. Start as ruler of a small province, building housing, roads, policing, water supply and social events, with tougher assignments as you succeed.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation / City Building; Strategy
dos:97b23d0b4ff408e1.title: Caesar

dos:97b78a3688925095.description: A vertical shoot-em-up from Webfoot Technologies with Space Invaders-style opponents that maneuver across the whole play area in waves.
dos:97b78a3688925095.title: B.A.D.: Blasting, Annihilation & Destruction

dos:97be49c9b3916c2f.description: A no-frills chess program with an adjustable timer, a move record and a log in which the computer shares its thoughts and gives the player recommendations.
dos:97be49c9b3916c2f.title: Mephisto Genius 2.0

dos:97befb47efd2efda.description: A single-player adaptation of Photon, a Lazer Tag rival. Blue Squad and Red Squad, each three strong with a base, fight in a maze-like arena, and you control one Blue Squad member.
dos:97befb47efd2efda.title: Proton

dos:97c2d0c1084dfa00.description: An adventure based on the movie. As Bill and Ted, use Rufus's time-traveling phone booth to visit eras, collect items and get historical figures to follow you, some only after a bribe.
dos:97c2d0c1084dfa00.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure

dos:97ca3f65eb2b5e9a.description: A horror adventure using the graphical interface of Deja Vu and Shadowgate. After your car crashes on a lonely road at night, you wake to find your brother missing.
dos:97ca3f65eb2b5e9a.title: Uninvited

dos:97cb60020d176e73.description: An introductory adventure in which you search for a scientist, missing after experimenting with a time-travel device and accused of murdering a colleague. You must travel back in time to find him.
dos:97cb60020d176e73.title: A Matter of Time

dos:97ce41dd55fd8674.description: An action game set in the seventh millennium on a devastated Earth, where radiation has split humanity into four sub-races. The factions escaped the hostile planet to establish themselves elsewhere.
dos:97ce41dd55fd8674.title: Kristor

dos:97dda1acdf160aea.description: A platform puzzle game in which the Boppin brothers rescue the video game villains trapped in picture patterns by good-doers. Match all the pictures and destroy the blocks.
dos:97dda1acdf160aea.title: Boppin'

dos:97df24c4d0396d2b.description: You are trapped in Thor's domain and must find three missing items scattered through an ASCII world, controlling a smiley face and shooting the many enemies.
dos:97df24c4d0396d2b.title: The Thor Trilogy

dos:97e075fdd02642eb.description: A Wizardry-like role-playing game in which a band of dungeon crawlers seeks the fabled Dragon Sword to confront the dragon Oijngate. Explore large first-person maps and fight monsters.
dos:97e075fdd02642eb.title: The Dragon Sword

dos:97e5be0cf100d565.description: An isometric action game, sequel to the Amiga and C64 platformer Arnie. It is not a licensed title and requires fast reflexes.
dos:97e5be0cf100d565.title: Arnie Savage: Combat Commando

dos:97e65302c16e390d.description: A Wall Street trading simulation for up to four players. A knowledge quiz sets your starting money, then you buy and sell shares and funds in response to market news.
dos:97e65302c16e390d.title: Wall$treet

dos:97ec39fa6589e677.description: A shareware showcase of what ZZT can do, from Epic MegaGames, a kind of sequel to ZZT and Super ZZT. It builds on the popularity of ZZT's homemade worlds shared over bulletin boards.
dos:97ec39fa6589e677.title: Best of ZZT

dos:97ed2debb5cb9906.description: A fish and aquarium simulator in which you catch, breed, evolve and mutate tropical fish, then release them in an aquarium you design. Fish, plants and backdrops are generated with genetic algorithms.
dos:97ed2debb5cb9906.title: El-Fish

dos:980c939f3ef84860.description: A 2D fighting game and Capcom's first with licensed Marvel characters. Play as Colossus, Cyclops, Iceman, Psylocke, Storm or Wolverine, or villains Omega Red, Sentinel, Silver Samurai and Spiral.
dos:980c939f3ef84860.title: X-Men: Children of the Atom

dos:981a06c66f391d17.description: A versus fighting game whose eight combatants are aliens gathered on a spaceship to fight to the death. Story Mode follows the tournament through one alien, and Free Play lets you pit any against each other.
dos:981a06c66f391d17.title: Xenophage: Alien Bloodsport

dos:982993d885b3f6ab.description: Cinemaware's basketball game, with exhibition and league play and a full league season with one player assigned to each of the 28 clubs. Camera positions vary, with top-down views when the ball is close.
dos:982993d885b3f6ab.title: TV Sports: Basketball

dos:9829ad3d0332a089.description: A shooter and strategy game in which, as Nikola ap Io, you lead Strike Force Centauri, an elite team founded to combat pirates, as a Terra Hegemony assault on Alpha Centauri unfolds.
dos:9829ad3d0332a089.title: Terra Nova: Strike Force Centauri

dos:982de74f7be41f85.description: A strategic trading and combat game, similar to Elite, in which the Viking Union controls the railways after the sun's disappearance and an ice age. As a train captain you must overthrow them.
dos:982de74f7be41f85.title: Arctic Baron (Transarctica)

dos:9835103fb62a2193.description: A single-player keyboard blackjack game with four variations: Blackjack, Seven and One-Half, Nine and Pontoon, played with one or two decks.
dos:9835103fb62a2193.title: Tommy's Twenty-One

dos:983712832465b10e.description: The second chapter of Yendorian Tales Book 1. The Orb of Zamora is returned but a new threat rises as powerful wizards invade a mine in the mountains, and your band of adventurers must stop them.
dos:983712832465b10e.title: Yendorian Tales Book 1: Chapter 2

dos:983d5b30e90a8c12.description: A platformer starring small blue-haired Trolls. You roam each level rescuing baby trolls, with a set minimum to collect before leaving through the Pigstop.
dos:983d5b30e90a8c12.title: Trolls

dos:985b9f2201c1688e.description: The successor to Legend of the Sword. The evil wizard Suzar has returned and thrown the five heroes into his dungeon, and as one of them you free your comrades, explore the island and stop him for good.
dos:985b9f2201c1688e.title: The Final Battle

dos:986176a8ccc9d871.description: A puzzle game in which a bouncing ball must clear all the squares matching its color. You steer it only horizontally and use paint pots to change its color.
dos:986176a8ccc9d871.title: Diamonds (1996)

dos:986ab791ced94e11.description: A role-playing game, known in Europe as Galdregons Domain, set in the land of Mezron. The evil wizard Azazael is seeking five gems that will give him ultimate power, and you must stop him against medusas, cults and undead.
dos:986ab791ced94e11.title: Death Bringer

dos:986b9482b1ee8c60.description: A turn-based World War II wargame simulating a what-if battle between General Patton and Field Marshal Rommel for Normandy. The aim is to gather as many points as possible, positive for the Allies and negative for the Axis.
dos:986b9482b1ee8c60.title: Patton vs. Rommel

dos:987bf740c28b22b3.description: A Formula One simulation with real teams and cars, 16 Grand Prix courses and a track editor. Drive for one of five teams in a single race or a full season, adjusting car setup for realistic weather.
dos:987bf740c28b22b3.title: Grand Prix Unlimited

dos:988197c145af567f.description: An early variation of the classic roguelike Rogue.
dos:988197c145af567f.title: 10Rogue

dos:9896bef5e3a321f5.description: A Christmas edition of Jazz Jackrabbit with four levels, new graphics and sound, and a rap version of Little Drummer Boy. You keep your favorite weapons, but there are no bosses.
dos:9896bef5e3a321f5.title: Jazz Jackrabbit: Holiday Hare 1995

dos:98af97bffcf543fd.description: A simple top-down role-playing game, written by one programmer for a 1995 contest, in which you save a girl from a bully.
dos:98af97bffcf543fd.title: Warrior's Quest

dos:98b5ceb7c5adafba.description: A NetHack variant adding new player roles, monsters, items and special levels. Its name stands for SuperLotsoAddedStuffHack, and it draws on earlier variants NetHack Plus and NetHack--.
dos:98b5ceb7c5adafba.title: SLASH

dos:98b7a310d298f6e5.description: A platformer in which a mother kangaroo is separated from her child. Each level is a three-storey structure you climb by jumping.
dos:98b7a310d298f6e5.title: Kangaroo

dos:98bef03448070756.description: A very simple first-person maze game in which you hunt for treasures dropped in the maze, with no enemies or dangers so you can explore at your own pace.
dos:98bef03448070756.title: Treasure Hunt

dos:98c44d7ab089e5b9.description: A strategy game in which you adjust four machines, two tanks, a mixer and a conveyor belt, to produce good boxes quickly. There are four skill levels, and fast work gets you promoted to President.
dos:98c44d7ab089e5b9.title: Factory Works I

dos:98c8cb8da07ef911.description: A basic football management game based on the English leagues, in which you take any team from the Conference to the top division. Pick your starting eleven, rated by ability and fitness, and use the transfer market.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:98c8cb8da07ef911.title: Graeme Souness Soccer Manager

dos:98c91b391ad42c89.description: A DOS clone of Sega's Columns falling-block puzzle game.
dos:98c91b391ad42c89.title: Columns (1989)

dos:98cb15ff19d76c42.description: The second game of a series by Mirinae, a vertical-scrolling shooter that followed the MSX release For the Day 2.
dos:98cb15ff19d76c42.title: The Day 3: Dragon Force

dos:98d0650170f96f47.description: A remake of Skool Daze with new graphics and sound but the same 1985 gameplay, plus random weather and other effects. You play Eric, a school student.
dos:98d0650170f96f47.title: Klass of '99

dos:98d2d47b1b6a06c9.description: A rally game covering the African part of the 11th Paris-Dakar route in 1988-1989, through Tunisia, Algeria, Niger, Burkina Faso, Mali and Senegal. You drive a car from a behind-the-car view along a marked path in the Sahara.
dos:98d2d47b1b6a06c9.title: African Raiders-01

dos:98db713cff4f8c39.description: A top-down space shooter in a semi-3D environment in which you fire rounds and missiles at enemies. You can enter tunnels to collect ammo, shield or fuel upgrades by climbing the walls.
dos:98db713cff4f8c39.title: Stargoose Warrior

dos:98ddf86a944b84d9.description: A chess game played against the computer, with a set of historical games by professionals. It is meant for serious players and can be viewed as 2D icons or in 3D.
dos:98ddf86a944b84d9.title: Complete Chess System

dos:98df53e08dacd8ab.description: The first Microsoft Flight Simulator, advanced enough in 1982 to meet FAA regulations. It gives full control of the instrument panel, configurable for any experience level, with more than 20 airports.
dos:98df53e08dacd8ab.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (v1.0)

dos:98e13ca5fe84d132.description: A Bomberman-like game designed only for multiplayer battles on one computer, in which anthropomorphic rabbits play demolition experts trying to kill each other. It started as shareware and became free in 2001.
dos:98e13ca5fe84d132.title: Xplosiv

dos:98ed67135b140b4d.description: A Mario Kart-style racing game with unusual characters, such as Siamese twins, a circus trainer and a mad scientist, racing hot-rods over ten tracks with weapons like lightning bolts, body bags and chickens.
dos:98ed67135b140b4d.title: Wreckin Crew

dos:98f04dbb7d1de09f.description: The Aliants have conquered Earth, and as a surviving member of the human forces you fight back in the story of humankind's struggle.
dos:98f04dbb7d1de09f.title: Aliants: The Desperate Battle For Earth!

dos:98f058c345278ab1.description: A single-player, mouse- or keyboard-controlled draughts game from the developer of Colossus Draughts, which won championships in the early 1990s.
dos:98f058c345278ab1.title: Colossus X Draughts

dos:990168f19f28eaf9.description: Drive Ike and Billy Joe's moonshine-running car across the US, viewed from above and behind in the style of OutRun and Lotus. It plays like a reverse Chase H.Q., fleeing Sheriff Sam's staff.
dos:990168f19f28eaf9.title: Moonshine Racers

dos:9905cbf2b9759b10.description: Rescue the Lemmings across 120 puzzle levels. They walk blindly toward the exit past drops, gaps, barriers and rivers, and you control them by assigning skills to individual ones.
dos:9905cbf2b9759b10.title: Lemmings

dos:9914133d20eef7bb.description: A compilation of Williams arcade classics: Defender, Defender II, Joust, Robotron: 2084 and Sinistar. The PC version also includes video supplements with interviews with the original programmers.
dos:9914133d20eef7bb.title: Williams Arcade Classics

dos:991e27d422447b53.description: A new platformer with an old-school look by Japanese developer Inufuto, who writes his games with his own C compiler for many 8-bit platforms. Clear each level by collecting all the stars while avoiding the baddies.
dos:991e27d422447b53.title: Cracky

dos:992f321d5f2f306a.description: An early text adventure about a date at a drive-in cinema. Choose actions to influence how the evening develops.
dos:992f321d5f2f306a.title: Drive-In

dos:9936c5813e0c1c7c.description: A comedy adventure in which you work for an intergalactic pizza shop, making deliveries across the universe.
dos:9936c5813e0c1c7c.title: Pizza Quest I: Cruisin for a Bruisin

dos:9938c2707699a03a.description: A first-person 3D paddle game that mixes Arkanoid with a shooter. You shoot fireballs against walls to break free by destroying the breakable ones.
dos:9938c2707699a03a.title: Breakfree

dos:9942d9404eb04a57.description: A role-playing game of swords and sorcery meeting steam-age technology. Lead a party of up to six from the standard fantasy races and classes to stop the Darkfall from engulfing the world of Aden.
dos:9942d9404eb04a57.title: World of Aden: Thunderscape

dos:994598814c65a298.description: A light-cycle style game for multiple players, based on the Amiga game Dune 3. Each player steers a worm continuously across the field, and running into walls or other worms is fatal.
dos:994598814c65a298.title: Pune

dos:994f0f8cc09c1b85.description: A fan-made vertical-scrolling shooter with ships from the Star Wars universe, with no regard for sides. You are attacked by hordes of TIE Fighters, Millennium Falcons and other ships.
dos:994f0f8cc09c1b85.title: Starwars 2

dos:99565caa4e42bc0b.description: An adventure set in 16th-century Rouen, where Geoffroi Le Brun arrives for a new posting at the musketeer headquarters. A dying Comte has had his precious will stolen by bandits.
dos:99565caa4e42bc0b.title: Touché: The Adventures of the Fifth Musketeer

dos:9964acd70d85837d.description: A shareware platform shooter in the vein of Duke Nukem II and Bio Menace. In a post-apocalyptic world, survivor Rock Tempest emerges to find mutated life forms and fights his way to safety.
dos:9964acd70d85837d.title: Mutant Earth

dos:9965147de696c22b.description: A television quiz show with a dating-game twist. Learn the other contestants' preferences and earn money to buy items that improve your chances of making a connection.
dos:9965147de696c22b.title: Late Night S♥xy TV Show

dos:99684d71c74f5188.description: Play a black ant sneaking into the nest of the white ants to steal their eggs, guarded by the white queen and her soldiers. It uses character graphics like all of Tommy's games.
dos:99684d71c74f5188.title: Tommy's Ant Farm

dos:997426e4014e92a8.description: A shareware single-player card game with several patience variants: Accordion, Klondike, Canfield and Scorpion.
dos:997426e4014e92a8.title: Tommy's Patience

dos:998a26a744397465.description: An alternate version of Corncob 3-D sold directly by the maker. Having driven the aliens off Earth, you pursue them as they take refuge on the other planets of the solar system.
dos:998a26a744397465.title: Corncob 3-D: The Other Worlds Campaign

dos:9991693699aceb10.description: A Kaboom!-style game in which a mad bomber throws bombs from a high wall and you catch them in buckets of water before they detonate. It is controlled by mouse or joystick.
dos:9991693699aceb10.title: Kerboom!

dos:99979a982a2cc420.description: An adventure in which Raymond Pardon, jailed for six years for a hold-up he did not commit, has also lost his wife Mylene. You investigate to discover who was involved.
dos:99979a982a2cc420.title: L'Affaire...

dos:9999d2e8e7521472.description: A fantasy adventure that replaces the usual inventory puzzles with magical four-note melodies called drafts, played on a distaff.
dos:9999d2e8e7521472.title: Loom

dos:999cbb88120d803a.description: A single-player Pac-Man-like game in which you eat food in a maze while chased by ghosts. The maze is much larger and extends beyond the screen in all directions.
dos:999cbb88120d803a.title: Eat'em II

dos:999f8cf72e9f513c.description: A platformer in which Ulysses, washed ashore after a storm, is asked by the people to rescue twelve women imprisoned by the witch Circe for sacrifice, in return for help getting home to Ithaca.
dos:999f8cf72e9f513c.title: Ulises

dos:99a2df997dc7f51b.description: A pinball game themed on time. The first table is set in a past of dinosaurs, the second in the present, and the third in a different era.
dos:99a2df997dc7f51b.title: Pinball Prelude

dos:99c5c668983d963d.description: A shareware Monopoly for two to four players with save game, written by Don Phillip Gibson to teach himself Turbo Pascal. It follows all the official Parker Brothers rules.
dos:99c5c668983d963d.title: Monopoly (1985)

dos:99c6b108ac90c792.description: An educational town-building game. Pick buildings to place on a green plot, which the game builds and joins with roads, then drive a little car around the town in two play modes.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Education; Racing & Driving
dos:99c6b108ac90c792.title: Stickybear Town Builder

dos:99c888bf0e62957a.description: An arcade action game in which you command the Starship Enterprise against NOMAD. Fight through ten levels of multiple rounds with Klingon fighters and other threats.
dos:99c888bf0e62957a.title: Star Trek: Strategic Operations Simulator

dos:99ca600c7ae18fae.description: Control the Diamond Grabber and collect all the diamonds scattered through the maze.
dos:99ca600c7ae18fae.title: Diamond Grabber

dos:99cbc36766f121c3.description: A single-player shareware draw poker game. You start with $500 in chips, bet in $10 increments, and may discard any of your five cards for replacements.
dos:99cbc36766f121c3.title: Draw Poker (1991)

dos:99cc564ff5dc25f5.description: Run an upstart car company from the beginning of the 20th century, designing cars, opening branches across Europe, hiring workers and engineers, and building ever larger factories.
dos:99cc564ff5dc25f5.title: Motor City

dos:99d3b5199ba114db.description: A fighting game pitting a red ninja against a blue one. Move, jump, duck and swing your sword to kill your opponent.
dos:99d3b5199ba114db.title: Eternal Fight: The Ninja 3

dos:99e4869e0689019a.description: A Lode Runner clone in which you collect everything on a level and exit through the top using ladders. You can dig holes in the brick floor to trap enemies.
dos:99e4869e0689019a.title: Scavenger

dos:99e7d9a443dbf3dc.description: A simple Bust-A-Move style bubble puzzle game.
dos:99e7d9a443dbf3dc.title: BangWool

dos:99f4860007a2ccf4.description: A four-level platformer starring Michael Jackson. In the first level you dodge fans while finding the pieces of a rabbit costume, then escape on a motorbike to Michaelsville to find orbs that transform it.
dos:99f4860007a2ccf4.title: Moonwalker

dos:99fa674a58346165.description: The sequel to Desert Strike. Ibn Kilbaba, son of the dead Kilbaba, threatens to destroy America, and you fly missions to stop him.
dos:99fa674a58346165.title: Jungle Strike

dos:9a058fb0c36f74b2.description: Become a gambler in Donald Trump's Trump Castle casino-hotel. Play blackjack, craps, keno, poker, roulette and slots, with a $10,000 bet limit that can be changed and a high score table.
dos:9a058fb0c36f74b2.title: Trump Castle: The Ultimate Casino Gambling Simulation

dos:9a08f88a22d52967.description: An adventure in which P. J. Barrett picks up the wrong TV at a repair shop, turns it on at home and is sucked through a portal into a strange world.
dos:9a08f88a22d52967.title: Altered Destiny

dos:9a33ad9e2432fb46.description: An educational mystery game in which you help Jake and Jennifer Eagle solve over 50 mysteries in London while sightseeing. Collect clues and review them on a handheld computer called T.R.A.V.I.S.
dos:9a33ad9e2432fb46.title: Eagle Eye Mysteries in London

dos:9a39b35566563210.description: A game of combat in the age of fighting sail, seen from a graphical deck view, with a chart view for checking positions in fleet battles. It runs on ten-minute turns or issue-orders-on-interrupt.
dos:9a39b35566563210.title: Ralph Bosson's High Seas

dos:9a39c97668c9e01f.description: The sequel to Aces of the Pacific, set in the Western theater of World War II. Fly fighters and fighter-bombers for England, Germany or the United States, escorting bombers, attacking ground troops and controlling the skies.
dos:9a39c97668c9e01f.title: Aces Over Europe

dos:9a40d5e999a2348f.description: An adventure in which the newly crowned King Callash of Gran Callahach faces the return of the sorcerer Sanwe, who was imprisoned twenty years earlier by the Dragonsphere spell and swore revenge.
dos:9a40d5e999a2348f.title: Dragonsphere

dos:9a5ff94b70e76e61.description: A 3D tank game, often called the earliest ancestor of first-person shooters. Earth has been invaded and you drive from a first-person view, targeting and firing at tanks and planes.
dos:9a5ff94b70e76e61.title: Battle Zone

dos:9a7ad41760a8486d.description: A humorous animated chess game in which pieces capture with digitized live-action cutscenes. The computer player taunts and distracts you, and will steal a piece if you let it.
dos:9a7ad41760a8486d.title: National Lampoon's Chess Maniac 5 Billion and 1

dos:9a912da34d80aaf9.description: A Jagged Alliance spin-off in which you lead mercenaries through missions in overhead-view turn-based combat. It adds new mission types, weapons and multiplayer over IPX.
dos:9a912da34d80aaf9.title: Jagged Alliance: Deadly Games

dos:9a93e595659997c6.description: A chess program that won the 1989 British Open Personal Computer Chess Championship. It has a pull-down menu interface.
dos:9a93e595659997c6.title: Chess Player 2150

dos:9ab47e3a5a1b1451.description: A tile-based puzzle game in which Chip must pass an initiation test to join the Bit Busters computer club. Use keys and special shoes to get through 149 increasingly difficult levels.
dos:9ab47e3a5a1b1451.title: Chip's Challenge

dos:9abac22cad04f072.description: A Cold War spy text adventure set in the border town of Ostnitz between the fictional Eastern Bloc nation of Frobnia and neutral Litzenburg, as the US ambassador is about to arrive.
dos:9abac22cad04f072.title: Border Zone

dos:9aca7968e0340e02.description: An Italian pinball game with 6 sci-fi tables, with music and voice.
dos:9aca7968e0340e02.title: Pinball Warriors

dos:9acf04cc6c768596.description: A futuristic adventure set in 2160. Devlin McCormack arrives at the deep space station Cerberus after his son Danny's death and, finding he was murdered, stays to investigate.
dos:9acf04cc6c768596.title: The Orion Conspiracy

dos:9afb1cd352c7e6a3.description: The full version of a QBasic role-playing game with several characters, including a secret one, plus magic and items.
dos:9afb1cd352c7e6a3.title: Elysian Fields

dos:9b034ba01b3e786b.description: The first StarFight title, a cinematic multi-genre game with one short third-person adventure section and five action levels, whose events are all hard-coded.
dos:9b034ba01b3e786b.title: StarFight

dos:9b08577f76fdb422.description: Manage a team in a new European Super League, choosing from over a hundred teams from all over Europe.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:9b08577f76fdb422.title: Footy Fanatic

dos:9b14371c0399261d.description: The first game from Mirinae Software and the first top-down shooter from South Korea. Before each planet-level you choose from a wide variety of ships and weapons.
dos:9b14371c0399261d.title: Defender of Freedom

dos:9b1dbb39d5507f74.description: A basic Korean-language Sokoban-style puzzle game.
dos:9b1dbb39d5507f74.title: Chang Go Ji Gi

dos:9b2374156076fc02.description: A platformer based on the film. Young Simba is banished after his father Mufasa is killed and his evil uncle Scar takes over the kingdom, and he must grow up and return.
dos:9b2374156076fc02.title: The Lion King

dos:9b2383a05c97c496.description: A two-player strategy board game on a 10x10 board. Players take turns placing tiles of their color, flipping any single opposing tile between two of theirs, and aim for the most tiles.
dos:9b2383a05c97c496.title: Magnetic

dos:9b2bb5dcddcca3d9.description: The sequel to Saboteur, in which the ninja hero has been killed and his sister Nina avenges him with kung-fu moves across 700 screens.
dos:9b2bb5dcddcca3d9.title: Saboteur II

dos:9b381dccf4b4c97e.description: A Tetris-style game in which you connect one side of a well to the other with a circuit of blocks. There are ten kinds, including stopper blocks and universal blocks that complete any circuit.
dos:9b381dccf4b4c97e.title: On Disk Monthly's Circuitry

dos:9b39434e2010fe73.description: A first-person shooter set in 2044, when corporations rule a fallen world and rebels fight them. Your hero sacrifices his life to save a stranger and is revived in the stranger's lab.
dos:9b39434e2010fe73.title: CyberMage: Darklight Awakening

dos:9b3e614409b7d879.description: You are a green worm eating pizzas, and each one lengthens your tail. Unlike similar games, the worm can turn at many angles rather than just right angles.
dos:9b3e614409b7d879.title: Pizza Worm

dos:9b42d7776570de6c.description: A text adventure set after a nuclear war, in which you are one of the few survivors, mutant gangs roam the land, and you must find a sanctuary.
dos:9b42d7776570de6c.title: Sanctuary

dos:9b4b55386127aade.description: A fighting game based on the arcade original. A Shaolin tournament held every 50 years has been corrupted by the sorcerer Shang Tsung and his warrior Prince Goro, who aim to win ten in a row for the Outworld.
dos:9b4b55386127aade.title: Mortal Kombat

dos:9b5602b0eb977fdd.description: A puzzle game inspired by the Rubik's Cube. Shift and rotate the lower ring to copy the pattern on the upper ring before time runs out.
dos:9b5602b0eb977fdd.title: Scrylis

dos:9b5743d51a51661c.description: A single-player Tetris-like game, the last version, with added features such as banking the next piece.
dos:9b5743d51a51661c.title: Quatris II Gold

dos:9b739814386571ee.description: An educational title for ages seven and up in which Rayman teaches numeracy and literacy. The games match Volume 1 but with more difficult questions.
dos:9b739814386571ee.title: Maths and English with Rayman Volume 2

dos:9b7511445ab4615c.description: A medieval war strategy game and role-playing game covering all of Middle Earth. Play alternates between overhead maps with real-time strategic control and scrolling wilderness screens for combat.
dos:9b7511445ab4615c.title: J.R.R. Tolkien's War in Middle Earth

dos:9b951e8899505118.description: Start with a basic Lamborghini and $6000 and rise through the 4 racing divisions across 60 American racetracks. Each division has 20 rivals, with up to 3 in each race.
dos:9b951e8899505118.title: Lamborghini: American Challenge

dos:9b961f021af1988d.description: The game show Family Feud. Two families compete to guess the five most popular survey answers to a question, scoring points for the number of people who gave the same answer.
dos:9b961f021af1988d.title: The All New Family Feud

dos:9b96b0f4caa38d73.description: A first-person shooting gallery game based on a South Korean fantasy-futuristic film of the same name.
tags: Action; First Person Shooter; Flight Simulator; Vehicle Simulation
dos:9b96b0f4caa38d73.title: Dragon Tuka 3D

dos:9b9ef1d46c1a6104.description: Run a transport company from 1930, in the midst of the Great Depression, building an empire of trains, ships, lorries, planes and helicopters as technology evolves. Play alone or against computer rivals.
dos:9b9ef1d46c1a6104.title: Transport Tycoon

dos:9baeac8993bcd132.description: A set of 20 simple games, including cards, shooting, billiards, cups and Tetris. It has arcade, travel, versus and practice modes for up to two players, and supports PC Gun.
dos:9baeac8993bcd132.title: Bon Bon Paradise

dos:9bbb5bbf73f93800.description: A single-player keyboard-controlled variant of Star Trek with nine difficulty levels and an autoplay mode that plays itself until you take over.
dos:9bbb5bbf73f93800.title: Tommy's Trek

dos:9bc4d6be29bdd1b3.description: A baseball game with teams from different eras, such as those with Babe Ruth and Willie Mays, and camera angles and TV-style presentation.
dos:9bc4d6be29bdd1b3.title: Earl Weaver Baseball

dos:9bc64f8e97af80f3.description: An arcade Formula 1 race with some simulation elements. Run a single race, a series or a championship, with settings such as the number of participants.
dos:9bc64f8e97af80f3.title: GP Sprint

dos:9bd4d994f2ef44f2.description: An adventure in which you help the treasure hunter Killian search for the lost dwarven kingdom of Dol Armaeth, overrun by evil after its wise king died. The areas are visited in a linear order.
dos:9bd4d994f2ef44f2.title: Armaëth: The Lost Kingdom

dos:9bdaf955d4384eab.description: An educational simulation about volcanoes and the Mount Saint Helens eruption, in three parts to be taken in order, including a survival simulation.
dos:9bdaf955d4384eab.title: Volcano!

dos:9bdb38bdfbfc1c0e.description: A soccer management simulation that emphasizes psychology. As manager you control strategy, half-time pep talks and PR moves to improve public perception.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:9bdb38bdfbfc1c0e.title: On the Ball

dos:9be8a3857d199035.description: A text adventure in which you look for the leprechaun's pot of gold at the end of the rainbow, starting in your own bedroom apartment and roaming the streets, woods and caves.
dos:9be8a3857d199035.title: Shenanigans

dos:9bea6b9d7ea95c45.description: A World War II simulation of the B-17 bomber group, the 306th Bomb Group. It covers training, the move to Thurleigh, England, and twenty-five missions, starting as a second lieutenant with few flight hours.
dos:9bea6b9d7ea95c45.title: First Over Germany

dos:9bea737581cecc40.description: A text adventure in which your ship has crash-landed on a hostile alien planet and you must gather parts inside a deserted alien ship to get off.
dos:9bea737581cecc40.title: Marooned Again

dos:9bf3a5f932c6ea84.description: An artillery game in the vein of Worms or Scorched Earth, featuring manly squirrels.
dos:9bf3a5f932c6ea84.title: WarKurre

dos:9bfa4f46027c8e83.description: The first adventure of Sir Ramic Hobbs, a drunken and dimwitted knight bound to rescue a princess from a gorilla. A disembodied wizard narrates and advises, in a game full of insult jokes.
dos:9bfa4f46027c8e83.title: Sir Ramic Hobbs and the High Level Gorilla

dos:9bfb794d46bdfec0.description: A shareware single-player game of Nim against the computer. You can change the rule so that the winner is the one who makes the last legal move.
dos:9bfb794d46bdfec0.title: Tommy's Nim

dos:9bfe600f9694d06e.description: A top-down arcade game like Gauntlet in which Storm and a Wizard friend rescue Storm's wife Corrine from the lab of Una Cum. Kill monsters and collect treasure, alone or with a second player.
dos:9bfe600f9694d06e.title: Storm

dos:9bff7f4fc1229447.description: A first-person space shooter in which you operate a turret on a spaceship, defending it from enemy ships and asteroids with limited rockets and a main weapon that shares energy with the shields.
dos:9bff7f4fc1229447.title: Backlash: A Turret Gunner Simulation

dos:9c0759bb4382ac1b.description: An early collection of talking story books for children.
dos:9c0759bb4382ac1b.title: Bookie Bookworm Collection

dos:9c09151f5b264f2e.description: You play a small green creature who must climb eight towers to blow them up, as they are poisoning the water of potential colony planets. You make your way up via walkways around the outside.
dos:9c09151f5b264f2e.title: Tower Toppler

dos:9c0d7b6b6986c1d8.description: An epic role-playing game set in medieval Germany. Take a premade party or create characters by choosing career paths from age 10, with more time in a career making them better.
dos:9c0d7b6b6986c1d8.title: Darklands

dos:9c0dd15c5bbebb95.description: A cartoony side-scroller in which a Viking child frees friends and family held by the god Loki in Valhalla. Fight through 16 levels, with shops where you can buy items.
dos:9c0dd15c5bbebb95.title: Prophecy: Viking Child

dos:9c1faf396b89a7fc.description: A shareware card game for one to seven players, with the computer filling in for missing players. It is a trick-taking game in which you bid how many tricks you will take and score for hitting exactly that number.
dos:9c1faf396b89a7fc.title: Tommy's Oh Hell

dos:9c315680fb9c81c8.description: A real-time strategy game in which humans sent to prepare Planet X3 for colonization find an alien race, the Protoids, has also landed. Help from Earth is at least 13 years away.
dos:9c315680fb9c81c8.title: Planet X3

dos:9c31da52ceb54178.description: The sequel to Defender. Rescue humanoids before Landers turn them into Mutants, now carrying them to safety through the Stargate, which also warps you to the nearest humanoid in danger.
dos:9c31da52ceb54178.title: Stargate

dos:9c379c937e520248.description: A platformer in which Tiny Goodbite, one of the California Raisins, rescues his captured friends from a cereal factory. Climb and jump through many floors, collecting a key on each level.
dos:9c379c937e520248.title: The California Raisins

dos:9c39ed2fcc6d98bf.description: Two programs in one: Desert Storm, a multimedia database about the Gulf War including the Pentagon's official report, and Coalition Command, a strategy game.
dos:9c39ed2fcc6d98bf.title: Desert Storm with Coalition Command

dos:9c427dfd014a7c84.description: Build influence in a fictional city's criminal underworld while pursuing political power. Manage money, recruit helpers, buy property and vehicles, and take part in overhead action sequences against rivals.
dos:9c427dfd014a7c84.title: Dime City

dos:9c439e98e520d99c.description: MiraCom's supercomputer has taken over a corporation and threatens to destroy Paris. As the fighter pilot Blue Arrow, you pilot a cybership through eleven levels.
dos:9c439e98e520d99c.title: FIREWALL: Man vs. Machine

dos:9c4555aa2c93d68c.description: A keyboard-controlled ASCII shooter. Pirates of the mad Emperor Louis the 30th have captured your friend Jean, and you pilot an armed hovercraft through seven islands destroying missile towers to rescue him.
dos:9c4555aa2c93d68c.title: Rescue!

dos:9c4792d985922265.description: An educational game in which the Berenstain Bears teach young children about letters.
dos:9c4792d985922265.title: The Berenstain Bears: Learn About Letters

dos:9c49de65d818cd74.description: An educational game teaching kids about Australian geography and history and about major diseases. You play a doctor and pilot for the Royal Flying Doctor Service.
dos:9c49de65d818cd74.title: Foxtrot Delta

dos:9c4c6ed27c5631bf.description: A roguelike role-playing game by Erno Tuomainen, set in the fantasy world of Salmorria, where you are a burly adventurer seeking quests and gold.
dos:9c4c6ed27c5631bf.title: The Legend of Saladir
