dos:9c56344491d209c9.description: Lead your country's space program in a race to the moon against a competing superpower. Develop and make safe your hardware, choose your astronauts, and get them there.
dos:9c56344491d209c9.title: Buzz Aldrin's Race into Space

dos:9c595d526336e79b.description: A Danish arcade game sponsored by Unibank. You play a seal swimming through coastal waters, avoiding fishing nets, stones and barrels, and periodically surfacing as an air gauge decreases.
dos:9c595d526336e79b.title: Luffe

dos:9c5efbab3b941630.description: A platform and puzzle game in which you operate an unconventional machine at a toy company, cranking out action figures from Star Wars, Indiana Jones and LucasArts games to meet a quota each night.
dos:9c5efbab3b941630.title: Night Shift

dos:9c73b62725f41ec8.description: Patrol planets in both a jeep and a helicopter, destroying enemy units and obstacles. The jeep has more hit points, and in two-player mode the helicopter can help the jeep.
dos:9c73b62725f41ec8.title: Heli-Jeep

dos:9c79c534290880e6.description: The second part of a series of rare French puzzle games for very young children from Colorado Technologies, teaching color shades and geometric shapes.
dos:9c79c534290880e6.title: Gaminours: Shapes and Colors

dos:9c7ca7b48c37e8ab.description: A first-person shooter based on the first three Alien films. As Lt. Ripley you play three sections, the LV426 colony, the prison planet and the derelict ship, with about ten missions each.
dos:9c7ca7b48c37e8ab.title: Alien Trilogy

dos:9c7e6e1f49a7e9db.description: Command a lunar base. Supply oxygen, water, power, heat and shelter for the colony, starting from a bare mineral-rich lunar plain.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation / City Building
dos:9c7e6e1f49a7e9db.title: Moonbase

dos:9c848eccb057fe7e.description: A text adventure based on Arthur C. Clarke's novel. A giant asteroid approaching Earth proves to be an alien starship, and as commander of the Endeavor you must rendezvous with and explore it.
dos:9c848eccb057fe7e.title: Rendezvous with Rama

dos:9c90ed0396b748e0.description: An enhanced Sensible Soccer with virtually every important soccer league, with multiple divisions in many countries, all major international competitions, and a career mode.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:9c90ed0396b748e0.title: Sensible World of Soccer

dos:9c9f0bc39bc736c5.description: An arcade space shooter set in heavily defended underground caverns with wind tunnels, fire-walls and lakes. Use your tractor beam to recover stolen nuclear pods and carry them to the surface.
dos:9c9f0bc39bc736c5.title: TerraFire

dos:9cb3086f6e9bd886.description: The sequel to The 7th Guest, with improved video compression. You play Carl Denning, boyfriend of the reporter Robin Morales, who has mysteriously vanished.
dos:9cb3086f6e9bd886.title: The 11th Hour

dos:9cbbdd7ebed3cee3.description: A Snake variant in which you guide a snake across a board to eat digits, growing longer. Eat 9 digits for 10 points each to finish a level, and hitting a wall, obstacle or your own tail costs a life.
dos:9cbbdd7ebed3cee3.title: Zmiy

dos:9cbc78483871e215.description: A city-building strategy game with cartoony graphics and gentle humor. Choose a starting point with flat land and resources, and compete for supremacy with up to 3 others.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation / City Building; Strategy
dos:9cbc78483871e215.title: Serf City: Life is Feudal

dos:9cc177a2a3bc4058.description: A five-level hack-and-slash game with a boss at the end of each level. Fight flying demons, chimeras, valkyries and skeletons with axes, maces and fire weapons to save the land of Lograth.
dos:9cc177a2a3bc4058.title: Rastan

dos:9ccdd6800c47dfb5.description: A text adventure in which the great wizard Zot has left behind a castle full of monsters, traps and treasures, including the orb of power. You are an adventurer in search of the orb and other treasure.
dos:9ccdd6800c47dfb5.title: The Wizard's Castle (1981)

dos:9cd2dbd1710506d2.description: A racing game licensed from Speed Racer. All the main characters appear, including Racer X, Pops, Trixie, Spritle and Chim-Chim, and you play Speed Racer.
dos:9cd2dbd1710506d2.title: Speed Racer in The Challenge of Racer X

dos:9cd8709e30ddaf0b.description: A detailed golf simulation endorsed by Greg Norman, with two courses and 3D modeling of ball lie and swing style. Ball effects, weather and wind are optional, and match play and stroke play are offered.
dos:9cd8709e30ddaf0b.title: Greg Norman's Shark Attack!: The Ultimate Golf Simulator

dos:9cdd07d22ce19168.description: An action game in which aliens who watched Earth's wars as television drop modern weapons on past eras, and a British scientist who discovers the conspiracy sets out to stop them.
dos:9cdd07d22ce19168.title: Legends

dos:9cea702011f86974.description: A turn-based space conquest game. Start from a single system, harvest metals to build ships, and claim more worlds, with each system also contributing to research.
dos:9cea702011f86974.title: Spaceward Ho!

dos:9ceb3c7db1f160d8.description: A game based on a children's TV game show. Two contestants compete in stunts and trivia, and the winner gathers prizes in a maze.
dos:9ceb3c7db1f160d8.title: Fun House

dos:9ced908094ba9027.description: A squash simulation from Krisalis with accurate rules, an isometric court and legal shot requirements. It offers three ball speeds, variable match lengths and an easy mode.
dos:9ced908094ba9027.title: Jahangir Khan World Championship Squash

dos:9ceef419de12417c.description: Pedestrians keep walking toward gaps in a bridge, and you stop them by blocking the gaps instantly with a keypress. Levels up to 6 have three gaps and later ones four.
dos:9ceef419de12417c.title: Bridge Hopper

dos:9cf3744ac3276e68.description: A complex Tetris variant, an expert-level Welltris in which the well is a cylinder, or tube, instead of a cube.
dos:9cf3744ac3276e68.title: Tubis

dos:9cfe35c86fd6d9a4.description: Probe the sea floor for treasure through 10 levels, with unlimited spears against sharks, killer clams and baby guppies while watching your air gauge.
dos:9cfe35c86fd6d9a4.title: Deep Sea Diver

dos:9cfeab52c1282084.description: A turn-based strategy game in a fantasy world with steampunk elements. The Shadowlord has conquered most of the world, and you are summoned as one of four heroes to free it.
dos:9cfeab52c1282084.title: Fantasy General

dos:9d01984f77e6d9f8.description: A game closely modeled on Out of this World. A man walking in the woods is abducted by anthropomorphic biorobots, their ship crashes on another planet, and the survivor explores it avoiding hostile creatures.
dos:9d01984f77e6d9f8.title: Biorobot's Base

dos:9d035296321f31f7.description: A strategic football simulation focused on coaching. Draft from current or classic teams, then build coaching strategies for the computer to run or call plays yourself, with no direct control of the players.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Football
dos:9d035296321f31f7.title: NFL Pro League Football: New 1991 Version

dos:9d03b6bd5be5b21b.description: An adventure in a Victorian mansion once home to the eccentric Uppingham family, where at least seven fabulous jewels are rumored to be hidden.
dos:9d03b6bd5be5b21b.title: Cuckoo's Nest

dos:9d1e5399a12fc739.description: A Snake-type game in which you prospect for diamonds guarded by ghosts that march across the screen in tight horizontal ranks. You must squirm past them and grab the gems.
dos:9d1e5399a12fc739.title: Squirm

dos:9d1e9523a51f5b7d.description: An adventure set in 1993 at a performance of The Phantom of the Opera, where a chandelier crashes onto the crowd. You play detective Raoul Montand, asked for help by his friend.
dos:9d1e9523a51f5b7d.title: Return of the Phantom

dos:9d22fa9f97a8de86.description: An adventure set in August 1991, days before the USSR collapses. As KGB officer Maksim Rukov in Department P, you investigate corruption and root out double agents, in an engine based on Cryo's Dune.
dos:9d22fa9f97a8de86.title: Conspiracy (Enhanced CD)

dos:9d4a76f7db9bed9a.description: A video game take on the tilting-maze toy. Roll a steel ball through the maze while enemy balls chase and explode on contact, avoiding explosive traps, trap doors and electric sensors.
dos:9d4a76f7db9bed9a.title: Mega Maze

dos:9d5445c4bd3d3947.description: A TRS-80 BASIC text adventure from 1983, the middle of a trilogy between Project Triad and Codename Intrepid. It builds puzzles around math and logic, in one section even requiring a text adventure played inside the adventure.
dos:9d5445c4bd3d3947.title: Beyond the Tesseract

dos:9d5dfcf474c22b11.description: A puzzle game like The Fool's Errand. Follow the Mallard family to all 50 states, solving puzzles at two tourist traps in each to find souvenirs needed for the final puzzle.
dos:9d5dfcf474c22b11.title: Are We There Yet?

dos:9d643bf251c63853.description: A side-scrolling action game like Earthworm Jim in which you control the duck Crazy Drake through six episodes. Evil Dr. FoulBrain has stolen the Sacred GoldenEgg from his palace in LoonVille.
dos:9d643bf251c63853.title: Crazy Drake

dos:9d707cc1bcd5d0c6.description: A shareware educational tile-matching game on a grid. Click cells to flip tiles revealing colors, letters or numbers, and match them to reveal all the tiles.
dos:9d707cc1bcd5d0c6.title: Teaching Tiles

dos:9d721d4f5ca0e97c.description: A puzzle game with 40 multi-screen puzzles, 15 in the shareware version, of up to 200 screens each. Get from a white cone to a green cone, pushing gray cylinders or, in the registered version, sliding gold cylinders.
dos:9d721d4f5ca0e97c.title: Escape from Markana 2

dos:9d75d4d5dfba126c.description: A shareware Trivial Pursuit-style game. The computer simulates the dice roll, moves the player, announces the category and asks a question.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Education; Quiz
dos:9d75d4d5dfba126c.title: Trivia 2000

dos:9d7a3387c67ed95d.description: Steel Panthers World War II, an authorized stand-alone expansion for SSI's Steel Panthers II. It has several hundred scenarios, mostly from World War II and some from the interwar period, plus campaigns.
dos:9d7a3387c67ed95d.title: SPWW2

dos:9d980a88efa8445d.description: A 3D simulation by Alessandro Ghignola, who went on to create Noctis. It uses blue wireframe graphics at 320x200 and was originally in Italian.
dos:9d980a88efa8445d.title: Crystal Pixels

dos:9d9d2a41bd2b1aa7.description: A graphic adventure with a point-and-click icon interface, the sequel to Innocent Until Caught. Play either the macho Jack or the tough feminist Ysanne on another adventure to save the galaxy.
dos:9d9d2a41bd2b1aa7.title: Innocent Until Caught 2: Presumed Guilty

dos:9da0dc36d6199976.description: An adventure in which you play American secret agent Jon Daring on January 1, 2000. British Intelligence calls him to London to infiltrate and stop a threat.
dos:9da0dc36d6199976.title: C.I.T.Y. 2000

dos:9da13af41ad1fe70.description: Move a red circle around the screen with WASD to avoid white circles. You can only see them in your line of sight, and they can lose sight of you too.
dos:9da13af41ad1fe70.title: Evade

dos:9db029b644c57802.description: A mid-90s economic simulation of an airline company. You start owning 100% of a stock corporation with a few million dollars, buy airplanes and define routes, ticket prices and loads on a world map.
dos:9db029b644c57802.title: Airlines

dos:9db8242770d1ad4d.description: A Bible-themed Concentration game about God and Jesus, for one to three players. Match pairs of cards, and the player with the most pairs wins.
dos:9db8242770d1ad4d.title: Maker's Matchup

dos:9dc04c13657f7ec4.description: A pinball game in which you are the ball itself, influencing your roll direction and horizontal orientation with the arrow keys.
dos:9dc04c13657f7ec4.title: Balls from HELL

dos:9ddd81df5521af24.description: The follow-up to Aftershock for Quake, a compilation of over 500 single-player and deathmatch maps, nearly a quarter of them exclusive, and more than 100 QuakeC patches, with a basic front-end.
dos:9ddd81df5521af24.title: Tremor for Quake

dos:9de55451c876e13c.description: A VGA remake with mouse support and digitized sounds of a 1989 educational strategy game about the Norman Conquest of England in the 11th century.
dos:9de55451c876e13c.title: Knights & Kings

dos:9dea93ab6a3812b5.description: A CD re-release of the point-and-click adventure Daughter of Serpents, with a few new scenes and without character generation. You are a visitor on a business trip to an ancient city, where a murder occurs.
dos:9dea93ab6a3812b5.title: The Scroll

dos:9debc24811289544.description: A text adventure that begins at midnight in the center of a medieval castle full of traps and dangers. You have no possessions and must escape through observation and persistence.
dos:9debc24811289544.title: Enchanted Castle

dos:9df3427fd8e9a80c.description: A fighting game in which martial artist Oolong seeks to become Grand Master of Kung-Fu in his father's honor, facing skilled martial artists one on one in side-view battles, with punches and kicks.
dos:9df3427fd8e9a80c.title: Yie Ar Kung Fu

dos:9df667ec8ec1b464.description: The sequel to Livingstone Supongo. Dr. Livingstone must be rescued again, through two worlds with savage animals, hostile natives and deadly traps.
dos:9df667ec8ec1b464.title: Livingstone II

dos:9dfe9e0a8b425443.description: A Cold War spy adventure set in Germany. As an American spy, you must recover stolen NATO defense plans, beginning in your apartment with a computer, bugging equipment and an answerphone.
dos:9dfe9e0a8b425443.title: The Third Courier

dos:9e09ce8f2568a58d.description: A mouse-driven adventure in which you are transported to the BorderWorld. Click N, E, W or S to move, and each destination displays a text description.
dos:9e09ce8f2568a58d.title: Borderworld Part I: The Arrival

dos:9e0c4487e877332a.description: A Settlers-style strategy game in which you build a local economy with housing, food and power before attacking other nations to rule the world. You can pick environmental settings as in Civilization.
dos:9e0c4487e877332a.title: Global Effect

dos:9e12e9c546fdec88.description: A Game Boy-style Tetris in under 3 KB. It has only the classic A-type mode: move, rotate and drop falling pieces, and clear complete lines, with the action speeding up.
dos:9e12e9c546fdec88.title: TinyTris

dos:9e247eab763bf0f0.description: A combination of the computer game Life with ideas from dogfighting and cockfighting, simulating seven life forms that fight for survival. It has animated 16-color graphics and sound.
dos:9e247eab763bf0f0.title: Darwin's Arena

dos:9e26786779a06c30.description: A Linux distribution building simulator. Analyze and select software packages, fix bugs, manage volunteers and paid staff, and keep your distro's size reasonable.
dos:9e26786779a06c30.title: Linux Tycoon

dos:9e27ab9681d406db.description: Save the maiden from the dungeon in a text adventure with a two-word parser.
dos:9e27ab9681d406db.title: Maiden

dos:9e3a54836651ca28.description: A tactical starship simulation of the struggle among Star Trek nations. Take command of a fleet or a single ship from the Federation, Romulans, Klingons or Orions against computer opponents.
dos:9e3a54836651ca28.title: Begin: A Tactical Starship Simulation

dos:9e3abfe3de9c16b9.description: A mouse-driven starship command simulation in which you assign ships and captains to task forces while directly controlling a flagship, with an interface like Star Trek: The Next Generation's LCARS.
dos:9e3abfe3de9c16b9.title: Rules of Engagement 2

dos:9e400961f543482d.description: A Pac-Man variant in which Jr. eats all the dots in a much larger scrolling maze while avoiding four ghosts. Bonus items appear from time to time.
dos:9e400961f543482d.title: Jr. Pac-Man

dos:9e460a8c08388a7a.description: A fan-made version of the game show Wheel of Fortune.
dos:9e460a8c08388a7a.title: Wheel of Fortune (1986)

dos:9e4a977bf38b1de0.description: A miner is caved in and must find the emergency exit that leads to the upper levels. The exit is welded shut, so he has to find a way to open it.
dos:9e4a977bf38b1de0.title: The Tunnel Man

dos:9e4d322ac26a1606.description: A two-player shareware game in which players catapult cows at each other. Catapults can be angled right or left and moved forward, but not backward.
dos:9e4d322ac26a1606.title: Apocalypse Cow

dos:9e51d4844c25c325.description: A conversion of the arcade game Lunar Lander. Land the spacecraft on the pad by adjusting thrust and tilting left or right, and a descent that is too fast crashes the rocket.
dos:9e51d4844c25c325.title: Rocket Lander

dos:9e5b66b7a01c6894.description: An educational game for ages 3 to 6 with a keyboard template of two blue lines dividing the keyboard in four. You press keys above, below, left or right of the lines when asked.
dos:9e5b66b7a01c6894.title: Juggles' Butterfly

dos:9e5d5e9ad8e25430.description: A BBS door game spun off from Legend of the Red Dragon, with silly fantasy and expanded gameplay options and side-shows in the vein of Usurper.
dos:9e5d5e9ad8e25430.title: Betrayal of the Obsidian Baboon

dos:9e63a2430c017686.description: A fantasy role-playing game by Howard Feldman inspired by Pool of Radiance, Shard of Spring and Bard's Tale, following Dungeons and Dragons rules. It takes at least 60 hours to finish.
dos:9e63a2430c017686.title: The Search for Freedom

dos:9e6a99de69a13816.description: An adventure in which a window cleaner in 1989 finds a secret passage to a time machine and alien documents. He is transported to 1304 to rescue someone.
dos:9e6a99de69a13816.title: Future Wars: Adventures In Time

dos:9e6eed708dfe1ad2.description: A cancelled first-person shooter in development at Mindscape in 1995-96, which would have been among the few shooters set in the Warhammer world.
dos:9e6eed708dfe1ad2.title: Warhammer 40000: Dark Crusaders

dos:9e7c6d525ffc19c4.description: A Tetris variant for one or two players with handmade sounds.
dos:9e7c6d525ffc19c4.title: Drop 'Em

dos:9e86f7d8014a911f.description: One of the oldest chess games, developed by David Kittinger in 1979, with a 1984 DOS version. It uses black-and-white CGA graphics and standard chess notation typed on the keyboard.
dos:9e86f7d8014a911f.title: MYCHESS

dos:9e8a90fca8b61894.description: A graphic role-playing game by Martin Richardson in which you search for diamonds, emeralds and magic rings while fighting goblins, ghosts and other fiends.
dos:9e8a90fca8b61894.title: Dungeon of Death (1989)

dos:9e8aec942dd7a307.description: A soccer management simulation, the first in ESP Software's football manager series. Take control of a team from the four English divisions, with cups, stadium improvements, finances, training, sponsorships, contracts and scouts.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:9e8aec942dd7a307.title: Football Masters 96/97

dos:9e9a53ab49ada662.description: A mouse-controlled puzzle in which a picture is broken into pieces and you reassemble it by swapping two pieces at a time, with a chime when a piece lands correctly.
dos:9e9a53ab49ada662.title: Picture Puzzle

dos:9e9c5cff9f62ebd9.description: A real-time strategy game in which you fight for control of sectors, some with factories that produce units. Touch a sector's flag to claim it, and use six robot types with different armaments, armor and speed.
dos:9e9c5cff9f62ebd9.title: Z

dos:9e9ce29078d89fa1.description: Choose from five character classes, Paladin, Necromancer, Barbarian, Zen-Druid or Shadowy Tracker, and explore the three levels of the dungeon Ebon Titan to face the boss Titan himself.
dos:9e9ce29078d89fa1.title: Advanced Xoru

dos:9ea10ed80a7f537f.description: The sequel to Driller. The Ketars are collecting energy with devices called EGOs to blast the planet Evath with radiation, and you must beam into their base on the moon to stop them.
dos:9ea10ed80a7f537f.title: Dark Side

dos:9ea8985bd77cd2c0.description: A compilation of Jane's AH-64D Longbow and the Flash Point: Korea expansion. Fly the AH-64D attack helicopter with an authentic flight model and detailed simulation of its millimeter wave radar.
dos:9ea8985bd77cd2c0.title: Jane's Combat Simulations: AH-64D Longbow Gold

dos:9eaaaab556a50ed4.description: A stunt flying and filming simulation with over 50 aircraft, including the space shuttle, and over 1000 props. Fly around the island, make your own films, or fly stunts for money.
dos:9eaaaab556a50ed4.title: Stunt Island

dos:9eab70c20566d79e.description: A shareware family board game in which players start at the corners and race to the center. A spinner tells each player which colored cell to move to.
dos:9eab70c20566d79e.title: Pallanda

dos:9eb154b3019063d0.description: An arcade conversion in which you are a fighter pilot flying through wave after wave of enemies.
dos:9eb154b3019063d0.title: Lock-On

dos:9ebca88213fac155.description: A talking language teacher that helps you learn to speak Spanish.
dos:9ebca88213fac155.title: Talking Teacher for Early Spanish

dos:9ebcb6455f126c27.description: An interactive fiction game with ANSI graphics, a menu front end and RPG elements. As Star Stryker you hunt Shadow, an escaped mad scientist imprisoned for experimenting with genetic mutants, starting on Nimbus III.
dos:9ebcb6455f126c27.title: Star Stryker

dos:9ebd794356719e1b.description: The sequel to Shadow President, in which, as President of the United States, you handle power, government, diplomacy and terrorists who want to nuke another country with your own arsenal.
dos:9ebd794356719e1b.title: CyberJudas

dos:9ecbaf91e716d85c.description: One of the first golf simulators with DOS graphics, released in 1985, the same year as World Tour Golf.
dos:9ecbaf91e716d85c.title: NCR Golf

dos:9edc873553c20452.description: Sierra's 256-color VGA remake of Hero's Quest with a new interface. In the town of Spielburg the governor's daughter is missing, robbers camp nearby, and the witch Baba Yaga is at large; the town needs a hero.
dos:9edc873553c20452.title: Quest for Glory I: So You Want To Be A Hero (SCI Remake)

dos:9edd315567d52200.description: A management game set in 1550, when Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. As the owner of a small trading company, you gain wealth and influence through international trade and luxury goods until you win a post as counselor to the Queen.
dos:9edd315567d52200.title: Gloriana

dos:9f03437597fdd2c9.description: A first-person shooter bundled with Creative Labs 3D Blaster cards, set in the mid-21st century as rebels of the Lunar Defense Force prepare a war of independence. It requires a Rendition Verite 1000 video card.
dos:9f03437597fdd2c9.title: Rebel Moon

dos:9f04a84c65d6e9a3.description: A basic Breakout clone in 1.8 KB of machine code. Bounce a ball off a sliding paddle to tear down a wall brick by brick, and win without losing your seven balls.
dos:9f04a84c65d6e9a3.title: Rebound

dos:9f0f1fff3af50149.description: A fighting game set in Zulula, a town in the land of Akistar that holds martial tournaments, whose Evil Lords rule in secret. Can a hero win glory in the tournament and expose them?
dos:9f0f1fff3af50149.title: Champions of Zulula: Elite Edition

dos:9f173c432e98f7fc.description: A tiny Tetris that fits in a half-kilobyte boot sector, so the PC boots straight into the game with no operating system. It manages rudimentary VGA graphics.
dos:9f173c432e98f7fc.title: TetrOS

dos:9f185457340daac5.description: A science fiction game by Tsunami Media blending role-playing, exploration, space combat and strategy. Command a spaceship in real time from a first-person view, traveling among planets and launching an explorer vessel.
dos:9f185457340daac5.title: Protostar: War on the Frontier

dos:9f18a128a9cd67fd.description: A death tournament between bumper cars. Knock your opponents out of their cars and hit them before they leave the game zone, facing more and tougher enemies on later stages.
dos:9f18a128a9cd67fd.title: Autocrash

dos:9f262aa7d75bb0c9.description: The sequel to Ultima, with separate town and world maps and time gates that let you travel into other eras of Earth. Your single character roams the land fighting monsters and looking for key items.
dos:9f262aa7d75bb0c9.title: Ultima II: The Revenge of the Enchantress

dos:9f35cfac978f5837.description: A 3D combat submarine simulator. Seek out enemy convoys and sink the supply ships and escorts with torpedoes and missiles, watching your fuel and air supply.
dos:9f35cfac978f5837.title: USS Stinger

dos:9f383af223a8332b.description: A wargame set from 200 BC to 200 AD, letting you stage battles between Roman armies of varying size and type, barbarian races, or a Roman army against a barbarian horde. It provides over two dozen scenarios.
dos:9f383af223a8332b.title: Cohort II

dos:9f481de3e73dc62a.description: A complete remake of the action-strategy classic Archon with rewritten code, better graphics and sound, MOD music, a new game board and an extra special weapon for each figure.
tags: Action; Board Game / Party Game; Strategy
dos:9f481de3e73dc62a.title: Archon Ultra

dos:9f4a2f3e27e511b9.description: A platformer based on the TV show in which the witch Hexana has kidnapped Hugo's family. Five levels are ported from the show, such as driving a draisine while dodging trains.
dos:9f4a2f3e27e511b9.title: Hugo 1 & 2

dos:9f57dae0ffe98f33.description: A simple adventure for young players in which you play Snoopy, solving puzzles by picking up objects and dropping them in certain places. It works with keyboard or joystick and has just 5 actions.
dos:9f57dae0ffe98f33.title: Snoopy: The Cool Computer Game

dos:9f5f645f8a8fa62a.description: A comedy adventure in Al Lowe's series in which Larry, single again, lands on a TV game show called Stallions and wins a weekend at the La Costa Lotta spa resort.
dos:9f5f645f8a8fa62a.title: Leisure Suit Larry 6: Shape Up or Slip Out!

dos:9f7cd83d96abfbb8.description: A shareware side-scrolling shooter in which you fly a helicopter through a fortress's heavy defenses to rescue captured officials, using a machine gun and several types of missiles.
dos:9f7cd83d96abfbb8.title: Deep Fortress

dos:9f97e3f46b065baf.description: An educational game for two with school subjects including alphabet, math, algebra, time, chemistry, world and US history, and US geography.
dos:9f97e3f46b065baf.title: Schoolhouse

dos:9f9c0e5a556af65c.description: A simple educational game in which you place sprites around the screen to create stories from their pictures.
dos:9f9c0e5a556af65c.title: Once Upon A Time... Puppet Playhouse

dos:9fa2b9f4a4b5054f.description: A wire-frame space combat simulator in which you fly around an alien planet looking for clues to a mysterious event in its past. You can turn off combat or exploration.
dos:9fa2b9f4a4b5054f.title: Echelon

dos:9fa310b4a4f6ab77.description: A turn-based strategy game, conceived as a board game and originally developed for the PDP-10. Players use armies from cities to conquer a 60x100 map.
dos:9fa310b4a4f6ab77.title: Empire

dos:9fa9e883c8fd2b11.description: An educational game for ages 3 to 7 with 26 games to help with reading and math skills, including matching words, recognizing letters and finding letters on the keyboard.
dos:9fa9e883c8fd2b11.title: Brandon's Big Lunchbox

dos:9fbe6d9e23d502b0.description: A dinosaur-themed educational game for elementary school children with four mini-games, AstroDrive, Zug Escape, Ptera-Ptutor and Spell-A-Saur, built around unscrambling and spelling words.
dos:9fbe6d9e23d502b0.title: Spell-A-Saurus

dos:9fc167eb940871d2.description: A two-player Breakout clone with 48 stages, in which both players have paddles at once so one can watch the ball while the other catches bonus blocks. Collect power-ups and letters spelling BONUS.
dos:9fc167eb940871d2.title: Egawalls

dos:9fd39288e0e32668.description: The European release of Mario's Early Years: Fun with Numbers, an educational game in which Mario teaches young children numbers and sums.
dos:9fd39288e0e32668.title: Mario Teaches Sums

dos:9fe132fe658f14de.description: The second Space Quest. Janitor Roger Wilco faces the return of Sludge Vohaul, who plans to infest the planet Xenon with thousands of genetically engineered door-to-door life insurance salesmen.
dos:9fe132fe658f14de.title: Space Quest II: Vohaul's Revenge

dos:9fe5e9ac4c899330.description: A version of Monopoly for 2 to 8 players, who can all be computer players. It offers a short game with a time limit or a standard game, and several graphic formats.
dos:9fe5e9ac4c899330.title: Leisure Genius presents Monopoly

dos:9ff1fbc5ecd85ab0.description: An adventure with artwork and inspiration from horror designer H. R. Giger. You play Mike Dawson, an ad company manager who buys a solitary mansion in the small town of Woodland Hills to pursue a writing career.
dos:9ff1fbc5ecd85ab0.title: Dark Seed

dos:9ff22f3ebd48a9bc.description: A two-player space ship combat game with a choice of ships, gravity strengths and other options.
dos:9ff22f3ebd48a9bc.title: SWAR!

dos:9ffa9537eac4a576.description: A darts simulation in which you throw by pressing the space bar three times: first to aim horizontally, second for the angle and third for the strength. The aim is to run out of points.
dos:9ffa9537eac4a576.title: Darts (1989)

dos:9fffffa743c2f226.description: A Korean side-scrolling beat-em-up from the studio TG Entertainment, released only in South Korea, known there as Eojjeonji...Jeonyeok.
dos:9fffffa743c2f226.title: Night Where Good Things Are Bound to Happen, A

dos:a002f801a78454fd.description: A LucasArts adventure set in the creepy Edison mansion, where a local girl named Sandy has gone missing and rumors of strange experiments circulate.
dos:a002f801a78454fd.title: Maniac Mansion (Enhanced Version)

dos:a00a3ef53c943733.description: A platform adventure in which the archaeologist Malvineous Havershim, studying ruins in Madagascar built by the mysterious Blue Builders, is overcome by gas while translating glyphs and enters a dream world.
dos:a00a3ef53c943733.title: Xargon

dos:a00b7176ab92c381.description: A baseball simulation from Micro Sports with league play, team management, detailed statistics, drafts, trades and accurately modeled stadiums. It bears the Major League Baseball seal and includes 1991 season rosters.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:a00b7176ab92c381.title: Pro League Baseball (1992)

dos:a00eed4428d90b11.description: A stock Tetris in text-mode graphics made for keyboard-driven play over modem as a BBS door game, which can also be played locally. The unregistered version has only three levels.
dos:a00eed4428d90b11.title: Tris

dos:a015109bfd08ef50.description: A strategic simulation of interplanetary conflict. Manage resources, power stations, farms and laboratories from a military workstation to explore and conquer other worlds.
dos:a015109bfd08ef50.title: When Two Worlds War

dos:a01de62fdf5e4c00.description: A non-scrolling top-down shooter in which robot ships attack Earth in waves, with an arrow showing their entry direction. Your ship has a turret to shoot them.
dos:a01de62fdf5e4c00.title: Spheroids

dos:a024df16ef2ddd6e.description: A managerial American football game in which you are the general manager of a struggling NFL team and must win games and turn a profit. You draft players and handle every part of the organization.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Football
dos:a024df16ef2ddd6e.title: Total Control Football

dos:a02bc09b121561d9.description: A point-and-click icon-based adventure in which paranormal investigator Jhon Steel arrives in Reality-on-the-Norm to find a horror case. Talk to inhabitants and collect items.
dos:a02bc09b121561d9.title: Paranormal Investigation

dos:a03300c5a6ec78f6.description: A backgammon game for one or two players with several computer difficulty levels and full mouse support, rolling the dice with the right mouse button. It can also start from non-standard positions.
dos:a03300c5a6ec78f6.title: World Champion Backgammon

dos:a0340198481fdcf2.description: The third McGee educational game, entirely wordless so a young child can play alone. McGee goes to a fun fair.
dos:a0340198481fdcf2.title: McGee at the Fun Fair

dos:a037f03f8f959eb7.description: An action platformer set in 1776, when settlers of Buenos Aires send an expedition to Tierra del Fuego. The ship is wrecked and the lone survivor, biologist Sebastian de Anchorena, must go on.
dos:a037f03f8f959eb7.title: Terra Incognita

dos:a043fe44f62bfbc9.description: A stock market simulation for one to six players. The goal is to earn the most money in ten turns by buying and selling stocks, using price lists and graphs.
dos:a043fe44f62bfbc9.title: Black Monday

dos:a0569dcc77b70fac.description: A shareware, keyboard-controlled game based on QIX. Claim over half of a bordered rectangle by making smaller rectangles, while the meanies inside try to touch you.
dos:a0569dcc77b70fac.title: Gotcha

dos:a05c7b66c5769be6.description: A strategy game in which you build the strength and knowledge to unite the free worlds and defeat an alien horde. You begin with one ship and a chosen crew, relying on research, exploration and diplomacy.
dos:a05c7b66c5769be6.title: Iron Seed

dos:a0661fbae6615ca5.description: A simple quiz game from Big Blue Disk #20 that helps you learn US state capitals. Five data sets of ten states each have you swap capital names until they match their states.
dos:a0661fbae6615ca5.title: States and Capitals (1988)

dos:a06c24bc5bb2e2ba.description: The sixth Wizardry game. The Cosmic Forge is a magic pen that makes whatever is written with it come true, and your party journeys into a castle once ruled by an evil King, Queen and Wizard to find out what became of it.
dos:a06c24bc5bb2e2ba.title: Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge

dos:a06d2d82d4fb4993.description: An adventure based on the Stephen King novel, using an interface reminiscent of LucasArts' SCUMM. You play horror novelist Thad Beaumont, whose evil twin is committing terrible crimes.
dos:a06d2d82d4fb4993.title: The Dark Half

dos:a06f897737e4ed42.description: The sequel to Les Manley in Search for the King, now a point-and-click adventure without a text parser. Les searches for his friend Helmut the Human Bean, kidnapped from his mansion in L.A.
dos:a06f897737e4ed42.title: Les Manley In: Lost In L.A.

dos:a08729606270828d.description: A kung-fu fighting game in which a demonic yellow devil has seized the original manuscript written by Cheng Heung, and the Shaolin fighters must stop him.
dos:a08729606270828d.title: Choy-Lee-Fut Kung-Fu Warrior

dos:a08cee09e7a66510.description: A platformer in which Carlos, a bearded man in bright coveralls accompanied by a parrot, jumps through 5 levels full of clowns, rats, monkeys and golf players, climbing ladders and using passageways.
dos:a08cee09e7a66510.title: Les aventures de Carlos

dos:a08dbc3cd8ebf4d2.description: Manage a UK football team, choosing from one hundred clubs and using a database of 1270 players and hundreds of support staff. Guide a fourth-division team up to the premier league using charts and graphs.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:a08dbc3cd8ebf4d2.title: The Soccer Game

dos:a099e8ca833a4fe6.description: You are a rolling eyeball finding your way through mazes. Each maze has puzzles and objects such as keys to collect, and a time limit.
dos:a099e8ca833a4fe6.title: Mind-Roll

dos:a0a0e2e4768021af.description: The Settlers II Gold Edition, containing Veni, Vidi, Vici, the Mission CD, a world atlas and 130 fan-made maps. You start a settlement with one building and must find sources of stone and wood.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation / City Building; Strategy
dos:a0a0e2e4768021af.title: The Settlers II: Gold Edition

dos:a0b55b9d8b24d1ca.description: A volleyball game with full six-player teams and the original rules, played as a single match against the AI or another player. A tactics menu sets defense and offense strategy.
dos:a0b55b9d8b24d1ca.title: Volleyball Simulator

dos:a0bdcce43fd1586f.description: A live-video shooting gallery game in which you blast through a gang's hideouts and bank robberies to rescue the Mayor and his daughter from Mad Dog McCree.
dos:a0bdcce43fd1586f.title: Mad Dog McCree

dos:a0bf89338ccb6992.description: A puzzle game on a star-shaped web where you move, arrange and combine colored photons to produce a specific pattern. It is postcard-ware, freeware that asks for a postcard.
dos:a0bf89338ccb6992.title: Drop of Light

dos:a0e1d7ad543f225e.description: A game based on the movie, made of action sequences that recreate scenes such as the dungeon escape and the ice caves. Play them in order or read the story as a manuscript and jump to scenes.
dos:a0e1d7ad543f225e.title: Willow

dos:a10c4f0f4f0da84a.description: A pinball game built with Pinball Construction Set, centered on a star-shaped object ringed by 5 bumpers. Up to 4 players, with 9 background colors.
dos:a10c4f0f4f0da84a.title: Star Chamber

dos:a111bd2882c711ca.description: A freeware fan-made sequel to Spear of Destiny with new sprites, weapons and exploding barrels, and 23 levels asking what happened to Hitler after the war and who got the Spear.
dos:a111bd2882c711ca.title: Spear Resurrection

dos:a1147284cc3a4e39.description: Odysseus Kent, an odd fellow, sets off with a shovel and a map from a shadowy man at a bus stop to find the Lost Treasure of Randolph McBoing, supposedly in a cemetery.
dos:a1147284cc3a4e39.title: The Trials of Odysseus Kent

dos:a118490261d07903.description: A shareware space combat flight simulation from Virtual Adventures with varied missions, including pure shooting, tactical missions and space racing.
dos:a118490261d07903.title: Star Quest I in the 27th Century

dos:a122ce653cc1dac7.description: An unofficial English remaster of the 1992 economy sim in which the giant company Dynatech secures resources for a depleted Earth by discovering and developing new ones.
dos:a122ce653cc1dac7.title: Dynatech: 30th Anniversary Edition

dos:a127b64d74cfef0a.description: A much improved version of SubLOGIC's Jet with better speed, flight characteristics and precision, smooth zooming, a game menu, mouse control and landing gear. It loads scenery files rather than only scenery disks.
dos:a127b64d74cfef0a.title: Jet 2.0

dos:a12bd7cc724ea8c6.description: A shareware puzzle game in which you line up blocks with colored arrows so that blocks of the same color touch and disappear. Clear them all to finish the level.
dos:a12bd7cc724ea8c6.title: BrainStorm Pro

dos:a137ce54d8cae071.description: A turn-based strategy game with role-playing elements, like Fire Emblem. It is set in a cyberpunk future in which mega-corporations rule and social inequality has caused an economic depression.
dos:a137ce54d8cae071.title: Last Laibers

dos:a13e4f29fda7d5bd.description: A semi-realistic kart racing game with a low sense of speed and plenty of sliding. It has simulation and arcade modes, race AI, and two-player split screen.
dos:a13e4f29fda7d5bd.title: Formula Karts

dos:a13f1db47747e997.description: A real-time strategy game in which you lead one of five races, tens of thousands of years after a catastrophe shut down Earth's ecology. A resource called Mana is found to be regenerating.
dos:a13f1db47747e997.title: Alchemist

dos:a145b31393c49985.description: A chess game in SVGA on CD-ROM with multiple skill levels, various boards and pieces, pull-down menus, an analysis mode and a VCR-like replay option. It can give the player a chess rating.
dos:a145b31393c49985.title: Grandmaster Chess

dos:a15dfcba369962ac.description: A Spanish arcade racing game from Ediciones Mago that calls itself a simulator.
dos:a15dfcba369962ac.title: F1 Simulator

dos:a15e86955d8c7275.description: A third-person point-and-click adventure of exploration and puzzles. Out for a night walk in New York, Jeremy hears a story from an old man about a cursed kingdom and is transported there.
dos:a15e86955d8c7275.title: Heaven's Dawn

dos:a15ef068e9116def.description: A role-playing game based on Steve Jackson Games' Car Wars. Starting as an average person in New York, build money and prestige through story missions, paid side quests and arena battles.
dos:a15ef068e9116def.title: Autoduel

dos:a1616b5263e79d83.description: A Tetris variant in which a man who fell asleep in front of a monitor walks at the bottom of the well. You fill it with pipes, clocks and other urban shapes, forming steps for him to climb out.
dos:a1616b5263e79d83.title: Tetriller

dos:a17345cc7ebd80e7.description: The 1989 Carmen Sandiego game in which you travel through time to collect clues and the warrant needed to arrest Carmen's henchmen and finally Carmen herself.
dos:a17345cc7ebd80e7.title: Where in Time Is Carmen Sandiego?

dos:a19337d496d75044.description: A two-player game of exploitation and conquest on an interstellar scale. Two factions, The League and The People's Holy Republic, compete over decades for control of a rich star cluster.
dos:a19337d496d75044.title: Stellar Crusade

dos:a19694f32aa5091c.description: A college basketball simulation for replaying individual games or whole seasons from the past or present, with a built-in Stat Compiler that keeps permanent team records.
dos:a19694f32aa5091c.title: Pure-Stat College Basketball

dos:a1a02bc770618220.description: An advertisement game in which you control a free climber and climb Mt. Guano by clicking one of his four limbs and dragging it to a suitable crack in the rock wall.
dos:a1a02bc770618220.title: MER Adventure Climbing

dos:a1a3fa7318afe6db.description: A shareware keyboard-controlled Frogger clone from Germany. Take Karl across a five-lane motorway and a river, avoiding crocodiles, otters and cars, as he is a young frog who drowns in water.
dos:a1a3fa7318afe6db.title: Karl Quappe

dos:a1aa31cf9b5de58c.description: A shooter in which you move your ship up and down while firing at two erratic enemy orbs on the right. Ships freeze while a laser crosses the screen, so you can't dodge once it's fired.
dos:a1aa31cf9b5de58c.title: Fire Storm

dos:a1d9d335c19affbe.description: A freeware Monopoly for up to six players with save and load, but no computer opponent.
dos:a1d9d335c19affbe.title: PC-Monopoly

dos:a1edb9ae31699392.description: A Euchre card game with a 24-card deck and five cards dealt to each player. The top card is turned up as a trump offering, and players decide whether to order it up or pass.
dos:a1edb9ae31699392.title: Euchre (Scott Abdey, 1992)

dos:a1f93ffe165a2be6.description: A military precision approach air traffic control simulator, also known as Ground Control Approach, released alongside TRACON 1.5 by the same producer. It was the only PC simulator of this approach type.
dos:a1f93ffe165a2be6.title: Rapcon: Military Air Traffic Control Simulator

dos:a1fa2bb613e5e80d.description: A tactical battle simulator in which you command a starship or a small group of ships. It has mouse support, a graphical interface, sound, music, animations and real-time scenarios.
dos:a1fa2bb613e5e80d.title: The Starship Commander's Tactical Battle Simulator

dos:a215f951e203d57a.description: A text adventure in which strange events are unfolding at your hospital, which is now called an Institute, and even your daughter is acting oddly. You may be the one to solve the mystery.
dos:a215f951e203d57a.title: A Bloody Life!

dos:a21b830e63bd9f99.description: A first-person flight simulation like Ace of Aces in which you shoot down Japanese fighters and bombers over the ocean. A cockpit window and instrument panel show engine power, altitude, fuel and ammunition.
dos:a21b830e63bd9f99.title: Hellcat Ace

dos:a22b72612eb4eaa2.description: A DOS conversion of the Amiga shooter in which Plexu walks, jumps and fires a single, double or super shot gun. Instead of side-scrolling, the action is split into single screens with a boss at the end of each level.
dos:a22b72612eb4eaa2.title: Plexu: The Time Travellers

dos:a22fc15bb8443008.description: An adaptation of the TV game show in which you are given the answer and must supply the question.
dos:a22fc15bb8443008.title: Jeopardy! (1993)

dos:a232032d47fd4e6a.description: An Ocean golf game with many forms of play, including skins, foursomes, matchplay, strokeplay, practice and fourball, across varied terrain and locations with several difficulty levels.
dos:a232032d47fd4e6a.title: International Open Golf Championship

dos:a23579668341ba8e.description: A schoolboy punished for wanting to play a video game is transported to a fantasy world of anthropomorphic animals, where as the warrior Zakato he must save it from an evil goddess.
dos:a23579668341ba8e.title: Zakato: Maan

dos:a235e9337d39ede8.description: A puzzle game in several sections, beginning with a cipher, that challenges you in different ways.
dos:a235e9337d39ede8.title: Enigma

dos:a239dbefa402bf79.description: Set in 2020, when road rage rules the highways, you are an Eastern European factory worker with the world's last Lada. Your mission is to reach the abandoned Lada factory and reactivate it.
dos:a239dbefa402bf79.title: Lada: The Ultimate Challenge

dos:a239f4ace55b9a45.description: An early Westwood turn-based role-playing game in which a stranded space jockey on Saturn's moon Titan assembles a team to find a lost city. Characters have attributes and 21 skills that can be raised.
dos:a239f4ace55b9a45.title: Mines of Titan

dos:a250198343c7e346.description: Play one of three evil wizards competing for a magical talisman. Hatch, raise and breed dragons and use them and spells to conquer or aid villages and cities while fighting the other wizards.
dos:a250198343c7e346.title: Dragon Lord

dos:a258d4721a65e73f.description: A rare Arkanoid-style game, the first independent work of British programmer Richard Wright, later known for the Galactix games.
dos:a258d4721a65e73f.title: Brix II

dos:a25bceb71c7f4eda.description: A soccer championship among 128 teams of robot players. Each team has four players with different strengths who can be sold and replaced on the player market, for example with spider or worm robots.
dos:a25bceb71c7f4eda.title: Bot Soccer

dos:a26a79d7b94b3544.description: A cute fan-made platformer like Prince of Persia stripped down to its bare minimum.
dos:a26a79d7b94b3544.title: Mini Prince

dos:a26b6120427bb6b0.description: A flight simulation based on Dale Brown's Flight of the Old Dog. You command the crew of an experimental, heavily modified B-52 bomber outfitted with the latest weapons and stealth technology.
dos:a26b6120427bb6b0.title: Megafortress

dos:a26b7d82a0edaaa3.description: A tool for children to write illustrated fairy tales based on the stories of Robin Hood and Peter Pan, with a scene editor for ready-made backgrounds and characters and a text editor.
dos:a26b7d82a0edaaa3.title: Peter Pan and Robin Hood Fairy Tale Factory

dos:a270690e801ddf34.description: A Boulder Dash variant in which humanity tries to exterminate all rabbits by storing cabbages underground. You control the rabbit Myra, digging through dirt in each of 120 levels.
dos:a270690e801ddf34.title: Legend of Myra

dos:a291cf02d0bdae5c.description: A Spanish top-down shooter in English, apparently designed for two players. You play a muscular long-haired girl with a huge cannon fighting monsters in a techno-fantasy world.
dos:a291cf02d0bdae5c.title: Thera

dos:a2b1a50635f26446.description: A fan-made Dune game that reuses graphics from Westwood's Dune II but is a turn-based tactics game rather than real-time. Its plot loosely draws on earlier and later books.
dos:a2b1a50635f26446.title: Dune III

dos:a2b2754969c4503f.description: The second Adventures with Edison game, sponsored by the Smithsonian Institution. With the happy little Edison, visit museums to find missing treasures for a detective agency.
dos:a2b2754969c4503f.title: Mystery at the Museums

dos:a2b2f83c17684b90.description: A platformer based on the Tintin comic Prisoners of the Sun. As Tintin you rescue the kidnapped Professor Calculus, in many more locations than the comic's Peru.
dos:a2b2f83c17684b90.title: The Adventures of Tintin: Prisoners of the Sun

dos:a2b40ba31849b93b.description: A text adventure in which the only survivor of the dangerous planet Doomawangara returns on a rescue mission to save an ambassador kidnapped by renegade robots.
dos:a2b40ba31849b93b.title: Return to Doom

dos:a2c7431128ee1702.description: A real-time game in which you control either the US or Soviet nuclear arsenal during an escalating exchange. It has a basic four-screen interface and dozens of weapon systems.
dos:a2c7431128ee1702.title: Bravo Romeo Delta

dos:a2d9bada673200c6.description: A low-resolution early PC platformer that shares an engine with Apogee's Arctic Adventure and Pharaoh's Tomb. It has four episodes of twenty puzzle-filled, one-screen levels each, the first shareware.
dos:a2d9bada673200c6.title: Monuments of Mars

dos:a2da9f6fdce2e06e.description: A close relative of Kroz in which you search for the Heart of Courage in the Ezam dungeons, evading lost souls and using pick axes and teleport scrolls in a largely invisible maze.
dos:a2da9f6fdce2e06e.title: Maze Runner

dos:a2db58cddc3a162e.description: A simple computerized backgammon game with aggressive or defensive computer play styles, three game speeds and a save/load option.
dos:a2db58cddc3a162e.title: Backgammon Royale

dos:a2eeb3eac6de651f.description: A role-playing game in which you play a knight who must restore order to a kingdom left a chaotic wasteland, plagued by thieves and monsters, by finding the Rainbow Egg.
dos:a2eeb3eac6de651f.title: Vor Terra

dos:a2f4debc51966560.description: A fantasy role-playing game in which you and four characters collect weapons, armor, spells and keys and fight through the maze of ShardMoure Keep to retrieve the Infernal Tome, a manuscript that can stop time.
dos:a2f4debc51966560.title: The Infernal Tome

dos:a2f9ed8d77f2d5a0.description: An improved version of Jack Nicklaus Unlimited Golf and Course Design with better graphics and sound. It also plays courses created for the earlier game.
dos:a2f9ed8d77f2d5a0.title: Jack Nicklaus Golf & Course Design: Signature Edition

dos:a30320e715ed7ac7.description: The Infocom text adventure in which you are Arthur Dent, whose house and then planet have been destroyed. Your friend Ford Prefect, not really an out-of-work actor, has rescued you.
dos:a30320e715ed7ac7.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

dos:a30e53fe179bfd0f.description: The last of the lunar colony strategy trilogy after Moonbase and Lunar Command, an almost exact copy of Lunar Command with improved graphics and some added complexity.
dos:a30e53fe179bfd0f.title: Lunar Commander 2 (1995)

dos:a310b836b3e6c0bb.description: Play a US Navy SEAL in 3 independent missions involving terrorists and hostages. Each mission has several portions with different mechanics, including swimming and submarining.
dos:a310b836b3e6c0bb.title: Navy Seal

dos:a31886a4fdc78bc1.description: A top-down tank game in which two tanks battle to blast into each other's fortresses with guns and helicopters. It is built for head-to-head play via split screen or modem.
dos:a31886a4fdc78bc1.title: Fire Power

dos:a32714ca4b92b821.description: A beat-em-up based on Jet Li's movie in which Jet Li's hero fights through hordes of opponents, with punches and a powerful horizontal sweep with frequent kicks.
dos:a32714ca4b92b821.title: Last Hero in China

dos:a32cca6994fd8067.description: An SCI demo game made by Brian Provinciano to showcase his SCI Studio on the old TechTV show Call for Help with Chris Pirillo.
dos:a32cca6994fd8067.title: LockerGnome Quest

dos:a333dece12121685.description: A 3D tennis game with 3Dfx support, also known as Tie Break Tenis 98. Choose your player and court surface, men's or women's tennis, and a single match or world championship.
dos:a333dece12121685.title: Extreme Tennis

dos:a33401d3ff952384.description: A game designed for stereo 3D LCD shutter glasses, but playable in a normal DOS window. It combines real-time fluid dynamics airflow simulation, physics-based interaction, and flying and driving simulation.
dos:a33401d3ff952384.title: VR Slingshot

dos:a33471fd6ad024d2.description: An educational game teaching logic and problem solving. Four tram cars each hold one of ten animals, and you work out which is where by placing four animals each turn.
dos:a33471fd6ad024d2.title: Alpine Tram Ride

dos:a33573f5511a81da.description: A quiz of 100 fill-in-the-blank questions on literary and historical facts, decoding and wordplay, with a few characters of the correct answer given as hints.
dos:a33573f5511a81da.title: Ultra-Quiz

dos:a337fce31305e229.description: An action adventure in which you wake with your identity stripped away and take control of your destiny, making your way through indoor and outdoor areas of an insane reality.
dos:a337fce31305e229.title: BioForge

dos:a341d558453349f8.description: A sports game with eight Winter Olympic events. You play the events in a row, deselectable, and the player with the most points wins, with two players at a time on split screen.
dos:a341d558453349f8.title: Winter Supersports '92

dos:a346fba1bc667cad.description: A role-playing game in which Wil Mason is transported to the fantasy world of Middlemere, ruled by four rival brothers. It mixes arcade elements with a first-person view like Eye of the Beholder.
dos:a346fba1bc667cad.title: Obitus

dos:a359cda799c78234.description: A single-player shareware platform puzzle game. On each screen of multilevel platforms with vines, collect all the treasure chests while avoiding obstacles such as water hazards.
dos:a359cda799c78234.title: L. Runner II

dos:a3604dd75f67f572.description: A shareware educational title that teaches children to recognize US and Canadian coins, controlled by keyboard or mouse, with three games including matching coin pictures to denominations.
dos:a3604dd75f67f572.title: Animated Money

dos:a368195624fdbeea.description: FIFA Soccer 97, with commentary by John Motson and Andy Gray, player moves from David Ginola using MotionBlending, and interactive replays. Play a league or cup tournament, or practice.
dos:a368195624fdbeea.title: FIFA Soccer 97

dos:a3885a07642c6af3.description: A dungeon crawl that uses filled polygons for a 3D dungeon, where you fight dragons and other enemies with venomous, magical and breath effects in 16 colors.
dos:a3885a07642c6af3.title: Bob's Dragon Hunt

dos:a397a7596734608f.description: A World War II air combat simulation in which you fly as an American or German pilot in 1943-1945, with experimental German aircraft such as the Me 262, Me 163 Komet and Gotha flying wing, and the standard Me 109.
dos:a397a7596734608f.title: Secret Weapons of the Luftwaffe

dos:a39b695def0c042f.description: Krisalis's second football game, a sequel to Manchester United - The Official. Lead your team through the European championships, either letting the computer play matches or taking control of the players.
dos:a39b695def0c042f.title: Manchester United Europe

dos:a39d07e58fe40947.description: The sequel to Star Control. The Alliance has lost and the Ur-Quan armada imprisons the Alliance races on their homeworlds, including Earth, but a lost research vessel has found something at a distant star system.
dos:a39d07e58fe40947.title: Star Control II

dos:a3a03ac915c381bc.description: A single-player game against the computer in which a discus bounces across the screen and you control a vertical paddle. Hitting targets scores points, with white gorillas worth ten points.
dos:a3a03ac915c381bc.title: Tommy's Floppy Discus

dos:a3a6cf251ee0b909.description: Joe Blade must rescue six leaders kidnapped by Crax Bloodfinger in different parts of his base. He finds six bombs to deactivate with only 20 minutes to rescue everyone, in a side-on flick-screen game.
dos:a3a6cf251ee0b909.title: Joe Blade II

dos:a3c1f830677ef062.description: A platformer with puzzle elements in which you guide Jacek, the Electroman, through 8 levels using teleporters, shooting enemies and collecting weapon power-ups, as your weapon gradually weakens.
dos:a3c1f830677ef062.title: Electroman

dos:a3c2c2f7c0e0a389.description: A Pang-style game of 50 levels for one or two players on the same screen. Shoot hooks upward to burst the balloons bouncing around the playfield.
dos:a3c2c2f7c0e0a389.title: She Bo

dos:a3c95ab115a3a319.description: The sequel to Eye of the Beholder. The Archmage Khelben sends the Heroes of Waterdeep to investigate the Temple Darkmoon, near where people have disappeared and shallow graves have been found.
dos:a3c95ab115a3a319.title: Eye of the Beholder II: The Legend of Darkmoon

dos:a3d6ec51a5ed5b8d.description: An interactive cartoon in which a brave English soldier must stop the Fascist Von Max from building a Doomsday Machine with special crystals. Each level has a different task, such as shooting, fights and chases.
dos:a3d6ec51a5ed5b8d.title: Guy Spy and the Crystals of Armageddon

dos:a3df7512be989aea.description: A post-apocalyptic strategy game in which you lead a gang of warriors across the land, battling mutants and other gangs and looting towns.
dos:a3df7512be989aea.title: Roadwar 2000

dos:a3e2e8ea585f5ae2.description: A single-player space shooter in which you fly over an alien landscape shooting enemy ships. Fuel runs out quickly, so you swoop low to refuel from gas pumps.
dos:a3e2e8ea585f5ae2.title: Fire and Ice

dos:a3e5f8de4db6c895.description: An unofficial sequel to Wasteland from Electronic Arts, using a modified Wasteland engine. Decades after a nuclear bombardment, Florida has broken off from the mainland as an island community.
dos:a3e5f8de4db6c895.title: Fountain of Dreams

dos:a3e75e0c445ceec4.description: An educational game in which you explore the human brain, collecting treasures, mainly cell types. You travel using anatomical directions and are quizzed on neuroanatomy.
dos:a3e75e0c445ceec4.title: Brainscape

dos:a3f1eb1e63b4851f.description: A remake of the Atari ST game Bolo, a Breakout variant in which your paddle can move all around the screen. Across 50 levels, destroy all the blocks with gimmicks such as no gravity and slippery ice.
dos:a3f1eb1e63b4851f.title: Bolo (1995)

dos:a3f2c9b77ec2e427.description: A first-person shooter by Jesse Petrilla about the hunt for Osama bin Laden, one of his games based on real-world conflicts and built from artwork borrowed from other shooters of the time.
dos:a3f2c9b77ec2e427.title: Quest for Al-Qaeda: The Hunt for Bin Laden

dos:a3fb748c6be5bb61.description: An isometric 3D arcade adventure in which the thief Karadoc raids the five stories of Castle Wulf, rumored to hold treasure but also full of deadly traps, riddles and monsters.
dos:a3fb748c6be5bb61.title: Cadaver

dos:a3fdfd6dff815fa6.description: A World War II strategy game, a follow-up to Air Force Commander, focused entirely on air combat between the Allies and the Axis. Pick a scenario and manage resources and bases.
dos:a3fdfd6dff815fa6.title: WW2 Air Force Commander

dos:a3ff3a7c53ede0ec.description: A Sierra-style adventure in which Hugo must save his girlfriend, who went to babysit in a haunted house. It was re-released commercially in 1995 as part of the Hugo Trilogy.
dos:a3ff3a7c53ede0ec.title: Hugo's House of Horrors

dos:a407aefaa2bdf86b.description: A lighthearted adventure made with Adventure Game Studio, set on a distant snow-filled planet.
dos:a407aefaa2bdf86b.title: Permanent Daylight

dos:a409c84ccc7cc290.description: A turn-based hex wargame with three epic Napoleonic battles and a construction kit for recreating any land battle of the period. It has four programs, including a Battle program and a Mapmaker.
dos:a409c84ccc7cc290.title: Great Napoleonic Battles

dos:a40ea4db94c6d9bd.description: A vertical shooter in which your airplane, which can also move backward, flies up from the bottom of the screen to destroy similar aircraft.
dos:a40ea4db94c6d9bd.title: G.O.E.M.

dos:a410a089666989b7.description: The continuation of the Shaw's Nightmare series, with 30 levels plus 2 secret levels, and new monsters, music, sound effects and graphics.
dos:a410a089666989b7.title: Shaw's Nightmare II

dos:a411ca3eb1272830.description: One of the first roguelikes with a wilderness and more than one dungeon. You search the Caverns of Larn for a cure for your daughter's strange disease.
dos:a411ca3eb1272830.title: Larn

dos:a42a92b3b9be725d.description: A side-view volleyball game with matches of 1, 3 or 5 sets, each won by the first to 15 points. Teams include the Rollers, CoCo, the Beach Boys and the Geniases.
dos:a42a92b3b9be725d.title: Over the Net!

dos:a4369e91c63d9d19.description: A classic-style racing arcade game like OutRun in which you drive a set distance in a short time to earn extra time. A two-lane public road has slow traffic going your way and oncoming traffic.
dos:a4369e91c63d9d19.title: Turbo

dos:a43d18f33e705500.description: A Boulder Dash-style game in which you dig through underground caves to collect diamonds and reach the exit before time runs out. Some caves lack enough diamonds, but there are ways to generate more.
dos:a43d18f33e705500.title: The New Dash Dimension

dos:a443fbf2444a6bbe.description: A side-scrolling platformer in which Baby Jo tries to get home through four levels, avoiding bad-tempered animals and machines. Jo can throw rattles at enemies such as bees, lawnmowers and spiders.
dos:a443fbf2444a6bbe.title: Baby Jo in 'Going Home'

dos:a446b20bb0e87a39.description: A football manager game based on the four top English leagues. Its icon-driven interface shows each screen as an office, such as the manager's, president's or bank's, and you click items to reach them.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:a446b20bb0e87a39.title: Ultimate Soccer Manager

dos:a44cf72365cd2794.description: A casino game in which Madame Zuinga's Hotel and Casino is cursed with spirits after a ruined gambler left behind a necklace and called on dark forces for revenge.
dos:a44cf72365cd2794.title: Haunted Casino

dos:a451454b312e336e.description: An isometric hockey game licensed from Brett Hull with motion-captured graphics, full running commentary by Al Michaels, realistic fouls, and a mode where Brett helps you improve your game.
dos:a451454b312e336e.title: Brett Hull Hockey 95

dos:a46aad4087614a0a.description: The original extreme games compilation, set in sunny California. Compete in skateboarding, footbag, surfing, roller skating, flying disc and BMX, with the surfing event scored by judges.
dos:a46aad4087614a0a.title: California Games

dos:a488c950808e9e31.description: A Snake clone, much like Vlak. You control a green serpent on a black field with food, drinks and inedible items such as skulls and poison pots, while blue stones give extra lives.
dos:a488c950808e9e31.title: Vivi Vicious Viper

dos:a49c9fd16f783bec.description: A children's educational game with arcade elements.
dos:a49c9fd16f783bec.title: Easy Street

dos:a4a1e8f76ca45467.description: An obscure high-resolution Breakout clone with a story, adjustable bounce angle by angling the paddle, and blocks that are small squares.
dos:a4a1e8f76ca45467.title: Break Through Bukulu

dos:a4a21cc4706af2ec.description: General Tegel leads an offensive against the alien K'kistik and hires soldiers of any race, shipping them across the galaxy for missions. You pick your mercenaries for each job.
dos:a4a21cc4706af2ec.title: Tegel's Mercenaries

dos:a4a4c6b0fcee960c.description: A Korean side-scrolling platformer with cartoon-like graphics. You play the young warrior Tipi, who sets out to kill the red dragon that has taken his future wife.
dos:a4a4c6b0fcee960c.title: The Adventure of Tipi

dos:a4a5cfe7429a5cd6.description: A text-mode maze game in which a yellow happy face is stranded in a large multi-segmented labyrinth, each segment about the size of a screen.
dos:a4a5cfe7429a5cd6.title: Amaze

dos:a4a79b5175e25367.description: A multi-genre military action game in which you rise from Cadet to tactical genius commanding mechanized forces. It has three kinds of combat simulations, including the main battle tank.
dos:a4a79b5175e25367.title: Heavy Metal

dos:a4ae6a1e3c0fe188.description: A shareware color matching puzzle game. Colored balls travel through overlapping transparent tubes and you catch the falling spheres with a test tube.
dos:a4ae6a1e3c0fe188.title: Tubes

dos:a4b6c981068f1133.description: A Battleship game in which you place your fleet on a grid and play against another person or one of three computer opponents of different strengths. The toughest is not in the shareware version.
dos:a4b6c981068f1133.title: Operation Just Because

dos:a4b72c0ef30cb7ee.description: A Japanese-style role-playing game in which the hero pursues Gorgus after his father's death. Travel through towns and dungeons, collect items, gain experience and fight turn-based battles.
dos:a4b72c0ef30cb7ee.title: Mad Paradox

dos:a4b73d0554406a57.description: A mouse-controlled game like Missile Command in which you defend your central space station from aliens by firing torpedoes at the cursor.
dos:a4b73d0554406a57.title: Space Spirals

dos:a4be9b122574d8ea.description: A shareware strategy game for up to 5 empires, player or computer controlled. Produce starships and missiles and deploy fleets on a star map to conquer systems; battles resolve automatically with animation.
dos:a4be9b122574d8ea.title: Stelcon 2469

dos:a4c596ceb628ddc2.description: The real-time strategy classic, including the Covert Operations add-on, that built on Westwood's Dune II. Select units with the mouse and direct them while opponents move without waiting for turns.
dos:a4c596ceb628ddc2.title: Command & Conquer

dos:a4c5affc6fe608e0.description: A government simulation about political decisions and their consequences, in which you are the newly chosen president of the fictitious Latin American country of Chimerica.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation / Political; Strategy
dos:a4c5affc6fe608e0.title: Hidden Agenda

dos:a4cf892d1345d08e.description: A 2D scrolling platformer for the original IBM PC with a CGA card, using a tweaked text mode for 80x50 resolution in 16 colors. A little duck jumps and shoots fireballs to find out who attacked her family castle.
dos:a4cf892d1345d08e.title: MagiDuck

dos:a4d3a311b131082d.description: A 1927 murder mystery in which Inspector Raoul Dusentier is invited on a sailing ship cruise by wealthy Niklos Karaboudjan, who is murdered on the second day, and sets out to find the killer.
dos:a4d3a311b131082d.title: Cruise for a Corpse

dos:a4fce3fc0d723642.description: A pinball game with four tables: Dooke (underworld devils), Enlightment (space travel), Air Crash (modern air combat) and Shark Attack (sunken treasure guarded by sharks). The tables are not the usual rectangle.
dos:a4fce3fc0d723642.title: Cyberball (1998)

dos:a505ea648a6235ed.description: A hospital management simulation in which you build a hospital from an empty building, with rooms for diagnosis and treatment of bizarre diseases such as Bloaty Head, Slack Tongue and Alien DNA.
dos:a505ea648a6235ed.title: Theme Hospital

dos:a514207de1839f4e.description: The first Advanced Dungeons & Dragons role-playing game to go online, hosted by America Online. It is set in the city of Neverwinter and more than 20 surrounding areas.
dos:a514207de1839f4e.title: Neverwinter Nights

dos:a51bd2296ff4436c.description: A futuristic motor boat racing game with a Wipeout-like touch to hinder rivals. In the third millennium the boats can dive in lava, acid and other dangerous substances.
dos:a51bd2296ff4436c.title: Thunder Offshore

dos:a51f50cda40a9c40.description: As a covered wagon party of pioneers, head west from Independence, Missouri to Oregon's Willamette Valley. Stock up on provisions, then decide when to rest, how much to eat and more along the way.
dos:a51f50cda40a9c40.title: The Oregon Trail

dos:a51f8fb6f42c6c80.description: A shooter inspired by the Soviet spacecraft Buran, which went into space in 1988 as a response to the American Shuttle.
dos:a51f8fb6f42c6c80.title: Buran

dos:a51f96215916c1cd.description: A Klondike solitaire game played with one 52-card deck, laid out in the standard seven-column layout.
dos:a51f96215916c1cd.title: TEGL Klondike Solitaire

dos:a52496bcb8befee8.description: A business simulation in which you run a company that builds bridges, coordinating supplies and labor and leaving money for research and development.
dos:a52496bcb8befee8.title: International Bridge Contractors

dos:a541913a496bb450.description: A division and brigade level wargame of the battles between Germany and Russia in WWII on a 36 by 36 hex map from Smolensk to Moscow. It includes PBEM, computer opponents and a scenario editor.
dos:a541913a496bb450.title: Smolensk to Moscow

dos:a542b2cafceac4f5.description: A Space Invaders clone in which you fight waves of descending attackers.
dos:a542b2cafceac4f5.title: Hell Fire

dos:a54ee0d6d549825f.description: The first-person shooter in which experiments with teleportation on the moons of Mars go wrong and open a gateway to Hell. A marine squad sent to Phobos is overrun by demons.
dos:a54ee0d6d549825f.title: DOOM

dos:a5557bdea992e72c.description: A collection of eight small medieval-themed games, including crossbow and archery shooting events with rotating and moving targets.
dos:a5557bdea992e72c.title: Knight Games

dos:a555bfe95bd33c90.description: A straightforward platformer by Stephan Vogler in which you play Kid, collecting fruit and avoiding snakes and pitfalls. Plan your path well, since the blocks you bust with your head may lead to a safer route.
dos:a555bfe95bd33c90.title: Kid

dos:a567309b95eedda3.description: One of the first chess programs for personal computers, with large graphics filling nearly the whole screen. It has seven skill levels plus postal chess, and you can play either side.
dos:a567309b95eedda3.title: Bluebush Chess

dos:a56cc3110382d892.description: A castle-building strategy sequel with a new interface and video cutscenes on the CD versions. Choose one of five feuding lords vying for the Crown, keeping the Pope and your people happy.
dos:a56cc3110382d892.title: Castles II: Siege & Conquest

dos:a5783eb134fa1e28.description: SSI's action-strategy game like Archon. Pit your forces against a computer or human foe on a game board, and when two pieces collide they fight for survival on another board.
dos:a5783eb134fa1e28.title: Dark Legions

dos:a585c7d1f861d639.description: A Pac-Man variation that advertises Intel's Above Board memory expansion card, based on the fact that 640 KB of RAM is not enough for everyone.
dos:a585c7d1f861d639.title: Memory Hog Hunter

dos:a58ab50debe508ba.description: A math puzzle in which you fill in a four by four lattice of equations with the missing symbols and numbers so that every equation across and down is correct.
dos:a58ab50debe508ba.title: Magic Boxes

dos:a5909916588db2a7.description: A simulation of the World War II B-17 heavy bomber. Customize your bomber with a name and nose art, then fly randomly assigned missions into Germany while managing a crew of 10.
dos:a5909916588db2a7.title: B-17 Flying Fortress

dos:a59b54906a312f65.description: Fly the RAH-66 Comanche attack helicopter with the Griffin squadron through over 30 missions. It has realistic physics, stealth, easy and advanced flight models and a full tutorial.
dos:a59b54906a312f65.title: Comanche 3

dos:a59faa13e700d7bd.description: An Iranian shooting gallery game set during the Iran-Iraq war, in which you play a militiaman with a hand-held anti-tank launcher attacking Iraqi tanks that cross the screen.
dos:a59faa13e700d7bd.title: Tank Hunter

dos:a5a24998d4f40b7d.description: An interactive full-motion video adventure set in New York in 2040. Brutal killings reminiscent of Jack the Ripper become personal for crime reporter Jack Quinlan, who must solve the mystery.
dos:a5a24998d4f40b7d.title: Ripper

dos:a5b4c573882df8e9.description: You are on safari to photograph animals as they enter and leave the screen, to save them from extinction, while shooting poachers who will kill you if you are slow.
dos:a5b4c573882df8e9.title: Safari Guns

dos:a5b6e8de5425a607.description: A small, primitive text adventure that works as an interactive political cartoon, with a two-word parser. It has nothing to do with elands.
dos:a5b6e8de5425a607.title: Revenge of the Eland

dos:a5bff2d5e5404ce6.description: A vocabulary game with 5 subgames at four difficulty levels from age 10 to adult, including platformers, crosswords, word searches, scrambles and sentence completion. It supports English, Spanish, French and German.
dos:a5bff2d5e5404ce6.title: Word Attack 3

dos:a5c0b1ae6f8e51cf.description: A shareware two-player strategy game with Tetris-like pieces that appear on either side of the play area. Players place pieces to build a vertical wall across the screen.
dos:a5c0b1ae6f8e51cf.title: Berlin Wall

dos:a5ca43f383f3b91d.description: A three-part text adventure that won the 1994 AGT programming contest, in which you leave on a two-week vacation from ICON Inc. It is influenced by Infocom's Bureaucracy.
dos:a5ca43f383f3b91d.title: Klaustrophobia

dos:a5ce7c3dff96e100.description: A point-and-click adventure of the film in which Peter Banning, an ordinary dad who was once Peter Pan, returns to Neverland to rescue his children from Captain Hook.
dos:a5ce7c3dff96e100.title: Hook

dos:a5d225eefffc7282.description: A humorous Spanish point-and-click adventure in which John Hacker, sent to talk to Count Drascula about some land, sets out to rescue a girl kidnapped by the Count.
dos:a5d225eefffc7282.title: Drascula: The Vampire Strikes Back

dos:a5d3d40df34ff9a9.description: A scrolling shooter set in a maximum-security prison where secret experiments are rumored and inmates have super powers. Steve Kane is taken there after being wrongly convicted of highway homicide.
dos:a5d3d40df34ff9a9.title: They Call Me... The Skul (Game)

dos:a5d96d1563ad2e21.description: A licensed Formula 1 game from Gremlin, between a full simulation like F1 GP and action games like Continental Circus. Races have 12 cars and last 3 to 20 laps.
dos:a5d96d1563ad2e21.title: Nigel Mansell's World Championship

dos:a5fafb6d209754e3.description: A word puzzle game with 25 random letters on a 5x5 grid. Spell as many words as possible from adjacent letters, checked against an 80,000-word dictionary.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Puzzle; Strategy
dos:a5fafb6d209754e3.title: Wordle

dos:a5fc64ebaac5ee8c.description: A DOS port of Madden '96 using the extra space of a CD for improved graphics and animation, with 3D rendered graphics, 640x480 resolution and John Madden announcing. It has over 500 players and 240 plays.
dos:a5fc64ebaac5ee8c.title: Madden NFL Football: Limited Edition

dos:a6031846f31d56d5.description: A straightforward action game in which spiders descend from above at different speeds and you fight them off with a boxing glove.
dos:a6031846f31d56d5.title: Spider Boxer

dos:a60409b246265ac4.description: In 2119, Earth sends seedships as arks across the stars. You lead the UNS Calypso to the Beta Caeli star system, the farthest, in a mix of adventure, colony management and 4X strategy.
tags: Adventure; Construction and Management Simulation; Strategy / 4X
dos:a60409b246265ac4.title: Alien Legacy

dos:a61fec5ee1f699f9.description: A Columns-inspired action puzzler by demosceners. Groups of three blocks fall into a pit, and you form horizontal, vertical or diagonal groups of three or more to clear them. The registered version adds two-player mode.
dos:a61fec5ee1f699f9.title: Xixit

dos:a6212a4cb4b80aff.description: An interactive movie in which, after the death of Dr. Everett Cussler, colleagues gather at Dr. Elizabeth Duran's isolated cabin for the reading of the will, within range of your camera and microphone.
dos:a6212a4cb4b80aff.title: Voyeur II

dos:a62290ed310fc445.description: A stand-alone updated Championship Manager 2 for the 96/97 season with two playable leagues, Italian Serie A and Serie B, and a database of over 4000 real players.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:a62290ed310fc445.title: Championship Manager 2: The European Leagues

dos:a62d88415c6660d8.description: The 1997 edition of the Madden NFL football series with modem and network support.
dos:a62d88415c6660d8.title: Madden NFL '97

dos:a640dd7ed51b05f6.description: A tactical wargame of the British hunt for the German battleship Bismarck in World War II.
dos:a640dd7ed51b05f6.title: Battleship Bismarck

dos:a643a15cee338f2c.description: A first-person shooting gallery from the Spanish company Ediciones Manali, set in an ancient castle where you destroy ghosts and monsters moving at various speeds.
dos:a643a15cee338f2c.title: Ghost

dos:a64f272087aa8906.description: An action-oriented baseball simulation and update to HardBall 4, with adjustable difficulty, sharper graphics, more comments by Al Michaels, and improved league play with 1994 major leaguers and a legends league.
dos:a64f272087aa8906.title: HardBall 5

dos:a6530391d2c5877e.description: Kill as many zombies as you can before they tear you apart. Aim with the mouse and fire with the mouse buttons, with a pistol, shotgun and machine gun.
dos:a6530391d2c5877e.title: Z-Blast

dos:a66364dbe0ee8134.description: An educational game in which you capture aliens wandering a grid by drawing the specified polygons around them. A Super Zoid escapes unless you answer a geometry question.
dos:a66364dbe0ee8134.title: Trap-A-Zoid

dos:a6649e8dedaba864.description: A simple mouse-driven shooter in which you protect a man hanging out under beehives. Bees attack in groups of four, and you pick them off in the air.
dos:a6649e8dedaba864.title: Killer Bees (1992)

dos:a68cced3c5f2fdfc.description: A CD of 150 more Doom levels and mods from the net, packaged by WizardWorks with version 1.3 of its D! front end.
dos:a68cced3c5f2fdfc.title: D!Zone 150

dos:a68fb2f4ce164887.description: An adventure based on the graphic novel. You have nine days to explore a world of wizards and spells with Roxanna, daughter of Mara the witch, and the retired knight Bragon.
dos:a68fb2f4ce164887.title: The Quest for the Time-Bird

dos:a6a5fd8cd1676693.description: A Grand Prix motorcycle racing simulation with 4 bikes and 12 tracks, including Brno, Suzuka and Spa. Play a full season with qualifying, a single race or practice, with one or two players on a split screen.
dos:a6a5fd8cd1676693.title: Grand Prix 500 2

dos:a6ace90072f58543.description: An educational game in which you start as a medical trainee and work your way up with each successful surgery, each case coming with a debriefing on the patient's history.
dos:a6ace90072f58543.title: Laser Surgeon: The Microscopic Mission

dos:a6b8a2d1a18b40bc.description: A space miniature golf game with 18 holes in zany scenarios, played by giving simple directions to the ball with the mouse. In space there is no air.
dos:a6b8a2d1a18b40bc.title: Fuzzy's World Of Miniature Space Golf

dos:a6d5e2c70e5dea2c.description: A soccer game in which you pick one of twenty-four countries for a World Championship identical to the real 1990 World Cup. You also choose which players take the field.
