dos:a6d5e2c70e5dea2c.title: World Championship Soccer

dos:a6d771a67a2abe7b.description: A limited Robotron clone in which a stickman runs around a forest firing a machine gun only in the direction he moves, trying to mow down criminal stickmen using the least ammunition.
dos:a6d771a67a2abe7b.title: Bob vs the Mob

dos:a6db39cecbb9777b.description: Perform heroic deeds to change the public's view of you from villain to hero and retake your castle. Gather your band of merry men and take down the Sheriff and his guards.
dos:a6db39cecbb9777b.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood

dos:a6df8924e513e473.description: A game of galactic conquest like Master of Orion or Stars!, with depth, good AI and an interface mostly of written statistics.
dos:a6df8924e513e473.title: Imperium

dos:a6e1379ec7b281ba.description: A clone of Deflektor in which you turn mirrors with the mouse to guide a laser and pop all the balloons on a level.
dos:a6e1379ec7b281ba.title: Reflektor

dos:a6e2c96d156d8e00.description: A flippant side-scrolling platformer with an anti-remake philosophy, in which you play Wolverine across a pastoral landscape fighting an army of cloned game icons such as Mario, Sonic and Alex Kidd.
dos:a6e2c96d156d8e00.title: B-Clopd

dos:a6f6ef55bfd24e8d.description: A cover-mount CD for the book 3D Game Alchemy for Doom, Doom II, Heretic and Hexen, a collection of third-party resources for making your own levels.
dos:a6f6ef55bfd24e8d.title: 3D Alchemy

dos:a709eb2cfad37c86.description: A freeware Pac-Man type game for up to four players taking turns. Eat pills in a maze while chased by ghosts, with a high score table and keyboard controls.
dos:a709eb2cfad37c86.title: Eat It

dos:a713f81590a39106.description: A horror adventure game developed by DigiFX Interactive and published by Merit Studios in 1996.
dos:a713f81590a39106.title: Harvester

dos:a71a96575c8bdd55.description: A simple marksmanship game in which hostile starships fly across the screen and you line them up in your crosshairs to fire your twin lasers. Five enemies fly different paths, with four skill levels.
dos:a71a96575c8bdd55.title: Target (1983)

dos:a7252e453965062d.description: A platformer in which you play Beethoven, the big dog from the movie, rescuing his four puppies and bringing them back to their mom while avoiding bad-tempered cats and mean dogcatchers.
dos:a7252e453965062d.title: Beethoven's 2nd

dos:a731fefd876c7600.description: A medieval-themed first-person shooter in three episodes, The Trial, The Journey and The Battle, in which a champion takes up the legendary Thor's Hammer to push back an encroaching evil.
dos:a731fefd876c7600.title: Thor's Hammer

dos:a737b96a2dc27ca1.description: A shareware clone of the Atari arcade game in which man's killer robots threaten to wipe out the human race, and you must stop them.
dos:a737b96a2dc27ca1.title: Robotron: 2084 (1995)

dos:a73bf32e13863118.description: A turn-based shareware word game for one to four players. Place lettered tiles into a grid to form words, with ninety-second turns.
dos:a73bf32e13863118.title: KrisKros

dos:a74061751372c1df.description: A short but well-designed fan-made SCI adventure made to demonstrate SCI Studio.
dos:a74061751372c1df.title: Legend of the Lost Jewel

dos:a74207f578eabbb5.description: A shareware text and graphics adventure for beginners. As Charles Browning, servant to a wealthy businessman in Victorian London, you are blamed for a murder you did not commit and must evade your captors and find the real killer.
dos:a74207f578eabbb5.title: The Child Murderer

dos:a757f70e4844b562.description: A trivia game based on the first three seasons of Star Trek: The Next Generation, with questions in categories such as new characters, places and alien races. Each question has a timer, with fifteen seconds to answer.
dos:a757f70e4844b562.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation - Trivia

dos:a76ec2f0386032e9.description: Play the special agent Cougar, who must penetrate a criminal's fortress to retrieve information on a new drug. The game is divided into three parts of different styles, the first a side-scrolling action section.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Racing & Driving; Vehicle Simulation
dos:a76ec2f0386032e9.title: Cougar Force

dos:a79b527fd13f71c6.description: The sequel to Pac-Man starring his girlfriend. Eat the dots and avoid the ghosts in four different mazes, with new features to keep it fresh.
dos:a79b527fd13f71c6.title: Ms. Pac-Man

dos:a79ee1213a60e964.description: A Monopoly game for 2 to 16 players with save game and all the official Parker Brothers rules. Its options are menu driven in colored text-mode pop-up windows.
dos:a79ee1213a60e964.title: The Electronic Monopoly Designer Kit

dos:a7b3303f284e7895.description: A platoon-level tactical game of armored warfare covering almost all ground weapons used on the Russian Front from 1941 to 1945. Command a German or Russian battle group in four historical scenarios or random ones.
dos:a7b3303f284e7895.title: Kampfgruppe

dos:a7b5bda0ec46ffe7.description: A mouse-controlled adventure in which the teenage black mage Davy Jones finds his magic ring stolen, and a note blames the Russians. He sets off to get it back, similar to Sam & Max Hit the Road.
dos:a7b5bda0ec46ffe7.title: The Soviet Union Strikes Again

dos:a7c139c147ae097e.description: A 3D golf game for up to ten computer golfers or four teams, in individual or team competition. You can change the golfers' names, hair and skin colors.
dos:a7c139c147ae097e.title: Wilson ProStaff Golf

dos:a7c3aaba099971a2.description: A woman exploring a shipwreck in 1992 is transported back to 1840, when the ship was still intact. She explores, and her sleuthing leads to revelations about her past.
dos:a7c3aaba099971a2.title: Lost in Time

dos:a7e0c399fd2114c0.description: A fast arcade-style game in which you evade a computer or human opponent while solving a complex maze that leads to safety. It has 200 levels plus 50 advanced ones.
dos:a7e0c399fd2114c0.title: Pharaoh's Revenge

dos:a7e8ccf8f6ca3d7e.description: A Tetris variant by Johan Peitz of Free Lunch Design, a revised version of his 1997 Tetris game.
dos:a7e8ccf8f6ca3d7e.title: Freetris

dos:a7ed1f1f6bdde77f.description: A freeware parody that combines Mortal Kombat with Pong, with a storyline about the ancient white paddle and the younger colored paddles that challenge him.
dos:a7ed1f1f6bdde77f.title: Pong Kombat

dos:a7ef280f3eb5b536.description: Tour the country from sea to shining sea to learn its geography and history.
dos:a7ef280f3eb5b536.title: America Adventure

dos:a7f3ed3d325bc58d.description: An isometric role-playing adaptation of the HeroQuest board game, in which you control a wizard, dwarf, barbarian and elf through 14 missions to defeat the evil wizard Morcar under strict turn-based rules.
dos:a7f3ed3d325bc58d.title: HeroQuest

dos:a7f56d9a60a02bc2.description: A promotional first-person game in which you control the Energizer bunny through 6 levels, finding two drumsticks, a drum and a Duracell battery to bring to the bunny so he can start drumming.
dos:a7f56d9a60a02bc2.title: Duracell: Run the Bunny

dos:a7f6ec2c876411dc.description: A shareware two-player light-cycle game inspired by Tron. Each player leaves a solid trail while driving around the arena, and the goal is to make the opponent crash.
dos:a7f6ec2c876411dc.title: Cbgtron

dos:a7fcc91a13ddb4cf.description: A Centipede clone in which you move a spaceship around the bottom third of the screen shooting up at a snake. A section separated from the body becomes a new snake.
dos:a7fcc91a13ddb4cf.title: Megapede (1993)

dos:a806cb099961b94f.description: The second part of the Super Kroz trilogy, in which you move your player through levels killing and avoiding monsters while solving puzzles.
dos:a806cb099961b94f.title: Temple of Kroz

dos:a80cc32a89943d5a.description: Manage a basketball team starting with a budget of $9,000,000. Buy a team of 8 players, pick 5 for each match, handle the team economy, and play the games on court.
dos:a80cc32a89943d5a.title: The Basket Manager

dos:a81783915478d140.description: A keyboard card game of Crazy Eights from Big Blue Disk #21, played against the computer. Match the previous card's value or suit and get rid of your cards first.
dos:a81783915478d140.title: Crazy Eights

dos:a81f3d422b38c345.description: An update of Sensible Soccer released months later, with teams from the 92-93 European tournaments and updated player names after transfers.
dos:a81f3d422b38c345.title: Sensible Soccer: European Champions - 92/93 Edition

dos:a822a898219b9def.description: An easy adventure starring Ebenezer Scrooge, the first of Leisuresoft's Leisureland series. Your job is to convince Scrooge to give more than he takes on Christmas day.
dos:a822a898219b9def.title: Scrooge

dos:a833fd4c5129dcf4.description: A simple fixed-screen space shooter in which a small cannon moves left and right across the bottom of the screen defending against never-ending waves of TIE fighters.
dos:a833fd4c5129dcf4.title: TIE Invaders

dos:a836da74d92e3db1.description: A hockey game by MindSpan, the makers of HardBall. Play exhibition games, an entire season or the playoffs for the Stanley Cup, with a side view and a different view when someone shoots.
dos:a836da74d92e3db1.title: Face Off!

dos:a85754813859e593.description: A football game that takes the gameplay of Dino Dini's Kick Off games and updates it. It includes European teams you can customize, and an Arcade Challenge mode against five computer team speeds.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:a85754813859e593.title: Goal!

dos:a85ea7186ae4743b.description: The second game in a fantasy role-playing and murder mystery series, in which you play an Inspector investigating a murder.
dos:a85ea7186ae4743b.title: Legends of Murder II: Grey Haven

dos:a8607bb5cac1746f.description: A platform puzzle game starring Colin Curly, a dog who loves Quavers snacks and is digitized into his computer after finishing the game Pushover. He is trapped inside it, faced with an array of challenges.
dos:a8607bb5cac1746f.title: One Step Beyond

dos:a86955acc4cff754.description: A strategy game for two players or against the computer, with a random map generator, VGA graphics, and pieces with special abilities including flying, invisibility and special attacks.
dos:a86955acc4cff754.title: Hostile Takeover 2

dos:a86d5c0c47fc3ec5.description: A point-and-click adventure in which a traveling merchant survives a werewolf attack but is cursed to become one. You must find a cure before time runs out.
dos:a86d5c0c47fc3ec5.title: Wolfsbane

dos:a877ee7911e24145.description: A blackjack game for 1 to 6 players on one table, betting money against the dealer. House rules can be changed, and an in-game tutor teaches basic strategy and card counting from Dr. Thorp's tables.
dos:a877ee7911e24145.title: Dr. Thorp's Mini Blackjack

dos:a883413316005494.description: Two shareware versions of Chinese Checkers for up to six players, each racing to move all their marbles to the opposite side of the board.
dos:a883413316005494.title: Chinese Checkers / Deluxe Chinese Checkers

dos:a883413316005494.1.description: A translation of traditional Chinese Checkers for up to six players, with twice as many checkers as some similar games.
dos:a883413316005494.1.title: Chinese Checkers

dos:a883413316005494.2.description: Chinese Checkers for up to six players, in which you race to move all your marbles to the opposite side of the board. It was nominated for two 1992 Shareware Industry Awards.
dos:a883413316005494.2.title: Deluxe Chinese Checkers

dos:a88594d2f5aea3d9.description: A little-known advertising platformer made for the Humpty's restaurant chain, which only became widely available in 2018.
dos:a88594d2f5aea3d9.title: Humpty's Scramble

dos:a8862b4408fecb50.description: An Infocom text adventure in which you sleep in cryogenic suspension for half a millennium at an underground complex while your mind is wired to a network of computers.
dos:a8862b4408fecb50.title: Suspended: A Cryogenic Nightmare

dos:a89d35621b3b4371.description: An isometric arcade game for children in which Max and his dog Sparky shoot creatures with a water pistol.
dos:a89d35621b3b4371.title: Max & Sparky

dos:a89e455377b81613.description: A MiG-29 Fulcrum flight simulation modeled by former British Aerospace simulator designers, with cannons, rockets and air-to-air and air-to-ground missiles. It recreates aerodynamics, blackouts and physics across six missions.
dos:a89e455377b81613.title: MiG-29 Fulcrum

dos:a8a6730c27ad0825.description: A simple roguelike with no spells, in which you mix reagents like in Ultima. It has one overview map and 5 dungeons of 5 levels, each teaching a new recipe.
dos:a8a6730c27ad0825.title: SRogue

dos:a8afdf30890e00e8.description: An educational game about dinosaurs with several areas that use the included blue-red 3-D glasses. Kids can use a reference encyclopedia to explore when and where each dinosaur lived.
dos:a8afdf30890e00e8.title: 3-D Dinosaur Adventure

dos:a8c7d1d212517ac9.description: A team-based wrestling game in which you play as either a face team, the good guys, or a heel team, the baddies.
dos:a8c7d1d212517ac9.title: Tag Team Wrestling

dos:a8d5b7dc74eccbfe.description: A two-player puzzle game on an eight-by-eight grid in which selecting squares changes your score and uncovers an image. One player moves horizontally and the other vertically, and the highest score wins when no moves remain.
dos:a8d5b7dc74eccbfe.title: Penthouse: Hot Numbers

dos:a8e2b57151007ba1.description: A platformer set in Norumbega, where the evil Fang Duck invades with his duck minions. Peach, the spryest land lobster in the land, is chosen to stop him.
dos:a8e2b57151007ba1.title: Peach the Lobster

dos:a8e51b901b82776f.description: A golf simulator where you choose the field, course, tournament and player. You pick power and direction as usual, can place the camera anywhere, and the backgrounds are pixel video.
dos:a8e51b901b82776f.title: Hole in One

dos:a8f71986213db6d0.description: The sequel to the role-playing game The Kingdom of Syree, similar to the early Ultima titles. You resume the role of the Lord Champion of Syree, who returned to a simple life after defeating the evil wizard.
dos:a8f71986213db6d0.title: The Kingdom of Syree II: Black Magic

dos:a8f8937238485d60.description: A football management game with all five English leagues. Begin with a Conference team and try to reach the Premier league and win European competitions, or earn job offers from other clubs.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:a8f8937238485d60.title: Premier Manager 2

dos:a90257ec45342e83.description: Roam space in your ship to conquer the universe, moving among star systems, discovering friendly or hostile planets, and engaging in space combat or conversation to further a fairly linear plot.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Simulation; Vehicle Simulation
dos:a90257ec45342e83.title: Galactic Empire

dos:a90ffd17fe8b8601.description: An adventure game based on Jane Austen's novel Pride and Prejudice.
dos:a90ffd17fe8b8601.title: Pride and Prejudice

dos:a9113194bb6d84e6.description: A spider solitaire game with a double deck in which you win by eliminating the cards in 8 batches.
dos:a9113194bb6d84e6.title: EGA-Spider

dos:a91329569caa4054.description: The final chapter of the Phantasie trilogy, in which the Dark Lord Nikademus sets out to conquer the entire world and you take on the quest to stop him. It adds improvements to weapons and more.
dos:a91329569caa4054.title: Phantasie III: The Wrath of Nikademus

dos:a91a0549a6d7e2d4.description: Explore the ocean with its plants and animals, zooming in and taking pictures of the creatures and plants under the sea.
dos:a91a0549a6d7e2d4.title: Eco-Adventures in the Oceans

dos:a91e81b27ebe03fa.description: The forerunner of Deuteros: The Next Millennium, with a premise like Sierra's Outpost. In the 22nd century, Earth is destroyed and you re-establish colonization starting with an outpost of a few hundred survivors on the moon.
dos:a91e81b27ebe03fa.title: Millennium: Return to Earth

dos:a922c54892be219c.description: Go back in time to lead a prehistoric tribe to a new homeland after their volcano erupts and lava engulfs the village. You provide for your tribe along the way.
dos:a922c54892be219c.title: The Lost Tribe

dos:a92afc828b43841c.description: Coach an English soccer team from the Third Division until you become the national coach. Handle finances such as buying and selling players, expanding the stadium and hiring staff, as well as the athletic side.
dos:a92afc828b43841c.title: Club & Country

dos:a92deb43a009273a.description: A real-time Sokoban-style puzzle game in which the Quadraliens have captured the Astra space reactor that powers mankind's stations, and contamination is rising. Six pilots are the last chance.
dos:a92deb43a009273a.title: Quadralien

dos:a930227856203eaa.description: A point-and-click adventure in which Joe King's plane, carrying actress Faye Russell, crash-lands in a remote jungle. The adventure is spread over 100 screens in the spirit of hammy B-movies.
dos:a930227856203eaa.title: Flight of the Amazon Queen

dos:a9438f420cfdefe4.description: The NFL-licensed third Front Page Sports football game with complete rosters for all 28 teams and 1994/95 players. It includes major rule changes and 3,000 stock plays.
dos:a9438f420cfdefe4.title: Front Page Sports: Football Pro '95

dos:a94cdb68a1aa3da3.description: A fixed-perspective arcade game in which you drop a rocket from the mother-ship and land safely on a desolate planet to pick up abandoned astronauts and bring them home.
dos:a94cdb68a1aa3da3.title: Meteor Mission

dos:a95233ac96a8d9ca.description: A donationware text adventure set in a fantasy scenario with references to modern or future times, such as a computer or spaceship. You have no specific goal and begin by exploring.
dos:a95233ac96a8d9ca.title: Adventure in the Magic Land

dos:a952445a5421b4aa.description: A futuristic sports game from Webfoot, best described as a cross between hockey and soccer. Control a magnetic ball and keep the opponent in check, with good 3D graphics.
dos:a952445a5421b4aa.title: 3D CyberPuck

dos:a95d37c6bc4bb11e.description: A text adventure in which a social visit to Biblioll College turns into an exploration of alchemical secrets and old conspiracies when your brother goes missing.
dos:a95d37c6bc4bb11e.title: Christminster

dos:a9885a8f25e710d2.description: A sequel to Under a Killing Moon using the same 3D engine and real actors. Explore the game world, examine objects from different angles, talk to many people and solve complex puzzles.
dos:a9885a8f25e710d2.title: The Pandora Directive

dos:a98d735593851cf2.description: A motorcycle game based on the 500cc World Championship starring the Spanish legend Angel Nieto. It offers several game modes in which you beat all your rivals, plus multiplayer.
dos:a98d735593851cf2.title: Angel Nieto Pole 500

dos:a98e17c13aa3c547.description: A detailed space exploration and trading game in which you build your own ship to specifications.
dos:a98e17c13aa3c547.title: Universe II

dos:a98ea81c46873f19.description: A year after the original Ninja Gaiden, the villain Ashtar plans to plunge the world into darkness. Ryu Hayabusa fights vile creatures on his way to destroy Ashtar.
dos:a98ea81c46873f19.title: Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos

dos:a9960efcf5d387a1.description: A port of the Street Fighter II series with faster fighting, 4 new characters, new locations and more balanced moves. Pick a fighter and beat opponents to become world champion.
dos:a9960efcf5d387a1.title: Super Street Fighter II Turbo

dos:a9af5f3fe34b629c.description: A Bomberman-like game with isometric graphics and a crayon art style like Yoshi's Island. Play alone or with another player in History mode or Battle mode.
dos:a9af5f3fe34b629c.title: Isometric Bomber

dos:a9be6aa57ccfc10e.description: A racing game that takes up less than 4 KB, most likely the very first game made in South Korea.
dos:a9be6aa57ccfc10e.title: Car

dos:a9c3696681d107d4.description: A Fisher-Price educational game for young children set on the Little People farm.
dos:a9c3696681d107d4.title: Fisher-Price: Little People Farm

dos:a9c45c20735077da.description: A Galaxian clone in which you battle the enemy.
dos:a9c45c20735077da.title: Cosmic Crusader

dos:a9cb18e8687aa42c.description: A collection of six Wild West mini-games with humorous presentation, starting with throwing knives at a spinning board. You can play as many as you like and retry any you fail.
dos:a9cb18e8687aa42c.title: Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show

dos:a9cf7b88a0ee6df3.description: The second part of a Tolkien adventure with graphics, following the Hobbits Frodo, Pippin and Sam as they bring the Ring to Mount Doom.
dos:a9cf7b88a0ee6df3.title: Fellowship of the Ring, The: Part 2

dos:a9e3060c54935f9e.description: A card game collection with Crazy 8's, blackjack, a matching game, 52-Pickup and Klondike solitaire, a dozen card backs and classical music. The registered version adds four more games.
dos:a9e3060c54935f9e.title: Cavalcade O' Card Games

dos:a9fc0c4601b9c8f7.description: A World War I flight simulation set in 1916, in which new British pilots stationed at a small airfield in Thetford, England, train to answer the German army's use of aircraft.
dos:a9fc0c4601b9c8f7.title: Wings of Glory

dos:a9ff051d8d95e111.description: A bundled release of the light-gun shooter A.D Cop, sold with a LightGun, with enhanced menu graphics and a new level.
dos:a9ff051d8d95e111.title: A.D Cop

dos:aa0187a88677c143.description: A platformer-shooter in the style of console games, in which an evil mega-robot called The Machine attacks the starship Avalon 1 and only Bren McGuire escapes.
dos:aa0187a88677c143.title: Turrican II: The Final Fight

dos:aa1e098254865b1a.description: A stand-alone expansion to Math Rescue with 45 new levels, additional word problems and three music tracks, with the same graphics and storyline.
dos:aa1e098254865b1a.title: Math Rescue Plus

dos:aa26d2a8f4d2f632.description: A courier delivering a package is trapped in Genoq Biolabs in Singapore, where the security system has gone crazy and genetically engineered organisms are rampaging. Fight through 10 floors of isometric action and puzzles.
dos:aa26d2a8f4d2f632.title: D/Generation

dos:aa312bd1719aadae.description: A text adventure in which you are Tracey Valencia, a university freshman whose car breaks down in the desert while driving home for Thanksgiving.
dos:aa312bd1719aadae.title: I-O: Jailbait on Interstate Zero

dos:aa462acfc0ba2d83.description: A disc of another 1000 Doom and Doom II levels with the D! front end, collected from the net by WizardWorks.
dos:aa462acfc0ba2d83.title: D!Zone 2

dos:aa544ac81c065d8d.description: A computer adaptation of the American TV game show in which two competitors throw dice, eliminate numbers and answer trivia questions in real time.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Game Show
dos:aa544ac81c065d8d.title: High Rollers

dos:aa571707c9ad7787.description: A follow-up to Lode Runner with 50 of the most challenging levels, intended for experts. It has no level editor, levels are played in order, and a save-game option costs a life each time you restore.
dos:aa571707c9ad7787.title: Championship Lode Runner

dos:aa5efbf92b3811ca.description: An evil wizard turns you into a ball of air and sends you into his mansion of over 250 rooms to find a Spellbook. You have a slow leak and must keep refilling with air.
dos:aa5efbf92b3811ca.title: Airball

dos:aa6644c1ea5aebff.description: A canceled add-on pack for Shadow Warrior later released as freeware, adding three Wang Bang levels, a Capture The Flag level and a twelve-map episode.
dos:aa6644c1ea5aebff.title: Wanton Destruction

dos:aa665c0e5a35bcf5.description: A Fisher-Price memory game in which you flip cards to find matching pairs and must remember those that don't match. It has 3 levels with 12, 16 or 20 cards.
dos:aa665c0e5a35bcf5.title: Fisher-Price: I Can Remember

dos:aa7366deedf3aa26.description: The original King's Quest. As Sir Graham, you set out to retrieve three stolen treasures: a protective shield, a mirror that foretells the future, and a chest forever filled with gold.
dos:aa7366deedf3aa26.title: King's Quest I: Quest for the Crown (PCjr)

dos:aa74d3f5d2f3a0c9.description: A Dutch Snake variant in which Wally the worm moves constantly through a room that spawns fruit. Steer left and right to collect it and grow longer.
dos:aa74d3f5d2f3a0c9.title: Wurm

dos:aa7977e5e94f1a90.description: The sequel to Home Alone. Kevin McCallister is lost in New York and must avoid the criminals Harry and Marv through 4 levels, with weapons such as a super somersault and a punch gun.
dos:aa7977e5e94f1a90.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York

dos:aa7d86b53d32237b.description: The sequel to Transylvania. Princess Sabrina and Crown Prince Erik return after King John's death to find the crown vanished, while Vampire Lord Drakul tries to uncover its secrets.
dos:aa7d86b53d32237b.title: Transylvania II: The Crimson Crown

dos:aa7ec35bc783abbe.description: A console-style platformer with 4 worlds including ice, desert and fields, each with multiple routes. You get past the cutesy bad guys by spinning at them, and collect power-ups such as food and water.
dos:aa7ec35bc783abbe.title: Quik the Thunder Rabbit

dos:aa8b579f81960246.description: A 3D action adventure with music by Queen. In the future an all-seeing machine called The Eye bans creativity, and you play Dubroc, sentenced to death in The Arena for rediscovering music.
dos:aa8b579f81960246.title: Queen: The eYe

dos:aa9412aeed60d4dd.description: An unofficial Quake add-on with a handful of single-player and deathmatch levels, a Quake level editor and a selection of hints and cheats.
dos:aa9412aeed60d4dd.title: Aftershock for Quake

dos:aa98e3f32bdfe9d0.description: Lead the secret war on illegal drugs in South America with advanced weapons like F-22 fighters and AH-64 helicopters. Destroy the drug pipeline to starve the barons of cash, without hitting civilians.
dos:aa98e3f32bdfe9d0.title: ATAC: The Secret War Against Drugs

dos:aaa3eac413f1f560.description: A light-gun style shooter set in 1920s Chicago, like Operation Wolf. As a lone gunman you battle Capone's men down streets and alleys as the screen scrolls sideways.
dos:aaa3eac413f1f560.title: Capone

dos:aaa570e9bd58f7a8.description: One of the oldest PC chess games, played against the computer with up to 6 difficulty levels. It recognizes only two keys, Del to select a piece and Ins to place it.
dos:aaa570e9bd58f7a8.title: Chess88

dos:aaac63f71f838519.description: A golf simulation endorsed by Lee Trevino, called by the U.S. National Video Game Team the best video golf simulation available when it was released in 1988.
dos:aaac63f71f838519.title: Lee Trevino's Fighting Golf

dos:aabbd4bc1dcd4bd8.description: A Middle East wargame with actual and hypothetical scenarios such as Desert Storm and another war between Israel and Syria. It focuses on simulating tactics and the impact of smaller factors.
dos:aabbd4bc1dcd4bd8.title: Point of Attack

dos:aac681dfb4a04273.description: A text adventure in which the entrance to the passages beneath an old Gothic church has been forgotten, and a sinister aura surrounds one of the large tombs in its graveyard.
dos:aac681dfb4a04273.title: Catacombs Revisited

dos:aad2c4f3016a4f60.description: A platformer combined with a quiz game. Gadget uses his time machine to go back to the dinosaur age and needs a crystal to power it, which he can collect only after answering questions.
dos:aad2c4f3016a4f60.title: Gadget: Lost in Time

dos:aae25e63bf3399e7.description: A single-player Battleship with the addition of sea mines. Both sides place 8 ships on a 19x15 grid, from an aircraft carrier down.
dos:aae25e63bf3399e7.title: Battleship (1991)

dos:aae6e69e5f254309.description: A turn-based strategy game set in Germicide Park, an amusement park for germs inside a human body. You play either the human or the germs.
dos:aae6e69e5f254309.title: Germicide

dos:aaeb5d8b55f198ea.description: A baseball simulation adding Home Run Derby and Pitching Practice, with multiple viewpoints, instant replays and 28 pitches. Use real or fictitious teams, or create your own down to the logo.
dos:aaeb5d8b55f198ea.title: HardBall 4

dos:aaf9e3fb545b8d8f.description: A real-time wargame of tactical battles between Roman legions on three terrain maps, with armies of selectable size and content, including foot soldiers, archers and cavalry. You can pause to give orders.
dos:aaf9e3fb545b8d8f.title: Cohort: Fighting for Rome

dos:ab186299ce9dd31e.description: The second and third Duke Nukum episodes, Mission: Moonbase and Trapped in the Future, platform games on the Crystal Caves engine in which Duke fights Dr. Proton and his Techbots.
dos:ab186299ce9dd31e.title: Duke Nukum: Episode 2 - Mission: Moonbase / Duke Nukum: Episode 3 - Trapped in the Future

dos:ab186299ce9dd31e.1.description: The second Duke Nukum episode, based on the Crystal Caves engine. In 1997 the mad Dr. Proton commands an army of Techbots to conquer the world, and Duke Nukum is the only hero who can stop him.
dos:ab186299ce9dd31e.1.title: Duke Nukum: Episode 2 - Mission: Moonbase

dos:ab186299ce9dd31e.2.description: The third Duke Nukum episode, Trapped in the Future, based on the Crystal Caves engine. Duke Nukum fights Dr. Proton and his army of Techbots.
dos:ab186299ce9dd31e.2.title: Duke Nukum: Episode 3 - Trapped in the Future

dos:ab2325641db793b8.description: A six-level action game converted from the Data East coin-op, beating a succession of opponents and an end-of-level boss. Action takes place on two levels of the screen reachable by jumping or ladders.
dos:ab2325641db793b8.title: Bad Dudes

dos:ab2325693d9a4975.description: A strategy game in which you play the US or the USSR against the computer, launching ICBMs at your opponent, who responds in kind. You can intercept incoming missiles with anti-ballistic missiles.
dos:ab2325693d9a4975.title: Global Thermonuclear War (1988)

dos:ab34edccd73ed901.description: A management game based on Polish speedway leagues. Run the finances of a first or second league club to win the championship, handling ticket sales, advertising, sponsors, riders, motorcycles and loans.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Racing & Driving; Sports
dos:ab34edccd73ed901.title: Insane Speedway

dos:ab3bade849dbf7c3.description: A Dragonlance action game set between Heroes of the Lance and Shadow Sorcerer. It has a side-scrolling action view, unlike the standard GoldBox role-playing games.
dos:ab3bade849dbf7c3.title: Dragons of Flame

dos:ab404f3aca75514b.description: A single-player strategy game for MS-DOS created and published by PC-SIG in 1985, based on global thermonuclear war.
dos:ab404f3aca75514b.title: Global Thermonuclear War (1985)

dos:ab465633470b6407.description: A top-down cyberpunk racing game with 30 tracks. It has a one-race arcade mode and a simulator mode like a career, with money, car damage, sponsors and upgrades.
dos:ab465633470b6407.title: Nitro Racers

dos:ab473beee77a76d9.description: A platformer based on the cartoon in which Fred Flintstone's pet dinosaur Dino is lost in the city of Bedrock. Play as Fred or Barney, avoiding enemies such as crocodiles.
dos:ab473beee77a76d9.title: The Flintstones: Dino: Lost in Bedrock

dos:ab4986fc5bc4096b.description: An unofficial PC port of an Atari ST Mahjong game. Pick tiles with the same patterns and a free edge to make them disappear before time runs out.
dos:ab4986fc5bc4096b.title: Match It!

dos:ab49dd31fe58b1ed.description: A public domain Snake game. Feed the constantly moving snake with the arrow keys to score points as it grows longer, avoiding walls and itself.
dos:ab49dd31fe58b1ed.title: Amazon Snake

dos:ab5bb0b8607c57aa.description: Total Pinball with the same slightly changed four tables as Pinball Mania: Kick Off (soccer), Jail Break (prison), Tarantula (a spider) and Jackpot (gambling), optionally presented in 3D.
dos:ab5bb0b8607c57aa.title: Pinball 3D-VCR

dos:ab67ee8d7f508d4b.description: A parody action adventure in which you play a stoner anarchist who vents his anger at a purple dinosaur and the others on his children's show.
dos:ab67ee8d7f508d4b.title: BarneySplat

dos:ab6b4014299f219d.description: A shareware baseball simulation in which you manage a major league team, choosing teams, positioning defenders and picking tactics such as bunt and hit and run, with many statistics.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:ab6b4014299f219d.title: Wild Pitch!

dos:ab7255cfe0598653.description: A Space Invaders-inspired typing game in which letters slowly descend and you type them to destroy them. It has 99 speeds and 39 lessons, and mistakes drain energy.
dos:ab7255cfe0598653.title: Type Attack

dos:ab7b197da96e6b2e.description: An overhead racing game with 256-color parallax scrolling at 70 fps, the first project of a small Finnish group. The full version has 35 tracks, twelve vehicles, twelve opponents and a track editor.
dos:ab7b197da96e6b2e.title: Fatal Fumes

dos:ab7bf32926de6397.description: Four games on one disk, including Space War, Moon Lander and Meteor Shower. In Meteor Shower you collect pieces of a scene while falling meteors remove them.
dos:ab7bf32926de6397.title: Space Battles

dos:ab7e14196933f301.description: A clone of Flappy Bird written in 16-bit x86 assembly.
dos:ab7e14196933f301.title: Floppy Bird

dos:ab7e4e4e1bca1210.description: A freeware clone of Combat with a two-player mode and joystick support. The 13th level code could be emailed to the author for a deluxe version with SoundBlaster support.
dos:ab7e4e4e1bca1210.title: Tankgame

dos:ab82f82f3ac42e46.description: The last id Tech 1 Doom game, with two separate 32-level episodes, TNT: Evilution and The Plutonia Experiment, made by Team TNT and the Casali brothers.
dos:ab82f82f3ac42e46.title: Final DOOM

dos:ab85e83887ec3a61.description: You play Cliff, a hard-boiled private eye trapped in a tall building about to be blown up, and descend nine linear floors to win. It has a lengthy introduction and little mystery solving.
dos:ab85e83887ec3a61.title: Cliff Diver: Investigator For Hire

dos:ab8d75730d685805.description: A fast multiplayer action game in which up to four players fly ships in cave-like 2D arenas and shoot each other. Choose from 10 spaceships and dozens of weapons; there are no AI opponents.
dos:ab8d75730d685805.title: Assault Wing

dos:abae8cebbc3dedb3.description: An A320 flight simulation sold in Japan for DOS/V, with 3D modeled buildings and textures and 8 Japanese airports including Haneda, Narita, Kansai and Chitose.
dos:abae8cebbc3dedb3.title: Jet Stream

dos:abb1f8a1964b8527.description: An arcade puzzle hybrid in which, in Professor Hybrys's game, you use a ball and control unit across 80 labyrinths, destroying all the destructible blocks in each level.
dos:abb1f8a1964b8527.title: Titan

dos:abb6ba156f3ca0a2.description: An educational math game where you choose to practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, division or conversion, set the complexity and a time limit, and can play against the computer.
dos:abb6ba156f3ca0a2.title: Batter Up

dos:abc6ac05c1b79393.description: A Q*Bert clone in which you jump on a pyramid of blocks, changing their colors while avoiding a snake and other characters. Clear a pyramid to advance to a harder level.
dos:abc6ac05c1b79393.title: Bert and the Snake

dos:abca28a484c31f7d.description: Chris Crawford's updated Balance of Power, set in 1989 as the Communist Block crumbles. Use military, covert and industrial forces to make your country the most prestigious while avoiding nuclear war.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation / Political; Strategy
dos:abca28a484c31f7d.title: Balance of Power: The 1990 Edition

dos:abcb1b2dfcd2f3d4.description: Fly a German Bundeswehr battle helicopter on search and rescue and supporting missions abroad, with gameplay somewhat like Electronic Arts' Strike series.
dos:abcb1b2dfcd2f3d4.title: Helicopter Mission

dos:abd07f9e07916ab0.description: A fast real-time 3D combat game in which you choose your ship and shipmates, command your group and take over the Cylindrix. It can also be played by modem.
dos:abd07f9e07916ab0.title: Cylindrix

dos:abd308a30ba11bf0.description: MicroProse's American football simulation, the first in a short-lived series, with the teams and players of the 1993 NFL season, single game and league modes, and team and playbook editors.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Football
dos:abd308a30ba11bf0.title: NFL Coaches Club Football

dos:abdbaf1ce00ffe86.description: The fourth edition of PC Futbol for the 1995/1996 league, a managerial simulator in which you decide training, transfers and the stadium. It adds a pro manager mode that starts from the bottom.
dos:abdbaf1ce00ffe86.title: PC Futbol 4.0

dos:abdc5ba6fe02c4dc.description: A Commander Keen platformer set between Keen 3 and Keen 4. Billy Blaze, forced to eat vegetables, dreams of a world he must save.
dos:abdc5ba6fe02c4dc.title: Commander Keen: Keen Dreams

dos:abecc9418fdf8bb2.description: A frantic shooter lasting around 30 seconds in which aliens come onto the screen and you blast them, with VGA graphics and SB sound.
dos:abecc9418fdf8bb2.title: Alien Phobia

dos:abf7432a167e28a5.description: A 3D arcade driving game from Atari Games. Race a high-performance sports car around the course as fast as possible, hitting checkpoints to gain extra time, with traffic in both directions.
dos:abf7432a167e28a5.title: Hard Drivin'

dos:abf80cc84b5efbb6.description: The sequel to Dragon Lore: The Legend Begins. You play Werner von Wallenrod, named Knight of the Dragon, whom a mysterious lord at the Dragon Prince's table wants to stop.
dos:abf80cc84b5efbb6.title: Dragon Lore II: The Heart of the Dragon Man

dos:abfa791b2d853db8.description: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles rescue April O'Neil, held hostage by Bebop and Rocksteady, then their sensei Splinter, and then go after Shredder in the Technodrome. You play all four turtles.
dos:abfa791b2d853db8.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

dos:abfe2a563daa2a8c.description: A single-player shareware logic puzzle game like Chip's Challenge. Maneuver crates into the storage area in the fewest moves; the shareware version has five rooms.
dos:abfe2a563daa2a8c.title: Crates

dos:ac03204a21e5ad8d.description: A race against the computer, shown as a smiling face, on a figure-8 track in 40-column ASCII graphics, for a single lap.
dos:ac03204a21e5ad8d.title: Racecar

dos:ac03940a0abf5d19.description: A single-player shareware arcade game with text graphics in which enemy bombers fly across the screen and you choose among forty gun turrets along the bottom to shoot them.
dos:ac03940a0abf5d19.title: Tommy's Air Raid

dos:ac05764ab8af3c0d.description: A casino compilation: Slot Jack, The Executive Edition of Video Craps, Slot Poker and Diamond Roulette, with English and Spanish modes for some.
dos:ac05764ab8af3c0d.title: Casino Challenge

dos:ac07d1cd7fd535f5.description: A platform puzzle game in which you are Mimi, avoiding or shooting mites and finding your way out of a maze.
dos:ac07d1cd7fd535f5.title: Mimi & The Mites

dos:ac33f7eaf4e1bf7c.description: A basic darts simulator for one player against the computer or two players, with regular 501 rules. The computer picks opponents of differing ability at random, and they improve during the competition.
dos:ac33f7eaf4e1bf7c.title: World Darts

dos:ac40dcf5c6fd6085.description: A vertical shooter like Raptor and Xenon in which aliens called Visitors invade Earth. Choose from 5 ship types with different abilities and weaknesses.
dos:ac40dcf5c6fd6085.title: Vanguard Ace: Vertical Madness

dos:ac6a3294b66b382d.description: A Jacks or better video poker game with an integrated tutor and Stanford Wong as an analyzer. Set a bet, deal the hand, ask the tutor, analyze and hold cards.
dos:ac6a3294b66b382d.title: Dr. Wong's Jacks+ Video Poker

dos:ac70ed80e276f2dc.description: The 4X space strategy sequel in which new races take to space around the mystical planet Orion, long ago created by the Ancients, who also banished the Antarans to another dimension.
dos:ac70ed80e276f2dc.title: Master of Orion II: Battle at Antares

dos:ac7337910a6541cc.description: A compilation of three light-gun games, two by Dinamic Software and one by Opera Soft, bundled with the Gun Stick light gun from MHT Ingenieros: Mike Gunner, Solo and Target Plus.
dos:ac7337910a6541cc.title: Pack Regalo Gun Stick

dos:ac860d730d5f9b53.description: One of the few cricket games, Audiogenic's second after Graham Gooch's Test Match. All the international sides are present and you can change the players.
dos:ac860d730d5f9b53.title: Allan Border's Cricket

dos:ac92f00c857099a3.description: An adventure in which Zeet and Deedle follow their great-explorer grandfather's trail to Earth to rescue him, meeting an array of whimsical, surreal characters.
dos:ac92f00c857099a3.title: SpaceKids

dos:ac942acd48f54d86.description: An adventure set in the early 21st century, in which Earth has a global oil shortage and Tunisia holds large amounts of high-quality oil. The USA and Soviet governments race to buy it until the Soviets kidnap a US citizen.
dos:ac942acd48f54d86.title: Codename: ICEMAN

dos:aca791d39b45e3f8.description: A clone of Columns in which sets of tiles move down the screen at increasing speed and you line up three or more matching tiles in a row or diagonal to remove them.
dos:aca791d39b45e3f8.title: Beyond Columns

dos:aca81559299e7d3b.description: An online adaptation of the board game Risk for three to six players. The globe has six continents and 42 countries, and the first to conquer all wins.
dos:aca81559299e7d3b.title: Global War

dos:acaa3e7f8a3a8113.description: A first-person dungeon crawl role-playing game in which you move through tight corridors with a point-and-click interface, picking up items, solving puzzles and fighting creatures such as zombies.
dos:acaa3e7f8a3a8113.title: WaxWorks

dos:acaf11faa3fb09d1.description: A computer adaptation of Go with a full tutorial of the basic rules. Options include board size from 9x9 to 19x19 and computer level from 1 to 20.
dos:acaf11faa3fb09d1.title: Go Simulator

dos:acb424a24d621833.description: A draw poker game much like the casino version, in which you bet that you can win the hand with one of nine combinations of cards.
dos:acb424a24d621833.title: Draw Poker (1993)

dos:acb80c0afc2c718e.description: A role-playing game with a three-quarters overhead perspective like certain Ultima games and standard RPG gameplay.
dos:acb80c0afc2c718e.title: Wraith

dos:acba671ce859fc6c.description: ESPN Extreme Games has Exhibition, New Season and Continue modes. In a new season you race sixteen other competitors on any of four racing machines.
dos:acba671ce859fc6c.title: ESPN Extreme Games

dos:acca2f401fd2ba49.description: A fruit machine gambling game in which you start with a fixed amount of cash and choose whether to collect or gamble your winnings, followed by a dice game of guessing higher or lower.
dos:acca2f401fd2ba49.title: Dizzy Dice

dos:accea70aa006c425.description: An action and wargame hybrid set on the European front in WWII. Make tactical decisions from a top-down map and then fight in first person across 150 single-player missions.
dos:accea70aa006c425.title: Muzzle Velocity

dos:acd8a0554d5f1be9.description: A turn-based game in which you try to escape a maze while avoiding robots.
dos:acd8a0554d5f1be9.title: Expedition

dos:acdae8ec1b9f4514.description: A mid-90s side scroller in which you play Jack Flash, sucking the energy from evil inanimate objects that have been brought to life.
dos:acdae8ec1b9f4514.title: Jack Flash

dos:acdceba498baaf08.description: A Malay-language platformer with a Christmas theme, in which you control a ball-shaped ninja-styled hero with legs and hands.
dos:acdceba498baaf08.title: Bug Hunter

dos:acdf3ece7060c39c.description: A version of the dice game Yahtzee, originally written for the Compucolor II, for up to 5 players, one of whom may be the computer. Score points by making combinations with five dice, re-rolling any after the first roll.
dos:acdf3ece7060c39c.title: Yahtzee

dos:acf5624fe63185b9.description: As Fleet Admiral, send your starship armada from the home planet to explore the stars. Planets may be barren or industrial and resist colonization, and you choose whether to conquer and colonize them.
dos:acf5624fe63185b9.title: Galaxy

dos:acf5f43e5fd9e6c3.description: Two-on-two arcade basketball with players from all NBA teams. It is fast, with no fouls and deliberately unrealistic jams, players are rated in eight categories, and up to four humans can play.
dos:acf5f43e5fd9e6c3.title: NBA Jam Tournament Edition

dos:acfc32abaa55dcb1.description: A Pac-Man clone in which you control a smiley face collecting all the dots in one of four mazes while monsters roam, each with different behavior; contact costs a life.
dos:acfc32abaa55dcb1.title: Chomps

dos:ad0302d628a6ffb7.description: A DOS version of the arcade game Rygar, notable for being nearly pixel perfect long before MAME.
dos:ad0302d628a6ffb7.title: Rygar

dos:ad0fddb512daa93a.description: A little-known soccer management game with fictional English teams. It combines on-field strategy through the captain with basic management, such as picking match strategy and buying players.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:ad0fddb512daa93a.title: Superstar Soccer

dos:ad2572dafa0eef8e.description: An early computer translation of the classic APBA board-and-paper football simulation.
dos:ad2572dafa0eef8e.title: APBA Pro Football

dos:ad401a52198ea3d3.description: Explore a house created with Virtual Reality Studio and find treasure, collecting it by shooting it.
dos:ad401a52198ea3d3.title: Eerie Estates

dos:ad4c00cef5be871b.description: A real-time wargame of World War II in which you command the Axis or Allies through 20 scenarios from the Normandy invasion to the capture of Berlin, with 15 unit types and an isometric engine with three zoom levels.
dos:ad4c00cef5be871b.title: Offensive

dos:ad4cb0d62db8b7fc.description: Bob Morane, hero of the Francophone novels and comics, parachutes into the South American jungle near an Inca sanctuary and must stop his enemy the Yellow Shadow from seizing the ancient treasure.
dos:ad4cb0d62db8b7fc.title: Bob Morane: Jungle 1

dos:ad51db6f466cf8d9.description: An action puzzle game from Software Visions, makers of MegaZeux, with 256-color graphics. Reach the exit door, picking up bombs, knives and keys along the way.
dos:ad51db6f466cf8d9.title: Apocalypse Abyss

dos:ad54dc508c0c042c.description: A Prohibition-era strategy adventure. With Al Capone gone, Chicago's profits are up for grabs, and every action has long-term consequences while you keep your people on your side.
dos:ad54dc508c0c042c.title: The King of Chicago

dos:ad6de06224384c48.description: As Bruce Lee, fight Master Po and his army of martial arts warriors to stop their destruction of Hong Kong Island. The AI learns from your past actions, so you can't win by repeating one move.
dos:ad6de06224384c48.title: Bruce Lee Lives

dos:ad77259d0aa2ae88.description: A simple top-down shooter whose title means The Ultimate I'll Kill Everyone. Kill everyone on the map using weapons picked up or bought from stores, against numerous enemies.
dos:ad77259d0aa2ae88.title: The Ultimate Tapan Kaikki

dos:ad7949c52b4bc1c2.description: A retro arcade game in which you control a ball, with two modes: The Quest, collecting minerals in levels, and Ball Blazing Fantasy, a one-on-one soccer match played by balls.
dos:ad7949c52b4bc1c2.title: Ball Blazing Fantasy

dos:ad7ffe37980850f4.description: A Warcraft-like real-time strategy game with RPG elements set in prehistoric times. You choose among tribes, whose simple men can evolve rather than just work.
dos:ad7ffe37980850f4.title: Jurassic War

dos:ad8618627087070e.description: A sequel to Mind Castle I with a second mystery, again focused on logic and reading.
dos:ad8618627087070e.title: Mind Castle II

dos:ad8b1a945fba5c9e.description: A text adventure based on Ray Bradbury's novel. As Fireman Guy Montag, who burns books, you become a rebel pursued by the authorities, with the help of the Underground.
dos:ad8b1a945fba5c9e.title: Fahrenheit 451

dos:ad8bb55f0922a942.description: A compilation of Gunship 2000, its Scenario Disk and Mission Builder. Fly the Apache, Longbow Apache, Blackhawk, Comanche or MD-500 Defender on campaigns or missions, with updated terrain graphics.
dos:ad8bb55f0922a942.title: Gunship 2000 (CD-ROM Edition)

dos:ad9aa2931a69da19.description: A platformer for two characters, Joe and Nat, graffiti artists on the run from New York's police who end up in a mysterious castle. They can jump, crawl, kick, slide and swim.
dos:ad9aa2931a69da19.title: Yo! Joe! Beat the Ghosts

dos:ada2f37e55d27f60.description: A three-part game starring Hugo. First he navigates a gold mine maze, collecting nuggets and avoiding mine carts and dynamite on a time limit, then crosses an old bridge with huge holes.
dos:ada2f37e55d27f60.title: Hugo Labyrinth

dos:ada73db68326f9c4.description: A Tetris clone in which you eliminate lines of falling blocks in a practice mode or the Conquest of 100 stages. Clear lines until the indicator turns yellow, with bombs along the way.
dos:ada73db68326f9c4.title: Drak

dos:ada9e9296092bcf5.description: Robert receives a letter from a relative in England and is teleported from Stonehenge to the magical world of Valoria, where he must become a wizard and survive battles against monsters.
dos:ada9e9296092bcf5.title: SpellCraft: Aspects of Valor

dos:adaf8fe8396e4b5d.description: A golf simulation with Pebble Beach and St. Andrews, using a three-click swing system. It has Beginner and Expert difficulty options.
dos:adaf8fe8396e4b5d.title: Mean 18

dos:adbba0dc9a7a6eea.description: A two-player grid game against an android opponent over fifteen challenges, in which you take turns selecting positive or negative values, moving horizontally or vertically according to your role, to finish with the higher score.
dos:adbba0dc9a7a6eea.title: S♥xy Droids

dos:adbe503255b25427.description: An educational game that teaches basic mathematics to young children through a bakery theme. Five mini-games have you solve simple calculations to prepare cakes.
dos:adbe503255b25427.title: Piece of Cake

dos:adc1bd562df6a7a4.description: A two-section game. First you play a human aboard the Station placing bets, then you become Quiwkali, leader of the Metal Claw tribe. The sections are independent.
dos:adc1bd562df6a7a4.title: Hunter's Law Deluxe

dos:add553e567eebb13.description: The complete The Terminator 2029 with its mission disk Operation Scour, making 34 missions, plus over 330MB of briefings, character speech and music.
dos:add553e567eebb13.title: The Terminator 2029 - Deluxe CD Edition

dos:add93f4dc062a95d.description: An isometric sci-fi action game with strategy elements set on the space station Beacon 04523N, where three human officers sleep in cryogenic tanks until an emergency wakes them.
dos:add93f4dc062a95d.title: Wreckers

dos:ade0e51775e9162c.description: Linus crash-landed on Earth and made it home, but nobody believes his story. Help him return to Earth to take pictures, in an adventure with arcade action sections.
dos:ade0e51775e9162c.title: Cosmic Spacehead

dos:ade463591c113a46.description: A slow-paced Bomberman clone without power-ups that supports two-player co-op.
dos:ade463591c113a46.title: EGGermon

dos:ade5f7035305baf7.description: A two-player artillery game in which you and your opponent each have a missile tower on a 2D map and take turns firing over cliffs and mountains using velocity, range and angle.
dos:ade5f7035305baf7.title: OnTarget

dos:ade8f48d0b5a10c2.description: A side-scrolling platformer continuing the story of MegaDestroyer Frantis, who bails out over planet Rakbet IV and lands in an underground enemy base and must continue on foot to destroy it.
dos:ade8f48d0b5a10c2.title: Frantis: Mission II

dos:ade93aa521244dca.description: A role-playing game in which four heroes save Kalynthia from the arch mage Bronagh. The overworld is shown top-down with plenty to do beyond the main quest, and towns use a static interface.
dos:ade93aa521244dca.title: Abandoned Places: A Time for Heroes

dos:adf3d3a5e24e8ec8.description: A freeware platformer in which Osbit, an operating system bit, is stranded by a power surge and fights through three levels of corrupted DOS and nasty bugs to get home.
dos:adf3d3a5e24e8ec8.title: Osbit

dos:adfda7f5defa6471.description: A computerized version of Reversi, or Othello, playable against the CPU or another human on an eight-by-eight board.
dos:adfda7f5defa6471.title: Reversi

dos:adff5c6a353bd1a9.description: An advergame in which you drive a Volkswagen Golf as far as possible down a road filled with obstacles such as oil slicks and rolling balls, where any contact ends the run.
dos:adff5c6a353bd1a9.title: Kalli and Co.

dos:ae066b731a475c46.description: A trilogy of updated graphical versions of three classic Apshai games: Temple of Apshai, Upper Reaches of Apshai and Curse of Ra.
dos:ae066b731a475c46.title: Temple of Apshai Trilogy

dos:ae1ce63988d8cb82.description: The board game Stratego, a more elaborate Capture the Flag. Each player has 40 pieces, including the flag, 5 bombs and 9 types of military units, and moves them in turns.
dos:ae1ce63988d8cb82.title: Stratego

dos:ae2010809e565913.description: A shooter in which you aim a character left and right with the bracket keys and fire at a face. A white-filled face costs you ammunition and a black-filled one costs ammunition and shield.
dos:ae2010809e565913.title: Faceshooter

dos:ae303bce96a2c1c1.description: A side-scrolling shooter-platformer in which Bitmap Kid, who has deep pockets, sets out to get back his toys stolen by creatures across four worlds.
dos:ae303bce96a2c1c1.title: Magic Pockets

dos:ae3c3d501566fcab.description: A South Korean shoot-em-up candidate for the title of first for PC, released commercially in a cardboard box.
dos:ae3c3d501566fcab.title: Korean Soul

dos:ae460b282b088dd6.description: A top-down shooter with logic elements, resembling Alien Breed, in which you destroy Martian terrorists who have seized a moon base where scientists researched new weapons.
dos:ae460b282b088dd6.title: Rooster

dos:ae5b1aebf34677d7.description: The first Warcraft. The Kingdom of Azeroth is invaded by Orcs through a portal opened by the mage Medivh, and you lead either the humans or the Orcs.
dos:ae5b1aebf34677d7.title: Warcraft: Orcs & Humans

dos:ae73e6adb03e53b6.description: A platformer starring Scrooge McDuck and his nephews. Flintheart Glomgold challenges Scrooge to see who is richest in 30 days.
dos:ae73e6adb03e53b6.title: Disney's Duck Tales: The Quest for Gold

dos:ae8c6d14167e6473.description: A mix of a shooting gallery and Paratrooper.
dos:ae8c6d14167e6473.title: Biobombers

dos:ae93cd145cfaf89c.description: An educational game in which children keep a helicopter flying by spelling words. The screen shows speed, altitude, fuel, score and cargo, with three difficulty levels and up to 400 words in 40 categories.
dos:ae93cd145cfaf89c.title: Spellicopter

dos:ae9fe755fcafd2f4.description: The officially licensed game of the 1995 movie, against the Riddler and Two-Face. It mixes a side-scrolling platformer with one-on-one fighting.
dos:ae9fe755fcafd2f4.title: Batman Forever

dos:aea6e0d222181504.description: A Snake variant that came with some Microsoft Mouse drivers for DOS, in which you play a mouse, the food, trying not to be eaten by an ever-growing snake.
dos:aea6e0d222181504.title: Boa

dos:aebc8016817e120e.description: A side-view fighting game in which the evil Akuma has destroyed the hero's homeland and kidnapped Princess Mariko. Fight increasingly difficult opponents to reach his palace.
dos:aebc8016817e120e.title: Karateka

dos:aec0fa40d48694c9.description: Collect all the diamonds without being caught in an explosion. If any diamonds are destroyed you cannot complete the level.
dos:aec0fa40d48694c9.title: Diamonds (1998)

dos:aec64b8e62e460dd.description: A text adventure built with the Adventure Game Toolkit in which you prepare for a date with Susan, searching houses, a park and a construction-site maze for objects she asks for.
dos:aec64b8e62e460dd.title: Susan (A L♥stful Game)

dos:aec7cba6ea4e6d97.description: A psychedelic children's adventure in which Ronnie is set the unusual task of learning magic by his teacher. Sitting crying under a tree, he is asked by the tree why he is wetting it.
dos:aec7cba6ea4e6d97.title: Strawberry Magic

dos:aecc5e0070ea49ea.description: A side-scrolling action shooter from Taiwan featuring large mechs.
dos:aecc5e0070ea49ea.title: Robot Hunter

dos:aed69448e1aee7a6.description: A playable-to-the-end but unfinished adventure in which Dr. Jummybummy looks for his glasses, escapes prison, and stops aliens from destroying the Earth by pressing a lot of buttons.
dos:aed69448e1aee7a6.title: Dr. Jummybummy's Space Adventure 2

dos:aed8c542d3dfe001.description: A tribute to simple 1980s action games with a scrolling maze, in which you play a variant of Capture The Flag, maneuvering your car to capture flags and avoid being tagged by enemy cars.
dos:aed8c542d3dfe001.title: Speed-Kar!

dos:aee0b54bd6966636.description: A 3D shooter based on the movie Pumpkinhead II: Blood Wings. As the Keeper of the Spirits you travel through mystical realms for objects to appease Pumpkinhead's spirit, glimpsing film clips through portals.
dos:aee0b54bd6966636.title: Bloodwings: Pumpkinhead's Revenge

dos:aee64a79c74a037a.description: A scrolling shoot-em-up with bright but simple graphics.
dos:aee64a79c74a037a.title: Mega Force 2

dos:aeeb4f7bd58e9490.description: A remake of the original Carmen Sandiego game. As a rookie detective, you track thieves stealing the world's treasures, using geography clues to catch them before a deadline.
dos:aeeb4f7bd58e9490.title: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego? Enhanced

dos:aeed8e142cb92d6a.description: A platformer in which 7-year-old Tom's mother is kidnapped by an evil sorcerer in an old Scottish castle, and the brave ghost Sir Reginald Arrow appears to help Tom save her from a dark ritual.
dos:aeed8e142cb92d6a.title: Tom and the Ghost

dos:af040f7462b57f68.description: A 256-color Boulder Dash clone in which you collect gems and reach the exit in each level, manipulating rocks, bombs and lasers to get past obstacles.
dos:af040f7462b57f68.title: Trugg

dos:af12743513fab8a9.description: An Asteroids clone in which you can only shoot horizontally.
dos:af12743513fab8a9.title: Argon

dos:af1746b4d58ad591.description: The sequel to Midwinter, set years later in a thawed world. The Peaceful Atlantic Federation faces invasion by the slave-trading Saharan Empire, with the Slave isles between them.
dos:af1746b4d58ad591.title: Midwinter II: Flames of Freedom

dos:af182e770686d05c.description: A run-and-gun shooter in which a Marine is sent into a power plant to investigate a power loss and finds that Timestrikers are making ruptures in time to invade Earth in three time periods.
dos:af182e770686d05c.title: Chasm: The Rift

dos:af4465d88c0dea94.description: A space shooter seen from the cockpit of the last scout ship of its squadron after a vicious alien attack. With a pair of frontal lasers and limited shield energy, you hold off relentless waves of enemy fighters.
dos:af4465d88c0dea94.title: The Last Warrior

dos:af4c5f15e6ecc7c5.description: The Confederation has been at war with the Kilrathi for 20 years, and you join the Vega campaign as a 2nd Lieutenant posted to the carrier Tiger's Claw, in a space combat flight simulator.
dos:af4c5f15e6ecc7c5.title: Wing Commander

dos:af4ec130c876294d.description: A black-and-white Snake variant, Robak meaning Worm, in which you eat food in a small room filled with obstacles and bonuses to reach the length needed to open the door to the next stage.
dos:af4ec130c876294d.title: Robak

dos:af573ea00780fe13.description: The very rare CD-ROM version of Defender of the Crown, possibly the first PC game on CD. You play one of four Saxon knights in medieval England after the King's death and the theft of his crown.
dos:af573ea00780fe13.title: Defender of the Crown CD-ROM

dos:af6147fd3ef20708.description: An arcade shooter with a small fighter whose goal is to escort a huge bomber unharmed to destroy the enemy fleet in the Persian Gulf, using abilities such as creating false images on the radar.
dos:af6147fd3ef20708.title: Silent Shadow

dos:af645e01dd5da604.description: An action and strategy basketball game for one or two players, playing three on three on the whole court with 3, 6, 9 or 12 minute quarters. You can customize your team from players with different strengths.
dos:af645e01dd5da604.title: Fast Break

dos:af6d4cfbf56e3e1f.description: A sport of the future in which you choose a vehicle and enter an arena to score the most goals before time runs out. The ball bounces constantly, and you are bombarded by opponents, with a variety of weapons.
dos:af6d4cfbf56e3e1f.title: BattleSport

dos:af6d96c690a0ff09.description: The second half of Savage Island, which continues exactly where the first leaves off, with a code sheet you can decipher after finishing to reveal the island's ultimate secret.
dos:af6d96c690a0ff09.title: Savage Island Part 2

dos:af82c353abfce7a6.description: A puzzle game in which you guide a small green ball called Element through mazes with the arrow keys without running out of energy, which is lost with every move.
dos:af82c353abfce7a6.title: Elements

dos:af89ede72f84aabb.description: A political simulation in which you take over the Kremlin as Ligachov, Yeltsin or Gorbachov, set foreign and domestic policy and react to crises such as Chernobyl, keeping Nationalists and Reformists in line.
dos:af89ede72f84aabb.title: Crisis in the Kremlin

dos:af8aea83eb7ba82d.description: A nearly peaceful children's arcade game in which you play a bear piloting an early 20th-century airplane. It began as a mini-game in Putt-Putt Goes to the Moon.
dos:af8aea83eb7ba82d.title: Bear Stormin'

dos:afa3cd064d982e66.description: A side-view action platformer with puzzle elements based on the Italian comic character Dylan Dog, London's nightmare detective. After a dream, Dylan receives an invitation to a mansion.
dos:afa3cd064d982e66.title: Dylan Dog: Murderers

dos:afacbc0dea4f218f.description: A beat-em-up in which you play Popeye fighting aliens.
dos:afacbc0dea4f218f.title: Popeye 3: WrestleCrazy

dos:afb7d07e563d7f2c.description: A comic Western adventure in which Freddy Pharkas, once one of the fastest guns in the West, had his ear shot off by the outlaw Kenny, gave up his pistols and became a pharmacist.
dos:afb7d07e563d7f2c.title: Freddy Pharkas: Frontier Pharmacist

dos:afc18cde828fa293.description: An educational game from Russia covering math, literature and geography.
dos:afc18cde828fa293.title: Erudit (Smart)

dos:aff9282bdc42209a.description: A near-exact clone of Taito's Puzznic. Move pieces horizontally, and when two or more of the same type touch they disappear. Clear every piece before time runs out.
dos:aff9282bdc42209a.title: Brix 4: Genius

dos:aff9d8e6ffeded6c.description: An all-female fighting game with a limited set of moves.
dos:aff9d8e6ffeded6c.title: Femme Fatality

dos:affa2c9132922b02.description: A wargame covering major battles of the Second World War, from the Sahara to the Russian campaign, the Battle of the Bulge and D-Day. A map editor lets you modify or create scenarios, and you can take direct control of vehicles and guns.
dos:affa2c9132922b02.title: Campaign (Empire Software)

dos:affab73ce477b395.description: A freeware Pipe Mania variant in which you lay a pathway so that a mole can find his way home. It has sound, three difficulty levels, a high score table and mouse control.
dos:affab73ce477b395.title: Molefest

dos:b001a62a6ed495e7.description: A kart racing game starring characters from Core Design's Chuck Rock series. Each team rides a prehistoric motorcycle with a side car, one driving and the other fighting opponents with clubs, punches and kicks.
dos:b001a62a6ed495e7.title: BC Racers

dos:b017ba052dd68875.description: A simplified roguelike with randomly generated levels containing treasure to collect and monsters to fight, in ASCII graphics.
dos:b017ba052dd68875.title: Dungeon (1987)

dos:b01d4e23985fc74b.description: The third Kick Off game, the first with an isometric view instead of top-down. It has four competitions, World Cup Finals, League, Knock Out Cup and the challenge, and 32 teams.
dos:b01d4e23985fc74b.title: Kick Off 3: European Challenge

dos:b0224c56e451ee0b.description: An unauthorized AGS fan sequel to Quest for Glory I. The Hero of Spielburg revisits the stomping grounds of his early days between numbered installments.
dos:b0224c56e451ee0b.title: Quest for Glory 4½: So You Thought You Were A Hero

dos:b02842b78307b0dc.description: An unofficial DOS version of the Nintendo Duck Hunt by the art group CiA, using ANSI graphics. You head outdoors with your hunting dog to shoot ducks.
dos:b02842b78307b0dc.title: Duck Hunt (1995)

dos:b034f69cb3f7f7bf.description: An odd pinball game based on the Atari ST game Starball. One huge table has 3 main parts, each with its own flippers, with bizarre concepts such as dropping between the flippers.
dos:b034f69cb3f7f7bf.title: Starball

dos:b0402bf2ff14a7e1.description: A game based on the Dave Stevens comic and the Disney movie, with action sequences mimicking the film, including racing a plane, a warehouse shootout and hand-to-hand combat atop a flying blimp.
dos:b0402bf2ff14a7e1.title: The Rocketeer

dos:b05a98ef82b956a3.description: A platformer in which you play a man trapped in a horrible nightmare where dying means dying for real. Survive until the alarm clock rings at 8:12, with every room costing six minutes.
dos:b05a98ef82b956a3.title: Frightmare

dos:b06264869146d423.description: A colorful fan remake of the arcade classic Joust, with bird-mounted knights competing for aerial superiority, where the lower rider is dismounted when two meet, leaving eggs behind.
dos:b06264869146d423.title: Joust VGA

dos:b073b27337dd7f56.description: An action-oriented baseball game starring Orel Hershiser with two modes, strike zone and home run derby, and a batting interface that lets you adjust speed and direction.
dos:b073b27337dd7f56.title: Orel Hershiser's Strike Zone

dos:b087862befdde4b3.description: A genre crossover of an arcade space shooter and a medical simulation. Defend your planet from a biological attack and stop the epidemic by testing experimental medicine.
dos:b087862befdde4b3.title: Emergency Mission

dos:b08cd23cbed6f795.description: A science fiction text adventure in which an artificial intelligence is merged with your body after an experiment and you must find a source of energy to stay alive. Character interaction uses a list of questions.
dos:b08cd23cbed6f795.title: Cyborg

dos:b0969ad54201c2ed.description: A puzzle game like Atomix, in which colored blocks slide in the chosen direction until they meet an obstacle. Unlike Atomix, the goal is not to create a shape.
dos:b0969ad54201c2ed.title: Shiftrix

dos:b09832ddf1b67f7e.description: A Wild West interactive shooter in which the Zorton Brothers, two gunmen who think they are the center of the world, terrorize the town.
dos:b09832ddf1b67f7e.title: Los Justicieros

dos:b098f68ceef2c769.description: A shareware arcade shooter in which a soldier with a jet pack must destroy all enemies before fuel and ammunition run out, with three lives.
dos:b098f68ceef2c769.title: Sky Bombers

dos:b09b7579e4e1f164.description: A draw poker game against four computer players named Lucky, Shifty, Ace and Slim, in which each is dealt five cards and can bet or check.
dos:b09b7579e4e1f164.title: Draw Poker (1982)

dos:b0a7194d1901c924.description: A vertical shoot-em-up that also scrolls horizontally, revealing new enemies as you reach the edge, including static turrets and waves of cannon fodder across 6 levels.
dos:b0a7194d1901c924.title: SideWinder

dos:b0c0a68cceb0a3ca.description: The Commander's Edition of Silent Hunter, a World War II US Fleet submarine combat simulator, compiling the original and three patrol disks, with fifteen additional scenarios and new patrol zones.
dos:b0c0a68cceb0a3ca.title: Silent Hunter

dos:b0c10e23cbf592b7.description: Control Thomas the Tank Engine on special trips such as taking children to the seaside, medicine to the hospital or delivering the mail, avoiding dead ends, level crossings and other trains. It is designed for ages 3 and up.
dos:b0c10e23cbf592b7.title: Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends

dos:b0c7931e168abafb.description: A baseball game with all 26 major league teams and full rosters, plus 1989 All-Star squads. It has one- and two-player modes and a password mode for playing a full season.
dos:b0c7931e168abafb.title: R.B.I. Baseball 2

dos:b0db374131ede860.description: The sequel to Bane of the Cosmic Forge. Your party of 6 leaves the fantasy realm for a sci-fi one, with new settings, monsters, strategies and alliances that shape the story.
dos:b0db374131ede860.title: Wizardry VII: Crusaders of the Dark Savant

dos:b0dce8871f64ec14.description: A turn-based real estate simulation from Blue Chip in which each turn is a month. Study market trends and buy and sell properties to get filthy rich.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Simulation; Strategy
dos:b0dce8871f64ec14.title: Baron: The Real Estate Simulation

dos:b0f42a8c31f95e63.description: An unfinished one-level demo of a top-down scrolling shoot-em-up in which enemy ships take many hits to die and move very fast.
dos:b0f42a8c31f95e63.title: Expunger

dos:b0fca62f971f67cc.description: A platformer based on the Hanna-Barbera cartoon, in which Huckleberry Hound, an amateur Hollywood actor, completes acts in Under World, Sea World, Canyon World and Sky World.
dos:b0fca62f971f67cc.title: Huckleberry Hound in Hollywood Capers

dos:b108b47477171fe0.description: Start a railroad with $100000 and design your own network moving people and goods across the country in 4 scenarios on two continents, using revenue to expand while appeasing stockholders.
dos:b108b47477171fe0.title: Sid Meier's Railroad Tycoon

dos:b10e9f75af345dd9.description: A rail shooter from Tynesoft set on a roller coaster covered in targets. The ride follows its path while you aim and shoot the targets, alone or cooperatively.
dos:b10e9f75af345dd9.title: Roller Coaster Rumbler

dos:b11fc15695f7deb0.description: A 370-point version of the original text adventure Colossal Cave Adventure by Will Crowther and Don Woods, developed in FORTRAN.
dos:b11fc15695f7deb0.title: Classic Adventure: The Original Colossal Cave!

dos:b12612d710a6e176.description: A computerized version of the card game Uno with the official rules, in which you play one computer opponent using keyboard keys to choose cards.
dos:b12612d710a6e176.title: Uno

dos:b1364e0d029f0db9.description: A shareware game in which Nicky Neanderthal hunts the dinosaurs in the area and gets back to his cave, scoring points for each dinosaur killed with a spear. He cannot pass through bushes or water.
dos:b1364e0d029f0db9.title: Dino Hunt

dos:b147bbe68babe1a2.description: An Infocom text adventure, an anthology of the Great Underground Empire, in which Megaboz's revenge sets the stage for the Zork series.
dos:b147bbe68babe1a2.title: Zork Zero: The Revenge of Megaboz

dos:b148706536d42b04.description: A text adventure in which the Federation of Earth sends you to Mars to secure the lost treasures of Aukbaa. Your fuel is depleted, and you must acquire the treasures and return home.
dos:b148706536d42b04.title: Red Planet

dos:b1496fda9bc522c0.description: A DOS shareware remake of Ms. Pac-Man with a Classic mode and an enhanced Champ mode, and a maze editor for making your own levels.
dos:b1496fda9bc522c0.title: CHAMP Ms. Pac-em

dos:b14fbd3ace6e9759.description: A Tetris variant in which you stack words rather than bricks, choosing the correct spelling from options with the left and right cursor keys.
dos:b14fbd3ace6e9759.title: Ortotris

dos:b156ffb6994312bb.description: An educational game in which the Berenstain Bears continue to teach young children in the second volume of Learning At Home.
dos:b156ffb6994312bb.title: The Berenstain Bears: Learning At Home, Volume Two

dos:b15bba6909f10b59.description: A simple chess game programmed by Ken Silverman of Duke Nukem 3D and Build engine fame.
dos:b15bba6909f10b59.title: Chess (1995)

dos:b1621f5485815f20.description: A wargame with three scenarios, including the German capture of Rostov in late 1941 and the Russian counteroffensive that recaptured it, and Operation Blau from June to August 1942.
dos:b1621f5485815f20.title: Rostov

dos:b171c8fd1c432361.description: A puzzle game by Anarchy Entertainment, similar to Too Many Geckos!, in which you rotate three-dimensional pyramids so the colored shapes on the pieces match.
dos:b171c8fd1c432361.title: Lynq

dos:b173771c5ccefba1.description: A first-person role-playing game in which the Avatar witnesses the kidnapping of Baron Almric's daughter, is blamed, and is thrown into the Great Stygian Abyss to find the girl or rot in the dungeon.
dos:b173771c5ccefba1.title: Ultima Underworld: The Stygian Abyss

dos:b17486c5d716fe57.description: A game set in August 1991, days before the USSR collapses. As KGB officer Maksim Rukov in Department P, you investigate KGB corruption and root out double agents, with an interface and engine based on Cryo's Dune.
dos:b17486c5d716fe57.title: KGB

dos:b17629cc2b04cc7d.description: Move a snake around the screen to eat rats for points, which are worth more as the snake moves faster and at higher levels. A watch in the corner means you must eat a rat before time is up.
dos:b17629cc2b04cc7d.title: EGA Snake

dos:b1789f3a12f2efb1.description: A Tetris clone. Turning sound on appears to stop input from responding.
dos:b1789f3a12f2efb1.title: Mega Tetris

dos:b17ad5ef255a16fe.description: A simple futuristic sports game like Marble Madness. Control a ball over a landscape to find a hidden puck and herd it back to your starting point, while a computer or human opponent tries the same.
dos:b17ad5ef255a16fe.title: Sliders

dos:b17dc6d5032c704d.description: A set of 16 games, 9 business tools and 4 other applications for the IBM PC to familiarize new users with a home computer. All use ASCII graphics and are accessed from three menus.
dos:b17dc6d5032c704d.title: FriendlyWare PC Introductory Set

dos:b185ae5b5c2fdd08.description: A creativity program published by Turner Interactive with Cartoon Network in 1995, hosted by Moxy, for making music videos from cartoon clips. It came with a bonus VHS tape.
dos:b185ae5b5c2fdd08.title: Toon Jam

dos:b191f16d12313621.description: A simple Arkanoid-style paddle game in which the ball cannot fall out of the screen.
dos:b191f16d12313621.title: Dia Bolo

dos:b19cc46b067e33dc.description: A remake of the 1986 isometric action adventure Batman with color graphics and sounds, renamed Watman. Assemble the hovercraft and rescue Robin in a batcave full of bizarre creatures and surreal rooms.
dos:b19cc46b067e33dc.title: Watman

dos:b1c1a0c95a06d253.description: An arcade action game of six levels in which you evolve from an amoeba to a human. In the amoeba stage, eat all the DNA while avoiding spores, microbes and antibodies.
dos:b1c1a0c95a06d253.title: Evolution

dos:b1cc52a2afefb358.description: Don Bluth's second Laserdisc conversion after Dragon's Lair. As Dexter, fight the madman Borf, who has kidnapped your girlfriend Kimberly and threatens the world with the Infanto Ray, which turns adults into children.
dos:b1cc52a2afefb358.title: Space Ace

dos:b1cdc5bde118d85e.description: A puzzle game in which you control a black orb in a labyrinth of 200 landscapes. The main task is to open oxyd stones by bumping them to uncover matching colored symbols, like a memory game.
dos:b1cdc5bde118d85e.title: Oxyd

dos:b1e4386efcc0fe06.description: A turn-based, command-driven strategy game in the mold of Star Trek. Command the star cruiser Illiad of the Consortium of Planets, protecting an 8x8 galaxy from the Kaons and Omegans.
dos:b1e4386efcc0fe06.title: Galactic Encounters

dos:b1e78d6bb0427366.description: As a noble ninja, prove the honor of the shogun Yuichiro by recovering a stolen sword from the evil Toranaga, walking from a village to a castle and fighting enemies and traps with martial arts.
dos:b1e78d6bb0427366.title: Sword of Honour

dos:b1f1924aaf684578.description: A round-based simulation of the Korean War, June 1950 to April 1951. Play Douglas MacArthur, commander of United Nations forces, or the Chinese general staff, managing the conflict at a limited level or escalating it.
dos:b1f1924aaf684578.title: MacArthur's War: Battles for Korea

dos:b1fd97b598347a21.description: A remake of an obscure 1983 game with new graphics, sound and music. Move a blue X called Zippy through a labyrinth of dangerous obstacles and dead ends in a maze that moves independently of you.
dos:b1fd97b598347a21.title: Splat! PC

dos:b2025c0020b1df29.description: An educational anatomy game set at the end of the 21st century, when infections resistant to conventional medicine plague humanity and you take missions inside the body.
dos:b2025c0020b1df29.title: Bodyworks Voyager: Missions in Anatomy

dos:b2129d70888d2d68.description: A versus fighting game set in China's Three Kingdoms era with sixteen heroes and three modes: Conquer China, Warriors Battle and Two-Player Match Ups.
dos:b2129d70888d2d68.title: Sango Fighter 2

dos:b224038150604240.description: The follow-up to Legend for the Amiga, an isometric 3D role-playing game in an Eastern setting. You control four characters, a Barbarian, Runemaster, Assassin and Troubadour, solving puzzles and conquering dungeons.
dos:b224038150604240.title: Worlds of Legend: Son of the Empire

dos:b235202b3e8e9661.description: A 3D racing game in which the Pod-People, an alien race stranded in an abandoned toy shop on Earth after their planet is destroyed, race.
dos:b235202b3e8e9661.title: Mag-Racer

dos:b237289faa1b6843.description: Create a fighter and take him to the top of the Heavyweight, Middleweight or Welterweight division. Before each fight you train for a set number of weeks, and the fights are viewed from the side.
dos:b237289faa1b6843.title: Star Rank Boxing II

dos:b237875c96be42ea.description: A short photographic point-and-click story about meeting Vida. Try different actions to advance the encounter, and an unsuccessful choice generally lets you try again.
dos:b237875c96be42ea.title: Vida

dos:b239e2ea1f9437fa.description: A platformer made for a marketing campaign for the Israeli snack Bamba, in which you play the snack's baby mascot collecting Bamba scattered around the Jungle and delivering it to animals, with a single course.
dos:b239e2ea1f9437fa.title: MsiBamba Shel Bamba

dos:b242098b63d39511.description: An empty house with nothing to manipulate, meant as sample code for Mr. Kenner's Adventure Game and Interactive Fiction Generator. It uses one-letter commands.
dos:b242098b63d39511.title: A Quick Run Around the House
