dos:b2422dff258b9d54.description: An educational game teaching logic and reasoning. In a mysterious castle, Mr. Winn says a treasure awaits at the top of a tower, but you must solve puzzles and riddles to climb its floors.
dos:b2422dff258b9d54.title: Mind Castle I

dos:b246599e76f978e1.description: A good-looking four-player take on Arkanoid, in which AI can control any of the paddles.
dos:b246599e76f978e1.title: Paddlers

dos:b2508275e04ba9af.description: A side-scrolling platformer loosely based on King Arthur's myth. You play Artura, son of the Pendragon, rescuing Nimue from your half-sister Morgause, fighting spiders and bats with an axe.
dos:b2508275e04ba9af.title: Artura

dos:b2524de7cadbd5b3.description: A strategic-level wargame of World War II in Europe, based on the Avalon Hill board game of the same name.
dos:b2524de7cadbd5b3.title: Third Reich

dos:b25fc36967e12d79.description: A small, witty text adventure with clever puzzles. You visit your friend John Baker, who is missing, and a blizzard rolls in while you wait.
dos:b25fc36967e12d79.title: John's Fire Witch

dos:b2699832c4681167.description: An educational game in which kids learn physics by steering a ball with four settings: gravity, friction, ball material and initial force. It looks like Marble Madness but is easier, with 5 levels of several rooms each.
dos:b2699832c4681167.title: The Wild Science Arcade

dos:b2701107fb53ae6d.description: A puzzle board game in which you swap tiles to line up same-colored sequences and eliminate them. Tile shapes vary from squares to triangles and hexagons, and a limited pocket supplies tiles.
dos:b2701107fb53ae6d.title: Swap

dos:b27c84da77bb6781.description: A single-player shareware mix of chess and wargaming played on a 20x50 board with three hundred pieces on each side, as the alien Tommy plays.
dos:b27c84da77bb6781.title: Tommy's Towers

dos:b297fc24dc105322.description: A platformer in which Spider-Man rescues Mary Jane from the villain Mysterio on a film set studio. Fight enemies and stun them with web.
dos:b297fc24dc105322.title: The Amazing Spider-Man

dos:b2ab39a7600d58f4.description: A squad-based tactical strategy game like the later X-COM, and sequel to Tegel's Mercenaries. Insect aliens called K'Kistiks are draining the Consortium's planets, and one last planet, Berok, remains.
dos:b2ab39a7600d58f4.title: Strike Squad

dos:b2af3749006c101f.description: The third Magic Candle top-down role-playing game, similar to the early Ultima games, with a more complex party management system that lets you divide your party and give each group tasks.
dos:b2af3749006c101f.title: The Magic Candle III

dos:b2bcf01d822f8339.description: A Pac-Man clone that encourages seeking a college degree: you collect A's instead of dots while avoiding monsters like Goofoff, Chicky, Boozer and Junky.
dos:b2bcf01d822f8339.title: Pac-Maine

dos:b2cc9a06a5801050.description: A versus fighting game set in 80,000 AD, when humanity has reached the peak of its evolution and faces de-evolution after mutations are introduced into the gene pool.
dos:b2cc9a06a5801050.title: Battle of the Eras

dos:b2cd8a7c556db5a2.description: A Gauntlet-style arcade game with text adventure elements, in which your bandit visits 16 worlds throughout time to grab as much loot as possible.
dos:b2cd8a7c556db5a2.title: Time Bandit

dos:b2d8d2941c59c98d.description: A children's story-builder that lets kids create magical stories with a click, with no computer knowledge needed. After selecting a word, the scene comes to life.
dos:b2d8d2941c59c98d.title: The Adventures of Nikko

dos:b2de798bcb088cca.description: A side-scrolling shooter in which you defend your colonies from waves of attacking aliens, with layered scrolling screens and new background artwork and enemies for each of 7 levels.
dos:b2de798bcb088cca.title: Revenge of Defender

dos:b2f5fd2442dc5b54.description: Drive a one-man tank through arctic, desert and urban environments, blowing up trees, buildings and walls. Enemies attack in tanks, planes, helicopters and on foot, and each weapon works best on a specific enemy.
dos:b2f5fd2442dc5b54.title: Mass Destruction

dos:b31b0d72755d7800.description: An adventure in which you play Jim, who must write his thesis.
dos:b31b0d72755d7800.title: Jim Quest 1: The Phantom Thesis

dos:b31d51f4f4ec16c5.description: A role-playing game with adventure and action elements. Your team of four spies, Kat, Tia, Roco and Mad Dog, must recover stolen documents from a fortified secret laboratory and escape alive.
dos:b31d51f4f4ec16c5.title: The Nine Lives of Secret Agent Katt

dos:b32ba20caedb9c0c.description: The second Leisure Suit Larry game. Larry Laffer, thrown out by his great love, is left with nothing and sets off looking for love again in several wrong places.
dos:b32ba20caedb9c0c.title: Leisure Suit Larry Goes Looking for Love (in Several Wrong Places)

dos:b332f81ddba9a511.description: The caveman-era platformer sequel to Prehistorik. Use your club on animal enemies that drop bonus items, with no required food target this time.
dos:b332f81ddba9a511.title: Prehistorik 2

dos:b335774d5ab4bca5.description: A Doom clone made with the Pie 3D Game Creation System. Escape a prison against grey-dressed guards, using guns, machine guns, bombs and lasers, and find keys to open doors or bomb them.
dos:b335774d5ab4bca5.title: Eternal Prison

dos:b341fc4cd1858764.description: A puzzle game in which you fill all squares of an 8x8 board with rectangular pieces having yellow or red sides, scoring as many points as possible.
dos:b341fc4cd1858764.title: Dimono

dos:b347ba5bb8555674.description: The sequel to Wizball. The screen doesn't scroll and you have full control of Wizkid, bashing him into bricks of different shapes and sizes.
dos:b347ba5bb8555674.title: Wizkid: The Story of Wizball II

dos:b348a6b0f0a10dcc.description: A Breakout-style game in which you clear levels by bouncing the ball back up against the blocks.
dos:b348a6b0f0a10dcc.title: Breakin

dos:b34b12bb0d234e1e.description: Pinball Dreams Deluxe, a compilation of 8 tables from Pinball Dreams and Pinball Dreams II, with a Hi-Res graphic mode that shows almost two thirds of a table on screen.
dos:b34b12bb0d234e1e.title: Pinball Arcade

dos:b359209964d562bf.description: An ASCII text-based air traffic control simulation in which each plane is shown as a letter and arrow, and a side list shows planes in your airspace. Guide airplanes safely to their destinations.
dos:b359209964d562bf.title: Air Traffic Controller

dos:b35935e7aa365da7.description: Pilot a starfighter on missions from locating lost artifacts to destroying the enemy in an early first-person space shooter.
dos:b35935e7aa365da7.title: Skyfox II: The Cygnus Conflict

dos:b35f1ac37d9cc418.description: An early Compaq-DOS demo suite, including Time to Play, a collection of games, along with a Biorhythms program.
dos:b35f1ac37d9cc418.title: Compaq-DOS

dos:b36440cc1274a818.description: An Infocom text adventure in which you are a backwater island's top diver and shipwreck expert, hired by shady characters to locate and salvage sunken treasure.
dos:b36440cc1274a818.title: Cutthroats

dos:b364a95c8817fd5c.description: An arcade-oriented baseball game, called TV Sports: Baseball in Europe, in which you pick from 26 teams and play as batter and pitcher. It includes a managerial element for full seasons.
dos:b364a95c8817fd5c.title: Bo Jackson Baseball

dos:b36653d015b1268b.description: The second in a little-known series of soccer management simulators. Pick one of eighty English teams to bring to League, FA Cup and European glory, and choose a coaching role of five.
dos:b36653d015b1268b.title: Tracksuit Manager 2

dos:b367de09906b3fc1.description: George, Lizzy and Ralph, turned into a gorilla, lizard and werewolf by an experiment, destroy buildings by smashing at them until they collapse, with up to 3 players. The police and army try to stop them.
dos:b367de09906b3fc1.title: Rampage

dos:b36aedfb0442085f.description: A role-playing game in which monsters plague the island nation of Yendor and nobles are near war, and the Society of Wizards aids a brave adventurer who must also recover the wizards' stolen orb.
dos:b36aedfb0442085f.title: Yendorian Tales Book 1

dos:b36edd51f7d4c3ca.description: A chess game from the Sargon series with variable move times from 5 seconds to infinity, move undo, side swapping and a search feature that displays its calculations.
dos:b36edd51f7d4c3ca.title: Sargon III

dos:b36ff04461eead93.description: A 2003 DOS port of the 1988 Irem arcade beat-em-up Vigilante.
dos:b36ff04461eead93.title: Vigilante

dos:b37814628f6c15eb.description: A short piece of interactive fiction in which the phone rings at 9:05 AM after a rough night and you must get up and get moving.

dos:b3868da8559364a6.description: Automotive advertisement software containing a nine-hole golf game based on the Buick Classic at Westchester Country Club. Aim with the arrow keys, change clubs, and use a two-touch power bar.
dos:b3868da8559364a6.title: Buick Dimensions (1990)

dos:b3872e594821b281.description: A wargame of Operation Barbarossa and the 48th Panzer Korps, the Fire Brigade. It recreates three dates in the attack, and you can play any of them from either side.
dos:b3872e594821b281.title: Fire-Brigade: The Battle for Kiev - 1943

dos:b3a1a9eab101e097.description: A strategy role-playing game based on TSR's Birthright world of Anuire. It combines first-person dungeon and castle quests, tactical real-time battles, and economic and diplomatic strategy.
dos:b3a1a9eab101e097.title: Birthright: The Gorgon's Alliance

dos:b3a805e2a86ae0b4.description: A demonstration in which your PC solves the classic problem of placing eight queens on a chessboard so no two attack each other, including the algorithm in Turbo Pascal code.
dos:b3a805e2a86ae0b4.title: Eight Queens

dos:b3b84a73a0e8d0c7.description: The Skweeks' pink land has been drained of color by Pitark, and you travel through 99 continents cleaning each one in sequence, moving Skweek in four directions.
dos:b3b84a73a0e8d0c7.title: Skweek

dos:b3b8b7bb0d778ece.description: The first Wizardry, one of the original dungeon crawlers. Create a party of up to six adventurers and send them into a 3D vector dungeon to fight monsters and find treasure in the domain of Trebor.
dos:b3b8b7bb0d778ece.title: Wizardry I: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord

dos:b3bb6193e425eb88.description: A simulation of the TV game show Now You See It. Players find answers hidden in a letter grid, and the first to 1000 points goes to the Championship Round.
dos:b3bb6193e425eb88.title: Now You See It

dos:b3c4206a8fed0409.description: A horizontally scrolling sci-fi shoot-em-up, the fourth installment of a Korean series. Choose between two pilots or have two players defend Earth against mechanical aliens.
dos:b3c4206a8fed0409.title: The Day 5: Assault Dragon

dos:b3d251908e62c110.description: A solitaire board game played with tiles, like Shanghai. Place all the tiles on the board following specific rules to obtain the highest score.
tags: Board Game / Party Game; Puzzle; Strategy
dos:b3d251908e62c110.title: Ishido: The Way of Stones

dos:b3e4c90bbf17cbe7.description: An interactive children's story following the fairy tale, in which you click around each scene of characters and animals, starting by meeting the miller's daughter, her father and the king.
dos:b3e4c90bbf17cbe7.title: Rumpelstiltskin's Labyrinth of the Lost

dos:b3e645140a74deeb.description: An arcade horizontal shoot-em-up in which you control Lieutenant Henry, with a second player as Sergeant Sanders in some versions, to save Earth from the mercenary invaders of Bozon.
dos:b3e645140a74deeb.title: Side Arms Hyper Dyne

dos:b3eeb4dbb77b1e9e.description: A falling-ball puzzle game in which you rotate clusters of colored balls and line up matching colors in horizontal or vertical lines. Finishing a stage unlocks a gallery image.
dos:b3eeb4dbb77b1e9e.title: X Rock

dos:b4024074b9bc3e71.description: A slot machine simulation. Start with 100 coins and bet 1 to 3 coins, then click the handle to pull it down. If you run out of coins you can start a new game.
dos:b4024074b9bc3e71.title: Vegas Bandit

dos:b40bc32136500674.description: A rare total conversion of Wolfenstein 3D with 3 new episodes, 2 new modes and modified weapons.
dos:b40bc32136500674.title: Beyond Wolfenstein 2: Special Edition v3.0

dos:b42fa30acf2e4192.description: The first Fire and Forget game from Titus, a racing game in which you complete courses around the globe by blowing up enemies and avoiding obstacles, with six courses in each level.
dos:b42fa30acf2e4192.title: Fire and Forget

dos:b431402fe1978f12.description: An action game in which one or two players choose among four characters, such as Thor the Warrior, and fight through 100 levels of hordes of enemies.
dos:b431402fe1978f12.title: Gauntlet

dos:b4366f15e07e45dc.description: An evil scientist has created rampaging monsters through genetic engineering, and you take back a chain of islands by breeding your own faster, smarter, more aggressive creatures in a lab.
dos:b4366f15e07e45dc.title: Unnatural Selection

dos:b4419e7c106a9843.description: The second expansion module for Temple of Apshai, which is required to play it. Set in ancient Egypt, the quest is to recover four treasures from four great constructs.
dos:b4419e7c106a9843.title: Dunjonquest: Curse of Ra

dos:b4504a2b7308fda7.description: A rare Spanish arcade game in which you play a chef with big eyes and a cap, first preparing and then defending your culinary masterpiece over four levels.
dos:b4504a2b7308fda7.title: Cocinero

dos:b455dfe1f9fc44ab.description: The first game based on the Spanish comic El Capitan Trueno, hero of the 12th century. It was released for the ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, MSX and MS-DOS.
dos:b455dfe1f9fc44ab.title: El Capitán Trueno

dos:b45634283cf4b6b1.description: A single-player shareware version of the children's card game Old Maid, played against the computer with a 52-card deck from which one queen has been removed.
dos:b45634283cf4b6b1.title: Tommy's Old Maid

dos:b45c02e4431e03cc.description: A maze game in which you navigate fifty stages, collect bonuses and use attacks to clear obstacles or stun enemies. It also offers competitive play for up to four players.
dos:b45c02e4431e03cc.title: Bomb'X

dos:b464b05c8a63ad72.description: A Korean educational game like Where in Time Is Carmen Sandiego?, in which a detective for a futuristic agency in 2010 pursues a criminal who escaped with a time machine through various time periods.
dos:b464b05c8a63ad72.title: Time Machine I

dos:b46d4555e56fdb27.description: A Breakout variant with special abilities such as releasing several balls or a ball that cuts through solid blocks, levels with teleporters and bumpers, and a training mode.
dos:b46d4555e56fdb27.title: Breakline

dos:b477a71cf7bcaf7e.description: A question-and-answer guessing game based on the TV show, played against the computer or another person. Questions come from a poll of 100 people, and you guess how many answered Yes or No.
dos:b477a71cf7bcaf7e.title: Card Sharks

dos:b47d9c150cefc8b8.description: The fourth Dizzy game. The land has been corrupted by an evil wizard, and Dizzy, the egg, walks, jumps and flips through many screens, picking up and using items and talking to people.
dos:b47d9c150cefc8b8.title: Magicland Dizzy

dos:b47ecda979c5a271.description: A fast-paced platformer starring Zool, a gremlin-like creature from another dimension who travels through six worlds of three stages each to earn the rank of Ninja.
dos:b47ecda979c5a271.title: Zool

dos:b499d2d005cc111a.description: A TV and movie trivia game for up to 14 individuals or teams.
dos:b499d2d005cc111a.title: TV and Cinema 101: Trivia from Talkies to Trekkies

dos:b49e9e60b3b2140f.description: In the age of King Arthur, a new knight proves himself by searching the kingdom for Excalibur and the Black Knight whose Dwarf minions stole it, in a platformer with hidden treasure troves.
dos:b49e9e60b3b2140f.title: Last Knight in Camelot

dos:b4ba1b70ab05aaf7.description: A side-view arcade game without scrolling, inspired by Underwurlde and Starquake. You control a tank-like robot that can split in two, with its head flying off on its own.
dos:b4ba1b70ab05aaf7.title: The Last Mission

dos:b4bb07000ec71e50.description: An unofficial English fan translation of a Polish adventure in which the friends Kajko and Kokosz face the Rogueknights and their plot to conquer the village of Mirmilowo, in a setting that resembles Asterix.
dos:b4bb07000ec71e50.title: Kajko i Kokosz

dos:b4c5cc9945b2bb4f.description: The war against the Kilrathi is going badly. As war hero Colonel Christopher Blair aboard the old carrier Victory, you lead the Confederation's last-ditch attempt to destroy the Kilrathi.
dos:b4c5cc9945b2bb4f.title: Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger

dos:b4c6e1eb33e828ac.description: An arcade-action math adventure in which you flip, jump, duck and shoot your way to defeat Apathy and return to Mt. Olympus, learning the Numbers of Light.
dos:b4c6e1eb33e828ac.title: Mathology

dos:b4c85791898b64cb.description: A text adventure sequel in which you use the components from part 1 to make a magical arrow to destroy Zerdon, the accomplice of the Wizard Akyrz.
dos:b4c85791898b64cb.title: Mysterious Adventure No. 4: Arrow of Death Part 2

dos:b4d452da0401b18f.description: A strategy game set in 16th-century Japan in which you conquer your opponent's cities on Honshu. Occupy all ten cities to win by forming armies to defend your five and attack theirs.
dos:b4d452da0401b18f.title: Conquest of Japan

dos:b4d9225df9707ccd.description: A seven card stud poker game from The WorkWare Co. in which you start with $500 and play against up to seven other players. Registering one game in the series gets you discs with all three.
dos:b4d9225df9707ccd.title: Poker Challenge: 7 Card Stud Version

dos:b511ec3828f86bd0.description: A sci-fi role-playing game in which you lead a team of high-tech mercenaries on dozens of missions in four star systems, with three real-time combat systems: deep space, atmospheric air combat and ground battles.
dos:b511ec3828f86bd0.title: Hard Nova

dos:b518c07fe209286c.description: A 2D action game set in 2040, in which a maintenance engineer sent by mistake to a desolate planet at the edge of the universe tries to earn his way home as humanity turns planets into hydroponic greenhouses.
dos:b518c07fe209286c.title: The Space Vegetable Corps

dos:b535561fa43007f4.description: A real-time strategy game focused on combat without base building. In 2045 terrorists seize an island in the Pacific, and a mercenary group called the Panic Soldiers is sent to drive them away.
dos:b535561fa43007f4.title: Panic Soldier

dos:b5399fa7c86554b1.description: An abstract puzzle game in which you set up a network of pipes so that a substance called flooz flows through as many as possible. Pieces are offered in random order in seven types.
dos:b5399fa7c86554b1.title: Pipe Dream

dos:b5438ed532761726.description: A one-on-one fighting game in which the Dalai Llama organizes a martial arts contest for animals of all species. You take on furry creatures, and finally the Dalai Llama himself, across mostly outdoor levels.
dos:b5438ed532761726.title: Brutal: Paws of Fury

dos:b54463c256c0d322.description: A random level generator for Doom and Doom II that usually creates levels of killing monsters and picking up health, weapons and ammunition before reaching the exit.
dos:b54463c256c0d322.title: DOOM: SLIGE

dos:b5460721babfbcf8.description: A product tie-in with Unilever's Peperami salami. In the town of Snackopolis, tension between cookies, vegetables and other snack creatures is rising before the mayoral election.
dos:b5460721babfbcf8.title: Animal

dos:b54edb0796ec57ab.description: A straightforward jet simulation with an open-ended mission, in which the primary role is Combat Air Patrol, and ground attacks are possible once enemy air cover is reduced. You can use wingmen.
dos:b54edb0796ec57ab.title: EuroFighter 2005

dos:b55fd7c654f29113.description: A fantasy adventure spoof with British humor. Choose between two protagonists, explore a nonlinear world, trade barbed dialogue with wandering characters and solve puzzles across several quests.
dos:b55fd7c654f29113.title: Kingdom O' Magic

dos:b56d13f7d711b69c.description: You and several unarmed friends cross treacherous landscapes to retrieve treasures stolen by the Evil Master. You carry a crossbow and shoot obstacles and enemies in your friends' way.
dos:b56d13f7d711b69c.title: Crossbow

dos:b571b4afed4adac5.description: The sequel to Rebel Assault. Starfighter pilot Rookie One answers a distress call from a freighter while scouting the Dreighton Nebula, where ships are known to disappear.
dos:b571b4afed4adac5.title: Star Wars: Rebel Assault II - The Hidden Empire

dos:b5722c4c1bd30632.description: A shareware game controlled by keyboard, mouse or joystick in which you spin a web and catch all the flies before they breed out of control. You can erase flies with the spider.
dos:b5722c4c1bd30632.title: Spider Web

dos:b57e2375563908f5.description: Get rich betting at the dog racing track. You start with $1000 plus half that in the bank, with three greyhounds in each race, betting on the winner only for a fixed 150% return.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Racing & Driving; Sports
dos:b57e2375563908f5.title: Grayhound Racer

dos:b58411fa1109bddb.description: An arcade game set in ImpArea, which is full of imps transporting the souls of sinners. You have a limited time to free as many lost souls as possible with your magic glass on a static screen.
dos:b58411fa1109bddb.title: ImpArea

dos:b58ae9b5a2d3ff8f.description: Ride an off-road bike through all the stages of the African trail. Choose three items of equipment before each stage, meet other riders who try to knock you off, and gauge your speed.
dos:b58ae9b5a2d3ff8f.title: African Trail Simulator

dos:b59909c31ebfc0f5.description: A Worms-like game in real time instead of turn-based. Each player picks 5 weapons out of 40, from pistols and shotguns to bazookas and cluster bombs, and can dig through mud and jump.
dos:b59909c31ebfc0f5.title: Liero

dos:b5a095fcb0f180c1.description: A single-player shareware backgammon game against the computer with three skill levels, a tournament mode, modem play and a score table, playable by keyboard or mouse.
dos:b5a095fcb0f180c1.title: PC-Gammon

dos:b5a37c66ceccc634.description: A severely ill man on the operating table is trapped in his own subconscious by a daemon named Emily. To escape he must find four orbs in Dali-influenced mini-games, in a game with action and puzzle elements.
dos:b5a37c66ceccc634.title: Weird Dreams

dos:b5a5de695dae1e2c.description: A Space Invaders clone in which you control a small space fighter to destroy lines of alien ships before they reach the bottom of the screen.
dos:b5a5de695dae1e2c.title: Clone Invader

dos:b5ac8e3b9f4c340e.description: Command the USS Columbia to stop warships from attacking Federation Headquarters in an ASCII space battle game where you must destroy all the warships.
dos:b5ac8e3b9f4c340e.title: Galaxy Trek

dos:b5b800e733f3673d.description: A Korean beat-em-up in which the peoples of the world have formed a peaceful Great Nation, but evil returns, so the president creates an elite police force of the world's strongest, most courageous fighters.
dos:b5b800e733f3673d.title: Cheon'gong Cheon'gi

dos:b5c482f19968155c.description: A text adventure in which a wealthy eccentric relative has died and his $7.4 million inheritance goes to whoever first finds his secret invention, with a cousin also searching for it.
dos:b5c482f19968155c.title: Storms I

dos:b5c5f526cf5e1463.description: A text-graphics remake of Pac-Man in which you eat dots in a maze while avoiding ghosts. Four flashing dots make the ghosts edible for shorter times on later levels.
dos:b5c5f526cf5e1463.title: MyMan

dos:b5d05df38307f140.description: An early adaptation of the TV game show in which you climb the pyramid by winning rounds. In each round you choose a category and give clues for words that share a common thread.
dos:b5d05df38307f140.title: The $100,000 Pyramid

dos:b5e2a3eff5ebeba2.description: A fixed-screen shooter with vector and bitmapped graphics.
dos:b5e2a3eff5ebeba2.title: BattleStar (1994)

dos:b5ec67ad3f33888e.description: A text adventure set in a collapsed world as the Federated Nations fall apart and rioters storm the Washington Monument. Only Doctor Virgil can save the world.
dos:b5ec67ad3f33888e.title: Mindwheel

dos:b5f5f0050d0557da.description: A simple head-to-head deathmatch between two spaceships. Choose two powerups such as missiles, shields and cloaking, then fight the computer or a human at difficulties from sitting duck to very dangerous.
dos:b5f5f0050d0557da.title: Thunder Zone

dos:b5f68573e70545d9.description: A puzzle game in which, as a hero, you collect all the hearts in each of 25 levels by solving puzzles such as turning blue hearts red and crossing water with limited blocks.
dos:b5f68573e70545d9.title: Hero's Heart

dos:b5fa58496783fe23.description: A role-playing game from MicroProse released the year of Darklands, with a 256-color VGA top-down view. As Prince of Alonia you control a party in the world of Nhagardia.
dos:b5fa58496783fe23.title: Challenge of the Five Realms

dos:b60c30821a275ca0.description: A virtual comic like They Call Me... The Skul. Five living suits of armor have invaded Earth, four set on destroying it and the fifth out to stop them, but it must first bond with a host.
dos:b60c30821a275ca0.title: The Suit

dos:b616d921a691d9e2.description: A role-playing game in which you are a Battlemage with the skills of a fighter, wizard and cleric, hired as a mercenary to repel an inhuman horde from the South on the islands of Argentan.
dos:b616d921a691d9e2.title: Ranadinn

dos:b6257fefb84144ba.description: A vertically scrolling action game in which you fly a jet up a river to destroy the enemy's bridges, while balloons, ships, choppers and aircraft try to stop you. Fly over fuel stations to refuel.
dos:b6257fefb84144ba.title: River Raid

dos:b63af55333a6eea6.description: Four indoor sports in DesignStar's SportTime line: ten-pin bowling, air hockey, darts and ping pong. Each has computer opponents at multiple skill levels plus human-versus-human and demo modes.
dos:b63af55333a6eea6.title: Superstar Indoor Sports

dos:b63fa6435c4e20ca.description: A Build Engine first-person shooter demo whose full game was never finished. You begin on Pymandros, captured by the Lesyrgian Troops who have come to regain the All-Father.
dos:b63fa6435c4e20ca.title: Fate

dos:b6418d02257ebeb0.description: A Columns clone from Uzbekistan, apparently made at the Tashkent State Technical University, in which you line up blocks of falling figures in three or more of one color.
dos:b6418d02257ebeb0.title: Line123

dos:b6424eb87e1e1a28.description: A freeware game in which you control a one-ton weight and crush as many of the people walking across the screen as possible by hitting them.
dos:b6424eb87e1e1a28.title: 1 Ton

dos:b64e80eb90fb68c9.description: A computerized checkers game in which you eat all the enemy pieces before your opponent does. You can choose your piece color, one of nine enemy levels, and a defensive or offensive strategy.
dos:b64e80eb90fb68c9.title: Dames Simulator

dos:b665ecc4d117dac3.description: Use the keyboard to match the space and color of objects on the screen.
dos:b665ecc4d117dac3.title: Animated Shapes

dos:b67523c7e1233f98.description: An adventure in which you make choices for the unlucky Beasley through his evening, where the right choice moves you on and the wrong choice is instant death.
dos:b67523c7e1233f98.title: Beasley's Deathtrap

dos:b6757f2063a32199.description: A poker game with a short guide to the basics, and the ability to play a single game or take part in a tournament.
dos:b6757f2063a32199.title: Championship Poker

dos:b67857a0555d4e43.description: A Color Lines-type puzzle game on a hexagonal cell board. Build straight lines of at least five identical fruits, which disappear from the board, as three new fruits appear each turn.
dos:b67857a0555d4e43.title: Funny Fruits

dos:b67cad912ef16a09.description: Six clans are at war in the land of Sorinor, each hiring mercenaries to kill opposing VIPs and protect their own. You are a mercenary commander winning battles as offense or defense, in a campaign or single missions.
dos:b67cad912ef16a09.title: Ambush at Sorinor

dos:b67d1db310c720e6.description: The third game in the Star Fleet universe, narrower in focus. You manage the planetary invasion forces of the Krellan Empire against the United Galactic Alliance, a bit like playing Empire in a sci-fi setting.
dos:b67d1db310c720e6.title: Star Legions

dos:b67f861eb52f1867.description: A simple fantasy first-person shooter in which a mage descends into the dungeons of Grelminar the Lich to kill him and save a man named Nemesis, with a chargeable fireball spell as his only weapon.
dos:b67f861eb52f1867.title: Catacomb 3-D

dos:b6818af6e42d7b83.description: A shooter in which chickens run onto the screen and you throw an unlimited number of bombs at them.
dos:b6818af6e42d7b83.title: Chickens

dos:b685968509773779.description: The sequel to Clonk, adding a strategy part to the melee rounds. Two to four players each lead troops of Clonks to conquer towns and castles on a hexagon map.
dos:b685968509773779.title: Clonk 2: Debakel

dos:b68aa99540a78dd2.description: As Rick Dangerous, stop the Fat Guy and his plan to help an alien race take over the world, through Hyde Park, Ice Caverns, Forest and Atomic Mines, solving puzzles and memorizing traps.
dos:b68aa99540a78dd2.title: Rick Dangerous 2

dos:b69326c872458e60.description: A flight simulation in which you fly mail runs from airports in one of 5 American states. It features VOR tower readings, DME and ILS.
dos:b69326c872458e60.title: Solo Flight

dos:b69d5519ba066be9.description: A German platformer with English support and no specific plot, in which you play a strange creature shaped like a purple ball on two thin legs.
dos:b69d5519ba066be9.title: Dreamworld Adventure

dos:b6a1f30f8b8114a7.description: Control a small frog jumping across lily pads toward his goal. The pads shrink and sink, new ones appear, and enemy bugs chase you; touching bad bugs or water means death.
dos:b6a1f30f8b8114a7.title: Toppler

dos:b6a775d036d76709.description: A Breakout variant with several different types of power-ups.
dos:b6a775d036d76709.title: Break It

dos:b6a7b44994061c10.description: A Concentration game about Moses and the Bible for one to three players, who match pairs of facedown cards. The player with the most pairs wins.
dos:b6a7b44994061c10.title: Moses Matchup

dos:b6b2ad8bafbd980f.description: An Eamon adventure in which a free-wheeling fantasy adventurer from the Guild of Free Adventurers undertakes dangerous quests on the world of Eamon to earn riches and experience.
dos:b6b2ad8bafbd980f.title: Eamon Adventure Disk 2: The Ice Cave

dos:b6b3142d39e280cc.description: The New Second Edition of the Wheel of Fortune game by ShareData, with more than a thousand new phrases to guess.
dos:b6b3142d39e280cc.title: Wheel of Fortune: New Second Edition

dos:b6b4257a3b3563cc.description: A post-apocalyptic adventure in which you play Raven, a psionic mutant Tuner working for the Tuner Netwerk, who witnesses the massacre of a village by Protozorqs and disobeys his orders.
dos:b6b4257a3b3563cc.title: Chamber of the Sci-Mutant Priestess

dos:b6b8983fe8254bb4.description: A real-time strategy game set in 16th-century Korea, where rival armies fight for supremacy. Food, wood and metal build structures and troops, and spare resources can be sold for money.
dos:b6b8983fe8254bb4.title: War Diary

dos:b6c8b0a375715834.description: A five-set tennis game against the computer or another player, with an isometric court, five skill levels and scoring that follows real tennis.
dos:b6c8b0a375715834.title: Grand Prix Tennis

dos:b6cc5d1be2863876.description: The sequel in the Test Drive series, driving exotic cars while fleeing police. It adds a true 3D engine, radio music, police evasion, instant replay, digitized dashboards and larger environments with multiple routes.
dos:b6cc5d1be2863876.title: Test Drive III: The Passion

dos:b6ccc192f65ab59c.description: A Centipede-style shooter in which your gun moves in the bottom section of a mushroom patch to defend it from a multi-segmented worm and other vermin.
dos:b6ccc192f65ab59c.title: Fuzzy Worm

dos:b6cf548e44f9cae8.description: A text adventure with graphics and Legend's verb-list interface. The player travels to six geographical locations in nine different time periods.
dos:b6cf548e44f9cae8.title: Timequest

dos:b6dfbdd8c47f29f5.description: An educational game in which a newly elected President asks you to run macroeconomic policy in Econoland by setting government spending, taxes and monetary policy for employment, stable prices and growth.
dos:b6dfbdd8c47f29f5.title: Econoland-2001

dos:b6e0b32cf601ffb6.description: Paragon's first commercial game, a side-view fighting game in which you defend your country from the evil forces of Sanjo with special weapons such as blinding powder, throwing stars and katanas.
dos:b6e0b32cf601ffb6.title: Master Ninja: Shadow Warrior of Death

dos:b6e37281d583e319.description: A sci-fi 3D chase-view shooter like Space Harrier. Control an armored mech on a hostile planet, flying or advancing on the ground to destroy or avoid mechanized enemies and traps.
dos:b6e37281d583e319.title: Izmir

dos:b6e41c93e02711aa.description: A game of detail observation and memorization with several modes that test skills related to detective work.
dos:b6e41c93e02711aa.title: Detective Academy

dos:b6edf840acb1c2b8.description: Richard Wong's version of Breakout for one or two players, in which two brick walls face each other.
dos:b6edf840acb1c2b8.title: Brickwar

dos:b6fcdb52b8159a6f.description: subLOGIC's advanced airline simulator in which you fly airliners such as the Boeing 737, 747, 767 or Airbus A320 among two dozen US airports with buildings in major cities and radio beacons.
dos:b6fcdb52b8159a6f.title: Flight Assignment: Airline Transport Pilot

dos:b70403cd1cf1ccb2.description: A compact Sokoban in a 1KB executable, with only 256 bytes of code and the rest level data. Written in assembly with ASCII graphics, you push boxes as an At-sign.
dos:b70403cd1cf1ccb2.title: Sokoban

dos:b714bbe990a1f8f1.description: A single-character fantasy role-playing adventure in a huge 40-level labyrinth. Use steel, magic and wit to defeat Shadow Weaver, the villain responsible for the evil.
dos:b714bbe990a1f8f1.title: The Summoning

dos:b7167c25c9fb4c27.description: Become the pirate Francis Drake and find the fabled Kristal of Konos to return it to its rightful resting place, with many added side adventures.
dos:b7167c25c9fb4c27.title: The Kristal

dos:b728da5c03d6bb51.description: id Software's compilation of additional Doom maps, the Maximum Doom collection, plus twenty new official stand-alone Master Levels from independent level designers.
dos:b728da5c03d6bb51.title: Master Levels for DOOM II

dos:b72c5de33a99ef3d.description: An early Nibbles clone for the IBM PC with ASCII graphics and three modes: single player, two players and versus computer. Eat randomly appearing food to grow while avoiding your own body.
dos:b72c5de33a99ef3d.title: John Chenault's Snake!

dos:b735d4bdd016305d.description: A surrealistic puzzle adventure released in only a few European countries, in which you are a young prince who must prove himself worthy of a throne left to him by the late king.
dos:b735d4bdd016305d.title: Blue Ice

dos:b73c08a6e8203e13.description: A point-and-click SCI remake of Sierra's 1987 AGI adventure based on Disney's The Black Cauldron.
dos:b73c08a6e8203e13.title: The Black Cauldron (2010)

dos:b74fb54ae5af837c.description: A mob game billed as officially endorsed by the Mafia. Play as the Godfather, femme fatale or the Killer, using mobsters to bribe, blackmail or fight against punks, cops, killers and rival gangs.
dos:b74fb54ae5af837c.title: Crime Does Not Pay

dos:b7537c946caa300a.description: In the far future, disputes between races are settled in CyberRace, an everything-goes series of sled races. You play Shaw, son of a champion killed in a suspicious accident, seeking to avenge him.
dos:b7537c946caa300a.title: CyberRace

dos:b75d71b3c385b68b.description: A matching game in which you match flags, and each wrong match lowers the flag on the pole.
dos:b75d71b3c385b68b.title: Find the Flag

dos:b75de5da78137e98.description: A text adventure in which the land of Pentari is in chaos after renegades take the Delphin Wizard's Guild. As a military captain you regain the city, free captured royalty and eliminate the insurgents.
dos:b75de5da78137e98.title: Pentari: First Light

dos:b76dc63fe59c88f2.description: A canceled add-on pack for Shadow Warrior later released as freeware, with a new 13-level single-player episode and three new Wang-Bang levels.
dos:b76dc63fe59c88f2.title: Twin Dragon

dos:b76f39bccf68ce91.description: An Artillery clone for one player against the computer or two players, one an IBM PC and the other a Mac, who take turns firing floppy discs at each other across a cityscape.
dos:b76f39bccf68ce91.title: ComputerWars

dos:b776ce398666b393.description: An educational title based on Richard Scarry's book, in which you explore the cartoon-animated town of Busytown, choosing places and characters to visit and practicing as you learn.
dos:b776ce398666b393.title: Richard Scarry's Best Neighborhood Disc Ever!

dos:b777f4d6d8ec6b12.description: Karn the warrior wields the Deathbringer Sword, which traps a demon, through 30 side-scrolling beat-em-up levels of interconnected stages with multiple exits.
dos:b777f4d6d8ec6b12.title: Deathbringer

dos:b788b9e0df55b56f.description: A Merchant Prince game in which you govern a 15th-century Italian city-state, dealing with nature's forces and competing against up to 5 other players.
dos:b788b9e0df55b56f.title: Santa Paravia and Fiumaccio

dos:b79173a7231e70f6.description: A NetHack variant based on NetHack 3.1.3 that adds new character classes, monsters and items, including Fire Mage, Ice Mage and Undead roles. The goal remains to retrieve the Amulet of Yendor.
dos:b79173a7231e70f6.title: NetHack Plus

dos:b7b458f39503af79.description: The only interactive game licensed by the Australian Rugby League, with 44 teams including both Origin teams, 20 ARL, 12 European and 8 international teams. It has play-by-play commentary by Ray Warren and Fatty Vautin.
dos:b7b458f39503af79.title: ARL 96

dos:b7b72d15c958575f.description: A single-player shareware pinochle game with three variations: the basic game, Kitty, where the highest bidder exchanges four cards, and Pass.
dos:b7b72d15c958575f.title: Pinocle Games

dos:b7beadb6d718a54b.description: A freeware remake of Star Castle. Control a small fighter and destroy a mighty battleship surrounded by three energy walls that constantly fires homing torpedoes at you.
dos:b7beadb6d718a54b.title: Star Castle PC

dos:b7cfe80950bc7b82.description: The sequel to BattleTech: The Crescent Hawk's Inception. In 3029, 19-year-old MechWarrior Jason Youngblood of House Steiner strikes back at the Draconis Combine, which captured his family.
dos:b7cfe80950bc7b82.title: BattleTech: The Crescent Hawks' Revenge

dos:b7d2a69772a7db98.description: Make your way through levels of a hostile Netherworld in a space ship, collecting diamonds against a time limit while dragons, moving mines and acid-spitting creatures attack.
dos:b7d2a69772a7db98.title: Netherworld

dos:b7d6408617e48a83.description: The fourth Quest for Glory. Having saved the world twice, you are magically transported from Tarna to Mordavia, a gloomy land full of charm and danger.
dos:b7d6408617e48a83.title: Quest For Glory IV: Shadows of Darkness

dos:b7e540bab0e16d04.description: The last of Access Software's Leader Board golf games before Links. Wind, snap and power matter as you avoid bunkers, water and rough, and a course editor is included.
dos:b7e540bab0e16d04.title: World Class Leader Board

dos:b7eab07469397112.description: The fourth Ultima, with color graphics and conversations with NPCs. Its story and goal are a radical departure from other role-playing games.
dos:b7eab07469397112.title: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar

dos:b7edb85bb96ae7b0.description: An Infocom text adventure in which you, a soldier of fortune marooned by your followers in the Egyptian desert, find a lost pyramid, enter its tomb and decipher its hieroglyphics.
dos:b7edb85bb96ae7b0.title: Infidel

dos:b7ef26fa268dbcb3.description: A coloring book in which you click on a color and then on the shape you want to paint.
dos:b7ef26fa268dbcb3.title: EGA Coloring Book

dos:b7f0134ee29dd712.description: A soccer management game that includes the rule changes introduced in World Cup 94. Updated squads let you change player ages, goals, caps and skills.
dos:b7f0134ee29dd712.title: Goal 94

dos:b7f1e7950929aa98.description: After rescuing the princess Ecstatica, our hero returns to find his village under dark spirits after a mis-cast spell shattered the holy seal that guards the secret of existence.
dos:b7f1e7950929aa98.title: Ecstatica II

dos:b7f48d7ba1ce0ba5.description: An Eamon adventure in which a free-wheeling fantasy adventurer from the Guild of Free Adventurers takes on dangerous quests in the world of Eamon.
dos:b7f48d7ba1ce0ba5.title: Eamon Adventure Disk 4: Quest For Trezore

dos:b80d3576f6129922.description: A collection of clones of Space Invaders, Pac-Man, Breakout and Tetris sharing one design, all played on a long horizontal rectangle.
dos:b80d3576f6129922.title: Rock Games

dos:b814e9058c7addf7.description: A tag-team wrestling game for one or two players, who assemble a two-man team from eight wrestlers such as Mr. Cool, Sgt. Slam, Tomahawk and Ninja on a static ring.
dos:b814e9058c7addf7.title: Take Down

dos:b8288f93530f5175.description: Six early learning mini-games teaching young users navigation, logic, counting and the alphabet. The game never criticizes mistakes, so children can experiment with the keyboard.
dos:b8288f93530f5175.title: Amy's First Primer

dos:b828b6cc95c87f6c.description: A type of Hangman using words in paragraphs instead of letters. Guess words to complete a paragraph.
dos:b828b6cc95c87f6c.title: Eclipse

dos:b829f3693062b23a.description: A shareware quiz game for up to four players with World War II questions. It is a trivia shell with three difficulty levels applied to the same question pack.
dos:b829f3693062b23a.title: World War II Trivia

dos:b82bb6d94e73f630.description: A colorful Korean platformer starring Eol, a cute yellow animal who must defeat a demon and his minions through linear stages, defeating enemies and bosses with his tail.
dos:b82bb6d94e73f630.title: Eol-ui Moheom

dos:b84e7b381982e3c4.description: A long-running chess program that started as software for dedicated chess machines and was released for the IBM at version 6, continuing into the mid 2000s.
dos:b84e7b381982e3c4.title: Rebel Chess

dos:b8523c690cdc91ef.description: A role-playing game set after Earth's destruction, in which the Avalon-cult flees to the distant planet Avalon, whose village is attacked by hundreds of strange creatures.
dos:b8523c690cdc91ef.title: Avalon

dos:b85aa82281727adf.description: A side-scrolling beat-em-up in which two heroes, the boy Ki and his sister Tia, fight villains screen by screen with martial arts, alone or with two local players.
dos:b85aa82281727adf.title: Fistfight

dos:b86067cbc192fd37.description: A football game with real teams and players, with friendly games, a world cup, league and knockout competitions, and two players, or up to four through a multitap.
dos:b86067cbc192fd37.title: 4-4-2 Soccer

dos:b8684a06bbdbca65.description: A simple Temple Software text adventure in which you explore a strange, mostly abandoned and rumored haunted prison to find treasure, with puzzles mostly of giving the right item to the right person.
dos:b8684a06bbdbca65.title: The Phantom's Revenge

dos:b86d98c5abcde421.description: An arcade shooter in which hamburger parts fly through the sky and you shoot them down and catch them in the correct order to make complete hamburgers.
dos:b86d98c5abcde421.title: Burger Blaster

dos:b8749af6da777829.description: A top-down role-playing game in a world of snow and ice. Create a character from classes such as Hunter, Healer and Bard, with statistics that increase as you play.
dos:b8749af6da777829.title: Aleshar: The World of Ice

dos:b87e687385c87771.description: A Blitz-style demolition game in which a bomber flies back and forth over structures, losing altitude with each pass. Time the dropping of bombs to destroy the buildings before it crashes.
dos:b87e687385c87771.title: PLEBS

dos:b883d9fff90e3a2b.description: Control a spaceship in deathmatches in an arena called Kraal, in gameplay that mixes Beamrider and Star Wars.
tags: Action; Flight Simulator; Shooter; Vehicle Simulation
dos:b883d9fff90e3a2b.title: Nihilist

dos:b89a897ff8bdc864.description: A vertical scrolling shooter in which you control an aircraft that can move forward, backward, left and right against a variety of enemy aircraft.
dos:b89a897ff8bdc864.title: BARQ: The Rise of Freedom

dos:b89b58966aca50f6.description: Two demons compete with two human champions over the magical realm of Xanth. One champion is Dug Mundane, a young man from our world who has just broken up with his girlfriend.
dos:b89b58966aca50f6.title: Companions of Xanth

dos:b89e5fb8ed8f4479.description: Set in 2765, when mankind has damaged Earth and hires the mechanic species Destragon to make a new planet habitable, promising them land in return, until the Destragon betray them.
dos:b89e5fb8ed8f4479.title: EXP: The Excellent Potato

dos:b8a0004b9eeebe0c.description: As a fly trapped in a maze, run through the passageways picking up the numbers that answer the math problem at the bottom of the screen, while a spider chases you. You can design your own maze.
dos:b8a0004b9eeebe0c.title: Math Maze

dos:b8a7668b74dcd99e.description: A Bomberman-like game with single player, cooperative and deathmatch modes, for up to four players on one computer with split screen. In story mode, defeat all the monsters to advance.
dos:b8a7668b74dcd99e.title: Dstroy

dos:b8b1a45372024368.description: An old-style Spanish combat platformer with adventure elements, released only in Spain.
dos:b8b1a45372024368.title: Fray Luis

dos:b8c3e1011983528e.description: An educational counting game for children in which you click a number in a table to answer each question. A wrong answer makes the program say Oooops and lets you try again.
dos:b8c3e1011983528e.title: Add It!

dos:b8ec65330794f191.description: Journey to the red planet Swandah to prove your worth as a galactic knight, in a Sword and Planet tale of a cursed underground maze of caverns defended by ancient monstrosities.
dos:b8ec65330794f191.title: Cold Dreams

dos:b8f069f639cd3b4b.description: The second Police Quest game, following Sonny Bonds after his promotion to the Homicide squad in the fictional town of Lytton, California in 1988.
dos:b8f069f639cd3b4b.title: Police Quest 2: The Vengeance

dos:b8fb5e5e594a60b3.description: A text-mode proof-of-concept inspired by R-Type in which a small triangular ship faces a swarm of stupid but dangerous green happy faces against a scrolling starfield.
dos:b8fb5e5e594a60b3.title: ANAL: The Rectum Adventure

dos:b8fe288b2fdcfbbc.description: Learn basic math by munching on multiples, factors, primes, equalities and inequalities while keeping your Muncher away from the Troggles.
dos:b8fe288b2fdcfbbc.title: Number Munchers

dos:b91b1998640ed8aa.description: Find and kill the evil Shalan deep in a dungeon, first confronting his minions, from skeletons to zombies who steal your belongings. A friendly boomerang sometimes helps.
dos:b91b1998640ed8aa.title: Dungeon of Shalan

dos:b92b8b4b54623e2d.description: Play a motorcycle stunt performer jumping over an increasing number of buses. Pick up speed on the way to the ramp and adjust your throttle.
dos:b92b8b4b54623e2d.title: Dare-Devil

dos:b943edf443fd3c3e.description: A variant of Angband influenced by Roger Zelazny's Chronicles of Amber, in which you descend the dungeon to face Oberon and then the Serpent of Chaos.
dos:b943edf443fd3c3e.title: Zangband

dos:b94497f58af4f043.description: The shareware version of Baron Baldric: A Grave Adventure, with three levels that are not in the 10-level registered game. The Baron explores crypts collecting treasure, food and flint for light.
dos:b94497f58af4f043.title: Baron Baldric: A Grave Overture

dos:b94d6d0a90e8a455.description: A fantasy game in which you play an apprentice food merchant traveling with four adventurers. Unlike other Infocom games, it needs no typing, offering multiple-choice actions.
dos:b94d6d0a90e8a455.title: Journey: The Quest Begins

dos:b951f62fa954000e.description: A side-view platformer, similar to Chuck Rock, in which a caveman marches through hostile prehistoric environments seeking food, which is mostly found on living animals, and keeping himself safe.
dos:b951f62fa954000e.title: Prehistorik

dos:b96705323511c005.description: The sequel to Solar Winds: The Escape. As bounty hunter Jake Stone, you escape your solar system through a strange portal after your Government leads you into a death trap.
dos:b96705323511c005.title: Solar Winds: Galaxy & The Escape

dos:b96945148bab5273.description: A stock market game with buying and selling shares, takeover bids, a money market, World Bank loans, insurance and taxation, in which you try to gain control of your chosen company.
dos:b96945148bab5273.title: City

dos:b96acf39df12faa4.description: Answer basic math questions to erase monsters and earn points.
dos:b96acf39df12faa4.title: Monster Math

dos:b97e8ae266abec5c.description: A real-time strategy game recreating the 1879 battle in which 137 men at the British outpost of Rorke's Drift repelled over 4,000 Zulu warriors. You pause to issue orders.
dos:b97e8ae266abec5c.title: Rorke's Drift

dos:b9852da2c1096c35.description: An action game starring Britain's Harrier VTOL aircraft. It uses the Rotoscape system, in which your plane is seen from above while the polygonal background rotates around it, and adds changing altitude.
dos:b9852da2c1096c35.title: Operation Harrier

dos:b98e16e0f4b06b8e.description: After defeating Lord Xeen, you find a magic pyramid among the ruins of Greyhaven that leads to Havec, a new world. The Dragon Pharoh sends you to see what threat lies on the other side.
dos:b98e16e0f4b06b8e.title: Might and Magic: Swords of Xeen

dos:b9974ca7f2ee9608.description: An educational game for preschoolers and children learning English. Panda Ping and a purple cuckoo named Cookies show you animals from four areas of the zoo, including the savanna.
dos:b9974ca7f2ee9608.title: Ping and Kookys Cuckoo Zoo

dos:b997d3e28a00b5f5.description: A rare text-based tank simulation that handles hex-style wargame elements entirely through text.
dos:b997d3e28a00b5f5.title: Battle Tank: Kursk to Berlin

dos:b9a64e8858f1ac47.description: A horizontal shooter sequel in which a monkey now throws cherries instead of bananas.
dos:b9a64e8858f1ac47.title: Sibal Monkey Adventure 2

dos:b9ab7a73cb1ef7b3.description: A walk-and-shoot game following the movie series. Over five levels, one per decade from the 1940s to the 1980s, work your way up the Corleone family and destroy rival families.
dos:b9ab7a73cb1ef7b3.title: The Godfather

dos:b9c098b1cbeca23d.description: A word and vocabulary learning game for ages 8 and up. Enter the Word Wizard's castle and take on quiz challenges by clicking parts of each room, against a clock that rewards correct answers with bonus time.
dos:b9c098b1cbeca23d.title: Mind Castle: The Spell of the Word Wizard

dos:b9c1c45968c32a45.description: An action flight game set in World War I. As a young pilot whose base is attacked by Germans, find the source of the attacks by shooting down every German plane, with the story told in live-action cutscenes.
dos:b9c1c45968c32a45.title: Wing Nuts: Battle in the Sky

dos:b9cb3f7bda4241cb.description: Count Chuck has kidnapped the world's animals, including Johnny Dash's dog Tex, and Johnny enters the Night World with a slingshot to save him from skeletons, zombies and severed hands.
dos:b9cb3f7bda4241cb.title: Monster Bash

dos:b9d6757b311b6767.description: You play a raptor, a futuristic thief who raids untouched ancient archaeological sites. The supposed home of the Holy Grail has been partially unearthed in northern Scotland, and you go in to raid it.
dos:b9d6757b311b6767.title: Azrael's Tear

dos:b9e9cc398cc9b044.description: Pit historic and legendary baseball teams from 1901 to 1989 against each other with accurate rosters and stats. It plays like a strategy game with ASCII graphics and chance rolls.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:b9e9cc398cc9b044.title: Budget Baseball

dos:b9ec6768722690df.description: A BBS door adaptation of Legend of the Red Dragon with even more silliness, in single-key menu-driven fantasy adventure and combat, building stats toward a showdown with the Red Dragon.
dos:b9ec6768722690df.title: Bazooka of the Red Dragon

dos:b9f0903890d6efb3.description: A re-release of Fighter Duel with improved flight models, 9-player IPX network play, radio chat, extra planes, expanded video card compatibility and force feedback joystick support.
dos:b9f0903890d6efb3.title: Fighter Duel: Special Edition

dos:b9fda0ebc1ccdcf2.description: The original future sport game, played on a small court with five players per team. Throw the ball into the opponent's goal with unlimited physical contact and no illegal moves; you can bribe before each match.
dos:b9fda0ebc1ccdcf2.title: Speedball

dos:ba0168dae1a516ba.description: A slot machine simulation in which you throw coins in and complete the CASH'n'GRAB feature by collecting numbers, and can then choose from bonuses like Pick a Win, Fruit Step and Win Spins.
dos:ba0168dae1a516ba.title: Arcade Fruit Machine

dos:ba02c661ffcbdcc0.description: A BBS door game in which a detective searches for a missing princess and a mysterious relic. Repeated rounds of short minigames build the score needed to complete the investigation.
dos:ba02c661ffcbdcc0.title: The Legend of the Purple T♥t

dos:ba051bd86aa0bc54.description: A 2D shooting gallery based on the 1990 film, from Grandslam.
dos:ba051bd86aa0bc54.title: Die Hard 2: Die Harder

dos:ba07dc2bbe0205ef.description: An Othello variant played with little aliens on an 8x8 board in which you place aliens in turns, flipping enemy aliens between your pieces, to have the most when the match ends.
dos:ba07dc2bbe0205ef.title: Kengi

dos:ba10b1fbd4b6c96d.description: An airline flight simulation with totally rewritten flight models of the MD-83, MD-88 and B747-400, based on true inertia, airflow calculations and detailed forces down to tyre deformations.
dos:ba10b1fbd4b6c96d.title: Airline Simulator 2

dos:ba1e1f07eec2f496.description: A 3D fighting game like Virtua Fighter. Choose one of eight comic book style characters, each with special moves and its own planet with flying camera perspectives.
dos:ba1e1f07eec2f496.title: FX Fighter

dos:ba22ab2916d8d2c7.description: A rally simulator in which you control the state of the car, such as gasoline, water and damages, and the race route, refueling and buying supplies from powerboats in Europe or tankers in Africa.
dos:ba22ab2916d8d2c7.title: Paris-Dakar

dos:ba3e6339e4705a02.description: A word-guessing game based on the paper and pencil original for at least two players. Guess letters in blank spaces, and each wrong guess adds to a drawing of a hanged man.
dos:ba3e6339e4705a02.title: Hangman!

dos:ba496109b4cec2f8.description: You are the captain of the Final Impact squadron as the alliance of hostile aliens, the Xarras, conquers the Core sector. Perform 11 missions to defeat them, choosing one of three spaceships and your equipment.
dos:ba496109b4cec2f8.title: Final Impact

dos:ba5789fc7ff47261.description: A single-player action and strategy game in which you lead a raid on the palace of the Dragon King, fighting through its eight floors with your white soldiers against colored enemies.
dos:ba5789fc7ff47261.title: Tommy's Palace

dos:ba5b6d3e27bbc0ea.description: A large, detailed adventure based on Lewis Carroll's novel that lets you experience Alice's dream.
dos:ba5b6d3e27bbc0ea.title: Wonderland

dos:ba68bd28e01e053d.description: A murder mystery in which Professor P. U. Plum, curator of the Calhoon Museum, is found dead in the Dome Room, and you, Inspector Claude la Mort of the Surete, investigate who killed him and why.
dos:ba68bd28e01e053d.title: Murder in the Museum

dos:ba78ddcdb29b2358.description: A DOS port from MSX of the sequel to Yie Ar Kung-Fu by Friends Software, released the year of the original.
dos:ba78ddcdb29b2358.title: Yie Ar KungFu 2

dos:ba8088cdb1f44bc4.description: The sequel to Winter Challenge with 8 summer events from athletics to cycling, including a downhill kayak run where you navigate gates and avoid the stream's margins.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Olympiad
dos:ba8088cdb1f44bc4.title: The Games: Summer Challenge

dos:ba8093ca3c1c2f7d.description: A role-playing game that looks and feels like Ultima V, made by someone who loved the series and borrowed its graphics but none of its code.
dos:ba8093ca3c1c2f7d.title: Fake Ultima

dos:ba85eadf5008b83f.description: The first construction set game. Build a pinball table by dropping parts onto it, alter gravity, bounce, kick and speed, paint backboards, wire targets for specials and save your creations.
dos:ba85eadf5008b83f.title: Pinball Construction Set

dos:ba88441e6c10ac5d.description: A college basketball simulation like NFL Challenge, with real players of its time on twenty teams with made-up names. Play single matches between two humans or against the AI.
dos:ba88441e6c10ac5d.title: Basketball Challenge

dos:ba8d0341059cd3f4.description: A shareware 3D maze exploration game. Find and collect five gold coins on each level to leave the maze; the shareware version has one maze and the registered version five.
dos:ba8d0341059cd3f4.title: Lost (Digital Reality)

dos:ba9796b36ac24522.description: A TADS remake of the first major adventure game, Colossal Cave, with a modern parser, expanded location descriptions and more.
dos:ba9796b36ac24522.title: Colossal Cave Revisited

dos:ba9e7c8cb155eb3f.description: The successor to Pinball Fantasies with an upgraded engine. Tables include Babewatch, Law & Justice, Extreme Sports and, on CD versions, The Vikings, with ramps, bonus areas and combos.
dos:ba9e7c8cb155eb3f.title: Pinball Illusions

dos:ba9fbdca4068a027.description: A keyboard-controlled tile matching game in which three-colored bricks fall from the top of the screen and you create horizontal, vertical or diagonal strings of three or more of the same color to explode them.
dos:ba9fbdca4068a027.title: Fallout (1990)

dos:baa540c3d7564110.description: Goofy and Mickey are railroad conductors helping young children identify colors and shapes as a train crosses colorful landscapes, with its smoke stack producing shapes such as squares, circles and triangles.
dos:baa540c3d7564110.title: Goofy's Railway Express

dos:baac6eeea7822c6f.description: A football simulation with real players and stats representing 5 years of statistics, including injuries, substitutions and trades, which you can also change by creating your own roster.
dos:baac6eeea7822c6f.title: Microleague Pro Football 4.0

dos:baaf4cb6d363d436.description: The third Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective, in which you solve three crimes by visiting locations, listening to dialogue and reading mock London newspapers, then present your case in court.
dos:baaf4cb6d363d436.title: Sherlock Holmes: Consulting Detective Volume III

dos:bac33b65bff11093.description: The third installment of a Korean series of horizontally scrolling sci-fi shoot-em-ups, in which Captain Lee and his friends again stop an army of mechanized creatures from destroying Earth.
dos:bac33b65bff11093.title: The Day 4: Icarus

dos:bad277e6aa7d9bd6.description: Trapped in the Enchanted Forest, you use a magic wand to shoot sparks at insects attacking in continuous waves, in a version of Centipede.
dos:bad277e6aa7d9bd6.title: Centipede (IBM)(1983)

dos:bad70ea94a46b6b6.description: A text-based American football game pitting a human player's team against the computer. Each side picks a play from eight offensive and five defensive options.
dos:bad70ea94a46b6b6.title: Football (1983)

dos:bae2e4a2fc293c11.description: Play a scientifically engineered creature that transforms into four physical states, from a floating cloud to a heavy solid that bursts through parts of the world, using limited transformations to complete levels.
dos:bae2e4a2fc293c11.title: MegaMorph

dos:baf6f7a84f837638.description: A puzzle game in which you steer a small white dot with the numeric keypad, crashing into blue balls that appear randomly to earn points.
dos:baf6f7a84f837638.title: Blue Balls

dos:baff8cd1cc6b477f.description: A repackaging of JetFighter III with the Enhanced Campaign CD, a mission editor, new missions and additional scenery, known for detailed and expansive terrain.
dos:baff8cd1cc6b477f.title: JetFighter III Platinum

dos:bb0a024572244450.description: A spirit board simulation, like DaSi and Taboo before it, in which you type questions and the planchette answers by spelling out words.
dos:bb0a024572244450.title: Phoenix Fire

dos:bb1b0b93c10e3fe2.description: A first-person role-playing shooter in which the knight Grondoval travels to the Island of Char, where the witch Illwhyrin has cast a curse of never-ending darkness on his homeland and built her lair, Witchaven.
dos:bb1b0b93c10e3fe2.title: Witchaven

dos:bb42d04f84f05583.description: A difficult turn-based Sokoban-like puzzle game in which you push boxes onto storage spots, with four kinds of blocks plus conveyors, unstable passages and wraparound screens, in several dozen puzzles.
dos:bb42d04f84f05583.title: Block-O-Mania

dos:bb477360226e97fa.description: The sequel to Street Fighter II Turbo, with four new characters and stages for sixteen playable fighters and many multiplayer modes, including an elimination group battle.
dos:bb477360226e97fa.title: Super Street Fighter II

dos:bb4835b6e9edbfeb.description: The deluxe edition of the Jeopardy! quiz show game.
dos:bb4835b6e9edbfeb.title: Jeopardy! Deluxe Edition

dos:bb4d53ae1f3d3be4.description: A free text-mode Centipede clone in Pascal. Fire ASCII arrows from a gun moving along a narrow band at the bottom of a mushroom-littered field full of bugs.
dos:bb4d53ae1f3d3be4.title: Bugs!

dos:bb62f79da2a0609c.description: The sequel to Castle of Dr. Brain. Tour the Island of Dr. Brain to find a battery for his experiment, solving a plethora of puzzles, before his rival scientist beats you to it.
dos:bb62f79da2a0609c.title: The Island of Dr. Brain

dos:bb713f48bcef53e3.description: In the 1940s the Nazis built a base on the moon and plan to use a substance called Lunarium to reduce people's intelligence. You are sent back in time with a jet-propulsion backpack to change the result of the war.
dos:bb713f48bcef53e3.title: Rocket Ranger

dos:bb720c13809557f0.description: Fly the McDonnell Douglas AH-64A Apache attack helicopter over various locations, or in target practice and combat modes. Two players can compete via modem.
dos:bb720c13809557f0.title: Sierra's 3-D Helicopter Simulator

dos:bb739fd247307106.description: A freeware adaptation of Mastermind in English and Norwegian, in which you guess a 4-peg color combination from black and white key peg hints. It allows from 4 to 10 colors, repeated or not.
dos:bb739fd247307106.title: MasterMind (1989)

dos:bb7dd40baab48469.description: A Korean sci-fi horizontally-scrolling shoot-em-up in which you pick one of two spacecraft to cross hostile areas, with weapon upgrades, shields and weapon-switching orbs, like Thunder Force IV.
dos:bb7dd40baab48469.title: Illusion Blaze

dos:bb8ee671a530aef7.description: The first computerized version of Jules Verne's novel, mixing action and adventure with action-oriented mini-games. You are a scientist out to prove Arne Saknussem's scroll true.
dos:bb8ee671a530aef7.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth

dos:bb9ed97b71887c04.description: A Street Fighter-like fighting game in which you choose a fighter and travel around the world to challenge many others. Fighters can refill their health and have super moves.
dos:bb9ed97b71887c04.title: Tough Guy

dos:bba3023f38c3f080.description: A platformer in which Monte Carlo, the ruler of Transylvania sealed away centuries ago, is growing free as the seal weakens, monsters appear and young girls disappear from the villages.
dos:bba3023f38c3f080.title: Rusty

dos:bba3176b0c48f408.description: After a nuclear holocaust in 2005, survivors live on the island of Quarea, ruled by demons whose pure evil leader Arrut Loopaz lives in the forbidden ruins of Detritus. You play Nikki.
dos:bba3176b0c48f408.title: Detritus: The Daemons Quest

dos:bba3cf1c85ed07e0.description: A 2D platformer based on Peyo's comic, with two game modes. In the first, a Smurf must save Smurfette from Gargamel's clutches, using a teleportation spell found by Papa Smurf.
dos:bba3cf1c85ed07e0.title: The Smurfs: The Teletransportsmurf

dos:bbc2c66d2525a5d2.description: A Concentration game on an 8x5 board of 20 pairs of tiles. All faces are shown briefly, then hidden, and you uncover two tiles per move to match pairs and clear the board.
dos:bbc2c66d2525a5d2.title: Memory

dos:bbc2d7cc9f17376b.description: An adaptation of Gridrunner in which you defend Earth from space worms that attack the Solar System's planets. Your ship moves about the bottom rows of a grid and fires only upward.
dos:bbc2d7cc9f17376b.title: Worm Burner

dos:bbc3286c86591f1e.description: A board-puzzle game with a story. As a money collector, you must collect money bags lost around the city and deliver them to banks quickly before thieves get there.
dos:bbc3286c86591f1e.title: Solver: The Bank Quest

dos:bbdb08b7eca9c339.description: You are Adol Christian, a red-haired swordsman sent by a fortuneteller to find information about the six books of Ys, which sealed the secret of an ancient land.
dos:bbdb08b7eca9c339.title: Ys: The Vanished Omens

dos:bbe51a62ee3c5266.description: Play or manage greatest teams ever from 1901-1968 or the best of each team, with 2000 players each ranked in 134 categories. You can create your own teams and leagues and set how computer managers manage.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball
dos:bbe51a62ee3c5266.title: Tony La Russa Baseball II

dos:bbebf19e10cad9ca.description: A remake of the trading simulation Merchant Prince in which you lead one of the most influential families of 14th-century Venice, based on Machiavelli's book The Prince.
dos:bbebf19e10cad9ca.title: Machiavelli The Prince

dos:bbedf448c0ed21a0.description: A role-playing game in which private investigator JR Knight and his companion Faythe investigate gang activity in Cobra City, exploring districts, gathering clues and fighting in real-time mouse-controlled battles.
dos:bbedf448c0ed21a0.title: Cobra Mission

dos:bbf2cc3eb17fb405.description: A shareware single-player puzzle game on a six by six grid with some shaded squares. Clear all the squares in the fewest possible moves by selecting cells.
dos:bbf2cc3eb17fb405.title: Tommy's Nite Lites!

dos:bc09c18cc1b0ecfd.description: GameTek's conversion of the 1980s game show Hollywood Squares. Two contestants play tic-tac-toe with celebrity squares, agreeing or disagreeing with the celebrity's answers.
dos:bc09c18cc1b0ecfd.title: Hollywood Squares

dos:bc0cc9fd27a35777.description: The alien meat-supplier Zlarg for the fast-food chain Orion Burger plans to use humans as the raw material for burgers, and you set out to stop him.
dos:bc0cc9fd27a35777.title: Orion Burger

dos:bc2059c08daebec0.description: Set a year after Ultima VII, when Lord British's castle is encased in a gem of blackrock by the Guardian during a feast. The Avatar must find a way to deal with it.
dos:bc2059c08daebec0.title: Ultima Underworld II: Labyrinth of Worlds

dos:bc2eff7af057e273.description: A simple arcade game in which you control a small spacecraft and destroy the flying saucer of aliens in a space sector assigned in a briefing before each mission.
dos:bc2eff7af057e273.title: Spacecutter

dos:bc305d566745f00f.description: Extend an oil-mining robotic arm deep below the earth's crust to mine oil while avoiding monstrous bugs, which cost you a life if they touch the arm.
dos:bc305d566745f00f.title: Oil's Well (1984)

dos:bc35b08f0b1a8488.description: Set in 1800, command one of five factions vying for control of India. Territories generate taxes you spend on hiring troops and improving the military, industry or law and order.
dos:bc35b08f0b1a8488.title: Champion of the Raj

dos:bc36dad82af40939.description: Command a five-person treasure hunting team searching underwater sites for sunken treasure and artifacts, training your crew for roles such as divers who avoid sharks and scientists.
dos:bc36dad82af40939.title: Sea Rogue

dos:bc3afa1cc3b3552d.description: A single-player escape-the-maze game in which you are a hero taken prisoner by the nation of Markana and left alone in their trap and puzzle-laden maze, which they believe is impenetrable.
dos:bc3afa1cc3b3552d.title: Escape from Markana

dos:bc3b4bde3751bab7.description: An X-Men game set in the Murderworld amusement arcade. Magneto and Arcade have kidnapped Professor X, and the X-Men must rescue him, combining action and adventuring skills.
dos:bc3b4bde3751bab7.title: X-Men: Madness in Murderworld

dos:bc5737bf66f0f601.description: A game developed for an interactive TV game show similar to the Danish Hugo show, in which candidates at home controlled the hero Coba by phone in several minigames.
dos:bc5737bf66f0f601.title: Coba on the Run 1

dos:bc687e0393d7d478.description: Man an advanced helicopter and shoot at humanity's problems across five unrelated levels of two stages each, such as destroying drug plants in South America or dealing with terrorists at sea.
dos:bc687e0393d7d478.title: Fire!

dos:bc6bd9a4b49def9f.description: A Mahjongg variant in which you remove tiles with the same marks until the board is empty. Tiles can be eliminated when they are projected on the same line with no tiles between them.
dos:bc6bd9a4b49def9f.title: Turn It

dos:bc70292782fb62c4.description: A simple two-player tactical combat simulation on a hex grid set in the Cold War, with six Soviet units attacking three cities defended by four US units.
dos:bc70292782fb62c4.title: Combat: Conflict Simulation

dos:bc720caca94d6a3e.description: The sequel to the arcade driving simulator Hard Drivin'. Complete laps of three courses, including the Hard Drivin' track, before a timer expires, with checkpoints adding time.
dos:bc720caca94d6a3e.title: Race Drivin'

dos:bc84edda4e14e428.description: You control a battle tank, the Rotor, hovering in a 2D labyrinth with heavy gravity. Any contact with walls or enemies is deadly, so you rotate it freely and use an afterburner to maneuver.
dos:bc84edda4e14e428.title: Rotor

dos:bc966842d9a1fa8b.description: A single-player shareware adventure based on the 1992 Los Angeles riots, set in a DOS window. You start at a motorway junction outside the city and pick an attitude with which to approach the situation.
dos:bc966842d9a1fa8b.title: Angst: A Game of Urban Survival!

dos:bc9923e2fcb3cbcd.description: A real-time strategy game in which you start with a few Baldies and build structures, increase your population and create weapons. There are four classes: builders, scientists, soldiers and workers.
dos:bc9923e2fcb3cbcd.title: Baldies

dos:bc9a16695611f019.description: A collection of mini-games starring ALF, the wise-talking alien who crash-landed on Earth, in a party theme.
dos:bc9a16695611f019.title: ALF's Party Kit!

dos:bca843a26546a5ba.description: A pinball simulation on a table called The Web. With three flippers, send the ball into openings, trapdoors and ramps for bonuses such as multiball, and some targets activate special missions.
dos:bca843a26546a5ba.title: Pro Pinball: The Web

dos:bcb0ee3b662d622a.description: The sequel to Infiltrator, in which you infiltrate an enemy compound on foot or fly missions in an attack helicopter. Enter huts to retrieve weapons and information.
dos:bcb0ee3b662d622a.title: Infiltrator II: The Next Day

dos:bcb45e3f8e9cd60a.description: A simple Rogue-like role-playing game in which you enter a multi-level dungeon and return with a valuable treasure, fighting, bribing or evading enemies along the way.
dos:bcb45e3f8e9cd60a.title: Warrior of Ras: Volume One - Dunzhin

dos:bcbb5e2bb732f8b8.description: Extinguish all the flames in a building by forming groups of five or more connected water droplets of the same color as the flames.
dos:bcbb5e2bb732f8b8.title: Conflagration

dos:bccb8a6b4ee2021c.description: A wargame simulating the Battle of Gettysburg, July 1-3, 1863. Command Union or Confederate forces, play two-player, or watch the computer play both sides.
dos:bccb8a6b4ee2021c.title: Gettysburg (1990)

dos:bcd3f9ba70462dec.description: A spelling game for children in which you control Muscle Pete, walking across the floor to touch the letters that spell objects shown on screen.
dos:bcd3f9ba70462dec.title: Muscle Pete's Spell Off

dos:bcfb926b365c6c68.description: A remake of Lode Runner in which other men try to steal your gold. Collect all the gold bricks and climb the stairs to the top to win.
dos:bcfb926b365c6c68.title: Lode Runner Live

dos:bd06f1ed18b24c18.description: Build a great galactic empire protected by a huge frontier shield by completing missions, trading with starbases and fighting off invading aliens. The ship is flown top-down with gauges for energy, temperature and radiation.
dos:bd06f1ed18b24c18.title: Empire!

dos:bd260dcd201232ca.description: A real-time adventure in which you are a prisoner in a jail guarded by droids on day and night patrol, and must find your way out of a labyrinth, bashing doors, as your health decreases.
dos:bd260dcd201232ca.title: Eden Blues

dos:bd2f6cfc4ffaf3f1.description: An artillery game inspired by Gorillas with warring rats, who lob fiery death at each other in a dispute over a warehouse full of restaurant supplies.
dos:bd2f6cfc4ffaf3f1.title: Ratillery

dos:bd332d4edd6b4523.description: A collection of simple children's games, including Rock Paper Scissors, 23 Matches, where whoever takes the last match loses, and a Connect Four variant.
dos:bd332d4edd6b4523.title: Tommy's Trifles

dos:bd3757a9ba52dd3c.description: After crash-landing a UFO, Leonard and Bubba fight their way back to Hickston. This standalone sequel adds vehicles, weapons and enemies across fourteen first-person shooter levels.
dos:bd3757a9ba52dd3c.title: Redneck Rampage Rides Again

dos:bd57a536d964ca85.description: A 3D dungeon crawler tribute remake of Mazzembly, starring the aspiring demoscener Demulamu touring a virtual reality demo party to gain fame, with randomly generated levels.
dos:bd57a536d964ca85.title: Mazzembly 3D

dos:bd616f73a72e02df.description: An amateur clone of the Amiga game Alien Breed by one-person Crowfoot Software, released in 1997.
dos:bd616f73a72e02df.title: Alien Assault (1997)

dos:bd6a9f27e0fb1f1f.description: subLOGIC's simple flight simulator offering free flight and over 200 flight assignments for beginner pilots, with five small aircraft including the Cessna CitationJet.
dos:bd6a9f27e0fb1f1f.title: Flight Light Plus

dos:bd6cc8863c1dad08.description: An updated Battlezone in which you compete in the T-Mek tournament of the future, controlling a hovercraft in an arena and blowing up everyone else, with an overall view of your opponents.
dos:bd6cc8863c1dad08.title: T-Mek

dos:bd7c1dfd012b62b0.description: A fan-made sequel to Chex Quest 2 whose content was found to have been taken from various other WADs.
dos:bd7c1dfd012b62b0.title: Chex Quest 3 (Unofficial)

dos:bd9ac776743d509c.description: A strategy game that recreates the world as the Vikings experienced it, where the gods matter in every decision and a glorious death is a high goal. You compete against other players for the gods' favor.
dos:bd9ac776743d509c.title: Hammer of the Gods

dos:bda16d7cc84da8cf.description: An arcade side-scrolling shooter in which you pilot a submarine through treacherous underwater caves to destroy a heavily guarded reactor, armed with missiles, torpedoes and a Big Kill weapon.
dos:bda16d7cc84da8cf.title: Sea Dragon

dos:bdafa10dbebfb258.description: Ocean's game of the 1992 Olympics in Barcelona, with a variety of disciplines divided into sections including track and field events such as running, relay, hurdles, discus, shot put and jumps.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Olympiad
dos:bdafa10dbebfb258.title: The Games '92: España

dos:bdb53722f9e821b8.description: An unconventional boxing game in which low blows and other normally forbidden moves are allowed. Enter a tournament against the computer or challenge a friend.
dos:bdb53722f9e821b8.title: Low Blow

dos:bdb9ac121b132979.description: A role-playing game set in 2400 A.D. in which you are about to join the Underground resistance. Characters and robots move in real time and are seen from a top-down perspective.
dos:bdb9ac121b132979.title: 2400 A.D.

dos:bdc9c98a4c0dcc49.description: An unusual arcade space simulator from Spanish developers, made in English by a very small team of amateurs and published on physical media.
dos:bdc9c98a4c0dcc49.title: Fripp

dos:bdd84f1c9783410f.description: A shareware educational trilogy for ages three to seven covering maths, the alphabet and reading in sea-themed mini-games. Each volume has five mini games, the first being the Maths Wave.
dos:bdd84f1c9783410f.title: Sea School

dos:bde3d4b4a707be9f.description: A word challenge game that measures your English. Pick the right synonym or definition for the highlighted word from four choices, with a hundred words per volume across four volumes.
dos:bde3d4b4a707be9f.title: Word Whiz

dos:bde616c738d77b44.description: A short Korean shoot-em-up that can be very simple or very difficult depending on settings, with a short story told in Korean before it begins.

dos:bde6b24b9e4ea7b7.description: An educational maths game in which all twelve activities and puzzles are based on setting up and managing a circus, building skills like spatial reasoning and pattern recognition.
dos:bde6b24b9e4ea7b7.title: Math Circus: Act 1

dos:bdea4df48bd2feb5.description: A comic adventure about nine-year-old Willy Beamish getting into trouble with his sister, his teacher Ms. Glass and his parents.
dos:bdea4df48bd2feb5.title: The Adventures of Willy Beamish

dos:bdeb3ea6ef36c61f.description: A stand-alone expansion for Dawn Patrol with SVGA graphics, head-to-head play via modem, improved AI, several camera views, 13 planes and over 150 levels.
dos:bdeb3ea6ef36c61f.title: Dawn Patrol: Head to Head

dos:bded958e520135ea.description: A fan game based on Ron Gilbert's Monkey Island series.
