dos:bded958e520135ea.title: Night of the Hermit

dos:bdf8e63bf0c6fd92.description: The sequel to Impossible Mission. You have 8 hours to stop the psychotic genius Elvin from destroying the world, entering his tower fortress, avoiding robots, assembling security combinations and recovering musical sequences.
dos:bdf8e63bf0c6fd92.title: Impossible Mission II

dos:bdfdd1779b046d6b.description: A Danish platformer based on a Danish television series.
dos:bdfdd1779b046d6b.title: General Dryptud: Jagten Pa Johanna

dos:be034aab4d08e84d.description: A sequel to the original Soccer Management text simulator.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer
dos:be034aab4d08e84d.title: Soccer Game II, The

dos:be06b7e33d46ea14.description: A port of the Windows game Minesweeper back to MS-DOS, with a grid of concealed cells, some containing mines and others showing the number of adjacent mines.
dos:be06b7e33d46ea14.title: DOSMINE

dos:be1260697cb6bed2.description: A single-player shareware Snake variant with keyboard control, adjustable speed and sound toggling.
dos:be1260697cb6bed2.title: Viper (1994)

dos:be2ad27e7cc6380b.description: A puzzle game starring aliens from the planet Phrohmaj, in which you place all the colored tiles into the correct spaces on the board, with always one more tile than spaces.
dos:be2ad27e7cc6380b.title: FlipOut!

dos:be2f4b08eba194c9.description: A basketball game with a black-basketball theme, many game options including one on one and group, and a betting option.
dos:be2f4b08eba194c9.title: Jammit

dos:be35fdb1cb9951a9.description: A freeware billiards game for two players on a pocketless table seen from above, with sliders to set shot power and table temperature, and close-up windows for cue aim.
dos:be35fdb1cb9951a9.title: Biliardo 2

dos:be37fd0ffcd5d5b5.description: A turn-based strategy game in which you play a warlock, sorceress, barbarian or knight, building a castle to earn units such as dragons and cyclopes that strengthen your hero's army.
dos:be37fd0ffcd5d5b5.title: Heroes of Might and Magic

dos:be3b447b9d1ee07e.description: A platformer in which Drake, who came to Africa for treasure, crashes his plane in the jungle and explores 13 levels of cave complex to find the exit, avoiding or killing enemies.
dos:be3b447b9d1ee07e.title: Drake Snake and the Secret Crypt

dos:be4d7ceb6942343b.description: Bloodlust Software's parody of Pong in which the paddles have attitude and special moves and the ball, now a severed head, complains when you hit it.
dos:be4d7ceb6942343b.title: Nogginknockers

dos:be52a81da6e4b402.description: A space shooter reminiscent of Computer Space. Fly a starship on a wrap-around field with inertial thrust in any direction, pursued by enemy formations, firing only left or right.
dos:be52a81da6e4b402.title: XO-Fighter

dos:be5dd19ab2edf837.description: A remake of the Amiga/Atari ST game with a Thrust-like feel. Make your way through levels collecting all cargo containers and returning them to your base, past enemies patrolling the caves.
dos:be5dd19ab2edf837.title: Gravity Force (2000)

dos:be5e933a4e44284d.description: Play five-card draw poker against Donna or Sam in Anco's continuation of the series, exchanging cards, raising bets and managing a starting bankroll of one hundred dollars.
dos:be5e933a4e44284d.title: Str♥p Poker II Plus

dos:be6bf9159c421bf2.description: Take the role of a Marine Corps commander responsible for several divisions, who has to wait for his men to call in with information, in a battle history of the United States Marine Corps.
dos:be6bf9159c421bf2.title: Halls of Montezuma: A Battle History of the United States Marine Corps

dos:be6f34a73cdc44ad.description: A game based on Atari's arcade game in which you play the Road Runner, running along the road, avoiding trucks, landmines and falling rocks, eating birdseed, and not getting caught by Wile E. Coyote.
dos:be6f34a73cdc44ad.title: Road Runner

dos:be7188498b099545.description: You play the mighty Thor, using your hammer to solve problems and deal with beasts, in an action puzzle game with a slightly noticeable story.
dos:be7188498b099545.title: God of Thunder

dos:be760fb4d8389def.description: A homage to 1950s horror films in which you play Count Frederick Valdemar entering a gothic mansion with six levels full of vampires, zombies, ghouls and other creatures.
dos:be760fb4d8389def.title: Horror Zombies from the Crypt

dos:be7ca3cb22c67362.description: A SimCity-like game with a military element, set in the distant future, in which you are Colony Administrator of a new settlement on a far-flung planet, aiming for the highest Quality of Life for the colonists.
dos:be7ca3cb22c67362.title: Utopia: The Creation of a Nation

dos:be7cfd7785e6de5e.description: A strategy game in which you are an aspiring pizza chef who wants to start the best pizza chain in the world. Choose a character with varying starting money and a city in the USA or Europe.
dos:be7cfd7785e6de5e.title: Pizza Tycoon

dos:be82cf548b03fe4d.description: A text adventure at the English Language Institute of the University of Delaware, in which you play an international student arriving at the institute in a simplified simulation of student life.
dos:be82cf548b03fe4d.title: Escape from the ELI

dos:be8745172c924a1e.description: A Concentration game about David from the Bible for 1 to 3 players, who match pairs of facedown cards related to stories of David.
dos:be8745172c924a1e.title: Davidic Matchup

dos:be8965ac84047bb9.description: The sequel to Cyberdogs with improved gameplay. Take your character on missions shooting everything around with weapons bought before missions, with an editor for making your own.
dos:be8965ac84047bb9.title: C-Dogs

dos:be8abd544cfdc3ab.description: A German turn-based racing game in which you choose up to four opponents and one of twenty-five tracks.
dos:be8abd544cfdc3ab.title: Race

dos:be8b7dab992e3394.description: A PC conversion of the stock market board game. Invest in stocks when prices are low and sell when they rise, starting with $5000 in cash and 10 different securities.
dos:be8b7dab992e3394.title: Computer Stocks & Bonds

dos:be8ed2946b6c9cf2.description: A stand-alone add-on to Lemmings with 100 new levels and all new graphics and music.
dos:be8ed2946b6c9cf2.title: Oh No! More Lemmings

dos:beaa286c7f543a20.description: Control a multi-segmented snake in a maze, surviving and earning points. Three enemy snakes enter each level, and you complete it by eating them all, though you can only eat segments of one that outnumbers yours.
dos:beaa286c7f543a20.title: Serpentine

dos:beae27220d457612.description: A shareware first-person action game with a Tron-like plot. The evil Dr. Devaro lures users into The Grid to play malicious games, and you ride a hypercycle against his legions of riders.
dos:beae27220d457612.title: Hypercycles

dos:bec1cf0f4ba763fa.description: A classic space shooter in pure text mode, made for a DOS game creation competition at high-voltage.cz, with source code included.
dos:bec1cf0f4ba763fa.title: Space Assault

dos:bed0a1061986390c.description: A DOS falling-block puzzle game with three difficulty levels, high scores and joypad support. An optional challenge mode deliberately withholds useful pieces, and a monochrome mode suits older displays.
dos:bed0a1061986390c.title: F-Tetris

dos:bed54ddb9ea115ce.description: An adventure in which Hitler escaped by plane to Thunder Bay after the war, and after he kills your friend Mike Lam, you go on a quest to thwart him.
dos:bed54ddb9ea115ce.title: Napalm Quest

dos:bed927d2d0281533.description: A freeware shooting range in which you shoot Barney before he escapes from the screen.
dos:bed927d2d0281533.title: Purple Dinosaur Massacre

dos:bedeb5e695cf4052.description: The second Elder Scrolls RPG, sequel to Arena. Daggerfall thrusts you into a non-linear world full of plots, conspiracy and political intrigue, to be faced with your wits, blade and magic.
dos:bedeb5e695cf4052.title: The Elder Scrolls: Daggerfall

dos:bee39cd5d510d2dc.description: A PC remake of the classic by Dan and Bill Bunten. As an explorer commissioned by the King and Queen of Spain, voyage to a new world, claim land, negotiate with or conquer the natives, and gain fame and fortune.
dos:bee39cd5d510d2dc.title: Seven Cities of Gold: Commemorative Edition

dos:bee53311d6b26163.description: A text-mode 747 flight simulator, possibly the first for PC, with code in BASIC published in BYTE in November 1982. Except at takeoff and landing, you see only the panels and controls, operated by keyboard.
dos:bee53311d6b26163.title: Jetset

dos:bee57f228094ac7e.description: A wargame based on the board game, covering the Persian Gulf region with complete air, land and sea orders of battle for more than a dozen nations. It ends after 25 turns or on other victory conditions.
dos:bee57f228094ac7e.title: Gulf Strike

dos:bee6e79f34fb4549.description: A shareware educational game teaching fractions, decimals, ratios, proportions and percentages to grades 4 to 9. In 2135 a super hero answers a message from the evil super genius Dr. Ronan.
dos:bee6e79f34fb4549.title: Math Assault II Fractions

dos:beea094a03cd63d4.description: The first Duke Nukum episode, Shrapnel City, based on the Crystal Caves engine. In 1997 the mad Dr. Proton plans to conquer the world with an army of Techbots, and Duke Nukum is the only hero who can stop him.
dos:beea094a03cd63d4.title: Duke Nukum: Episode 1 - Shrapnel City

dos:beec3cfdb2213c28.description: A shareware card game played with a 52-card deck. After the deal there is an auction in which players bid on who can win the most points in the trick-playing phase.
dos:beec3cfdb2213c28.title: Tommy's Pitch

dos:bef08fd6fcd30cbd.description: The third Wayne Gretzky Hockey game, adding VGA graphics, voice-overs, more player stats and longer league play, covering both coaching and playing.
dos:bef08fd6fcd30cbd.title: Wayne Gretzky Hockey 3

dos:bf03e786a9c24014.description: A golf game combining a 3-click swing meter with a 3D engine that brings the Australian countryside to life. It has 5 game modes, 3 skill levels and randomized flag placement each round.
dos:bf03e786a9c24014.title: Golf Pro 2000 Downunder

dos:bf10245af59ec4e3.description: The second Despair game, a first-person shooter in which the aliens from the first game are back and after you, using the same 3D engine as Castaway.
dos:bf10245af59ec4e3.title: Despair 2

dos:bf1216cb05f825ba.description: A shareware Tetris clone that shows reflections of each falling block at the bottom of the playground.
dos:bf1216cb05f825ba.title: Novalight Tetris

dos:bf12a47e84915a6c.description: Basically European Racers with a different scenario. Four muscle cars, including a '67 Chevelle and a '71 Hemi 'Cuda, and their parts can be viewed and disassembled in a CAD-like program.
dos:bf12a47e84915a6c.title: Backroad Racers

dos:bf13374669f7eb8b.description: A strange isometric action game from East Asia in which you play a panda, choosing from several pandas including a female one, and find your way home screen by screen.
dos:bf13374669f7eb8b.title: Panda: Go Home!

dos:bf1b169ab102a0cd.description: A Paul Panks text adventure in which you direct Camphora, a phantom beetle, through the environs of Atsuta Jingu, plotting revenge against Sugawara no Michizane.
dos:bf1b169ab102a0cd.title: Ghost of the Fireflies

dos:bf1e965112ebce1e.description: A BASIC game simulating the running of a large multi-user mainframe. As operator you configure memory, disk and tape drives, concurrent users and game speed, then cope with the workload.
dos:bf1e965112ebce1e.title: Computer Operator

dos:bf23baa94cf48984.description: In the remote land of Eoliae, where winds move armies, the Great master has been murdered and the evil Sharkaan threatens the land. You must learn the power of the winds.
dos:bf23baa94cf48984.title: Storm Master

dos:bf35734bf11da54e.description: A naval wargame by Peter Turkan, a programmer and military history lover who made all his games independently, released in 1994 on floppy disks and CD.
dos:bf35734bf11da54e.title: Midway

dos:bf37b074c607ccd6.description: A video adventure technologically almost identical to Goody but with a more complex map, in which you alternate among three weapons and a pole while searching for David Livingstone.
dos:bf37b074c607ccd6.title: Livingstone, I Presume?

dos:bf3ab6f80637b8c9.description: The first Questprobe Marvel Comics game, an illustrated interactive fiction game. As Bruce Banner and the Hulk, free yourself from ropes in a desert bunker and collect all the gems to escape.
dos:bf3ab6f80637b8c9.title: Questprobe featuring The Hulk

dos:bf3d3498d21eb5e0.description: A single-player shareware Mahjong game with twenty tile layouts and several tile sets including traditional, monster, letters, words and colors. It is played entirely with the mouse.
